meaning_1: purification of a religious donation; way of purifying a gift
example_1: catasso dakkhiṇāvisuddhiyo. atth'āvuso, dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato.
commentary: (DNa) dakkhiṇāvisuddhiyo'ti dānasaṅkhātā dakkhiṇā visujjhanti mahapphalā honti etāhī'ti dakkhiṇāvisuddhiyo.

meaning_1: worthy of gifts; worthy of offerings
example_1: yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā, esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā'ti
example_2: viceyya dānaṃ sugatappasatthaṃ, ye dakkhiṇeyyā idha jīvaloke, etesu dinnāni mahapphalāni, bījāni vuttāni yathā sukhette'ti.

meaning_1: recipient; who is worthy of gifts
example_1: yaṃ kho, aggivessana, tādisaṃ dakkhiṇeyyaṃ āgamma avītarāgaṃ avītadosaṃ avītamohaṃ, taṃ dāyakānaṃ bhavissati. yaṃ kho, aggivessana, mādisaṃ dakkhiṇeyyaṃ āgamma vītarāgaṃ vītadosaṃ vītamohaṃ, taṃ tuyhaṃ bhavissatī'ti.

meaning_1: fire (of hell for those abusing) someone worthy of gifts
commentary: (ANa) dakkhiṇeyy'aggī'ti ettha pana dakkhiṇā'ti cattāro paccayā, bhikkhusaṅgho dakkhiṇeyyo. so gihīnaṃ tīsu saraṇesu pañcasu sīlesu dasasu sīlesu mātāpituupaṭṭhāne dhammika-samaṇabrāhmaṇa-upaṭṭhāne'ti evam'ādīsu kalyāṇadhammesu niyojanena bah'ūpakāro, tasmiṃ micchāpaṭipannā gihī bhikkhusaṅghaṃ akkositvā paribhāsitvā niray'ādīsu nibbattanti, tasmā so'pi purimanayen'eva anudahan'aṭṭhena dakkhiṇeyy'aggī'ti vutto.

example_1: mahāsamayo pavanasmiṃ, devakāyā samāgatā, āgat'amha imaṃ dhammasamayaṃ, dakkhitāye aparājitasaṅghan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) dakkhitāye… dassan'atthāya

example_1: seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintī'ti.
atha kho soṇassa koḷivisassa mātāpitaro soṇaṃ koḷivisaṃ etadavocuṃ, rājā te, tāta soṇa, pāde dakkhitu'kāmo. mā kho tvaṃ, tāta soṇa, yena rājā tena pāde abhippasāreyyāsi.
akkhīni ca turiyā'r'iva, kinnariyā'r'iva pabbat'antare, tava me nayanāni dakkhiya, bhiyyo kāmaratī pavaḍḍhati.
commentary: (THIa) tava me nayanāni dakkhiyā'ti tava vuttaguṇavisesāni nayanāni disvā

example_1: eso kho, deva, kālaṅ'kato nāma. na dāni taṃ dakkhanti mātā vā pitā vā aññe vā ñātisālohitā, so'pi na dakkhissati mātaraṃ vā pitaraṃ vā aññe vā ñātisālohite'ti.

evaṃ vutte, ahaṃ, kevaṭṭa, taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavocaṃ, bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhu, sāmuddikā vāṇijā tīradassiṃ sakuṇaṃ gahetvā nāvāya samuddaṃ ajjhogāhanti. te atīradakkhiniyā nāvāya tīradassiṃ sakuṇaṃ muñcanti.
tesaṃ sutvāna sappaññā, sacittaṃ paccaladdhā te, aniccaṃ aniccato dakkhuṃ, dukkham'addakkhu dukkhato.
example_2: aniccaṃ aniccato dakkhuṃ, dukkham'addakkhu dukkhato, anattani anattā'ti, asubhaṃ asubhat'addasuṃ. sammādiṭṭhisamādānā, sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ upaccagun'ti
commentary: (ANa) aniccato dakkhun'ti aniccabhāvena addasaṃsu.

meaning_1: I myself will see; I will know for myself
example_1: kadā nu rūpe amite ca sadde, gandhe rase phusitabbe ca dhamme, ādittato'haṃ samathehi yutto, paññāya dacchaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.
commentary: (THa) paññāya dacchan'ti vipassanāpaññāsahitāya maggapaññāya dakkhissaṃ.

example_1: dāsiṃ dāsaṃ ca so dajjā, assaṃ c'assatarīrathaṃ, hatthiñ'ca kuñjaraṃ dajja, kathaṃ so dajja dārake.
commentary: (JAa) kathaṃ na dajjā'ti kena kāraṇena na dadeyya.

example_1: saccaṃ bhaṇe na kujjheyya, dajjā appam'pi yācito, etehi tīhi ṭhānehi, gacche devāna santike.
example_2: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, sunakkhatta, api nu so puriso amussa āsīvisassa ghoravisassa hatthaṃ vā aṅguṭṭhaṃ vā dajjā yaṃ jaññā, imin'āhaṃ daṭṭho maraṇaṃ vā nigacchāmi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan'ti?

example_2: dā'icc'etassa dhātussa sabbassa dajj'ādeso hoti vā. dajjāmi, dajjeyya, dadāmi, dadeyya.

example_2: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyaṃ aññataro bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṅ'kato hoti.

example_1: uccāliṅga-pāṇaka-daṭṭh'ūpatthambhe'ti uccāliṅga-pāṇaka-daṭṭhena aṅgajātaṃ kammaniyaṃ hoti.
vattu'kāmo haṃsānaṃ sīghavegatāya bārāṇasinagare rājanivesanassa uparibhāgaṃ sampattakāle daṭṭhaṭṭhānato daṇḍakaṃ vissajjetvā ākās'aṅgaṇe patitvā dvedhā bhijji.

meaning_1: should be seen; should be regarded as; should be understood (with)
example_1: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, kabaḷīkāro āhāro daṭṭhabbo?
example_2: imassa nu kho, sāriputta, saṃkhittena bhāsitassa kathaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo'ti? evaṃ vutte, āyasmā sāriputto tuṇhī ahosi.

meaning_1: can be seen; can be witnessed (by)
example_1: yaṃ taṃ nekkhammena ñātabbaṃ nekkhammena daṭṭhabbaṃ nekkhammena pattabbaṃ nekkhammena sacchikātabbaṃ taṃ vata jayaseno rājakumāro kāmamajjhe vasanto kāme paribhuñjanto kāmavitakkehi khajjamāno kāmapariḷāhena pariḍayhamāno kāmapariyesanāya ussuko ñassati vā dakkhati vā sacchi vā karissatī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
iti kho, bhikkhave, tathāgato daṭṭhā daṭṭhabbaṃ, diṭṭhaṃ na maññati, adiṭṭhaṃ na maññati, daṭṭhabbaṃ na maññati, daṭṭhāraṃ na maññati.
iti kho, bhikkhave, tathāgato daṭṭhā daṭṭhabbaṃ, diṭṭhaṃ na maññati, adiṭṭhaṃ na maññati, daṭṭhabbaṃ na maññati, daṭṭhāraṃ na maññati.
commentary: (ANa) daṭṭhā daṭṭhabban'ti disvā daṭṭhabbaṃ

example_1: kāmesu vinaya gedhaṃ, nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato, uggahītaṃ nirattaṃ vā, mā te vijjittha kiñcanaṃ.
example_2: so'haṃ evaṃ viharanto, ñatvā dhammaṃ nirūpadhiṃ, ārogye yobbanasmiñ'ca, jīvitasmiñ'ca ye madā, sabbe made abhibho'smi, nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato
commentary: (SNPa) daṭṭhū'ti disvā. (SaPM) apica, nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato'ti ettha daṭṭhun'ti padassa disvā'ti atthadassanato yath'ārahaṃ tum'antāni tvāsadd'antapad'atthavasena'pi gahetabbāni

meaning_1: wanting to see; wishing to visit
example_1: taṃ saddaṃ sutvā turitam'avasarī so, suddh'odanassa tada bhavanaṃ upāvisi, nisajja tattha idam'avocāsi sakye, kuhiṃ kumāro aham'api daṭṭhu'kāmo.
yattha nu kho, bhante, na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjati, sakkā nu kho so, bhante, gamanena lokassa anto ñātuṃ vā daṭṭhuṃ vā pāpuṇituṃ vā'ti?
example_2: iccheyyāsi no tvaṃ, mārisa moggallāna, vejayantassa pāsādassa rāmaṇeyyakaṃ daṭṭhun'ti? adhivāsesi kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno tuṇhībhāvena.

example_1: yattha kho, āvuso, na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjati, n'āhaṃ taṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ daṭṭheyyaṃ patteyyan'ti vadāmī'ti.
example_2: yathā yathā vā pana taṃ ñāteyyaṃ vā daṭṭheyyaṃ vā sacchikareyyaṃ vā, tathā tathā ñassati vā dakkhati vā sacchikarissati vā'ti ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati.
commentary: (ANa) daṭṭheyyan'ti daṭṭhabbaṃ.

meaning_1: burnt; burnt down; consumed by fire
example_1: tena kho pana samayena rañño utenassa uyyānagatassa antepuraṃ daḍḍhaṃ hoti, pañca ca itthisatāni kālaṅ'katāni honti sāmāvatīpamukhāni.
example_2: seyyathā'pi vā pana nandiya sukkhe tiṇadāye aggi mutto ḍahaññ'eva gacchati no daḍḍhaṃ paccudāvattati
commentary: (VINa) daḍḍhan'ti agginā daḍḍhaṃ.

example_1: avinaṭṭhe vinaṭṭhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. adaḍḍhe daḍḍhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. avilutte viluttasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
sabbe tasanti daṇḍassa, sabbesaṃ jīvitaṃ piyaṃ, attānaṃ upamaṃ katvā, na haneyya na ghātaye.
example_2: tasmā't'iha, phagguna, tava ce'pi koci pāṇinā pahāraṃ dadeyya, leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dadeyya, daṇḍena pahāraṃ dadeyya, satthena pahāraṃ dadeyya, tatrā'pi tvaṃ, phagguna, ye gehasitā chandā ye gehasitā vitakkā te pajaheyyāsi.
commentary: (SNa) daṇḍenā'ti catuhatthadaṇḍena vā khadiradaṇḍena vā ghaṭikamuggarena vā.

example_1: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā daṇḍam'olubbha ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi
example_2: alaṃ, āvuso dāsaka, kiṃ imāya sandhāvanikāya! āhar'āvuso, daṇḍaṃ, aham'eva yena therā bhikkhū ten'upasaṅkamissāmī'ti.

example_1: nidhāya daṇḍaṃ bhūtesu, tasesu thāvaresu ca, yo na hanti na ghāteti, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā rañño dasseyyuṃ, ayaṃ te, deva, coro āgucārī, imassa yaṃ icchasi taṃ daṇḍaṃ paṇehī'ti

anekehi sambhārehi samāraddhā vadati, seyyath'idaṃ, doṇiñ'ca paṭicca cammañ'ca paṭicca daṇḍañ'ca paṭicca upadhāraṇe ca paṭicca tantiyo ca paṭicca koṇañ'ca paṭicca purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca ev'āyaṃ, bhante, vīṇā nāma anekasambhārā mahāsambhārā.
commentary: (DNt) daṇḍo'ti vīṇadaṇḍo.

example_1: na kho, āvuso gotama, āciṇṇaṃ nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa kammaṃ, kamman'ti paññapetuṃ. daṇḍaṃ, daṇḍan'ti kho, āvuso gotama, āciṇṇaṃ nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa paññapetun'ti.
commentary: (MNa) daṇḍāni paññapetī'ti idaṃ nigaṇṭhasamayena pucchanto āha.

meaning_1: with a stick; having a handle
example_1: anekasākhañ'ca sahassamaṇḍalaṃ, chattaṃ marū dhārayum'antalikkhe, suvaṇṇadaṇḍā vītipatanti cāmarā, na dissare cāmarachattagāhakā.
vuttaṃ kho pan'etaṃ bhagavatā kakac'ūpam'ovāde, ubhatodaṇḍakena ce'pi, bhikkhave, kakacena corā ocarakā aṅgam'aṅgāni okanteyyuṃ, tatrā'pi yo mano padūseyya na me so tena sāsanakaro'ti.
saṇhanūpurasuvaṇṇamaṇḍitā, sobhare su jaṅghā pure mama, tā jarāya tiladaṇḍakā'r'iva, saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā.
example_2: vattu'kāmo haṃsānaṃ sīghavegatāya bārāṇasinagare rājanivesanassa uparibhāgaṃ sampattakāle daṭṭhaṭṭhānato daṇḍakaṃ vissajjetvā ākās'aṅgaṇe patitvā dvedhā bhijji.

example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, sutaṃ te daṇḍak'āraññaṃ kāliṅg'āraññaṃ majjh'āraññaṃ mātaṅg'āraññaṃ araññaṃ araññabhūtan'ti?
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, sutaṃ te daṇḍakī'raññaṃ kāliṅg'āraññaṃ majjh'āraññaṃ mātaṅg'āraññaṃ araññaṃ araññabhūtan'ti?
commentary: (MNa) tattha daṇḍakī'raññ'ādīnaṃ evaṃ araññabhūtabhāvo jānitabbo, sarabhaṅgabodhisattassa tāva parisāya ativepullataṃ gatāya kisavaccho nāma tāpaso mahāsattassa antevāsī vivekavāsaṃ patthayamāno gaṇaṃ pahāya godhāvarītīrato kaliṅgaraṭṭhe daṇḍakī'rañño kumbhapuraṃ nāma nagaraṃ upanissāya rāj'uyyāne vivekamanubrūhayamāno viharati. tassa senāpati upaṭṭhāko hoti.

example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, sutaṃ te daṇḍakī'raññaṃ kāliṅg'āraññaṃ majjh'āraññaṃ mātaṅg'āraññaṃ araññaṃ araññabhūtan'ti?

meaning_1: threatened with a stick; threatened with punishment
example_1: ye'pi'ssa te honti dāsā'ti vā pessā'ti vā kammakarā'ti vā, te'pi daṇḍatajjitā bhayatajjitā assumukhā rudamānā parikammāni karonti.
example_2: akkuddhasantā vadhadaṇḍatajjitā, aduṭṭhacittā patino titikkhati, akkodhanā bhattuvas'ānuvattinī, yā evarūpā purisassa bhariyā, dāsī ca bhariyā'ti ca sā pavuccati.
commentary: (ANa) vadhadaṇḍatajjitā'ti daṇḍakaṃ gahetvā vadhena tajjitā, ghātessāmi nan'ti vuttā.

meaning_1: leaning on a stick; supported by a staff
example_1: ambho purisa, na tvaṃ addasa manussesu itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā āsītikaṃ vā nāvutikaṃ vā vassasatikaṃ vā jātiyā jiṇṇaṃ gopānasivaṅkaṃ bhoggaṃ daṇḍaparāyaṇaṃ pavedhamānaṃ gacchantaṃ āturaṃ gatayobbanaṃ khaṇḍadantaṃ palitakesaṃ vilūnaṃ khallitasiraṃ valitaṃ tilak'āhatagattan'ti?
commentary: (MNa) daṇḍaparāyaṇan'ti daṇḍapaṭisaraṇaṃ daṇḍadutiyaṃ.

meaning_1: leaning on a staff; supported by a walking stick
meaning_2: leaning on a stick, supported by a staff
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, tam'eva bhaginiṃ passeyya aparena samayena āsītikaṃ vā nāvutikaṃ vā vassasatikaṃ vā jātiyā, jiṇṇaṃ gopānasivaṅkaṃ bhoggaṃ daṇḍaparāyanaṃ pavedhamānaṃ gacchantiṃ āturaṃ gatayobbanaṃ khaṇḍadantaṃ palitakesaṃ, vilūnaṃ khalitasiraṃ valinaṃ tilak'āhatagattaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) daṇḍaparāyaṇan'ti daṇḍapaṭisaraṇaṃ daṇḍadutiyaṃ.

meaning_1: with a stick in hand; carrying a staff
meaning_2: carrying a staff in one's hand
example_1: na daṇḍapāṇissa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
commentary: (VINa) daṇḍapāṇissā'ti ettha daṇḍo nāma majjhimassa purisassa catuhatthappamāṇo daṇḍapāṇibhāvo pan'assa chattapāṇimhi vuttanayen'eva veditabbo.

example_1: daṇḍapāṇi'pi kho sakko jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena mahāvanaṃ ten'upasaṅkami
commentary: (MNa) daṇḍapāṇī'ti na jarādubbalatāya daṇḍahattho. ayañ'hi taruṇo paṭhamavaye ṭhito, daṇḍacittatāya pana suvaṇṇadaṇḍaṃ gahetvā vicarati, tasmā daṇḍapāṇī'ti vutto.

example_1: na h'ettha, brāhmaṇa, dissanti daṇḍappahārā'pi galaggahā'pi, tasmā evarūpaṃ yaññaṃ upasaṅkamanti arahanto vā arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpannā.
commentary: (DNa) daṇḍappahārā'ti, paṭipāṭiyā tiṭṭhatha tiṭṭhathā'ti ujuṃ gantvā gaṇhatha gaṇhathā'ti ca ādīni vatvā dīyamānā daṇḍappahārā'pi galaggāhā'pi dissanti.

meaning_1: fear of chastisement; peril of punishment
example_1: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, daṇḍabhayaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco passati coraṃ āgucāriṃ, rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārente
example_2: att'ānuvādabhayam'pi dukkhaṃ, par'ānuvādabhayam'pi dukkhaṃ, daṇḍabhayam'pi dukkhaṃ, duggatibhayam'pi dukkhaṃ… evarūpāni, mahārāja, bahuvidhāni anekavidhāni dukkhāni saṃsāragato anubhavati.
commentary: (ANa) daṇḍabhayan'ti dvattiṃsa kammakāraṇā paṭicca uppajjanakabhayaṃ.

grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of daṇḍamantara
meaning_1: across a stick; near a stick
example_1: te na kumbhimukhā paṭiggaṇhanti na kaḷopimukhā paṭiggaṇhanti na eḷakam'antaraṃ na daṇḍam'antaraṃ na musalam'antaraṃ na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ na gabbhiniyā na pāyamānāya na puris'antaragatāya
commentary: (DNa) na eḷakam'antaran'ti ummāraṃ antaraṃ katvā diyyamānaṃ na gaṇhati. kasmā? ayaṃ maṃ nissāya antarakaraṇaṃ labhatī'ti. daṇḍamusalesu'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: (comm) type of bird with a human face
example_1: suka-sāḷika-sadd'ettha, daṇḍamāṇavakāni ca, sobhati sabbakālaṃ sā, kuveranaḷinī sadā.
commentary: (DNa) daṇḍamāṇavakāni cā'ti manussamukhasakuṇā.

meaning_2: kind of bird with a human face

meaning_1: hanging onto a walking stick; leaning on a staff
example_1: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā daṇḍam'olubbha ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi

tena hi, samma migava, alaṃ dān'ajja uyyānabhūmiyā. tam'eva dāni mayaṃ bhavantaṃ raṭṭhapālaṃ payirupāsissāmā'ti.
commentary: (DNa) alaṃ dān'ajja uyyānabhūmiyā'ti, ajja uyyānabhūmiṃ passissāmā'ti gacchāma, alaṃ tāya uyyānabhūmiyā'ti saṃviggahadayo saṃveg'ānurūpam'āha.

meaning_lit: for the sake of a gift
example_1: ārogy'atthāya moceti, sukh'atthāya moceti, bhesajj'atthāya moceti, dān'atthāya moceti, puññ'atthāya moceti, yaññ'atthāya moceti, sagg'atthāya moceti
commentary: (VIN) dān'atthāyā'ti dānaṃ dassāmi.

example_1: puna caparaṃ, sīha, dāyako dānapati yaṃ yadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati, yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado'va upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto.
example_2: bhūtapubb'āhaṃ, bhante, sirī nāma rājā ahosiṃ dāyako dānapati dānassa vaṇṇavādī.

meaning_1: source of charity; stream of generosity
commentary: (VINa) dānapathānī'ti dānāni'y'eva vuccanti. atha vā dānapathānī'ti dānanibaddhāni dānavattānī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: highest state of generosity; perfection of giving
meaning_2: highest state of generosity; perfection of giving
example_1: vicinanto tadā dakkhiṃ, paṭhamaṃ dānapāramiṃ, pubbakehi mah'esīhi, anuciṇṇaṃ mahāpathaṃ.
example_2: ehi amma piyadhīti, piyā me dānapāramī, hadayaṃ me'bhisiñcetha, karotha vacanaṃ mama.
commentary: (APAa) bāhirakabhaṇḍapariccāgo dānapāramī nāma, aṅgapariccāgo dānaupapāramī nāma, jīvitapariccāgo dānaparamatthapāramī nāmā'ti dasa pāramiyo dasa upapāramiyo dasa paramatthapāramiyo'ti samattiṃsa pāramiyo telayantaṃ vinivaṭṭento viya mahāmeruṃ matthaṃ katvā cakkavāḷamahāsamuddaṃ āluḷento viya ca sammasati.

meaning_1: fruit of giving; result of generosity
example_1: atha kho sīho senāpati yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho sīho senāpati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, sakkā nu kho, bhante, bhagavā sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ paññāpetun'ti?
example_2: laddheyyaṃ labhate macco, tattha dānaphalaṃ kuto, n'atthi dānaphalaṃ deva, avaso devavīriyo.

meaning_1: made by giving; produced by charity
meaning_2: made by giving; produced by charity
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu parittaṃ kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu parittaṃ kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ n'ābhisambhoti.
example_2: kusalā cetanā kām'āvacarā rūp'āvacarā dānamayā sīlamayā bhāvanāmayā, ayaṃ vuccati puññ'ābhisaṅkhāro.
commentary: (ANa) dānam'eva dānamayaṃ, dānacetanāsu vā purimacetanāto nipphannā sanniṭṭhāpakacetanā dānamayaṃ sīl'ādīhi sīlamayādīni viya.

meaning_1: produced by generosity; derived from offering
example_1: atha kho yāni tāni kulāni aḍḍhāni mahaddhanāni mahābhogāni pahūtajātarūparajatāni pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇāni pahūtadhanadhaññāni, sabbāni tāni dānasambhūtāni c'eva saccasambhūtāni ca sāmaññasambhūtāni ca.
commentary: (SNa) dānasambhūtānī'ti dānena sambhūtāni nibbattāni. sesapadadvaye'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: giving and sharing; offering and distributing
example_1: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno daḷhasamādāno ahosi kusalesu dhammesu, avatthitasamādāno kāyasucarite vacīsucarite manosucarite dānasaṃvibhāge sīlasamādāne uposath'upavāse matteyyatāya petteyyatāya sāmaññatāya brahmaññatāya kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyitāya aññatar'aññataresu ca adhikusalesu dhammesu.
commentary: (DNa) dānasaṃvibhāge'ti ettha ca dānam'eva diyyanavasena dānaṃ, saṃvibhāgakaraṇavasena saṃvibhāgo.

meaning_1: loving to give and share; who delights in sharing gifts; who enjoys distributing charity
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, cāgadhanaṃ

meaning_1: accustomed to giving; in the habit of donating
example_1: dāyako'ti dānasīlo. dānapatī'ti yaṃ dānaṃ demi, tassa pati hutvā demi, na dāso na sahāyo.

meaning_1: grounds for giving; reason for donation
example_1: aṭṭha dānavatthūni. āsajja dānaṃ deti, bhayā dānaṃ deti, adāsi me'ti dānaṃ deti, dassati me'ti dānaṃ deti, sāhu dānan'ti dānaṃ deti, ahaṃ pacāmi, ime na pacanti, n'ārahāmi pacanto apacantānaṃ dānaṃ na dātun'ti dānaṃ deti, idaṃ me dānaṃ dadato kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchatī'ti dānaṃ deti.
commentary: (DNa) dānavatthūnī'ti dānakāraṇāni.

example_1: kālakañcā mahābhismā, asurā dānaveghasā, vepacitti sucitti ca, pahārādo namucī saha.
commentary: (DNa) asurā dānaveghasā'ti dānaveghasā nāma aññe dhanuggaha-asurā.

meaning_2: distributor of alms or who serves in feeding

example_1: pubbakāraṃ karotī'ti dān'ādikaṃ kusalakiccaṃ paṭhamataraṃ karoti.

example_2: sve dān'āhaṃ sake nivesane bhagavato vādaṃ āropessāmī'ti bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, adhivāsetu me, bhante, bhagavā svātanāya attacatuttho bhattan'ti.

example_1: atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, handa dāni, bhikkhave, āmantayāmi vo, vayadhammā saṅkhārā appamādena sampādethā'ti. ayaṃ tathāgatassa pacchimā vācā.
example_2: pariccattaṃ kho rañño nāgassa jīvitaṃ. n'atthi dāni kiñci rañño nāgassa akaraṇīyan'ti.

example_1: yehi manussā āgataṃ bhikkhuṃ na manasi karonti, tatra bhikkhussa evaṃ hoti, kosu nāma idāni maṃ imasmiṃ kule paribhindi, virattarūpā dān'ime mayi manussā'ti
paṇḍupalāso'va dāni'si, yamapurisā'pi ca te upaṭṭhitā, uyyogamukhe ca tiṭṭhasi, pātheyyam'pi ca te na vijjati.
example_2: upanītavayo ca dāni'si, sampayāto'si yamassa santike, vāso te n'atthi antarā, pātheyyam'pi ca te na vijjati.

commentary: (DNa) dān'ūpapattiyo'ti dānapaccayā upapattiyo.

meaning_1: having caused to give; having had given (to)

example_1: sehi dārehi asantuṭṭho, vesiyāsu padussati, dussati paradāresu, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

example_2: idha pana, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃ'y'eva appamattakaṃ pāpakammaṃ kataṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hoti, n'ānu'pi khāyati, kiṃ bahu'd'eva.

meaning_1: who has seen the Dhamma; who has perceived reality
meaning_2: who has realized the final truth
example_1: atha kho brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
commentary: (MNa) diṭṭho ariyasaccadhammo etenā'ti diṭṭhadhammo.

meaning_1: Nibbāna in this life; complete cooling in the present existence
example_1: sato vā pana sattassa ucchedaṃ vināsaṃ vibhavaṃ paññapenti, diṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ vā pan'eke abhivadanti.
commentary: (MNa) diṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ vā'ti iminā pañca diṭṭhadhammanibbānavādā kathitā. tattha diṭṭhadhammo'ti paccakkhadhammo vuccati, tattha tattha paṭiladdhaattabhāvass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. diṭṭhadhamme nibbānaṃ diṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ, imasmiṃ'y'eva attabhāve dukkhavūpasaman'ti attho.

meaning_1: attained Nibbāna in this very life; whose fire has gone out here and now
example_1: jarāmaraṇassa ce, āvuso, bhikkhu nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto hoti, diṭṭhadhammanibbānappatto bhikkhū'ti alaṃ vacanāya.

meaning_1: doctrine of total emancipation in this life itself
meaning_2: (proponent of the) doctrine of total emancipation in this life itself
example_1: apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhiyā katamehi catucattālīsāya ākārehi abhiniveso hoti? soḷasa saññīvādā, aṭṭha asaññīvādā, aṭṭha n'evasaññī-n'āsaññī-vādā, satta ucchedavādā, pañca diṭṭhadhammanibbānavādā, apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhiyā imehi catucattālīsāya ākārehi abhiniveso hoti.
commentary: (PMa) diṭṭhadhammo'ti paccakkhadhammo, tattha tattha paṭiladdha-attabhāvass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. diṭṭhadhamme nibbānaṃ diṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ, imasmiṃ'y'eva attabhāve dukkhavūpasamo'ti attho, taṃ vadantī'ti diṭṭhadhammanibbānavādā.

meaning_1: holding the doctrine of total emancipation in this life itself
meaning_2: holding the doctrine of total emancipation in this life itself
example_1: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā diṭṭhadhammanibbānavādā sato sattassa paramadiṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ paññapenti pañcahi vatthūhi.
commentary: (DNa) diṭṭhadhammanibbānavāde diṭṭhadhammo'ti paccakkhadhammo vuccati, tattha tattha paṭiladdhattabhāvass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. diṭṭhadhamme nibbānaṃ diṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ, imasmiṃ'y'eva attabhāve dukkhavūpasamanan'ti attho. taṃ vadantī'ti diṭṭhadhammanibbānavādā. paramadiṭṭhadhammanibbānan'ti paramaṃ diṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ uttaman'ti attho.

meaning_1: comfortable existence in this very life; pleasant way to pass the time here and now
example_1: taṃ t'āhaṃ, bhikkhu, evaṃ vadāmi, iṅgha tvaṃ, mārisa, app'ossukko diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāram'anuyutto viharassu, anakkhātaṃ kusalañ'hi, mārisa, mā paraṃ ovadāhī'ti.
example_2: yato ca kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu… catunnañ'ca jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī… evaṃ so ten'aṅgena paripūro hoti.
commentary: (ANa) diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārāyā'ti imasmiṃ'y'eva paccakkhe attabhāve sukhavihār'atthāya.

meaning_1: enjoying a comfortable existence here and now; pursuing a pleasant life in this very world
example_1: taṃ t'āhaṃ, bhikkhu, evaṃ vadāmi, iṅgha tvaṃ, mārisa, app'ossukko diṭṭhadhamma-sukhavihāram'anuyutto viharassu, anakkhātaṃ kusalañ'hi, mārisa, mā paraṃ ovadāhī'ti.

meaning_1: to be felt in this life; to be experienced here and now
example_1: evarūpassa, bhikkhave, puggalassa tādisaṃ'y'eva appamattakaṃ pāpakammaṃ kataṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hoti, n'āṇu'pi khāyati, kiṃ bahu'd'eva.
example_2: puna capar'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, te nigaṇṭhe evaṃ vadāmi, taṃ kiṃ maññath'āvuso nigaṇṭhā, yam'idaṃ kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā samparāyavedanīyaṃ hotū'ti labbham'etan'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.
commentary: (MNa) diṭṭhadhammavedanīyan'ti imasmiṃ'y'eva attabhāve vipākadāyakaṃ.

meaning_1: for the sake of welfare in this life; for benefit in this world
construction:
diṭṭha + dhamma + hita + attha + āya
diṭṭhadhammahitattha + āya
example_1: diṭṭhadhammahit'atthāya, samparāyasukhāya ca, kat'āvakāsā pucchāma, yaṃ kiñci abhipatthitan'ti.
commentary: (JAa) diṭṭhadhammahit'atthāyā'ti imasmiṃ'y'eva attabhāve hit'atthāya ca paraloke sukh'atthāya ca hotī'ti.

meaning_1: attained perfection and mastery of direct knowledge in this very life
sanskrit: dṛṣṭadharma + abhijñā + vi + avasāna + pārami + prāpta
family_compound: diṭṭha dhamma abhiññā vosāna pāramī patta3
example_1: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho saṅgāravo māṇavo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, santi kho, bho gotama, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā diṭṭhadhamm'ābhiññā-vosāna-pāramippattā, ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānanti.
commentary: (MNa) diṭṭhadhamm'ābhiññā-vosāna-pāramippattā'ti diṭṭhadhamme abhiññāte imasmiññ'eva attabhāve abhijānitvā vositavosānā hutvā pāramīsaṅkhātaṃ sabbadhammānaṃ pārabhūtaṃ nibbānaṃ pattā mayan'ti vatvā ādibrahmacariyaṃ paṭijānantī'ti attho.

meaning_1: completely quenched in this life; perfectly extinguished here and now
meaning_2: completely calmed in this life; perfectly extinguished here and now
example_1: etadaññāya ye satā, diṭṭhadhamm'ābhinibbutā, upasantā ca te sadā, tiṇṇā loke visattikan'ti.
example_2: te appamattā sukhino, diṭṭhadhamm'ābhinibbutā, sabbaverabhay'ātītā, sabbadukkhaṃ upaccagun'ti.
commentary: (ANa) diṭṭhadhamm'ābhinibbutā'ti diṭṭhadhamme imasmiṃ'y'eva attabhāve sabbakilesanibbānena nibbutā. (SNPa) diṭṭhadhamm'ābhinibbutā'ti viditadhammattā, diṭṭhadhammattā, rāg'ādi-nibbānena ca abhinibbutā. sesaṃ sabbattha pākaṭam'eva.

meaning_1: concerning this life; regarding this world; relevant to here and now
example_1: duve imā cakkhumatā pakāsitā, nibbānadhātū anissitena tādinā, ekā hi dhātu idha diṭṭhadhammikā, saupādisesā bhavanettisaṅkhayā, anupādisesā pana samparāyikā, yamhi nirujjhanti bhavāni sabbaso.
example_2: atha kho brahm'āyussa brāhmaṇassa etadahosi, kat'āvakāso kho'mhi samaṇena gotamena. kiṃ nu kho ahaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ puccheyyaṃ, diṭṭhadhammikaṃ vā atthaṃ samparāyikaṃ vā'ti.
commentary: (ITIa) diṭṭhadhammikā'ti imasmiṃ attabhāve bhavā vattamānā.

meaning_1: in this life and the next; here and hereafter
suffering in this life and the next
concerning benefit in this life and the hereafter
striving in the present; making an effort here and now
example_1: sace, bhikkhave, sattā diṭṭhadhamm'ūpakkamahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, addhā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā evarūpā diṭṭhadhamm'ūpakkamā yaṃ eta'r'ahi evarūpā dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.

meaning_1: due to striving in the present; because of exertion here and now
example_1: sace, bhikkhave, sattā diṭṭhadhamm'ūpakkamahetu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, addhā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā evarūpā diṭṭhadhamm'ūpakkamā yaṃ eta'r'ahi evarūpā dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti.

meaning_1: who has seen the way; who has seen the state (of Nibbāna)
example_1: kiñ'c'āpi so kamma karoti pāpakaṃ, kāyena vācā uda cetasā vā, abhabba so tassa paṭicchadāya, abhabbatā diṭṭhapadassa vuttā, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
diṭṭhapubbo pana te, bhikkhu, so bhagavā, disvā ca pana jāneyyāsī'ti? na kho me, āvuso, diṭṭhapubbo so bhagavā, disvā c'āhaṃ na jāneyyan'ti.

meaning_1: who has attained vision (of Nibbāna); epithet of a stream-enterer
family_set: epithets of stream entry; types of ariyas
commentary: (ADha) diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ passitaṃ paññāyā'ti diṭṭhappatto. ayam'pi kāyasakkhī viya chabbidho'va hoti.

meaning_2: who believes in auspicious things seen

meaning_1: merely the seen; only what is seen; sight itself
example_1: ettha ca te, māluṅkyaputta, diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbesu dhammesu diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati, sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati, mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati, viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati.
commentary: (UDa) tattha diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattan'ti rūp'āyatane cakkhuviññāṇena diṭṭhamattaṃ.

meaning_1: perceiving as seen; thinking one has seen (something)
commentary: (VINa) adiṭṭhe diṭṭhasaññino'ti arahatte ñāṇacakkhunā adiṭṭhey'eva, diṭṭhaṃ amhehi arahattan'ti diṭṭhasaññino hutvā. esa nayo appatt'ādīsu.

meaning_1: who has found calm; who has realized peace

meaning_2: comparing one's view on things seen or known

example_1: udabindu yathā'pi pokkhare, padume vāri yathā na limpati, evaṃ muni n'opalimpati, yadidaṃ diṭṭhasutaṃ mutesu vā.
example_2: ubhosu antesu vineyya chandaṃ, phassaṃ pariññāya anānugiddho, yadattagarahīī tadakubbamāno, na lippatī diṭṭhasutesu dhīro.

meaning_2: visible audible feelable and knowable; seen, heard, felt and known
compound_construction: diṭṭha ca suta ca muta ca viññāta ca
example_1: idha diṭṭhasutamutaviññātesu, piyarūpesu hemaka, chandarāgavinodanaṃ, nibbānapadam'accutaṃ.

meaning_1: visible, audible, sensible and knowable; which can be seen, heard, sensed and known
meaning_lit: to be seen heard sensed and known
compound_construction: diṭṭha ca suta ca muta ca viññātabba ca
example_1: ettha ca te, māluṅkyaputta, diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbesu dhammesu diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati, sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati, mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati, viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati.
example_2: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā diṭṭha-suta-muta-viññātabba-saṅkhāra-mattena etassa āyatanassa upasampadaṃ paññapenti, byasanañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, akkhāyati etassa āyatanassa upasampadāya.
commentary: (MNa) diṭṭha-suta-muta-viññātabba-saṅkhāra-mattenā'ti diṭṭhaviññātabbamattena sutaviññātabbamattena mutaviññātabbamattena. ettha ca vijānātī'ti viññātabbaṃ, diṭṭha-suta-muta-viññātabba-mattena pañcadvārikasaññā-pavatti-mattenā'ti ayañ'hi ettha attho.

meaning_1: mere visible, audible, sensible and knowable conditions; just fabrications which can be seen, heard, sensed and known
sanskrit: dṛṣṭa + śruta + mata + vijñātavya + saṃskāra + mātra
family_compound: diṭṭha suta muta viññātabba saṅkhāra mattā
example_1: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā diṭṭha-suta-muta-viññātabba-saṅkhāra-mattena etassa āyatanassa upasampadaṃ paññapenti, byasanañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, akkhāyati etassa āyatanassa upasampadāya.
commentary: (MNa) diṭṭha-suta-muta-viññātabba-saṅkhāra-mattenā'ti diṭṭhaviññātabbamattena sutaviññātabbamattena mutaviññātabbamattena. ettha ca vijānātī'ti viññātabbaṃ, diṭṭha-suta-muta-viññātabba-mattena pañcadvārikasaññā-pavatti-mattenā'ti ayañ'hi ettha attho.

example_1: ye kec'ime samaṇabrāhmaṇāse, diṭṭhassuten'āpi vadanti suddhiṃ, sīlabbatenāpi vadanti suddhiṃ, anekarūpena vadanti suddhiṃ, kacci'ssu te bhagavā tattha yatā carantā, atāru jātiñ'ca jarañ'ca mārisa, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.
commentary: (NIDD2) diṭṭhassuten'āpi vadanti suddhin'ti diṭṭhena'pi suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ vadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharanti, sutenapi suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ vadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharanti, diṭṭhassutena'pi suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ vadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharantī'ti, diṭṭhassuten'āpi vadanti suddhiṃ.

meaning_1: who speaks about the seen; who states what one has seen (as)
example_1: diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā, sute sutavāditā, mute mutavāditā, viññāte viññātavāditā, ime kho, āvuso, cattāro vohārā tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena samma'd'akkhātā.
example_2: aṭṭh'ime, bhikkhave, ariyavohārā. katame aṭṭha? adiṭṭhe adiṭṭhavāditā, asute asutavāditā, amute amutavāditā, aviññāte aviññātavāditā, diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā, sute sutavāditā, mute mutavāditā, viññāte viññātavāditā.
commentary: (MNa) diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā'ti-ādīsu yāya cetanāya diṭṭhe diṭṭhaṃ me'ti vadati, sā diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā nāma. (DNa) diṭṭhavāditā'ti diṭṭhaṃ mayā'ti evaṃ vāditā.

meaning_1: who speaks about the seen; who states what one has seen (as)
example_1: adiṭṭhe diṭṭhavādī hoti, asute sutavādī hoti, amute mutavādī hoti, aviññāte viññātavādī hoti… adiṭṭhe adiṭṭhavādī hoti, asute asutavādī hoti, amute amutavādī hoti, aviññāte aviññātavādī hoti.

te tassa satt'āhassa accayena tiṇagahanā vanagahanā rukkhagahanā nadīviduggā pabbatavisamā nikkhamitvā aññam'aññaṃ āliṅgitvā sabhāgāyissanti samassāsissanti, diṭṭhā, bho, sattā jīvasi, diṭṭhā, bho, sattā jīvasīti.

meaning_1: disposition of view; tendency to a belief
example_1: ath'evaṃ diṭṭh'ādhimuttīnaṃ yathāsatti yathābalaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ indriyaparopariyatta-ñāṇena indriyaparopariyattaṃ passati, saddh'ādīnaṃ tikkhamudubhāvadassanato.
kiñ'c'āpi, bhikkhave, evarūpassa puggalassa na diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjati, atha kho naṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, kalyāṇamitto purisapuggalo kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko'ti.
example_2: ye'me, bho gotama, kulaputtā bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ uddissa saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, bhavaṃ tesaṃ gotamo pubbaṅ'gamo, bhavaṃ tesaṃ gotamo bahukāro, bhavaṃ tesaṃ gotamo samādapetā, bhoto ca pana gotamassa sā janatā diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjatī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjatī'ti dassan'ānugatiṃ paṭipajjati, yan'diṭṭhiko bhavaṃ gotamo yaṃkhantiko yaṃruciko, te'pi tan'diṭṭhikā honti taṃkhantikā taṃrucikā'ti attho.

meaning_1: underlying tendency towards views; inherent inclination towards opinions; underlying conceptual beliefs
example_1: es'ev'anto rāg'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto paṭigh'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto diṭṭh'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto vicikicch'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto mān'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto bhavarāg'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto avijj'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto daṇḍ'ādāna-satth'ādāna-kalaha-viggaha-vivāda-tuvaṃtuvaṃ-pesuñña-musāvādānaṃ
example_2: kāmarāg'ānusayassa… paṭigh'ānusayassa… diṭṭh'ānusayassa… vicikicch'ānusayassa… mān'ānusayassa… bhavarāg'ānusayassa… avijj'ānusayassa pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati.

example_1: keci pana ekattan'ti ekattanayaṃ vadanti nānattan'ti nānattanayaṃ. apare ekattasaññī attā hoti arogo paraṃ maraṇā, nānattasaññī attā hotī'ti evaṃ diṭṭh'ābhinivesaṃ. taṃ sabbaṃ idha n'ādhippetattā ayuttam'eva hoti.
commentary: (ANt) diṭṭhi'y'eva saccan'tiādi-vasena abhinivisatī'ti diṭṭh'ābhiniveso.

meaning_1: openly expressing one's opinion; voicing one's dissent
example_1: evañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, te bhikkhū tāhi āpattīhi vuṭṭhitā honti, ṭhapetvā thullavajjaṃ, ṭhapetvā gihippaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, ṭhapetvā diṭṭh'āvikammaṃ, ṭhapetvā ye na tattha hontī'ti.

meaning_1: view; belief; opinion; concept; theory; attitude; philosophy; credo; creed; dogma
example_1: na diṭṭhiyā na sutiyā na ñāṇena, mun'īdha nanda kusalā vadanti, visenikatvā anīghā nirāsā, caranti ye te munayoti brūmi.
example_2: visenikatvā pana ye caranti, diṭṭhīhi diṭṭhiṃ avirujjhamānā, tesu tvaṃ kiṃ labhetho pasūra, yes'īdha n'atthī param'uggahītaṃ.

example_1: yā imā, bhante, anekavihitā diṭṭhiyo loke uppajjanti, attavādapaṭisaṃyuttā vā lokavādapaṭisaṃyuttā vā, ādim'eva nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno manasikaroto evam'etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ pahānaṃ hoti, evam'etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ paṭinissaggo hotī'ti?
commentary: (MNa) diṭṭhiyo'ti micchādiṭṭhiyo.

meaning_1: clinging to views; attachment to beliefs
example_1: tassa diṭṭhīnaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhiajjhosānaṃ diṭṭhitaṇhā sānuseti.

meaning_1: stuck in a view; being entrenched in a belief
example_1: yāvatā, āvuso, diṭṭhi yāvatā diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhiadhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhisamuṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhisamugghāto, tam'ahaṃ jānāmi tam'ahaṃ passāmi.
commentary: (ANa) diṭṭh'ādhiṭṭhānan'ti diṭṭhīnaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṃ, adhiṭhatvā adhibhavitvā pavattāya diṭṭhiyā etaṃ nāmaṃ.

meaning_1: having views; believing in; holding opinions
meaning_2: believing in, having the theory of
example_1: dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, tayā aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatr'āyogena aññatr'ācariyakena, saññā purisassa attā'ti vā, aññā'va saññā añño attā'ti vā'ti.
example_2: anuvattakā'ti yaṃdiṭṭhiko so hoti yaṃkhantiko yaṃruciko te'pi taṃdiṭṭhikā honti taṃkhantikā taṃrucikā.

meaning_1: wasteland of views; desert of belief
example_1: idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāraṃ diṭṭhivisūkaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ

meaning_1: cause for views; reason for belief
(wrong or false) belief; misconception; theory; dogma; doctrine; speculative view
example_1: idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāraṃ diṭṭhivisūkaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ
example_2: pubb'āsave hitvā nave akubbaṃ, na chandagū no'pi nivissavādī, sa vippamutto diṭṭhigatehi dhīro, na lippati loke anattagarahī.
commentary: (DNa) diṭṭhigatan'ti diṭṭhi'y'eva. yathā gūthagataṃ muttagatan'ti vutte na gūth'ādito aññaṃ atthi, evaṃ diṭṭhi'y'eva diṭṭhigataṃ.

meaning_1: discussion about views as the basis for the cycle of existence
jungle of views; impenetrable thicket of beliefs; thick covering of views
example_1: idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāraṃ diṭṭhivisūkaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ
example_2: diṭṭhigahanapakkhando, parāmāsena mohito, asuddhiṃ maññisaṃ suddhiṃ, andhabhūto aviddasu.
commentary: (THa) andhabhūto puthujjano'ti paññācakkhuvekallena avijjandhatāya andhabhūto puthujjano hutvā vanagahanapabbatagahan'ādīni viya duratikkaman'aṭṭhena diṭṭhi'y'eva gahanaṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ, taṃ pakkhando anupaviṭṭho'ti diṭṭhigahanapakkhando

example_1: ko nāmo ayaṃ, bhante, dhammapariyāyo'ti? tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, ānanda, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ atthajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, dhammajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, brahmajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, diṭṭhijālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo'ti'pi naṃ dhārehī'ti.

meaning_1: clinging to views; attachment to beliefs
example_1: tassa diṭṭhīnaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhi'jjhosānaṃ diṭṭhitaṇhā sānuseti.

meaning_1: basis for opinion; grounds for view; standpoint for views
example_1: attani ca, bhikkhave, attaniye ca saccato thetato anupalabbhamāne, yam'pi taṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ, so loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassāmī'ti, nan'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kevalo paripūro bāladhammo'ti?
example_2: so suṇāti tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā sabbesaṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhāna-adhiṭṭhāna-pariyuṭṭhāna-abhinivesa-anusayānaṃ samugghātāya sabbasaṅkhārasamathāya sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggāya taṇhākkhayāya virāgāya nirodhāya nibbānāya dhammaṃ desentassa.
commentary: (ANa) yāvatā diṭṭhiṭṭhānan'ti khandhā'pi diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ, avijjā'pi, phasso'pi, saññā'pi, vitakko'pi ayonisomanasikāro'pi, pāpamitto'pi, paratoghoso'pi diṭṭhiṭṭhānan'ti evaṃ yattakaṃ aṭṭhavidham'pi diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhikāraṇaṃ nāma atthi.

meaning_1: who has abandoned the basis for opinions; who has given up grounds for view
commentary: (ANa) diṭṭhiṭṭhānappahāyinan'ti dvāsaṭṭhi-diṭṭhigata-ppahāyinaṃ.

meaning_1: grounds for views, standpoints for views, obsession with views, adherences and underlying tendencies; basis for views, fixation with views, being possessed by views, dogmatic opinions and dormant dispositions
sanskrit: dṛṣṭi + sthāna + adhiṣṭhāna + paryavasthāna + abhiniveśa + anuśaya
family_compound: diṭṭhi ṭhāna adhiṭṭhāna pariyuṭṭhāna abhinivesa anusaya
construction: diṭṭhi + ṭhāna + adhiṭṭhāna + pariyuṭṭhāna + abhinivesa + anusaya
example_1: so suṇāti tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā sabbesaṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhān'ādhiṭṭhāna-pariyuṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayānaṃ samugghātāya sabbasaṅkhārasamathāya sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggāya taṇhākkhayāya virāgāya nirodhāya nibbānāya dhammaṃ desentassa.
commentary: (MNa) diṭṭhiṭṭhān'ādhiṭṭhāna-pariyuṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayānan'ti diṭṭhīnañ'ca diṭṭhiṭṭhānānañ'ca diṭṭh'ādhiṭṭhānānañ'ca diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānānañ'ca abhinives'ānusayānañ'ca

meaning_1: craving for views; attachment to beliefs
example_1: tassa diṭṭhīnaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhi'jjhosānaṃ diṭṭhitaṇhā sānuseti.

meaning_1: illustrating a theory; illuminating a concept
delight in views; happiness with beliefs
example_1: tassa diṭṭhīnaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhi'jjhosānaṃ diṭṭhitaṇhā sānuseti.

meaning_1: acceptance of a view after consideration; approving a view after understanding it
example_1: etha tumhe, kālāmā, mā anussavena, mā param'parāya, mā itikirāya, mā piṭakasampadānena, mā takkahetu, mā nayahetu, mā ākāraparivitakkena, mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā, mā bhabbarūpatāya, mā samaṇo no garū'ti.
commentary: (ANa) mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā'ti amhākaṃ nijjhāyitvā khamitvā gahitadiṭṭhiyā saddhiṃ sametī'ti'pi mā gaṇhittha.

meaning_1: support for views; foundation for opinions; basis for beliefs
example_1: passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, taṃ diṭṭhinissayaṃ yaṃsa diṭṭhinissayaṃ nissayato na uppajjeyyuṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
example_2: imesañ'ca, cunda, pubb'antasahagatānaṃ diṭṭhinissayānaṃ imesañ'ca apar'antasahagatānaṃ diṭṭhinissayānaṃ pahānāya samatikkamāya evaṃ mayā cattāro satipaṭṭhānā desitā paññattā.
commentary: (DNa) tattha diṭṭhiyo'va diṭṭhinissayā, diṭṭhinissitakā diṭṭhigatikā'ti attho.

meaning_1: way of acquiring a view; acquisition of belief
example_1: diṭṭhipaṭilābhaṃ'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi, sevitabbam'pi, asevitabbam'pi, tañ'ca aññam'aññaṃ diṭṭhipaṭilābhaṃ.
commentary: (MNt) diṭṭhi'y'eva paccayavasena paṭiladdhatāya diṭṭhipaṭilābho. saññāpaṭilābhe'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: breakthrough of vision; penetration of view
example_1: satinepakke tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñ'ca satinepakke avigatapemo. diṭṭhipaṭivedhe tibbacchando hoti, āyatiñ'ca diṭṭhipaṭivedhe avigatapemo.
commentary: (DNa) diṭṭhipaṭivedhe'ti maggadassane.

meaning_2: (one) who has achieved insight; who has achieved (nibbāna) through insight

meaning_1: stuck in views; settled in theories; entrenched in opinions; with rigid dogma
example_1: ye kec'ime diṭṭhiparibbasānā, idam'eva saccan'ti vivādayanti, sabb'eva te nindam'anvānayanti, atho pasaṃsam'pi labhanti tattha.
example_2: sakaṃ sakaṃ diṭṭhiparibbasānā, viggayha nānā kusalā vadanti, yo evaṃ jānāti sa vedi dhammaṃ, idaṃ paṭikkosam'akevalī so.
commentary: (SNPa) diṭṭhīnivesā'ti idaṃsacc'ābhinivesa-saṅkhātāni diṭṭhinivesanāni.

example_1: yāvatā, āvuso, diṭṭhi yāvatā diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhiadhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhisamuṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhisamugghāto, tam'ahaṃ jānāmi tam'ahaṃ passāmi.
commentary: (ANa) diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānan'ti katamāni aṭṭhārasa diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānāni? yā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāraṃ diṭṭhivisūkaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ diṭṭhisallaṃ diṭṭhisambādho diṭṭhipalibodho diṭṭhibandhanaṃ diṭṭhipapāto diṭṭh'ānusayo diṭṭhisantāpo diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhigantho diṭṭh'upādānaṃ diṭṭh'ābhiniveso diṭṭhiparāmāso. imāni aṭṭhārasa diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānānī'ti evaṃ vuttaṃ diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānaṃ.

meaning_1: fever for views; burning passion for beliefs
example_1: tassa diṭṭhīnaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhi'jjhosānaṃ diṭṭhitaṇhā sānuseti.
tesañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ aññam'aññassa vacīsaṃhāro uppajjeyya diṭṭhipalāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi.
commentary: (MNa) diṭṭhipaḷāso'tiādīhi cittassa anārādhaniyabhāvo kathito. (MNt) diṭṭhipaḷāso'ti yugaggāhavasena laddhi.

example_1: tesañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ aññam'aññassa vacīsaṃhāro uppajjeyya diṭṭhipaḷāso cetaso āghāto appaccayo anabhiraddhi.
commentary: (MNa) diṭṭhipaḷāso'tiādīhi cittassa anārādhaniyabhāvo kathito. (ANa) diṭṭhipaḷāso'ti diṭṭhiṃ nissāya uppajjanako yugaggāhalakkhaṇo paḷāso diṭṭhipaḷāso nāma.

meaning_1: purification of view; purity of opinion
example_1: iti evarūpiṃ diṭṭhipārisuddhiṃ aparipūraṃ vā paripūressāmi paripūraṃ vā tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmī'ti, yo tattha chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, idaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, diṭṭhi-pārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgaṃ.

meaning_1: factor related to striving for the purification of view
example_1: iti evarūpiṃ diṭṭhipārisuddhiṃ aparipūraṃ vā paripūressāmi paripūraṃ vā tattha tattha paññāya anuggahessāmī'ti, yo tattha chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, idaṃ vuccati, byagghapajjā, diṭṭhi-pārisuddhi-padhāniy'aṅgaṃ.

meaning_1: thirst for views; craving for beliefs
example_1: tassa diṭṭhīnaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhi'jjhosānaṃ diṭṭhitaṇhā sānuseti.

meaning_1: attained understanding; (or) attained through view; epithet of a stream-enterer or higher
example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, bhaddāli, api nu tvaṃ, bhaddāli, tasmiṃ samaye ubhatobhāgavimutto vā hosi paññāvimutto vā kāyasakkhi vā diṭṭhippatto vā saddhāvimutto vā dhamm'ānusārī vā saddh'ānusārī vā'ti?
example_2: katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo diṭṭhippatto? idha ekacco puggalo ye te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe āruppā te na kāyena phusitvā viharati, paññāya c'assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhīṇā honti, tathāgatappaveditā c'assa dhammā paññāya vodiṭṭhā honti vocaritā.
commentary: (MNa) diṭṭh'antaṃ patto'ti diṭṭhippatto. tatr'idaṃ saṅkhepalakkhaṇaṃ, dukkhā saṅkhārā, sukho nirodho'ti ñātaṃ hoti diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ phusitaṃ paññāyā'ti diṭṭhippatto. vitthārato pan'eso'pi kāyasakkhi viya chabbidho hoti. ten'ev'āha, idh'ekacco puggalo idaṃ dukkhan'ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā'ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, tathāgatappaveditā c'assa dhammā paññāya vodiṭṭhā honti vocaritā… ayaṃ vuccati puggalo diṭṭhippatto'ti (pu. pa. 208).

example_1: ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, sīlabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, diṭṭhibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa
commentary: (DNa) sammādiṭṭhiṃ vināsayamānā uppannā diṭṭhi eva byasanaṃ diṭṭhibyasanaṃ.

meaning_1: because of a disastrous belief; due to failure in view
example_1: sīlabyasanahetu vā, bhikkhave, sattā diṭṭhibyasanahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti. imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca byasanāni.

meaning_1: underlying tendency towards thinking I am; underlying tendency towards self-comparison
example_1: so sabbaso rāg'ānusayaṃ pahāya paṭigh'ānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā asmī'ti diṭṭhimān'ānusayaṃ samūhanitvā avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti

meaning_1: infatuation with views; fixation on beliefs
example_1: tassa diṭṭhīnaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhi'jjhosānaṃ diṭṭhitaṇhā sānuseti.

meaning_1: yoke of beliefs; bondage of views
example_1: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, yogā. katame cattāro? kāmayogo, bhavayogo, diṭṭhiyogo, avijjāyogo.
commentary: (ANa) sassatadiṭṭhisahagato ca rāgo dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhiyo ca diṭṭhiyogo … diṭṭhīsu yojetī'ti diṭṭhiyogo.

meaning_1: detachment from the bond of beliefs
meaning_lit: unyoking from the yoke of view
example_1: cattāro visaññogā, kāmayogavisaññogo, bhavayogavisaññogo, diṭṭhiyogavisaññogo, avijjāyogavisaññogo.
commentary: (DNa) arahattamaggo bhavayogavisaññogo nāma. sot'āpattimaggo diṭṭhiyogavisaññogo nāma. arahattamaggo avijjāyogavisaññogo nāma.

meaning_1: detachment from the bond to views; disconnection from bondage to beliefs
example_1: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, visaṃyogā. katame cattāro? kāmayogavisaṃyogo, bhavayogavisaṃyogo, diṭṭhiyogavisaṃyogo, avijjāyogavisaṃyogo.
commentary: (ANa) kāmayogavisaṃyogo'ti kāmayogato visaṃyojanakāraṇaṃ. sesapadesu'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: passion for views; love of beliefs
example_1: tassa diṭṭhīnaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo diṭṭhīsu diṭṭhirāgo diṭṭhinandī diṭṭhisneho diṭṭhimucchā diṭṭhipipāsā diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhi'jjhosānaṃ diṭṭhitaṇhā sānuseti.

meaning_1: passion for a view, attachment to it, bondage to it, greed for it, obsession with it, and fixation with it; love of a belief, adherence to it, being tied to it, craving for it, being consumed by it, and addiction to it
sanskrit: dṛṣṭi + rāga + abhiniveśa + vinibandha + pari + gṛddha + paryavasthāna + adhyavasāya
family_compound: diṭṭhi rāga abhinivesa vinibandha paligedha pariyuṭṭhāna ajjhosāna
construction: diṭṭhirāga + abhinivesa + vinibandha + paligedha + pariyuṭṭhāna + ajjhosāna
example_1: atthi pana, bho kaccāna, koci lokasmiṃ yo imañ'c'eva kāmarāg'ābhinivesa-vinibandha-paligedha-pariyuṭṭhān'ajjhosānaṃ samatikkanto, imañ'ca diṭṭhirāg'ābhinivesa-vinibandha-paligedha-pariyuṭṭhān'ajjhosānaṃ samatikkanto'ti?

meaning_1: due to passion for a view, attachment to it, bondage to it, greed for it, obsession with it, and fixation with it; because of love of a belief, adherence to it, being tied to it, craving for it, being consumed by it, and addiction to it
sanskrit: dṛṣṭi + rāga + abhiniveśa + vinibandha + pari + gṛddha + paryavasthāna + adhyavasāya + hetu
family_compound: diṭṭhi rāga abhinivesa vinibandha paligedha pariyuṭṭhāna ajjhosāna hetu
construction: diṭṭhirāga + abhinivesa + vinibandha + paligedha + pariyuṭṭhāna + ajjhosāna + hetu
example_1: ko pana, bho kaccāna, hetu ko paccayo yena samaṇā'pi samaṇehi vivadantī'ti? diṭṭhi-rāg'ābhinivesa-vinibandha-paligedha-pariyuṭṭhān'ajjhosāna-hetu kho, brāhmaṇa, samaṇā'pi samaṇehi vivadantī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) kāmarāg'ābhinivesa-vinibandha-paligedha-pariyuṭṭhān'ajjhosāna-hetū'ti kāmarāg'ābhinivesahetu, kāmarāgavinibandhahetu, kāmarāgapaligedhahetu, kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhānahetu, kāmarāgaajjhosānahetū'ti attho. idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, yv'āyaṃ pañca kāmaguṇe nissāya uppajjati kāmarāgo, tass'ābhinives'ādihetu. kāmarāgena abhiniviṭṭhattā vinibaddhattā tasmiṃ'y'eva ca kāmarāge mahāpaṅke viya paligedhattā anupaviṭṭhattā ten'eva ca kāmarāgena pariyuṭṭhitattā gahitattā kāmarāgene'va ca ajjhositattā gilitvā pariniṭṭhapetvā gahitattā'ti. diṭṭhirāg'ādipadesu'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: bond of belief; fetter of views
example_1: satta saññojanāni, anunayasaññojanaṃ, paṭighasaññojanaṃ, diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ, vicikicchāsaññojanaṃ, mānasaññojanaṃ, bhavarāgasaññojanaṃ, avijjāsaññojanaṃ.
commentary: (PMa) diṭṭhigatiko hi ekasmiṃ patiṭṭhātuṃ na sakkoti, kadāci sassataṃ anussarati, kadāci ucchedaṃ. diṭṭhi'y'eva anatthe saṃyojetī'ti diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ.

meaning_1: eradication of views; extermination of beliefs
