commentary: (MNa) sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā'ti idhā'pi maggapaññā sammā hetunā nayena vaṭṭadukkhaṃ khepayamānā gacchatī'ti sammā dukkhakkhayagāminī nāma. vipassanā tadaṅgavasena vaṭṭadukkhañ'ca kilesadukkhañ'ca khepayamānā gacchatī'ti dukkhakkhayagāminī. dukkhakkhayagāminiyā vā maggapaññāya paṭilābhasaṃvattanato esā dukkhakkhayagāminī'ti veditabbā.

meaning_lit: discourse on desire for the uncomfortable, etc.

meaning_1: in the sense of being painful
example_1: rogato'ti-ādīsu ābādh'aṭṭhena rogato, antodos'aṭṭhena gaṇḍato, anupaviddh'aṭṭhena dukkhajanan'aṭṭhena ca sallato, dukkh'aṭṭhena aghato, rog'aṭṭhena ābādhato, asak'aṭṭhena parato, palujjan'aṭṭhena palokato, nissatt'aṭṭhena suññato, na att'aṭṭhena anattato.
commentary: (PMa) dukkh'aṭṭhenā'ti bhay'aṭṭhena, paṭipīḷan'aṭṭhena vā.

example_1: tisso dukkhatā, dukkhadukkhatā, saṅkhāradukkhatā, vipariṇāmadukkhatā.
commentary: (SNa) dukkhatā'ti dukkhasabhāvo.

meaning_1: from suffering; from discomfort; from pain
example_1: evaṃ kir'assa ahosi, saddhā tāva dhammaṃ sotu'kāmā gamissanti'y'eva, assaddhā'pi pana dhanalobhena gantvā dhammaṃ sutvā dukkhato muccissantī'ti.

grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of dukkha
meaning_1: as suffering; as pain; as discomfort
example_1: yo sukhaṃ dukkhato adda, dukkham'addakkhi sallato, ubhay'antarena n'āhosi, kena lokasmi kiṃ siyā.
example_2: tesaṃ sutvāna sappaññā, sacittaṃ paccaladdhā te, aniccaṃ aniccato dakkhuṃ, dukkham'addakkhu dukkhato.
commentary: (MNa) dukkhato'ti na sukhato. (ANa) paṭipīḷan'ākārena dukkhato

example_1: tatra, bhante, y'āyaṃ paṭipadā dukkhā dandh'ābhiññā, ayaṃ, bhante, paṭipadā ubhayen'eva hīnā akkhāyati dukkhattā ca dandhattā ca.

meaning_1: suffering inherent in pain; normal suffering
example_1: tisso dukkhatā, dukkhadukkhatā, saṅkhāradukkhatā, vipariṇāmadukkhatā.
commentary: (DNa) dukkhadukkhatā'ti dukkhabhūtā dukkhatā. dukkhavedanāy'etaṃ nāmaṃ.

meaning_1: discomfort and distress; pain and stress; physical pain and mental suffering
example_1: ek'āyano ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā
example_2: vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā sambhavanti.
commentary: (MNa) dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāyā'ti kāyikadukkhassa ca cetasikadomanassassa cā'ti imesaṃ dvinnaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya, nirodhāyā'ti attho. ayañ'hi maggo bhāvito tissatther'ādīnaṃ viya dukkhassa, sakk'ādīnaṃ viya ca domanassassa atthaṅ'gamāya saṃvattati.

meaning_1: uncomfortable phenomenon; painful experience; state of suffering
example_1: ajātaṃ asamuppannaṃ, asokaṃ virajaṃ padaṃ, nirodho dukkhadhammānaṃ, saṅkhār'ūpasamo sukho'ti.
example_2: katamo ca, bhikkhave, soko? yo kho, bhikkhave, aññatar'aññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa aññatar'aññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa soko socanā socitattaṃ antosoko antoparisoko, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, soko
commentary: (DNa) dukkhadhammenā'ti vadhabandh'ādinā dukkhakāraṇena. (SNa) dukkhadhammānan'ti dukkhasambhavadhammānaṃ. pañcasu hi khandhesu sati chedana-vadha-bandhan'ādi-bhedaṃ dukkhaṃ sambhavati, tasmā te dukkhasambhavadhammattā dukkhadhammā'ti vuccanti.

meaning_1: uncomfortable in nature; of unpleasant character
commentary: (SNa) dukkhadhammānan'ti dukkhasambhavadhammānaṃ. pañcasu hi khandhesu sati chedana-vadha-bandhan'ādi-bhedaṃ dukkhaṃ sambhavati, tasmā te dukkhasambhavadhammattā dukkhadhammā'ti vuccanti.

example_1: cha'y'imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, sukhadhātu, dukkhadhātu, somanassadhātu, domanassadhātu, upekkhādhātu, avijjādhātu. imā kho, ānanda, cha dhātuyo yato jānāti passati, ettāvatā'pi kho, ānanda, dhātukusalo bhikkhū'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.

commentary: (ANa) navame jāti'pi dukkhā'ti-ādinā nayena vuttaṃ dukkhaṃ adhivahati āharatī'ti dukkh'ādhivahaṃ. dukkh'ādhivāhan'ti'pi pāṭho. tass'attho, lok'uttarapādakajjhān'ādi ariyadhamm'ābhimukhaṃ dukkhena adhivāhīyati pesīyatī'ti dukkh'ādhivāhaṃ. idam'pi vaṭṭavasena uppannacittam'eva. tañ'hi vuttappakārā devamanussādisampattiyo dadamānampi jātiādīnaṃ adhivahanato dukkh'ādhivahaṃ, ariyadhammādhigamāya duppesanato dukkhādhivāhañca nāma hotī'ti.

meaning_2: difficult to bring or lead towards (?)

meaning_1: source of suffering; cause of discomfort
example_1: so evaṃ pajānāti, imassa kho me dukkhanidānassa saṅkhāraṃ padahato saṅkhārappadhānā virāgo hoti, imassa pana me dukkhanidānassa ajjhupekkhato upekkhaṃ bhāvayato virāgo hotī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) imassā'ti paccuppannānaṃ pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ mūlabhūtassa. dukkhanidānassā'ti taṇhāya. sā hi pañcakkhandhadukkhassa nidānaṃ.

meaning_lit: discourse on the uncomfortable being conducive to complete quenching

meaning_1: end of suffering; cessation of distress
example_1: dukkhaṃ, bhikkhave, veditabbaṃ, dukkhassa nidānasambhavo veditabbo, dukkhassa vemattatā veditabbā, dukkhassa vipāko veditabbo, dukkhanirodho veditabbo, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā veditabbā.
example_2: katamā ca, bhikkhave, avijjā? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dukkhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhasamudaye aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) tassā'y'eva taṇhāya, dvinnam'pi vā tesaṃ saccānaṃ accantakkhayo asamuppatti dukkhanirodho nāma

meaning_1: path of practice leading to the cessation of suffering
example_1: katamā ca, bhikkhave, avijjā? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dukkhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhasamudaye aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ.
example_2: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ

meaning_1: noble truth of the path of practice leading to the ending of suffering
meaning_2: noble truth of the way leading to the cessation of dukkha
family_idioms: dukkha nirodha gāmī paṭipadā ariya sacca
example_1: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ? ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
example_2: idaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccan'ti me, bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi.

meaning_1: path of practice leading to the cessation of suffering
meaning_2: path of practice leading to the cessation of suffering

meaning_1: leading to the cessation of suffering
meaning_2: (the practice) leading to the extinction of suffering
example_1: katamā ca, bhikkhave, avijjā? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dukkhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhasamudaye aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ.
example_2: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā'ti. iti h'idaṃ, bhikkhave, vuccati dukkhanirodhagāminī samanupassanā'ti. ayam'ev'ettha attho'ti.
commentary: (SNa) dukkhanirodhagāminī samanupassanā'ti ettha saha vipassanāya catumaggañāṇaṃ samanupassanā'ti vuttaṃ.

meaning_1: noble truth of the ending of suffering
meaning_2: noble truth of the cessation of dukkha
example_1: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, dukkhanirodhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ? yo tassā'y'eva taṇhāya asesavirāganirodho cāgo paṭinissaggo mutti anālayo.
sukh'āvaho dukkhanudo, vedehassa yasassino, matiṃ te paṭihaññāmi, usuṃ palasatena vā.
commentary: (JAa) dukkhanudo'ti kāyikasukha-cetasikasukhañ'ca āvahāmi, dukkhañ'ca nudemi.

meaning_1: gone to the end of suffering
example_1: mālaṃ na dhāre na ca gandham'ācare, mañce chamāyaṃ va sayetha santhate, etañ'hi aṭṭh'aṅgika-māh'uposathaṃ, buddhena dukkh'antagunā pakāsitaṃ.
commentary: (SNPa) dukkh'antagunā'ti vaṭṭadukkhassa antagatena.

example_1: dukkhan'ti khandhe paṭipassa yoniso, yato ca dukkhaṃ samudeti taṃ jaha, idh'eva dukkhassa karohi antaṃ, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
example_2: so idaṃ dukkhan'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhanirodho'ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ

meaning_1: this is unpleasant; this is painful
example_1: kiñ'ca vijānāti? sukhan'ti'pi vijānāti, dukkhan'ti'pi vijānāti, adukkham'asukhan'ti'pi vijānāti. vijānāti vijānātī'ti kho, āvuso, tasmā viññāṇan'ti vuccatī'ti.
dukkhaṃ, dukkhan'ti, bhante, vuccati. kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, dukkhaṃ vā assa dukkhapaññatti vā'ti

meaning_lit: discourse on the question about suffering

meaning_1: averse to suffering; opposed to pain
meaning_2: averse to pain, finding suffering disagreeable
example_1: atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitu'kāmo amaritu'kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikūlo.

meaning_1: averse to suffering; opposed to pain
example_1: yv'āyaṃ, bhante, puggalo attan'tapo attaparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto so attānaṃ sukhakāmaṃ dukkhapaṭikkūlaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti, iminā me ayaṃ puggalo cittaṃ n'ārādheti.
commentary: (MNa) dukkhapaṭikkūlan'ti dukkhassa paṭikūlaṃ, paccanīkasaṇṭhitaṃ dukkhaṃ apatthayamānan'ti attho.

meaning_1: afflicted with suffering; overcome by misery
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, otiṇṇo'mhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkh'otiṇṇo dukkhapareto.
commentary: (ITIa) dukkhaparetā'ti tehi dukkhadukkhavatthūhi abhibhūtā. jāti'ādayo hi dukkhassa vatthubhāvato dukkhā, dukkhabhāvato ca soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā dukkhā'ti.

meaning_2: having afflicted, having caused pain, having hurt

meaning_1: averse to suffering; opposed to pain
example_1: atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitu'kāmo amaritu'kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhappaṭikūlo.
commentary: (NIDD1a) dukkhappaṭikkūlo'ti dukkhaṃ anicchamāno.

meaning_1: averse to suffering; opposed to pain
example_1: seyyathā'pi, gahapati, aṅgārakāsu sādhikaporisā, pūrā aṅgārānaṃ vīt'accikānaṃ vītadhūmānaṃ. atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitu'kāmo amaritu'kāmo sukhakāmo dukkhappaṭikkūlo.
commentary: (MNa) dukkhapaṭikkūlan'ti dukkhassa paṭikūlaṃ, paccanīkasaṇṭhitaṃ dukkhaṃ apatthayamānan'ti attho.

meaning_1: being in suffering; afflicted with pain
meaning_2: being in suffering; afflicted with pain; lit. reached pain
example_1: idāni maṃ edisaṃ evaṃ dukkhappattaṃ disvā tava alaṃ hasituṃ, mā edise kāle parihāsakeḷiṃ karohī'ti.
āraddhaṃ kho pana me, aggivessana, vīriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho ten'eva dukkhappadhānena padhān'ābhitunnassa sato.

meaning_1: full of problems; with many troubles
example_1: tam'enaṃ passāmi aparena samayena dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā pettivisayaṃ upapannaṃ, dukkhabahulā vedanā vedayamānaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) dukkhabahulā'ti pettivisayasmiñ'hi dukkham'eva bahulaṃ, sukhaṃ parittaṃ kadāci anubhavitabbaṃ hoti, tasmā evam'āha.

meaning_1: hard to endure; difficult to tolerate
example_1: saṃsaraṃ hi nirayaṃ agacchissaṃ, petalokam'agamaṃ punappunaṃ, dukkhamamhi'pi tiracchānayoniyaṃ, n'ekadhā hi vusitaṃ ciraṃ mayā.
commentary: (THa) dukkhamamhi'pī'ti aññam'aññaṃ tikhiṇa-kasā-patod'ābhighāt'ādi-dukkhehi dussahāya'pi. liṅgavipallāsena h'etaṃ vuttaṃ, dukkhamamhi'pī'ti.

example_1: kathaṃsu tarati oghaṃ, kathaṃsu tarati aṇṇavaṃ, kathaṃsu dukkham'acceti, kathaṃsu parisujjhatī'ti.
example_2: saddhā tarati oghaṃ, appamādena aṇṇavaṃ, vīriyena dukkham'acceti, paññāya parisujjhati.
commentary: (SNa) yasmā ca sakadāgāmī vīriyena tatiyamaggaṃ ārādhetvā sakadāgāmimaggena anatītaṃ kāmoghavatthuṃ kāmoghasaññitañca kāmadukkhamacceti, tasmā vīriyena dukkhamaccetī'ti iminā padena kām'oghataraṇaṃ anāgāmimaggaṃ anāgāmiñ'ca pakāseti.

example_1: kathaṃvidhaṃ sīlavantaṃ vadanti, kathaṃvidhaṃ paññavantaṃ vadanti, kathaṃvidho dukkham'aticca iriyati, kathaṃvidhaṃ devatā pūjayantī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) dukkham'aticca iriyatī'ti dukkhaṃ atikkamitvā viharati

example_1: yo dukkham'addakkhi yatonidānaṃ, kāmesu so jantu kathaṃ nameyya, upadhiṃ viditvā saṅgo'ti loke, tass'eva jantu vinayāya sikkhe'ti.
example_2: yo sukhaṃ dukkhato adda, dukkham'addakkhi sallato, adukkham'asukhaṃ santaṃ, adakkhi naṃ aniccato.
commentary: (ITIa) dukkhamaddakkhi sallato'ti yathā sallaṃ sarīraṃ anupavisantam'pi paviṭṭham'pi uddhariyamānam'pi pīḷam'eva janeti, evaṃ dukkhavedanā uppajjamānā'pi ṭhitippattā'pi bhijjamānā'pi vibādhati'y'evā'ti taṃ sallato vipassī'ti vuttaṃ.

example_1: aniccaṃ aniccato dakkhuṃ, dukkham'addakkhu dukkhato, anattani anattā'ti, asubhaṃ asubhat'addasuṃ, sammādiṭṭhisamādānā, sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ upaccagun'ti
sace bhāyatha dukkhassa, sace vo dukkham'appiyaṃ, m'ākattha pāpakaṃ kammaṃ, āvi vā yadi vā raho.
commentary: (UDa) dukkhaṃ appiyaṃ aniṭṭhaṃ

example_1: na paro paraṃ nikubbetha, n'ātimaññetha katthaci naṃ kañci, byārosanā paṭighasaññā, n'āññam'aññassa dukkham'iccheyya.
example_2: kāmā hi citrā madhurā manoramā, aviddasū yattha sitā puthujjanā, te dukkham'icchanti punabbhav'esino, cittena nītā niraye nirākatā.
commentary: (KHPa) n'āññam'aññassa dukkham'iccheyyā'ti aññam'aññassa dukkhaṃ na iccheyya.

example_1: jhāya bhikkhu mā pamādo, mā te kāmaguṇe ramessu cittaṃ, mā lohaguḷaṃ gilī pamatto, mā kandi dukkham'idan'ti ḍayhamāno.
example_2: yathā'pi mūle anupaddave daḷhe, chinno'pi rukkho punareva rūhati, evam'pi taṇh'ānusaye anūhate, nibbattatī dukkham'idaṃ punappunaṃ.

meaning_1: root of suffering; source of pain
example_1: buddho ahu maṅgalo vītarāgo, usabhacchidā jāliniṃ dukkhamūlaṃ, santaṃ padaṃ ajjhagam'opanīto, uposatho sundaro saccanāmo.
commentary: (MNa) passi jahi upadhidukkhamūlan'ti ettha passi nāma so paccekabuddho, dukkhassa pana mūlaṃ upadhiṃ jahī'ti ayam'assa thuti.

example_1: yato yato mano nivāraye, na dukkham'eti naṃ tato tato, sa sabbato mano nivāraye, sa sabbato dukkhā pamuccati.
example_2: yassa sel'ūpamaṃ cittaṃ, ṭhitaṃ n'ānupakampati, virattaṃ rajanīyesu, kopaneyye na kuppati, yass'evaṃ bhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, kuto taṃ dukkham'essatī'ti.
commentary: (UDa) kuto taṃ dukkham'essatī'ti taṃ uttamapuggalaṃ kuto sattato saṅkhārato vā dukkhaṃ upagamissati, na tādisassa dukkhaṃ atthī'ti attho.

example_1: bālo puttataṇhāya c'eva dhanataṇhāya ca haññati vihaññati dukkhayati

commentary: (VISM) dukkhalakkhaṇam'pi pākaṭaṃ hoti udayabbayehi paṭipīḷan'āvabodhato.

meaning_2: reason for the characteristic of suffering

example_1: dubbhikkham'iva vā dukkhasaccaṃ, dubbuṭṭhi viya samudayasaccaṃ, subhikkham'iva nirodhasaccaṃ, suvuṭṭhi viya maggasaccaṃ.
commentary: (DNt) tattha attā, loko'ti ca diṭṭhiyā adhiṭṭhānabhāvena, vedanā-phass'āyatan'ādi-mukhena ca gahitesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu taṇhāvajjā pañc'upādānakkhandhā dukkhasaccaṃ.

meaning_1: detailed analysis of the truth of suffering; investigation of the first truth
example_1: tattha katamā jātī'ti-ādīsu padabhājanīyesu tatthā'ti dukkhasaccaniddese vuttesu jāti'ādīsu. yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānan'ti saṅkhepato anekesaṃ sattānaṃ sādhāraṇaniddeso.

meaning_2: what is called the truth of suffering

meaning_1: recognition of suffering; perception of no ease; perceiving discomfort (in)
example_1: cha, bhikkhave, ānisaṃse sampassamānena alam'eva bhikkhunā sabbasaṅkhāresu anodhiṃ karitvā dukkhasaññaṃ upaṭṭhāpetuṃ. katame cha?
example_2: asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā, aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā, nirodhasaññā
commentary: (ANa) anicce dukkhasaññā'ti dukkh'ānupassanāñāṇe uppannasaññā.

meaning_1: fortified by the perception of suffering (in)
example_1: anicce dukkhasaññāparicitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato ālasye kosajje vissaṭṭhiye pamāde ananuyoge apaccavekkhaṇāya tibbā bhayasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti, seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ukkhittāsike vadhake.

meaning_1: recognizing suffering; perceiving no ease; perceiving discomfort (in)
example_1: idha tvaṃ, dīghāvu, sabbasaṅkhāresu anicc'ānupassī viharāhi, anicce dukkhasaññī, dukkhe anattasaññī pahānasaññī virāgasaññī nirodhasaññī'ti. evañ'hi te, dīghāvu, sikkhitabban'ti.

meaning_1: source of stress; arising of suffering; appearance of discomfort
example_1: yo imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu chando ālayo anunayo ajjhosānaṃ so dukkhasamudayo. yo imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, so dukkhanirodho'ti. ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno bahukataṃ hoti.
example_2: katamā ca, bhikkhave, avijjā? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dukkhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhasamudaye aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ.

meaning_1: leading to the arising of suffering; which leads to the source of stress; which creates discomfort
example_1: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sakkāyasamudayagāminī paṭipadā, sakkāyasamudayagāminī paṭipadā'ti. iti h'idaṃ, bhikkhave, vuccati dukkhasamudayagāminī samanupassanā'ti. ayam'ev'ettha attho.
commentary: (SNa) dukkhasamudayagāminī samanupassanā'ti yasmā sakkāyo dukkhaṃ, tassa ca samudayagāminī paṭipadā nāma rūpaṃ attato samanupassatī'ti evaṃ diṭṭhisamanupassanā vuttā, tasmā dukkhasamudayagāminī samanupassanā'ti ayam'ettha attho hoti.

meaning_1: generation of the arising of suffering; creation of the source of stress; (comm) production of the mass of suffering
meaning_2: generation of the arising of suffering; creation of the source of stress
example_1: viññāṇañ'ca hi, ānanda, nāmarūpe patiṭṭhaṃ na labhissatha, api nu kho āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ dukkhasamudayasambhavo paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
commentary: (DNa) dukkhasamudayasambhavo'ti dukkharāsisambhavo.

meaning_lit: discourse on the origin of suffering

meaning_1: noble truth of the origin of suffering
meaning_2: noble truth of the origin of dukkha
example_1: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ? y'āyaṃ taṇhā ponobbhavikā nandīrāgasahagatā tatratatr'ābhinandinī. seyyath'idaṃ, kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā.
example_2: taṃ kho pan'idaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ pahātabban'ti

meaning_1: arising of discomfort; origination of suffering
example_1: dukkhaṃ dukkhasamuppādaṃ, dukkhassa ca atikkamaṃ, ariyaṃ c'aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ, dukkh'ūpasamagāminaṃ.

meaning_1: unpleasant to the touch; painful to the touch
example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, māgaṇḍiya, api nu so puriso iti c'itic'eva kāyaṃ sannāmeyyā'ti? evaṃ, bho gotama. taṃ kissa hetu? asu hi, bho gotama, aggi dukkhasamphasso c'eva mah'ābhitāpo ca mahāpariḷāho cā'ti.
commentary: (DhSa) dukkhasamphassan'ti dukkhavedanāpaccayaṃ aniṭṭhaphoṭṭhabbaṃ.

meaning_1: unpleasantness to the touch; fact of being painful to the touch
example_1: ye kho pan'assa sevanti bhajanti payirupāsanti diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjanti, tesaṃ taṃ hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya. idam'assa dukkhasamphassatāya vadāmi. seyyathā'pi so, bhikkhave, potthako dukkhasamphasso tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.
commentary: (MNt) āyatiṃ dukkhaphalatāya eta'r'ahi ca kilesadukkhabahulatāya kāmānaṃ dukkhasamphassatā, tadubhayasaṃyuttesu tesu ca taṃ asallakkhitvā ek'antasukh'ābhiniveso viparītasaññāya, na kevalāya sukhavedanāya sukhā'ti pavattasaññī.

example_1: yo'pi hetu yo'pi paccayo viññāṇassa uppādāya, so'pi dukkho. dukkhasambhūtaṃ, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ kuto sukhaṃ bhavissati!

meaning_1: considered to be stressful; regarded as painful; agreed to be uncomfortable
example_1: sadevakassa lokassa, ete vo sukhasammatā, yattha c'ete nirujjhanti, taṃ nesaṃ dukkhasammataṃ.

bhikkhāya caranto kālānam'accayena jarājiṇṇo dubbhojanadukkhaseyyāhi milātasarīro bhikkhāya caranto āgamma pīṭhikāya nipanno niddaṃ okkamitvā uṭṭhāya nisinno attānaṃ oloketvā puttesu attano patiṭṭhaṃ apassanto cintesi
commentary: (JAa) dukkhaseyyan'ti tasmiṃ āpaṇe dukkhasayanaṃ.

example_1: etañ'hi tumhe paṭipannā, dukkhass'antaṃ karissatha, akkhāto vo mayā maggo, aññāya sallakantanaṃ.
example_2: yo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye, appamatto vihassati, pahāya jātisaṃsāraṃ, dukkhass'antaṃ karissatī'ti.

meaning_1: who makes an end of suffering
example_1: upasanto anāyāso, vippasanno anāvilo, kalyāṇasīlo medhāvī, dukkhass'antakaro siyā.
example_2: ettāvatā kho, āvuso, bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti, pariññeyyaṃ parijānāti, abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hotī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) dukkhass'antakaro hotī'ti sakalavaṭṭadukkhassa pariyantaṃ parivaṭumaṃ karo hoti.

example_1: das'uttaraṃ pavakkhāmi, dhammaṃ nibbānapattiyā, dukkhass'antakiriyāya, sabbaganthappamocanaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) dukkhass'antakiriyāyā'ti sakalassa vaṭṭadukkhassa pariyantakaraṇ'atthaṃ.

meaning_2: Chapter 6 of the Nidānasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 2 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

meaning_1: removal of suffering; elimination of unease
example_1: chandajaṃ aghaṃ chandajaṃ dukkhaṃ, chandavinayā aghavinayo, aghavinayā dukkhavinayo'ti.
commentary: (SNa) aghavinayā dukkhavinayo'ti pañcakkhandhavinayena vaṭṭadukkhaṃ vinītam'eva hoti.

meaning_1: resulting in suffering; with painful results
meaning_2: having pain as its fruit, creating misery
example_1: samit'āssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā
example_2: yaṃ kho ahaṃ idaṃ kāyena kammaṃ kattu'kāmo idaṃ me kāyakammaṃ attabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatteyya, parabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatteyya, ubhayabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatteyya, akusalaṃ idaṃ kāyakammaṃ dukkh'udrayaṃ dukkhavipākan'ti
commentary: (ANa) dukkhavipākehī'ti vipākakāle dukkh'uppādakehi.

meaning_1: resulting in more suffering; with more painful results
example_1: tatr'ānanda, yo c'ev'āyaṃ ācariy'ūpaddavo, yo ca antevās'ūpaddavo ayaṃ tehi brahmac'ārūpaddavo dukkhavipākataro c'eva kaṭukavipākataro ca, api ca vinipātāya saṃvattati.

meaning_1: painful feeling; unpleasant sensation; bad experience
example_1: tañ'ce, āvuso, bhikkhuṃ pare akkosanti paribhāsanti rosenti vihesenti, so evaṃ pajānāti, uppannā kho me ayaṃ sotasamphassajā dukkhavedanā. sā ca kho paṭicca, no apaṭicca. kiṃ paṭicca?
dukkhavedaniyaṃ, bhikkhu, phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dukkhā vedanā. so dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti.
example_2: tass'eva dukkhavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā yaṃ tajjaṃ vedayitaṃ dukkhavedaniyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppannā dukkhā vedanā sā nirujjhati, sā vūpasammatī'ti pajānāti.
commentary: (MNa) sukhavedaniyan'ti sukhavedanāya paccayabhūtaṃ. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo.

example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññath'āvuso nigaṇṭhā, yam'idaṃ kammaṃ sukhavedanīyaṃ taṃ upakkamena vā padhānena vā dukkhavedanīyaṃ hotū'ti labbham'etan'ti? no h'idaṃ, āvuso.
commentary: (MNa) sukhavedanīyan'ti iṭṭh'ārammaṇavipākadāyakaṃ kusalakammaṃ. viparītaṃ dukkhavedanīyaṃ
(VISMa) sayam'pi dukkhahetu tvamitī'ti evaṃ sayam'pi tvaṃ etassa dukkhassa hetu, evaṃ samāne tassa tuyhañ'ca tassa dukkhassa hetubhāve

grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of dukkha
example_1: jayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, dukkhaṃ seti parājito, upasanto sukhaṃ seti, hitvā jayaparājayaṃ.
example_2: kodhano'yaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodh'ābhibhūto kodhapareto, kiñ'c'āpi so pallaṅke seti gonak'atthate paṭalik'atthate kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇe sauttaracchade ubhato-lohitak'ūpadhāne, atha kho so dukkhaññ'eva seti kodh'ābhibhūto.
commentary: (SNa) dukkhaṃ setī'ti jitāni hatthiādīni anusocanto dukkhaṃ sayissati. idaṃ bhagavā puna tassa jayakāraṇaṃ disvā āha.

example_1: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ? jāti'pi dukkhā, jarā'pi dukkhā, maraṇam'pi dukkhaṃ, soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā'pi dukkhā, appiyehi sampayogo'pi dukkho, piyehi vippayogo'pi dukkho, yam'p'icchaṃ na labhati tam'pi dukkhaṃ, saṃkhittena pañc'upādānakkhandhā dukkhā.

meaning_1: bringing suffering; causing discomfort; conducive to pain
example_1: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ abhāvitaṃ abahulīkataṃ dukkh'ādhivahaṃ hoti yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ. cittaṃ, bhikkhave, abhāvitaṃ abahulīkataṃ dukkh'ādhivahaṃ hotī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) jāti'pi dukkhā'ti-ādinā nayena vuttaṃ dukkhaṃ adhivahati āharatī'ti dukkh'ādhivahaṃ. dukkh'ādhivāhan'ti'pi pāṭho. tass'attho, lok'uttarapādakajjhān'ādi ariyadhamm'ābhimukhaṃ dukkhena adhivāhīyati pesīyatī'ti dukkh'ādhivāhaṃ. idam'pi vaṭṭavasena uppannacittam'eva.

meaning_1: bringing suffering; causing discomfort; conducive to pain
example_1: cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, phass'āyatanā adantā aguttā arakkhitā asaṃvutā dukkh'ādhivāhā honti. katame cha? cakkhu, bhikkhave, phass'āyatanaṃ adantaṃ aguttaṃ arakkhitaṃ asaṃvutaṃ dukkh'ādhivāhaṃ hoti
commentary: (SNa) dukkh'ādhivāhā hontī'ti nerayik'ādi-bhedaṃ adhikadukkhaṃ āvahanakā honti.

meaning_1: afflicted with suffering; stricken by pain; fallen into misery
example_1: duppabbajjaṃ durabhiramaṃ, durāvāsā gharā dukhā, dukkhosamānasaṃvāso, dukkh'ānupatit'addhagū, tasmā na c'addhagū siyā, na ca dukkh'ānupatito siyā.
example_2: rūpañ'ca h'idaṃ, mahāli, ek'antadukkhaṃ abhavissa dukkh'ānupatitaṃ dukkh'āvakkantaṃ anavakkantaṃ sukhena, na'y'idaṃ sattā rūpasmiṃ sārajjeyyuṃ.
commentary: (SNa) dukkh'ānupatitā'ti dukkhena anupatitā.

example_1: dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipannassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ayam'anudhammo hoti yaṃ rūpe dukkh'ānupassī vihareyya … parimuccati dukkhasmā'ti vadāmī'ti.
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sabbasaṅkhāresu dukkh'ānupassī viharati.
commentary: (ANa) dukkh'ānupassī'ti pīḷan'ākāraṃ dukkhato anupassanto.

example_1: kissa rodathā'ti ca mātāpitūhi vuttā ime nimmātāpitikā tāpasapositā amhe atīva paharantī'ti vadanti. tato tesaṃ mātāpitaro ime dārakā aññe dārake viheṭhenti dukkhāpenti, na ime saṅgahetabbā, vajjitabbā ime'ti āhaṃsu.
synonym: ārambhati, upahanti, khanati, tāpayati, paritāpeti, bādheti, byāpajjati, byābādheti, vihiṃsati, hanati, hiṃsati

example_1: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti bahujan'āhitāya bahujan'āsukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
example_2: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū duggahitehi sutt'antehi byañjanappatirūpakehi atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca paṭibāhanti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujan'āhitāya paṭipannā bahujan'āsukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.

meaning_1: beset with suffering; immersed in suffering
example_1: rūpañ'ca h'idaṃ, mahāli, ek'antadukkhaṃ abhavissa dukkh'ānupatitaṃ dukkh'āvakkantaṃ anavakkantaṃ sukhena, na'y'idaṃ sattā rūpasmiṃ sārajjeyyuṃ.
commentary: (SNa) dukkh'āvakkantā'ti dukkhena okkantā otiṇṇā.

example_1: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave puriso ābādhiko assa dukkhito bāḷhagilāno
example_2: tassa atipemena dukkhitassa balavasoko uppajji, hadayavatthu uṇham'ahosi. nāsikāya appahontiyā mukhena uṇhe assāsapassāse vissajjesi, assūni parivattitvā lohitabindūni hutvā nettehi nikkhamiṃsu.
commentary: (DNa) dukkhitan'ti rogadukkhena dukkhitaṃ. (UDa) dukkhito'ti kāyasannissitaṃ dukkhaṃ sañjātaṃ assā'ti dukkhito, dukkhappatto'ti attho.

example_1: kāmā kaṭukā āsīvis'ūpamā, yesu mucchitā bālā, te dīgharattaṃ niraye, samappitā haññante dukkhitā.
katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, dukkh'indriyaṃ? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ, kāyikaṃ asātaṃ, kāyasamphassajaṃ dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ
example_2: jīvit'indriyaṃ, sukh'indriyaṃ, dukkh'indriyaṃ, somanass'indriyaṃ, domanass'indriyaṃ, upekkh'indriyaṃ
commentary: (SNa) dukkh'indriyañ'ca pajānātī'ti dukkhasaccavaseneva pajānāti.

meaning_1: ending of suffering; cessation of the faculty of pain
example_1: so dukkh'indriyañ'ca pajānāti, dukkh'indriyasamudayañ'ca pajānāti, dukkh'indriyanirodhañ'ca pajānāti, yattha c'uppannaṃ dukkh'indriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhati tañ'ca pajānāti. kattha c'uppannaṃ dukkh'indriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhati?

meaning_1: appearance of suffering; arising of the faculty of pain
example_1: so dukkh'indriyañ'ca pajānāti, dukkh'indriyasamudayañ'ca pajānāti, dukkh'indriyanirodhañ'ca pajānāti, yattha c'uppannaṃ dukkh'indriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhati tañ'ca pajānāti. kattha c'uppannaṃ dukkh'indriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhati?
commentary: (SNa) dukkh'indriyasamudayan'ti kaṇṭakena vā viddhassa maṅkulena vā daṭṭhassa paccattharaṇe vā valiyā phuṭṭhassa dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ uppajjati, taṃ etassa samudayo'ti pajānāti.

example_1: atha kho māro pāpimā, jānāti maṃ uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī'ti dukkhī dummano tatth'ev'antaradhāyī'ti.
commentary: (VINa) dukkhī'ti cetodukkhena dukkhī.

example_1: akusalaṃ idaṃ kāyakammaṃ dukkh'udrayaṃ dukkhavipākan'ti?
commentary: (PMa) akusalaṃ dukkhavuddhimattā dukkh'udrayaṃ.

example_1: iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.
commentary: (ANt) dukkhaṃ upanisā kāraṇam'etissā'ti dukkh'ūpanisā, dukkhanibandhanā dukkhahetukā saddhā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: led into suffering; drawn into difficulty; brought into misery
example_1: kāmesu giddhā pasutā pamūḷhā, avadāniyā te visame niviṭṭhā, dukkh'ūpanītā paridevayanti, kiṃsū bhavissāma ito cutāse.

meaning_1: calming of suffering; relief from suffering; alleviation of suffering
example_1: dukkhaṃ dukkhasamuppādaṃ, dukkhassa ca atikkamaṃ, ariyaṃ c'aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ, dukkh'ūpasamagāminaṃ.
example_2: yadā ca buddhā lokasmiṃ, uppajjanti pabhaṅ'karā, te imaṃ dhammaṃ pakāsenti, dukkh'ūpasamagāminaṃ.

meaning_1: leading to relief from suffering; leading to alleviation of suffering
meaning_lit: leading to the calming of suffering
example_1: dukkhaṃ dukkhasamuppādaṃ, dukkhassa ca atikkamaṃ, ariyaṃ c'aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ, dukkh'ūpasamagāminaṃ.
example_2: yadā ca buddhā lokasmiṃ, uppajjanti pabhaṅ'karā, te imaṃ dhammaṃ pakāsenti, dukkh'ūpasamagāminaṃ.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, rājañña, kassako bījanaṅgalaṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya. so tattha dukkhette dubbhūme avihatakhāṇukaṇṭake bījāni patiṭṭhāpeyya khaṇḍāni pūtīni vāt'ātapahatāni asāradāni asukhasayitāni.
commentary: (DNa) dukkhette'ti duṭṭhukhette nissārakhette. (SNa) dukkhettan'ti visamakhettaṃ.

meaning_1: with pain; with discomfort; with suffering
example_1: yena vā pana dukkhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto bahiddhā pariyeṭṭhiṃ āpajjati, ko ekapadaṃ dvipadaṃ jānāti imassa dukkhassa nirodhāyā'ti?
example_2: phassena phuṭṭho na sukhena majje, dukkhena phuṭṭho'pi na sampavedhe, phassadvayaṃ sukhadukkhe upekkhe, anānuruddho aviruddha kenaci.

grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of dukkha
example_1: tasmā hi dhīro idh'upaṭṭhitassatī, kāme ca pāpe ca asevamāno, sahā'pi dukkhena jaheyya kāme, paṭisotagāmī'ti tam'āhu puggalaṃ.

meaning_1: immersed in suffering; afflicted with suffering; fallen into misery
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, otiṇṇo'mhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkh'otiṇṇo dukkhapareto.
commentary: (ITIa) etehi jāti'ādīhi otiṇṇā dukkh'otiṇṇā, tehi jātiādidukkhehi anto anupaviṭṭhā.

meaning_1: living together with others is painful; (comm) living together with people from different backgrounds and with different abilities is suffering
construction:
dukkho + samāna + saṃvāso
dukkho + asamāna + saṃvāso
example_1: duppabbajjaṃ durabhiramaṃ, durāvāsā gharā dukhā, dukkhosamānasaṃvāso, dukkh'ānupatit'addhagū, tasmā na c'addhagū siyā, na ca dukkh'ānupatito siyā.
commentary: (DHPa) dukkho samānasaṃvāso'ti gihino vā hi ye jātigottakulabhogehi pabbajitā vā sīl'ācārabāhusacc'ādīhi samānā'pi hutvā, ko'si tvaṃ, ko'smi ahan'tiādīni vatvā adhikaraṇapasutā honti, te asamānā nāma, tehi saddhiṃ saṃvāso dukkho'ti attho.

example_1: na kahāpaṇavassena, titti kāmesu vijjati, app'assādā dukhā kāmā, iti viññāya paṇḍito.
example_2: duppabbajjaṃ durabhiramaṃ, durāvāsā gharā dukhā, dukkhosamānasaṃvāso, dukkh'ānupatit'addhagū, tasmā na c'addhagū siyā, na ca dukkh'ānupatito siyā.

example_1: kadā nu'haṃ bhayajananiṃ dukh'āvahaṃ, taṇhālataṃ bahuvidh'ānuvattaniṃ, paññāmayaṃ tikhiṇam'asiṃ gahetvā, chetvā vase tam'pi kadā bhavissati.

meaning_1: faring badly; poor; miserable; suffering; unfortunate

to preach; to teach; to explain (to)

example_2: na kho, ānanda, sukaraṃ paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ. paresaṃ, ānanda, dhammaṃ desentena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo. katame pañca?

meaning_1: having preached; having taught; having explained (to)

meaning_1: will point out; will preach; will expound

example_1: na taṃ yāce yassa piyaṃ jigiṃse, desso hoti atiyācanāya, nāgo maṇiṃ yācito brāhmaṇena, adassanaṃ'y'eva tadajjhagamā'ti.
example_2: na me dessā ubho puttā, maddī devī na dessiyā.
commentary: (THIa) dessā'ti appiyā.

meaning_1: hating; enemy of; who is against

saccaṃ bhaṇe na kujjheyya, dajjā appam'pi yācito, etehi tīhi ṭhānehi, gacche devāna santike.
example_2: yo so yodh'ājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tam'enaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī'ti.

example_1: devassa kho dānaṃ dīyati, amhākaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati. sādhu mayam'pi devaṃ nissāya dānāni dadeyyāma, puññāni kareyyāmā'ti.
example_2: sādhu, devo, vāhanāgāresu ca dvāresu ca āṇāpetu, yena vāhanena jīvako icchati tena vāhanena gacchatu, yena dvārena icchati tena dvārena gacchatu, yaṃ kālaṃ icchati taṃ kālaṃ gacchatu, yaṃ kālaṃ icchati taṃ kālaṃ pavisatū'ti.

meaning_lit: god; i.e. Indra, god of the heavens
example_1: devo ca vassati devo ca gaḷagaḷāyati, ekako c'āhaṃ bherave bile viharāmi, tassa mayhaṃ ekakassa bherave bile viharato, n'atthi bhayaṃ vā chambhitattaṃ vā lomahaṃso vā.
example_2: pakk'odano duddhakhīro'ham'asmi, anutīre mahiyā samānavāso, channā kuṭi āhito gini, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.
commentary: (DNa) devo'ti megho.

meaning_lit: god; i.e. Indra, god of the heavens
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussakkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamagataṃ abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca
example_2: seyyathā'pi nāma saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ osadhitārakā bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca
commentary: (SNa) deve'ti ākāse

meaning_1: divine maiden; celestial nymph; heavenly girl
example_1: tattha cittaṃ paṇidhehi, yattha te vusitaṃ pure, tāvatiṃsesu devesu, sabbakāmasamiddhisu, purakkhato parivuto, devakaññāhi sobhasī'ti.
example_2: pabhā niddhāvate tassa, sataraṃsī'va uggato, ākiṇṇo devakaññāhi, āmodiṃ kāmakām'ahaṃ.

example_1: atha kho āyasmā ānando sāy'anhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi, āyām'āvuso, yena devakatasobbho ten'upasaṅkamissāma guhādassanāyā'ti. evam'āvuso'ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṃ.
commentary: (MNa) devakatasobbho'ti vass'odaken'eva tinnaṭṭhāne jāto mahāudakarahado.

meaning_1: host of heavenly beings; group of gods
example_1: mahāsamayo pavanasmiṃ, devakāyā samāgatā, āgat'amha imaṃ dhammasamayaṃ, dakkhitāye aparājitasaṅghan'ti.
example_2: ye keci buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gatāse, na te gamissanti apāyabhūmiṃ, pahāya mānusaṃ dehaṃ, devakāyaṃ paripūressantī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) devakāyā'ti devaghaṭā.

grammar: masc loc sg of devakāya, comp, irreg form of devakāyasmiṃ
meaning_1: in the host of heavenly beings; among the group of gods
construction:
deva + kāya + smiṃ > smi
devakāya + smi
example_1: n'atthi dāni pun'āvāso, devakāyasmi jālini, vikkhīṇo jātisaṃsāro, n'atthi dāni punabbhavo'ti.
commentary: (SNa) n'atthi dāni pun'āvāso, devakāyasmi jālinī'ti… devate devakāyasmiṃ devasamūhe upapajjanavasena puna āvāso āvasanaṃ idāni mayhaṃ n'atthī'ti attho.

meaning_1: group of gods; class of deities
example_1: tesaṃ nisinnānaṃ abhikkamiṃsu, vīrā virāgā virajaṃ karontā, te disvā saṃvegam'akāsi vāsavo, dev'ābhibhū devagaṇassa majjhe.
example_2: gandhabbakāyaṃ paripūrentī'ti gandhabbadevagaṇaṃ paripūrenti.
commentary: (DNt) gandhabbadevagaṇan'ti gandhabbadevasamūhaṃ.

meaning_1: who criticizes the gods; who finds fault with the gods
example_1: ahesuṃ kho ye, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ… bhūtagarahakā bhūtajigucchakā, devagarahakā devajigucchakā, pajāpatigarahakā pajāpatijigucchakā, brahmagarahakā brahmajigucchakā
atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamah'āmatto anattamano ahosi, kathañ'hi nāma devo devagahadārūni nagarapaṭisaṅkhārikāni āpad'atthāya nikkhittāni dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa dassatī'ti!
commentary: (VINa) devagahadārūnī'ti devena gahitadārūni. rājapaṭiggahitabhūtāni dārūnī'ti attho.

meaning_1: travelling amongst the gods; journey in heaven
example_1: bhavanā nikkhamitvāna, caranto devacārikaṃ, yadā icchāmi gamanaṃ, devasaṅghapurakkhato.
example_2: yadā buddho atthadassī, carate devacārikaṃ, koṭisatasahassānaṃ, dutiy'ābhisamayo ahu.
commentary: (BVa) devacārikan'ti devānaṃ vinayan'atthaṃ devalokacārikan'ti attho.

meaning_lit: discourse on gods passing away onto hell, etc.

meaning_1: who is repulsed by the gods; who is disgusted with the gods

meaning_1: one of the gods; member of the deities
example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhu, amanussaggāho? idha, bhikkhu, ekacco aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati, imin'āhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi dev'aññataro vā'ti.
example_2: yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati, imin'āhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi dev'aññataro vā'ti, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.

example_1: manussānaṃ piyo hoti, amanussānaṃ piyo hoti, devatā rakkhanti, n'āssa aggi vā visaṃ vā satthaṃ vā kamati, tuvaṭaṃ cittaṃ samādhiyati, mukhavaṇṇo vippasīdati
example_2: anejaṃ mūladassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kiṃ nissitā isayo manujā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā devatānaṃ, yaññam'akappayiṃsu puthū'dha loke, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

meaning_1: obligation to the gods; responsibility to the deities
example_1: kuto, bho sāriputta, amhākaṃ appamādo yesaṃ no… mitt'āmaccānaṃ mitt'āmaccakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ñātisālohitānaṃ ñātisālohitakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, atithīnaṃ atithikaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, pubbapetānaṃ pubbapetakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, devatānaṃ devatākaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, rañño rājakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ayam'pi kāyo pīṇetabbo brūhetabbo'ti?
commentary: (MNt) gandha-puppha-vilepana-jālā-bhattehi kālena kālaṃ devatānaṃ pūjā devatākaraṇīyaṃ, devatābalī'ti attho

meaning_1: cared for by gods; treated with compassion by deities
example_1: tato naṃ anukampan'ti, mātā puttaṃ'va orasaṃ, devat'ānukampito poso, sadā bhadrāni passatī'ti.

meaning_1: recollection of (the qualities of) divine beings
example_1: ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno devat'ānussatiṃ bhāveti

puna caparaṃ, gahapati, ariyasāvako uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sed'āvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi pañcabaliṃ kattā hoti, ñātibaliṃ, atithibaliṃ, pubbapetabaliṃ, rājabaliṃ, devatābaliṃ. idam'assa tatiyaṃ ṭhānagataṃ hoti pattagataṃ āyatanaso paribhuttaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) devatābalin'ti devatānaṃ kattabbabaliṃ. sabbam'etaṃ tesaṃ tesaṃ yath'ānucchavikavasena dātabbadānassa adhivacanaṃ.

meaning_1: spoken by a deity; preached by a gods
example_1: dhammo nāma buddhabhāsito, sāvakabhāsito, isibhāsito, devatābhāsito, atth'ūpasañhito, dhamm'ūpasañhito.
commentary: (VINa) devatābhāsito'ti devatāhi bhāsito, so devatāsaṃyutta-devaputtasaṃyutta-mārasaṃyutta-brahmasaṃyutta-sakkasaṃyutt'ādi-vasena veditabbo.

example_1: ettāvatā ca iminā vipassissa bhagavato apadānānusārena vitthārakathanena, tathāgatassevesā, bhikkhave, dhammadhātu suppaṭividdhā'ti evaṃ vuttāya dhammadhātuyā suppaṭividdhabhāvaṃ pakāsetvā idāni, devatā'pi tathāgatassa etam'atthaṃ ārocesun'ti vuttaṃ devat'ārocanaṃ pakāsetuṃ ekam'id'āhan'ti-ādim'āha.

tasmiṃ, bhikkhave, devanikāye anekāni devatāsahassāni anekāni devatāsatasahassāni yen'āhaṃ ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.

meaning_1: one thousand deities; a thousand gods
example_1: samaṇaṃ khalu, bho, gotamaṃ anekāni devatāsahassāni pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gatāni
commentary: (MNa) anekānaṃ devatāsahassānan'ti āyasmatā rāhulena padum'uttarassa bhagavato pādamūle pālitanāgarājakāle patthanaṃ paṭṭhapentena saddhiṃ patthanaṃ paṭṭhapitadevatā'y'eva. tāsu pana kāci bhūmaṭṭhakā devatā, kāci antalikkhakā, kāci cātumahārājikā, kāci devaloke, kāci brahmaloke nibbattā. imasmiṃ pana divase sabbā ekaṭṭhāne andhavanasmiṃ'y'eva sannipatitā.

meaning_2: act of purification in the presence of the gods
example_1: tassa attano ca tāsañ'ca devatānaṃ saddhañ'ca sīlañ'ca sutañ'ca cāgañ'ca paññañ'ca anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmojjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti. ayaṃ vuccati, visākhe, ariyasāvako devat'uposathaṃ upavasati, devatāhi saddhiṃ saṃvasati, devatā ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmojjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
commentary: (ANa) devat'uposathan'ti devatā sakkhiṭṭhāne ṭhapetvā attano guṇe anussarantena upavuttha-uposatho devat'uposatho nāma.

example_1: kodhaṃ jhatvā sukhaṃ seti, kodhaṃ jhatvā na socati, kodhassa visamūlassa, madhur'aggassa devate, vadhaṃ ariyā pasaṃsanti, tañ'hi jhatvā na socatī'ti.
example_2: atthakāmo'si me yakkha, hitakāmo'si devate, karomi tuyhaṃ vacanaṃ, tvaṃ'si ācariyo mama.

meaning_1: divinity; fact of being a deity
example_1: viññāṇaṃ anidassanaṃ anantaṃ sabbato pabhaṃ, taṃ… bhūtānaṃ bhūtattena ananubhūtaṃ, devānaṃ devattena ananubhūtaṃ, pajāpatissa pajāpatittena ananubhūtaṃ, brahmānaṃ brahmattena ananubhūtaṃ

meaning_1: state of being a deity; godly state
example_1: tvaññ'eva no citta karosi brāhmaṇo, tvaṃ khattiyo rājadasī karosi, vessā ca suddā ca bhavāma ekadā, devattanaṃ vā'pi tav'eva vāhasā.

meaning_1: generic monk's name used in examples; Deva the elder
example_1: mettāsinehasiniddhāni pana nayanāni ummīletvā suppasannena mukhena olokanaṃ sammukhā mettaṃ manokammaṃ nāma. devatthero, tissatthero arogo hotu app'ābādho'ti samannāharaṇaṃ parammukhā mettaṃ manokammaṃ nāma.

meaning_1: name of a monk; relative and nemesis of the Buddha

(SNa) devadahan'ti devā vuccanti rājāno, tesaṃ maṅgaladaho, sayaṃjāto vā so daho'ti, tasmā devadaho'ti vutto. tassa avidūre nigamo devadahan'tv'eva napuṃsakaliṅgavasena saṅkhaṃ gato.

meaning_1: host of devas; assembly of deities

commentary: (VINa) na mayaṃ, bhante ānanda, buddhagarahino'ti bhante ānanda, mayaṃ na buddhaṃ garahāma, na buddhassa dosaṃ dema. na dhammagarahino, na saṅghagarahino.

meaning_1: with respect for the teaching; giving weight to the Dhamma
example_1: kadā nu'haṃ sabbhi samāgamesu, diṭṭho bhave dhammagarūhi tādibhi, yāthāvadassīhi jit'indriyehi, padhāniyo taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
commentary: (ANa) dhammo garu assā'ti dhammagaru.

meaning_1: respect for the Dhamma; reverence towards the teaching
meaning_2: respect for the Dhamma; reverence towards the teaching
example_1: anujānāmi, bhikkhave, navakena bhikkhunā uddisantena samake vā āsane nisīdituṃ, uccatare vā dhammagāravena, therena bhikkhunā uddisāpentena samake vā āsane nisīdituṃ, nīcatare vā dhammagāravenā'ti.

meaning_1: respectful towards the teaching; giving weight to the Dhamma
example_1: tathā hi pana tvaṃ, bho'ti, pādukā ārohitvā ucce āsane nisīditvā sīsaṃ oguṇṭhitvā etadavoca, bhaṇa, samaṇa, dhamman'ti. dhammagaruno hi te bhavanto dhammagāravā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) dhammagāravatā'ti navavidhe lok'uttaradhamme garubhāvo.

meaning_1: fact of having respect for the teaching; fact of giving weight to the Dhamma
example_1: satthugāravatā, dhammagāravatā, saṅghagāravatā, sikkhāgāravatā, samādhigāravatā, appamādagāravatā, paṭisanthāragāravatā. ime kho, bhante, satta dhammā bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattantī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) dhammagāravatā'ti navavidhe lok'uttaradhamme garubhāvo.

meaning_1: guarded by the Dhamma; protected by the teaching
example_1: abalaṃ taṃ balaṃ āhu, yassa bālabalaṃ balaṃ, balassa dhammaguttassa, paṭivattā na vijjati.
example_2: hito bahunnaṃ paṭipajja bhoge, taṃ devatā rakkhati dhammaguttaṃ, bahussutaṃ sīlavat'ūpapannaṃ, dhamme ṭhitaṃ na vijahati kitti.
commentary: (SNa) dhammaguttassā'ti dhammena rakkhitassa, dhammaṃ vā rakkhantassa.

meaning_2: who announces about the preaching of the Dhamma

example_1: ujuko nāma so maggo, abhayā nāma sā disā, ratho akūjano nāma, dhammacakkehi saṃyuto.
commentary: (SNa) dhammacakkehi saṃyuto'ti kāyika-cetasika-vīriya-saṅkhātehi dhammacakkehi saṃyutto.

meaning_1: rolling the wheel of Dhamma forward; turning the wheel of the teaching
example_1: bandhumassa rañño bandhumatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi. vipassissa, mārisā, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa evaṃ abhinikkhamanaṃ ahosi evaṃ pabbajjā evaṃ padhānaṃ evaṃ abhisambodhi evaṃ dhammacakkappavattanaṃ.
commentary: (BVa) tattha pañcavaggiyānaṃ attano buddhabhāvaṃ pakāsetvā paññattavarabuddh'āsanagato pañcavaggiye bhikkhū āmantetvā dhammacakkappavattana-sutt'antaṃ desesi.

meaning_lit: discourse on rolling the wheel of Dhamma forward
section on rolling the wheel of Dhamma forward
meaning_2: Chapter 2 of the Saccasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

meaning_1: insight into the nature of reality; spiritual insight; understanding of the way things are
family_set: epithets of stream entry; five eyes
example_1: seyyathā'pi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ samma'd'eva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, evam'eva tesaṃ caturāsītipāṇasahassānaṃ tasmiṃ'y'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi, yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti
example_2: khat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. upahat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā pitaraṃ dhammikaṃ dhammarājānaṃ jīvitā na voropessatha, imasmiññ'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ uppajjissathā'ti.
commentary: (DNa) dhammacakkhun'ti dhammesu vā cakkhuṃ, dhammamayaṃ vā cakkhuṃ, aññesu ṭhānesu tiṇṇaṃ maggānam'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. idha pana sotāpattimaggass'eva.

meaning_1: acquiring insight into the nature of reality; gaining spiritual insight
example_1: n'eva satimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti purimaṃ dukkhakkhandhaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādiṇṇaṃ upanidhāya yadidaṃ sattakkhattuṃparamatā. evaṃ mah'atthiyo kho, bhikkhave, dhamm'ābhisamayo, evaṃ mah'atthiyo dhammacakkhupaṭilābho'ti.

meaning_1: conduct in line with the Dhamma; ethical conduct; moral behaviour
example_1: dānañ'ca dhammacariyā ca, ñātakānañ'ca saṅgaho, anavajjāni kammāni, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.
example_2: ime ca, mahāli, dasa dhammā loke na saṃvijjeyyuṃ, na'y'idha paññāyetha adhammacariyāvisamacariyā'ti vā dhammacariyāsamacariyā'ti vā.
commentary: (KHPa) dhammassa cariyā, dhammā vā anapetā cariyā dhammacariyā. ñāyante amhākaṃ ime'ti ñātakā.

meaning_1: taking extreme pleasure in ethical conduct; very fond of conduct in line with the Dhamma
example_1: pubbaṅ'gamo sucaritesu ahu, dhammesu dhammacariy'ābhirato, anvāyiko bahujanassa ahu, saggesu vedayittha puññaphalaṃ.

meaning_1: ethical and moral conduct; good conduct and wholesome behaviour
example_1: tividhaṃ kho, gahapatayo, kāyena dhammacariyāsamacariyā hoti, catubbidhaṃ vācāya dhammacariyāsamacariyā hoti, tividhaṃ manasā dhammacariyāsamacariyā hoti.
example_2: yo hi, bho sāriputta, mātāpitūnaṃ hetu adhammacārī visamacārī assa, na taṃ seyyo, yo ca kho, bho sāriputta, mātāpitūnaṃ hetu dhammacārī samacārī assa, tadev'ettha seyyo. adhammacariyāvisamacariyāhi, bho sāriputta, dhammacariyāsamacariyā seyyo'ti.

meaning_1: because of ethical and moral conduct; due to good conduct and wholesome behaviour
example_1: dhammacariyāsamacariyāhetu kho, gahapatayo, evam'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantī'ti.

meaning_1: generosity with the teaching; Dhamma sharing
example_1: katame dve? āmisacāgo ca dhammacāgo ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve cāgā.
commentary: (ANa) āmisassa cajanaṃ āmisacāgo, dhammassa cajanaṃ dhammacāgo.

meaning_1: who lives the Dhamma; who practices the teaching; who walks in truth
example_1: uttiṭṭhe nappamajjeyya, dhammaṃ sucaritaṃ care, dhammacārī sukhaṃ seti, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.
example_2: dhammo have rakkhati dhammacāriṃ, dhammo suciṇṇo sukham'āvahati. es'ānisaṃso dhamme suciṇṇe, na duggatiṃ gacchati dhammacārī.

example_1: ākaṅkheyya ce, gahapatayo, dhammacārī samacārī, aho vat'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti, ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.
commentary: (MNa) dhammacārī'ti dhammikasivavijj'ādikammakārī. (JAa) dhammacārī'ti dasakusalakammapatha-dhammacārī.

meaning_1: thinking about the Dhamma; examination of phenomena
example_1: sati gīvā siro paññā, vīmaṃsā dhammacintanā, dhammakucchisamāvāso, viveko tassa vāladhi.

meaning_1: lawfully accused; properly charged; legally impeached
example_1: dhammacuditassa, āvuso, bhikkhuno imehi pañcah'ākārehi vippaṭisāro upadahātabbo.

meaning_1: monument to the Dhamma; tribute to the teaching
example_1: eso, bhikkhave, rājā pasenadi kosalo dhammacetiyāni bhāsitvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkanto. uggaṇhatha, bhikkhave, dhammacetiyāni, pariyāpuṇātha, bhikkhave, dhammacetiyāni, dhāretha, bhikkhave, dhammacetiyāni.
commentary: (MNa) dhammacetiyānī'ti dhammassa cittīkāravacanāni. tīsu hi ratanesu yattha katthaci cittīkāre kate sabbattha kato'y'eva hoti, tasmā bhagavati cittīkāre kate dhammo'pi kato'va hotī'ti bhagavā dhammacetiyānī'ti āha.

meaning_lit: discourse on monuments to the Dhamma

meaning_1: lawful accuser; who charges correctly; who impeaches legally
meaning_2: (a monk) who accuses (someone) of an offence properly, by the rules
example_1: dhammacodakassa, āvuso, bhikkhuno imehi pañcah'ākārehi avippaṭisāro upadahātabbo.
commentary: (VINa) pañcadasasu dhammesu appatiṭṭhahitvā abhūtena vatthunā codento adhammacodako nāma, tena tathā codito adhammacuditako nāma. vipariyāyena dhammacodakacuditakā veditabbā.

meaning_1: interest in mental phenomena; desire for thoughts
example_1: dhammadhātuṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaññā, dhammasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaṅkappo, dhammasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammacchando, dhammacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariḷāho, dhammapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariyesanā.
commentary: (ADHa) dhammacchando'ti sabhāvacchando. ayañ'hi chando nāma taṇhāchando, diṭṭhichando, vīriyachando, dhammacchando'ti bahuvidho nānappakārako. tesu dhammacchando'ti imasmiṃ ṭhāne kattukamyatākusaladhammacchando adhippeto.

meaning_1: born from Dhamma; born of the teaching
example_1: tassa me tumhe puttā orasā mukhato jātā dhammajā dhammanimmitā dhammadāy'ādā, no āmisadāy'ādā.

meaning_1: net of the teaching; net of Dhamma
example_1: ko nāmo ayaṃ, bhante, dhammapariyāyo'ti? tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, ānanda, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ atthajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, dhammajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, brahmajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, diṭṭhijālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo'ti'pi naṃ dhārehī'ti.
uṭṭhānavato satīmato, sucikammassa nisammakārino, saññatassa dhammajīvino, appamattassa yaso'bhivaḍḍhati.
example_2: pakkamissañ'ca nāḷāto, ko'dha nāḷāya vacchati, bandhantī itthirūpena, samaṇe dhammajīvino.

meaning_1: who knows the teaching; who knows the Dhamma; who understands reality
example_1: satta sappurisadhammā, idh'āvuso, bhikkhu dhammaññū ca hoti atthaññū ca attaññū ca mattaññū ca kālaññū ca parisaññū ca puggalaññū ca.
commentary: (DNa) suttageyy'ādikaṃ dhammaṃ jānātī'ti dhammaññū.

meaning_1: firmly established in the Dhamma; righteous; just; moral; virtuous
example_1: sīladassanasampannaṃ, dhammaṭṭhaṃ saccavedinaṃ, attano kamma kubbānaṃ, taṃ jano kurute piyaṃ.
example_2: kesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, sadā puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati, dhammaṭṭhā sīlasampannā, ke janā saggagāmino'ti.
synonym: dhammika, dhammiya, dhammī, sīlavatī, sīlavant, sugatī
commentary: (SNa) dhammaṭṭhā sīlasampannā'ti tasmiṃ dhamme ṭhitattā tena'pi sīlena sampannattā dhammaṭṭhā sīlasampannā. (DHPa) dhammaṭṭhan'ti navavidhalok'uttaradhamme ṭhitaṃ, sacchikata-lok'uttaradhamman'ti attho. (SNPa) dhammaṭṭho'ti catusaccadhamme ṭhito.

meaning_1: firmly established in and connected with the Dhamma
example_1: sace c'assa kathākāmo, kālam'aññāya paṇḍito, dhammaṭṭhapaṭisaṃyuttā, yā ariyacaritā kathā.
commentary: (ANa) dhammaṭṭhapaṭisaṃyuttā'ti yā ca dhamme ṭhitena kathitakathā, sā dhammaṭṭhā c'eva hoti tena ca dhammena paṭisaṃyuttā'ti dhammaṭṭhapaṭisaṃyuttā.

meaning_1: regularity of natural principles; stability of the Dhamma
example_1: api ca samaṇo gotamo bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ tathaṃ paṭipadaṃ paññapeti dhammaṭṭhitataṃ dhammaniyāmataṃ.
commentary: (DNa) dhammaṭṭhitatan'ti navalok'uttaradhammesu ṭhitasabhāvaṃ.

meaning_1: knowledge of the stability of the Dhamma
meaning_2: knowledge of relationship of ideas or states, knowledge of structure of ideas or states (term for dependent origination)
example_1: asati jātiyā n'atthi jarāmaraṇan'ti ñāṇaṃ, yam'pi'ssa taṃ dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇaṃ tam'pi khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhamman'ti ñāṇaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇan'ti paccay'ākāre ñāṇaṃ. paccay'ākāro hi dhammānaṃ pavattiṭṭhitikāraṇattā dhammaṭṭhitīti vuccati, ettha ñāṇaṃ dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇaṃ, etass'eva chabbidhassa ñāṇassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ. (SNa) dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇan'ti vipassanāñāṇaṃ, taṃ paṭhamataraṃ uppajjati.

meaning_1: reflection on the Dhamma; (comm) right intention
example_1: upekkhāsatisaṃsuddhaṃ, dhammatakkapurejavaṃ, aññāvimokkhaṃ pabrūmi, avijjāya pabhedanaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) dhammatakkapurejavan'ti dhammatakko vuccati sammāsaṅkappo, so ādito hoti, purato hoti, pubbaṅ'gamo hoti aññāvimokkhassā'ti dhammatakkapurejavo.

meaning_1: headed by reflection on the teaching; with thoughts about the Dhamma leading the way; (comm) preceded by right view or right intention; (or) initial phase of vipassanā
example_1: upekkhāsatisaṃsuddhaṃ, dhammatakkapurejavaṃ, aññāvimokkhaṃ pabrūmi, avijjāya pabhedanan'ti.
commentary: (NIDD2) dhammatakkapurejavan'ti dhammatakko vuccati sammāsaṅkappo. so ādito hoti, purato hoti, pubbaṅ'gamo hoti aññāvimokkhassā'ti, evam'pi dhammatakkapurejavaṃ. atha vā, dhammatakko vuccati sammādiṭṭhi. sā ādito hoti, purato hoti, pubbaṅ'gamo hoti aññāvimokkhassā'ti, evam'pi dhammatakkapurejavaṃ. atha vā, dhammatakko vuccati catunnaṃ maggānaṃ pubbabhāgavipassanā. sā ādito hoti, purato hoti, pubbaṅ'gamo hoti aññāvimokkhassā'ti, evam'pi dhammatakkapurejavaṃ. (SNPa) dhammatakkapurejavan'ti iminā tasmiṃ catutthajjhānavimokkhe ṭhatvā jhān'aṅgāni vipassitvā adhigataṃ arahattavimokkhaṃ vadati. arahattavimokkhassa hi maggasampayuttasammāsaṅkapp'ādi-bhedo dhammatakko purejavo hoti. ten'āha, dhammatakkapurejavan'ti.

example_1: katamā ca, bhikkhave, taṇhā? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, taṇhākāyā, rūpataṇhā, saddataṇhā, gandhataṇhā, rasataṇhā, phoṭṭhabbataṇhā, dhammataṇhā. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, taṇhā.
example_2: rūpataṇhā… saddataṇhā… gandhataṇhā… rasataṇhā… phoṭṭhabbataṇhā… dhammataṇhā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etth'esā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati

meaning_1: this is natural (for); this is the nature (of); this is the character (of); this is normal (for)
example_1: sīlavato, bhikkhave, sīlasampannassa na cetanāya karaṇīyaṃ, avippaṭisāro me uppajjatū'ti. dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yaṃ sīlavato sīlasampannassa avippaṭisāro uppajjati.
example_2: dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa, kiñ'c'āpi tathārūpiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati, yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati, atha kho naṃ khippam'eva satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu deseti vivarati uttānīkaroti, desetvā vivaritvā uttānīkatvā āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.

example_1: sabbe saddhammagaruno, vihaṃsu viharanti ca, tathā'pi viharissanti, esā buddhāna dhammatā.
example_2: tassā hi nāma, āvuso, bāhirāya pathavīdhātuyā tāva mahallikāya aniccatā paññāyissati, khayadhammatā paññāyissati, vayadhammatā paññāyissati, vipariṇāmadhammatā paññāyissati.
commentary: (MNa) dhammatāyā'ti sabhāvena.

meaning_1: universal law; nature of the Dhamma
example_1: uttamaṃ dhammataṃ patto, sabbaloke anatthiko, ādittā'va gharā mutto, maraṇasmiṃ na socati.

meaning_2: natural form; i.e. stones, trees, etc.

meaning_1: well investigated according to character; thoroughly scrutinized regarding qualities
example_1: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tathāgate dhammasamannesanā hoti. evañ'ca pana tathāgato dhammatāsusamanniṭṭho hotī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) dhammatāsusamanniṭṭho'ti dhammatāya susamanniṭṭho, sabhāven'eva suṭṭhu samannesito hotī'ti attho.

meaning_2: being legal or valid, being according to the rule
discourse on the meaning of the Dhamma

meaning_1: thief of the Dhamma; who steals the teaching
meaning_2: thief of dhamma (who enters the Saṅgha dishonestly)
example_1: atha kho āyasmā susimo bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, accayo maṃ, bhante, accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, yv'āhaṃ evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye dhammatthenako pabbajito. tassa me, bhante, bhagavā accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā'ti.

meaning_2: elder in dhamma, one venerable because of his qualities

example_1: tayo therā, jātithero, dhammathero, sammutithero.
commentary: (DNa) cattāro'me, bhikkhave, therakaraṇā dhammā. idha, bhikkhave, thero sīlavā hoti, bahussuto hoti, catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ lābhī hoti, āsavānaṃ khayā bahussuto hoti, catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ lābhī hoti, āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro therakaraṇā dhammā'ti (a. ni. 4.22). evaṃ vuttesu dhammesu ekena vā anekehi vā samannāgato dhammathero nāma.

meaning_1: who sees the truth; who perceives reality
example_1: na hi socati bhikkhu kadāci, maggajino sammāpaṭipanno, kittiñ'ca sukhañ'ca anubhoti, dhammadaso'ti tam'āhu pahit'attaṃ.
commentary: (THa) dhammadaso'ti tam'āhu tathattan'ti taṃ tathabhāvaṃ sammāpaṭipannaṃ yāthāvato dhammadassī'ti paṇḍitā āhu.

meaning_1: seeing the Dhamma; understanding the teaching
example_1: tasmā saddhañ'ca sīlañ'ca, pasādaṃ dhammadassanaṃ, anuyuñjetha medhāvī, saraṃ buddhāna sāsanan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) dhammadassanan'ti padena dhamme pasādo gahito'ti evaṃ cattāri sot'āpattiy'aṅgāni vuttāni.

meaning_1: gift of Dhamma; gift of the teaching
example_1: sabbadānaṃ dhammadānaṃ jināti, sabbarasaṃ dhammaraso jināti, sabbaratiṃ dhammarati jināti, taṇhakkhayo sabbadukkhaṃ jināti.
example_2: dve'māni, bhikkhave, dānāni āmisadānañ'ca dhammadānañ'ca. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dvinnaṃ dānānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammadānaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) dhammadānan'ti idh'ekacco amatapattipaṭipadaṃ kathetvā deti, idaṃ dhammadānaṃ nāma.

meaning_1: spiritual heir; inheritor of the Dhamma
meaning_2: having dhamma as one's inheritance, spiritual heir
example_1: tassa me tumhe puttā orasā mukhato jātā dhammajā dhammanimmitā dhammadāy'ādā, no āmisadāy'ādā.
example_2: tumhe ca me bhikkhave āmisadāy'ādā bhaveyyātha no dhammadāy'ādā, tumhe'pi tena ādiyā bhaveyyātha, āmisadāy'ādā satthusāvakā viharanti, no dhammadāy'ādā'ti

meaning_lit: discourse on heirs of the teaching

example_1: atha kho dhammadinno upāsako pañcahi upāsakasatehi saddhiṃ yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
commentary: (SNa) dhammadinno'ti sattasu janesu eko. buddhakālasmiñ'hi dhammadinno upāsako, visākho upāsako, uggo gahapati, citto gahapati, hatthako āḷavako, cūḷaanāthapiṇḍiko, mahāanāthapiṇḍiko'ti ime satta janā pañcasataupāsakaparivārā ahesuṃ. etesu esa aññataro.

meaning_1: name of an arahant nun; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost nun in giving Dhamma talks
family_set: great disciples; names of arahants; names of nuns
example_1: atha kho visākho upāsako yena dhammadinnā bhikkhunī ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā dhammadinnaṃ bhikkhuniṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
example_2: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ dhammakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammadinnā.
notes: Therīgāthā verse 12 (TH1.12, TH12) is attributed to her.

meaning_1: with Dhamma as one's place of safety; with Dhamma as one's solid ground
meaning_2: having the Dhamma as a sound footing
example_1: dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā
makkhī dhammaṃ suṇāti makkhapariyuṭṭhito, upārambhacitto dhammaṃ suṇāti randhagavesī, dhammadesake āhatacitto hoti khīlajāto, duppañño hoti jaḷo eḷamūgo, anaññāte aññātamānī hoti.

meaning_lit: for the purpose of giving a Dhamma talk

example_1: atha kho bāhiyassa dārucīriyassa bhagavato imāya saṃkhittāya dhammadesanāya tāva'd'eva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucci.
example_2: idha no, āvuso, ko viseso, ko adhippayāso, kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ samaṇassa vā gotamassa amhākaṃ vā, yadidaṃ dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanaṃ, anusāsaniyā vā anusāsanin'ti?
commentary: (MNa) dhammadasenā'ti tantiṭhapanā.

meaning_1: by means of the Dhamma discourse
rule about teaching the Dhamma; Pācittiya 7

example_1: suvijāno bhavaṃ hoti, suvijāno parābhavo, dhammakāmo bhavaṃ hoti, dhammadessī parābhavo.

meaning_1: who sees the Dhamma; who understands the reality
example_1: oghassa nittharaṇ'atthaṃ, anekavihitaṃ maggaṃ akkhāsi, tasmiñ'ce amate akkhāte, dhammaddasā ṭhitā asaṃhīrā.
example_2: evaṃ ahaṃ amatadasamhi devatā, tathāgatassanadhivarassa sāvikā, dhammaddasā paṭhamaphale patiṭṭhitā, sot'āpannā na ca pana m'atthi duggati.
commentary: (SNa) dhammaddasā'ti dhammassa passitāro. (VVa) dhammaddasā'ti catusaccadhammaṃ diṭṭhavatī.

example_1: tena hi tvaṃ, tāta, dhammaṃ'y'eva nissāya dhammaṃ sakkaronto dhammaṃ garuṃ karonto dhammaṃ mānento dhammaṃ pūjento dhammaṃ apacāyamāno dhammaddhajo dhammaketu dhamm'ādhipateyyo dhammikaṃ rakkh'āvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahassu antojanasmiṃ balakāyasmiṃ khattiyesu anuyantesu brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamajānapadesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu migapakkhīsu.
commentary: (DNa) dhammaddhajo dhammaketū'ti taṃ dhammaṃ dhajam'iva purakkhatvā ketum'iva ca ukkhipitvā pavattiyā dhammaddhajo dhammaketu ca hutvā'ti attho.

meaning_1: who knows the Dhamma by heart
meaning_2: who knows the Dhamma by heart
example_1: na tāvatā dhammadharo, yāvatā bahu bhāsati, yo ca appam'pi sutvāna, dhammaṃ kāyena passati, sa ve dhammadharo hoti, yo dhammaṃ nappamajjati.
example_2: bahussuto dhammadharo, bahussuto dhammadharo'ti, bhante, vuccati. kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, bahussuto dhammadharo hotī'ti?
commentary: (ANa) dhammadharā'ti sutadhammānaṃ ādhārabhūtā.

meaning_1: nature of reality; way things are
example_1: sā hi, rājakumāra, tathāgatassa dhammadhātu suppaṭividdhā yassā dhammadhātuyā suppaṭividdhattā ṭhānaso'v'etaṃ tathāgataṃ paṭibhātī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) dhammadhātū'ti dhammasabhāvo. sabbaññutaññāṇassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ. taṃ bhagavatā suppaṭividdhaṃ, hatthagataṃ bhagavato.

example_1: evaṃ, bhante. idaṃ kho, gahapati, dhātunānattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, cakkhuviññāṇadhātu… manodhātu, dhammadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu.
commentary: (SNa) cakkhudhātū'ti-ādīsu… tisso manodhātuyo manodhātu, vedan'ādayo tayo khandhā sukhumarūpāni nibbānañ'ca dhammadhātu, sabbam'pi manoviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇadhātū'ti.

meaning_1: remembering the teaching; bearing the Dhamma in mind
example_1: sā'pi nāma, bhikkhave, saddhā n'āhosi, tam'pi nāma, bhikkhave, upasaṅkamanaṃ n'āhosi, sā'pi nāma, bhikkhave, payirupāsanā n'āhosi, tam'pi nāma, bhikkhave, sot'āvadhānaṃ n'āhosi, tam'pi nāma, bhikkhave, dhammassavanaṃ n'āhosi, sā'pi nāma, bhikkhave, dhammadhāraṇā n'āhosi

meaning_2: with dhamma as master; guided by dhamma

meaning_1: delight in the Dhamma; enjoyment of the Dhamma
example_1: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, ten'eva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
commentary: (MNa) dhammarāgena dhammanandiyā'ti padadvayehi samathavipassanāsu chandarāgo vutto.

grammar: nt loc sg of dhanva, irreg form of dhanvani
meaning_1: on dry land; on the shore; on a sandbank
example_1: anatthasaṃhitaṃ ñatvā, yaṃ kiñci amaraṃ tapaṃ, sabbaṃ n'atth'āvahaṃ hoti, phiy'ārittaṃ'va dhammani.
commentary: (SNa) phiy'ārittaṃ'va dhammanī'ti araññe thale phiy'ārittaṃ viya.

meaning_1: acceptance of the teaching after consideration; approving of the teaching after understanding it
example_1: atthaṃ upaparikkhato dhammā nijjhānaṃ khamanti, dhammanijjhānakkhantiyā sati chando jāyati, chandajāto ussahati, ussahitvā tuleti, tulayitvā padahati, pahit'atto samāno kāyena c'eva paramasaccaṃ sacchikaroti paññāya ca naṃ ativijjha passati.
commentary: (ADha) sabbe'pi'ssā te kamm'āyatan'ādayo dhammā nijjhānaṃ khamanti, visesato ca pañcakkhandhasaṅkhātā dhammā punappunaṃ aniccadukkh'ānattavasena nijjhāyamānā taṃ nijjhānaṃ khamantī'ti dhammanijjhānakhantī

meaning_1: acceptance of the teaching after consideration; approving of the teaching after understanding it
meaning_2: choice after pondering over the True Idea (Dhamma); acceptance of the Dhamma as a result of reflection
example_1: yogavihitesu vā kammāyatanesu yogavihitesu vā sippāyatanesu yogavihitesu vā vijjāṭṭhānesu kammassakataṃ vā sacc'ānulomikaṃ vā… viññāṇaṃ aniccan'ti vā, yaṃ evarūpiṃ anulomikaṃ khantiṃ diṭṭhiṃ ruciṃ mutiṃ pekkhaṃ dhammanijjhānakhantiṃ parato assutvā paṭilabhati, ayaṃ vuccati cintāmayā paññā
commentary: (ADha) sabbe'pi'ssā te kamm'āyatan'ādayo dhammā nijjhānaṃ khamanti, visesato ca pañcakkhandhasaṅkhātā dhammā punappunaṃ aniccadukkh'ānattavasena nijjhāyamānā taṃ nijjhānaṃ khamantī'ti dhammanijjhānakhantī

(VINt) dhammavasena upacāravasena nimantanā dhammanimantanā'ti pāḷipadassa attho veditabbo. sace pana vadeyyātha, bhante, yen'attho'ti idaṃ saccam'eva vuttaṃ siyā, pavārito'y'eva hoti. yasmā pana pavāretvā'pi adātu'kāmo appavāritaṭṭhāne'y'eva tiṭṭhati, tasmā bhagavā pavārit'āpavāritabhāvaṃ avicāretvā ñātako te, upananda, aññātako'ti ñātakaaññātakabhāvaṃ'y'eva vicāresi.

meaning_1: mental representation of phenomena; mental image
example_1: idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na dhammanimitt'ānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti na dhammanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ na dhammanimitt'assādavinibandhaṃ na dhammanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ avisaṭan'ti vuccati.
commentary: (ANt) dhammanimittan'ti dhamm'ārammaṇasaṅkhātaṃ nimittaṃ.

meaning_1: expanding of and bondage to the resort that is the representation of mental phenomena
example_1: rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā kho, gahapati, niketasārī'ti vuccati. saddanimitta … gandhanimitta… rasanimitta… phoṭṭhabbanimitta… dhammanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā kho, gahapati, niketasārī'ti vuccati. evaṃ kho, gahapati, niketasārī hoti.
commentary: (SNa) rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā'ti rūpam'eva kilesānaṃ paccay'aṭṭhena nimittaṃ, ārammaṇakiriya-saṅkhāta-nivāsanaṭṭhān'aṭṭhena niketan'ti rūpanimittaniketaṃ. visāro ca vinibandho ca visāravinibandhā. ubhayen'api hi kilesānaṃ patthaṭabhāvo ca vinibandhanabhāvo ca vutto, rūpanimittanikete visāravinibandhā'ti rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā, tasmā rūpanimittaniketamhi uppannena kilesavisārena c'eva kilesabandhanena cā'ti attho.
notes: A difficult term to translate. See CPB note 22. Also see rūpanimittaniketavisāravinibandha.

meaning_1: bound by gratification to the mental representation of phenomena
example_1: idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno manasā dhammaṃ viññāya dhammanimitt'ānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti, dhammanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ dhamma-nimitt'assāda-vinibandhaṃ dhammanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati. evaṃ kho āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: bound with a chain to the gratification from the mental representation of phenomena
example_1: idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya dhammanimitt'ānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti, dhammanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ dhamma-nimitt'assāda-vinibandhaṃ dhammanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati. evaṃ kho āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: bound by the gratification from the mental representation of phenomena
example_1: idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya dhammanimitt'ānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti, dhammanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ dhamma-nimitt'assāda-vinibandhaṃ dhammanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati. evaṃ kho āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: following the mental representations of phenomena
example_1: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya dhammanimitt'ānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti, dhammanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ dhamma-nimitt'assāda-vinibandhaṃ dhammanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati. evaṃ kho āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: created by the Dhamma; fashioned from the Dhamma
example_1: tassa me tumhe puttā orasā mukhato jātā dhammajā dhammanimmitā dhammadāy'ādā, no āmisadāy'ādā.

meaning_1: invariance of natural principles; orderliness of the teaching
example_1: api ca samaṇo gotamo bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ tathaṃ paṭipadaṃ paññapeti dhammaṭṭhitataṃ dhammaniyāmataṃ.
evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ. tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na dhammaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me dhammanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.

meaning_2: who follows dhamma; who develops understanding

meaning_1: guidelines of the teaching; Dhamma as a guide
meaning_2: leading rope, guiding rope, that is dhamma
example_1: teh'ānanda, bhikkhūhi sabbeh'eva samaggehi sannipatitabbaṃ. sannipatitvā dhammanetti samanumajjitabbā. dhammanettiṃ samanumajjitvā yathā tattha sameti tathā taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametabbaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) dhammanetti samanumajjitabbā'ti dhammarajju anumajjitabbā ñāṇena ghaṃsitabbā upaparikkhitabbā. sā pan'esā dhammanetti, iti kho, vaccha, ime dasa dhammā akusalā dasa dhammā kusalā'ti evaṃ mahāvacchagottasutte (ma. ni. 2.194) āgatā'ti vuttā. sā eva vā hotu, yo vā idha dhammo'ti ca vinayo ca vutto.

meaning_1: inference about the Dhamma; understanding about the teaching (for someone regarding someone)
example_1: evam'eva kho me, bhante, dhamm'anvayo vidito, ye te, bhante, ahesuṃ atītam'addhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, sabbe te bhagavanto pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacittā sattabojjh'aṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhiṃsu.
example_2: ayam'pi hi nāma, sāriputta, sunakkhattassa moghapurisassa mayi dhamm'anvayo na bhavissati, iti'pi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho
commentary: (DNa) dhamm'anvayo'ti dhammassa paccakkhato ñāṇassa anuyogaṃ anugantvā uppannaṃ anumānañāṇaṃ nayaggāho vidito. sāvakapāramīñāṇe ṭhatvāva iminā'va ākārena jānāmi bhagavā'ti vadati. therassa hi nayaggāho appamāṇo apariyanto. yathā sabbaññutaññāṇassa pamāṇaṃ vā pariyanto vā n'atthi, evaṃ dhammasenāpatino nayaggāhassa. tena so iminā evaṃvidho, iminā anuttaro satthā'ti jānāti. therassa hi nayaggāho sabbaññutaññāṇagatiko eva. (MNa) tattha anvetī'ti anvayo, jānāti, anubujjhatī'ti attho. dhammassa anvayo dhamm'anvayo

meaning_2: necessity of an idea or principle

meaning_1: teaching the Dhamma; communicating the teaching
example_1: so tāya dhammapaññattiyā divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhu, bhikkhu paññattibahulo, no dhammavihārī.
commentary: (ANa) dhammapaññattiyā'ti dhammassa paññāpanāya.

meaning_2: false representation of the teachings or the rule

example_1: katame dve? āmisapaṭisanthāro ca dhammapaṭisanthāro ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve paṭisanthārā.
commentary: (ADha) dhammapaṭisanthāro'ti dhammassa appaṭilābhena attanā saha paresaṃ chiddaṃ yathā pihitaṃ hoti paṭicchannaṃ, evaṃ dhammena paṭisantharaṇaṃ.

meaning_1: analytical understanding of natural conditions; discriminative understanding of the teaching
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, dhammapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, niruttipaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, yathāvimuttaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhati.

meaning_1: attained analytical understanding of natural conditions; (comm) reached a discriminative understanding of the teaching
example_1: katamehi pañcahi? atthapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, dhammapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, niruttipaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ ucc'āvacāni kiṃkaraṇīyāni tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatr'upāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ
commentary: (VINa) na dhammapaṭisambhidāpatto'ti pāḷidhamme paṭisambhidāpatto na hoti. (PYt) pāḷidhamme'ti iminā dhammapaṭisambhidāpatto'ti ettha dhammasarūpaṃ dasseti.

meaning_1: experiencing the teaching; sensitive to the Dhamma; (comm) knowing the text
example_1: tassa atthapaṭisaṃvedino dhammapaṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. idaṃ paṭhamaṃ vimutt'āyatanaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) atthapaṭisaṃvedino'ti pāḷi-atthaṃ jānantassa. dhammapaṭisaṃvedino'ti pāḷiṃ jānantassa.

meaning_1: verse of the teaching; line of Dhamma; religious saying
meaning_2: line or stanza of the Dhamma
example_1: ko imaṃ pathaviṃ vicessati, yamalokañ'ca imaṃ sadevakaṃ, ko dhammapadaṃ sudesitaṃ, kusalo puppham'iva pacessati.
example_2: yo ca gāthā sataṃ bhāse, anatthapadasaṃhitā, ekaṃ dhammapadaṃ seyyo, yaṃ sutvā upasammati.
commentary: (DHPa) ko dhammapadaṃ sudesitan'ti yathāsabhāvato kathitattā sudesitaṃ sattatiṃsa-bodhipakkhiyadhamma-saṅkhātaṃ dhammapadaṃ (DHPa) dhammapadan'ti atthasādhakaṃ khandh'ādipaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, cattār'imāni paribbājakā dhammapadāni. katamāni cattāri? anabhijjhā paribbājakā dhammapadaṃ, abyāpādo paribbājakā dhammapadaṃ, sammāsati paribbājakā dhammapadaṃ, sammāsamādhi paribbājakā dhammapadan'ti

meaning_1: path of Dhamma; way of the teaching; (comm) state of awakening
example_1: saddhā hi dānaṃ bahudhā pasatthaṃ, dānā ca kho dhammapadaṃ'va seyyo, pubbe ca hi pubbatare ca santo, nibbānam'ev'ajjhagamuṃ sapaññā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) dānā ca kho dhammapadaṃ'va seyyo'ti dānato nibbānasaṅkhātaṃ dhammapadam'eva seyyo.

example_1: bhayadassi vā [bhayadassāvī dha. pa. 32 dhammapade'pi]
example_2: tato paraṃ jātakaṃ, niddeso, paṭisambhidāmaggo, apadānaṃ, suttanipāto, khuddakapāṭho, dhammapadaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, vimānavatthu, petavatthu, theragāthā, therīgāthā'ti imaṃ tantiṃ saṅgāyitvā khuddakagantho nām'āyan'ti ca vatvā abhidhammapiṭakasmiṃ'y'eva saṅgahaṃ āropayiṃsū'ti dīghabhāṇakā vadanti.

example_1: aññatra asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā, aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā apariyādinnā'y'ev'assa, sāriputta, tathāgatassa dhammadesanā, apariyādinnaṃ'y'ev'assa tathāgatassa dhammapadabyañjanaṃ, apariyādinnaṃ'y'ev'assa tathāgatassa pañhapaṭibhānaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) dhammapadabyañjanan'ti pāḷiyā padabyañjanaṃ, tassa tassa atthassa byañjanakaṃ akkharaṃ.

meaning_lit: discourse on aspects of the Dhamma

meaning_1: generosity with the teaching; Dhamma sharing
example_1: katame dve? āmisapariccāgo ca dhammapariccāgo ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve pariccāgā.
so tāya dhammapariyattiyā divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhu, bhikkhu pariyattibahulo, no dhammavihārī.
nibbedhikapariyāyaṃ vo, bhikkhave, dhammapariyāyaṃ desessāmi. taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca.
example_2: ko nāmo ayaṃ, bhante, dhammapariyāyo'ti? tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, ānanda, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ madhupiṇḍikapariyāyo tv'eva naṃ dhārehī'ti

example_1: katamā dve? āmisapariyeṭṭhi ca dhammapariyeṭṭhi ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve pariyeṭṭhiyo.
commentary: (ANa) matthakappattā āmisapariyesanā āmisapariyeṭṭhi, matthakappattā'va dhammapariyesanā dhammapariyeṭṭhīti vuttā.

meaning_1: quest for mental phenomena; searching for thoughts
example_1: dhammadhātuṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaññā, dhammasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaṅkappo, dhammasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammacchando, dhammacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariḷāho, dhammapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariyesanā.
commentary: (SNa) no dhammapariyesanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariḷāho'ti evaṃ āgataṃ paṭisedhamattam'eva nānaṃ.

meaning_1: quest for Dhamma; searching for the teaching
example_1: imā kho, bhikkhave, dve pariyesanā. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ pariyesanānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammapariyesanā'ti.

meaning_1: fever for mental phenomena; burning passion for thoughts
example_1: dhammadhātuṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaññā, dhammasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaṅkappo, dhammasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammacchando, dhammacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariḷāho, dhammapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariyesanā.
commentary: (SNa) no dhammapariyesanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariḷāho'ti evaṃ āgataṃ paṭisedhamattam'eva nānaṃ.

meaning_1: lotus ponds in the palace called Dhamma
meaning_2: lotus ponds in the palace called Dhamma

meaning_1: with Dhamma palace as the foremost (among them)
example_1: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītipāsādasahassāni ahesuṃ dhammapāsādappamukhāni.

meaning_1: who drinks the Dhamma; who delights in the Dhamma
example_1: dhammapīti sukhaṃ seti, vippasannena cetasā, ariyappavedite dhamme, sadā ramati paṇḍito.

meaning_1: flavour of delight in the Dhamma; juice of joy in the teaching
example_1: pavivekarasaṃ pitvā, rasaṃ upasamassa ca, niddaro hoti nippāpo, dhammapītirasaṃ pivaṃ.

meaning_1: giving precedence to the teaching; explaining the nature of things; aiming at the Dhamma
example_1: anāpatti atthapurekkhārassa, dhammapurekkhārassa, anusāsanipurekkhārassa, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
commentary: (VINa) dhammapurekkhārassā'ti pāḷiṃ vācentassa vā sajjhāyantassa vā. evaṃ atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca purakkhatvā bhaṇantassa atthapurekkhārassa ca dhammapurekkhārassa ca anāpatti.

example_1: imā kho bhikkhave, dve pūjā. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ pūjānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammapūjā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) āmisena pūjanaṃ āmisapūjā, dhammena pūjanaṃ dhammapūjā.

meaning_1: illuminating the Dhamma; explaining the teaching
example_1: etādisī dhammappakāsan'ettha, na tattha kiṃkaṅkhati koci sāvako, nitiṇṇa-oghaṃ vicikicchachinnaṃ, buddhaṃ namassāma jinaṃ jan'indaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) etādisī dhammappakāsan'etthā'ti ettha sāsane evarūpā dhammappakāsanā, yāya sāvakā etehi guṇehi samannāgatā honti.

meaning_1: having the teaching as a refuge; with the Dhamma as one's support
example_1: evaṃ appaṭisaraṇe ca pana, bho ānanda, ko hetu sāmaggiyā'ti? na kho mayaṃ, brāhmaṇa, appaṭisaraṇā, sappaṭisaraṇā mayaṃ, brāhmaṇa, dhammappaṭisaraṇā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) dhammappaṭisaraṇā'ti dhammo amhākaṃ paṭisaraṇaṃ, dhammo avassayo'ti dīpeti.

meaning_1: connected with the Dhamma; regarding the teaching
example_1: ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma nāmaṃ, buddhappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, dhammappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, saṅghappaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, tesu tesu vā pana janapadesu anoññātaṃ anavaññātaṃ ahīḷitaṃ aparibhūtaṃ cittīkataṃ, etaṃ ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma nāmaṃ.

meaning_1: experiencing mental phenomena; conscious of thought
meaning_2: experiencing mental phenomena; conscious of thought
example_1: puna caparaṃ, upavāṇa, bhikkhu manasā dhammaṃ viññāya dhammappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammarāgappaṭisaṃvedī ca.

meaning_1: who measures by teaching; appraising by Dhamma; who judges on the basis of instruction
example_1: rūpappamāṇo rūpappasanno, ghosappamāṇo ghosappasanno, lūkhappamāṇo lūkhappasanno, dhammappamāṇo dhammappasanno. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.
commentary: (ANa) dhamme pamāṇaṃ gahetvā pasanno dhammappamāṇo nāma… satasahassaṃ koṭṭhāse katvā pana eko koṭṭhāso'va dhammappamāṇo, sesā na dhammappamāṇā'ti veditabbā.

meaning_1: delighted by the Dhamma; pleased by the teaching; (comm) cause for happiness
example_1: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, setughāto gīte, setughāto nacce, alaṃ vo dhammappamoditānaṃ sataṃ sitaṃ sitamattāyā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) dhammappamoditānaṃ satan'ti ettha dhammo vuccati kāraṇaṃ, kenaci'd'eva kāraṇena pamuditānaṃ santānaṃ.

meaning_1: who has confidence in teaching; whose faith is based on Dhamma; pleased by instruction
example_1: rūpappamāṇo rūpappasanno, ghosappamāṇo ghosappasanno, lūkhappamāṇo lūkhappasanno, dhammappamāṇo dhammappasanno. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.
commentary: (ANa) dhamme pamāṇaṃ gahetvā pasanno dhammappamāṇo nāma.

meaning_1: treasurer of the Dhamma; epithet of Ānanda
commentary: (DNt) tathā dhammabhaṇḍ'āgāro, tattha niyutto'ti dhammabhaṇḍ'āgāriko. atha vā nānārājabhaṇḍarakkhako bhaṇḍ'āgāriko viyā'ti bhaṇḍ'āgāriko, dhammassa anurakkhako bhaṇḍ'āgārikoti tam'eva sadisatākāraṇadassanena visesetvā dhammabhaṇḍ'āgāriko'ti vutto. (APt) dhammo pariyatti, so'va bhaṇḍaṃ dhanaṃ sukhadāyakato, tassa agāraṃ ṭhapan'aṭṭhānaṃ gehaṃ, tabbhāve tiṭṭhatī'ti dhammabhaṇḍ'āgāriko, iko.

example_1: so h'āvuso, bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati, cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto, vattā pavattā, atthassa ninnetā, amatassa dātā, dhammassāmī tathāgato
