commentary: (MNa) aviparītasabhāv'aṭṭhena pariyattidhammappavattanato vā hadayena cintetvā vācāya nicchāritadhammamayo'ti dhammabhūto.

meaning_1: value of the teaching; richness of the Dhamma; wealth of the teaching
example_1: taṃ mayaṃ āyasmato sāriputtassa dhamm'ojaṃ dhammabhogaṃ dhamm'ānuggahaṃ anussarāmā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) dhamm'ojaṃ dhammabhogan'ti ubhayen'api dhammaparibhogo'va kathito. (ANa) catunnaṃ paccayānaṃ bhuñjanaṃ āmisabhogo, dhammassa bhuñjanaṃ dhammabhogo.

meaning_1: explained the teaching (to); clarified the Dhamma (for)
meaning_2: explained the teaching; clarified the Dhamma
example_1: iti buddho abhiññāya, dhammam'akkhāsi bhikkhunaṃ, dukkhass'antakaro satthā, cakkhumā parinibbuto'ti.

meaning_1: stinginess about the Dhamma; selfishness with the teaching
example_1: pañca macchariyāni, āvāsamacchariyaṃ, kulamacchariyaṃ, lābhamacchariyaṃ, vaṇṇamacchariyaṃ, dhammamacchariyaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) dhammamacchariyaṃ. tena samannāgato bhikkhu imaṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā eso maṃ abhibhavissatī'ti aññassa na deti. yo pana dhamm'ānuggahena vā puggal'ānuggahena vā na deti, na taṃ macchariyaṃ.

meaning_1: stingy with (sharing) the teaching; selfish about (teaching) Dhamma
example_1: katamehi pañcahi? āvāsamaccharinī hoti, kulamaccharinī hoti, lābhamaccharinī hoti, vaṇṇamaccharinī hoti, dhammamaccharinī hoti. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgatā bhikkhunī yath'ābhataṃ nikkhittā evaṃ niraye.
commentary: (ANa) dhammamaccharinī'ti pariyattidhammaṃ maccharāyati, aññesaṃ dātuṃ na icchati.

grammar: ger of dhammaṃ ājānāti, comp vb
meaning_1: understanding the Dhamma; comprehending the teaching
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu, sutānañ'ca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti, dhātānañ'ca dhammānaṃ atth'ūpaparikkhī hoti attham'aññāya dhammam'aññāya, dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno hoti.
example_2: kusalī bhāsasī tesaṃ, mārapāsappahāyinaṃ, kassa te dhammam'aññāya, acchiduṃ bhavabandhanan'ti.

meaning_1: taught the Dhamma; preached the Dhamma
example_1: buddho dhammam'adesesi, jātiyā samatikkamaṃ, sabbadukkhappahānāya, so maṃ sacce nivesayi.
commentary: (NIDD2) dhammam'adesesī'ti dhamman'ti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ… nibbānañ'ca nibbānagāminiñ'ca paṭipadaṃ ācikkhi desesi paññapesi paṭṭhapesi vivari vibhaji uttānīakāsi pakāsesī'ti, yo te dhammam'adesesi.

meaning_1: teaches the Dhamma; explains the teaching
example_1: so ca sabbadado hoti, yo dadāti upassayaṃ, amataṃ dado ca so hoti, yo dhammam'anusāsatī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) yo dhammam'anusāsatī'ti yo dhammaṃ anusāsati, aṭṭhakathaṃ katheti, pāḷiṃ vāceti, pucchitapañhaṃ vissajjeti, kammaṭṭhānaṃ ācikkhati, dhammassavanaṃ karoti, sabbo'p'esa dhammaṃ anusāsati nāma.

meaning_1: made of the Dhamma; (comm) made of wisdom
example_1: sele yathā pabbatamuddhaniṭṭhito, yathā'pi passe janataṃ samantato, tath'ūpamaṃ dhammamayaṃ sumedho, pāsādam'āruyha samantacakkhu, sok'āvatiṇṇaṃ janatam'apetasoko, avekkhati jātijar'ābhibhūtan'ti.
commentary: (NIDD1a) dhammamayaṃ paññāmayaṃ

meaning_1: made of mental phenomena; consisting of thought
example_1: yo taṃ dhammamayaṃ vegaṃ sahati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atari manosamuddaṃ saūmiṃ sāvaṭṭaṃ sagāhaṃ sarakkhasaṃ, tiṇṇo pāraṅ'gato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo'ti.

meaning_1: concerning the teaching; about the Dhamma
example_1: satthāraṃ dhammam'ārabbha, saṅghaṃ sīlāni attano, adhigacchasi pāmojjaṃ, pītisukhamasaṃsayaṃ, tato pāmojjabahulo, dukkhass'antaṃ karissasī'ti.

meaning_1: supreme teaching; highest Dhamma; ultimate reality; ultimate nature of things
example_1: yo ca vassasataṃ jīve, apassaṃ dhammam'uttamaṃ, ek'āhaṃ jīvitaṃ seyyo, passato dhammam'uttamaṃ.
example_2: tañ'c'āhaṃ abhinandāmi, mahesi dhammam'uttamaṃ, yaṃ viditvā sato caraṃ, tare loke visattikaṃ.

meaning_1: only the Dhamma; just the teaching
example_1: anuyogo ca kho, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho, micchāpaṭipadā'ti, iti vadaṃ dhammam'eva deseti.
commentary: (MNa) dhammam'eva deseyyā'ti sabhāvam'eva katheyya.

example_1: yo dhammayāgaṃ ayajī amaccharī, tathāgato sabbabhūt'ānukampī, taṃ tādisaṃ devamanussaseṭṭhaṃ, sattā namassanti bhavassa pāragun'ti.
commentary: (ITIa) mahāsamayasutta-maṅgalasutta-cūḷarāhul'ovādasutta-samacittasutta-desan'ādayo dhammayāgā

example_1: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno atth'ūpasaṃhitaṃ dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā ahosi, bahujanaṃ nidaṃsesi, pāṇīnaṃ hitasukh'āvaho dhammayāgī.

meaning_1: vehicle of Dhamma; carriage of reality
example_1: sakkā, ānandā'ti bhagavā avoca, imass'eva kho etaṃ, ānanda, ariyassa aṭṭh'aṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanaṃ, brahmayānaṃ iti'pi, dhammayānaṃ iti'pi, anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo iti'pī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) ayañ'hi sabbadosavigamena seṭṭho, iminā ca ariyā nibbānaṃ yantī'ti brahmayānaṃ iti'pi, dhammabhūtattā yānattā ca dhammayānaṃ iti'pi, anuttarattā kilesasaṅgāmassa ca vijitattā anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo iti'pi vattuṃ vaṭṭati.

example_1: cirassaṃ vata me mahito mah'esī, mahāvanaṃ samaṇo paccapādi, so'haṃ cajissāmi sahassapāpaṃ, sutvāna gāthaṃ tava dhammayuttaṃ.
commentary: (THa) dhammayuttan'ti… dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ

meaning_1: devoted to (learning and preaching) the teaching
example_1: idh'āvuso, dhammayogā bhikkhū jhāyī bhikkhū apasādenti, ime pana jhāyino'mhā, jhāyino'mhā'ti jhāyanti pajjhāyanti nijjhāyanti avajjhāyanti
commentary: (ANa) dhamme yogo anuyogo etesan'ti dhammayogā. dhammakathikānaṃ etaṃ nāmaṃ.

example_1: yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi
commentary: (VIN) dhammarakkhitā nāma sahadhammikā rakkhanti gopenti issariyaṃ kārenti vasaṃ vattenti.

meaning_1: generic monk's name used in vinaya examples
lover of the teaching; devoted to the Dhamma
example_1: dhamm'ārāmo dhammarato, dhammaṃ anuvicintayaṃ, dhammaṃ anussaraṃ bhikkhu, saddhammā na parihāyati.

meaning_1: taking pleasure in mental phenomena; pleased by thinking
example_1: mano kho, māgaṇḍiya, dhamm'ārāmo dhammarato dhammasammudito. so tathāgatassa danto gutto rakkhito saṃvuto, tassa ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.

meaning_1: treasure of the teaching; jewel of the Dhamma
example_1: imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve ratanāni. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dvinnaṃ ratanānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammaratanan'ti.
commentary: (ANa) ratikaraṇ'aṭṭhena āmisaṃ āmisaratanaṃ, dhammo dhammaratanaṃ.

meaning_1: delight in the Dhamma; love for the Dhamma
example_1: sabbadānaṃ dhammadānaṃ jināti, sabbarasaṃ dhammaraso jināti, sabbaratiṃ dhammarati jināti, taṇhakkhayo sabbadukkhaṃ jināti.
commentary: (DHPa) yāpesā puttarati-dhīturati-dhanarati-itthirati-naccagītavādit'ādirati-pabhedā ca anekappabhedā ratī, sā'pi saṃsāravaṭṭe pātetvā dukkh'ānubhavanass'eva paccayo. yā pan'esā dhammaṃ kathentassa vā suṇantassa vā vācentassa vā anto uppajjamānā pīti udaggabhāvaṃ janeti, assūni pavatteti, lomahaṃsaṃ janeti, sāyaṃ saṃsāravaṭṭassa antaṃ katvā arahattapariyosānā hoti. tasmā sabbaratīnaṃ evarūpā dhammarati'y'eva seṭṭhā. tena vuttaṃ, sabbaratiṃ dhammarati jinātī'ti

meaning_1: taste of the Dhamma; flavour of the Dhamma
example_1: sabbadānaṃ dhammadānaṃ jināti, sabbarasaṃ dhammaraso jināti, sabbaratiṃ dhammarati jināti, taṇhakkhayo sabbadukkhaṃ jināti.

meaning_1: passion for the teaching; love for the Dhamma
example_1: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, ten'eva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
commentary: (MNa) dhammarāgena dhammanandiyā'ti padadvayehi samathavipassanāsu chandarāgo vutto.

meaning_1: greed for mental phenomena; desire for thoughts
example_1: puna caparaṃ, upavāṇa, bhikkhu manasā dhammaṃ viññāya dhammappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammarāgappaṭisaṃvedī ca.

meaning_1: experiencing greed for mental phenomena; experiencing desire for thoughts
meaning_2: experiencing greed for the mental phenomena; experiencing desire for the thoughts
example_1: puna caparaṃ, upavāṇa, bhikkhu manasā dhammaṃ viññāya dhammappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammarāgappaṭisaṃvedī ca.

meaning_1: just king; righteous ruler; benign dictator
example_1: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato. tass'imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti
example_2: khat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. upahat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā pitaraṃ dhammikaṃ dhammarājānaṃ jīvitā na voropessatha, imasmiññ'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ uppajjissathā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) dhammarājā'ti tass'eva vevacanaṃ. dhammena vā laddharajjattā dhammarājā.

meaning_1: king of the Dhamma; epithet of the Buddha
example_1: idañ'hi taṃ jetavanaṃ, isisaṅghanisevitaṃ, āvutthaṃ dhammarājena, pītisañjananaṃ mama.
example_2: rāj'āham'asmi selā'ti, dhammarājā anuttaro, dhammena cakkaṃ vattemi, cakkaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) ahañ'hi dhammarājā anuttaro bhav'aggato avīcipariyantaṃ katvā tiriyaṃ appamāṇalokadhātuyo anusāsāmi. yāvatā hi apadadvipad'ādi-bhedā sattā, ahaṃ tesaṃ aggo. na hi me koci sīlena vā… vimuttiñāṇadassanena vā paṭibhāgo atthi, sv'āhaṃ evaṃ dhammarājā anuttaro anuttaren'eva catusatipaṭṭhān'ādi-bhedana dhammena cakkaṃ vattemi.

meaning_1: justly acquired; honestly gained; legally obtained; legitimately acquired
example_1: yo dhammaladdhassa dadāti dānaṃ, uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatassa jantu, atikkamma so vetaraṇiṃ yamassa, dibbāni ṭhānāni upeti macco'ti.
example_2: kodhanassa, bhikkhave, purisapuggalassa kodh'ābhibhūtassa kodhaparetassa, ye'pi'ssa te honti bhogā uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sed'āvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā, te'pi rājāno rājakosaṃ pavesenti kodh'ābhibhūtassa.
commentary: (SNa) dhammaladdhassā'ti dhammena samena laddhassa bhogassa dhammaladdhassa ca puggalassa.

example_1: dhammasamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammacchando, dhammacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariḷāho, dhammapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariyesanā, dhammapariyesanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammalābho.

meaning_1: thought about mental phenomena; conception of thoughts
example_1: dhammadhātuṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaññā, dhammasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaṅkappo, dhammasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammacchando, dhammacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariḷāho, dhammapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariyesanā.

meaning_1: Book 1 of the Abhidhamma; Enumeration of Phenomena
example_1: āyasmā ca nāgaseno kusalā dhammā, akusalā dhammā, abyākatā dhammā'ti tikadukapaṭimaṇḍitaṃ dhammasaṅgaṇīpakaraṇaṃ, khandhavibhaṅg'ādi aṭṭhārasa vibhaṅgapaṭimaṇḍitaṃ vibhaṅgappakaraṇaṃ
katame dve? āmisasaṅgaho ca dhammasaṅgaho ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve saṅgahā.
example_2: tato therā ime amhesu garucittīkāraṃ na karontī'ti navake bhikkhū dvīhi saṅgahehi na saṅgaṇhanti, n'eva dhammasaṅgahena saṅgaṇhanti, na āmisasaṅgahena, cīvarena vā pattena vā pattapariyāpannena vā vasanaṭṭhānena vā kilamante'pi nappaṭijagganti, pāḷiṃ vā aṭṭhakathaṃ vā dhammakathābandhaṃ vā guḷhaganthaṃ vā na sikkhāpenti.
commentary: (ANa) aṭṭhame catūhi paccayehi saṅgaho āmisasaṅgaho, dhammena saṅgaho dhammasaṅgaho

example_1: bhagavatā cha cīvarāni anuññātāni. dhammasaṅgāhakattherehi tesaṃ anulomāni dukūlaṃ, pattuṇṇaṃ, cīnapaṭṭaṃ, somārapaṭṭaṃ, iddhimayikaṃ, devadattiyan'ti aparāni cha anuññātāni. tattha pattuṇṇanti pattuṇṇadese pāṇakehi sañjātavatthaṃ.
commentary: (VAt) dhammasaṅgāhakattherā'ti mahākassap'ādayo.

meaning_2: communal recitation of the teaching; Buddhist council

meaning_1: thoughts about mental phenomena; intention regarding thoughts
example_1: katame ca, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, cetanākāyā, rūpasañcetanā, saddasañcetanā, gandhasañcetanā, rasasañcetanā, phoṭṭhabbasañcetanā, dhammasañcetanā.

meaning_1: recognition of mental activity; perception of mental phenomena
example_1: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave… se āyatane veditabbe yattha mano ca nirujjhati, dhammasaññā ca nirujjhati, se āyatane veditabbe'ti. idaṃ vatvā bhagavā uṭṭhāy'āsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
example_2: kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cha'y'imā, bhikkhave, saññā, rūpasaññā, saddasaññā, gandhasaññā, rasasaññā, phoṭṭhabbasaññā, dhammasaññā.

example_1: dve'me, bhikkhave, bālā. katame dve? yo ca adhamme dhammasaññī, yo ca dhamme adhammasaññī. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve bālā'ti.
katame dve? āmisasanthāro ca dhammasanthāro ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve santhārā.
commentary: (ANa) catūhi paccayehi attano ca parassa ca antarapaṭicchādanavasena santharaṇaṃ āmisasanthāro, dhammena santharaṇaṃ dhammasanthāro.

meaning_1: corruption of the teaching; pollution of the doctrine
example_1: te'pi bhavissanti abhāvitakāyā abhāvitasīlā abhāvitacittā abhāvitapaññā. iti kho, bhikkhave, dhammasandosā vinayasandoso, vinayasandosā dhammasandoso. idaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ eta'r'ahi asamuppannaṃ āyatiṃ samuppajjissati.
commentary: (ANa) dhammasandosā vinayasandoso'ti dhammasandosena vinayasandoso hoti. kathaṃ pana dhammasmiṃ dussante vinayo dussati nāma? samathavipassanādhammesu gabbhaṃ aggaṇhantesu pañcavidho vinayo na hoti, evaṃ dhamme dussante vinayo dussati. dussīlassa pana saṃvaravinayo nāma na hoti, tasmiṃ asati samathavipassanā gabbhaṃ na gaṇhāti. evaṃ vinayasandosen'api dhammasandoso veditabbo.

example_1: katame dve? āmisasannicayo ca dhammasannicayo ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve sannicayā.
commentary: (ANa) āmisassa cinanaṃ vaḍḍhanaṃ āmisasannicayo, dhammassa cinanaṃ vaḍḍhanaṃ dhammasannicayo.

example_1: sutt'antaṃ abhidhammañ'ca, vinayañ'cā'pi kevalaṃ, nav'aṅgaṃ buddhavacanaṃ, esā dhammasabhā tava.
example_2: sa puṇṇako kurūnaṃ kattuseṭṭhaṃ, oropiya dhammasabhāya majjhe, ājaññam'āruyha anomavaṇṇo, pakkāmi vehāyasam'antalikkhe.
commentary: (APAa) dhammasabhā dhamm'ādhikaraṇasālā'ti attho.

meaning_1: investigation of the character; examination of the qualities (of)
example_1: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tathāgate dhammasamannesanā hoti. evañ'ca pana tathāgato dhammatāsusamanniṭṭho hotī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) dhammasamannesanā'ti sabhāvasamannesanā.

example_1: mahāsamayo pavanasmiṃ, devakāyā samāgatā, āgat'amha imaṃ dhammasamayaṃ, dakkhitāye aparājitasaṅghan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) āgat'amha imaṃ dhammasamayan'ti evaṃ samāgate devakāye disvā mayam'pi imaṃ dhammasamūhaṃ āgatā.

meaning_1: undertaking a practice; taking up something
example_1: atthi, bhikkhave, dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhaṃ āyatiṃ dukkhavipākaṃ, atthi, bhikkhave, dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannadukkhañ'c'eva āyatiñ'ca dukkhavipākaṃ
commentary: (MNa) dhammasamādānānī'ti dhammo'ti gahitagahaṇāni.

meaning_1: meditative composure based on natural principles
example_1: sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. ayaṃ kho, gāmaṇi, dhammasamādhi. tatra ce tvaṃ cittasamādhiṃ paṭilabheyyāsi, evaṃ tvaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pajaheyyāsi.
commentary: (SNa) ettha dhammasamādhī'ti dasa-kusalakammapatha-dhammā, cittasamādhī'ti saha vipassanāya cattāro maggā. atha vā pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyatī'ti (a. ni. 5.26) evaṃ vuttā pāmojja-pīti-passaddhi-sukha-samādhi-saṅkhātā pañca dhammā dhammasamādhi nāma, cittasamādhi pana saha vipassanāya cattāro maggā'va. atha vā dasakusalakammapathā cattāro brahmavihārā cā'ti ayaṃ dhammasamādhi nāma, taṃ dhammasamādhiṃ pūrentassa uppannā citt'ek'aggatā cittasamādhi nāma.
notes: The commentary seems unusually uncertain about the specific meanings of dhammasamādhi and cittasamādhi.

meaning_1: arising of phenomena; origination of causes
example_1: suddhaṃ dhammasamuppādaṃ, suddhaṃ saṅkhārasantatiṃ, passantassa yathābhūtaṃ, na bhayaṃ hoti gāmaṇi.

meaning_1: contact with mental phenomena; impression of thoughts; phenomenological experience
example_1: dhammadhātuṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaññā, dhammasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaṅkappo, dhammasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasamphasso, dhammasamphassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasamphassajā vedanā

meaning_1: produced by contact with mental phenomena; caused by the impression of thoughts; born from phenomenal experience
example_1: dhammadhātuṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaññā, dhammasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaṅkappo, dhammasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasamphasso, dhammasamphassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasamphassajā vedanā, dhammasamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammacchando, dhammacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariḷāho, dhammapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariyesanā, dhammapariyesanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammalābho.

meaning_1: generated by mental phenomena; produced by thought
example_1: tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā, anekā dhammasambhavā, abhijjhā ca vihesā ca, cittam'ass'ūpahaññati, evaṃ ācinato dukkhaṃ, ārā nibbānam'uccati.

meaning_1: partaking of the teaching together; mutual enjoyment of Dhamma
example_1: sambhuñjeyya vā'ti sambhogo nāma dve sambhogā, āmisasambhogo ca dhammasambhogo ca.
commentary: (VIN 2.5.7.9) dhammasambhogo nāma uddisati vā uddisāpeti vā, padena uddisati vā uddisāpeti vā, pade pade āpatti pācittiyassa. akkharāya uddisati vā uddisāpeti vā, akkhar'akkharāya āpatti pācittiyassa.

meaning_1: considered to be moral; regarded as natural
example_1: adhammasammataṃ kho pana, vāseṭṭha, tena samayena hoti, tadeta'r'ahi dhammasammataṃ. ye kho pana, vāseṭṭha, tena samayena sattā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevanti, te māsam'pi dvemāsam'pi na labhanti gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā pavisituṃ.
commentary: (DNa) tadeta'r'ahi dhammasammatan'ti taṃ idāni dhammo'ti sammataṃ, dhammo'ti taṃ gahetvā vicaranti.

meaning_1: pleased with mental phenomena; enjoying thinking
example_1: kāyo kho, māgaṇḍiya, phoṭṭhabb'ārāmo phoṭṭhabbarato… mano kho, māgaṇḍiya, dhamm'ārāmo dhammarato dhammasammudito. so tathāgatassa danto gutto rakkhito saṃvuto, tassa ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.

meaning_1: taking refuge in the Dhamma; relying on the Dhamma; finding support in the teaching
meaning_2: placing one's faith in the Dhamma
example_1: tasmā't'ih'ānanda, attadīpā viharatha attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā, dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā
sādhu kho, devānam'inda, dhammasaraṇagamanaṃ hoti. dhammasaraṇagamanahetu kho, devānam'inda, evam'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.

meaning_1: because of taking refuge in the Dhamma
example_1: sādhu kho, devānam'inda, dhammasaraṇagamanaṃ hoti. dhammasaraṇagamanahetu kho, devānam'inda, evam'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjanti.

meaning_2: body of the Dhamma; essence of the teaching

family_set: names of arahants; names of monks
example_1: itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā dhammasavo thero gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.
commentary: (THa) so tena puññakammena devaloke nibbattitvā apar'āparaṃ sugatīsu'y'eva saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde magadharaṭṭhe brāhmaṇakule nibbattitvā dhammasavo'ti laddhanāmo viññutaṃ patto hetusampattiyā codiyamāno ghar'āvāse ādīnavaṃ pabbajjāya ānisaṃsañ'ca disvā dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ viharantaṃ bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā dhammaṃ sutvā paṭiladdhasaddho pabbajitvā vipassanāya kammaṃ karonto nacirass'eva arahattaṃ pāpuṇi. tena vuttaṃ apadāne
notes: Theragāthā verse 107 (TH1.107, TH107) is attributed to him.

example_1: dve'me, bhikkhave, saṃvibhāgā āmisasaṃvibhāgo ca dhammasaṃvibhāgo ca. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dvinnaṃ saṃvibhāgānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammasaṃvibhāgo.
commentary: (ANa) dhammassa saṃvibhajanaṃ dhammasaṃvibhāgo.

meaning_1: connected with Dhamma; related to the teaching; connected with reality
example_1: na h'etaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, atthasaṃhitaṃ na dhammasaṃhitaṃ n'ādibrahmacariyakaṃ, na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati

meaning_1: talking about the Dhamma; Dhamma discussion
example_1: kālena dhammassavanaṃ, kālena dhammasākacchā, kālena sammasanā, kālena vipassanā
example_2: khantī ca sovacassatā, samaṇānañ'ca dassanaṃ, kālena dhammasākacchā, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

meaning_1: master of the Dhamma; lord of the teaching; epithet of the Buddha
essence of the Dhamma; the core of the teaching
example_1: ye etadaññāya padaṃ asaṅkhataṃ, vimuttacittā bhavanettisaṅkhayā, te dhammasār'ādhigamā khaye ratā, pahaṃsu te sabbabhavāni tādino'ti.

meaning_1: realizing the essence of the Dhamma; reaching the core of the teaching
example_1: ye etadaññāya padaṃ asaṅkhataṃ, vimuttacittā bhavanettisaṅkhayā, te dhammasār'ādhigamā khaye ratā, pahaṃsu te sabbabhavāni tādino'ti.
commentary: (ITIa) dhammasār'ādhigamā'ti vimuttisārattā imassa dhammavinayassa, dhammesu sārabhūtassa arahattassa adhigamanato.

meaning_1: following the Dhamma; conforming to the teaching; (or) remembering the Dhamma
example_1: saccaṃ dhammo saṃyamo brahmacariyaṃ, majjhe sitā brāhmaṇa brahmapatti, sa t'ujjubhūtesu namo karohi, tam'ahaṃ naraṃ dhammasārī'ti brūmī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) tam'ahaṃ naraṃ dhammasārī'ti brūmī'ti yo evaṃ paṭipajjati, tam'ahaṃ puggalaṃ dhammasārī eso dhammasāriyā paṭicchanno'ti ca kusaladhammehi akusaladhamme sāretvā ṭhito'ti vā'ti vadāmī'ti.

meaning_1: excellence of the teaching; superb nature of the Dhamma
example_1: tato cittaṃ vimucci me, passa dhammasudhammataṃ, tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan'ti.

meaning_2: generalissimo of the Law, epithet of Sāriputta

meaning_1: Dhamma general; epithet of the Buddha
meaning_2: generalissimo of the Dhamma, epithet of the Buddha
example_1: evaṃ dhammasenāpatinā ca pasatthabhāv'ānurūpaṃ attano dhāraṇabalaṃ dassento sattānaṃ sotu'kamyataṃ janeti evaṃ me sutaṃ, tañ'ca kho atthato vā byañjanato vā anūnaman'adhikaṃ, evam'eva na aññathā daṭṭhabban'ti.
ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno sīl'ānussatiṃ bhāveti.
commentary: (ANa) dhammasotaṃ samāpanno'ti vipassanāsaṅkhātaṃ dhammasotaṃ samāpanno.

meaning_1: hearing the teaching; hearing a sermon; listening to the Dhamma
example_1: pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā dhammassavane. katame pañca? assutaṃ suṇāti, sutaṃ pariyodāpeti, kaṅkhaṃ vitarati, diṭṭhiṃ ujuṃ karoti, cittam'assa pasīdati.
example_2: ekasmiñ'hi kāle satthari āḷavinagaraṃ upanissāya agg'āḷave cetiye viharante bahū upāsakā upāsikā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ca vihāraṃ dhammassavan'atthāya gacchanti, divā dhammassavanaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: hall where the Dhamma is preached; hall for listening to sermons
example_1: dhammassavan'agge pana nisīditvā niddāyanto c'eva nānappakārañ'ca niratthakakathaṃ kathento dhamme agāravo viharati nāma. saṅghamajjhe bāhāvikkhepakaṃ nānattakathaṃ kathento theranavamajjhimesu ca cittīkāraṃ akaronto saṅghe agāravo viharati nāma.
commentary: (PYt) dhammassavan'aggan'ti dhammassavanaṃ gaṇhanti etthā'ti dhammassavan'aggo, dhammasavanamaṇḍapo. atha vā dhammassavanaṃ gaṇhātī'ti dhammassavan'aggo, dhammassavanaṭṭhāne samāgamajano, taṃ dhammassavan'aggaṃ.

meaning_1: sake of hearing a sermon; purpose of hearing the teaching
example_1: tesu ariyasāvakānaṃ dve'y'eva kiccāni ahesuṃ. purebhattaṃ dānaṃ denti, pacchābhattaṃ gandhamāl'ādihatthā vatthabhesajjapānak'ādīni gāhāpetvā dhammassavan'atthāya gacchanti.
example_2: ekasmiñ'hi kāle satthari āḷavinagaraṃ upanissāya agg'āḷave cetiye viharante bahū upāsakā upāsikā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo ca vihāraṃ dhammassavan'atthāya gacchanti, divā dhammassavanaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: in accordance with the teaching; following the teaching; in line with the teaching
example_1: paṇḍito, bhikkhave, pukkusāti kulaputto paccapādi dhammass'ānudhammaṃ, na ca maṃ dhamm'ādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi.
example_2: tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo'ti? paṇḍito, bhikkhave, bāhiyo dārucīriyo paccapādi dhammass'ānudhammaṃ, na ca maṃ dhamm'ādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi. parinibbuto, bhikkhave, bāhiyo dārucīriyo'ti.

meaning_1: lord of the Dhamma; master of reality
example_1: so h'āvuso, bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati, cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto, vattā pavattā, atthassa ninnetā, amatassa dātā, dhammassāmī tathāgato
vanappagumbe yatha phussit'agge, gimhānamāse paṭhamasmiṃ gimhe, tath'ūpamaṃ dhammavaraṃ adesayi, nibbānagāmiṃ paramaṃ hitāya, idam'pi buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
example_2: varo varaññū varado var'āharo, anuttaro dhammavaraṃ adesayi, idam'pi buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

meaning_2: definition of ideas or states (opp. of vicikicchā)

meaning_1: who speaks about Dhamma; who speaks according to the teaching
example_1: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, lokena vivadāmi, loko'va mayā vivadati. na, bhikkhave, dhammavādī kenaci lokasmiṃ vivadati.
example_2: kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ
commentary: (MNa) navalok'uttaradhamma-sannissitaṃ katvā vadatī'ti dhammavādī

meaning_1: who talks the truth; who speaks according to reality
example_1: evaṃ vutte, assalāyano māṇavo te brāhmaṇe etadavoca, samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo dhammavādī, dhammavādino ca pana duppaṭimantiyā bhavanti. n'āhaṃ sakkomi samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane paṭimantetun'ti.
commentary: (MNa) dhammavādī'ti sabhāvavādī.

meaning_lit: discourse on the question about speaking of Dhamma

meaning_1: investigation of reality; examining states; analysing the teaching
example_1: santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgaṃ, atthi me ajjhattaṃ dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgo'ti pajānāti
example_2: yasmiñ'ca kho, bhikkhave, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, kālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo vīriyasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo pītisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya.

meaning_1: investigation of reality as an element of awakening; analysing the teaching as a factor of enlightenment
example_1: yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tathā sato viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinati pavicarati parivīmaṃsam'āpajjati, dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti.
example_2: yasmiñ'ca kho, bhikkhave, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, kālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo vīriyasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo pītisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya.
commentary: (DNa) dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa pana atthi, bhikkhave, kusal'ākusalā dhammā… kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgā dhammā, tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'āhāro anuppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattatī'ti evaṃ uppādo hoti. (SNa) satta dhammā dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya saṃvattanti, paripucchakatā vatthuvisadakiriyā indriyasamattapaṭipādanā duppaññapuggalaparivajjanā paññavantapuggalasevanā gambhīrañāṇacariyapaccavekkhaṇā tadadhimuttatā'ti.

meaning_1: pondering about mental phenomena; contemplating things
example_1: rūpavicāro loke… saddavicāro loke… gandhavicāro loke… rasavicāro loke… phoṭṭhabbavicāro loke… dhammavicāro loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etth'esā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ.

meaning_1: thoughts about the Dhamma; thinking about the teaching
example_1: tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate ath'āparaṃ dhammavitakka-avasissati. so hoti samādhi na c'eva santo na ca paṇīto nappaṭippassaddhaladdho na ekodibhāv'ādhigato sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato hoti.
example_2: so tehi dhammavitakkehi divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) dhammavitakk'āvasissantī'ti dhammavitakkā nāma dasa-vipassan'upakkilesa-vitakkā.

meaning_1: thoughts about the Dhamma are left; contemplation of the teaching remains; (comm) imperfections of insight remain
example_1: tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate ath'āparaṃ dhammavitakk'āvasissati.
commentary: (ANa) dhammavitakk'āvasissantī'ti dhammavitakkā nāma dasa-vipassan'upakkilesa-vitakkā.

meaning_1: thoughts about the Dhamma are left; contemplation of the teaching remains; (comm) imperfections of insight remain
example_1: tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate santi adhicittam'anuyuttassa bhikkhuno sukhumasahagatā upakkilesā ñātivitakko janapadavitakko anavaññattipaṭisaṃyutto vitakko, tam'enaṃ sacetaso bhikkhu dabbajātiko pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti. tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate ath'āparaṃ dhammavitakko'vasissati.
commentary: (ANa) dhammavitakk'āvasissantī'ti dhammavitakkā nāma dasa-vipassan'upakkilesa-vitakkā.

meaning_1: teaching and training; doctrine and discipline
example_1: evam'evaṃ kho pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā na āyataken'eva aññāpaṭivedho
example_2: evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ manussattaṃ labhati. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. evaṃ adhiccam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo loke dibbati.
commentary: (SNa) imaṃ dhammavinayan'ti imaṃ dhammañ'ca vinayañ'ca. ubhayam'p'etaṃ sāsanass'eva nāmaṃ.

meaning_1: discrimination of mental phenomena; evaluation of mental processes; investigation of reality
example_1: asso yathā bhadro kasāniviṭṭho, ātāpino saṃvegino bhavātha, saddhāya sīlena ca vīriyena ca, samādhinā dhammavinicchayena ca, sampannavijjācaraṇā patissatā, jahissatha dukkham'idaṃ anappakaṃ.

meaning_1: trained in the teaching; educated in the Dhamma
example_1: ye c'ime opapātikā dhammavinītā sātirekāni catuvīsatisatasahassāni māgadhakā paricārakā abbhatītā kālaṅ'katā tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sot'āpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā.
commentary: (DNa) dhammavinītā'ti sammāniyyānena niyyātā. (DNt) dhammavinītā'ti ariyadhamme vinītā.

meaning_1: change, fading and ending of mental phenomena; alteration, disappearance and cessation of thoughts
example_1: dhammavipariṇāmavirāganirodhā dukkhā, bhikkhave, devamanussā viharanti. tathāgato ca kho, bhikkhave, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho rūpānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavaṃ ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā na rūp'ārāmo na rūparato na rūpasammudito.
idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo lābhī c'eva hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī ca adhipaññādhammavipassanāya.

meaning_1: who practices the teaching; who lives according to the Dhamma
example_1: so tāya dhammapariyattiyā na divasaṃ atināmeti, n'āpi riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, bhikkhu dhammavihārī hoti.
example_2: iti kho, bhikkhu, desito mayā pariyattibahulo, desito paññattibahulo, desito sajjhāyabahulo, desito vitakkabahulo, desito dhammavihārī.

example_1: katamā dve? āmisavuddhi ca dhammavuddhi ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve vuddhiyo.
commentary: (ANa) āmisena vaḍḍhanaṃ āmisavuddhi, dhammena vaḍḍhanaṃ dhammavuddhi.

meaning_1: inspiration from the teaching; enthusiasm from the Dhamma
example_1: yathodhi kho pan'assa cattaṃ hoti vantaṃ muttaṃ pahīnaṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, so buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatomhī'ti labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
example_2: ujugatacitto kho pana, mahānāma, ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) dhammavedan'ti aveccappasādassa hetuṃ odhiso kilesappahānaṃ paccavekkhato uppannaṃ vuttappakārameva vedanti evam'pi ettha attho veditabbo. (ANa) dhammavedan'ti pāḷiṃ nissāya uppannaṃ pītipāmojjaṃ.

example_1: katamāni dve? āmisavepullañ'ca dhammavepullañ'ca. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve vepullāni.
commentary: (ANa) āmisassa vipulabhāvo āmisavepullaṃ, dhammassa vipulabhāvo dhammavepullan'ti.

(VINa) buddhavevacanāni vā'ti buddhassa vā pariyāyanāmāni… asakyaputtiyassa vā. tattha vaṇṇapaṭṭhāne āgataṃ nāmasahassaṃ upāligāthāsu (ma ni 2.76) nāmasataṃ aññāni ca guṇato labbhamānāni nāmāni buddhavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. sabbāni'pi dhammassa nāmāni dhammavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. esa nayo sabbattha.

meaning_2: understands the Dhamma; comprehends the teaching

meaning_1: practices the teaching; lives the Dhamma
example_1: uttiṭṭhe nappamajjeyya, dhammaṃ sucaritaṃ care, dhammacārī sukhaṃ seti, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.
example_2: dhammaṃ care yo'pi samuñjakaṃ care, dārañ'ca posaṃ dadam'appakasmiṃ, sataṃ sahassānaṃ sahassayāginaṃ, kalam'pi n'āgghanti tathāvidhassa te'ti.
commentary: (SNa) dhammaṃ care'ti dasakusalakammapathadhammaṃ carati.

example_1: so ārāmagato parisati dhammaṃ deseti, na taṃ parisaṃ ussādeti, na taṃ parisaṃ apasādeti, añña'd'atthu dhammiyā kathāya taṃ parisaṃ sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
example_2: accāraddhamhi vīriyamhi, satthā loke anuttaro, vīṇ'opamaṃ karitvā me, dhammaṃ desesi cakkhumā, tass'āhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, vihāsiṃ sāsane rato.

meaning_1: preaches the Dhamma; gives a Dhamma talk
example_1: so saṅkhāya kulāni upasaṅkamati saṅkhāya nisīdati saṅkhāya dhammaṃ bhāsati saṅkhāya uccārapassāvaṃ sandhāreti
example_2: saṅghagato kho pana anānākathiko hoti atiracchānakathiko. sāmaṃ vā dhammaṃ bhāsati, paraṃ vā ajjhesati, ariyaṃ vā tuṇhībhāvaṃ n'ātimaññati.

meaning_1: gift of the teaching to a guest
example_1: katamāni dve? āmis'ātitheyyañ'ca dhamm'ātitheyyañ'ca. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve ātitheyyāni.
commentary: (ANa) ātitheyyānī'ti āgantukadānāni. atitheyyānī'ti'pi pāṭho.

example_1: vihesā p'esā, ānanda, assa tathāgatassa. tasmā't'ih'ānanda, dhamm'ādāsaṃ nāma dhammapariyāyaṃ desessāmi, yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanā'va attānaṃ byākareyya, khīṇanirayo'mhi
example_2: bhāvito me maggo, ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko amatagāmī, nibbānaṃ sacchikataṃ, dhamm'ādāsaṃ avekkhiṃhaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) dhamm'ādāsan'ti dhammamayaṃ ādāsaṃ. (THIa) dhamm'ādāsaṃ avekkhiṃ'han'ti dhammamayaṃ ādāsaṃ addakkhiṃ apassiṃ ahaṃ.

meaning_1: Dhamma discourse on the mirror of the Dhamma
legitimately and illegitimately; lawfully and unlawfully; legally and illegally
example_1: idha pana, gāmaṇi, ekacco kāmabhogī dhamm'ādhammena bhoge pariyesati, sāhasena'pi asāhasena'pi. dhamm'ādhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena'pi asāhasena'pi attānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti saṃvibhajati puññāni karoti.
commentary: (SNa) dhamm'ādhammenā'ti dhammena ca adhammena ca. (ANa) dhamm'ādhammenā'ti dasa-kusalakammapatha-dhammena'pi dasa-akusalakammapatha-adhammena'pi.

meaning_1: controversy about the teaching; technical points about the teaching
example_1: tassa kā gati, ko abhisamparāyo'ti? paṇḍito, bhikkhave, bāhiyo dārucīriyo paccapādi dhammass'ānudhammaṃ, na ca maṃ dhamm'ādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi. parinibbuto, bhikkhave, bāhiyo dārucīriyo'ti.
example_2: paṇḍito, bhikkhave, pukkusāti kulaputto paccapādi dhammass'ānudhammaṃ, na ca maṃ dhamm'ādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi.
commentary: (MNa) na ca maṃ dhamm'ādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesī'ti mañ'ca dhammakāraṇā na kilamesi, na punappunaṃ kathāpesī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: taking the Dhamma as an authority; putting the teaching in charge
example_1: passanti devā ca tathāgatā ca, lokasmiṃ bālaṃ visamaṃ carantaṃ, tasmā hi att'ādhipateyyako ca, lok'ādhipo ca nipako ca jhāyī, dhamm'ādhipo ca anudhammacārī, na hīyati saccaparakkamo muni.
commentary: (ANa) dhamm'ādhipo'ti dhammajeṭṭhako.

meaning_2: respecting of Dhamma as one's guide

meaning_1: fact of taking Dhamma as an authority; putting the teaching in charge
example_1: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, ādhipateyyāni. katamāni tīṇi? att'ādhipateyyaṃ, lok'ādhipateyyaṃ, dhamm'ādhipateyyaṃ.
example_2: so dhammaṃ'y'eva adhipatiṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, dhamm'ādhipateyyaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) navavidhaṃ lok'uttaradhammaṃ jeṭṭhakaṃ katvā nibbattitaṃ dhamm'ādhipateyyaṃ.

example_1: tena hi tvaṃ, tāta, dhammaṃ'y'eva nissāya dhammaṃ sakkaronto dhammaṃ garuṃ karonto dhammaṃ mānento dhammaṃ pūjento dhammaṃ apacāyamāno dhammaddhajo dhammaketu dhamm'ādhipateyyo dhammikaṃ rakkh'āvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahassu antojanasmiṃ balakāyasmiṃ khattiyesu anuyantesu brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamajānapadesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu migapakkhīsu.
commentary: (DNa) dhamm'ādhipateyyo'ti dhamm'ādhipatibhūto āgatabhāvena dhammavasen'eva sabbakiriyānaṃ karaṇena dhamm'ādhipateyyo hutvā.

example_1: ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, bhikkhu rūp'ādhibhū, sadd'ādhibhū, gandh'ādhibhū, ras'ādhibhū, phoṭṭhabb'ādhibhū, dhamm'ādhibhū, adhibhū, anadhibhūto, adhibhosi te pāpake akusale dhamme saṃkilesike ponobbhavike sadare dukkhavipāke āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiye. evaṃ kho, āvuso, anavassuto hotī'ti.

meaning_1: overpowered by mental phenomena; overwhelmed by thoughts
example_1: ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, bhikkhu rūp'ādhibhūto, sadd'ādhibhūto, gandh'ādhibhūto, ras'ādhibhūto, phoṭṭhabb'ādhibhūto, dhamm'ādhibhūto, adhibhūto, anadhibhū, adhibhaṃsu naṃ pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṃkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā. evaṃ kho, āvuso, avassuto hoti.

meaning_1: disrespect towards the Dhamma; contempt for the teaching
example_1: anādariyaṃ nāma dve anādariyāni, puggal'ānādariyañ'ca dhamm'ānādariyañ'ca.
commentary: (VIN 2.5.6.4) dhamm'ānādariyaṃ nāma upasampannena paññattena vuccamāno kath'āyaṃ nasseyya vā vinasseyya vā antaradhāyeyya vā, taṃ vā na sikkhitu'kāmo anādariyaṃ karoti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

example_1: dhamme, bhikkhave, yoniso manasi karotha, dhamm'āniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha. dhamme, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto, dhamm'āniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto dhammesu'pi nibbindati. nandikkhayā rāgakkhayo, rāgakkhayā nandikkhayo.

meaning_1: concern about teaching; compassion with regard to the teaching
example_1: katamā dve? āmis'ānukampā ca dhamm'ānukampā ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve anukampā.
commentary: (ANa) catūhi paccayehi anukampanaṃ āmis'ānukampā, dhammena anukampanaṃ dhamm'ānukampā'ti.

meaning_1: assistance with the Dhamma; support with the teaching
example_1: taṃ mayaṃ āyasmato sāriputtassa dhamm'ojaṃ dhammabhogaṃ dhamm'ānuggahaṃ anussarāmā'ti.
example_2: dve'me, bhikkhave, anuggahā āmis'ānuggaho ca dhamm'ānuggaho ca. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dvinnaṃ anuggahānaṃ yadidaṃ dhamm'ānuggaho.
commentary: (SNa) dhamm'ānuggahan'ti dhammena anuggahaṇaṃ.

meaning_1: in accordance with the teaching; following the teaching
example_1: yo kho, ānanda, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā upāsako vā upāsikā vā dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno viharati sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī so tathāgataṃ sakkaroti garuṃ karoti māneti pūjeti apaciyati paramāya pūjāya
example_2: yato kho tvaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, sappurise bhajissasi tato tvaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, saddhammaṃ sossasi. yato kho tvaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, saddhammaṃ sossasi tato tvaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, dhamm'ānudhammaṃ paṭipajjissasi.
commentary: (MNa) dhamm'ānudhamman'ti dhammassa anudhammaṃ anucchavikaṃ paṭipadaṃ.

meaning_1: practice of the teaching according to the teaching; accordant following of the Dhamma
example_1: so aparena samayena ariyadhammaṃ suṇāti, yoniso manasi karoti, dhamm'ānudhammaṃ paṭipajjati. so ariyadhammassavanaṃ āgamma yonisomanasikāraṃ dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipattiṃ asaṃsaṭṭho viharati kāmehi asaṃsaṭṭho akusalehi dhammehi.

meaning_1: practising correctly; following the teaching properly; practising the Dhamma properly
meaning_lit: practising the Dhamma according to the Dhamma
example_1: catuppadāya ce'pi, bhikkhu, gāthāya attham'aññāya dhammam'aññāya dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno hoti bahussuto dhammadharo'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.
example_2: na tāv'āhaṃ, pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti viyattā vinītā visāradā bahussutā dhammadharā dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipannā
commentary: (ANa) dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipannā'ti ariyadhammassa anudhammabhūtaṃ vipassanādhammaṃ paṭipannā. (ANa) dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno'ti navalok'uttaradhammassa anudhammaṃ saha sīlena pubbabhāgapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno.

meaning_1: practising the teaching according to the teaching; following the Dhamma accordingly
example_1: evaṃ dhamm'ānudhammappaṭippannaṃ iminā'p'aṅgena samannāgataṃ satthāraṃ n'eva atīt'aṃse samanupassāma, na pan'eta'r'ahi, aññatra tena bhagavatā.
dhamm'ānupassanā nīvaraṇapabbaṃ

meaning_1: observing phenomena; who watches mental phenomena; (or) observing the nature of things
example_1: kathañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhammesu dhamm'ānupassī viharati pañcasu nīvaraṇesu
example_2: yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu anicc'ānupassī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati… dhammesu dhamm'ānupassī, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.

example_1: tāyaṃ velāyan'ti tassaṃ vippakārakaraṇavelāyaṃ. imaṃ udānan'ti taṃ vippakāraṃ agaṇetvā assa agaṇanahetubhūtaṃ dhamm'ānubhāvadīpakaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi.

meaning_1: who has attained the path of stream entry through understanding the teaching
example_1: yassa kho, bhikkhave, ime dhammā evaṃ paññāya mattaso nijjhānaṃ khamanti, ayaṃ vuccati dhamm'ānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ
example_2: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ye te bhikkhū dhamm'ānusārino saddh'ānusārino, te'pi tiriyaṃ mārassa sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gamissanti.
commentary: (MNa) dhamm'ānusārino saddh'ānusārino'ti ime dve sot'āpattimaggaṭṭhā honti. yath'āha, katamo ca puggalo dhamm'ānusārī? yassa puggalassa sot'āpattiphala-sacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa paññ'indriyaṃ adhimattaṃ hoti, paññāvāhiṃ paññāpubbaṅ'gamaṃ ariyamaggaṃ bhāveti. ayaṃ vuccati puggalo dhamm'ānusārī.

meaning_1: who has attained the path of stream entry through understanding the teaching
meaning_2: acting in conformity with the Dhamma
example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, bhaddāli, api nu tvaṃ, bhaddāli, tasmiṃ samaye ubhatobhāgavimutto vā hosi paññāvimutto vā kāyasakkhi vā diṭṭhippatto vā saddhāvimutto vā dhamm'ānusārī vā saddh'ānusārī vā'ti?
commentary: (MNa) dhammaṃ anussaratī'ti dhamm'ānusārī. dhammo'ti paññā, paññāpubbaṅ'gamaṃ maggaṃ bhāvetī'ti attho.

meaning_1: recollection of (the qualities of) the teaching
example_1: ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno dhamm'ānussatiṃ bhāveti

meaning_1: following the Dhamma; acting according to the teaching
meaning_2: acting in conformity with the Dhamma
example_1: ye ca kho samma'd'akkhāte, dhamme dhamm'ānuvattino, te janā pāram'essanti, maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ.

meaning_1: complete comprehension of the Dhamma; total understanding of reality
example_1: n'eva satimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti purimaṃ dukkhakkhandhaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādiṇṇaṃ upanidhāya yadidaṃ sattakkhattuṃparamatā. evaṃ mahatthiyo kho, bhikkhave, dhamm'ābhisamayo, evaṃ mahatthiyo dhammacakkhupaṭilābho'ti.
example_2: dasavīsasahassānaṃ, dhamm'ābhisamayo ahu, ekadvinnaṃ abhisamayā, gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyā.
commentary: (BVa) dhamm'ābhisamayo'ti catusaccadhammappaṭivedho.

meaning_1: field of mental phenomena; realm of qualia
example_1: cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbānī'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? rūp'āyatanaṃ sadd'āyatanaṃ gandh'āyatanaṃ ras'āyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabb'āyatanaṃ dhamm'āyatanaṃ

meaning_1: based on mental phenomena; related to thought processes
example_1: puna caparaṃ, ānanda, bhikkhu vedanāsu … citte … dhammesu dhamm'ānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. tassa dhammesu dhamm'ānupassino viharato dhamm'ārammaṇo vā uppajjati kāyasmiṃ pariḷāho, cetaso vā līnattaṃ, bahiddhā vā cittaṃ vikkhipati.

meaning_1: enjoying the Dhamma; taking pleasure in the Dhamma; fond of the teaching
example_1: dhamm'ārāmo dhammarato, dhammaṃ anuvicintayaṃ, dhammaṃ anussaraṃ bhikkhu, saddhammā na parihāyati.
commentary: (DHPa) tattha nivāsanaṭṭhena samathavipassanādhammo ārāmo assā'ti dhamm'ārāmo. tasmiṃ'y'eva dhamme rato'ti dhammarato.

meaning_1: enjoying mental phenomena; taking pleasure in thought
example_1: kāyo kho, māgaṇḍiya, phoṭṭhabb'ārāmo phoṭṭhabbarato… mano kho, māgaṇḍiya, dhamm'ārāmo dhammarato dhammasammudito. so tathāgatassa danto gutto rakkhito saṃvuto, tassa ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.

so pana dhamm'āsanato otaranto dhammakathiko viya, nisseṇito otaranto puriso viya, ca dve ca hatthe dve ca pāde pasāretvā ṭhitako'va mātukucchisambhavena kenaci asucinā amakkhito suddho visado kāsikavatthe nikkhittamaṇiratanaṃ viya jotayanto mātukucchito nikkhami.
yo pana bhikkhu dhammikānaṃ kammānaṃ chandaṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
example_2: katamañ'ca, gahapati, atthisukhaṃ? idha, gahapati, kulaputtassa bhogā honti uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sed'āvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā.
commentary: (VIN 2.5.8.9) dhammikānan'ti dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena katattā dhammā etesu atthī'ti dhammikāni, tesaṃ dhammikānaṃ catunnaṃ saṅghakammānaṃ.

example_1: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato. tass'imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti
example_2: na attahetu na parassa hetu, na puttam'icche na dhanaṃ na raṭṭhaṃ, na iccheyya adhammena samiddhim'attano, sa sīlavā paññavā dhammiko siyā.
commentary: (MNa) dhammo assa atthī'ti dhammiko. (MNa) dhammena caratī'ti dhammiko, ñāyena samena vattatī'ti attho.

example_1: atha kho bhagavā saccakaṃ nigaṇṭhaputtaṃ etadavoca, yā'pi kho te esā, aggivessana, purimā kāyabhāvanā bhāsitā sā'pi ariyassa vinaye no dhammikā kāyabhāvanā.
katamā dve? āmis'iddhi ca dhamm'iddhi ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve iddhiyo.
commentary: (ANa) āmisaṃ ijjhanaka-samijjhanaka-vasena āmis'iddhi, dhammo'pi ijjhanaka-samijjhanaka-vasena dhamm'iddhi.

meaning_1: righteous; religious; moral; related to the Dhamma
example_1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhū nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti
example_2: kathañ'hi no siyā, bhante! idān'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya amatena abhisitto'ti.

meaning_2: acting in accordance with dhamma, with the rule

meaning_1: with a Dhamma talk; with a religious discourse; with a spiritual sermon
example_1: so bhuttāvī anumodati, na taṃ bhattaṃ garahati, na aññaṃ bhattaṃ paṭikaṅkhati, añña'd'atthu dhammiyā kathāya taṃ parisaṃ sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
example_2: kathañ'hi no siyā, bhante! idān'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya amatena abhisitto'ti.
commentary: (MNa) dhammiyā kathāyā'ti bhagavā dhammiṃ kathaṃ kathento

meaning_1: Dhamma talk; religious discourse; spiritual sermon

commentary: (DNa) nāthakaraṇā'ti sanāthā, bhikkhave, viharatha mā anāthā, dasa ime, bhikkhave, dhammā nāthakaraṇā'ti (a. ni. 10.18) evaṃ akkhātā attano patiṭṭhākarā dhammā.

commentary: (ANa) nānādhātun'ti tāsaṃ'y'eva dhātūnaṃ vilakkhaṇatāya nānappakāradhātuṃ.

meaning_1: penetration of the various states; breakthrough of understanding into the many states
example_1: ekapuggalassa, bhikkhave, pātubhāvā… catunnaṃ paṭisambhidānaṃ sacchikiriyā hoti, anekadhātupaṭivedho hoti, nānādhātupaṭivedho hoti, vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyā hoti, sot'āpattiphala-sacchikiriyā hoti, sakadāgāmiphala-sacchikiriyā hoti, anāgāmiphala-sacchikiriyā hoti, arahattaphala-sacchikiriyā hoti.
commentary: (ANa) nānādhātupaṭivedho'ti ettha imā'va aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo nānāsabhāvato nānādhātuyo'ti veditabbā. yo pan'etāsaṃ nānāsabhāvā etā'ti evaṃ nānākaraṇato paṭivedho, ayaṃ nānādhātupaṭivedho nāma.

meaning_1: knowledge of the fact of having a various dispositions; understanding of the fact of having different inclinations
fact of having various dispositions; fact of having different inclinations; fact of having multiple propensities
example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato sattānaṃ nān'ādhimuttikataṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
commentary: (ANa) nān'ādhimuttikatan'ti hīn'ādīhi adhimuttīhi nān'ādhimuttikabhāvaṃ.

meaning_1: fact of having a various dispositions; fact of having different inclinations; fact of having a multiple propensities

example_1: tumhe khv'attha, vāseṭṭha, nānājaccā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānākulā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā. ke tumhe'ti, puṭṭhā samānā samaṇā sakyaputtiy'āmhā'ti, paṭijānātha.
example_2: evam'eva kho, sāriputta, tesaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ antaradhānena buddh'ānubuddhānaṃ sāvakānaṃ antaradhānena ye te pacchimā sāvakā nānānāmā nānāgottā nānājaccā nānākulā pabbajitā te taṃ brahmacariyaṃ khippaññ'eva antaradhāpesuṃ.
commentary: (VINa) nānānāmā'ti buddharakkhito, dhammarakkhito'ti-ādi nāmavasena vividhanāmā.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhante, nānāpupphānaṃ mahāpuppharāsi, tam'enaṃ dakkho mālākāro vā mālākār'antevāsī vā vicittaṃ mālaṃ gantheyya.
commentary: (APAa) nānāpupphaṃ samokirin'ti campak'ādīhi anekehi pupphehi samokiriṃ pūjesin'ti attho.

example_1: manāpadāyī labhate manāpaṃ, yo ujjubhūtesu dadāti chandasā, acchādanaṃ sayanam'annapānaṃ, nānāppakārāni ca paccayāni.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, dve balavanto purisā dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuyā santāpeyyuṃ samparitāpeyyuṃ, evam'eva kho, āvuso, adhimatto kāyasmiṃ ḍāho.
example_2: tam'enaṃ dve balavanto purisā nānābāhāsu gahetvā taṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ upakaḍḍheyyuṃ. atha kho tassa purisassa ārakā'v'assa cetanā ārakā patthanā ārakā paṇidhi.

meaning_1: different in name; distinct in terms of expressions; spelled differently
example_1: yā c'āyaṃ, āvuso, appamāṇā cetovimutti, yā ca ākiñcaññā cetovimutti, yā ca suññatā cetovimutti, yā ca animittā cetovimutti, ime dhammā nān'ātthā c'eva nānābyañjanā ca udāhu ek'atthā byañjanam'eva nānan'ti?
example_2: atthi kho, āvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā nān'ātthā c'eva nānābyañjanā ca, atthi ca kho, āvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā ek'atthā, byañjanam'eva nānaṃ.

example_1: alaṃ, ānanda, mā soci mā paridevi nanu etaṃ, ānanda, mayā paṭikacc'eva akkhātaṃ sabbeh'eva piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo aññathābhāvo
commentary: (DNa) piyehi manāpehī'ti mātāpitābhātābhaginiādikehi jātiyā nānābhāvo, maraṇena vinābhāvo, bhavena aññathābhāvo.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, dvinnaṃ kaṭṭhānaṃ saṅghaṭṭanasamodhānā usmā jāyati, tejo abhinibbattati, tesaṃ'y'eva kaṭṭhānaṃ nānābhāvanikkhepā tajjā usmā sā nirujjhati sā vūpasammati, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, sukhavedaniyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukh'indriyaṃ.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, dvinnaṃ kaṭṭhānaṃ saṅghaṭṭanasamodhānā usmā jāyati tejo abhinibbattati. tesaṃ'y'eva dvinnaṃ kaṭṭhānaṃ nānābhāvāvinikkhepā yā tajjā usmā sā nirujjhati sā vūpasammati. evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, sukhavedaniyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhavedanā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pūtimuttaṃ nānābhesajjehi saṃsaṭṭhaṃ. atha puriso āgaccheyya paṇḍukarogī.
commentary: (MNa) nānābhesajjehī'ti harītakāmalak'ādīhi nān'osadhehi.

example_1: kiñ'c'āpi, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā nānāmagge paññapenti, addhariyā brāhmaṇā tittiriyā brāhmaṇā chandokā brāhmaṇā bavhārijjhā brāhmaṇā, atha kho sabbāni tāni niyyānikā niyyanti takkarassa brahmasahabyatāya.
seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre bahūni ce'pi nānāmaggāni bhavanti, atha kho sabbāni tāni gāmasamosaraṇāni bhavanti
commentary: (DNa) nānāmaggānī'ti mahant'āmahanta-jaṅghamagga-sakaṭamagg'ādi-vasena nānāvidhāni sāmantā gāma-nadī-taḷāka-khett'ādīhi āgantvā gāmaṃ pavisanamaggāni.

example_1: seyyathā'pi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā nānārattānaṃ dussānaṃ dussakaraṇḍako pūro
example_2: seyyathā'pi, āvuso moggallāna, rañño vā rājamah'āmattassa vā nānārattānaṃ dussānaṃ dussakaraṇḍako pūro assa.
commentary: (ANa) nānārattānan'ti nilapītalohitodātavaṇṇehi nānārajanehi rattānaṃ.

meaning_1: various trees; different kinds of trees
example_1: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, pokkharaṇī acch'odakā sāt'odakā sīt'odakā setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā nānārukkhehi sañchannā.

meaning_1: with different preferences; with various inclinations
meaning_2: having various wishes; having different aims
example_1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā nānātitthiya-samaṇabrāhmaṇa-paribbājakā sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasanti nānādiṭṭhikā nānākhantikā nānārucikā nānādiṭṭhinissayanissitā.
commentary: (UDa) nānā ruciyo etesan'ti nānārucikā

example_1: na naggacariyā na jaṭā na paṅkā, n'ānāsakā thaṇḍilasāyikā vā, rajojallaṃ ukkuṭikappadhānaṃ, sodhenti maccaṃ avitiṇṇakaṅkhaṃ.

idha pana, bhikkhave, āgantukā bhikkhū passanti āvāsike bhikkhū nānāsaṃvāsake. te samānasaṃvāsakadiṭṭhiṃ paṭilabhanti, samānasaṃvāsakadiṭṭhiṃ paṭilabhitvā na pucchanti, apucchitvā ekato uposathaṃ karonti.
commentary: (VINa) yena saddhiṃ uposath'ādiko saṃvāso atthi, ayaṃ samānasaṃvāsako, itaro nānāsaṃvāsako.

meaning_1: of different colours; of various colours
example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa pubb'eva sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattass'eva sato cattāro sakuṇā nānāvaṇṇā catūhi disāhi āgantvā pādamūle nipatitvā sabbasetā sampajjiṃsu.
example_2: ath'ettha sakuṇā santi, nānāvaṇṇā bahū dijā, modanti saha bhariyāhi, aññam'aññaṃ pakūjino.
commentary: (ANa) nānāvaṇṇā'ti eko nīlavaṇṇo, eko pītavaṇṇo, eko lohitavaṇṇo, eko paṇḍupalāsavaṇṇo'ti evaṃ nānāvaṇṇā.

meaning_1: having different views; with different beliefs; holding different opinions (about)
example_1: tesañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ siyaṃsu dve bhikkhū abhidhamme nānāvādā.
example_2: kodhanā upanāhī ca, makkhī thambhī saṭhā bahū, ussukī nānāvādā ca, bhavissanti anāgate.
commentary: (THa) nānāvādā'ti aññam'aññaṃ viruddhavādā viruddhadiṭṭhikā, kalahakārakā cā'ti attho.

meaning_1: endowed with various kinds of charming discourse
with various environments; with different fields; with different domains
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso chappāṇake gahetvā nānāvisaye nānāgocare daḷhāya rajjuyā bandheyya.
example_2: pañc'imāni, bho gotama, indriyāni nānāvisayāni nānāgocarāni, na aññam'aññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhonti.

example_1: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave ubhatomukhā putoḷi pūrā nānāvihitassa dhaññassa seyyath'idaṃ sālīnaṃ vīhīnaṃ muggānaṃ māsānaṃ tilānaṃ taṇḍulānaṃ
commentary: (MNa) nānāvihitassā'ti nānāvidhassa.

meaning_1: from various kingdoms; belonging to different countries
example_1: tena kho pana samayena nānāverajjakānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ pañcamattāni brāhmaṇasatāni sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasanti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.
commentary: (MNa) nānāverajjakānan'ti nānāvidhesu rajjesu aññesu kāsikosal'ādīsu jātā vā nivasanti vā, tato vā āgatā'ti nānāverajjakā, tesaṃ nānāverajjakānaṃ.

meaning_1: gone to various foreign kingdoms; gone to different distant lands
example_1: santi h'āvuso, nānāverajjagataṃ bhikkhuṃ pañhaṃ pucchitāro, khattiyapaṇḍitā'pi brāhmaṇapaṇḍitā'pi gahapatipaṇḍitā'pi samaṇapaṇḍitā'pi.
commentary: (SNa) nānāverajjagatan'ti ekassa rañño rajjato nānāvidhaṃ rajjagataṃ.

example_1: iti ekaccānaṃ pāṇānaṃ anuddayāya anukampāya samādapenti, ekaccānaṃ pāṇānaṃ n'ānuddayāya n'ānukampāya samādapenti.

meaning_1: to be abandoned when going; to be left behind when leaving

commentary: (SNa) nikkhepanadhammo'ti nikkhipitabbasabhāvo.

meaning_1: laying down the path; setting the procedure; outlining the steps

example_1: atha kho bhagavā cundaṃ kammāraputtaṃ āmantesi, yaṃ te, cunda, sūkaramaddavaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ taṃ sobbhe nikhaṇāhi.

meaning_1: having made dig; having caused to bury
example_1: rājā pañcasate naggasamaṇake gāhāpetvā pañcasatehi corehi saddhiṃ rāj'aṅgaṇe nābhippamāṇesu āvāṭesu nikhaṇāpetvā palālehi paṭicchādāpetvā aggiṃ dāpesi.

seyyathā'pi, aggivessana, hatthidamako mahantaṃ thambhaṃ pathaviyaṃ nikhaṇitvā āraññakassa nāgassa gīvāyaṃ upanibandhati āraññakānañ'c'eva sīlānaṃ abhinimmadanāya āraññakānañ'c'eva sarasaṅkappānaṃ abhinimmadanāya
cakkhussa rahonāma na sakkā hoti akkhiṃ vā nikhaṇīyamāne bhamukaṃ vā ukkhipīyamāne sīsaṃ vā ukkhipīyamāne passituṃ. sotassa rahonāma na sakkā hoti pakatikathā sotuṃ.
nārī imā samparibhinnagattā, paggayha kandanti bhuje dujaccā, sammakkhitā lohitapubbalittā, gāvo yathā āghātane vikantā, tā bhūmibhāgasmiṃ sadā nikhātā, khandh'ātivattanti sajotibhūtā.
commentary: (JAa) sadā nikhātā'ti niccaṃ jalitaayapathaviyaṃ kaṭimattaṃ pavesetvā nikhaṇitvā ṭhapitā viya ṭhitā.

meaning_1: fact of being dug; fact of being buried

example_1: saññācikā nāma sayaṃ yācitvā purisam'pi puris'atthakaram'pi goṇam'pi sakaṭam'pi vāsim'pi parasum'pi kuṭhārim'pi kudālam'pi nikhādanam'pi vallim'pi veḷum'pi muñjam'pi pabbajam'pi tiṇam'pi mattikam'pi.
example_2: vāsīhi tacchetvā nikhādanaṃ ādāya anto suvisodhitaṃ visodheyya, anto suvisodhitaṃ visodhetvā lekhaṇiyā likheyya, lekhaṇiyā likhitvā pāsāṇaguḷena dhoveyya, pāsāṇaguḷena dhovetvā nāvaṃ kareyya, nāvaṃ katvā phiy'ārittaṃ bandheyya, phiy'ārittaṃ bandhitvā nadiṃ patāreyya.

meaning_1: (of something bad) suffers; experiences; undergoes; falls (into)
example_1: madhuvā maññati bālo, yāva pāpaṃ na paccati, yadā ca paccati pāpaṃ, bālo dukkhaṃ nigacchati.
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco aḍḍhakahāpaṇena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati, kahāpaṇena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati, kahāpaṇasatena'pi bandhanaṃ nigacchati.

example_1: tassa so mudumūsi antam'pi khādi, antaguṇam'pi khādi. so tatonidānaṃ maraṇam'pi nigacchi maraṇamattam'pi dukkhaṃ.
example_2: chaḷeva caturāsīti, vassāni navutāni ca, bhusaṃ dukkhaṃ nigacchittho, niraye katakibbiso.
commentary: (PVa) bhusaṃ dukkhaṃ nigacchittho'ti ativiya dukkhaṃ pāpuṇi.

meaning_2: member of the Jain Order, Naked ascetic
example_1: tena kho pana samayena satta ca jaṭilā satta ca nigaṇṭhā satta ca acelakā satta ca ekasāṭakā satta ca paribbājakā parūḷhakacchanakhalomā khārivividham'ādāya bhagavato avidūre atikkamanti.
example_2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā nigaṇṭhā isigilipasse kāḷasilāyaṃ ubbhaṭṭhakā honti āsanapaṭikkhittā, opakkamikā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayanti.

meaning_1: Jain religion; doctrine of the Jains
example_1: paññapetī'ti dasseti ṭhapeti. daṇḍāni paññapetī'ti idaṃ nigaṇṭhasamayena pucchanto āha. kāyadaṇḍaṃ vacīdaṇḍaṃ manodaṇḍan'ti ettha purimadaṇḍadvayaṃ te acittakaṃ payyapenti.

example_1: navame kilesānaṃ saṃvar'atthāya pavesanadvāraṃ pidahan'atthāya padhānaṃ saṃvarappadhānaṃ, pajahan'atthāya padhānaṃ pahānappadhānaṃ, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ brūhan'atthāya vaḍḍhan'atthāya padhānaṃ bhāvanāppadhānaṃ, tesaṃ'y'eva anurakkhaṇ'atthāya padhānaṃ anurakkhaṇāppadhānaṃ.
commentary: (ANt) pajahan'atthāyā'ti kāmavitakk'ādīnaṃ vinodan'atthāya.

example_1: so abhijānanto ekaṃ dhammaṃ, parijānanto ekaṃ dhammaṃ, pajahanto ekaṃ dhammaṃ, sacchikaronto ekaṃ dhammaṃ sammāvimuttiṃ phusati.
example_2: katamā c'ānanda, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā? idh'ānanda, bhikkhu ye loke upādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayā, te pajahanto viharati anupādiyanto. ayaṃ vuccat'ānanda, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā.

meaning_1: gave up; left; abandoned; let go (of)
example_1: aratiṃ pajahāsi sato, bhavāsi sataṃ taṃ sārayāmase, pātālarajo hi duttaro, mā taṃ kāmarajo avāhari.
example_2: ete ca vidvā manaso vitakke, ātāpiyo saṃvaratī satīmā, anugate manaso uppilāve, asesam'ete pajahāsi buddho'ti.
synonym: avassaji, ujjahi, ossaji, caji, chaḍḍayi, jahi, pajahi, pājahi, vijahi
commentary: (SNa) pajahāsī'ti pajaha. (UDa) pajahāsi samucchindī'ti.

meaning_1: gave up; left; abandoned; let go (of)
example_1: tesu ussukkajātesu, bhavasot'ānusārisu, ke'dha taṇhaṃ pajahiṃsu, ke lokasmiṃ anussukā'ti.
example_2: ye ca kho keci, bhikkhave, atītam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ taṃ aniccato addakkhuṃ dukkhato addakkhuṃ anattato addakkhuṃ rogato addakkhuṃ bhayato addakkhuṃ, te taṇhaṃ pajahiṃsu. ye taṇhaṃ pajahiṃsu te upadhiṃ pajahiṃsu.
synonym: ujjahi, ossaji, caji, chaḍḍayi, pajahāsi, vijahi
commentary: (ANa) pajahiṃsū'ti pajahanti.

meaning_1: to give up; to abandon; to let go (of)

example_1: brahmā'ti mātāpitaro, pubb'ācariyā'ti vuccare, āhuneyyā ca puttānaṃ, pajāya anukampakā.

example_1: ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno sīl'ānussatiṃ bhāveti.

example_2: sahā'pi dukkhena jaheyya kāme, yogakkhemaṃ āyatiṃ patthayāno, sammappajāno suvimuttacitto, vimuttiyā phassaye tattha tattha, sa vedagū vūsitabrahmacariyo, lok'antagū pāragato'ti vuccatī'ti.

grammar: prp, masc instr sg of pajānanta

example_1: yo ve avidvā upadhiṃ karoti, punappunaṃ dukkham'upeti mando, tasmā pajānaṃ upadhiṃ na kayirā, dukkhassa jātippabhav'ānupassī.

example_2: tañ'ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, yatth'assa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti

meaning_1: who delights in the lord of creation; who relishes the lord of creation; who is very happy with the lord of creation

meaning_1: overlord; lord of creation; creator god

example_1: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, paññādhanaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako paññavā hoti uday'atthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā
commentary: (DNa) sampatti-paṭilābh'aṭṭhena saddhā'va dhanaṃ saddhādhanaṃ. esa nayo sabbattha. paññādhanaṃ pan'ettha sabbaseṭṭhaṃ.

meaning_1: having understanding as a basis; with wisdom as foundation; established in knowledge
example_1: catur'ādhiṭṭhāno ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? paññ'ādhiṭṭhāno, sacc'ādhiṭṭhāno, cāg'ādhiṭṭhāno, upasam'ādhiṭṭhāno.
example_2: tasmā evaṃ samannāgato bhikkhu iminā paramena paññ'ādhiṭṭhānena samannāgato hoti. esā hi, bhikkhu, paramā ariyā paññā yadidaṃ, sabbadukkhakkhaye ñāṇaṃ.

meaning_1: ruled by understanding; governed by wisdom
example_1: katame cattāro? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo na sīlagaru hoti na sīl'ādhipateyyo, na samādhigaru hoti na samādh'ādhipateyyo, na paññāgaru hoti na paññ'ādhipateyyo.
commentary: (ANt) paññānimittaṃ ādhipateyyaṃ etassā'ti paññ'ādhipateyyo.

meaning_1: which obstructs wisdom; which impedes understanding
example_1: byāpādavitakko, bhikkhave, andhakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo aññāṇakaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko.
example_2: paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko'ti'pi me, bhikkhave, paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati.
commentary: (MNa) paññānirodhiko'ti anuppannāya lokiyalok'uttarāya paññāya uppajjituṃ na deti, lokiyapaññaṃ pana aṭṭhasamāpatti-pañc'ābhiññā-vasena uppannam'pi samucchinditvā khipatī'ti paññānirodhiko.

grammar: masc, agent, in comps, from paññapeti
example_1: ujjhāpanakaṃ nāma upasampannaṃ saṅghena sammataṃ sen'āsanapaññāpakaṃ vā bhatt'uddesakaṃ vā yāgubhājakaṃ vā phalabhājakaṃ vā khajjabhājakaṃ vā appamattakavissajjakaṃ vā avaṇṇaṃ kattu'kāmo

example_2: dukkhaṃ ārabbha yā uppajjati paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhabyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūri medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññ'indriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññāāloko paññāobhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanaṃ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi, idaṃ vuccati dukkhe ñāṇaṃ.
commentary: (PMa) obhāsan'aṭṭhena paññā'va obhāso paññāobhāso. pajjotan'aṭṭhena paññā'va pajjoto paññāpajjoto.

meaning_2: who removed the darkness of ignorance with the light of wisdom

meaning_1: obtaining wisdom; acquiring knowledge; gaining understanding
example_1: sappurisasaṃsevo, saddhammassavanaṃ, yonisomanasikāro, dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipatti, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā paññāpaṭilābhāya saṃvattantī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) paññāpaṭilābhāya saṃvattantī'ti ettha satta sekkhā paññaṃ paṭilabhanti nāma, khīṇ'āsavo paṭiladdhapañño nāmā'ti veditabbo. parato paññābuddhiyā'ti-ādīsupi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: done for the sake of obtaining wisdom; done for the purpose of acquiring knowledge
example_1: paññāpaṭilābhakatena kammunā, manussabhūto sukhumacchavī ahu, byākaṃsu uppādanimittakovidā, sukhumāni atthāni avecca dakkhiti.

meaning_1: gone for the sake of obtaining wisdom; gone for the purpose of acquiring knowledge
example_1: paññāpaṭilābhagatena kammunā, manussabhūto sukhumacchavī ahu, byākaṃsu uppādanimittakovidā, sukhumāni atthāni avecca dakkhiti.

meaning_2: to describe; to declare; for definition; designation

pa + ñāpe + ana + āya

example_1: ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo rūpakkhandhassa paññāpanāya? ko hetu ko paccayo vedanākkhandhassa paññāpanāya?

meaning_1: light of wisdom; radiance of understanding
example_1: katamā catasso? candappabhā, sūriyappabhā, aggippabhā, paññāpabhā, imā kho, bhikkhave, catasso pabhā. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imāsaṃ catunnaṃ pabhānaṃ yadidaṃ paññāpabhā'ti.
ekadhammo, bhikkhave, bhāvito bahulīkato paññāpabhedāya saṃvattati… anupādāparinibbānāya saṃvattati. katamo ekadhammo?
commentary: (ANa) paññāpabhedāyā'ti paññāya pabhedagaman'atthaṃ.

meaning_1: (of a seat, water, etc.) preparing; setting out
example_1: te ca āgantukā bhikkhū nevāsikehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodamānā sen'āsanāni paññāpayamānā pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā ahesuṃ.
commentary: (MNa) sen'āsanāni paññāpayamānā'ti attano attano ācariy'upajjhāyānaṃ vasanaṭṭhānāni pucchitvā dvāravātapānāni vivaritvā mañcapīṭhakaṭasārak'ādīni nīharitvā papphoṭetvā yathāṭṭhāne saṇṭhāpayamānā.

meaning_1: cleansed by understanding; purified by wisdom
example_1: sīlapaññāṇañ'ca pana lokasmiṃ aggam'akkhāyati. seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇa, hatthena vā hatthaṃ dhoveyya, pādena vā pādaṃ dhoveyya, evam'eva kho, brāhmaṇa, sīlaparidhotā paññā, paññāparidhotaṃ sīlaṃ. yattha sīlaṃ tattha paññā, yattha paññā tattha sīlaṃ.

meaning_1: nurtured by wisdom; fortified by understanding; matured by knowledge
example_1: samādhiparibhāvitā paññā mahapphalā hoti mah'ānisaṃsā. paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ samma'd'eva āsavehi vimuccati, seyyath'idaṃ, kām'āsavā, bhav'āsavā, avijj'āsavā'ti.
example_2: yassa kassaci, mahānāma, dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sīlaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sutaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ cāgaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ…

meaning_1: loss of wisdom; decline in understanding
example_1: appamattikā esā, bhikkhave, parihāni yadidaṃ ñātiparihāni. etaṃ patikiṭṭhaṃ, bhikkhave, parihānīnaṃ yadidaṃ paññāparihānī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) yadidaṃ paññāparihānī'ti yā esā mama sāsane kammassakatapaññāya jhānapaññāya vipassanāpaññāya maggapaññāya phalapaññāya ca parihāni, esā pacchimā, esā lāmakā, esā chaḍḍanīyā'ti attho.

example_1: oḷārikassa'pi kho ahaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, attapaṭilābhassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desemi… paññāpāripūriṃ vepullattañ'ca diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā'ti.
example_2: yathāpaṭipannānaṃ vo saṃkilesikā dhammā pahīyissanti, vodānīyā dhammā abhivaḍḍhissanti, paññāpāripūriṃ vepullattañ'ca diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā'ti.
commentary: (DNa) paññāpāripūrin'ti maggapaññāpāripūriṃ.

meaning_1: palace of understanding; tower of wisdom
example_1: pamādaṃ appamādena, yadā nudati paṇḍito, paññāpāsādam'āruyha, asoko sokiniṃ pajaṃ, pabbataṭṭho'va bhūmaṭṭhe, dhīro bāle avekkhati.
ta'y'idaṃ āyasmatā khemakena tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ vitthārena ācikkhitaṃ desitaṃ paññāpitaṃ paṭṭhapitaṃ vivaritaṃ vibhajitaṃ uttānīkatan'ti.

meaning_1: (of a rule) being formulated; being prescribed; being decreed; being declared (by)

example_2: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā param'atthavisuddhiṃ paññāpenti. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, param'atthavisuddhiṃ paññāpentānaṃ yadidaṃ sabbaso ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.

meaning_2: regulates or make a rule, promulgates
example_1: yato ca kho, bhaddāli, idh'ekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññāpeti tesaṃ'y'eva āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.

meaning_1: to define; to delineate; to describe
example_1: yā c'āvuso, paññā yañ'ca viññāṇaṃ, ime dhammā saṃsaṭṭhā udāhu visaṃsaṭṭhā? labbhā ca pan'imesaṃ dhammānaṃ vinibbhujitvā vinibbhujitvā nānākaraṇaṃ paññāpetun'ti?
example_2: sakkā evam'evaṃ viññāṇam'p'idaṃ ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññāpetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ iti'p'idaṃ viññāṇaṃ anattā'ti.

meaning_1: (of a seat, water, etc.) having prepared; having set out; having laid out
example_1: atha kho bhagavā kumbhakār'āvesanaṃ pavisitvā ekam'antaṃ tiṇasanthārakaṃ paññāpetvā nisīdi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
example_2: atha kho bhagavā catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññāpetvā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeti pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno.

commentary: (PM) paññābāhullāya saṃvattantī'ti katamaṃ paññābāhullaṃ? idh'ekacco paññāgaruko hoti paññ'ācarito paññ'āsayo paññ'ādhimutto paññādhajo paññāketu paññ'ādhipateyyo vicayabahulo pavicayabahulo okkhāyanabahulo samokkhāyanabahulo sampekkhāyanadhammo vibhūtavihārī taccarito taggaruko tabbahulo tanninno tappoṇo tappabbhāro tadadhimutto tadadhipateyyo. yathā gaṇagaruko vuccati gaṇabāhuliko'ti, cīvaragaruko vuccati cīvarabāhuliko'ti, pattagaruko vuccati pattabāhuliko'ti, sen'āsanagaruko vuccati sen'āsanabāhuliko'ti, evam'evaṃ idh'ekacco paññā garuko hoti paññ'ācarito paññ'āsayo paññ'ādhimutto paññādhajo paññāketu paññ'ādhipateyyo vicayabahulo pavicayabahulo okkhāyanabahulo samokkhāyanabahulo sampekkhāyanadhammo vibhūtavihārī taccarito taggaruko tabbahulo tanninno tappoṇo tappabbhāro tadadhimutto tadadhipateyyo. paññābāhullāya saṃvattantī'ti, idaṃ paññābāhullaṃ.

meaning_1: increase of wisdom; development of understanding
example_1: sappurisasaṃsevo, saddhammassavanaṃ, yonisomanasikāro, dhamm'ānudhammapaṭipatti, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā paññāpaṭilābhāya saṃvattanti, paññābuddhiyā saṃvattanti … nibbedhikapaññatāya saṃvattanti.
commentary: (PM) paññābuddhiyā saṃvattantī'ti katamā paññābuddhi? sattannañ'ca sekkhānaṃ puthujjanakalyāṇakassa ca paññā vaḍḍhati, arahato paññā vaḍḍhati. vaḍḍhitavaḍḍhanā paññābuddhiyā saṃvattantī'ti, ayaṃ paññābuddhi.

example_2: kadā nu paññāmayam'uggatejaṃ, satthaṃ isīnaṃ sahas'ādiyitvā, māraṃ sasenaṃ sahasā bhañjissaṃ, sīh'āsane taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

example_1: tathāgatappaveditā c'assa dhammā paññāya mattaso nijjhānaṃ khamanti, api c'assa ime dhammā honti

commentary: (ANa) paññāy'atthaṃ vipassatī'ti sahavipassanāya maggapaññāya catunnaṃ saccānaṃ atthaṃ vinivijjhitvā passati.

meaning_1: by wisdom; with intelligence; by understanding; with insight
example_1: yāni sotāni lokasmiṃ, sati tesaṃ nivāraṇaṃ, sotānaṃ saṃvaraṃ brūmi, paññāya-ete pidhiyyare.
example_2: te taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā tesaṃ dhammānaṃ paññāya atthaṃ na upaparikkhanti. tesaṃ te dhammā paññāya atthaṃ anupaparikkhataṃ na nijjhānaṃ khamanti.

meaning_1: is clearly known; is evident; is perceived; there is

example_2: yo, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya, yathā yath'āyaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathā taṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī'ti, evaṃ santaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyavāso na hoti, okāso na paññāyati sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya.

meaning_1: is allowed; is permitted (to); is known

example_2: seyyathā'pi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ samma'd'eva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, evam'eva tesaṃ caturāsītipāṇasahassānaṃ tasmiṃ'y'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
