example_1: accayo maṃ, bhante, accagamā, yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, y'āhaṃ evam'akāsiṃ. tassā me, bhante, ayyo ānando accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu, āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) taṃ te mayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāmā'ti taṃ tava aparādhaṃ mayaṃ khamāma.

example_1: dvattipattapūre paṭiggahetvā tato nikkhamantena bhikkhuṃ passitvā ācikkhitabbaṃ, amutra mayā dvattipattapūrā paṭiggahitā, mā kho paṭiggaṇhī'ti.

meaning_2: to take; to receive; to accept

example_1: te vuttavākyā rājāno, paṭiggayha-anusāsaniṃ, vippasannamanā santā, aṭṭhaṃsu samhi āsane'ti.
example_2: ajjhenāni paṭiggayha, kāmesu gadhito ahaṃ, acariṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ, paresaṃ ahitāyahaṃ.
commentary: (JAa) paṭiggayhā'ti paṭiggahetvā adhīyitvā.

example_1: anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, gilānassa, uddharitvā vā bhinditvā vā paṭiggahe vā nīharitvā vā chaḍḍeti, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
synonym: ādhāra, upadhāna, dhi, nidhāna, piṭhara, pīṭhara
commentary: (VINa) paṭiggahe vā'ti paṭiggahena paṭicchanto naṃ paṭiggahe chaḍḍeti.

example_1: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu anavasesadohī hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ saddhā gahapatikā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavārenti cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānapaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhārehi. tatra bhikkhu mattaṃ na jānāti paṭiggahaṇāya.
example_2: aj'eḷakapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, kukkuṭasūkarapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, hatthi-gav'assa-vaḷava-paṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, khettavatthupaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ.

example_1: pañcahi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi antevāsinā dakkhiṇā disā ācariyā paccupaṭṭhātabbā, uṭṭhānena upaṭṭhānena sussusāya pāricariyāya sakkaccaṃ sippapaṭiggahaṇena
commentary: (DNa) sakkaccaṃ sippapaṭiggahaṇenā'ti sakkaccaṃ paṭiggahaṇaṃ nāma thokaṃ gahetvā bahuvāre sajjhāyakaraṇaṃ, ekapadam'pi visuddham'eva gahetabbaṃ.

example_1: dvattipattapūre paṭiggahetvā tato nikkhamantena bhikkhuṃ passitvā ācikkhitabbaṃ, amutra mayā dvattipattapūrā paṭiggahitā, mā kho tattha paṭiggaṇhī'ti.
example_2: idaṃ me, bhante, cīvaraṃ aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā hatthato paṭiggahitaṃ, aññatra pārivattakā, nissaggiyaṃ. im'āhaṃ saṅghassa nissajjāmī'ti
commentary: (VINa) kāle paṭiggahitan'ti-ādīsu majjh'anhike avītivatte paṭiggahetvā pacitvā parissāvetvā cā'ti attho.

example_1: katame, bhikkhave, cattāro mah'āpadesā? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya, sammukhā m'etaṃ, āvuso, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ, ayaṃ dhammo, ayaṃ vinayo, idaṃ satthusāsanan'ti.
example_2: sammukhā kho pana m'etaṃ bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ, abhay'ūparato'ham'asmi, n'āham'asmi bhay'ūparato, vītarāgattā kāme na sevāmi khayā rāgassā'ti.

meaning_1: (vinaya) formally accepted; received by a monastic
example_1: paṭiggahitake vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. paṭiggahitake paṭiggahitakasaññī, anāpatti.

meaning_1: (vinaya) formally accepted; received by a monk
example_1: atirittaṃ nāma kappiyakataṃ hoti, paṭiggahitakataṃ hoti, uccāritakataṃ hoti, hatthapāse kataṃ hoti, bhuttāvinā kataṃ hoti, bhuttāvinā pavāritena āsanā avuṭṭhitena kataṃ hoti

meaning_1: perceiving as formally accepted; regarding (something) as received
example_1: paṭiggahitake vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. paṭiggahitake paṭiggahitakasaññī, anāpatti.

meaning_1: should be received (by); can be taken (by); acceptable (for)
example_1: disvāna aññam'aññaṃ saṇṭhapesuṃ, ayaṃ kho, āvuso, samaṇo gotamo āgacchati bāhulliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya. so n'eva abhivādetabbo, na paccuṭṭhātabbo, n'āssa pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ.
example_2: bhikkhuno pan'eva addhānamaggappaṭipannassa eḷakalomāni uppajjeyyuṃ, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbāni, paṭiggahetvā tiyojanaparamaṃ sahatthā haritabbāni asante hārake.

meaning_2: who accept, receives or takes, recipient
example_1: ahaṃ kho pana, tāta uttara, mantānaṃ dātā, tvaṃ mantānaṃ paṭiggahetā'ti.
sakkaccaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggahessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
example_2: na sāmisena hatthena pānīyathālakaṃ paṭiggahessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
synonym: uggaṇhāti, upagacchati, gaṇhati, gaṇhāti, paṭiggahāti, lāti, sampaṭicchati

example_1: na kho no, brāhmaṇa, kappati jātarūparajataṃ paṭiggahetun'ti. sace taṃ bhoto udenassa na kappati vihāraṃ bhoto udenassa kārāpessāmī'ti.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko sīsaṃnhāto uppalamālaṃ vā vassikamālaṃ vā atimuttakamālaṃ vā labhitvā ubhohi hatthehi paṭiggahetvā uttam'aṅge sirasmiṃ patiṭṭhapeyya
tam'enaṃ aññataro puriso telamalikatena sāhuḷicīrena vañceyya, idaṃ te, ambho purisa, odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucī'ti. so taṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, paṭiggahetvā pārupeyya.
example_2: sace yāgu hoti, bhājanaṃ dhovitvā yāgu upanāmetabbā. yāguṃ pītassa udakaṃ datvā bhājanaṃ paṭiggahetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ appaṭighaṃsantena dhovitvā paṭisāmetabbaṃ.

example_1: app'ekacce maṃ paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesuṃ, app'ekacce āsanaṃ paññapesuṃ, app'ekacce pād'odakaṃ upaṭṭhapesuṃ. api ca kho maṃ nāmena ca āvusovādena ca samudācaranti.
example_2: atha kho āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca nandiyo āyasmā ca kimilo bhagavantaṃ paccuggantvā, eko bhagavato pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesi, eko āsanaṃ paññapesi, eko pād'odakaṃ upaṭṭhāpesi

meaning_1: expected destination; place which will receive one
example_1: dussīlassa, bhikkhave, dve paṭiggāhā, nirayo vā tiracchānayoni vā. sīlavato, bhikkhave, dve paṭiggāhā, devā vā manussā vā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) paṭiggāhā'ti paṭiggāhakā, dussīlaṃ puggalaṃ dve ṭhānāni paṭiggaṇhantī'ti attho.

example_1: kathañ'c'ānanda, dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato? idh'ānanda, dāyako hoti sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo, paṭiggāhakā honti dussīlā pāpadhammā
example_2: sace so tena parivattetvā kappiyaṃ āharati rūpiyappaṭiggāhakaṃ ṭhapetvā sabbeh'eva paribhuñjitabbaṃ.

example_1: so sabbaso rāg'ānusayaṃ pahāya paṭigha-anusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā asmī'ti diṭṭhimān'ānusayaṃ samūhanitvā avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti
example_2: upekkhaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. upekkhañ'hi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato yo paṭigho so pahīyissati.

meaning_1: (sense) impression; impingement; impact; (comm) existence in the realm of sense desire
example_1: yattha nāmañ'ca rūpañ'ca, asesaṃ uparujjhati, paṭighaṃ rūpasaññā ca, etth'esā chijjate jaṭā'ti.
example_2: idha mayaṃ, bhante, yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhāma sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā, ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāma
commentary: (SNa) paṭighaṃ rūpasaññā cā'ti ettha paṭighasaññāvasena kāmabhavo gahito, rūpasaññāvasena rūpabhavo. tesu dvīsu gahitesu arūpabhavo gahito'va hoti bhavasaṅkhepenā'ti.

meaning_1: disliked image in the mind; mental image which irritates one
example_1: paṭighanimittaṃ, bhikkhave, ayoniso manasi karoto anuppanno c'eva byāpādo uppajjati uppanno ca byāpādo bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatī'ti
example_2: ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā byāpādassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā byāpādassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? atthi, bhikkhave, paṭighanimittaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) paṭighanimittan'ti-ādīsu pana paṭigho'pi paṭighanimittaṃ paṭigh'ārammaṇam'pi.

meaning_1: recognition of sense impression; perception of sense impact
example_1: idha mayaṃ, bhante, yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhāma sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā, ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāma
commentary: (Abh Vibh 6.3) cakkh'ādīnaṃ vatthūnaṃ rūp'ādīnaṃ ārammaṇānañ'ca paṭighātena samuppannā saññā paṭighasaññā. rūpasaññ'ādīnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. rūpasaññā saddasaññā gandhasaññā rasasaññā phoṭṭhabbasaññā, imā vuccanti paṭighasaññāyo'ti

example_1: na paro paraṃ nikubbetha, n'ātimaññetha katthaci naṃ kañci, byārosanā paṭighasaññā, n'āññam'aññassa dukkham'iccheyya.
commentary: (SNPa) byārosanā paṭighasaññā'ti kāyavacīvikārehi byārosanāya ca, manovikārena paṭighasaññāya ca.

meaning_1: bond of repulsion; fetter of resistance
example_1: satta saññojanāni, anunayasaññojanaṃ, paṭighasaññojanaṃ, diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ, vicikicchāsaññojanaṃ, mānasaññojanaṃ, bhavarāgasaññojanaṃ, avijjāsaññojanaṃ.
commentary: (NIDD1a) paṭighasaññojanā'ti byāpādasaññojanā. so hi ārammaṇe paṭihaññatī'ti paṭighan'ti vuccati. te eva thāmagat'aṭṭhena santāne anusentī'ti anusayā.

example_1: yehi, ānanda, ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi yehi uddesehi nāmakāyassa ca rūpakāyassa ca paññatti hoti, tesu ākāresu tesu liṅgesu tesu nimittesu tesu uddesesu asati api nu kho adhivacanasamphasso vā paṭighasamphasso vā paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
commentary: (DNa) paṭighasamphasso'ti sappaṭighaṃ rūpakkhandhaṃ vatthuṃ katvā uppajjanakasamphasso.

meaning_1: bond of repulsion; fetter of aversion
example_1: satta saṃyojanāni, anunayasaṃyojanaṃ, paṭighasaṃyojanaṃ, diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ, vicikicchāsaṃyojanaṃ, mānasaṃyojanaṃ, bhavarāgasaṃyojanaṃ, avijjāsaṃyojanaṃ.

so dve vedanā vedayati, kāyikañ'ca, cetasikañ'ca. tassā'y'eva kho pana dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno paṭighavā hoti. tam'enaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighavantaṃ, yo dukkhāya vedanāya paṭigh'ānusayo, so anuseti.
example_2: yena kho, jīvaka, rāgena yena dosena yena mohena vihesavā assa arativā assa paṭighavā assa so rāgo so doso so moho tathāgatassa pahīno ucchinnamūlo tāl'āvatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.

meaning_1: due to aversion; because of resistance
warding off; repelling; driving off; keeping at bay (of)
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso cīvaraṃ paṭisevati, yāva'd'eva sītassa paṭighātāya, uṇhassa paṭighātāya, ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-sarīṃsapa-samphassānaṃ paṭighātāya, yāva'd'eva hirikopīnappaṭicchādan'atthaṃ
example_2: yato ca kho, sāriputta, idh'ekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññapeti uddissati pātimokkhaṃ tesaṃ'y'eva āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.
commentary: (VINa) samparāyikānaṃ āsavānaṃ paṭighātāyā'ti samparāyikā āsavā nāma asaṃvare ṭhitena katapāpakammamūlakā samparāye narak'ādīsu pattabbā dukkhavisesā, tesaṃ paṭighāt'atthāya paṭippassambhan'atthāya vūpasam'atthāyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

example_1: ete ca ñatvā satimā sumedho, avekkhati vipariṇāmadhamme, iṭṭhassa dhammā na mathenti cittaṃ, aniṭṭhato no paṭighātam'eti.

meaning_1: underlying tendency to aversion; inherent inclination to resistance
example_1: so sabbaso rāg'ānusayaṃ pahāya paṭigh'ānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā asmī'ti diṭṭhimān'ānusayaṃ samūhanitvā avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti
example_2: kāmarāg'ānusayassa… paṭigh'ānusayassa… diṭṭh'ānusayassa… vicikicch'ānusayassa… mān'ānusayassa… bhavarāg'ānusayassa… avijj'ānusayassa pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
commentary: (MNa) paṭigh'ānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā'ti paṭigh'ānusayañ'ca sabb'ākāren'eva nīharitvā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. ettāvatā anāgāmimaggo kathito.

meaning_1: having the underlying tendency to aversion; with the inherent inclination to resistance
example_1: dukkhaṃ vedayamānassa, vedanaṃ appajānato, paṭigh'ānusayo hoti, anissaraṇadassino.
tathā hi mukhaghos'ādīhi paccayehi aññasmiṃ dese ādāsapabbatappades'ādike paṭibimba-paṭighos'ādikaṃ paccayuppannaṃ nibbattamānaṃ dissati, tasmā na sabbaṃ sabbattha upanetabban'ti ayam'ettha saṅkhepo.
commentary: (APt) atha vā ghosassa patirūpo paṭighoso.

example_1: khīṇ'āsavo, bhante, bhikkhu vusitavā katakaraṇīyo, karaṇīyaṃ attano asamanupassanto, katassa vā paṭicayaṃ, khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā nekkhamm'ādhimutto hoti
example_2: tassa sammā vimuttassa, santacittassa bhikkhuno, katassa paṭicayo n'atthi, karaṇīyaṃ na vijjati.

meaning_2: goes about, evades a question, obscures a matter of discussion
example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno aññen'āññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti.
example_2: sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno aññen'aññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.
commentary: (ANa) aññen'aññaṃ paṭicaratī'ti aññena vacanena aññaṃ paṭicchādeti, aññaṃ vā pucchito aññaṃ katheti

meaning_2: went about, evaded a question, obscured a matter of discussion
example_1: abhijānām'ahaṃ, bho gotama, pūraṇaṃ kassapaṃ vādena vādaṃ samārabhitā. so'pi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho aññen'aññaṃ paṭicari, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmesi, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātv'ākāsi.
tesaṃ, bhante, gopakena devaputtena paṭicoditānaṃ dve devā diṭṭh'eva dhamme satiṃ paṭilabhiṃsu kāyaṃ brahmapurohitaṃ, eko pana devo kāme ajjhāvasi.

sammāsambuddhassa te paṭijānato ime dhammā anabhisambuddhā'ti. tatra vata maṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ sahadhammena paṭicodessatī'ti nimittam'etaṃ, sāriputta, na samanupassāmi.
āsādan'āpekkho'ti iminā imaṃ codessāmi sāressāmi paṭicodessāmi paṭisāressāmi maṅku karissāmī'ti abhiharati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

meaning_1: having blamed; having rebuked; having reprimanded
meaning_2: having blamed in return, having reproved
example_1: ath'assa pacchato āgacchanto'pi tiṭṭhati. so ayaṃ bhikkhu tuyhaṃ uppannavitakkaṃ jānāti, ananucchavikaṃ te etan'ti attānaṃ paṭicodetvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā tatth'eva ariyabhūmiṃ okkamati. tathā asakkonto nisīdati.

te amhākaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ āgate amhākaṃ pāricariyaṃ gopako devaputto paṭicodesi, kutomukhā nāma tumhe, mārisā, tassa bhagavato dhammaṃ assuttha, ahañ'hi nāma itthikā samānā buddhe pasannā dhamme pasannā saṅghe pasannā sīlesu paripūrakārinī itthittaṃ virājetvā purisattaṃ bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā
commentary: (DNa) paṭicodesī'ti sāresi.

meaning_1: dependent; depending (on); contingent (upon); relying (on); because (of); supported (by); on account (of); grounded (on)
meaning_2: on account of, because of, concerning
example_1: yaṃ rūpaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ rūpassa assādo. yaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, ayaṃ rūpassa ādīnavo.
example_2: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttan'ti.

meaning_1: done on somebody's behalf; of which one is the cause of the action
meaning_2: action depending on (someone); action for which one is a cause
example_1: sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ uddissa pāṇaṃ ārabhanti, taṃ samaṇo gotamo jānaṃ uddissakataṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭiccakamman'ti.
commentary: (MNa) paṭiccakamman'ti attānaṃ paṭicca kataṃ.

meaning_1: (comm) who receives the result of the action
example_1: sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ uddissa pāṇaṃ ārabhanti, taṃ samaṇo gotamo jānaṃ uddissakataṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭiccakamman'ti.
commentary: (MNa) atha vā paṭiccakamman'ti nimittakammass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ, taṃ paṭicca kammam'ettha atthī'ti maṃsaṃ paṭiccakamman'ti vuttaṃ hoti yo evarūpaṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati, so'pi tassa kammassa dāy'ādo hoti, vadhakassa viya tassā'pi pāṇaghātakammaṃ hotī'ti tesaṃ laddhi.

meaning_1: arisen together from a cause; causally produced; dependently arisen
meaning_2: evolved by reason of the law of causation
example_1: tañ'ca kho saṅkhataṃ oḷārikaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ
example_2: paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kho, āvuso, sukhadukkhaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā. kiṃ paṭicca? phassaṃ paṭicca. iti vadaṃ vuttavādī c'eva bhagavato assa, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyya

ye'pi nigaṇṭhassa nāṭaputtassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā te'pi nigaṇṭhesu nāṭaputtiyesu nibbinnarūpā virattarūpā paṭivānarūpā yathā taṃ durakkhāte dhammavinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasamasaṃvattanike asammāsambuddhappavedite bhinnathūpe appaṭisaraṇe.
commentary: (MNa) paṭivānarūpā'ti tesaṃ nipaccakiriyato nivattasabhāvā.

meaning_1: withdraws; pulls back; makes turn away (from)
example_1: so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpeti. so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpetvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharati
commentary: (ANa) paṭivāpetī'ti nibbānavasena nivatteti. (ANa) cittaṃ paṭivāpetī'ti cittaṃ paṭisaṃharati moceti apaneti.

meaning_1: having withdrawn; having pulled back; having made turn away
example_1: so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpeti. so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpetvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharati

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, udake lekhā khippaṃ'y'eva paṭivigacchati, na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco puggalo āgāḷhena'pi vuccamāno pharusena'pi vuccamāno amanāpena'pi vuccamāno sandhiyati'm'eva saṃsandati'm'eva sammodati'm'eva.
tuliya paṭivicaya cintayitvā, mahājanasaṅgahanaṃ samekkhamāno, ayam'idam'arahati tattha tattha, purisavisesakaro pure ahosi.
commentary: (DNa) paṭivicayā'ti paṭivicinitvā.

meaning_1: examines; investigates; considers carefully; (comm) wanders around for the purpose of questioning
example_1: te taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā aññam'aññaṃ paṭipucchanti paṭivicaranti, idaṃ kathaṃ, imassa ko attho'ti? te avivaṭañ'c'eva vivaranti, anuttānīkatañ'ca uttānīkaronti, anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭhāniyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ paṭivinodenti.
commentary: (ANa) na ca paṭivicarantī'ti pucchan'atthāya cārikaṃ na vicaranti.
(NIDD1a) paṭivijānanto'ti taṃ taṃ paṭicca vijānamāno.

example_1: tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, soṇa, vīriyasamathaṃ adhiṭṭhahaṃ, indriyānañ'ca samataṃ paṭivijjha, tattha ca nimittaṃ gaṇhāhī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
example_2: evaṃ abhisaddahati, ime kho te dhammā ye me pubbe sutavā ahesuṃ, ten'āhaṃ eta'r'ahi kāyena ca phusitvā viharāmi, paññāya ca paṭivijjha passāmī'ti.

example_1: pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu nacirass'eva akuppaṃ paṭivijjhati. katamehi pañcahi?
example_2: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, ānanda, katamaṃ nu kho dukkarataraṃ vā durabhisambhavataraṃ vā, yo dūrato'va sukhumena tāḷacchiggaḷena asanaṃ atipāteyya poṅkh'ānupoṅkhaṃ avirādhitaṃ, yo vā sattadhā bhinnassa vālassa koṭiyā koṭiṃ paṭivijjheyyā'ti?

example_1: atha kho, ānanda, duppaṭivijjhataraṃ paṭivijjhanti, ye idaṃ dukkhan'ti yathābhūtaṃ paṭivijjhanti … ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā'ti yathābhūtaṃ paṭivijjhanti.

commentary: (SNa) sattadhā bhinnassa vālassa koṭiyā koṭiṃ paṭivijjheyyā'ti ekaṃ vālaṃ sattadhā bhinditvā, tassa ekaṃ bhedaṃ gahetvā, vātiṅgaṇamajjhe bandhitvā, aparaṃ bhedaṃ kaṇḍassa aggakoṭiyaṃ bandhitvā, usabhamatte ṭhito kaṇḍabaddhāya koṭiyā taṃ vātiṅgaṇabaddhakoṭiṃ paṭivijjheyyā'ti attho.

example_1: atha kho āyasmā soṇo aparena samayena vīriyasamathaṃ adhiṭṭhāsi, indriyānañ'ca samataṃ paṭivijjhi, tattha ca nimittaṃ aggahesi.

meaning_1: should be penetrated; should be comprehended; should be understood
meaning_2: should be penetrated; should be pierced
example_1: taṃ kho pana vo, anuruddhā, nimittaṃ paṭivijjhitabbaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) taṃ kho pana vo anuruddhā nimittaṃ paṭivijjhitabban'ti taṃ vo kāraṇaṃ jānitabbaṃ.

meaning_1: to comprehend; to understand; to penetrate
meaning_2: to comprehend; to understand; to penetrate
example_1: evam'pi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne n'āsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ, na bhagavantaṃ yāci, tiṭṭhatu, bhante, bhagavā kappaṃ, tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lok'ānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānan'ti, yathā taṃ mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto.
nibbijjhā'ti paṭivijjhitvā. sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā'ti paṭivijjhitvā, sabbe saṅkhārā dukkhā'ti paṭivijjhitvā… yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti paṭivijjhitvā.
example_2: paramadanto'ti aññena kenaci asikkhāpito acodito sayambhuñāṇena paṭivijjhitvā paramadamathena dantattā paramadanto nāma. parinibbuto'ti kilesaparinibbānena parinibbuto.
commentary: (NIDD1a) paṭivijjhitvā'ti ñāṇena nikkhametvā vā nibbijjhitvā vā.

example_1: añño saddh'indriyaṃ dhammo, añño vīriy'indriyaṃ dhammo, añño sat'indriyaṃ dhammo, añño samādh'indriyaṃ dhammo, añño paññ'indriyaṃ dhammo. yena ñāṇena ime nānā dhammā ñātā, ten'eva ñāṇena ime nānā dhammā paṭividitā'ti.
commentary: (PMa) paṭividitā'ti abhimukhabhāvena viditā pākaṭā nāma honti. tena paṭisambhidāpadassa attho vutto.

example_1: duddasaṃ anataṃ nāma, na hi saccaṃ sudassanaṃ, paṭividdhā taṇhā jānato, passato n'atthi kiñcanan'ti.
example_2: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ… ucchinnā bhavataṇhā, khīṇā bhavanetti, n'atth'idāni punabbhavo'ti.
commentary: (UDa) paṭividdhā taṇhā jānato passato n'atthi kiñcanan'ti tañ'ca nirodhasaccaṃ sacchikiriy'ābhisamayavasena abhisamentena visayato kiccato ca ārammaṇato ca ārammaṇappaṭivedhena asammohappaṭivedhena ca paṭividdhaṃ, yathāpariññ'ābhisamayavasena dukkhasaccaṃ, bhāvan'ābhisamayavasena maggasaccañ'ca asammohato paṭividdhaṃ hoti, evaṃ pahān'ābhisamayavasena asammohato ca paṭividdhā taṇhā hoti. evañ'ca cattāri saccāni yathābhūtaṃ ariyamaggapaññāya jānato passato bhav'ādīsu natabhūtā taṇhā n'atthi, tadabhāve sabbassa'pi kilesavaṭṭassa abhāvo, tato'va kammavipākavaṭṭānaṃ asambhavo'y'evā'ti evaṃ bhagavā tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anavasesa-vaṭṭadukkha-vūpasama-hetubhūtaṃ amatamahānibbānassa ānubhāvaṃ pakāsesi.

meaning_2: who acquired the understanding of a solitary Buddha

example_1: nava'y'ime, bhikkhave, āghātapaṭivinayā. katame nava? anatthaṃ me acari, taṃ kut'ettha labbhā'ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti.
example_2: kāmasaññānaṃ pariññā akkhātā, kāmapipāsānaṃ paṭivinayo akkhāto, kāmavitakkānaṃ samugghāto akkhāto, kāmapariḷāhānaṃ vūpasamo akkhāto?
commentary: (ANa) paṭivinayo'ti hi paṭivinayavatthūnam'pi paṭivinayakāraṇānam'pi etaṃ adhivacanaṃ, tadubhayam'pi idha vaṭṭati.

meaning_1: cause for driving out; means of removal
basis for driving out; object for removal

example_1: iti kira, bho, rūpaṃ anattā, vedanā anattā, saññā anattā, saṅkhārā anattā, viññāṇaṃ anattā, anattakatāni kammāni kam'attānaṃ phusissantī'ti. paṭivinītā kho me tumhe, bhikkhave, tatra tatra dhammesu.

meaning_1: should be driven out; should be dispelled; could be removed
example_1: ime kho, āvuso, pañca āghātapaṭivinayā, yattha bhikkhuno uppanno āghāto sabbaso paṭivinetabbo'ti.

meaning_1: drives out; dispels; gets rid of
example_1: pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā yāguyā. katame pañca? khuddaṃ paṭihanati, pipāsaṃ paṭivineti, vātaṃ anulometi, vatthiṃ sodheti, ām'āvasesaṃ pāceti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṃsā yāguyā'ti.
example_2: nava'y'ime, bhikkhave, āghātapaṭivinayā. katame nava? anatthaṃ me acari, taṃ kut'ettha labbhā'ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti.
synonym: paṭivinodeti, panudati, panudeti, panūdati, vinodayati, vinodeti

meaning_1: having driven out; having dispelled; having got rid of
example_1: yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā jighacchādubbalyaṃ paṭivinetvā evaṃ imaṃ rattin'divaṃ vītināmeyyan'ti.

so kho ahaṃ, bhante, aññatr'eva asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā vassasat'āyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvā'va lokassa antaṃ antarā'y'eva kālaṅ'kato.

meaning_1: should be driven out; should be dispelled; should be removed; should be assuaged
meaning_lit: to cause to be driven back
example_1: cundassa, ānanda, kammāraputtassa evaṃ vippaṭisāro paṭivinodetabbo.
example_2: imassa ca atthassa āvibhāvatthaṃ, pañc'ime, āvuso, āghātapaṭivinayā. yattha bhikkhuno uppanno āghāto sabbaso paṭivinodetabbo'ti (a. ni. 5.162) idaṃ pañcakanipāte āghātapaṭivinayasuttaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.
commentary: (VISMa) mettāyantena paṭighaṃ paṭivinodetabban'ti ettha keci pana upacārajjhānaṃ sampādetvā'ti atthaṃ vadanti, tesaṃ upacārajjhānato vuṭṭhānam'pi icchitabbaṃ siyā vuṭṭhahitvā'ti vuttattā. pubbe tasmiṃ puggale asatiyā amanasikārena paṭighaṃ anuppādentassa sādhāraṇato taṃ vikkhambhetvā jhānassa uppādanaṃ, samāpajjanañ'ca vuttaṃ. idāni pana taṃ anussarantassa'pi manasi karontassa'pi yathā paṭighaṃ na uppajjati, taṃ vidhiṃ dassetuṃ idaṃ vuttaṃ taṃ puggalaṃ mettāyantena paṭighaṃ vinodetabban'ti.

meaning_1: drives out; dispels; removes; gets rid (of)
example_1: tassa te āyasmanto avivaṭañ'c'eva vivaranti, anuttānīkatañ'ca uttānī karonti, anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭhāniyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ paṭivinodenti.
synonym: paṭivineti, panudati, panudeti, panūdati, vitarati, vinayati, vineti, vinodayati, vinodeti

meaning_1: having driven out; having dispelled; having removed; having got rid (of)
meaning_2: having dispelled, having removed, having gotten rid of
example_1: so sabbaso rāg'ānusayaṃ pahāya paṭigh'ānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā asmī'ti diṭṭhimān'ānusayaṃ samūhanitvā avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti
example_2: so aparena samayena rūpānaṃ'y'eva samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā rūpataṇhaṃ pahāya rūpapariḷāhaṃ paṭivinodetvā vigatapipāso ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto vihareyya.
commentary: (ANa) paṭivinodetvā'ti… nīharitvā

meaning_1: sees deeply back (into); sees repeatedly in detail; understands with frequent insight
example_1: asaṃhīraṃ asaṃkuppan'ti idaṃ vipassanā-paṭivipassanā-dassan'atthaṃ vuttaṃ. vipassanā hi rāg'ādīhi na saṃhīrati na saṃkuppatī'ti asaṃhīraṃ asaṃkuppaṃ, taṃ anubrūhaye vaḍḍheyya, paṭivipasseyyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.
commentary: (NPt) paṭivipasseyyā'ti vipassanā-sammasanam'āha.

meaning_1: repeated observation; (or) insight into previous insights
meaning_2: insight into past insight (as impermanent, etc.)
example_1: iminā diṭṭh'ārammaṇā taṇhā-māna-diṭṭhiyo kathitā. vipassanāya paṭivipassanākāle viya pacchimadiṭṭhiyā purimadiṭṭhiggahaṇakāle evaṃ hoti.
commentary: (MNt) paṭivipassanākāle'ti yamakato sammasan'ādi-kālaṃ sandhāy'āha.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, dakkho goghātako vā goghātak'antevāsī vā gāviṃ vadhitvā cātummahāpathe bilaso paṭivibhajitvā nisinno assa
imesaṃ pana, tapassi, tiṇṇaṃ daṇḍānaṃ evaṃ paṭivibhattānaṃ evaṃ paṭivisiṭṭhānaṃ katamaṃ daṇḍaṃ nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto mahāsāvajjataraṃ paññapeti pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, idh'assa puriso… musāvādā paṭivirato pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato samphappalāpā paṭivirato anabhijjhālu abyāpannacitto sammādiṭṭhiko.
example_2: idha cunda ekacco pāṇ'ātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato hoti nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī day'āpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī viharati

example_1: yā kho, bhikkhave, ariyacittassa anāsavacittassa ariyamaggasamaṅgino ariyamaggaṃ bhāvayato catūhi vacīduccaritehi ārati virati paṭivirati veramaṇī, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, sammāvācā ariyā anāsavā lok'uttarā magg'aṅgā.
yaṃnūna mayaṃ sabbaso nivāpabhojanā paṭivirameyyāma, bhayabhogā paṭiviratā araññ'āyatanāni ajjhogāhetvā vihareyyāmā'ti.
te sabbaso nivāpabhojanā paṭiviramiṃsu, bhayabhogā paṭiviratā araññ'āyatanāni ajjhogāhetvā vihariṃsu.

meaning_1: opposes; is against; is averse; is hostile (to)
example_1: so uppannaṃ lābhaṃ anurujjhati, alābhe paṭivirujjhati, uppannaṃ yasaṃ anurujjhati, ayase paṭivirujjhati, uppannaṃ pasaṃsaṃ anurujjhati, nindāya paṭivirujjhati, uppannaṃ sukhaṃ anurujjhati, dukkhe paṭivirujjhati.
sammā byākaramānā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ byākareyyuṃ, ananuruddh'āppaṭiviruddhass'āvuso, sā niṭṭhā, na sā niṭṭhā anuruddhappaṭiviruddhassā'ti.
example_2: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā bhavadiṭṭhiṃ allīnā bhavadiṭṭhiṃ upagatā bhavadiṭṭhiṃ ajjhositā, vibhavadiṭṭhiyā te paṭiviruddhā.
commentary: (MNa) anuruddhapaṭiviruddhassā'ti rāgena anuruddhassa kodhena paṭiviruddhassa.

example_1: tasmā pañcame vā sattame vā divase puna tattha cāretuṃ vaṭṭati, ettakena hi tiṇam'pi paṭiviruhati, udakam'pi pasīdati. ayaṃ pana imaṃ pañcāhikavāraṃ vā satt'āhikavāraṃ vā na jānāti, divase divase rakkhitaṭṭhāne'y'eva rakkhati.
yaṃ taṃ sāyaṃ sāyam'āsāya āharanti, pāto taṃ hoti pakkaṃ paṭivirūḷhaṃ. yaṃ taṃ pāto pātarāsāya āharanti, sāyaṃ taṃ hoti pakkaṃ paṭivirūḷhaṃ, n'āpadānaṃ paññāyati.
commentary: (DNa) pakkaṃ paṭivirūḷhan'ti sāyaṃ gahitaṭṭhānaṃ pāto pakkaṃ hoti, puna virūḷhaṃ paṭipākatikam'eva gahitaṭṭhānaṃ na paññāyati.
(VINa) paṭiviso'ti koṭṭhāso.
(MNa) paṭivisakānan'ti sāmantagehavāsīnaṃ.

example_1: imesaṃ pana, tapassi, tiṇṇaṃ daṇḍānaṃ evaṃ paṭivibhattānaṃ evaṃ paṭivisiṭṭhānaṃ katamaṃ daṇḍaṃ nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto mahāsāvajjataraṃ paññapeti pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā
atha kho, bhikkhave, kāḷī dāsī bhinnena sīsena lohitena galantena paṭivissakānaṃ ujjhāpesi, passath'ayye, soratāya kammaṃ, passath'ayye, nivātāya kammaṃ, passath'ayye, upasantāya kammaṃ!
commentary: (VINa) paṭivissake'ti sāmantagharavāsike.

example_1: api ca mayaṃ taṃ sarāma, kiṃ nu kho mahāsamaṇo n'āgacchatī'ti? khādanīyassa ca bhojanīyassa ca te paṭiviṃso ṭhapito'ti.

meaning_1: to attend (to); to look after; to inspect
example_1: brāhmaṇagahapatikānam'pi tasmiṃ samaye na phāsu hoti atiyātuṃ vā niyyātuṃ vā bāhirāni vā kamm'antāni paṭivekkhituṃ.
ty'āssa dhammā viditā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti. so evaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ kira'me dhammā ahutvā sambhonti, hutvā paṭiventī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) ahutvā sambhontī'ti iminā udayaṃ passati. hutvā paṭiventī'ti iminā vayaṃ passati.

example_1: ārocayāmi vo, bhikkhave, paṭivedayāmi vo, bhikkhave, mā vo sāmaññ'atthikānaṃ sataṃ sāmaññ'attho parihāyi sati uttariṃ karaṇīye
commentary: (MNa) paṭivedayāmī'ti jānāpemi.

example_1: tena hi tumhe āyasmanto muhuttaṃ idh'eva tāva hotha, yāv'āhaṃ bhagavantaṃ paṭivedemī'ti.
example_2: sampannaṃ sālikedāraṃ, suvā bhuñjanti kosiya, paṭivedemi te brahme, na ne vāretum'ussahe.
commentary: (VINa) bhagavantaṃ paṭivedemī'ti bhagavantaṃ jānāpemi.

meaning_2: having made known, having reformed, having announced

example_1: atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo ten'ev'antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsakasatāni paṭivedesi. ten'ev'antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsikāsatāni paṭivedesi. ten'ev'antaravassena tisso vijjā sacchākāsi. ten'ev'antaravassena parinibbāyi.

evaṃ, devā'ti kho dīgho kārāyano rañño pasenadissa kosalassa paṭissutvā bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni yojāpetvā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa paṭivedesi, yuttāni kho te, deva, bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni. yassa'dāni kālaṃ maññasī'ti.
evam'evaṃ kho pahārāda imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā na āyataken'eva aññāpaṭivedho
example_2: iti kho, bhikkhave, yāvatā saññāsamāpatti tāvatā aññāpaṭivedho
commentary: (DNa) paṭivedho'ti abhisamayo… avabodho.
(ANa) paññāpabhāvitaṃ attano ariyaphal'āvahaṃ paṭivedhañāṇaṃ

meaning_1: will destroy; will put an end (to); will terminate
example_1: iti purāṇañ'ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāma navañ'ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāma yātrā ca no bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsu vihāro cā'ti

meaning_1: we will destroy; we will put an end (to); we will terminate
example_1: iti purāṇañ'ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāma navañ'ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāma yātrā ca no bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsu vihāro cā'ti
commentary: (MNt) purāṇañ'ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmī'ti purāṇaṃ abhuttapaccayā uppajjanakavedanaṃ paṭihanissāmi.

grammar: fut 1st sg of paṭihaṅkhati, irreg form of paṭihanissati

grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of paṭhama
meaning_1: first; firstly; at first; first of all
meaning_2: at first, for the first time
construction:
pa + tama > ṭhama + aṃ
paṭhama + aṃ
example_1: attānam'eva paṭhamaṃ, patirūpe nivesaye, ath'aññam'anusāseyya, na kilisseyya paṇḍito.
example_2: āgantukassa dānaṃ deti, gamikassa dānaṃ deti, gilānassa dānaṃ deti, dubbhikkhe dānaṃ deti, yāni tāni navasassāni navaphalāni tāni paṭhamaṃ sīlavantesu patiṭṭhāpeti.

grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of paṭhama
construction:
pa + tama > ṭhama + aṃ
paṭhama + aṃ
example_1: sace te, bhaggava, agaru viharemu āvesane ekarattan'ti. na kho me, bhante, garu. atthi c'ettha pabbajito paṭhamaṃ vās'ūpagato. sace so anujānāti, viharatha, bhante, yathāsukhan'ti.
example_2: etāni pañca kammāni, chand'āharaṇ'ādīni pātimokkh'uddesato paṭhamaṃ kattabbatā, uposathassa uposathakammassa pubbakiccan'ti vuccati.

meaning_lit: first discourse on a certain monk

example_1: uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto terasa saṅgh'ādisesā dhammā nava paṭham'āpattikā, cattāro yāvatatiyakā.
commentary: (VINa) ettha paṭhamaṃ āpatti etesan'ti paṭhamāpattikā, paṭhamaṃ vītikkamakkhaṇe'y'eva āpajjitabbā'ti attho.

meaning_lit: first discourse on not completely understanding
first discourse on without a son

meaning_1: produced by the first (stage of meditation)
meaning_2: reborn from the first (stage of meditation)
example_1: sant'ānanda, sattā nānattakāyā ekattasaññino, seyyathā'pi devā brahmakāyikā paṭham'ābhinibbattā. ayaṃ dutiyā viññāṇaṭṭhiti.
commentary: (DNa) paṭhamābhinibbattā'ti te sabbe'pi paṭhamena jhānena abhinibbattā. tesu brahmapārisajjā pana parittena abhinibbattā, tesaṃ kappassa tatiyo bhāgo āyuppamāṇaṃ. brahmapurohitā majjhimena, tesaṃ upaḍḍhakappo āyuppamāṇaṃ, kāyo ca tesaṃ vipphārikataro hoti. mahābrahmāno paṇītena, tesaṃ kappo āyuppamāṇaṃ, kāyo pana tesaṃ ativipphāriko hoti. iti te kāyassa nānattā, paṭhamajjhānavasena saññāya ekattā nānattakāyā ekattasaññino'ti veditabbā.

example_1: ayam'assa paṭham'ābhinibbhidā hoti kukkuṭacchāpakass'eva aṇḍakosamhā.
commentary: (MNa) paṭham'ābhinibbhidā'ti paṭhamo ñāṇabhedo. dutiy'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: in the first period after full awakening
example_1: atha kho bhagavā tassa aḍḍhamāsassa accayena paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi, yena sv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, vihārena paṭham'ābhisambuddho viharāmi, tassa padesena vihāsiṃ.
commentary: (SNa) paṭham'ābhisambuddho'ti abhisambuddho hutvā paṭhamaṃ'y'eva ek'ūnapaññāsadivas'abbhantare.

example_1: sarasi tvaṃ, mahārāja, paṭham'ābhisitto evarūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā, dinnaññ'eva samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ tiṇakaṭṭh'odakaṃ paribhuñjantū'ti.
commentary: (VINa) paṭham'ābhisitto'ti abhisitto hutvā paṭhamaṃ.

meaning_lit: first discourse on the person of no integrity
first discourse on the quest for gratification
first discourse on the abandoning of ignorance

example_1: ālapanatthā dhike liṅg'atth'ābhidhānamatte ca paṭhamāvibhatti hoti.

meaning_1: youth; in the prime of life (up to age thirty-three)
meaning_lit: in the first stage of decay
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu daharo hoti yuvā susu kāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo samayo padhānāya.
aciraṃ vat'ayaṃ kāyo, paṭhaviṃ adhisessati, chuḍḍho apetaviññāṇo, niratthaṃ'va kaliṅgaraṃ.
example_2: yo pana bhikkhu paṭhaviṃ khaṇeyya vā khaṇāpeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
synonym: ku, chamā, bhū, bhūma, bhūmi, bhūri

example_1: yaṃ kiñci, rāhula, ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ… yaṃ vā pan'aññam'pia kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā paṭhavīdhātu

meaning_2: sap or essence of the earth

example_1: seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto sevālapaṇakapariyonaddho. tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ na jāneyya na passeyya.

meaning_1: due to bending; caused by bending

example_1: tadā paṇamya sirasā, katvā ca naṃ padakkhiṇaṃ, gantvā disvā narapatiṃ, idaṃ vacanam'abraviṃ.
example_2: vicittasaṅkhāraparikkhitaṃ imaṃ, ākhyātasaddaṃ vipulaṃ asesato, paṇamya sambuddham'anantagocaraṃ, sugocaraṃ yaṃ vadato suṇātha me.

meaning_2: having bowed down, having adored, having worshipped

example_1: idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato khamo hoti sattippahārānaṃ asippahārānaṃ usuppahārānaṃ pharasuppahārānaṃ bheri-paṇava-saṅkha-tiṇava-ninnāda-saddānaṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo khantā hoti.
example_2: saṅkho ca paṇavo ca saṅkhapaṇavaṃ, gītañ'ca vāditañ'ca gītavāditaṃ, daddari ca ḍiṇḍimo ca daddariḍiṇḍimaṃ. evaṃ tūriy'aṅg'atthe.
commentary: (ANa) paṇavenā'ti vajjhabheriyā.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, mahārāja, puriso addhānamaggappaṭipanno. so suṇeyya bherisaddam'pi mudiṅgasaddam'pi saṅkhasaddaṃ'pi paṇavasaddaṃ'pi dendimasaddaṃ'pi.
katena tassa etassa, paṇāmena visesato. ratanattaye visesena, visesassādarena me.
handa, kahaṃ pana tumhe āyasmanto gacchathā'ti? bhagavatā kho, āvuso, bhikkhusaṅgho paṇāmito'ti. tena'h'āyasmanto muhuttaṃ nisīdatha, app'eva nāma mayaṃ sakkuṇeyyāma bhagavantaṃ pasādetun'ti.
gacchatha, bhikkhave, paṇāmemi vo, na vo mama santike vatthabban'ti.
commentary: (MNa) paṇāmemī'ti nīharāmi.

meaning_2: having dismissed, having ejected, having shut
example_1: atha kho bhagavā kismiñci'd'eva pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇāmetvā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya kapilavatthuṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi
example_2: niddaṃ tandiṃ vijambhitaṃ, aratiṃ bhattasammadaṃ, vīriyena naṃ paṇāmetvā, ariyamaggo visujjhatī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) naṃ paṇāmetvā'ti etaṃ kilesajātaṃ nīharitvā.

meaning_1: (of hands) having stretched out (in reverential salutation)
example_1: evaṃ vutte, brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāy'āsanā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten'añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udāneti
example_2: atha kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā, nikkhante paṭhame yāme, uṭṭhāy'āsanā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten'añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

example_1: atha kho so bhikkhu vihāraṃ pavisissāmī'ti kavāṭaṃ paṇāmento addasa sabbaṃ vihāraṃ ahinā puṇṇaṃ, vātapānehi bhoge nikkhante, disvāna bhīto vissaram'akāsi.
iti me cakkhu siyā anāgatam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ paṇidahati, cetaso paṇidhānapaccayā tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto anāgataṃ paṭikaṅkhati.
synonym: adhiṭṭhahati, adhiṭṭheti, adhimuccati, abhinīharati, niyāmeti, sañcintayati, saṃcintayati
commentary: (MNa) paṇidahatī'ti patthanāvasena ṭhapesi.

meaning_1: makes a wish; hopes for; prays for
example_1: so tassa kāyaduccaritassa paṭicchādanahetu pāpikaṃ icchaṃ paṇidahati. mā maṃ jaññū'ti icchati, mā maṃ jaññū'ti saṅkappati, mā maṃ jaññū'ti vācaṃ bhāsati, mā maṃ jaññū'ti kāyena parakkamati.
commentary: (NIDD1a) pāpikaṃ icchaṃ paṇidahatī'ti lāmakaṃ patthanaṃ patiṭṭhāpeti.

example_1: tassa kismiñci'd'eva pasādanīye nimitte cittaṃ paṇidahato pāmojjaṃ jāyati

meaning_2: aspired to, longed for, put forth, directed
example_1: yassa khv'āhaṃ atthāya cittaṃ paṇidahiṃ so me attho abhinipphanno

meaning_2: aspired to, longed for, put forth, directed

meaning_1: should be guided; can be directed; should be determined; can be intended; can be aimed
example_1: ten'ānanda, bhikkhunā kismiñci'd'eva pasādanīye nimitte cittaṃ paṇidahitabbaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) kismiñci'd'eva pasādanīye nimitte cittaṃ paṇidahitabban'ti evaṃ kilesapariḷāhe ca līnatte ca bahiddhāvikkhepe ca uppanne kiles'ānurañjitena na vattitabbaṃ, kismiñci'd'eva pasādanīye pasād'āvahe buddh'ādīsu aññatarasmiṃ ṭhāne kammaṭṭhānacittaṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ.

meaning_2: having aspired to, having longed for, having put forth, having directed

example_1: iti me cakkhu siyā anāgatam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ paṇidahati, cetaso paṇidhānapaccayā tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto anāgataṃ paṭikaṅkhati.
commentary: (MNa) paṇidhānapaccayā'ti patthanāṭṭhapanakāraṇā.

meaning_1: due to making an aspiration; based on intention (for the future)
example_1: iti me cakkhu siyā anāgatam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ paṇidahati, cetaso paṇidhānapaccayā tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto anāgataṃ paṭikaṅkhati.
commentary: (MNa) paṇidhānapaccayā'ti patthanāṭṭhapanakāraṇā.

example_1: evaṃ kho, ānanda, paṇidhāya bhāvanā hoti
example_2: tato paṭinivattitvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
commentary: (SNa) paṇidhāyā'ti ṭhapetvā.

example_1: yo sugatesu manaṃ padosaye, sataṃ sahassānaṃ nirabbudānaṃ, chattiṃsatī pañca ca abbudāni, yam'ariyagarahī nirayaṃ upeti, vācaṃ manañ'ca paṇidhāya pāpakan'ti.

meaning_1: aimed (at); with the intention (towards); with an aspiration (for)
example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhu, amanussaggāho? idha, bhikkhu, ekacco aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati, imin'āhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi dev'aññataro vā'ti.
example_2: yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati, imin'āhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi dev'aññataro vā'ti, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.
commentary: (MNa) paṇidhāyā'ti patthayitvā.

example_1: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghamm'ābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito ek'āyanena maggena tam'eva aṅgārakāsuṃ paṇidhāya.
commentary: (MNa) paṇidhāyā'ti aṅgārakāsuyaṃ patthanā nāma n'atthi, aṅgārakāsuṃ ārabbha pana iriyāpathassa ṭhapitattā evaṃ vuttaṃ.

example_1: n'eva pubbenivāsāya, na'pi dibbassa cakkhuno, cetopariyāya iddhiyā, cutiyā upapattiyā, sotadhātuvisuddhiyā, paṇidhī me na vijjati.
commentary: (THa) paṇidhī me na vijjatī'ti imesaṃ abhiññāvisesānaṃ atthāya parikammavasena cittassa paṇidhi citt'ābhinīhāro me n'atthi n'āhosī'ti attho. sabbaññuguṇā viya hi buddhānaṃ aggamagg'ādhigamen'eva sāvakānaṃ sabbe sāvakaguṇā hatthagatā honti, na tesaṃ adhigamāya visuṃ parikammakaraṇakiccaṃ atthī'ti.

meaning_1: (comm) fulfilling one's obligation upon the fulfilment of a wish
example_1: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, santikammaṃ paṇidhikammaṃ bhūtakammaṃ bhūrikammaṃ vassakammaṃ vossakammaṃ vatthukammaṃ vatthuparikammaṃ ācamanaṃ nhāpanaṃ juhanaṃ
commentary: (DNa) santikamman'ti devaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā sace me idaṃ nāma samijjhissati, tumhākaṃ iminā ca iminā ca upahāraṃ karissāmī'ti samiddhikāle kattabbaṃ santipaṭissavakammaṃ. tasmiṃ pana samiddhe tassa karaṇaṃ paṇidhikammaṃ nāma

meaning_1: sets (one's heart); directs (one's mind); forms (an intention)
example_1: tāvatiṃsā ca yāmā ca, tusitā c'āpi devatā, nimmānaratino devā, ye devā vasavattino, tattha cittaṃ paṇidhehi, ratiṃ paccanubhossasī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) paṇidhehī'ti patthanāvasena ṭhapehi.

meaning_1: deep bow; prostration; falling at the feet; humble submission
commentary: (ITIa) paṇipāto nāma ajja ādiṃ katvā ahaṃ abhivādana-paccuṭṭhāna-añjalikamma-sāmīcikammaṃ buddh'ādīnaṃ eva tiṇṇaṃ vatthūnaṃ karomi iti maṃ dhāretū'ti evaṃ buddh'ādīsu paramanipaccakāro. imesañ'hi catunnaṃ ākārānaṃ aññataraṃ karontena gahitaṃ eva hoti saraṇagamanaṃ.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhante, puriso uday'atthiko assapaṇiyaṃ poseyya. so udayañ'c'eva n'ādhigaccheyya, uttariñ'ca kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assa. evam'evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, uday'atthiko bāle nigaṇṭhe payirupāsiṃ.
commentary: (ANa) assapaṇiyaṃ poseyyā'ti pañca assapotasatāni kiṇitvā pacchā vikkiṇissāmī'ti poseyya.

meaning_1: goods; wares; item to be sold
example_1: tena hi, bho, yān'amhākaṃ satthe appasārāni paṇiyāni, tāni chaḍḍetvā, yāni imasmiṃ satthe mahāsārāni paṇiyāni, tāni ādiyathā'ti.
commentary: (DNa) appasārānī'ti app'agghāni. paṇiyānī'ti bhaṇḍāni.

meaning_2: aspired to, longed for, put forth, directed, bent on, intent
example_1: yathā yathā vā pan'assa kāyo paṇihito hoti tathā tathā naṃ pajānāti
example_2: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu imam'eva kāyaṃ yathāṭhitaṃ yathāpaṇihitaṃ dhātuso paccavekkhati atthi imasmiṃ kāye pathavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātū'ti

meaning_2: desire to which one is disposed
example_1: yathā imassa bhoto manosaṅkhārā paṇihitā. tathā imassa cittassa anantarā imaṃ nāma vitakkaṃ vitakkessatī'ti.
commentary: (DNa) manosaṅkhārā paṇihitā'ti cittasaṅkhārā suṭṭhapitā.

example_1: atha kho brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi, kālo, bho gotama, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan'ti.
example_2: yam'pi no saddhā gahapatikā divā vikāle paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā denti, tatra'p'ime mukh'āvaraṇaṃ maññe karontī'ti.

example_1: yaṃ kiñci vittaṃ idha vā huraṃ vā, saggesu vā yaṃ ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, na no samaṃ atthi tathāgatena, idam'pi buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
example_2: so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ taṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ'y'eva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati. so hoti samādhi santo paṇīto paṭippassaddhiladdho ekodibhāv'ādhigato na sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato.

meaning_1: leading to the superior; going to the sublime
example_1: paṇītañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi paṇītagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.
commentary: (SNa) uttam'aṭṭhena paṇītaṃ.

meaning_2: due to the refined meditation state

meaning_1: more sublime; more refined; more delicious (than)
example_1: etadānuttariyaṃ, ānanda, ñāṇānaṃ yadidaṃ tattha tattha yathābhūtañāṇaṃ. etasmā c'āhaṃ, ānanda, ñāṇā aññaṃ ñāṇaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā n'atthī'ti vadāmi
example_2: imesaṃ kho, potaliya, catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ katamo te puggalo khamati abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā'ti?

meaning_1: more excellent fruit of the spiritual life
meaning_2: more excellent fruit of the spiritual life

meaning_1: giving fine things; who donates superior gifts; (comm) giving delicious flavoured food
example_1: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ paṇītadāyakānaṃ yadidaṃ mahānāmo sakko.
example_2: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ paṇītadāyikānaṃ yadidaṃ suppavāsā koliyadhītā.
commentary: (ANa) paṇītadāyakānan'ti paṇītarasadāyakānaṃ mahānāmo sakko aggo'ti dasseti.

example_1: aparā'pi tisso dhātuyo, hīnadhātu, majjhimadhātu, paṇītadhātu.
commentary: (DNa) hīn'ādīsu hīnā dhātū'ti dvādasa akusalacittuppādā. avasesā tebhūmakadhammā majjhimadhātu. nava lok'uttaradhammā paṇītadhātu.

meaning_1: more and more refined; more and more sublime
example_1: evaṃvādiṃ kho, bhikkhave, satthāraṃ arahati sāvako upasaṅkamituṃ dhammassavanāya. tassa satthā dhammaṃ deseti uttar'uttariṃ paṇītapaṇītaṃ kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) uttar'uttariṃ paṇītapaṇītan'ti uttar'uttariṃ c'eva paṇītatarañ'ca katvā deseti.

meaning_1: fine food; superior food; luxury food
example_1: yāni kho pana tāni paṇītabhojanāni, seyyath'idaṃ, sappi, navanītaṃ, telaṃ, madhu, phāṇitaṃ, maccho, maṃsaṃ, khīraṃ, dadhi. yo pana bhikkhu evarūpāni paṇītabhojanāni agilāno attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
example_2: agilāno nāma yassa vinā paṇītabhojanāni phāsu hoti.
commentary: (VINa) paṇītabhojanānī'ti uttamabhojanāni.

meaning_1: this is sublime; this is refined
example_1: avijjāya tv'eva tamokāyassa asesavirāganirodho, santam'etaṃ padaṃ paṇītam'etaṃ padaṃ, yadidaṃ, sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.

meaning_1: considered more delicious; thought to be tastier
example_1: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, ahu'd'eva aññathattaṃ ahu'd'eva domanassaṃ, yam'pi no imesaṃ dvinnaṃ bhattānaṃ paṇītasaṅkhātataraṃ tassa'pi no bhagavā pahānam'āha, tassa'pi no sugato paṭinissaggam'āhā'ti.

meaning_1: refined disposition; superior inclination; good tendency
example_1: adhimutti ajjhāsayadhātu. sā duvidhā hīn'ādhimutti paṇīt'ādhimuttī'ti. yāya hīn'ādhimuttikā sattā hīn'ādhimuttike'y'eva sevanti, paṇītādhimuttikā ca paṇīt'ādhimuttike'y'eva.
commentary: (VMVt) yāya dussīl'ādike hīn'ādhimuttike sevanti, sā hīn'ādhimutti. yāya paṇīt'ādhimuttike sevanti, sā paṇīt'ādhimutti. taṃ duvidham'pi adhimuttiṃ bhagavā sabb'ākārato jānāti.

meaning_1: aiming for the finest; resolved on the sublime; (comm) intent on Nibbāna

meaning_1: being driven out; being expelled; being rejected; being pushed away; being forced away
example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, ānanda, kaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno arahati sāvako satthāraṃ anubandhituṃ api paṇujjamāno'ti ?
commentary: (MNa) api panujjamānenā'pī'ti api nikkaḍḍhīyamānen'āpi. evarūpo hi puggalo sace'pi dārukalāpasataṃ vā udakaghaṭasataṃ vā vālikambaṇasataṃ vā daṇḍaṃ āharāpeti, mā idha vasī'ti nikkaḍḍhāpeti vā, taṃ taṃ khamāpetvā yāvajīvaṃ vatthabbam'evā'ti.

meaning_1: eliminated individual (interpretations of the) truth; removed personal (versions of the) truth
example_1: dasa ariyavāsā. idh'āvuso, bhikkhu pañc'aṅgavippahīno hoti, chaḷaṅgasamannāgato, ek'ārakkho, catur'āpasseno, paṇunnapaccekasacco, samavayasaṭṭh'esano, anāvilasaṅkappo, passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro, suvimuttacitto, suvimuttapañño.

meaning_1: (of fine or punishment) imposes; inflicts; exacts

example_2: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā rañño dasseyyuṃ, ayaṃ te, deva, coro āgucārī, imassa yaṃ icchasi taṃ daṇḍaṃ paṇehī'ti

meaning_2: having counted, having reckoned, having decreed (a fine or punishment)

example_1: yo'pi so, bhikkhave, satthā āmisagaru āmisadāy'ādo āmisehi saṃsaṭṭho viharati tassa pāyaṃ evarūpī paṇ'opaṇaviyā na upeti, evañ'ca no assa atha naṃ kareyyāma, na ca no evam'assa na naṃ kareyyāmā'ti, kiṃ pana, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgato sabbaso āmisehi visaṃsaṭṭho viharati.
commentary: (MNa) paṇ'opaṇaviyā'ti paṇaviyā ca opaṇaviyā ca. na upetī'ti na hoti. kayavikkayakāle viya agghavaḍḍhanahāpanaṃ na hotī'ti attho. ayaṃ goṇo kiṃ agghati, vīsati agghatī'ti bhaṇanto paṇati nāma. na vīsati agghati, dasa agghatī'ti bhaṇanto opaṇati nāma. idaṃ paṭisedhento āha paṇ'opaṇaviyā na upetī'ti. idāni taṃ paṇ'opaṇaviyaṃ dassetuṃ evañ'ca no assa, atha naṃ kareyyāma, na ca no evam'assa, na naṃ kareyyāmā'ti āha. (MNt) paṇena vohārena byākaraṇaṃ paṇaviyā, paṇaviyā abhāvena opaṇaviyā

example_1: vajjanīyā ca puggalā tasmiṃ na honti kiṃ? gahaṭṭhapaṇḍaka'ādayo ekavīsati vajjanīyā puggalā hatthapāsato bahikaraṇavasena vajjetabbā. te asmiṃ na honti.
example_2: yakkhiyā vā petiyā vā paṇḍakena vā tiracchānagatāya vā manussaviggah'itthiyā vā saddhiṃ raho paṭicchanne āsane nisajjaṃ kappeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. amātugāme mātugāmasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
commentary: (VINa) paṇḍako bhikkhave'ti ettha āsittapaṇḍako usūyapaṇḍako opakkamikapaṇḍako pakkhapaṇḍako napuṃsakapaṇḍako'ti pañca paṇḍakā. tattha yassa paresaṃ aṅgajātaṃ mukhena gahetvā asucinā āsittassa pariḷāho vūpasammati, ayaṃ āsittapaṇḍako. yassa paresaṃ ajjhācāraṃ passato usūyāya uppannāya pariḷāho vūpasammati, ayaṃ usūyapaṇḍako. yassa upakkamena bījāni apanītāni, ayaṃ opakkamikapaṇḍako. ekacco pana akusalavipāk'ānubhāvena kāḷapakkhe paṇḍako hoti, juṇhapakkhe pan'assa pariḷāho vūpasammati, ayaṃ pakkhapaṇḍako. yo pana paṭisandhiyaṃ'y'eva abhāvako uppanno, ayaṃ napuṃsakapaṇḍako'ti. tesu āsittapaṇḍakassa ca usūyapaṇḍakassa ca pabbajjā na vāritā, itaresaṃ tiṇṇaṃ vāritā. tesu'pi pakkhapaṇḍakassa yasmiṃ pakkhe paṇḍako hoti, tasmiṃ'y'evassa pakkhe pabbajjā vāritā'ti kurundiyaṃ vuttaṃ. yassa c'ettha pabbajjā vāritā, taṃ sandhāya idaṃ vuttaṃ, anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo upasampanno nāsetabbo'ti. so'pi liṅganāsanen'eva nāsetabbo. ito paraṃ nāsetabbo'ti vuttesu'pi es'eva nayo.

example_1: katamehi pañcahi? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vesiyāgocaro vā hoti, vidhavāgocaro vā hoti, thullakumārikāgocaro vā hoti, paṇḍakagocaro vā hoti, bhikkhunīgocaro vā hoti.

meaning_1: perceiving as asexual; regarding as neuter

commentary: (SNPa) paṇḍarānī'ti āyatanāni

meaning_1: name of a type of elephant

commentary: (APt) paṇḍaravaṇṇatāya paṇḍaro.

meaning_1: name of a mountain near Rājagaha
example_1: piṇḍacāraṃ caritvāna, nikkhamma nagarā muni, paṇḍavaṃ abhihāresi, ettha vāso bhavissati.
commentary: (SNPa) paṇḍavaṃ abhihāresī'ti taṃ pabbataṃ abhiruhi.

meaning_1: wise; intelligent; astute; learned; knowledgeable; skilled
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gāvī pabbateyyā paṇḍitā byattā khettaññū kusalā visame pabbate carituṃ.
example_2: dvīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ'ca puññaṃ pasavati.
synonym: ñāṇī, dhīra, nipaka, nipuṇa, pañña, paññavant, paññāṇavant, paññāvant, matimant, matīmant, mutimant, mutīmant, viññujātika, viññū, sapañña, sappañña
commentary: (SNa) paṇḍito'ti paṇḍiccena samannāgato.

meaning_1: sage; intelligent person; wise man; smart person
example_1: selo yathā ekaghano, vātena na samīrati, evaṃ nindāpasaṃsāsu, na samiñjanti paṇḍitā.
example_2: yaṃ taṃ apucchimha akittayī no, aññaṃ taṃ pucchāma tadiṅgha brūhi, ettāvat'aggaṃ nu vadanti h'eke, yakkhassa suddhiṃ idha paṇḍitāse, udāhu aññam'pi vadanti etto.
commentary: (MNa) bāle ca paṇḍite cā'ti bālā ca paṇḍitā ca.

meaning_1: wiser; more intelligent; more astute; cleverer (than)

meaning_1: sign of a wise person; indication of an intelligent person

meaning_1: prescribed by the wise; recommended by the intelligent
example_1: katamāni tīṇi? dānaṃ, bhikkhave, paṇḍitapaññattaṃ sappurisapaññattaṃ. pabbajjā, bhikkhave, paṇḍitapaññattā sappurisapaññattā.

meaning_1: characteristics of a wise person and a fool

meaning_1: level of the wise person; realm of the intelligent person
example_1: atha kho ayam'eva tato mahantataro kaṭaggaho yaṃ so paṇḍito kāyena sucaritaṃ caritvā, vācāya sucaritaṃ caritvā, manasā sucaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, kevalā paripūrā paṇḍitabhūmī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) kevalā paripūrā paṇḍitabhūmī'ti paṇḍito tīṇi sucaritāni pūretvā sagge nibbattati, tato manussalokaṃ āgacchanto kularūpabhogasampattiyaṃ nibbattati, tattha ṭhito tīṇi ca sucaritāni pūretvā puna sagge nibbattatī'ti ayaṃ sakalā paripuṇṇā paṇḍitabhūmi.

example_1: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, paṇḍitassa paṇḍitalakkhaṇāni paṇḍitanimittāni paṇḍit'āpadānāni. katamāni tīṇi?

meaning_1: characteristic of a wise person; manifestation of an intelligent person

example_1: āgantukassa dānaṃ deti, gamikassa dānaṃ deti, gilānassa dānaṃ deti, dubbhikkhe dānaṃ deti, yāni tāni navasassāni navaphalāni tāni paṭhamaṃ sīlavantesu patiṭṭhāpeti.

meaning_2: causes to establish, causes to set up, causes to install

meaning_1: (of an arrow) aims (at); sets one's sights on; shoots (into)

meaning_1: wanting to establish (in); wanting to convert (to)

meaning_1: to establish (in); to instil (in); to convert (to)

meaning_1: (in debate) having made someone state their position

atha kho āyasmā sāriputto dhanañ'jāniṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sati uttarikaraṇīye hīne brahmaloke patiṭṭhāpetvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkāmi. atha kho dhanañ'jāni brāhmaṇo acirapakkante āyasmante sāriputte kālam'akāsi, brahmalokañca upapajji.

meaning_1: (in debate) made someone assert their position
example_1: itiha bhagavā dīghatapassiṃ nigaṇṭhaṃ imasmiṃ kathāvatthusmiṃ yāvatatiyakaṃ patiṭṭhāpesi.

example_1: evaṃ, devā'ti kho, ānanda, kappako rañño maghadevassa paṭissutvā tāni palitāni sādhukaṃ saṇḍāsena uddharitvā rañño maghadevassa añjalismiṃ patiṭṭhāpesi.

meaning_2: having established, having stood firmly, having found a support

example_2: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu app'ābādho hoti app'ātaṅko, samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato n'ātisītāya n'āccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo samayo padhānāya.
commentary: (ANa) padhānakkhamo'ti vīriyakkhamo.

meaning_1: wanting to make an effort; wishing to strive; intent on exertion
example_1: alaṃ vat'idaṃ kulaputtassa padhān'atthikassa padhānāyā'ti. so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, tatth'eva nisīdiṃ alam'idaṃ padhānāyā'ti.
example_2: disvāna me etadahosi, pāsādikaṃ vat'idaṃ ambavanaṃ manuññaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ. alaṃ vat'idaṃ kulaputtassa padhān'atthikassa padhānāya. sace maṃ bhagavā anujāneyya, āgaccheyyāhaṃ imaṃ ambavanaṃ padhānāyā'ti.
commentary: (UDa) padhānatthikassā'ti yogena bhāvanāya atthikassa.

meaning_1: striving resolutely; making a determined effort
example_1: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, etadahosi, bahukārā kho me pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū, ye maṃ padhānapahit'attaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃsu. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ pañcavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyan'ti.
commentary: (MNa) padhānapahit'attaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃsū'ti padhān'atthāya pesit'attabhāvaṃ vasanaṭṭhāne pariveṇasammajjanena pattacīvaraṃ gahetvā anubandhanena mukh'odaka-dantakaṭṭha-dān'ādinā ca upaṭṭhahiṃsu.

meaning_1: devotes oneself to striving; commits oneself to making an effort
meaning_2: devotes oneself to striving; commits oneself to making an effort
example_1: katapuñño'si tvaṃ, ānanda, padhānam'anuyuñja, khippaṃ hohisi anāsavo'ti.
commentary: (DNt) padhānam'anuyuñjā'ti vīriyam'anuyuñjāhi, arahattasamāpattiyā anuyogaṃ karohī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappam'anvāya padhānam'anvāya anuyogam'anvāya appamādam'anvāya sammāmanasikāram'anvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati, yathāsamāhite citte anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
ime vuccanti padhānasaṅkhārā'ti. iti ayañ'ca chando, ayañ'ca chandasamādhi, ime ca padhānasaṅkhārā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, chandasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgato iddhipādo.
commentary: (SNa) padhānasaṅkhārā'ti padhānabhūtā saṅkhārā, catukiccasādhaka-sammappadhāna-vīriyass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

example_1: pasayha māraṃ abhibhuyya antakaṃ, yo ca phusī jātikkhayaṃ padhānavā, so tādiso lokavidū sumedho, sabbesu dhammesu atam'mayo munī'ti.
example_2: virato idha sabbapāpakehi, nirayadukkhaṃ aticca vīriyavā so, so vīriyavā padhānavā, dhīro tādi pavuccate tathattā.

meaning_1: strayed from the task; abandoned effort; given up striving
example_1: yato kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ odanakummāsaṃ, atha me te pañca bhikkhū nibbijja pakkamiṃsu, bāhulliko samaṇo gotamo, padhānavibbhanto, āvatto bāhullāyā'ti.
example_2: disvāna aññam'aññaṃ saṇṭhapesuṃ, ayaṃ kho, āvuso, samaṇo gotamo āgacchati bāhulliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya. so n'eva abhivādetabbo, na paccuṭṭhātabbo, n'āssa pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ.
commentary: (VINa) padhānavibbhanto'ti padhānato vibbhanto bhaṭṭho parihīno. (MNa) padhānavibbhanto'ti padhānato vibbhanto bhaṭṭho parihīno.

meaning_1: difference in effort; distinction in exertion
example_1: te c'assu imehi pañcahi padhāniy'aṅgehi samannāgatā, ettha pana nesaṃ, bhante, siyā viseso siyā nānākaraṇan'ti? ettha kho n'es'āhaṃ, mahārāja, padhānavemattataṃ vadāmi.
commentary: (MNa) padhānavemattatan'ti padhānanānattaṃ. aññādisam'eva hi puthujjanassa padhānaṃ, aññādisaṃ sotāpannassa, aññādisaṃ sakadāgāmino, aññādisaṃ anāgāmino, aññādisaṃ arahato, aññādisaṃ asītimahāsāvakānaṃ, aññādisaṃ dvinnaṃ aggasāvakānaṃ, aññādisaṃ paccekabuddhānaṃ, aññādisaṃ sabbaññubuddhānaṃ. puthujjanassa padhānaṃ sotāpannassa padhānaṃ na pāpuṇāti… paccekabuddhassa padhānaṃ sabbaññubuddhassa padhānaṃ na pāpuṇāti. imam'atthaṃ sandhāya padhānavemattataṃ vadāmī'ti āha. (SNPa) satt'āhaṃ vā padhānam'anuyuñjanti, aḍḍhamāsaṃ, māsaṃ, dvemāsaṃ, temāsaṃ, catumāsaṃ, pañcamāsaṃ, chamāsaṃ, ekavassaṃ dviticatupañcachavassāni vā. ayaṃ padhānavemattatā.

meaning_1: punished by exertion; tortured by striving
example_1: āraddhaṃ kho pana me, aggivessana, vīriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho ten'eva dukkhappadhānena padhān'ābhitunnassa sato.
commentary: (MNa) padhān'ābhitunnassā'ti padhānena abhitunnassa, viddhassa sato'ti attho.

meaning_1: produced by effort; brought into being by exertion; generated by energy
example_1: evam'eva kho, mahārāja, yaṃ taṃ tejaṃ vīriyā nimmathitaṃ padhān'ābhinibbattaṃ, n'āhaṃ tattha kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ vadāmi, yadidaṃ vimuttiyā vimuttin'ti.
kadā nu'haṃ sabbhi samāgamesu, diṭṭho bhave dhammagarūhi tādibhi, yāthāvadassīhi jit'indriyehi, padhāniyo taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
example_2: katame nava dhammā bhāvetabbā? nava pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgāni, sīlavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, cittavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, diṭṭhivisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, kaṅkhāvitaraṇavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, magg'āmaggañāṇadassana, visuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, paṭipadāñāṇadassanavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, ñāṇadassanavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, paññāvisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, vimuttivisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) padhāniy'aṅgānī'ti padhānaṃ vuccati padahanaṃ, padhānam'assa atthī'ti padhāniyo, padhāniyassa bhikkhuno aṅgāni padhāniy'aṅgāni.

meaning_1: factor related to striving; component of effort
example_1: ekam'ekenā'pi, bhante, aṅgena samannāgato so puriso mama santike hatth'ārūḷhaṃ aṅkusagayhaṃ sippaṃ sikkheyya, ko pana vādo pañcah'aṅgehī'ti! evam'eva kho, rājakumāra, pañc'imāni padhāniy'aṅgāni.
commentary: (MNa) padhāniy'aṅgānī'ti padhānaṃ vuccati padahanabhāvo, padhānam'assa atthī'ti padhāniyo. padhāniyassa bhikkhuno aṅgānī'ti padhāniy'aṅgāni.

meaning_lit: discourse on factors related to striving

example_1: yaṃ yaṃ disaṃ padhāvanti, taṃ taṃ dvāraṃ pidhīyati, abhinikkhamit'āsā te, sattā mokkhagavesino.
idaṃ sutvāna nigghosaṃ, bhūridattanivesane, ariṭṭho ca subhogo ca, padhāviṃsu anantarā.
disvā isiṃ paviṭṭhaṃ, ahināgo dummano padhūpāyi, sumanamanaso adhimano, manussanāgo'pi tattha padhūpāyi.
sabbo ādīpito loko, sabbo loko padhūpito, sabbo pajjalito loko, sabbo loko pakampito.
commentary: (SNa) padhūpito'ti santāpito.
(VINa) padhūpento nisīdī'ti pajjhāyanto attānaṃ'y'eva paribhāsanto nisīdi.

meaning_1: moreover; and so; but; or; however
meaning_2: and, yet, but, out the contrary, and now, more over
example_1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahākassapo pāvāya kusināraṃ addhānamaggappaṭippanno hoti mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi
example_2: samaṇā samaṇā'ti vo, bhikkhave, jano sañjānāti. tumhe ca pana, ke tumhe'ti puṭṭhā samānā, samaṇ'āmhā'ti paṭijānātha.

example_1: diṭṭhā hi mayā sucittitā, sombhā dārukapillakāni vā, tantīhi ca khīlakehi ca, vinibaddhā vividhaṃ panaccakā.
commentary: (THIa) vividhaṃ panaccakā'ti yantasutt'ādīnaṃ añchanavissajjan'ādinā paṭṭhapitanaccakā, panaccantā viya diṭṭhā'ti yojanā.

example_1: idaṃ niccaṃ, idaṃ dhuvaṃ, idaṃ sassataṃ, idaṃ kevalaṃ, idaṃ acavanadhammaṃ, idañ'hi na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjati, ito ca pan'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇaṃ n'atthī'ti
example_2: te kho evaṃ jāneyyuṃ, santañ'ca pan'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇaṃ atth'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇan'ti, asantaṃ vā aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇaṃ n'atth'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇan'ti.

meaning_1: or anything else; or any other
example_1: yaṃ kiñci, rāhula, ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ… yaṃ vā pan'aññam'pi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā pathavīdhātu
mūlabījaṃ nāma, haliddi, siṅgiveraṃ, vacā, vacattaṃ, ativisā, kaṭukarohiṇī, usīraṃ, bhaddamūttakaṃ, yāni vā pan'aññāni'pi atthi mūle jāyanti, mūle sañjāyanti, etaṃ mūlabījaṃ nāma.
pure puratthā purimāsu jātisu, cirappanaṭṭhe sucirappavāsino, ñātī suhajje sakhino samānayi, samaṅgikatvā anumoditā ahu.

meaning_2: gone to ruin; perished; destroyed; annihilated

example_1: tena kho pana samayena jambucorakā… labujacorakā… panasacorakā… tālapakkacorakā… ucchucorakā… timbar'ūsakacorakā timbar'ūsake uccinitvā bhaṇḍikaṃ ādāya agamaṃsu. sāmikā te corake anubandhiṃsu.
tena kho pana samayena jambucorakā… labujacorakā… panasacorakā… tālapakkacorakā… ucchucorakā… timbar'ūsakacorakā timbar'ūsake uccinitvā bhaṇḍikaṃ ādāya agamaṃsu. sāmikā te corake anubandhiṃsu.
tena kho pana samayena jambupālakā… labujapālakā… panasapālakā… tālapakkapālakā… ucchupālakā… timbar'ūsakapālakā bhikkhūnaṃ timbar'ūsakaṃ denti.
yāni kho pan'assa honti sāṭheyyāni kūṭeyyāni jimheyyāni vaṅkeyyāni, tāni yathābhūtaṃ āvikattā hoti satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu.
example_2: sace pan'assa pubbe vuttanayen'eva verimhi paṭighaṃ uppajjati, taṃ mettāya vuttanayen'eva vūpasametabbaṃ.

meaning_1: is lost; is destroyed; perishes; is ruined
meaning_2: is lost, disappears, goes to ruin
example_1: te evam'āhaṃsu, manaṃ vata, bho, anassāma, manaṃ vata, bho, panassāma.
example_2: mā vo amataṃ panassa.

meaning_1: was lost; disappeared; went to ruin
meaning_2: was lost, disappeared, went to ruin

example_1: panādo opamañño ca, devasūto ca mātali, cittaseno ca gandhabbo, naḷo rājā jan'esabho.
taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā'ti? aniccaṃ, bhante. yaṃ pan'āniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā'ti? dukkhaṃ, bhante.
example_2: yaṃ pan'āniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ, etaṃ mama, eso'ham'asmi, eso me attā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante

example_1: tatra su'daṃ, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro pitu-aṅke nisinno viceyya viceyya atthe panāyati ñāyena. viceyya viceyya kumāro atthe panāyati ñāyenā'ti kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa kumārassa bhiyyosomattāya vipassī vipassī tv'eva samaññā udapādi.
commentary: (DNa) atthe panāyatī'ti atthe jānāti passati, nayati vā pavattetī'ti attho.

example_1: taṃ kho pan'āyam'āyasmā dhammaṃ sutvā dvayena vūpakāsena sampādeti, kāyavūpakāsena ca cittavūpakāsena ca.

meaning_1: and for the venerable; and of the venerable
example_1: so ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadeyya, atthi pan'āyasmato koci veyyāvaccakaro'ti. cīvar'atthikena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro niddisitabbo ārāmiko vā upāsako vā, eso kho, āvuso, bhikkhūnaṃ veyyāvaccakaro'ti.
example_2: tañ'ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ pare evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, ke pan'āyasmato ākārā, ke anvayā, yen'āyasmā evaṃ vadesi, sammāsambuddho bhagavā, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo, suppaṭipanno saṅgho'ti?

example_1: evaṃ vutte, āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ etadavoca, konāmo āyasmā, kathañ'ca pan'āyasmantaṃ sabrahmacārī jānantī'ti? puṇṇo'ti kho me, āvuso, nāmaṃ, mantāṇiputto'ti ca pana maṃ sabrahmacārī jānantī'ti.
example_2: ko nāmo āyasmā, kathañ'ca pan'āyasmantaṃ sabrahmacārī jānantī'ti?
commentary: (MNa) kathañ'ca pan'āyasmantan'ti idaṃ pana thero sammodamāno āha.

example_1: sampajānamusāvādo kho pan'āyasmanto antarāyiko dhammo vutto bhagavatā, tasmā saramānena bhikkhunā āpannena visuddh'āpekkhena santī āpatti āvikātabbā, āvikatā hi'ssa phāsu hoti.
example_2: ime kho pan'āyasmanto dve aniyatā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.

example_1: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, n'āparaṃ itthattāyā'ti abbhaññāsi. aññataro ca pan'āyasmā soṇo arahataṃ ahosi.
example_2: idaṃ pan'āyasmā, kattha vuttaṃ bhagavatā'ti, iti puṭṭho na sampāyissati.

example_1: kāmaṃ kho pana m'āhu paro loko, hotu nesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ, atha ca pan'āyaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo diṭṭh'eva dhamme viññūnaṃ gārayho
example_2: atha ca pan'āyaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo diṭṭh'eva dhamme viññūnaṃ gārayho, dussīlo purisapuggalo micchādiṭṭhi n'atthikavādo'ti

example_1: lābhī acchādana-vattha-mokkhapāvuraṇānaṃ, bhavati yadi anāgāriyataṃ upeti, sahito purimakataphalaṃ anubhavati, na bhavati katassa panāso'ti.
synonym: kaliggaha, byaya, vaya, vighāta, vināsa, virāga, vyaya
commentary: (DNa) panāso'ti vināso.

meaning_1: and they could be; or they may be
example_1: yassa ca pana me bhāsitassa atthaṃ na ājāneyyātha, ahaṃ vo tattha paṭipucchitabbo, ye vā pan'āssu viyattā bhikkhū.

meaning_1: and friend; and what's more brothers
example_1: neyyaṃ pan'āvuso, dhammaṃ kena pajānātī'ti? neyyaṃ kho, āvuso, dhammaṃ paññācakkhunā pajānātī'ti.
example_2: yasmiṃ pan'āvuso, samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti, katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjh'aṅgānaṃ akālo bhāvanāya, katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjh'aṅgānaṃ kālo bhāvanāyā'ti?

meaning_1: but I; then I; and I
example_1: n'āhaṃ, moggallāna, sabbeh'eva saṃsaggaṃ vaṇṇayāmi na pan'āhaṃ, moggallāna, sabbeh'eva saṃsaggaṃ na vaṇṇayāmi
example_2: aññāya ca pan'āhaṃ samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtikānaṃ dhammaṃ ev'āhaṃ tasmā dhammavinayā apakkanto'ti?

example_1: taṃ kho pan'idaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ pahātabban'ti

meaning_1: and here a certain; but here some
meaning_2: and here a certain; but here some
example_1: samaṇo gotamo pāpito bhavissatī'ti bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, brāhmaṇo, bho gotama, pokkharasāti opamañño subhagavaniko evam'āha, evam'eva pan'idh'ekacce samaṇabrāhmaṇā uttarimanussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesaṃ paṭijānanti.
example_2: sant'etth'ekacce bhikkhū samma'd'eva aññaṃ byākaṃsu, santi pan'idh'ekacce bhikkhū adhimānena'pi aññaṃ byākaṃsu.

meaning_1: and of this; and about this
example_1: kiṃ pan'imassa mattaṭṭhakassa kāyassa taṇh'upādinnassa ahan'ti vā maman'ti vā asmī'ti vā? atha khv'āssa no't'ev'ettha hoti.
evam'eva kho, māgaṇḍiya, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā andhā acakkhukā ajānantā ārogyaṃ, apassantā nibbānaṃ, atha ca pan'imaṃ gāthaṃ bhāsanti
cha kho pan'imāni, āvuso, ajjhattikabāhirāni āyatanāni tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena samma'd'akkhātāni. katamāni cha?
example_2: cuddasa kho pan'imāni yonipamukhasatasahassāni saṭṭhi ca satāni cha ca satāni, pañca ca kammuno satāni pañca ca kammāni tīṇi ca kammāni, kamme ca aḍḍhakamme ca

example_1: yo pana bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya, kiṃ pan'imehi khudd'ānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi, yāva'd'eva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantī'ti, sikkhāpadavivaṇṇake pācittiyaṃ.

meaning_1: dispelling; driving out; rejecting; pushing away
example_1: papañcasaññā itar'ītarā narā, papañcayantā upayanti saññino, manomayaṃ gehasitañ'ca sabbaṃ, panujja nekkhammasitaṃ irīyati.
example_2: yaṃ kiñci sampajānāsi, uddhaṃ adho tiriyañ'cā'pi majjhe, etesu nandiñ'ca nivesanañ'ca, panujja viññāṇaṃ bhave na tiṭṭhe.

meaning_1: being driven away; being expelled; being forced away
example_1: tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā yāvajīvam'pi so puggalo anubandhitabbo, na pakkamitabbaṃ, api panujjamānena'pī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) api panujjamānenā'pī'ti api nikkaḍḍhīyamānen'āpi. evarūpo hi puggalo sace'pi dārukalāpasataṃ vā udakaghaṭasataṃ vā vālikambaṇasataṃ vā daṇḍaṃ āharāpeti, mā idha vasī'ti nikkaḍḍhāpeti vā, taṃ taṃ khamāpetvā yāvajīvaṃ vatthabbam'evā'ti.

meaning_1: driven out; dispelled; sent away; dispatched
example_1: yamhī na māyā vasatī na māno, yo vītalobho amamo nirāso, panuṇṇakodho abhinibbut'atto, so brāhmaṇo so samaṇo sa bhikkhū'ti.

meaning_1: who has removed personal interpretation of the truth; who has dispelled individual understanding of the truth
example_1: panuṇṇapaccekasacco, bhikkhave, bhikkhu samavayasaṭṭh'esano passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro patilīno'ti vuccati. kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu panuṇṇapaccekasacco hoti?
commentary: (ANa) panuṇṇapaccekasacco'ti idam'eva dassanaṃ saccaṃ, idam'eva saccan'ti evaṃ pāṭiekkaṃ gahitattā paccekasaṅkhātāni diṭṭhisaccāni panuṇṇāni nīhaṭāni pahīnāni assā'ti panuṇṇapaccekasacco.

meaning_1: dispels; drives out; rejects; pushes away

example_2: nindāya nappavedheyya, na uṇṇameyya pasaṃsito bhikkhu, lobhaṃ saha macchariyena, kodhaṃ pesuṇiyañ'ca panudeyya.
commentary: (SNa) panudā'ti nīhara

example_1: avivādavaḍḍhanakariṃ sugiraṃ, bhinn'ānusandhijananiṃ abhaṇi, kalahaṃ janassa panudī samaṅgī, sahitehi nandati pamodati ca.
example_2: daddallamānā āgañchuṃ, taṇhā ca aratī ragā, tā tattha panudī satthā, tūlaṃ bhaṭṭhaṃ'va māluto'ti.

meaning_2: having dispelled, having removed, having pushed away

example_1: tass'ovādakarā bahugihī ca pabbajitā ca, asuciṃ garahitaṃ dhunanti pāpaṃ, sa hi sucibhi parivuto bhavati, mala-khila-kali-kilese panudehī'ti.
synonym: paṭivineti, paṭivinodeti, panudati, panūdati, vinodayati, vinodeti

meaning_1: dispels; drives out; rejects; pushes away

example_2: ettāvat'aggam'pi vadanti h'eke, yakkhassa suddhiṃ idha paṇḍitāse, tesaṃ pan'eke samayaṃ vadanti, anupādisese kusalā vadānā.

meaning_1: and here; and in this regard
example_1: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho ghoṭamukho brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ udenaṃ etadavoca, ambho samaṇa, n'atthi dhammiko paribbajo, evaṃ me ettha hoti. tañ'ca kho bhavantarūpānaṃ vā adassanā, yo vā pan'ettha dhammo'ti.
example_2: ayaṃ pan'ettha saṅkhepo, bhagavato kira bhikkhusaṅghassa ca pañcannaṃ mahānadīnaṃ mah'oghasadise lābhasakkāre uppanne hatalābhasakkārā aññatitthiyā sūriy'uggamanakāle khajjopanakā viya nippabhā hutvā ekato sannipatitvā mantayiṃsu.

example_1: sā kho pan'esā, bhikkhave, taṇhā kattha uppajjamānā uppajjati, kattha nivisamānā nivisati? yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etth'esā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.
example_2: sā kho pan'esā, mahānāma, brahmunā sanaṅkumārena gāthā sugītā no duggītā, subhāsitā no dubbhāsitā, atthasaṃhitā no anatthasaṃhitā, anumatā bhagavatā'ti.

bhikkhu pan'eva dubbacajātiko hoti uddesapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoti
example_2: niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kathine bhikkhuno pan'eva akālacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ, paṭiggahetvā khippam'eva kāretabbaṃ

example_2: katī parissayā loke, gacchato agataṃ disaṃ, ye bhikkhu abhisambhave, pantamhi sayan'āsane.

example_2: paññaṃ purakkhatvā kalyāṇapīti, vikkhambhaye tāni parissayāni, aratiṃ sahetha sayanamhi pante, caturo sahetha paridevadhamme.

meaning_1: who lives in a secluded dwelling; who lives in a remote lodging

meaning_1: who lives in a secluded dwelling; who lives in a remote lodging
example_1: yassa kassaci, āvuso, bhikkhuno ime pāpakā akusalā icch'āvacarā appahīnā dissanti c'eva sūyanti ca, kiñ'c'āpi so hoti āraññiko pantasen'āsano piṇḍapātiko sapadānacārī paṃsukūliko lūkhacīvaradharo, atha kho naṃ sabrahmacārī na c'eva sakkaronti na garuṃ karonti na mānenti na pūjenti.

example_1: tañ'ca pana appaṭivānīyaṃ, asecanakam'ojavaṃ, pivanti maññe sappaññā, valāhakam'iva panthagū'ti.

meaning_2: obstacle, impediment, delay, illusion, hindrance to spiritual progress

meaning_1: ending of mental proliferation; cessation of endless conceptualization
example_1: channaṃ, āvuso, phass'āyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā papañcanirodho papañcavūpasamo'ti.

meaning_1: indulging in various opinions; engaged in mental proliferation; devoted to endless conceptualization
commentary: (THa) yo papañcamanuyutto'ti yo pana puggalo kamm'ārāmat'ādi-vasena rūp'ābhisaṅg'ādi-vasena ca pavattiyā papañcan'aṭṭhena taṇh'ādi-bhedaṃ papañcaṃ anuyutto, tattha ca anādīnavadassanena abhirato magasadiso, so nibbānaṃ virādhayi, so nibbānā suvidūravidūre ṭhito.

meaning_1: proliferating; making manifold; forming various opinions (about)

meaning_1: taking pleasure in mental proliferation; addicted to manifold ideas
example_1: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu… saṅgaṇik'ārāmo hoti saṅgaṇikarato saṅgaṇik'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, saṃsagg'ārāmo hoti saṃsaggarato saṃsagg'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, papañc'ārāmo hoti papañcarato papañc'ārāmataṃ anuyutto.

meaning_1: taking pleasure in mental proliferation; addicted to manifold ideas
example_1: sā pan'āvuso, niṭṭhā papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino udāhu nippapañc'ārāmassa nippapañcaratino'ti? sammā byākaramānā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ byākareyyuṃ, nippapañc'ārāmass'āvuso, sā niṭṭhā nippapañcaratino, na sā niṭṭhā papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino'ti.

example_2: mūlaṃ papañcasaṅkhāya, mantā asmī'ti sabbam'uparundhe, yā kāci taṇhā ajjhattaṃ, tāsaṃ vinayā sadā sato sikkhe.
commentary: (SNPa) saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā'ti evaṃ paṭipannass'āpi yā saññā, tan'nidānā taṇhādiṭṭhipapañcā appahīnā eva hontī'ti dasseti. (SNPa) papañcā'ti saṅkhātattā papañcā eva papañcasaṅkhā.

meaning_1: with a proliferation of opinions; full of diverse concepts
example_1: papañcasaññā itar'ītarā narā, papañcayantā upayanti saññino, manomayaṃ gehasitañ'ca sabbaṃ, panujja nekkhammasitaṃ irīyati.
commentary: (SNa) papañcasaññā'ti kilesasaññāya papañcasaññā nāma hutvā.

meaning_1: proliferation of opinions, concepts and constructs; (or) classification of diverse perceptions
example_1: yatonidānaṃ, bhikkhu, purisaṃ papañcasaññāsaṅkhā samudācaranti. ettha ce n'atthi abhinanditabbaṃ abhivaditabbaṃ ajjhositabbaṃ.
example_2: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena bhagavā attano papañcasaññāsaṅkhāpahānaṃ paccavekkhamāno nisinno hoti.
commentary: (DNa) papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno'ti tayo papañcā taṇhāpapañco, mānapapañco, diṭṭhipapañco'ti. tattha aṭṭhasatataṇhāvicaritaṃ taṇhāpapañco nāma. navavidho māno mānapapañco nāma. dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhiyo diṭṭhipapañco nāma.
