meaning_1: born from the proliferation of opinions, concepts and constructs
example_1: vitakko kho, devānam'inda, papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno papañcasaññāsaṅkhāsamudayo papañcasaññāsaṅkhājātiko papañcasaññāsaṅkhāpabhavo, papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya sati vitakko hoti, papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya asati vitakko na hotī'ti.

meaning_1: having the proliferation of opinions, concepts and constructs as origin
example_1: vitakko kho, devānam'inda, papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno papañcasaññāsaṅkhāsamudayo papañcasaññāsaṅkhājātiko papañcasaññāsaṅkhāpabhavo, papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya sati vitakko hoti, papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya asati vitakko na hotī'ti.
commentary: (DNa) papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno'ti tayo papañcā taṇhāpapañco, mānapapañco, diṭṭhipapañco'ti. tattha aṭṭhasatataṇhāvicaritaṃ taṇhāpapañco nāma. navavidho māno mānapapañco nāma. dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhiyo diṭṭhipapañco nāma. tesu idha taṇhāpapañco adhippeto. ken'aṭṭhena papañco? mattapamatt'ākāra-pāpan'aṭṭhena papañco. taṃsampayuttā saññā papañcasaññā. saṅkhā vuccati koṭṭhāso saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā'ti-ādīsu viya. iti papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno'ti papañcasaññākoṭṭhāsanidāno vitakko'ti attho. (DNt) saṅkhā vuccati koṭṭhāso bhāgaso saṅkhāyati upaṭṭhātī'ti. yasmā papañcasaññā taṃtaṃdvāravasena, ārammaṇavasena ca bhāgaso vitakkassa paccayā honti, na kevalā, tasmā papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno vitakko vutto, papañcasaññānaṃ vā anekabhedabhinnattā taṃsamudāyo papañcasaññāsaṅkhā'ti vutto. papañcasaññāsaṅkhāggahaṇena ca anavaseso dukkhasamudayo vutto taṃtaṃ nimittattā vaṭṭadukkhassā'ti.

meaning_1: suitable for leading to the end of the proliferation of opinions, concepts and constructs
sanskrit: prapañca + saṃjñā + saṃkhyā + nirodha + sārūpya + gāmin
family_compound: papañca saññā saṅkhā nirodha sāruppa gāmī
example_1: kathaṃ paṭipanno pana, mārisa, bhikkhu papañcasaññāsaṅkhā-nirodhasāruppagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hotī'ti?
commentary: (DNa) papañcasaññāsaṅkhā-nirodhasāruppagāminin'ti etissā papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya khayā nirodho vūpasamo, tassa sāruppañ'c'eva tattha gāminiṃ cā'ti saha vipassanāya maggaṃ pucchati. (DNa) evaṃ paṭipanno kho, devānam'inda, bhikkhu papañcasaññāsaṅkhā-nirodhasāruppagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hotī'ti bhagavā arahattanikūṭena desanaṃ niṭṭhapesi.

meaning_1: produced by the proliferation of opinions, concepts and constructs
example_1: vitakko kho, devānam'inda, papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno papañcasaññāsaṅkhāsamudayo papañcasaññāsaṅkhājātiko papañcasaññāsaṅkhāpabhavo, papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya sati vitakko hoti, papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya asati vitakko na hotī'ti.

meaning_1: with the proliferation of opinions, concepts and constructs as source
example_1: vitakko kho, devānam'inda, papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno papañcasaññāsaṅkhāsamudayo papañcasaññāsaṅkhājātiko papañcasaññāsaṅkhāpabhavo, papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya sati vitakko hoti, papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya asati vitakko na hotī'ti.

meaning_1: concept of being overwhelmed by a proliferation of opinions, concepts and constructs; what is called being overwhelmed by a proliferation of opinions, concepts and constructs
example_1: saññāpaññattiyā sati vitakkapaññattiṃ paññāpessatī'ti, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati. vitakkapaññattiyā sati papañcasaññāsaṅkhā-samudācaraṇa-paññattiṃ paññāpessatī'ti, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati.
commentary: (MNa) phassapaññattiṃ paññapessatī'ti phasso nāma eko dhammo uppajjatī'ti evaṃ phassapaññattiṃ paññapessati, dassessatī'ti attho. esa nayo sabbattha.

meaning_1: commentary on the Majjhima Nikāya compiled by Buddhaghosa
stilling of mental proliferation; subsiding of endless conceptualization
example_1: channaṃ, āvuso, phass'āyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā papañcanirodho papañcavūpasamo'ti.

meaning_1: enjoying various opinions; taking delight in proliferation; engaged in mental proliferation
example_1: yo papañcam'anuyutto, papañc'ābhirato mago, virādhayī so nibbānaṃ, yogakkhemaṃ anuttaraṃ.
example_2: ākāse'va padaṃ n'atthi, samaṇo n'atthi bāhire, papañc'ābhiratā pajā, nippapañcā tathāgatā.

meaning_1: enjoying mental proliferation; taking pleasure in manifold ideas
example_1: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu… saṅgaṇik'ārāmo hoti saṅgaṇikarato saṅgaṇik'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, saṃsagg'ārāmo hoti saṃsaggarato saṃsagg'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, papañc'ārāmo hoti papañcarato papañc'ārāmataṃ anuyutto.
example_2: sā pan'āvuso, niṭṭhā papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino udāhu nippapañc'ārāmassa nippapañcaratino'ti? sammā byākaramānā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ byākareyyuṃ, nippapañc'ārāmass'āvuso, sā niṭṭhā nippapañcaratino, na sā niṭṭhā papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino'ti.
commentary: (MNa) ettha āraman'ti etthā'ti ārāmo. papañco ārāmo assā'ti papañc'ārāmo.

meaning_1: enjoyment of manifold ideas; pleasure of mental proliferation
example_1: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu… saṅgaṇik'ārāmo hoti saṅgaṇikarato saṅgaṇik'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, saṃsagg'ārāmo hoti saṃsaggarato saṃsagg'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, papañc'ārāmo hoti papañcarato papañc'ārāmataṃ anuyutto.

meaning_1: proliferation; conceptualization; process of ever-expanding ideation
example_1: papañcitaṃ, bhikkhave, rogo, papañcitaṃ gaṇḍo, papañcitaṃ sallaṃ. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, nippapañcena cetasā viharissāmā'ti, evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.
commentary: (ADHa) māno hi iñjanato iñjitaṃ, maññanato maññitaṃ, phandanato phanditaṃ, papañcanato papañcitaṃ. tehi tehi kāraṇehi saṅkhatattā saṅkhatan'ti ca vuccati.

example_1: channaṃ, āvuso, phass'āyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā atth'aññaṃ kiñcī'ti, iti vadaṃ appapañcaṃ papañceti.
example_2: yaṃ papañceti tatonidānaṃ purisaṃ papañcasaññāsaṅkhā samudācaranti atīt'ānāgatapaccuppannesu cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu
commentary: (DNa) appapañcaṃ papañcetī'ti na papañcetabbaṭṭhāne papañcaṃ karoti, anācaritabbaṃ maggaṃ carati.

example_1: santi, bhikkhave, tacagandhe adhivatthā devā. santi, bhikkhave, papaṭikagandhe adhivatthā devā. santi, bhikkhave, pattagandhe adhivatthā devā.
commentary: (MNt) papaṭikagandho kabitth'ādi.

example_1: tatrāssu me idaṃ, sāriputta, lūkhasmiṃ hoti, n'ekavassagaṇikaṃ rajojallaṃ kāye sannicitaṃ hoti papaṭikajātaṃ.
na kho, nigrodha, ettāvatā tapojigucchā aggappattā ca hoti sārappattā ca, api ca kho papaṭikappattā hotī'ti.
commentary: (DNa) papaṭikappattā hotī'ti sāravato rukkhassa sāraṃ phegguṃ tacañ'ca atikkamma bahipapaṭikasadisā hotī'ti dasseti.

meaning_2: outer dry bark or crust of a tree
example_1: tassa papaṭikā'pi pāripūriṃ gacchati taco'pi pheggu'pi sāro'pi pāripūriṃ gacchati
example_2: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso sār'atthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkamm'eva sāraṃ atikkamma phegguṃ atikkamma tacaṃ atikkamma papaṭikaṃ, sākhāpalāsaṃ chetvā ādāya pakkameyya sāran'ti maññamāno.
commentary: (VVt) pappaṭikam'pī'ti allatacamatthake sukkhatacapaṭalam'pi.

meaning_2: friend of the careless; i.e. the Evil One

example_2: kām'andhā jālasañchannā, taṇhāchadanachāditā, pamattabandhunā baddhā, macchā'va kumināmukhe, jarāmaraṇam'anventi, vaccho khīrapako'va mātaran'ti.
commentary: (SNa) pamattabandhū'ti māraṃ ālapati. so hi yekeci loke pamattā, tesaṃ bandhu. (UDa) pamattabandhunā baddhā'ti kilesamārena devaputtamārena ca baddhā. yadaggena hi kilesamārena baddhā, tadaggena devaputtamārena'pi baddhā nāma honti.

example_1: n'accantavaṇṇā na bahūnaṃ kantā, na dakkhiṇā pamadā sevitabbā, na parassa bhariyā na dhanassa hetu, et'itthiyo pañca na sevitabbā'ti.

example_2: brahmabhūto atitulo, mārasenappamaddano, sabb'āmitte vasī katvā, modāmi akutobhayo.
commentary: (MNa) parasenappamaddanā'ti sace paṭimukhaṃ tiṭṭheyya parasenā, taṃ maddituṃ samatthā'ti adhippāyo. (MNa) mārasenappamaddano'ti kāmā te paṭhamā senā'ti evaṃ āgatāya mārasenāya pamaddano.

meaning_2: having crushed down, having defeated, having overcame

commentary: (CPa) pamaddī'ti balavabhāvena satte pamaddanasīlo. (JAa) pamaddī'ti attano balavabhāvena uḷāre'pi satte gahetvā attano vase karaṇena maddanasamattho.

example_1: tathāgato atīte buddhe… jātito'pi anussarati, mato'pi anussarati, gottato'pi anussarati, āyuppamāṇato'pi anussarati, sāvakayugato'pi anussarati, sāvakasannipātato'pi anussarati

meaning_1: due to the negligence; due to the carelessness (of)

meaning_1: due to negligence; owing to carelessness

meaning_1: who is familiar with assemblies; who moves around society
example_1: yato ca kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddho ca hoti, sīlavā ca, bahussuto ca, dhammakathiko ca, paris'āvacaro ca, visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseti… evaṃ so ten'aṅgena paripūro hoti.
commentary: (SNa) paris'āvacaro'ti parisāya avacaro. parisaṃ nāma bālā'pi, paṇḍitā'pi osaranti, yo pana parappavādaṃ madditvā attano vādaṃ dīpetuṃ sakkoti, ayaṃ paris'āvacaro nāma.

example_1: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati tap'od'ārāme. atha kho āyasmā samiddhi rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya yena tap'odā ten'upasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ.
example_2: atha kho bhagavā sāy'anhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, āyām'ānanda, yena pubbakoṭṭhako ten'upasaṅkamissāma gattāni parisiñcitun'ti.
commentary: (SNa) gattāni parisiñcitun'ti… gattāni parisiñcan'atthaṃ sarīradhovan'atthaṃ upasaṅkami.

example_1: tap'ode gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubb'āpayamāno.
example_2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ yena pubbakoṭṭhako ten'upasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ. pubbakoṭṭhake gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubb'āpayamāno.
commentary: (ANa) parisiñcitvā'ti vohāravacanam'etaṃ, nhāyitvā'ti attho.

example_1: kati jāgarataṃ suttā, kati suttesu jāgarā, katīhi rajaṃ ādeti, katīhi parisujjhatī'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko ādāse vā parisuddhe pariyodāte acche vā udakapatte sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno
example_2: vippasannāni kho te, gahapati, indriyāni, parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto.
synonym: asaṃkiliṭṭha, pasanna, pāvaka, visada, vītaraja, saṃsuddha, sukka, suci, sucibhūta, sucīmant, suddha, suddhika
commentary: (MNa) parisuddhaṃ malavigamena. (MNa) parisuddhan'ti nirupakkilesaṃ.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, vatthaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ malaggahitaṃ acch'odakaṃ āgamma parisuddhaṃ hoti pariyodātaṃ, ukkāmukhaṃ vā pan'āgamma jātarūpaṃ parisuddhaṃ hoti pariyodātaṃ.

meaning_1: discussion about reaching the pure peak and heartwood
sanskrit: pariśuddha + agra + prāpta + sāra + prāpta + kathā

meaning_1: fact of being pure in bodily action; fact of being undefiled in physical conduct
example_1: etam'ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, parisuddhakāyakammataṃ attani sampassamāno bhiyyo pallomam'āpādiṃ araññe vihārāya.

meaning_1: who is pure in bodily action; undefiled in physical conduct
example_1: na kho pan'āhaṃ aparisuddhakāyakamm'anto araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevāmi, parisuddhakāyakamm'anto'ham'asmi.
idha pan'āvuso, ekacco puggalo aparisuddhavacīsamācāro hoti parisuddhakāyasamācāro. evarūpe'pi, āvuso, puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo
example_2: ye'pi te, sāḷha, samaṇabrāhmaṇā parisuddhakāyasamācārā parisuddhavacīsamācārā parisuddhamanosamācārā parisuddh'ājīvā, bhabbā te ñāṇadassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.

meaning_1: purity of physical action; fact of having clean bodily conduct
construction:
parisuddha + kāya + samācāra + tā
parisuddhakāyasamācāra + tā
example_1: evam'evaṃ kho, āvuso, yv'āyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhavacīsamācāro parisuddhakāyasamācāro, y'āssa aparisuddhavacīsamācāratā na s'āssa tasmiṃ samaye manasi kātabbā, yā ca khv'āssa parisuddhakāyasamācāratā s'āssa tasmiṃ samaye manasi kātabbā.
example_2: parisuddho no kāyasamācāro bhavissati uttāno vivaṭo na ca chiddavā saṃvuto ca. tāya ca pana parisuddhakāyasamācāratāya n'ev'attān'ukkaṃsessāma na paraṃ vambhessāmā'ti evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.

meaning_1: pure in understanding and insight; with perfect knowledge and vision
example_1: puna caparaṃ, moggallāna, idh'ekacco satthā aparisuddhañāṇadassano samāno parisuddhañāṇadassano'mhī'ti paṭijānāti parisuddhaṃ me ñāṇadassanaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan'ti.

meaning_1: discussion about reaching the pure inner bark

example_1: tam'enaṃ sāmikā paribhuñjeyyuñ'c'eva pariyodapeyyuñ'ca, na ca naṃ raj'āpathe nikkhipeyyuṃ. evañ'hi sā, āvuso, kaṃsapāti aparena samayena parisuddhatarā assa pariyodātā'ti? evam'āvuso'ti.
taṃ kissa hetu? parisuddhattā, bhikkhave, vatthassa. evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, citte asaṃkiliṭṭhe, sugati pāṭikaṅkhā.

meaning_1: preaching a pure teaching; teaching perfect Dhamma
example_1: puna caparaṃ, moggallāna, idh'ekacco satthā aparisuddhadhammadesano samāno parisuddhadhammadesano'mhī'ti paṭijānāti parisuddhā me dhammadesanā pariyodātā asaṃkiliṭṭhā'ti.
garuke mama satthusāsane, yā sikkhā sugatena desitā, parisuddhapadaṃ anaṅgaṇaṃ, kiṃ maṃ ovariyāna tiṭṭhasi.
commentary: (THIa) tāhi parisuddhapadaṃ parisuddhakusalakoṭṭhāsaṃ

meaning_1: discussion about reaching the pure dry outer bark
discussion about reaching the pure sapwood

example_1: ye'pi te, sāḷha, samaṇabrāhmaṇā parisuddhakāyasamācārā parisuddhavacīsamācārā parisuddhamanosamācārā parisuddh'ājīvā, bhabbā te ñāṇadassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.

meaning_1: purity of mental conduct; fact of being pure in thought
construction:
parisuddha + mano + samācāra + tā
parisuddhamanosamācāra + tā

meaning_1: who has purified all the doors; i.e. body, speech and mind
with clean morals; having pure conduct
example_1: ahaṃ kho pana, moggallāna, parisuddhasīlo samāno parisuddhasīlo'mhī'ti paṭijānāmi parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan'ti. na ca maṃ sāvakā sīlato rakkhanti, na c'āhaṃ sāvakehi sīlato rakkhaṃ paccāsīsāmi.

evam'evā'ti etthā'pi idaṃ opammasaṃsandanaṃ, sālalaṭṭhi viya attabhāvo, nadīsotaṃ viya saṃsārasotaṃ, pāraṃ gantu'kāmapuriso viya yog'āvacaro, bahiddhā suparikammakatakālo viya chasu dvāresu saṃvarassa paccupaṭṭhitakālo, anto suvisodhitabhāvo viya abbhantare parisuddhasīlabhāvo, phiy'ārittabandhanaṃ viya kāyikacetasika-vīriya-karaṇaṃ, sotthinā pārimatīragamanaṃ viya anupubbena sīlaṃ pūretvā samādhiṃ pūretvā paññaṃ pūretvā nibbānagamanaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

meaning_1: with purified verbal conduct; with clean speech
example_1: pañc'ime, āvuso, āghātapaṭivinayā yattha bhikkhuno uppanno āghāto sabbaso paṭivinetabbo. katame pañca? idh'āvuso, ekacco puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhavacīsamācāro.
example_2: ye'pi te, sāḷha, samaṇabrāhmaṇā parisuddhakāyasamācārā parisuddhavacīsamācārā parisuddhamanosamācārā parisuddh'ājīvā, bhabbā te ñāṇadassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.

meaning_1: purity of verbal conduct; fact of being pure in verbal conduct
construction:
parisuddha + vacī + samācāra + tā
parisuddhavacīsamācāra + tā
example_1: evam'evaṃ khv'āvuso, yv'āyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro parisuddhavacīsamācāro, y'āssa aparisuddhakāyasamācāratā na s'āssa tasmiṃ samaye manasi kātabbā, yā ca khv'āssa parisuddhavacīsamācāratā s'āssa tasmiṃ samaye manasi kātabbā.

example_1: tam'enaṃ rajako yasmiṃ yasmiṃ raṅgajāte upasaṃhareyya, yadi nīlakāya yadi pītakāya yadi lohitakāya yadi mañjiṭṭhakāya, surattavaṇṇam'ev'assa parisuddhavaṇṇam'ev'assa.

meaning_1: with a pure explanation; with a perfect exposition
example_1: puna caparaṃ, moggallāna, idh'ekacco satthā aparisuddhaveyyākaraṇo samāno parisuddhaveyyākaraṇo'mhī'ti paṭijānāti parisuddhaṃ me veyyākaraṇaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan'ti.

meaning_1: pure in way of talking; perfect in mode of communication; pure in verbal dealings
example_1: vokkamati ayam'āyasmā purimavohārā pacchimavohāraṃ, aparisuddhavohāro ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā parisuddhavohāro'ti.

meaning_1: with pure livelihood; with proper mode of living
example_1: ye'pi te, sāḷha, samaṇabrāhmaṇā parisuddhakāyasamācārā parisuddhavacīsamācārā parisuddhamanosamācārā parisuddh'ājīvā, bhabbā te ñāṇadassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.

meaning_1: fact of having a pure livelihood; fact of having a proper mode of living
example_1: etam'ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, parisuddh'ājīvataṃ attani sampassamāno bhiyyo pallomam'āpādiṃ araññe vihārāya.
example_2: parisuddho no ājīvo bhavissati uttāno vivaṭo na ca chiddavā saṃvuto ca. tāya ca pana parisuddh'ājīvatāya n'ev'attān'ukkaṃsessāma na paraṃ vambhessāmā'ti evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.
commentary: (VISMa) vuttavidhinā āhārapariyesanato parisuddhājīvatā.

example_1: idha pana, gahapati, ekacco parisuddh'ābhā'ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati. so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parisuddh'ābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati. imā kho, gahapati, catasso bhav'ūpapattiyo.
chandaparisuddhi, utu'kkhānaṃ, bhikkhugaṇanā ca, ovādo, uposathassa etāni, pubbakiccan'ti vuccati.
commentary: (NIDD1a) parisuddhiyā'ti sabb'ākārena parisuddhabhāvāya.

example_1: mā brāhmaṇa dāru samādahāno, suddhiṃ amaññi bahiddhā hi etaṃ, na hi tena suddhiṃ kusalā vadanti, yo bāhirena parisuddhim'icche.

meaning_1: the venerables are pure in this regard
example_1: tatth'āyasmante pucchāmi, kacci'ttha parisuddhā, dutiyam'pi pucchāmi, kacci'ttha parisuddhā, tatiyam'pi pucchāmi, kacci'ttha parisuddhā, parisuddh'etth'āyasmanto, tasmā tuṇhī, evam'etaṃ dhārayāmī'ti.

meaning_1: dries up; withers up; shrivels up
example_1: phuṭṭhassa me aññatarena byādhinā, rogena bāḷhaṃ dukhitassa ruppato, parisussati khippam'idaṃ kaḷevaraṃ, pupphaṃ yathā paṃsuni ātape kataṃ.

meaning_2: having dried up, having washed away

example_1: tān'assu kukkuṭiyā sammā adhisayitāni sammā pariseditāni sammā paribhāvitāni
commentary: (SNa) sammā pariseditānī'ti kālena kālaṃ utuṃ gaṇhāpentiyā suṭṭhu samantato seditāni usmīkatāni.

example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhave, soko? yo kho, bhikkhave, aññatar'aññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa aññatar'aññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa soko socanā socitattaṃ antosoko antoparisoko, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, soko
divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhessāma
example_2: ye'pi hi keci, rāhula, anāgatam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kāyakammaṃ parisodhessanti… sabbe te evam'evaṃ paccavekkhitvā paccavekkhitvā kāyakammaṃ parisodhessanti
synonym: punāti, visodhayati, visodheti, vodāpeti, sodhayati, sodheti
commentary: (ANa) abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodhetī'ti abhijjhāto cittaṃ parimoceti, yathā naṃ sā muñcati c'eva muñcitvā ca na puna gaṇhāti, evaṃ karotī'ti attho.

example_1: ye hi keci, rāhula, atītam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kāyakammaṃ parisodhesuṃ… sabbe te evam'evaṃ paccavekkhitvā paccavekkhitvā kāyakammaṃ parisodhesuṃ
example_2: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigat'ābhijjhena cetasā vihāsiṃ, abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodhesiṃ.

example_1: amanussaṭṭhāne udakaṃ'va sītaṃ, tadapeyyamānaṃ parisosam'eti, evaṃ dhanaṃ kāpuriso labhitvā, n'ev'attanā bhuñjati no dadāti.

meaning_1: making dry up; causing to evaporate

example_1: akālacāriñ'hi sajanti saṅgā, akālacāriṃ puggalaṃ rāgasaṅg'ādayo aneke saṅgā sajanti parissajanti upaguhanti allīyanti. tasmā vikāle na caranti buddhā, tasmā ye catusaccabuddhā ariyapuggalā, na te vikāle piṇḍāya carantī'ti.
kilanto'smī'ti parissanto asmi. tena yathāvuttavedanānaṃ balavabhāvaṃ eva dasseti.
sace labhetha nipakaṃ sahāyaṃ, saddhiṃcaraṃ sādhuvihāridhīraṃ, abhibhuyya sabbāni parissayāni, careyya ten'attamano satīmā.
abalā naṃ balīyanti, maddant'enaṃ parissayā, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti, nāvaṃ bhinnam'iv'odakaṃ.
example_2: paṭisaṅkhā yoniso sen'āsanaṃ paṭisevāmi yāva'd'eva sītassa paṭighātāya uṇhassa paṭighātāya ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-siriṃsapa-samphassānaṃ paṭighātāya yāva'd'eva utuparissayavinodanaṃ paṭisallān'ārām'atthaṃ

example_1: parisā c'assa hoti bāhullikā. laddhaṃ laddhaṃ kolambe'pi ghaṭe'pi pūretvā paṭisāmeti, parissāvanāni'pi thavikāyo'pi pūretvā vātapānesu laggeti. tāni olīnavilīnāni tiṭṭhanti.
example_2: so hi khuddakavāsiñ'ca sūciñ'ca parissāvane pakkhipitvā pattassa anto ṭhapetvā pattaṃ aṃsakūṭe laggetvā ticīvaraṃ kāyapaṭibaddhaṃ katvā yen'icchakaṃ sukhaṃ pakkamati.
commentary: (PYt) udakaṃ parisuddhaṃ hutvā savati gacchati pavattati anenā'ti parissāvanaṃ.

example_1: kodhanaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalaṃ kodh'ābhibhūtaṃ kodhaparetaṃ, ye'pi'ssa te honti mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā, te'pi ārakā parivajjanti kodh'ābhibhūtaṃ.
example_2: tatra, bhikkhave, ye te makkaṭā abālajātikā alolajātikā, te taṃ lepaṃ disvā ārakā parivajjanti. yo pana so hoti makkaṭo bālajātiko lolajātiko, so taṃ lepaṃ upasaṅkamitvā hatthena gaṇhāti.

example_1: atthi, bhikkhave, āsavā dassanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā saṃvarā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā paṭisevanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā adhivāsanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā parivajjanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā vinodanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā bhāvanā pahātabbā
commentary: (MNa) dassanā pahātabbā'ti dassanena pahātabbā. esa nayo sabbattha.

meaning_1: by completely avoiding; through keeping away
example_1: atthi, bhikkhave, āsavā dassanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā saṃvarā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā paṭisevanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā adhivāsanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā parivajjanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā vinodanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā bhāvanā pahātabbā
commentary: (MNa) dassanā pahātabbā'ti dassanena pahātabbā. esa nayo sabbattha.

example_1: vāṇijo'va bhayaṃ maggaṃ, appasattho mahaddhano, visaṃ jīvitu'kāmo'va, pāpāni parivajjaye.
example_2: tasmā jantu sadā sato, kāmāni parivajjaye, te pahāya tare oghaṃ, nāvaṃ sitvā'va pāragū'ti.

meaning_1: completely avoiding; shunning; keeping away from
example_1: bhuñjati anavajjāni, sāvajjāni na bhuñjati, ghāsam'acchādanaṃ laddhā, sannidhiṃ parivajjayaṃ.
example_2: yañ'hi'ssa, bhikkhave, aparivajjayato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, parivajjayato evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti. ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, āsavā parivajjanā pahātabbā.

example_1: yo kāme parivajjeti, sappass'eva padā siro, so imaṃ visattikaṃ loke, sato samativattati.
example_2: pāpāni parivajjeti, sa munī tena so muni, yo munāti ubho loke, muni tena pavuccati.

example_1: yo'pi vassasataṃ jīve, so'pi maccuparāyaṇo, na kiñci parivajjeti, sabbam'ev'ābhimaddatī'ti.

meaning_2: having shunned, having avoided, having kept away from

example_1: so evam'āha, antavā ayaṃ loko parivaṭumo. taṃ kissa hetu?
commentary: (PMa) parivaṭumo'ti samantato paricchedavā.

example_1: so kho ahaṃ, āvuso, aparena samayena… appaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ.
example_2: tena kho pana samayena jānapadā manussā bahuṃ loṇam'pi telam'pi taṇḍulam'pi khādanīyam'pi sakaṭesu āropetvā bahārāmakoṭṭhake sakaṭaparivaṭṭaṃ karitvā acchanti

meaning_1: having caused to spin around; having made circle around

example_1: yaṃ buddhaseṭṭho parivaṇṇayī suciṃ, samādhim'ānantarikañ'ñam'āhu, samādhinā tena samo na vijjati, idam'pi dhamme ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

meaning_1: changing; twisting around; moving about; spinning
example_1: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ lahuparivattaṃ yatha'y'idaṃ cittaṃ. yāvañ'c'idaṃ, bhikkhave, upamā'pi na sukarā yāva lahuparivattaṃ cittan'ti.
so n'ātidūre n'āccāsanne āsanassa parivattati, na ca pāṇinā ālambitvā āsane nisīdati, na ca āsanasmiṃ kāyaṃ pakkhipati.

vighāto c'āhaṃ paripatāmi chamāyaṃ, parivattāmi vāricaro'va ghamme, rudato ca me assukā niggalanti, ācikkha bhante kissa ayaṃ vipāko, pucchāmi taṃ etam'atthaṃ bhadante, kathaṃ nu ucchuparibhogaṃ labheyyan'ti.
commentary: (PVa) parivattāmī'ti paribbhamāmi.

example_1: negamajānapadesu adhammikesu visamaṃ candimasūriyā parivattanti. visamaṃ candimasūriyesu parivattantesu visamaṃ nakkhattāni tārakarūpāni parivattanti.

meaning_1: rolled around (in); revolved (in); cycled (through); was reborn (in)

meaning_1: agreement about (the postponement of) the invitation ceremony

commentary: (MNa) pavāraṇasaṅgaho nāma ñattidutiyena kammena diyyati kassa pan'esa diyyati, kassa na diyyatī'ti. akārakassa tāva bālaputhujjanassa na diyyati, tathā āraddhavipassakassa c'eva ariyasāvakassa ca. yassa pana samatho vā taruṇo hoti vipassanā vā, tassa diyyati. bhagavā'pi tadā bhikkhūnaṃ citt'ācāraṃ parivīmaṃsanto samathavipassanānaṃ taruṇabhāvaṃ ñatvā, mayi ajja pavārente disāsu vassaṃvuṭṭhā bhikkhū idha osarissanti. tato ime bhikkhū vuḍḍhatarehi bhikkhūhi sen'āsane gahite visesaṃ nibbattetuṃ na sakkhissanti. sace'pi cārikaṃ pakkamissāmi, imesaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ dullabham'eva bhavissati. mayi pana apavārente bhikkhū'pi imaṃ sāvatthiṃ na osarissanti, aham'pi cārikaṃ na pakkamissāmi, evaṃ imesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ apalibuddhaṃ bhavissati. te attano attano vasanaṭṭhāne phāsu viharantā samathavipassanā thāmajātā katvā visesaṃ nibbattetuṃ sakkhissantī'ti so taṃdivasaṃ apavāretvā kattikapuṇṇamāyaṃ pavāressāmī'ti bhikkhūnaṃ pavāraṇasaṅgahaṃ anujāni. pavāraṇasaṅgahasmiñ'hi laddhe yassa nissayapaṭipannassa ācariy'upajjhāyā pakkamanti, so'pi sace patirūpo nissayadāyako āgamissati, tassa santike nissayaṃ gaṇhissāmī'ti yāva gimhānaṃ pacchimamāsā vasituṃ labhati. sace'pi saṭṭhivassā bhikkhū āgacchanti, tassa sen'āsanaṃ gahetuṃ na labhanti. ayañ'ca pana pavāraṇasaṅgaho ekassa dinno'pi sabbesaṃ dinno'y'eva hoti.

example_2: yathā, mahārāja, koci'd'eva puriso visaṃ abhisaṅkharitvā attanā ca piveyya, pare ca pāyeyya, so attanā'pi dukkhito bhaveyya, pare'pi dukkhitā bhaveyyuṃ.
commentary: (DNa) pāyentī'ti thaññaṃ pāyenti.

meaning_1: having made drink; having caused to drink; having got drunk
example_1: sakko devarājā, kiṃ no sādhāraṇena rajjenā'ti asure dibbapānaṃ pāyetvā matte samāne pādesu gāhāpetvā sinerupabbatapāde khipāpesi. te asurabhavanam'eva sampāpuṇiṃsu.
example_2: āpādikā'ti saṃvaḍḍhikā, tumhākaṃ hatthapādesu hatthapādakiccaṃ asādhentesu hatthe ca pāde ca vaḍḍhetvā paṭijaggikā'ti attho. posikā'ti divasassa dve tayo vāre nhāpetvā bhojetvā pāyetvā tumhe posesi.

grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of pāya

example_1: bah'ūpakārā, bhante, mahāpajāpati gotamī bhagavato mātucchā āpādikā posikā khīrassa dāyikā, bhagavantaṃ janettiyā kālaṅ'katāya thaññaṃ pāyesi. bhagavā'pi, bhante, bah'ūpakāro mahāpajāpatiyā gotamiyā.
commentary: (MNa) thaññaṃ pāyesī'ti nandakumāro kira bodhisattato katip'āhen'eva daharo, tasmiṃ jāte mahāpajāpati attano puttaṃ dhātīnaṃ datvā sayaṃ bodhisattassa dhātikiccaṃ sādhayamānā attano thaññaṃ pāyesi. taṃ sandhāya thero evam'āha.

meaning_1: far side; far shore; bank on the other side (of)
example_1: oraṃ samuddassa atittarūpo, pāraṃ samuddassa'pi patthayetha, rājā ca aññe ca bahū manussā, avītataṇhā maraṇaṃ upenti, ūnā'va hutvāna jahanti dehaṃ, kāmehi lokamhi na hatthi titti.
example_2: anāpatti na has'ādhippāyo, sati karaṇīye udakaṃ otaritvā nimujjati vā ummujjati vā palavati vā, pāraṃ gacchanto nimujjati vā ummujjati vā palavati vā, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

meaning_1: who has gone beyond; who has crossed over; who has mastered; who thoroughly knows
example_1: evaṃ mano chassu yadā subhāvito, phuṭṭhassa cittaṃ na vikampate kvaci, te rāgadose abhibhuyya bhikkhavo, bhavattha jātimaraṇassa pāragā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) bhavattha jātimaraṇassa pāragā'ti jātimaraṇānaṃ pāraṃ nibbānaṃ gamakā hotha.

meaning_1: far side of the Ganges river
example_1: sace me na byākarissasi, cittaṃ vā te khipissāmi, hadayaṃ vā te phālessāmi, pādesu vā gahetvā pāragaṅgāya khipissāmī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) pāragaṅgāyā'ti dvīsu pādesu gahetvā taṃ āviñchetvā yathā na pun'āgacchasi, evaṃ pāraṃ vā gaṅgāya khipissāmī'ti vadati.

meaning_1: gone beyond; reached the far shore; crossed over; epithet of an arahant
meaning_2: who has gone to the end or the other shore
example_1: paroparā yassa samecca dhammā, vidhūpitā atthagatā na santi, sa ve muni vusitabrahmacariyo, lok'antagū pāragato'ti vuccatī'ti.
example_2: yo'maṃ palipathaṃ duggaṃ, saṃsāraṃ moham'accagā, tiṇṇo pāragato jhāyī, anejo akathaṃkathī, anupādāya nibbuto, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) pāragato'ti chah'ākārehi pāragato. idha khīṇ'āsavo'va kathito. (ITIa) pāraṃ nibbānaṃ gato'ti pāragato.

meaning_1: seeking salvation; who is looking for the beyond
meaning_2: looking for the final end or the other shore
example_1: hananti bhogā dummedhaṃ, no ca pāragavesino, bhogataṇhāya dummedho, hanti aññ'eva attanaṃ.
example_2: alattakakatā pādā, mukhaṃ cuṇṇakamakkhitaṃ, alaṃ bālassa mohāya, no ca pāragavesino.

meaning_1: seeking the far shore; wanting to cross to the other side
meaning_2: seeking the far shore; wanting to cross to the other side
example_1: seyyathā'pi, vāseṭṭha, ayaṃ aciravatī nadī pūrā udakassa samatittikā kākapeyyā. atha puriso āgaccheyya pār'atthiko pāragavesī pāragāmī pāraṃ taritu'kāmo. so orime tīre ṭhito pārimaṃ tīraṃ avheyya, ehi pār'āpāraṃ, ehi pār'āpāran'ti.

meaning_1: name of a group of deities
example_1: ath'āguṃ harayo devā, ye ca lohitavāsino, pāragā mahāpāragā, āguṃ devā yasassino, das'ete dasadhā kāyā, sabbe nānattavaṇṇino.
commentary: (DNa) pāragā mahāpāragā'ti ete ca duvidhā āgatā.

meaning_1: who crosses over; who goes to the other shore
example_1: appakā te manussesu, ye janā pāragāmino, ath'āyaṃ itarā pajā, tīram'ev'ānudhāvati.

meaning_1: leading to the far shore; going across
meaning_2: going to the far shore; travelling across
example_1: pārañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi pāragāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.
commentary: (SNa) vaṭṭassa parabhāg'aṭṭhena pāraṃ.

meaning_1: who has gone beyond; who has crossed over
example_1: yaṃ manussā namassanti, sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ, devā'pi taṃ namassanti, iti me arahato sutaṃ.
example_2: muñca pure muñca pacchato, majjhe muñca bhavassa pāragū, sabbattha vimuttamānaso, na punaṃ jātijaraṃ upehisi.
commentary: (ANa) pāragū'ti pāraṅ'gatā.

meaning_1: master (of); who is profoundly learned (in); who is fully conversant (with)
meaning_lit: who has gone to the far side
example_1: tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lok'āyata-mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.
example_2: cittaṃ visuddhaṃ jānāti, muttaṃ rāgehi sabbaso. pahīnajātimaraṇo, brahmacariyassa kevalī, pāragū sabbadhammānaṃ, buddho tādī pavuccatī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) pāragū sabbadhammānan'ti sabbesaṃ lokiyalok'uttaradhammānaṃ abhiññāya pāraṃ gato, sabbadhamme abhijānitvā ṭhito'ti attho. pāragū'ti vā ettāvatā pariññāpāragū pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ, pahānapāragū sabbakilesānaṃ, bhāvanāpāragū catunnaṃ maggānaṃ, sacchikiriyāpāragū nirodhassa, samāpattipāragū sabbasamāpattīnan'ti ayam'attho vutto.

meaning_1: reached the other shore; gone across safely; gone beyond; epithet of an arahant
example_1: yattha kāmā nirujjhanti, ye ca kāme nirodhetvā nirodhetvā viharanti, addhā te āyasmanto nicchātā nibbutā tiṇṇā pāraṅ'gatā tadaṅgenā'ti vadāmi
example_2: tassa purisassa uttiṇṇassa pāraṅ'gatassa evam'assa, bahukāro kho me ayaṃ kullo, im'āhaṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ uttiṇṇo.
commentary: (ANa) pāraṅ'gato'ti paratīraṃ gato. (SNa) pāraṃ gato'ti nibbānaṃ gato.

meaning_1: going to the other shore; crossing safely; (comm) going to Nibbāna
example_1: pañcavedā sataṃ samaṃ, tapassī brāhmaṇā caraṃ, cittañ'ca nesaṃ na sammā vimuttaṃ, hīn'attharūpā na pāraṅ'gamā te.
example_2: taṇh'ādhipannā vatasīlabaddhā, lūkhaṃ tapaṃ vassasataṃ carantā, cittañ'ca nesaṃ na sammā vimuttaṃ, hīn'attharūpā na pāraṅ'gamā te.
commentary: (SNa) hīn'attarūpā na pāraṃ gamā te'ti hīn'attasabhāvā te nibbānaṅgamā na honti.

meaning_lit: discourse on going to the other shore
discourse on going to the other shore

example_1: pāṇā sūriyūpamā dve, gilānā apare tayo, pāraṅ'gāmī viraddho ca, ariyo nibbidāya cā'ti.

meaning_1: seeking the far shore; wanting to cross
meaning_2: seeking the far shore; wanting to cross
example_1: seyyathā'pi, vāseṭṭha, ayaṃ aciravatī nadī pūrā udakassa samatittikā kākapeyyā. atha puriso āgaccheyya pār'atthiko pāragavesī pāragāmī pāraṃ taritu'kāmo. so orime tīre ṭhito pārimaṃ tīraṃ avheyya, ehi pār'āpāraṃ, ehi pār'āpāran'ti.

meaning_1: seeing the far shore; (comm) seeing Nibbāna
example_1: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako na rūpabandhanabaddho, na santarabāhirabandhanabaddho, tīradassī, pāradassī, parimutto so dukkhasmā'ti vadāmi.
commentary: (SNa) apāradassī'ti pāraṃ vuccati nibbānaṃ, taṃ na passati.

example_1: dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, corā pāripanthikāti gahetvā sīsacchinnānaṃ lohitaṃ passannaṃ paggharitaṃ. dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, corā pāradārikā'ti gahetvā sīsacchinnānaṃ lohitaṃ passannaṃ paggharitaṃ, na tv'eva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakaṃ. taṃ kissa hetu?
commentary: (SNa) pāradārikā'ti paradāracārittaṃ āpajjanakā.

construction:
para > pāra + ma + *ī + tā
pāramī + tā
example_1: paññāpāramitaṃ patto, mahābuddhi mahāmati, ajaḷo jaḷasamāno, sadā carati nibbuto.
example_2: tath'eva tvam'pi ahitahite, samaṃ mettāya bhāvaya, mettāpāramitaṃ gantvā, sambodhiṃ pāpuṇissasī'ti.
commentary: (THa) paññāpāramitaṃ patto'ti sāvakañāṇassa pāramiṃ pārakoṭiṃ patto.

meaning_1: reached perfection; attained the ultimate state
example_1: abhiññāpāramippatto, sotadhātu visodhitā, tevijjo iddhipatto'mhi, cetopariyakovido.
example_2: sāriputtam'eva taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya, vasippatto pāramippatto ariyasmiṃ sīlasmiṃ, vasippatto pāramippatto ariyasmiṃ samādhismiṃ, vasippatto pāramippatto ariyāya paññāya, vasippatto pāramippatto ariyāya vimuttiyā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) pāramippatto'ti nipphattiṃ patto.

meaning_1: fulfilment; perfection; transcendental virtue; ultimate state
example_1: vicinanto tadā dakkhiṃ, dutiyaṃ sīlapāramiṃ, pubbakehi mah'esīhi, āsevitanisevitaṃ.
example_2: ayya sumedhatāpasa, porāṇakabodhisattānaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā, pāramiyo vicinissāmā'ti nisinnakāle yāni pubbanimittāni nāma paññāyanti, tāni sabbāni'pi ajja pātubhūtāni

meaning_1: goes to the far shore; crosses over
example_1: ye ca kho sammadakkhāte, dhamme dhamm'ānuvattino, te janā pāram'essanti, maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) pāram'essantī'ti te evarūpā janā nibbānapāraṃ gamissanti.

meaning_2: connected with the other world or the future birth

example_1: paṭipatti paṭipanno ca, viraddhañ'ca pāraṃgamā, sāmaññena ca dve vuttā, brahmaññā apare duve, brahmacariyena dve vuttā, vaggo tena pavuccatī'ti.

meaning_2: who has committed the gravest transgression of the rules for Bhikkhu
example_1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno sikkhaṃ appaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya, antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pi, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
example_2: uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto cattāro pārājikā dhammā. yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā na labhati bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ yathā pure, tathā pacchā, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
commentary: (VIN 6.8.5) pārājikan'ti yaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ suṇohi yathātathaṃ, cuto paraddho bhaṭṭho ca, saddhammā hi niraṅkato, saṃvāso'pi tahiṃ n'atthi, ten'etaṃ iti vuccati. (VINa) pārājiko'ti parājito, parājayaṃ āpanno.
notes: Indic Languages in Brill's Encyclopedia of Buddhism: 'Similarly, the correct derivation and original meaning of the legal technical term pārājika based on the Vedic verb parā + aj-, 'to drive away,' probably originally belonging to the vocabulary of cattle keepers and therefore unknown to the Buddhist tradition, which sought a connection to parā + ji-, 'to defeat' (pārājika > pārājayika), were found out by one of the pioneers of Western Buddhist studies, E. example_1: [ettha labheyy'āhaṃ… upasampadaṃ'ti vākyadvayaṃ sabbesu'pi mūlapotthakesu dissati, pārājikapāḷiyaṃ pana sudinnabhāṇavāre etaṃ n'atthi. pabbājetu maṃ bhagavā'ti idaṃ pana vākyaṃ marammapotthake y'eva dissati, pārājikapāḷiyañ'ca tadeva atthi]

meaning_1: (vinaya) nearly involving defeat; closely related to expulsion
example_1: kathañ'c'ānanda, sativinayo hoti? idh'ānanda, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ evarūpāya garukāya āpattiyā codenti pārājikena vā pārājikasāmantena vā, sarat'āyasmā evarūpiṃ garukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitā pārājikaṃ vā pārājikasāmantaṃ vā'ti?
commentary: (VINa) pārājikasāmantaṃ vā'ti ettha methunadhamme pārājikasāmantaṃ nāma dukkaṭaṃ hoti. adinn'ādān'ādīsu thull'accayaṃ.

family_set: names of arahants; names of monks

notes: Theragāthā verse 116 (TH1.116, TH116) is attributed to him.

meaning_1: far and near shore; world and self; other world and this world; thither and hither; duality; (comm) internal and external sense fields
example_1: yassa pāraṃ apāraṃ vā, pār'āpāraṃ na vijjati, vītaddaraṃ visaṃyuttaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) pāran'ti ajjhattikāni cha āyatanāni. apāran'ti bāhirāni cha āyatanāni. pār'āpāran'ti tadubhayaṃ.

meaning_1: far shore (come to) the near shore!
example_1: atha puriso āgaccheyya pār'atthiko pāragavesī pāragāmī pāraṃ taritu'kāmo. so orime tīre ṭhito pārimaṃ tīraṃ avheyya, ehi pār'āpāraṃ, ehi pār'āpāran'ti.
commentary: (DNa) ehi pār'āpāran'ti ambho pāra apāraṃ ehi, atha maṃ sahasā'va gahetvā gamissasi, atthi me accāyikakamman'ti attho.

meaning_1: Way to the Far Shore; Way to the Beyond; last chapter of the Sutta Nipāta (SNP 56, KN5.56)
example_1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati. tatra kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi, vuttam'idaṃ, sāriputta, pārāyaṇe ajitapañhe

meaning_1: Way to the Far Shore; Way to the Beyond; last chapter of the Sutta Nipāta
example_1: idañ'ca pana m'etaṃ, bhikkhave, sandhāya bhāsitaṃ pārāyane puṇṇakapañhe.
example_2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ maṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam'antarākathā udapādi, vuttam'idaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā pārāyane metteyyapañhe.

meaning_1: ?? meeting regarding the Way to the Far Shore ?? scripture regarding the Way to the Far Shore

example_1: atha kho uttaro māṇavo pārāsariy'antevāsī yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
aññathā kho, ānanda, deseti pārāsiviyo brāhmaṇo sāvakānaṃ indriyabhāvanaṃ, aññathā ca pan'ānanda, ariyassa vinaye anuttarā indriyabhāvanā hotī'ti.

andho hi, uttara, cakkhunā rūpaṃ na passati, badhiro sotena saddaṃ na suṇātī'ti. evaṃ vutte, uttaro māṇavo pārāsiviy'antevāsī tuṇhībhūto maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho pajjhāyanto appaṭibhāno nisīdi.
yā puṇṇamāse migamandalocanā, upāvisi puṇḍarīkattac'aṅgī, dve puṇṇamāyo tadahū amaññ'ahaṃ, disvāna pārāvatarattavāsiniṃ.
example_2: kāpotakānī'ti kapotavaṇṇāni, pārāvatapakkhavaṇṇānī'ti attho.

commentary: (DNa) puggalapaṇṇattīsū'ti lokavohāravasena satto puggalo naro poso'ti evaṃ paññāpetabbāsu lokapaññattīsu. buddhānañ'hi dve kathā sammutikathā, paramatthakathā'ti poṭṭhapādasutte (dī. ni. aṭṭha. 1.439-443) vitthāritā. (DNt) puggalapaṇṇattīsū'ti puggalānaṃ paññāpanesu. guṇavisesavasena aññam'aññaṃ asaṅkarato ṭhapanesu. lokavohāravasenā'ti lokasammutivasena.

meaning_1: who has faith in an individual; who has confidence in a single person
example_1: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ puggalappasannānaṃ yadidaṃ jīvako komārabhacco.
commentary: (ANa) puggalappasannānan'ti puggaliyappasādena samannāgatānaṃ upāsakānaṃ jīvako komārabhacco aggo'ti dasseti.

meaning_1: faith in a (single) person; confidence in an individual
example_1: saddhammaṃ asuṇanto saddhammā parihāyati. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo ādīnavo puggalappasāde.
commentary: (ANa) puggalappasāde'ti ekapuggalasmiṃ uppannappasāde.

meaning_lit: discourse on faith in a person

meaning_1: collection of bones (of a single) person
example_1: ekass'ekena kappena, puggalass'aṭṭhisañcayo, siyā pabbatasamo rāsi, iti vuttaṃ mah'esinā.
commentary: (ADht) ekassa puggalassa aṭṭhisañcayo aṭṭhisamūho ekena kappena pabbatasamo rāsi siyā.

meaning_1: proponent of the doctrine that the individual exists
example_1: evaṃ ucchedavādimhi pahonte sassatavādī, puggalavādimhi pahonte suññatavādī, suññatavādimhi pahonte puggalavādī'ti evaṃ ṭhān'āṭhāne na saṇṭhāti nāma.
commentary: (ANt) puggalavādimhī'ti iminā vacchakuttiyavādiṃ dasseti.

example_1: catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti, upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya. api ca m'ettha puggalavemattatā viditā'ti.

meaning_1: disrespect towards a person; personal contempt
example_1: anādariyaṃ nāma dve anādariyāni, puggal'ānādariyañ'ca dhamm'ānādariyañ'ca.
commentary: (VIN 2.5.6.4) puggal'ānādariyaṃ nāma upasampannena paññattena vuccamāno ayaṃ ukkhittako vā vambhito vā garahito vā, imassa vacanaṃ akataṃ bhavissatī'ti anādariyaṃ karoti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

example_1: puggalike puggalikasaññī aññassa puggalike, āpatti dukkaṭassa. attano puggalike anāpatti.
commentary: (VIN) puggalikenā'ti ekāya bhikkhuniyā, na saṅghassa, na gaṇassa.

example_1: gunnaṃ ce taramānānaṃ, jimhaṃ gacchati puṅgavo, sabbā tā jimhaṃ gacchanti, nette jimhaṃ gate sati.
commentary: (ANa) puṅgavo'ti usabho.

example_1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā verañjāyaṃ viharati naḷerupucimandamūle mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi
puccha maṃ sabhiya pañhaṃ, yaṃ kiñci manas'icchasi, tassa tass'eva pañhassa, ahaṃ antaṃ karomi te'ti.
pucchaka, sammajjanī padīpo ca, udakaṃ āsanena ca, uposathassa etāni, pubbakaraṇan'ti vuccati.
siyā kho pana bhikkhave ekabhikkhuss'āpi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā pucchatha bhikkhave mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha
example_2: anejaṃ mūladassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kiṃ nissitā isayo manujā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā devatānaṃ, yaññam'akappayiṃsu puthū'dha loke, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

example_1: parikappe na saṇṭhātī'ti idaṃ pañhapucchane'pi pañhakathane'pi labbhati. kathaṃ? ekacco hi, pañhaṃ pucchissāmī'ti kaṇṭhaṃ sodheti, so itarena, idaṃ nāma tvaṃ pucchissasī'ti vutto ñātabhāvaṃ ñatvā, na etaṃ, aññaṃ pucchissāmī'ti vadati.

grammar: ind, adv, comp, dat sg of pucchanattha

example_1: yaṃ jātaṃ taṃ saṅghamajjhe pucchante santaṃ atthī'ti vattabbaṃ asantaṃ n'atthī'ti vattabbaṃ
example_2: cirarattaṃ vat'ātāpī, dhammaṃ anuvicintayaṃ, samaṃ cittassa n'ālatthaṃ, pucchaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇe.

meaning_1: sequence of a sutta based on a question
meaning_2: sequence of meaning in a sutta based on a question asked
example_1: tattha, evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, siyā nu kho, bhante, bahiddhā asati paritassanā'ti? siyā bhikkhū'ti bhagavā avocā'ti (ma. ni. 1.242). evaṃ pucchantānaṃ vissajjitasuttavasena pucch'ānusandhi veditabbo.
commentary: (DNt) anusandhānaṃ anusandhi, pucchāya kato anusandhi pucch'ānusandhi. atha vā anusandhayatī'ti anusandhi, pucchā anusandhi etassā'ti pucch'ānusandhi. pucchāya anusandhiyatīti vā pucch'ānusandhi.

meaning_1: (of a discourse's origin) on account of a question
meaning_2: sutta delivered as the result of a question
example_1: evaṃ puṭṭhena bhagavatā yāni kathitāni bojjhaṅgasaṃyutt'ādīni, yāni vā pan'aññāni'pi devatāsaṃyutta-mārasaṃyutta-brahmasaṃyutta-sakkapañha-cūḷavedalla-mahāvedalla-sāmaññaphala-āḷavaka-sūciloma-kharalomasuttādīni, tesaṃ pucchāvasiko nikkhepo.
commentary: (DNt) pucchāya vaso pucchāvaso, so etassa atthi yathāvuttanayenā'ti pucchāvasiko.

example_1: puccheyyāma mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ kañci'd'eva desaṃ, sace āyasmā channo okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyā'ti. pucch'āvuso sāriputta, sutvā vedissāmā'ti.
sādhu, bhante'ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ pucchi
example_2: itthiyā'pi purisassa'pi nāmam'pi gottam'pi pucchitabbaṃ ahosi, tena pucchiṃ. gāmassa'pi nigamassa'pi nāmam'pi maggam'pi pucchitabbaṃ ahosi, tena pucchin'ti.
commentary: (VVa) pucchisaṃ apucchiṃ

example_1: kassako paṭijānāsi, na ca passāma te kasiṃ, kasiṃ no pucchito brūhi, yathā jānemu te kasiṃ.
example_2: aniṭṭhurī ananugiddho, anejo sabbadhī samo, tam'ānisaṃsaṃ pabrūmi, pucchito avikampinaṃ.

meaning_1: should be asked; could be asked
meaning_2: should be asked, should be questioned
example_1: evañ'ca kho eso, bhikkhu, pañho pucchitabbo
example_2: anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā pañho pucchitabbo, cattāro'me, āvuso, vohārā tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena samma'd'akkhātā. katame cattāro?

example_1: kā upanisā savanāyā'ti iti ce, bhikkhave, pucchitāro assu, te evam'assu vacanīyā, yāva'd'eva dvayatānaṃ dhammānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇāyā'ti. kiñ'ca dvayataṃ vadetha?

meaning_1: wanting to ask; wishing to enquire
example_1: evaṃ vutte, acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, na kho pana mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ bahu'd'eva pucchitu'kāmā'ti. puccha, kassapa, yadākaṅkhasī'ti.

meaning_1: to ask; to enquire; to question (somebody about)
example_1: kaṅkhī vecikicchī āgamaṃ, pañhe pucchituṃ abhikaṅkhamāno, tes'antakaro bhavāhi pañhe me puṭṭho, anupubbaṃ anudhammaṃ byākarohi me.

meaning_1: having asked; having enquired; having questioned (somebody about)
example_1: kiṃ bhante avelāya ayyā āgatā'ti pucchitvā ādito paṭṭhāya kathesuṃ
example_2: satthā mūlasiriṃ āmantetvā, jānāsi etan'ti pucchitvā, na jānāmī'ti vutte, pitā te ānandaseṭṭhī'ti vatvā asaddahantaṃ, ānandaseṭṭhi puttassa te pañca mahānidhiyo ācikkhāhī'ti ācikkhāpetvā saddahāpesi

example_1: na dhammo bhāsitabbo. kiṃ kāraṇā āgato'sī'ti pucchiyamāno jānāhi, āvuso'ti vattabbo. sace āsane vā nisīdati, āmisaṃ vā paṭiggaṇhāti, dhammaṃ vā bhāsati, ṭhānaṃ bhañjati.
commentary: (VINa) pucchiyamāno'ti idañ'hi karaṇ'atthe paccattavacanaṃ. atha vā pucchaṃ kurumāno pucchiyamāno'ti evam'p'ettha attho daṭṭhabbo.

example_1: anāpatti, kattha demā'ti pucchīyamāno, yattha tumhākaṃ deyyadhammo paribhogaṃ vā labheyya paṭisaṅkhāraṃ vā labheyya ciraṭṭhitiko vā assa yattha vā pana tumhākaṃ cittaṃ pasīdati tattha dethā'ti bhaṇati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
so taṃ purisaṃ tassa gāmassa vā nigamassa vā khematañ'ca subhikkhatañ'ca app'ābādhatañ'ca puccheyya
no ce'pi uccākulā pabbajito hoti, so ca hoti dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī, so pujjo, so tattha pāsaṃso'ti.
example_2: kiñ'c'āpi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā jighacchādubbalyaṃ paṭivinodetvā evaṃ taṃ rattin'divaṃ vītināmeyya, atha kho asu'y'eva me purimo bhikkhu pujjataro ca pāsaṃsataro ca

meaning_1: more commendable; more praiseworthy; more laudable
example_1: kiñ'c'āpi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu taṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā jighacchādubbalyaṃ paṭivinodetvā evaṃ taṃ rattin'divaṃ vītināmeyya, atha kho asu'y'eva me purimo bhikkhu pujjataro ca pāsaṃsataro ca
seyyathā'pi, bhante, rajoharaṇaṃ sucim'pi… puñchati, na ca tena rajoharaṇaṃ aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā.
example_2: seyyathā'pi, bhante, rajoharaṇaṃ sucim'pi puñchati asucim'pi puñchati gūthagatam'pi

example_1: upāhanā puñchantena paṭhamaṃ sukkhena coḷakena puñchitabbā, pacchā allena. upāhanāpuñchanacoḷakaṃ dhovitvā ekam'antaṃ vissajjetabbaṃ.

nivāto nāma nīcamanatā nivātavuttitā, yāya samannāgato puggalo nihatamāno nihatadappo pādapuñchanakacoḷasadiso chinnavisāṇa-usabhasamo uddhaṭadāṭhasappasamo ca hutvā saṇho sakhilo sukhasambhāso hoti, ayaṃ nivāto.

commentary: (THa) pādapuñchanin'ti pādapuñchanacoḷakkhaṇḍaṃ

example_1: upāhanā puñchantena paṭhamaṃ sukkhena coḷakena puñchitabbā, pacchā allena. upāhanāpuñchanacoḷakaṃ dhovitvā ekam'antaṃ vissajjetabbaṃ.

meaning_1: having wiped off; having cleaned away
example_1: evaṃ vutte, ānanda, subhaddā devī parodi assūni pavattesi. atha kho, ānanda, subhaddā devī assūni puñchitvā rājānaṃ mahāsudassanaṃ etadavoca
commentary: (DNa) atha kho, ānanda, subhaddā devī assūni puñchitvā'ti devī ekam'antaṃ gantvā roditvā kanditvā assūni puñchitvā etadavoca.

example_1: kiṃ nu satto'ti paccesi, māra diṭṭhigataṃ nu te, suddhasaṅkhārapuñjo'yaṃ, na'y'idha satt'upalabbhati.
example_2: araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanappatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ
commentary: (DNa) palālapuñjan'ti palālarāsi. (ITIa) aṭṭhipuñjo'ti aṭṭhisamūho.

example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni puñjakitāni terovassikāni
abhittharetha kalyāṇe, pāpā cittaṃ nivāraye, dandhañ'hi karoto puññaṃ, pāpasmiṃ ramatī mano.
example_2: sīlaṃ yāva jarā sādhu, saddhā sādhu patiṭṭhitā, paññā narānaṃ ratanaṃ, puññaṃ corehi dūharan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) puññan'ti puññacetanā, sā hi arūpattā pariharituṃ na sakkā'ti.

example_1: lābhī c'amhi cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū appapuññā app'esakkhā na lābhino cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārānan'ti.
example_2: mahantañ'ca taṃ padumavanañ'cā'ti mahāpadumavanaṃ, mahantī ca sā nadī cā'ti mahānadī, mahanto ca so maṇi cā'ti mahāmaṇi, mahanto ca so gahapatiko cā'ti mahāgahapatiko, mahantañ'ca taṃ dhanañ'cā'ti mahādhanaṃ, mahanto ca so puñño cā'ti mahāpuñño.
commentary: (SNa) appapuññā'ti parittapuññā.

meaning_1: who has made merit; who has done good; has gained spiritual wealth
example_1: patirūpe vase dese, ariyamittakaro siyā, sammāpaṇidhisampanno, pubbe puññakato naro, dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ yaso kitti, sukhañ'c'etaṃ'dhivattatī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) puññakato'ti katapuñño.

example_1: rājā satthu vacanaṃ sutvā, aho, bhante, bhāriyaṃ kammaṃ, ettake nāma bhoge vijjamāne n'eva attanā paribhuñji, na tumhādise buddhe dhuravihāre viharante puññakammaṃ akāsī'ti āha.
ye gahaṭṭhā puññakarā, sīlavanto upāsakā, dhammena dāraṃ posenti, te namassāmi mātalī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) puññakarā'ti catupaccayadānaṃ kusumbhasumanapūjā dīpasahassajālan'ti evam'ādipuññakārakā.

meaning_1: desiring merit; wishing to do meritorious deeds
example_1: kassapassa, bhikkhave, kulāni upasaṅkamato kulesu cittaṃ na sajjati na gayhati na bajjhati, labhantu lābhakāmā, puññakāmā karontu puññānī'ti, yathāsakena lābhena attamano hoti sumano, evaṃ paresaṃ lābhena attamano hoti sumano.
example_2: evam'ev'āhaṃ puññakāmo, disvā khettavar'uttamaṃ, yadi tattha kāraṃ na karomi, n'āhaṃ puññena atthiko.
commentary: (SNa) puññakāmo'ti puññ'atthiko (CPa) aham'pi puññakammassa rato laddhabbapuññaphalasaṅkhātaṃ puññakāmo

meaning_1: basis for good deeds; grounds for making merit
example_1: evaṃ sante, kho, māṇava, brāhmaṇānaṃ idaṃ chaṭṭhaṃ puññakiriyavatthu hoti, yadidaṃ anukampājātikan'ti.
commentary: (ANa) puññakiriyāni ca tāni tesaṃ tesaṃ ānisaṃsānaṃ vatthūni cā'ti puññakiriyavatthūni.

example_1: appamādaṃ pasaṃsanti, puññakiriyāsu paṇḍitā, appamatto ubho atthe, adhiggaṇhāti paṇḍito.

meaning_1: mountain of merit; mass of good
example_1: puññakhandhā'ti katakusalatāya puññakkhandhā viya.

meaning_1: exhaustion of merit; depletion of spiritual wealth
example_1: atha kho aññataro satto āyukkhayā vā puññakkhayā vā ābhassarakāyā cavitvā suññaṃ brahmavimānaṃ upapajjati. so tattha hoti manomayo pītibhakkho sayaṃpabho antalikkhacaro subhaṭṭhāyī, ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ tiṭṭhati.
example_2: devalokato hi devaputtā āyukkhayena puññakkhayena āhārakkhayena kopenā'ti catūhi kāraṇehi cavanti.
commentary: (DNa) āyukkhayā vā puññakkhayā vā'ti ye uḷāraṃ puññakammaṃ katvā yattha katthaci app'āyuke devaloke nibbattanti, te attano puññabalena ṭhātuṃ na sakkonti, tassa pana devalokassa āyuppamāṇen'eva cavantī'ti āyukkhayā cavantī'ti vuccanti. ye pana parittaṃ puññakammaṃ katvā dīgh'āyukadevaloke nibbattanti, te yāvat'āyukaṃ ṭhātuṃ na sakkonti, antarā'va cavantī'ti puññakkhayā cavantī'ti vuccanti.

example_1: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
example_2: sabbe'p'ime gāmavāsino maṃ hanantu vā bandhantu vā, īdise puññakkhette pānīyadānaṃ dassāmi evā'ti
commentary: (ANa) anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā'ti sabbalokassa asadisaṃ puññaviruhanaṭṭhānaṃ.

example_1: upaṭṭhite deyyadhamme, puññ'atthassa jigīsato, santesu paṭhamaṃ dinnā, vipulā hoti dakkhiṇā.
commentary: (ANa) puññ'atthassa jigīsato'ti puññena atthikassa puññaṃ gavesantassa.

example_1: ārogy'atthāya moceti, sukh'atthāya moceti, bhesajj'atthāya moceti, dān'atthāya moceti, puññ'atthāya moceti, yaññ'atthāya moceti, sagg'atthāya moceti
commentary: (VIN) puññ'atthāyā'ti puññaṃ bhavissati.

example_1: pucchām'ahaṃ gotamaṃ vadaññuṃ, (iti māgho māṇavo) kāsāyavāsiṃ agahaṃ carantaṃ, yo yācayogo dānapati gahaṭṭho, puññ'atthiko yajati puññapekkho, dadaṃ paresaṃ idha annapānaṃ, kathaṃ hutaṃ yajamānassa sujjhe.
commentary: (VVa) kesan'ti āha puññ'atthikānaṃ vipulapphalesinan'ti, puññena atthikānaṃ vipulaṃ mahantaṃ puññaphalaṃ icchantānaṃ, tathāgato eva lokassa puññakkhettan'ti dasseti. (CPa) puññ'atthiko'ti puññena atthiko, dhammacchandayutto.

meaning_1: stream of merit; shower of goodness; rain of fortune
example_1: āmodamāno pakireti, detha dethā'ti bhāsati, taṃ hi'ssa gajjitaṃ hoti, devass'eva pavassato, sā puññadhārā vipulā, dātāraṃ abhivassatī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) puññadhārā'ti anekadānacetanāmayā puññadhārā. (SNt) puññadhārā'ti puññamayadhārā puññ'ābhisandā.

example_1: katamesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ? dāyakassa puññ'antarāyakaro hoti, paṭiggāhakānaṃ lābh'antarāyakaro hoti, pubb'eva kho pan'assa attā khato ca hoti upahato ca. yo kho, vaccha, paraṃ dānaṃ dadantaṃ vāreti so imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ antarāyakaro hoti, tiṇṇaṃ pāripanthiko.

meaning_1: doing good and evil; merit and sin
example_1: samitāvi pahāya puññapāpaṃ, virajo ñatvā imaṃ parañ'ca lokaṃ, jātimaraṇaṃ upātivatto, samaṇo tādi pavuccate tath'attā.
example_2: anavassutacittassa, ananvāhatacetaso, puññapāpapahīnassa, n'atthi jāgarato bhayaṃ.

meaning_1: experiencing the fruit of meritorious and wicked deeds
example_1: sabbe sattā marissanti, maraṇ'antañ'hi jīvitaṃ, yathākammaṃ gamissanti, puññapāpaphal'ūpagā, nirayaṃ pāpakamm'antā, puññakammā ca suggatiṃ.
commentary: (NP) puññapāpaphal'ūpagā'ti kammānaṃ phaladassāvitā ca avippavāso ca.

meaning_1: looking for merit; seeking spiritual wealth
example_1: yaṃ kiñci yiṭṭhaṃ va hutaṃ va loke, saṃvaccharaṃ yajetha puññapekkho, sabbam'pi taṃ na catubhāgam'eti, abhivādanā ujugatesu seyyo.
example_2: aññena ca kevalinaṃ mah'esiṃ, khīṇ'āsavaṃ kukkuccavūpasantaṃ, annena pānena upaṭṭhahassu, khettaṃ hi taṃ puññapekkhassa hotī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) puññapekkhānan'ti puññaṃ icchantānaṃ puññ'atthikānaṃ. (ANa) puññapekkhānan'ti puññaṃ olokentānaṃ gavesantānaṃ. (DHPa) puññapekkho'ti puññaṃ icchanto.

grammar: adj, comp, dat pl of puññapekkha, irreg form of puññapekkhānaṃ
meaning_1: for (those) looking for merit; for (those) seeking spiritual wealth
construction:
puñña + pekkha + ānaṃ > āna
puññapekkha + āna
example_1: yajamānānaṃ manussānaṃ, puññapekkhāna pāṇinaṃ, karotaṃ opadhikaṃ puññaṃ, kattha dinnaṃ mahapphalan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) puññapekkhānan'ti puññaṃ icchantānaṃ puññ'atthikānaṃ.

meaning_1: way of making merit; beneficial practice
example_1: yo ca yajāpeti sabbe te anekasārīrikaṃ puññappaṭipadaṃ paṭipannā honti, yadidaṃ yaññ'ādhikaraṇaṃ.

meaning_1: result of meritorious deeds; fruit of good works
example_1: ettakaṃ puññaphalaṃ tumhākaṃ pattiṃ katvā dammi, mayhaṃ kumud'uppalehi saddhiṃ aruṇavatīmattikaṃ āharathā'ti tikkhattuṃ anussāvesi. tattha adhivattho nāgarājā taṃ saddaṃ sutvā mahallakavesena tassa santikaṃ gantvā kiṃ vadesī'ti āha.

meaning_1: arising of good consequences of merit
living on the fruit of one's merit
example_1: uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī no puññaphal'ūpajīvī, puññaphal'ūpajīvī no uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī, uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī ca puññaphal'ūpajīvī ca, n'eva uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī no puññaphal'ūpajīvī.
commentary: (DNt) ye pana attano puññaphalam'eva upajīventi, te puññaphal'ūpajīvino.

meaning_1: meritorious; related to merit; connected with good deeds
example_1: sammādiṭṭhiṃ'p'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, dvayaṃ vadāmi. atthi, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi sāsavā puññabhāgiyā upadhivepakkā, atthi, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi ariyā anāsavā lok'uttarā magg'aṅgā.
example_2: katamo ca, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ vipāko? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, kāmayamāno tajjaṃ tajjaṃ attabhāvaṃ abhinibbatteti puññabhāgiyaṃ vā apuññabhāgiyaṃ vā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ vipāko.
commentary: (MNa) puññabhāgiyā'ti puññakoṭṭhāsabhūtā.

meaning_1: who has a share in the merit
example_1: satthā suddhavatthaṃ pasāresi, dhātuyo tattha patiṃsu. tā patte pakkhipitvā catumahāpathe thūpaṃ kāresi mahājano vanditvā puññabhāgī bhavissatī'ti.
ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, yam'idaṃ, bho gotama, dāne puññañ'ca puññamahī ca taṃ dāyakānaṃ sukhāya hotū'ti.
commentary: (MNa) puññamahī'ti vipākakkhandhānaṃ'y'eva parivāro.

meaning_1: accumulation of merit; amassing of spiritual wealth
example_1: sāvako'pi khīṇ'āsavo sāvakabodhiyā hetubhūte puññasambhāre sambharanto pubbayogaṃ pubbacariyaṃ gatapaccāgatavattaṃ pūrento carimabhave nibbattanto anukkamena viññutaṃ patvā saṃsāre ādīnavaṃ disvā pabbajjāya cetayamāno pabbajjaṃ matthakaṃ pāpetvā sīl'ādīni paripūrento dhutadhamme samādāya…
example_2: tassa hi pātubhāvā ratanāni pātubhavanti. pātubhūtehi pana tehi saddhiṃ paripakke puññasambhāre so saṃyujjati, tadā lokassa tesu pātubhāvacittaṃ uppajjati. bahulavacanato c'āpi yuttam'ev'etaṃ.

example_1: lokkhasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, puññasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, bāhukāya pana nadiyā bahujano pāpakammaṃ kataṃ pavāhetī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) puññasammatā'ti puññan'ti sammatā.

example_1: yāvatā, bho, rañño pasenadissa kosalassa vijitaṃ yattha ca rājā pasenadi kosalo issariy'ādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kāreti, pahoti tattha rājā pasenadi kosalo samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā puññavantaṃ vā apuññavantaṃ vā brahmacariyavantaṃ vā abrahmacariyavantaṃ vā tamhā ṭhānā cāvetuṃ vā pabbājetuṃ vā'ti.
commentary: (BVa) puññavanto'ti mahāpuññā.

meaning_1: fruit of merit; results of good deeds
example_1: so khv'āhaṃ, bhante, evaṃ dīgharattaṃ katānaṃ puññānaṃ evaṃ dīgharattaṃ katānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pariyantaṃ n'ādhigacchāmi, ettakaṃ puññan'ti vā ettako puññavipāko'ti vā ettakaṃ sagge ṭhātabban'ti vā'ti.

meaning_1: makes merit; performs good deeds; does good works
example_1: devassa kho dānaṃ dīyati, amhākaṃ dānaṃ na dīyati. sādhu mayam'pi devaṃ nissāya dānāni dadeyyāma, puññāni kareyyāmā'ti.
example_2: accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo, vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti, etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno, puññāni kayirātha sukh'āvahānī'ti.

example_1: atthāyaṃ itarā pajā, puññābhāgā'ti me mano, saṅkhātuṃ no'pi sakkomi, musāvādassa ottappanti.

meaning_1: meritorious intention; positive karmic formations; wholesome intentional activity
example_1: yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno avijjā pahīnā hoti vijjā uppannā, so avijjāvirāgā vijj'uppādā n'eva puññ'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti na apuññ'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti na āneñj'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti.
commentary: (PMa) puññ'ābhisaṅkhāro'ti-ādīsu punāti attano kārakaṃ, pūreti c'assa ajjhāsayaṃ, pujjañ'ca bhavaṃ nibbattetī'ti puññaṃ, abhisaṅkharoti vipākaṃ kaṭattārūpañ'cā'ti abhisaṅkhāro, puññaṃ abhisaṅkhāro puññ'ābhisaṅkhāro.

meaning_1: stream of merit; meritorious result; outflow of goodness
meaning_2: accumulation of merit, outcome of merit
example_1: ayaṃ paṭhamo puññ'ābhisando kusal'ābhisando sukhass'āhāro.
commentary: (SNa) puññ'ābhisandā kusal'ābhisandā'ti puññanadiyo kusalanadiyo. (SNt) avicchedena niccappavattiyamānāni puññāni abhisandan'aṭṭhena puññ'ābhisandā'ti vuttā, tena puññanadiyo'ti attho vutto.

meaning_2: Chapter 4 of the Sotāpattisaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

meaning_1: headed according to one's merit; (or) headed towards a meritorious destination
example_1: avijjāgato yaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalo puññaṃ ce saṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, puññ'ūpagaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ. apuññaṃ ce saṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, apuññ'ūpagaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) puññ'ūpagaṃ hoti viññāṇan'ti kammaviññāṇaṃ kammapuññena upagataṃ sampayuttaṃ hoti, vipākaviññāṇaṃ vipākapuññena.

meaning_2: container (usually made of leaves), pocket, basket

meaning_1: container; wrap; pocket (usually made of a folded leaf)
meaning_2: container (usually made of leaves), pocket, basket

commentary: (MNa) paṇḍupuṭakassa sālino'ti puṭake katvā sukkhāpitassa rattasālino.

meaning_1: opening of packages; place where goods are distributed
example_1: yāvatā, ānanda, ariyaṃ āyatanaṃ yāvatā vaṇippatho idaṃ agganagaraṃ bhavissati pāṭaliputtaṃ puṭabhedanaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) puṭabhedanan'ti bhaṇḍapuṭabhedanaṭṭhānaṃ, bhaṇḍabhaṇḍikānaṃ mocanaṭṭhānan'ti vuttaṃ hoti. sakalajambudīpe aladdhabhaṇḍam'pi hi idh'eva labhissanti, aññattha vikkayena agacchantam'pi ca idh'eva gamissati. tasmā idh'eva puṭaṃ bhindissantī'ti attho. catūsu hi dvāresu cattāri sabhāyaṃ ekan'ti evaṃ divase divase pañcasatasahassāni uṭṭhahissantī'ti dasseti.

meaning_2: shoulder bag; knapsack on the sholder; bag carrying provisions on journeys
example_1: yathārūpaṃ parisaṃ alaṃ yojanagaṇanāni'pi dassanāya gantuṃ api puṭ'aṃsenā'pi, tathārūpo ayaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhusaṅgho.
commentary: (ANa) puṭ'aṃsenā'ti'pi pāṭho. tass'attho, puṭo aṃse assā'ti puṭ'aṃso, tena puṭ'aṃsena, aṃsena pātheyyapuṭaṃ vahantenā'pī'ti

example_1: tathārūpo ayaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhusaṅgho, tathārūpā ayaṃ, bhikkhave, parisā yathārūpaṃ parisaṃ alaṃ yojanagaṇanāni dassanāya gantuṃ puṭ'osenā'pi.
commentary: (MNa) puṭ'osenā'pī'ti puṭ'osaṃ vuccati pātheyyaṃ. taṃ pātheyyaṃ gahetvā'pi upasaṅkamituṃ yuttam'evā'ti attho. puṭ'aṃsenā'ti'pi pāṭho, tass'attho puṭo aṃse assā'ti puṭ'aṃso, tena puṭ'aṃsena, aṃse pātheyyapuṭaṃ vahantenā'pī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

example_1: anagāriy'upetassa, bhikkhācariyaṃ jigīsato, muni pabrūhi me puṭṭho, moneyyaṃ uttamaṃ padaṃ.
example_2: evaṃ puṭṭhā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā na c'eva sampāyissanti, uttariñ'ca vighātaṃ āpajjissanti. taṃ kissa hetu? yathā taṃ, bhikkhave, avisayasmiṃ.

example_1: middhī yadā hoti mahagghaso ca, niddāyitā samparivattasāyī, mahāvarāho'va nivāpapuṭṭho, punappunaṃ gabbham'upeti mando.
example_2: sūro yathā rājakhādāya puṭṭho, abhigajjam'eti paṭisūram'icchaṃ, yen'eva so tena palehi sūra, pubb'eva n'atthi yadidaṃ yudhāya.

meaning_1: coming to ask; arriving to question
example_1: kathaṃ satassa carato, viññāṇaṃ uparujjhati, bhagavantaṃ puṭṭhum'āgamma, taṃ suṇoma vaco tava.
example_2: kati lokasmiṃ pajjotā, yehi loko pakāsati, bhagavantaṃ puṭṭhum'āgamma, kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayan'ti.

example_1: sutvān'ahaṃ vīram'akāmakāmiṃ, ogh'ātigaṃ puṭṭhum'akāmam'āgamaṃ, santipadaṃ brūhi sahajanetta, yathātacchaṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.
example_2: kathaṃ satassa carato, viññāṇaṃ uparujjhati, bhagavantaṃ puṭṭhum'āgamma, taṃ suṇoma vaco tava.
commentary: (SNa) puṭṭhun'ti pucchituṃ.

example_1: evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, āvuso, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ, viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ. yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ, yaṃ dukkhaṃ taṃ niruddhaṃ tadatthaṅ'gatan'ti. evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, āvuso, evaṃ byākareyyan'ti.

meaning_1: (comm) part of the Avīci hell where one must stay a puṇḍarika-count in duration
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, vīsati kumudā nirayā, evam'eko sogandhiko nirayo. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, vīsati sogandhikā nirayā, evam'eko uppalanirayo. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, vīsati uppalā nirayā, evam'eko puṇḍariko nirayo.
tass'uddānaṃ puṇḍarī-aggisaha-kathināmo, dīghanakho puna bhāradvājagotto, sandaka-udāyi-muṇḍikaputto, maṇiko tathākaccāno varavaggo.

meaning_1: lotus; (specifically) white lotus; (comm) lotus with less than one hundred petals; (or) pink lotus
example_1: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā app'ekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā
example_2: seyyathā'pi, vāhana, uppalaṃ vā padumaṃ vā puṇḍarīkaṃ vā udake jātaṃ udake saṃvaḍḍhaṃ udakā paccuggamma ṭhitaṃ anupalittaṃ udakena.
commentary: (ANa) ettha ca setarattanīlesu yaṃkiñci uppalam'eva, ūnakasatapattaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ, satapattaṃ padumaṃ. pattaniyamaṃ vā vinā'pi setaṃ padumaṃ, rattaṃ puṇḍarīkan'ti ayam'ettha vinicchayo.

meaning_1: fragrant mango tree; white mango; Mangifera indica
example_1: sikhī, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho puṇḍarīkassa mūle abhisambuddho.
commentary: (DNa) ettha pana puṇḍarīko'ti set'ambarukkho.

meaning_1: one of the four treasures of a Bodhisatta
example_1: tathāgatassa pana jātadivase'y'eva saṅkho, elo, uppalo, puṇḍarīko'ti cattāro nidhayo uggatā. tesu saṅkho gāvutiko, elo aḍḍhayojaniko, uppalo tigāvutiko, puṇḍarīko yojaniko. tesu'pi gahitaṃ gahitaṃ pūrati'y'eva, iti bhagavā pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ ohāya pabbajito'ti veditabbo.
seyyathā'pi bhikkhave uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā app'ekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā
disvāna taṇhaṃ aratiṃ ragañ'ca, n'āhosi chando api methunasmiṃ, kim'ev'idaṃ muttakarīsapuṇṇaṃ, pādā'pi naṃ samphusituṃ na icche.
example_2: catucakkaṃ navadvāraṃ, puṇṇaṃ lobhena saṃyutaṃ, paṅkajātaṃ mahāvīra, kathaṃ yātrā bhavissatī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) puṇṇan'ti asucipūraṃ.

example_1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadah'uposathe pannarase puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto abbhokāse nisinno hoti.
example_2: kiṃ ummatto'si, nanu idān'eva divākaro atthaṅ'gato, so kathaṃ imaṃ puṇṇacandaṃ anubandhamāno uggacchissati?
commentary: (SNPa) puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā'ti pannarasadivasattā divasagaṇanāya abbh'ādi-upakkilesa-virahattā rattiguṇasampattiyā ca puṇṇattā puṇṇāya, paripuṇṇacandattā puṇṇamāya ca rattiyā.

meaning_1: name of a Sakyan arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in giving Dhamma talks; Puṇṇa Mantāṇiputta
family_set: great disciples; names of arahants; names of monks
example_1: puṇṇo nāma, bhante, āyasmā mantāṇiputto jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito, attanā ca app'iccho app'icchakathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā
example_2: evaṃ vutte, āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ etadavoca, konāmo āyasmā, kathañ'ca pan'āyasmantaṃ sabrahmacārī jānantī'ti? puṇṇo'ti kho me, āvuso, nāmaṃ, mantāṇiputto'ti ca pana maṃ sabrahmacārī jānantī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) puṇṇo'ti tassa therassa nāmaṃ. (AN1.196) etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ puṇṇo mantāṇiputto.
notes: Theragāthā verse 4 (TH1.4, TH4) is attributed to him.

meaning_1: name of an arahant monk from Sunāparanta; Puṇṇa Sunāparanta
family_set: names of arahants; names of monks
example_1: caṇḍā kho, puṇṇa, sunāparantakā manussā, pharusā kho, puṇṇa, sunāparantakā manussā. sace taṃ, puṇṇa, sunāparantakā manussā akkosissanti paribhāsissanti, tatra te, puṇṇa, kin'ti bhavissatī'ti?
commentary: (THa) so tena puññakammena devamanussesu saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde sunāparantajanapade suppārakapaṭṭane gahapatikule nibbatti, puṇṇo'ti'ssa nāmaṃ ahosi. so vayappatto vāṇijjavasena mahatā satthena saddhiṃ sāvatthiṃ gato. tena ca samayena bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati. atha so sāvatthivāsīhi upāsakehi saddhiṃ vihāraṃ gato satthu santike dhammaṃ sutvā paṭiladdhasaddho pabbajitvā vattapaṭivattehi ācariy'upajjhāye ārādhento vihāsi.
notes: Theragāthā verse 70 (TH1.70, TH70) is attributed to him.

meaning_1: name of a Koliyan ascetic who performed the cow practice
example_1: atha kho puṇṇo ca koliyaputto govatiko acelo ca seniyo kukkuravatiko yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

example_1: atirekaṃ kho pan'imassa bhoto satthuno naggiyaṃ muṇḍiyaṃ ukkuṭikappadhānaṃ kesamassulocanaṃ yo'haṃ puttasambādhavasanaṃ ajjhāvasanto kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhonto mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārento jātarūparajataṃ sādiyanto iminā bhotā satthārā samasamagatiko bhavissāmi abhisamparāyaṃ.

commentary: (ANa) tam'eva putt'assādaṃ nikāmayamāno'ti yv'āssa dhītaraṃ vā puttaṃ vā jātaṃ disvā puttapemaṃ putt'assādo uppajjati, taṃ patthayamāno icchamāno.

commentary: (MNa) so hi puthūnaṃ nānappakārānaṃ kilesādīnaṃ jananādīhi kāraṇehi puthujjano. yath'āha, puthu kilese janentī'ti puthujjanā, puthu avihatasakkāyadiṭṭhikā'ti puthujjanā, puthu satthārānaṃ mukham'ullokikā'ti puthujjanā, puthu sabbagatīhi avuṭṭhitā'ti puthujjanā, puthu nān'ābhisaṅkhāre abhisaṅkharontī'ti puthujjanā, puthu nānāoghehi vuyhantī'ti puthujjanā, puthu nānāsantāpehi santappantī'ti puthujjanā, puthu nānāpariḷāhehi paridayhantī'ti puthujjanā, puthu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu rattā giddhā gadhitā mucchitā ajjhosannā laggā lagitā palibuddhā'ti puthujjanā, puthu pañcahi nīvaraṇehi āvuṭā nivutā ovutā pihitā paṭicchannā paṭikujjitāti puthujjanā'ti (mahāni. 51). puthūnaṃ vā gaṇanapatham'atītānaṃ ariyadhammaparammukhānaṃ nīcadhammasamācārānaṃ janānaṃ antogadhattā'pi puthujjanā. puthu vā ayaṃ, visuṃ'y'eva saṅkhaṃ gato, visaṃsaṭṭho sīlasut'ādiguṇayuttehi ariyehi jano'ti'pi puthujjano.

meaning_1: highest state of being for a common person; peak of existence for a normal man

level of the common man; stage of being a normal person

commentary: (MNa) puthujjanasīlavante'ti puthujjanasīlavā nāma gosīladhātuko hoti, asaṭho amāyāvī paraṃ apīḷetvā dhammena samena kasiyā vā vaṇijjāya vā jīvikaṃ kappetā.

example_1: ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ iddhañ'c'eva phītañ'ca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitan'ti.
commentary: (DNa) puthubhūtan'ti sabb'ākāravasena puthulabhāvappattaṃ.

example_1: taṃ nūna soṇiṃ puthulaṃ sukoṭṭitaṃ, nisevitaṃ kañcanamekhalāhi, chinnaṃ vane khattiyehī avatthaṃ, siṅgālasaṅghā parikaḍḍhissanti.

grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of puthula
example_1: puthulato pana diyaḍḍharatanaṃ dvīsu passesu ratanamatt'ānucaṅkamaṃ dīghato saṭṭhihatthaṃ mudutalaṃ sama-vippakiṇṇa-vālukaṃ caṅkamaṃ vaṭṭati cetiyagirimhi dīpappasādaka-mahindattherassa caṅkamanaṃ viya, tādisaṃ taṃ ahosi.

meaning_1: with a great noise; make a cacophony

commentary: (MNa) puthu mahā saddo assā'ti puthusaddo.

meaning_1: other doctrines of different ascetics and Brahmans; alternate beliefs of various monks and priests
sanskrit: pṛthu, pṛthak + śramaṇa + brāhmaṇa + para + pravāda
example_1: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yam'idaṃ dhammasamādānaṃ paccuppannasukhañ'c'eva āyatiñ'ca sukhavipākaṃ tadaññe puthu-samaṇabrāhmaṇa-parappavāde abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocate cā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) puthu-samaṇabrāhmaṇa-parappavāde'ti puthūnaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇasaṅkhātānaṃ paresaṃ vāde.

meaning_1: doctrines of different ascetics and Brahmans; pronouncements of various monks and priests
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bho, puriso aggarasaparititto na aññesaṃ hīnānaṃ rasānaṃ piheti, evam'evaṃ kho, bho, yato yato tassa bhoto gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti, yadi suttaso, yadi geyyaso, yadi veyyākaraṇaso, yadi abbhutadhammaso, tato tato na aññesaṃ puthu-samaṇabrāhmaṇa-ppavādānaṃ piheti.
commentary: (ANa) aññesaṃ puthu-samaṇabrāhmaṇā-ppavādānan'ti ye aññesaṃ puthūnaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ laddhisaṅkhātappavādā, tesaṃ.

meaning_1: doctrines of different ascetics and Brahmans; beliefs of various monks and priests
example_1: kesakambalo, bhikkhave, sīte sīto, uṇhe uṇho, dubbaṇṇo, duggandho, dukkhasamphasso. evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, yāni kānici puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇavādānaṃ makkhalivādo tesaṃ paṭikiṭṭho akkhāyati.
commentary: (ANa) puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇavādānan'ti idam'pi paccatte sāmivacanaṃ.

meaning_1: many different ascetics and Brahmans; various monks and priests
construction:
puthu + samaṇā + brāhmaṇa + ā
puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇa + ā
example_1: tiṭṭhat'esā, bho gotama, amhākañ'c'eva aññesañ'ca puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ vācā. vilāpaṃ vilapitaṃ maññe.
example_2: api nu tumhe, bhikkhave, evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā yāni tāni puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ vata kotūhalamaṅgalāni tāni sārato paccāgaccheyyāthā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

example_1: yo hi koci manussesu, puthusippena jīvati, evaṃ vāseṭṭha jānāhi, sippiko so na brāhmaṇo.
commentary: (MNa) puthusippenā'ti tantavāya-kamm'ādi-nānāsippena.

meaning_1: various professions; different kinds of work
construction:
puthu + sippa + āyatana + āni
puthusippāyatana + āni
example_1: yathā nu kho imāni, bhante, puthusipp'āyatanāni, seyyath'idaṃ, hatth'ārohā ass'ārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsikaputtā āḷārikā kappakā nhāpakā sūdā mālākārā rajakā pesakārā naḷakārā
commentary: (DNa) sippam'eva sipp'āyatanaṃ. puthusipp'āyatanānī'ti bahūni sippāni.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, gāmaṇi, puriso mahatiṃ puthusilaṃ gambhīre udakarahade pakkhipeyya.
example_2: seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puthusilā dvedhābhinnā appaṭisandhikā hoti. evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, ākiñcaññ'āyatan'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye āneñjasaṃyojane se bhinne.

grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of puthu
example_1: aññaṃ ito y'ābhivadanti dhammaṃ, aparaddhā suddhim'akevalī te, evam'pi titthyā puthuso vadanti, sandiṭṭhirāgena hi te'bhirattā.

meaning_1: attached to many; (or) attached to by many
example_1: ye kec'ime vādapathā puthussitā, yaṃ nissitā samaṇabrāhmaṇā ca, tathāgataṃ patvā na te bhavant, visāradaṃ vādapath'ātivattaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) puthū'ti bahū. sitā'ti upanibaddhā abhisaṅkhatā. atha vā puthussitā'ti puthubhāvaṃ sitā upagatā, puthūhi vā sitā'ti'pi puthussitā.

example_1: mah'odadhiṃ aparimitaṃ mahāsaraṃ, bahubheravaṃ ratanagaṇānam'ālayaṃ, najjo yathā naragaṇasaṅghasevitā, puthū savantī upayanti sāgaraṃ.
example_2: idh'eva suddhi iti vādayanti, n'āññesu dhammesu visuddhim'āhu, yaṃ nissitā tattha subhaṃ vadānā, paccekasaccesu puthū niviṭṭhā.

meaning_1: in many ways; in different ways; variously
example_1: anejaṃ mūladassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kiṃ nissitā isayo manujā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā devatānaṃ, yaññam'akappayiṃsu puthū'dha loke, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.
example_2: parassa ce vambhayitena hīno, na koci dhammesu visesi assa, puthū hi aññassa vadanti dhammaṃ, nihīnato sam'hi daḷhaṃ vadānā.

gahakāraka diṭṭho'si, puna gehaṃ na kāhasi, sabbā te phāsukā bhaggā, gahakūṭaṃ visaṅkhataṃ, visaṅkhāragataṃ cittaṃ, taṇhānaṃ khayamajjhagā.
example_2: seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puriso manuññabhojanaṃ bhuttāvī chaḍḍeyya. taṃ kiṃ maññasi, sunakkhatta, api nu tassa purisassa tasmiṃ vante puna bhottu'kamyatā assā'ti?

example_1: punakammāya ukkoṭeyyā'ti, akataṃ kammaṃ dukkaṭaṃ kammaṃ punakātabbaṃ kammaṃ anihataṃ dunnihataṃ puna nihanitabbaṃ'ti ukkoṭeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

example_1: te raññā paṭikkhittā ekam'antaṃ apakkamma evaṃ samacintesuṃ, na kho etaṃ amhākaṃ patirūpaṃ, yaṃ mayaṃ imāni sāpateyyāni puna'd'eva sakāni gharāni paṭihareyyāma.
example_2: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rājañña, api nu tassa purisassa sunhātassa suvilittassa sukappitakesamassussa āmukkamāl'ābharaṇassa odātavatthavasanassa uparipāsādavaragatassa pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitassa samaṅgībhūtassa paricārayamānassa puna'd'eva tasmiṃ gūthakūpe nimujjitu'kāmatā

example_1: gattāni parimajjitvā, puna'p'āruyha caṅkamaṃ, caṅkame caṅkamiṃ so'haṃ, ajjhattaṃ susamāhito.

grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of punappuna
example_1: puññañ'ce puriso kayirā, kayirāth'etaṃ punappunaṃ, tamhi chandaṃ kayirātha, sukho puññassa uccayo.
example_2: yo ve avidvā upadhiṃ karoti, punappunaṃ dukkham'upeti mando, tasmā pajānaṃ upadhiṃ na kayirā, dukkhassa jātippabhav'ānupassī.

meaning_1: coming again and again; repeatedly coming
example_1: kiṃsu harantaṃ vārenti, haranto pana ko piyo, kiṃsu punappun'āyantaṃ, abhinandanti paṇḍitā'ti.

meaning_1: appearing again; renewed existence; rebirth; future life
example_1: yassa kho brāhmaṇa āyatiṃ gabbhaseyyā punabbhava-abhinibbatti pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tāl'āvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā tam'ahaṃ apagabbho'ti vadāmi
example_2: ñāṇañ'ca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi. akuppā me vimutti, ayam'antimā jāti, n'atthi dāni punabbhavo'ti
commentary: (MNa) n'atthi dāni punabbhavo'ti idāni me puna paṭisandhi nāma n'atthī'ti evaṃ paccavekkhaṇañāṇam'pi me uppannan'ti dasseti. (SNa) n'atthi dāni punabbhavo'ti idāni puna añño bhavo nāma n'atthī'ti.

meaning_1: production of renewed existence; birth of renewed becoming
example_1: tatra kallaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ, viññāṇ'āhāro āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbattiyā paccayo, tasmiṃ bhūte sati saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso'ti.
example_2: yañ'ca, bhikkhave, ceteti yañ'ca pakappeti yañ'ca anuseti, ārammaṇam'etaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā. ārammaṇe sati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa hoti. tasmiṃ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti hoti.
commentary: (MNa) punabbhavassa abhinibbattī'ti punabbhavābhinibbatti.

grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of punabhava
example_1: atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhīto saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto bhagavantaṃ'y'eva tāṇaṃ gavesī bhagavantaṃ'y'eva leṇaṃ gavesī bhagavantaṃ'y'eva saraṇaṃ gavesī, upanisīditvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, kim'etaṃ bhavaṃ gotamo āha? punabhavaṃ gotamo bravitū'ti.

na kho pana so, sāriputta, saṃsāro sulabharūpo yo mayā asaṃsaritapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā, aññatra suddh'āvāsehi devehi. suddh'āvāse c'āhaṃ, sāriputta, deve saṃsareyyaṃ, na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punarāgaccheyyaṃ.

meaning_1: come here again; returned here once more

commentary: (DNa) caviya punaridh'āgato'ti cavitvā puna idh'āgato.
