example_2: yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imaṃ rukkhaṃ ārohitvā yāva'd'atthañ'ca khādeyyaṃ ucchaṅgañ'ca pūreyyan'ti. so taṃ rukkhaṃ ārohitvā yāva'd'atthañ'ca khādeyya ucchaṅgañ'ca pūreyya.
commentary: (THIa) pūrassu dhammehī'ti sattatiṃsa-bodhipakkhiyadhammehi paripuṇṇā hohi.

example_1: so taṃ disvā, bhante, imasmiṃ sāsane kati dhurāni nāmā'ti pucchi. āvuso, vipassanādhuraṃ, ganthadhuran'ti. bhante, gantho nāma paṭibalassa bhāro, mayhaṃ pana dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, vipassanādhuraṃ pūressāmi kammaṭṭhānaṃ me dethā'ti vanditvā nisīdi.
evaṃ sante mayaṃ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇacaṇḍālam'pi na pūrema.

meaning_1: to fulfil; to complete; to accomplish
meaning_2: to fill, to fulfil, to complete

example_1: atha naṃ, idaṃ sītalaṃ bhavissatī'ti kaṭacchuṃ pūretvā ādāya āgacchantiṃ uttarāya dāsiyo disvā, apehi dubbinīte, na tvaṃ amhākaṃ ayyāya pakkuthitaṃ sappiṃ āsiñcituṃ anucchavikā'ti.
example_2: rājā te sabbe gāhāpetvā rāj'aṅgaṇe nābhippamāṇe āvāṭe khaṇāpetvā te tattha nisīdāpetvā paṃsūhi pūretvā upari palāle vikirāpetvā aggiṃ dāpesi.

meaning_1: having fulfilled; having completed; having accomplished
example_1: evam'evā'ti etthā'pi idaṃ opammasaṃsandanaṃ, sālalaṭṭhi viya attabhāvo, nadīsotaṃ viya saṃsārasotaṃ, pāraṃ gantu'kāmapuriso viya yog'āvacaro, bahiddhā suparikammakatakālo viya chasu dvāresu saṃvarassa paccupaṭṭhitakālo, anto suvisodhitabhāvo viya abbhantare parisuddhasīlabhāvo, phiy'ārittabandhanaṃ viya kāyikacetasika-vīriya-karaṇaṃ, sotthinā pārimatīragamanaṃ viya anupubbena sīlaṃ pūretvā samādhiṃ pūretvā paññaṃ pūretvā nibbānagamanaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

so lābhasakkāraṃ jigucchanto pabbajjaṃ anupagantvā, pahomi c'āhaṃ lābh'ālābh'ādīsu nibbikāro hotun'ti attānaṃ takkento, visesato para-paribhava-sahan'ādi-paṭipadaṃ pūrento upekkhāpāramiṃ matthakaṃ pāpessāmī'ti
atha kho te thūṇeyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā udapānaṃ tiṇassa ca bhusassa ca yāva mukhato pūresuṃ, mā te muṇḍakā samaṇakā pānīyaṃ apaṃsū'ti.

meaning_1: cake; (comm) various sweets and pastries made as a gift
example_1: bhikkhuṃ pan'eva kulaṃ upagataṃ pūvehi vā manthehi vā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavāreyya, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā dvattipattapūrā paṭiggahetabbā.
commentary: (KVa) pūvehī'ti paheṇak'atthāya paṭiyattehi atirasaka-modaka-sakkhalik'ādīhi yehi kehici khajjakehi.
(VINa) pūvagharaṃ nāma vikkāyikakhajjakapacanagharaṃ.

example_1: surā nāma piṭṭhasurā pūvasurā odanasurā kiṇṇapakkhittā sambhārasaṃyuttā.
commentary: (VINt) evaṃ pūve odane ca bhājane pakkhipitvā tajjaṃ udakaṃ datvā madditvā katā pūvasurā odanasurā'ti ca vuccati.

example_1: gaṇikā kumbhadāsī ca, pūvikā macchikā'pi ca, yathāsakena thāmena, pūgadhammaṃ akaṃsu te.
commentary: (DNt) pūvikā'ti pūvasampādakā, ye pūvam'eva nānappakārato sampādetvā vikkiṇantā jīvan'ti.

example_1: aññena ca kevalinaṃ mah'esiṃ, khīṇ'āsavaṃ kukkuccavūpasantaṃ, annena pānena upaṭṭhahassu, khettaṃ hi taṃ puññapekkhassa hotī'ti.
example_2: upanīyati jīvitam'appam'āyu, jar'ūpanītassa na santi tāṇā, etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno, lok'āmisaṃ pajahe santipekkho'ti.
commentary: (SNa) santipekkho'ti nibbānasaṅkhātaṃ accantasantiṃ pekkhanto icchanto patthayanto'ti.

example_1: naccaṃ gītaṃ vāditaṃ pekkhaṃ akkhānaṃ pāṇissaraṃ vetāḷaṃ kumbhathūṇaṃ sobhanakaṃ caṇḍālaṃ vaṃsaṃ dhovanaṃ hatthiyuddhaṃ assayuddhaṃ mahiṃsayuddhaṃ usabhayuddhaṃ ajayuddhaṃ meṇḍayuddhaṃ kukkuṭayuddhaṃ vaṭṭakayuddhaṃ daṇḍayuddhaṃ muṭṭhiyuddhaṃ
commentary: (DNa) pekkhan'ti naṭasamajjaṃ.

example_1: apalokento kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo sabbakāyen'eva apaloketi, so na uddhaṃ ulloketi, na adho oloketi, na ca vipekkhamāno gacchati, yugamattañ'ca pekkhati, tato c'assa uttari anāvaṭaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ bhavati.
example_2: api ca kho mātugāmassa cakkhunā cakkhuṃ upanijjhāyati pekkhati

example_1: okkhittacakkhunā antaraghare gantabbaṃ yugamattaṃ pekkhantena. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca tahaṃ tahaṃ olokento antaraghare gacchati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
example_2: yo ve buddhena codito, bhikkhu saṅghassa pekkhato, migāramātupāsādaṃ, pād'aṅguṭṭhena kampayi.

example_1: ākiñcaññaṃ pekkhamāno satimā, n'atthī'ti nissāya tarassu oghaṃ, kāme pahāya virato kathāhi, taṇhakkhayaṃ nattam'ah'ābhipassa.
example_2: tasmā pajānaṃ na upādiyetha, bhikkhu sato kiñcanaṃ sabbaloke, ādānasatte iti pekkhamāno, pajaṃ imaṃ maccudheyye visattan'ti.

meaning_1: having showed around; having given a tour

example_1: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno na ca visaṭaṃ, na ca visāci, na ca pana viceyya pekkhitā, ujuṃ tathā pasaṭam'ujumano, piyacakkhunā bahujanaṃ udikkhitā ahosi.
commentary: (DNa) na ca pana viceyya pekkhitā'ti viceyya pekkhitā nāma yo kujjhitvā yadā naṃ paro oloketi, tadā nimmīleti na oloketi, puna gacchantaṃ kujjhitvā oloketi, evarūpo n'āhosi. vineyyapekkhitā'ti'pi pāṭho, ayam'ev'attho.

meaning_1: to see; to take a look (at)

commentary: (JAa) pekhuṇānī'ti piñchāni.

example_1: atha kho sāḷho ca migāranattā rohaṇo ca pekhuṇiyanattā yen'āyasmā nandako ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ nandakaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
commentary: (ANa) sekhuniyanattā'ti sekhuniyaseṭṭhino nattā.

example_1: idha socati pecca socati, pāpakārī ubhay'attha socati, so socati so vihaññati, disvā kammakiliṭṭham'attano.
example_2: yam'pi taṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ, so loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassāmī'ti, tam'pi n'etaṃ mama, n'eso'ham'asmi, na m'eso attā'ti samanupassati.

example_1: ye me petā ñātī sālohitā kālaṅ'katā pasannacittā anussaranti tesaṃ taṃ mahapphalaṃ assa mah'ānisaṃsan'ti
example_2: supinena yathā'pi saṅgataṃ, paṭibuddho puriso na passati, evam'pi piyāyitaṃ janaṃ, petaṃ kālakataṃ na passati.

example_1: saṅghassa añjaliṃ katvā, idh'ekacce vadām'ahaṃ, apaviddhā anāthā te, yathā petā tath'eva te.
example_2: yathā vārivahā pūrā paripūrenti sāgaraṃ, evam'eva ito dinnaṃ petānaṃ upakappati.
commentary: (SNa) petā'ti susāne chaḍḍitā kālaṅ'katamanussā.

meaning_1: ghost state; state of being a spirit
construction:
pa + e + ta + ttana
peta + ttana

meaning_1: ghostly incarnation; existence as a spirit
personal possession of the departed; something belonging to the deceased; (comm) holdings of departed spirits
example_1: anāpatti sasaññissa, vissāsaggāhe, tāvakālike, petapariggahe, tiracchānagatapariggahe, paṃsukūlasaññissa, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
commentary: (VINa) petapariggahe'ti ettha pana pettivisaye upapannā'pi kālaṃ katvā tasmiṃ'y'eva attabhāve nibbattā'pi cātumahārājik'ādayo devā'pi sabbe petā'tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gatā, tesaṃ pariggahe anāpatti.

meaning_1: world of the departed; ghost realm
example_1: saṃsaraṃ hi nirayaṃ agacchissaṃ, petalokam'agamaṃ punappunaṃ, dukkhamamhi'pi tiracchānayoniyaṃ, n'ekadhā hi vusitaṃ ciraṃ mayā.
commentary: (THa) petalokan'ti pettivisayaṃ, khuppipās'ādi-bhedaṃ pet'attabhāvan'ti attho.

example_1: saṃsaraṃ hi nirayaṃ agacchissaṃ, petalokam'agamaṃ punappunaṃ, dukkhamamhi'pi tiracchānayoniyaṃ, n'ekadhā hi vusitaṃ ciraṃ mayā.

meaning_1: lying posture of a dead person; (comm) lying posture of a ghost
example_1: katamā ca, bhikkhave, petaseyyā? yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, petā uttānā senti, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, petaseyyā.
commentary: (DNa) yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, petā uttānā sentī'ti ayaṃ petaseyyā. appamaṃsalohitattā hi petā aṭṭhisaṅghāṭajaṭitā ekena passena sayituṃ na sakkonti, uttānā'va senti.

example_1: tato paraṃ jātakaṃ, niddeso, paṭisambhidāmaggo, apadānaṃ, suttanipāto, khuddakapāṭho, dhammapadaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, vimānavatthu, petavatthu, theragāthā, therīgāthā'ti imaṃ tantiṃ saṅgāyitvā khuddakagantho nām'āyan'ti ca vatvā abhidhammapiṭakasmiṃ'y'eva saṅgahaṃ āropayiṃsū'ti dīghabhāṇakā vadanti.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchato paṭikkamati, piṭṭhito rathaṃ pavatteti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo assadoso.

construction:
pa + e + ta + ī
peta + ī
example_1: mātugāmo nāma manuss'itthī, na yakkhī na petī, na tiracchānagatā. antamaso tadahujātā'pi dārikā, pag'eva mahattarī.

yassa kassaci, mahānāma, kulaputtassa pañca dhammā saṃvijjanti, yadi vā rañño khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa, yadi vā raṭṭhikassa pettanikassa, yadi vā senāya senāpatikassa, yadi vā gāmagāmaṇikassa, yadi vā pūgagāmaṇikassa, ye vā pana kulesu paccek'ādhipaccaṃ kārenti, vuddhi'y'eva pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
commentary: (ANa) pitarā dattaṃ sāpateyyaṃ bhuñjatī'ti pettaniko.

example_1: kumbhakāro pure āsiṃ, vekaḷiṅge ghaṭīkaro, mātāpettibharo āsiṃ, kassapassa upāsako.
example_2: yena saccen'ayaṃ sāmo, mātāpettibharo ahu, etena saccavajjena, visaṃ sāmassa haññatu.
commentary: (JAa) mātāpettibharā'ti jiṇṇe andhe mātāpitaro posenti, etādisā nesaṃ dhammikatā. (JAa) mātāpettibharo'ti analaso hutvā rattin'divaṃ mātāpitaro bhari.

meaning_1: paternal; coming from one's father; belonging to the father
example_1: ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātumahābhūtiko mātā-pettika-sambhavo odana-kummāsa-upacayo anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammo, idañ'ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan'ti
example_2: atha kho āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa pitā taṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇassa puñjaṃ vivarāpetvā āyasmantaṃ raṭṭhapālaṃ etadavoca, idaṃ te, tāta raṭṭhapāla, mātu mattikaṃ dhanaṃ, aññaṃ pettikaṃ, aññaṃ pitāmahaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) aññaṃ pettikaṃ aññaṃ pitāmahan'ti yaṃ pana te pitu ca pitāmahānañ'ca santakaṃ, taṃ aññaṃ'y'eva, nihitañ'ca payuttañ'ca ativiya bahu. ettha ca pitāmahan'ti taddhitalopaṃ katvā vuttan'ti veditabbaṃ. petāmahan'ti vā pāṭho.

example_1: gocare, bhikkhave, caratha sake pettike visaye. gocare, bhikkhave, carataṃ sake pettike visaye na lacchati māro otāraṃ, na lacchati māro ārammaṇaṃ. ko ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno gocaro sako pettiko visayo?
commentary: (DNa) pettike visaye'ti pitito āgatavisaye.

meaning_1: ghost realm; world of the forefathers; realm of the ancestors
example_1: katamā ca, bhikkhave, āsavānaṃ vemattatā? atthi, bhikkhave, āsavā nirayagamanīyā, atthi āsavā tiracchānayonigamanīyā, atthi āsavā pettivisayagamanīyā, atthi āsavā manussalokagamanīyā, atthi āsavā devalokagamanīyā.
example_2: abhabbo taṃ kammaṃ kātuṃ, yaṃ kammaṃ katvā nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā pettivisayaṃ vā upapajjeyya, abhabbo'va tāva kālaṃ kātuṃ yāva na sot'āpattiphalaṃ sacchikaroti.
commentary: (MNa) peccabhāvaṃ pattānaṃ visayo'ti pettivisayo.

meaning_1: which leads to the ghost realm; which is conducive to spirit rebirth
example_1: katamā ca, bhikkhave, āsavānaṃ vemattatā? atthi, bhikkhave, āsavā nirayagamanīyā, atthi āsavā tiracchānayonigamanīyā, atthi āsavā pettivisayagamanīyā, atthi āsavā manussalokagamanīyā, atthi āsavā devalokagamanīyā.

meaning_1: leading to the ghost realm; conducive to the world of the forefathers
example_1: pettivisayaṃ c'āhaṃ, sāriputta, pajānāmi, pettivisayagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ, pettivisayagāminiñ'ca paṭipadaṃ, yathā paṭipanno ca kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā pettivisayaṃ upapajjati tañ'ca pajānāmi.

meaning_1: to be experienced in the ghost realm
commentary: (ANa) nirayavedanīyan'ti niraye vipākadāyakaṃ. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: honouring one's father; respecting one's own father
example_1: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye petteyyā, atha kho et'eva bahutarā sattā ye apetteyyā
example_2: matteyyā hotha petteyyā, kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyikā, sāmaññā hotha brahmaññā, evaṃ saggaṃ gamissathā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) petteyy'ādīsu pituhitā petteyyā.

meaning_1: love for one's father; filial piety
example_1: sukhā matteyyatā loke, atho petteyyatā sukhā, sukhā sāmaññatā loke, atho brahmaññatā sukhā.
pemato jāyatī soko, pemato jāyatī bhayaṃ, pemato vippamuttassa, n'atthi soko kuto bhayaṃ.
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satthāraṃ upanissāya viharati aññataraṃ vā garuṭṭhāniyaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ, yatth'assa tibbaṃ hir'ottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti pemañ'ca gāravo ca.
commentary: (DNa) peman'ti gehassitapemaṃ. (SNa) n'atthi puttasamaṃ peman'ti virūpe'pi hi attano puttake suvaṇṇabimbakaṃ viya maññanti, mālāguḷe viya sīs'ādīsu katvā pariharamānā tehi ohaditā'pi omuttikā'pi gandhavilepanapatitā viya somanassaṃ āpajjanti. ten'āha, n'atthi puttasamaṃ peman'ti. puttapemasamaṃ pemaṃ nāma n'atthī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.
(NIDD1a) atthamadhuratāya sakalasarīre kopaṃ ajanetvā pemaṃ janetī'ti pemaniyā.

meaning_1: with an endearing tone; with a charming sound
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, himavante pabbate karavīkā nāma sakuṇajāti mañjussarā ca vaggussarā ca madhurassarā ca pemaniyassarā ca, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro mañjussaro ca ahosi vaggussaro ca madhurassaro ca pemaniyassaro ca.
commentary: (DNa) madhurassaro'ti sātassaro. pemaniyassaro'ti pemajanakassaro.

example_1: yā sā vācā n'elā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅ'gamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
commentary: (ANa) atthamadhuratāya sakalasarīre kopaṃ ajanetvā pemaṃ janetī'ti pemanīyā.

meaning_1: measure of love; degree of affection
example_1: evaṃ svākkhāte, bhikkhave, mayā dhamme uttāne vivaṭe pakāsite chinnapilotike yesaṃ mayi saddhāmattaṃ pemamattaṃ sabbe te saggaparāyanā'ti.
example_2: tathāgate c'assa saddhāmattaṃ hoti pemamattaṃ, api c'assa ime dhammā honti
commentary: (MNa) yesaṃ mayi saddhāmattaṃ pemamattan'ti iminā yesaṃ añño ariyadhammo n'atthi, tathāgate pana saddhāmattaṃ pemamattam'eva hoti. te vipassakapuggalā adhippetā. vipassakabhikkhūnañ'hi evaṃ vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā nisinnānaṃ dasabale ekā saddhā ekaṃ pemaṃ uppajjati.

meaning_1: mere love; simple affection; a measure of fondness
meaning_2: mere love; simple affection; love alone; by a measure of affection
example_1: tatra, bhaddāli, bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti, ayaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu saddhāmattakena vahati pemamattakena. sace mayaṃ imaṃ bhikkhuṃ pasayha pasayha kāraṇaṃ karissāma, mā yam'pi'ssa taṃ saddhāmattakaṃ pemamattakaṃ tamhā'pi parihāyī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) saddhāmattakena vahati pemamattakenā'ti ācariy'upajjhāyesu appamattikāya gehassitasaddhāya appamattakena gehassitapemena yāpeti. paṭisandhiggahaṇasadisā hi ayaṃ pabbajjā nāma, navapabbajito pabbajjāya guṇaṃ ajānanto ācariy'upajjhāyesu pemamattena yāpeti, tasmā evarūpā saṅgaṇhitabbā. appamattakam'pi hi saṅgahaṃ labhitvā pabbajjāya ṭhitā abhiññāpattā mahāsamaṇā bhavissanti. ettakena kathāmaggena ovaditabbayuttakaṃ ovadanti, na itaran'ti imam'eva bhagavatā dassitaṃ.

example_1: atha kho peyo ca hatth'ārohaputto kandarako ca paribbājako yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā pesso hatth'ārohaputto bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
commentary: (MNa) pesso'ti tassa nāmaṃ.

example_1: atthi, bhikkhave, dakkhiṇesu janapadesu dhovanaṃ nāma. tattha hoti annam'pi pānam'pi khajjam'pi bhojjam'pi leyyam'pi peyyam'pi naccam'pi gītam'pi vāditam'pi. atth'etaṃ, bhikkhave, dhovanaṃ, n'etaṃ n'atthī'ti vadāmi.
example_2: assamedhaṃ purisamedhaṃ, sammāpāsaṃ vājapeyyaṃ niraggaḷhaṃ, mahāyaññā mah'ārambhā, na te honti mahapphalā.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, gaṅgā nadī pūrā udakassa samatittikā kākapeyyā.
commentary: (MNa) kākapeyyo'ti mukhavaṭṭiyaṃ nisīditvā kākena gīvaṃ anāmetvā'va pātabbo.

meaning_1: made of crystal; made of quartz crystal
example_1: kusāvatiyā, ānanda, rājadhāniyā catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ dvārāni ahesuṃ. ekaṃ dvāraṃ sovaṇṇamayaṃ, ekaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ, ekaṃ veḷuriyamayaṃ, ekaṃ phalikamayaṃ.

meaning_1: plant which propagates from a joint; joint propagation

commentary: (SNa) phalubījan'ti ucchu veḷu naḷo'ti evam'ādi.

example_1: katame cattāro? uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī na kammaphal'ūpajīvī, kammaphal'ūpajīvī na uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī, uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī c'eva kammaphal'ūpajīvī ca, n'eva uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī na kammaphal'ūpajīvī, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.
commentary: (ANa) catutthe uṭṭhānavīriyen'eva divasaṃ vītināmetvā tassa nissandaphalamattaṃ kiñci'd'eva labhitvā jīvikaṃ kappeti, taṃ pana uṭṭhānaṃ āgamma kiñci puññaphalaṃ nappaṭilabhati, ayaṃ uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvī na kammaphal'ūpajīvī nāma. cātumahārājike pana deve ādiṃ katvā sabbe'pi devā uṭṭhānavīriyena vinā puññaphalass'eva upajīvanato kammaphal'ūpajīvino na uṭṭhānaphal'ūpajīvino nāma.

meaning_2: having broken; having split; having cut asunder

example_1: ropetva rukkhāni yathā phal'esī, mūle taruṃ chettu tam'eva icchasi, tath'ūpamaṃ cittam'idaṃ karosi, yaṃ maṃ aniccamhi cale niyuñjasi.
example_2: aṅgārino dāni dumā bhadante, phal'esino chadanaṃ vippahāya, te accimanto'va pabhāsayanti, samayo mahāvīra bhāgī rasānaṃ.

meaning_1: sense contact; sense impingement; sense impression; sense experience

example_2: phassanidānaṃ sātaṃ asātaṃ, phasse asante na bhavanti h'ete, vibhavaṃ bhavañ'c'āpi yam'etam'atthaṃ, etaṃ te pabrūmi itonidānaṃ.

example_1: aḍḍhā daliddā ca phusanti phassaṃ, bālo ca dhīro ca tath'eva phuṭṭho, bālo ca bālyā vadhito'va seti, dhīro ca na vedhati phassaphuṭṭho.

meaning_1: classes of sense contact; categories of sense impression
example_1: cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha viññāṇakāyā veditabbā, cha phassakāyā veditabbā, aṭṭhārasa mano'pavicārā veditabbā, chattiṃsa sattapadā veditabbā
example_2: katamo ca, bhikkhave, phasso? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, phassakāyā, cakkhusamphasso, sotasamphasso, ghānasamphasso, jivhāsamphasso, kāyasamphasso, manosamphasso. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, phasso.

meaning_1: produced by sense contact; caused by sense impingement

meaning_1: pair of experiences; pair of sense impressions
example_1: phassena phuṭṭho na sukhena majje, dukkhena phuṭṭho'pi na sampavedhe, phassadvayaṃ sukhadukkhe upekkhe, anānuruddho aviruddha kenaci.
commentary: (SNa) phassadvayaṃ sukhadukkhe upekkhe'ti sukhaphassañ'ca dukkhaphassañ'cā'ti idaṃ phassadvayaṃ upekkhe, upekkhā'm'ev'ettha uppādeyyā'ti attho. phassadvayaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ upekkho'ti vā pāṭho, phassahetukaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ upekkho, sukhe anurodhaṃ dukkhe ca virodhaṃ anuppādento upekkhako bhaveyyā'ti'pi attho.

meaning_1: diversity of sense contacts; variety of sense impingements

example_2: dhātunānattaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattaṃ. katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, dhātunānattaṃ?
commentary: (DNa) phassanānattaṃ paṭiccā'ti cakkhusamphass'ādi-nānattaṃ paṭicca. (SNa) uppajjati phassanānattan'ti nānāsabhāvo phasso uppajjati. tattha cakkhusamphass'ādayo cakkhuviññāṇ'ādisampayuttā, manosamphasso manodvāre paṭhamajavanasampayutto, tasmā.

meaning_lit: discourse on diversity of sense experiences

example_1: vedanā c'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? vedanā phassanidānā phassasamudayā phassajātikā phassapabhavā.
commentary: (NIDD1) phassanidānaṃ sātaṃ asātan'ti. sāt'āsātā phassanidānā phassasamudayā phassajātikā phassappabhavāti, phassanidānaṃ sātaṃ asātaṃ.

meaning_1: ending of sense contact; cessation of sense experience
example_1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, phasso kho, āvuso, eko anto, phassasamudayo dutiyo anto, phassanirodho majjhe, taṇhā sibbinī.
example_2: phassasamudayā vedanāsamudayo, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho.
commentary: (ANa) phassanirodho'ti nibbānaṃ.

meaning_1: leading to the ending of sense contact; leading to the cessation of sense experience

meaning_1: dependent on sense contact; caused by sense impingement

meaning_1: concept of sense contact; what is called sense impingement

commentary: (MNa) phassapaññattiṃ paññapessatī'ti phasso nāma eko dhammo uppajjatī'ti evaṃ phassapaññattiṃ paññapessati, dassessatī'ti attho. esa nayo sabbattha.

meaning_1: rooted in sense contact; stemming from sense impingement

meaning_1: source of sense contact; arising of sense experience
example_1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, phasso kho, āvuso, eko anto, phassasamudayo dutiyo anto, phassanirodho majjhe, taṇhā sibbinī.

meaning_1: with sense contact as source; originating from sense experience

commentary: (MNa) phassasamudayā'ti ettha pana pañcadvāre pañcavatthukavedanānaṃ sahajāta-cakkhusamphass'ādi-samudayā samudayo hoti. avasesānaṃ cakkhusamphass'ādayo upanissay'ādi-vasena paccayā. manodvāre tadārammaṇavedanānaṃ advārikānañ'ca paṭisandhi-bhav'aṅga-cuti-vedanānaṃ sahajātamanosamphassasamudayā samudayo hotī'ti veditabbo. (ANa) phassasamudayo'ti phasso samudayo assā'ti phassasamudayo, imasmiṃ attabhāve katakammaphassapaccayā nibbatto anāgatattabhāvo. (ANa) phassato samudenti rāsī bhavantī'ti phassasamudayā. (NIDD1a) phassasamudayo'ti vatth'ārammaṇo. yato samudeti uppajjati, so samudayo.

meaning_1: produced by sense contact; generated by touch
example_1: tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā, anekā phassasambhavā, abhijjhā ca vihesā ca, cittam'ass'ūpahaññati, evaṃ ācinato dukkhaṃ, ārā nibbānam'uccati.

meaning_1: complete comprehension of contact; total understanding of experience
example_1: ye ca phassaṃ pariññāya, aññāy'upasame ratā, te ve phass'ābhisamayā, nicchātā parinibbutā'ti.
commentary: (SNPa) phass'ābhisamayā'ti phassanirodhā.

meaning_1: with sense fields; having (six) fields of sense impression
example_1: cha dhāturo ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso cha phass'āyatano aṭṭhārasa mano'pavicāro catur'ādhiṭṭhāno, yattha ṭhitaṃ maññ'assavā nappavattanti, maññ'assave kho pana nappavattamāne muni santo'ti vuccati.
example_2: cha phass'āyatano ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cakkhusamphass'āyatanaṃ, sotasamphass'āyatanaṃ, ghānasamphass'āyatanaṃ, jivhāsamphass'āyatanaṃ, kāyasamphass'āyatanaṃ, manosamphass'āyatanaṃ.

meaning_1: sense field; field of experience; field of sense impression
example_1: evam'eva kho, āvuso, bhikkhu chassu phass'āyatanesu n'eva attānaṃ n'āttaniyaṃ samanupassati.
example_2: sati kāyagatā upaṭṭhitā, chasu phass'āyatanesu saṃvuto, satataṃ bhikkhu samāhito, jaññā nibbānam'attano'ti.
commentary: (MNa) phass'āyatanan'ti phassassa āyatanaṃ, ākaro'ti attho.

example_2: sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno aññen'aññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.

example_1: āyasmā sāriputto etadavoca, ajjhattasaṃyojanañ'ca, āvuso, puggalaṃ desessāmi bahiddhāsaṃyojanañ'ca. taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) iti ajjhattasaṅkhāte kāmabhave chandarāgo ajjhattasaṃyojanaṃ nāma, bahiddhāsaṅkhātesu rūp'ārūpabhavesu chandarāgo bahiddhāsaṃyojanaṃ nāma.

meaning_1: outside the entrance gate; outer gate-chamber
example_1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubb'ārāme migāramātupāsāde. tena kho pana samayena bhagavā sāy'anhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito bahidvārakoṭṭhake nisinno hoti.
example_2: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā bahidvārakoṭṭhakā nikkhāmetvā sūcighaṭikaṃ datvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami
commentary: (SNa) bahi dvārakoṭṭhake'ti pāsādadvārakoṭṭhakassa bahi, na vihāradvārakoṭṭhakassa.

meaning_1: outside the town; on the outskirts of the city
example_1: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati bahinagare aparapure vanasaṇḍe.
commentary: (MNa) bahinagare'ti nagarassa bahi, na ambapālivanaṃ viya antonagarasmiṃ. ayaṃ pana jīvak'ambavanaṃ viya nagarassa bahiddhā vanasaṇḍo. tena vuttaṃ bahinagare'ti.

meaning_2: outer city or outside the city

example_1: snehaparetā'ti udakasinehena parigatā. santarabāhirā'ti saddhiṃ antopadesena c'eva bahipadesena ca, sabbatthakam'eva udakasinehena phuṭā'ti attho.

meaning_1: exterior of a customs station; outside of a toll booth
example_1: dutiyaṃ pādaṃ atikkāmeti, āpatti pārājikassa. antosuṅkaghāte ṭhito bahisuṅkaghātaṃ pāteti, āpatti pārājikassa. suṅkaṃ pariharati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
commentary: (VINa) bahisuṅkaghātaṃ pātetī'ti rājapurisānaṃ aññavihitabhāvaṃ passitvā anto ṭhito'va bahi patanatthāya khipati. tañ'ce avassaṃ patanakaṃ, hatthato muttamatte pārājikaṃ. tañ'ce rukkhe vā khāṇumhi vā paṭihataṃ balavavātavegukkhittaṃ vā hutvā puna anto'y'eva patati, rakkhati. puna gaṇhitvā khipati, pubbe vuttanayen'eva pārājikaṃ. bhūmiyaṃ patitvā vaṭṭantaṃ puna anto pavisati, pārājikam'eva. kurundīsaṅkhepaṭṭhakathāsu pana sace bahi patitaṃ ṭhatvā vaṭṭantaṃ pavisati, pārājikaṃ.

meaning_1: many; much; lots; a lot (of); great; large
example_1: katamañ'ca, gahapati, ānaṇyasukhaṃ? idha, gahapati, kulaputto na kassaci kiñci dhāreti appaṃ vā bahuṃ vā.
example_2: dvīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ'ca apuññaṃ pasavati

meaning_1: very close; extremely near (to); nearly upon
example_1: yadā kho, bhikkhave, aññāsi lāpo sakuṇo bahuāgato kho my'āyaṃ sakuṇagghī'ti, atha tass'eva leḍḍussa antaraṃ paccupādi. atha kho, bhikkhave, sakuṇagghi tatth'eva uraṃ paccatāḷesi.
commentary: (SNa) bahuāgato kho my'āyan'ti mayhaṃ atthāya ayaṃ bahutaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgato, appaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ, idāni maṃ gaṇhissatī'ti ñatvā dāruguḷo viya vinivattitvā tass'eva leḍḍussa antare paccupādi, paṭipanno paviṭṭho'ti attho.

meaning_1: with many disadvantages; with lots of drawbacks
example_1: katamā c'ānanda, ādīnavasaññā? idh'ānanda, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññ'āgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati, bahudukkho kho ayaṃ kāyo bahuādīnavo.
dānañ'ca yuddhañ'ca samānam'āhu, app'āpi santā bahuke jinanti, appam'pi ce saddahāno dadāti, ten'eva so hoti sukhī paratthā'ti.
example_2: acchindāpeyyā'ti aññaṃ āṇāpeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. sakiṃ āṇatto bahukam'pi acchindati, nissaggiyaṃ hoti.

example_1: dhi'r'atthu kāmā asucī, duggandhā bahukaṇṭakā, yattha mātā ca dhītā ca, sabhariyā mayaṃ ahuṃ.
commentary: (THIa) bahukaṇṭakā'ti visūyikappavattiyā sucaritavinivijjhan'aṭṭhena bahuvidhakilesakaṇṭakā.

example_1: tassa ce, āvuso, bhikkhuno evaṃ buddhaṃ anussarato, evaṃ dhammaṃ anussarato, evaṃ saṅghaṃ anussarato upekkhā kusalanissitā saṇṭhāti, so tena attamano hoti. ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno bahukataṃ hoti.
commentary: (MNa) bahukataṃ hotī'ti ettāvatā'pi bahuṃ bhagavato sāsanaṃ kataṃ hoti

meaning_1: busy; with lots to do; with many duties
example_1: handa ca dāni mayaṃ, bho gotama, gacchāma. bahukiccā mayaṃ, bahukaraṇīyā'ti. yassa'dāni tvaṃ, aggivessana, kālaṃ maññasī'ti.
example_2: mayaṃ kho, mārisa moggallāna, bahukiccā bahukaraṇīyā, app'eva sakena karaṇīyena, api ca devānaṃ'y'eva tāvatiṃsānaṃ karaṇīyena.
commentary: (DNa) bahukiccā'ti balavakiccā. bahukaraṇīyā'ti tass'eva vevacanaṃ.
notes: (MW) one who has (or complains of having) much to do, who never has time for anything

meaning_1: very useful; extremely helpful; of great service (for or in)
example_1: yoniso manasikāro, dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno, n'atth'añño evaṃ bahukāro, uttam'atthassa pattiyā, yoniso padahaṃ bhikkhu, khayaṃ dukkhassa pāpuṇe'ti.
example_2: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno paccavekkhaṇā bahukārā hoti kusalesu dhammesu
commentary: (MNa) bahukāro'ti hitakiriyāya bah'ūpakāro.

meaning_1: busy; with lots to do; with many duties

meaning_1: multitude; many people; mass of people

example_2: yā sā vācā n'elā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅ'gamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
commentary: (SNa) bahujanassā'ti assutavato andhabālaputhujjanassa.

meaning_1: for the discomfort of many people
example_1: yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu satthari agāravo viharati appatisso, dhamme agāravo viharati appatisso, saṅghe agāravo viharati appatisso, sikkhāya na paripūrakārī, so saṅghe vivādaṃ janeti. yo hoti vivādo bahujana-ahitāya bahujana-asukhāya anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.

grammar: nt, comp, dat sg of bahujanāhita
meaning_1: for the disadvantage of many people; for the harm of the people
example_1: yo so, āvuso, bhikkhu satthari agāravo viharati appatisso, dhamme agāravo viharati appatisso, saṅghe agāravo viharati appatisso, sikkhāya na paripūrakārī, so saṅghe vivādaṃ janeti. yo hoti vivādo bahujana-ahitāya bahujana-asukhāya anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
commentary: (VINa) bahujana-ahitāya paṭipanno hotī'ti vinayadharena hi evaṃ chand'ādigatiyā adhikaraṇe vinicchite tasmiṃ vihāre saṅgho dvidhā bhijjati. ovād'ūpajīviniyo bhikkhuniyo'pi dve bhāgā honti. upāsakā'pi upāsikāyo'pi dārakā'pi dārikāyo'pi tesaṃ ārakkhadevatā'pi tath'eva dvidhā bhijjanti. tato bhummadevatā ādiṃ katvā yāva akaniṭṭhabrahmāno dvidhāva honti. tena vuttaṃ, bahujana-ahitāya paṭipanno hoti… dukkhāya devamanussānan'ti.

meaning_1: pleasing to the people; loved by the people

meaning_1: loved by the multitude; held dear by the people
example_1: piyadassano gihī'pi santo ca, bhavati bahujanapiyāyito, yadi ca na bhavati gihī samaṇo hoti, piyo bahūnaṃ sokanāsanoti.

meaning_1: leading the people; forerunner of the multitude (in)
example_1: yam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno bahujanapubbaṅ'gamo ahosi kusalesu dhammesu bahujanapāmokkho kāyasucarite vacīsucarite manosucarite… aññatar'aññataresu ca adhikusalesu dhammesu.

meaning_1: insulting the people; disrespecting the population
example_1: akkosabhaṇḍanavihesakāriṃ, ubbādhikaṃ bahujanappamaddanaṃ, abāḷhaṃ giraṃ so na bhaṇi pharusaṃ, madhuraṃ bhaṇi susaṃhitaṃ sakhilaṃ.

meaning_1: charming to the people; pleasing to the masses
example_1: pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato ahosiṃ, yā sā vācā n'elā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅ'gamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā ahosiṃ.

taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ, yo v'āyaṃ mayā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito ayaṃ vā mahāpathavī'ti?
example_2: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye manussesu paccājāyanti. atha kho ete'y'eva bahutarā sattā ye aññatra manussehi paccājāyanti.

meaning_1: with numerous females; with many women
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici kulāni bahu'tthikāni appapurisāni tāni suppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi.
upako palagaṇḍo ca, pukkusāti ca te tayo, bhaddiyo khaṇḍadevo ca, bahudantī ca piṅgayo, te hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ, dibbayogaṃ upaccagun'ti.
app'assādā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. aṭṭhikaṅkal'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.
example_2: kālikā hi, āvuso, kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. sandiṭṭhiko ayaṃ dhammo akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī'ti.

example_1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, hatthim'eva nu kho, bhante, mahantaṃ brahantaṃ kāy'upapannaṃ jano disvā evam'āha, nāgo vata, bho, nāgo'ti
example_2: kāḷī itthī brahatī dhaṅkarūpā, satthiñ'ca bhetvā aparañ'ca satthiṃ, bāhañ'ca bhetvā aparañ'ca bāhaṃ, sīsañ'ca bhetvā dadhithālakaṃ'va, esā nisinnā abhisandahitvā.

meaning_2: belonging to the company of Brahma
example_1: paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā brahmakāyikā devā saddam'anussāvesuṃ, lābhā vata bho vajjīnaṃ, suladdhalābhā vajjipajāya, yattha tathāgato viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho
example_2: so tadassādeti, taṃ nikāmeti, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati. tattha ṭhito tadadhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno brahmakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.

meaning_1: created by god; made by Brahma
example_1: ty'āhaṃ evaṃ vadāmi, kathaṃvihitakaṃ pana tumhe āyasmanto issarakuttaṃ brahmakuttaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethā'ti?
commentary: (DNa) issarakuttaṃ brahmakuttan'ti issarakataṃ brahmakataṃ, issaranimmitaṃ brahmanimmitan'ti attho. brahmā eva hi ettha ādhipaccabhāvena issaro'ti veditabbo.

example_1: dasabalasamannāgato, bhikkhave, tathāgato catūhi ca vesārajjehi samannāgato āsabhaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti
commentary: (ANa) brahman'ti seṭṭhaṃ uttamaṃ visiṭṭhaṃ. cakkan'ti dhammacakkaṃ.

meaning_1: spiritual path; spiritual practice; holy life
example_1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya app'eva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan'ti
example_2: ettako ce'pi, bhikkhu, attabhāvapaṭilābho abhavissa nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, na'y'idaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
commentary: (VIN) app'eva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan'ti bhikkhubhāvā cāveyyaṃ, samaṇadhammā cāveyyaṃ, sīlakkhandhā cāveyyaṃ, tapoguṇā cāveyyaṃ.

meaning_1: related to the spiritual path; about the spiritual practice; regarding the holy life; about celibacy
example_1: tasmā have lokavidū sumedho, lok'antagū vusitabrahmacariyo, lokassa antaṃ samitāvi ñatvā, n'āsīsati lokam'imaṃ parañ'cā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) vusitabrahmacariyo'ti maggabrahmacariyaṃ vasitvā ṭhito.

meaning_1: discussion about the incomplete spiritual life, etc.
purpose of the spiritual path; goal of the holy life
example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhave, brahmacariy'attho? yo kho, bhikkhave, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, brahmacariy'atthoti.

meaning_2: difficulty of the spiritual life; suffering of the holy life

example_1: ayaṃ kakkhaḷo pharuso jīvit'antarāyaṃ vā brahmacariy'antarāyaṃ vā karissatī'ti n'āroceti, aññe patirūpe bhikkhū apassanto n'āroceti, nachādetu'kāmo n'āroceti, paññāyissati sakena kammenā'ti n'āroceti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
commentary: (KVt) manussā ekaṃ vā bahū vā bhikkhū brahmacariyā cāvetu'kāmā gaṇhanti, ayaṃ brahmacariy'antarāyo.

meaning_1: finding support in the holy life
example_1: n'āhaṃ bhabbo eta'r'ahi, kāmāni paṭisevituṃ, anivatti bhavissāmi, brahmacariyaparāyaṇo'ti.
commentary: (ANa) brahmacariyaparāyaṇo'ti maggabrahmacariyaparāyaṇo. iminā lok'uttaro aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo kathito'ti.

meaning_1: finding support in the holy life; (or) living the holy life destined for Nibbāna
example_1: ahañ'ca sīlasampanne, cirarattasamāhite, sammāpabbajite vande, brahmacariyaparāyane.

meaning_1: perfection of the holy life; ideal of the spiritual path; culmination of the holy life
example_1: atha kho so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto viharanto nacirass'eva, yass'atthāya kulaputtā samma'd'eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.

meaning_1: personal experience of the culmination of the spiritual path
fruit of the spiritual path; result of the holy life
example_1: katamāni ca, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaphalāni? sot'āpattiphalaṃ, sakadāgāmiphalaṃ, anāgāmiphalaṃ, arahattaphalaṃ, imāni vuccanti, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaphalānī'ti.

meaning_1: led the spiritual life; lived the holy life
meaning_2: led the spiritual life; lived the holy life
example_1: rājā kho pan'ānanda, maghadevo caturāsītivassasahassāni kumārakīḷitaṃ kīḷi, caturāsītivassasahassāni oparajjaṃ kāresi, caturāsītivassasahassāni rajjaṃ kāresi, caturāsītivassasahassāni imasmiṃ'y'eva maghadevaambavane agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito brahmacariyam'acari.
example_2: te tositā cakkhumatā, buddhen'ādiccabandhunā, brahmacariyam'acariṃsu, varapaññassa santike.
commentary: (SNPa) brahmacariyam'acariṃsū'ti maggabrahmacariyaṃ acariṃsu.

meaning_1: in conformity with the spiritual path; proper for the holy life
example_1: yāni ca kho tāni sikkhāpadāni ādibrahmacariyakāni brahmacariyasāruppāni tattha dhuvasīlo ca hoti ṭhitasīlo ca, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
commentary: (ANa) brahmacariyasāruppānī'ti tāni'y'eva catumaggabrahmacariyassa sāruppāni anucchavikāni.

meaning_1: living the holy life; following the spiritual path; who is celibate renunciant
example_1: kāmesu brahmacariyavā, vītataṇho sadā sato, saṅkhāya nibbuto bhikkhu, tassa no santi iñjitā.
example_2: yodha puññañ'ca pāpañ'ca, bāhetvā brahmacariyavā, saṅkhāya loke carati, sa ve bhikkhū'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: living the holy life; following the spiritual path
example_1: ettako ce'pi, bhikkhu, attabhāvapaṭilābho abhavissa nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, na'y'idaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
example_2: yo, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya, yathā yath'āyaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathā taṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī'ti, evaṃ santaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyavāso na hoti, okāso na paññāyati sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya.
commentary: (SNa) na y'idaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyethā'ti ayaṃ maggabrahmacariyavāso nāma na paññāyeyya. maggo hi tebhūmakasaṅkhāre vivaṭṭento uppajjati. yadi ca ettako attabhāvo nicco bhaveyya, maggo uppajjitvā'pi saṅkhāravaṭṭaṃ vivaṭṭetuṃ na sakkuṇeyyā'ti brahmacariyavāso na paññāyetha.

meaning_1: lives the holy life; walks the spiritual path; follows a religion
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kāme ca nappaṭisevati, pāpañ'ca kammaṃ na karoti, sahā'pi dukkhena sahā'pi domanassena assumukho'pi rudamāno paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati.
example_2: tena kho pana samayena sabhiyassa paribbājakassa purāṇasālohitāya devatāya pañhā uddiṭṭhā honti, yo te, sabhiya, samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ime pañhe puṭṭho byākaroti tassa santike brahmacariyaṃ careyyāsī'ti.

meaning_1: spiritual path; spiritual practice; holy life; celibacy
example_1: acaritvā brahmacariyaṃ, aladdhā yobbane dhanaṃ, jiṇṇakoñcā'va jhāyanti, khīṇamacche'va pallale.
commentary: (MNa) brahmacariyan'ti dānam'pi veyyāvaccam'pi sikkhāpadam'pi brahmavihārā'pi dhammadesanā'pi methunavirati'pi sadārasantoso'pi uposatho'pi ariyamaggo'pi sakalasāsanam'pi ajjhāsayo'pi vīriyam'pi vuccati. (ANa) brahmacariyan'ti ariyamaggasīlaṃ.

meaning_1: support for the spiritual practice; help for the holy life
example_1: paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃs'ūparatiyā brahmacariy'ānuggahāya

grammar: masc, comp, dat sg of brahmacariyānuggaha
meaning_1: to support the spiritual practice; to help the holy life

commentary: (VISM) brahmacariyānuggahāyā'ti sakalasāsanabrahmacariyassa ca maggabrahmacariyassa ca anuggah'atthaṃ.

meaning_1: seeking renunciation; seeking a spiritual path
example_1: kathañ'c'āvuso, bhikkhu samavayasaṭṭh'esano hoti? idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno kām'esanā pahīnā hoti, bhav'esanā pahīnā hoti, brahmacariy'esanā paṭippassaddhā.
example_2: kām'esanā bhav'esanā, brahmacariy'esanā saha, iti saccaparāmāso, diṭṭhiṭṭhānā samussayā.
commentary: (ANa) brahmacariyaṃ esissāmi gavesissāmī'ti evaṃ pavatt'ajjhāsayasaṅkhātā brahmacariy'esanā'pi arahattamaggen'eva paṭippassaddhiṃ vūpasamaṃ gacchati. diṭṭhibrahmacariy'esanā pana sot'āpattimaggen'eva paṭippasambhatī'ti veditabbā.

(DNa) tattha katamā brahmacariy'esanā? sassato loko'ti vā… n'eva hoti na nahoti tathāgato parammaraṇā'ti vā, yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ vipariyesaggāho, ayaṃ vuccati brahmacariy'esanā'ti evaṃ vuttā diṭṭhigatikasammatassa brahmacariyassa gavesanadiṭṭhi brahmacariy'esanā nāma.

meaning_1: immersed in the spiritual path; absorbed in spiritual practice
example_1: yesaṃ saddhā ca sīlañ'ca, pasādo dhammadassanaṃ, te ve kālena paccenti, brahmacariy'ogadhaṃ sukhan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) brahmacariy'ogadhaṃ sukhan'ti brahmacariyaṃ ogāhitvā ṭhitaṃ uparimaggattayasampayuttaṃ sukhaṃ. (ANa) anuttaraṃ brahmacariy'ogadhan'ti arahattamaggasaṅkhātassa brahmacariyassa anuttaraṃ ogadhaṃ uttamapatiṭṭhābhūtaṃ nibbānaṃ. (ANt) maggabrahmacariyassa ogadhaṃ mūlaṃ patiṭṭhābhūtaṃ brahmacariy'ogadhaṃ. ten'āha arahattamaggasaṅkhātassā'ti-ādi.

meaning_lit: discourse on immersed in the spiritual path

example_1: yasmiṃ padese kappeti, vāsaṃ paṇḍitajātiyo, sīlavant'ettha bhojetvā, saññate brahmacārayo.
commentary: (ANa) apace brahmacārayo'ti brahmacārino apacayati, nīcavuttitaṃ nesaṃ āpajjati.

meaning_1: excessive desire of the spiritual practitioner; (comm) longing for the requisites of others
example_1: yañ'hi taṃ, kassapa, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, upaddutā brahmacārī brahmacār'ūpaddavena abhipatthanā brahmacārī brahmacāri-abhipatthanenā'ti, eta'r'ahi taṃ, kassapa, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, upaddutā brahmacārī brahmacār'ūpaddavena abhipatthanā brahmacārī brahmacāri-abhipatthanenā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) brahmacāri-abhipatthanenā'ti brahmacārīnaṃ adhimattapatthanāsaṅkhātena catupaccayabhāvena.

example_1: tesaṃ taṃ hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya. yañ'hi taṃ, kassapa, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, upaddutā brahmacārī brahmacār'ūpaddavena abhibhavanā brahmacārī brahmacāri-abhibhavanenā'ti

meaning_1: celibate woman; living the holy life; following the spiritual path
example_1: tassa ca viramāsi tāva'd'e, rāgo tattha khamāpayī ca naṃ, sotthi siyā brahmacārinī, na puno edisakaṃ bhavissati.
commentary: (THIa) sotthi siyā brahmacārinī'ti seṭṭhacārini mahesike tuyhaṃ ārogyam'eva bhaveyya.

meaning_1: pretending to be celibate; claiming to be chaste
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asuci saṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakamm'anto, assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño, abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño, antopūti avassuto kasambujāto.

meaning_1: celibate; chaste; abstaining from sexual intercourse; holy
example_1: abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī ahosiṃ ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
example_2: alaṅ'kato ce'pi samaṃ careyya, santo danto niyato brahmacārī, sabbesu bhūtesu nidhāya daṇḍaṃ, so brāhmaṇo so samaṇo sa bhikkhu.
commentary: (VIN 1.2.4) brahmacārin'ti methunadhammā paṭivirataṃ. (MNa) brahmaṃ seṭṭhaṃ paṭipadaṃ carantī'ti brahmacārī, methunā paṭiviratā'ti attho.

meaning_1: celibate man; who abstains from sexual intercourse
example_1: etadaggaṃ bhagini pāricariyānaṃ yā mādisaṃ sīlavantaṃ kalyāṇadhammaṃ brahmacāriṃ etena dhammena paricareyyā'ti methun'upasaṃhitena, saṅgh'ādiseso.
example_2: idha ekacco dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asucisaṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakamm'anto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambujāto, antopūtibhāvo'ti.
commentary: (VIN 1.2.4) brahmacārin'ti methunadhammā paṭivirataṃ.

meaning_1: living the holy life; following the spiritual path
example_1: araññe viharantānaṃ, santānaṃ brahmacārinaṃ, ekabhattaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ, kena vaṇṇo pasīdatī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) brahmacārinan'ti seṭṭhacārīnaṃ maggabrahmacariyavāsaṃ vasantānaṃ.

meaning_1: risk for one's celibacy; danger to the holy life
example_1: tatr'ānanda, yo c'ev'āyaṃ ācariy'ūpaddavo, yo ca antevās'ūpaddavo ayaṃ tehi brahmac'ārūpaddavo dukkhavipākataro c'eva kaṭukavipākataro ca, api ca vinipātāya saṃvattati.
commentary: (MNa) ācariy'ūpaddavenā'ti abbhantare uppannena kiles'ūpaddavena ācariyass'upaddavo. ses'upaddavesu'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: born from Brahma; made by god
example_1: brāhmaṇā, bho kaccāna, evam'āhaṃsu, brāhmaṇo'va seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīno añño vaṇṇo, brāhmaṇo'va sukko vaṇṇo, kaṇho añño vaṇṇo, brāhmaṇā'va sujjhanti, no abrāhmaṇā, brāhmaṇā'va brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā brahmajā brahmanimmitā brahmadāy'ādā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) brahmajā'ti brahmato nibbattā.

example_1: brahmajacco pure āsiṃ, udicco ubhato ahu, sojja putto sugatassa, dhammarājassa satthuno.

yāni c'imāni dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni brahmajāle bhaṇitāni, imā nu kho, bhante, diṭṭhiyo kismiṃ sati honti, kismiṃ asati na hontī'ti?

meaning_1: who is repulsed by god; who is disgusted with god

meaning_1: Brahmanhood; being a true Brahman; being a holy person
example_1: evaṃ vutte, acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, dukkaraṃ, bho gotama, sāmaññaṃ dukkaraṃ brahmaññan'ti.
example_2: pabbajjā, bho, app'esakkhā ca appalābhā ca, brahmaññaṃ mah'esakkhañ'ca mahālābhañ'cā'ti. mā bhavanto evaṃ avacuttha, pabbajjā app'esakkhā ca appalābhā ca, brahmaññaṃ mah'esakkhañ'ca mahālābhañ'cā'ti.

meaning_1: goal of being a Brahman; purpose of Brahmanhood; epithet of Nibbāna
example_1: na ca pana te āyasmanto sāmaññ'atthaṃ vā brahmaññ'atthaṃ vā diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.
commentary: (SNa) sāmaññ'atthaṃ vā brahmaññ'atthaṃ vā'ti ettha ariyamaggo sāmaññañ'c'eva brahmaññañ'ca. ubhay'atthā'pi pana attho nāma ariyaphalaṃ veditabbaṃ.

meaning_1: fruit of the spiritual path; result of the holy life
example_1: katamāni ca, bhikkhave, brahmaññaphalāni? sot'āpattiphalaṃ, sakadāgāmiphalaṃ, anāgāmiphalaṃ, arahattaphalaṃ, imāni vuccanti, bhikkhave, brahmaññaphalānī'ti.

meaning_1: considered (the definition of) Brahmanhood; reckoned as (fundamental to) being a Brahman
meaning_2: considered (the definition of) Brahmanhood; reckoned as (fundamental to) being a Brahman
example_1: evaṃ vutte, acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ime'pi kho, āvuso gotama, tapopakkamā etesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ sāmaññasaṅkhātā ca brahmaññasaṅkhātā ca.
commentary: (DNa) brahmaññasaṅkhātā'ti brāhmaṇakammasaṅkhātā.

example_1: bhavañ'hi soṇadaṇḍo abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahm'aḍḍhī, brahmavaccasī akhudd'āvakāso dassanāya…

meaning_1: godliness; state of being god; fact of being the creator
example_1: viññāṇaṃ anidassanaṃ anantaṃ sabbato pabhaṃ, taṃ… bhūtānaṃ bhūtattena ananubhūtaṃ, devānaṃ devattena ananubhūtaṃ, pajāpatissa pajāpatittena ananubhūtaṃ, brahmānaṃ brahmattena ananubhūtaṃ

meaning_1: (vinaya) punishment by not admonishing, instructing or communicating with the offender
meaning_2: punishment involving no admonishment or communication
example_1: yadaggena tayā, āvuso channa, arahattaṃ sacchikataṃ tadaggena te brahmadaṇḍo paṭippassaddho'ti. imāya kho pana vinayasaṅgītiyā pañca bhikkhusatāni anūnāni anadhikāni ahesuṃ. tasmā ayaṃ vinayasaṅgīti pañcasatikā'ti vuccatī'ti.
commentary: (DNt) brahmadaṇḍenā'ti bhikkhūhi itthan'nāmo n'eva vattabbo, na ovaditabbo, nānusāsitabbo'ti (cūḷava. 445) katena brahmadaṇḍena.

meaning_1: severe punishment; highest penalty; a Brahman's curse
example_1: atha kho tassa rājā okkāko bhīto saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto brahmadaṇḍena tajjito maddarūpiṃ dhītaraṃ adāsi.

meaning_lit: given by god; (or) protected by god
example_1: atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto kāsigāmake kumbhakārakule nibbattitvā kumbhakārakammaṃ katvā puttadāraṃ posesi.
commentary: (JAa) rāja brahmadattā'ti dvīhi'pi rājānaṃ ālapati.

meaning_lit: given by god; (or) protected by god
example_1: kassapassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa brahmadatto nāma brāhmaṇo pitā ahosi. dhanavatī nāma brāhmaṇī mātā ahosi janetti.

meaning_1: name of one the seven Bharata kings
meaning_lit: given by god; (or) protected by god
example_1: sattabhū brahmadatto ca, vessabhū bharato saha, reṇu dve dhataraṭṭhā ca, tadāsuṃ satta bhāradhā'ti.

brāhmaṇā, bho kaccāna, evam'āhaṃsu, brāhmaṇo'va seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīno añño vaṇṇo, brāhmaṇo'va sukko vaṇṇo, kaṇho añño vaṇṇo, brāhmaṇā'va sujjhanti, no abrāhmaṇā, brāhmaṇā'va brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā brahmajā brahmanimmitā brahmadāy'ādā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) brahmadāy'ādā'ti brahmuno dāy'ādā.

meaning_lit: gift to Brahmans; (or) gift from god
example_1: tena kho pana samayena caṅkī brāhmaṇo opāsādaṃ ajjhāvasati satt'ussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭh'odakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) brahmadeyyan'ti seṭṭhadeyyaṃ, chattaṃ ussāpetvā rājasaṅkhepena bhuñjitabban'ti attho. atha vā… brahmadeyyan'ti seṭṭhadeyyaṃ, yathā dinnaṃ na puna gahetabbaṃ hoti nissaṭṭhapariccattaṃ, evaṃ dinnan'ti attho.

meaning_2: personal name of an arahant monk
family_set: names of arahants; names of monks
example_1: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena aññatarissā brāhmaṇiyā brahmadevo nāma putto bhagavato santike agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti.
iti h'idaṃ mārassa ca anālapanatāya brahmuno ca abhinimantanatāya, tasmā imassa veyyākaraṇassa brahmanimantanikaṃ't'eva adhivacanan'ti.

brāhmaṇā, bho kaccāna, evam'āhaṃsu, brāhmaṇo'va seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīno añño vaṇṇo, brāhmaṇo'va sukko vaṇṇo, kaṇho añño vaṇṇo, brāhmaṇā'va sujjhanti, no abrāhmaṇā, brāhmaṇā'va brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā brahmajā brahmanimmitā brahmadāy'ādā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) brahmanimmitā'ti brahmunā nimmitā.

meaning_1: who has attained holiness; become divine; (comm) become foremost
example_1: isisattamassa akuhassa, tevijjassa brahmapattassa, nhātakassa padakassa, passaddhassa viditavedassa, purin'dadassa sakkassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
commentary: (MNa) brahmapattassā'ti seṭṭhapattassa.

meaning_1: attainment of holiness; attaining the highest state
example_1: saccaṃ dhammo saṃyamo brahmacariyaṃ, majjhe sitā brāhmaṇa brahmapatti, sa t'ujjubhūtesu namo karohi, tam'ahaṃ naraṃ dhammasārī'ti brūmī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) brahmapattiyā'ti seṭṭhapattiyā.

example_1: manussabhūtaṃ sambuddhaṃ, attadantaṃ samāhitaṃ, iriyamānaṃ brahmapathe, cittass'ūpasame rataṃ.
commentary: (THa) iriyamānaṃ brahmapathe'ti catubbidhe'pi brahmavihārapathe, brahme vā seṭṭhe phalasamāpattipathe samāpajjanavasena pavattamānaṃ. (ANa) brahmapathe'ti seṭṭhapathe, amatapathe, nibbānapathe.

example_1: nanu tvaṃ, bhikkhu, passasi brahmaparisaṃ sannipatitan'ti? iti kho maṃ, bhikkhave, māro pāpimā brahmaparisaṃ upanesi.
example_2: yo c'eva, pāpima, brahmā, yā ca brahmaparisā, ye ca brahmapārisajjā, sabb'eva tava hatthagatā sabb'eva tava vasaṃgatā.

meaning_1: who praises god; who approves of god
example_1: ye pana, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ… bhūtapasaṃsakā bhūt'ābhinandino, devapasaṃsakā dev'ābhinandino, pajāpatipasaṃsakā pajāpat'ābhinandino, brahmapasaṃsakā brahm'ābhinandino, te kāyassa bhedā pāṇupacchedā paṇīte kāye patiṭṭhitā.

meaning_1: member of god's assembly; member of Brahma's council
example_1: atha kho, bhikkhave, māro pāpimā aññataraṃ brahmapārisajjaṃ anvāvisitvā maṃ etadavoca, bhikkhu, bhikkhu, m'etam'āsado m'etam'āsado
example_2: yo c'eva, pāpima, brahmā, yā ca brahmaparisā, ye ca brahmapārisajjā, sabb'eva tava hatthagatā sabb'eva tava vasaṃgatā.

example_1: tesaṃ, bhante, gopakena devaputtena paṭicoditānaṃ dve devā diṭṭh'eva dhamme satiṃ paṭilabhiṃsu kāyaṃ brahmapurohitaṃ, eko pana devo kāme ajjhāvasi.

meaning_1: who has become a god; (comm) reborn as a Brahma and attained arahantship from there
example_1: santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe devappattā viharanti, santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe brahmappattā viharanti, santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe āneñjappattā viharanti, santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe ariyappattā viharanti.
commentary: (ANa) brahmappattā'ti niddos'aṭṭhena brahmabhāvasādhakaṃ brahmavihāraṃ brahmavihārena ca arahattaṃ pattā.

meaning_1: nominal Brahman; Brahman merely by birth
meaning_2: relative of the Brahma; i.e. a Brahman
example_1: na āmagandho mama kappatī'ti, icc'eva tvaṃ bhāsasi brahmabandhu, sālīnam'annaṃ paribhuñjamāno, sakuntamaṃsehi susaṅkhatehi, pucchāmi taṃ kassapa etam'atthaṃ, kathaṃ pakāro tava āmagandho.
example_2: brahmabandhu pure āsiṃ, ajj'amhi saccabrāhmaṇo, tevijjo vedasampanno, sottiyo c'amhi nhātako'ti.
commentary: (SNPa) brahmabandhu brāhmaṇa-guṇa-virahita-jātimatta-brāhmaṇā'ti paribhāsanto bhaṇati.

example_1: dūre ito brāhmaṇi brahmaloko, yassāhutiṃ paggaṇhāsi niccaṃ, n'etādiso brāhmaṇi brahmabhakkho, kiṃ jappasi brahmapathaṃ ajānaṃ.
so h'āvuso, bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati, cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto, vattā pavattā, atthassa ninnetā, amatassa dātā, dhammassāmī tathāgato
example_2: so n'eva attan'tapo na paran'tapo diṭṭh'eva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhappaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati.
commentary: (ANa) brahmabhūtena attanā'ti seṭṭhabhūtena attanā

example_1: uḷāro so kaṇho isi ahosi. so dakkhiṇajanapadaṃ gantvā brahmamante adhīyitvā rājānaṃ okkākaṃ upasaṅkamitvā maddarūpiṃ dhītaraṃ yāci.
commentary: (DNa) brahmamante'ti ānubhāvasampannatāya seṭṭhamante.

example_1: brahmayānarūpaṃ vata, bho'ti!! sakkā nu kho, bhante, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye brahmayānaṃ paññāpetun'ti?
commentary: (SNa) brahmayānaṃ anuttaran'ti asadisaṃ seṭṭhayānaṃ.

meaning_1: epithet of the Noble Eightfold Path
example_1: sakkā, ānandā'ti bhagavā avoca, imass'eva kho etaṃ, ānanda, ariyassa aṭṭh'aṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanaṃ, brahmayānaṃ iti'pi, dhammayānaṃ iti'pi, anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo iti'pī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) ayañ'hi sabbadosavigamena seṭṭho, iminā ca ariyā nibbānaṃ yantī'ti brahmayānaṃ iti'pi

meaning_1: vehicle suitable for Brahma; as if God's carriage
example_1: tam'enaṃ jano disvā evam'āha, brahmaṃ vata, bho, yānaṃ! brahmayānarūpaṃ vata, bho'ti!!

meaning_1: leading to Brahma; going to the world of the gods
example_1: atha kho so, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu tathārūpaṃ samādhiṃ samāpajji, yathāsamāhite citte brahmayāniyo maggo pāturahosi.

meaning_1: Brahma's realm; world of the gods
example_1: ayaṃ loko paro loko, brahmaloko sadevako, diṭṭhiṃ te n'ābhijānāti, gotamassa yasassino.
example_2: ko sujjhati muccati bajjhatī ca, ken'attanā gacchati brahmalokaṃ, ajānato me muni brūhi puṭṭho, bhagavā hi me sakkhi brahmajjadiṭṭho, tuvañ'hi no brahmasamo'si saccaṃ, kathaṃ upapajjati brahmalokaṃ jutima.

meaning_1: leading to Brahma's realm; going to the world of the gods
meaning_2: leading to Brahma's realm; going to the world of the gods
example_1: siyā nu kho, māṇava, tassa purisassa naḷakāragāme jātavaddhassa naḷakāragāmassa maggaṃ puṭṭhassa dandhāyitattaṃ vā vitthāyitattaṃ vā'ti, na tv'eva tathāgatassa brahmalokaṃ vā brahmalokagāminiṃ vā paṭipadaṃ puṭṭhassa dandhāyitattaṃ vā vitthāyitattaṃ vā.

meaning_1: having Brahma's realm as ultimate goal; with the world of the gods as ultimate purpose
commentary: (ANa) brāhmaṇānañ'ca, yaññaṃ yajissāmā'ti cittaṃ abhinivisati, brahmaloke patte pariyosānappattā nāma honti. tasmā te yaññābhinivesā brahmalokapariyosānā'ti vuttā.

meaning_1: teaching the path to Brahma's realm
companionship (with those in) Brahma's realm; company of (those in) the world of the gods
example_1: karuṇāsahagatena cetasā… muditāsahagatena cetasā… upekkhāsahagatena cetasā… abyāpajjena pharitvā vihāsi sāvakānañ'ca brahmalokasahabyatāya maggaṃ desesi.
commentary: (DNa) sāvakānañ'ca brahmalokasahabyatāya maggaṃ desesī'ti brahmaloke brahmunā sahabhāvāya maggaṃ kathesi.

meaning_1: intent on Brahma's realm; fixated on the world of the gods
example_1: mayhaṃ kho, bhante, evaṃ ahosi, ime kho brāhmaṇā brahmalok'ādhimuttā, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ dhanañ'jānissa brāhmaṇassa brahmānaṃ sahabyatāya maggaṃ deseyyan'ti.

meaning_1: reborn in the world of the gods; headed towards Brahma's realm
example_1: tuvaṭaṃ cittaṃ samādhiyati, mukhavaṇṇo vippasīdati, asammūḷho kālaṃ karoti, uttari appaṭivijjhanto brahmalok'ūpago hoti.

meaning_1: rebirth in Brahma's realm; re-arising in the world of the gods
example_1: taṃ kho pan'ānanda, kalyāṇaṃ vattaṃ na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāva'd'eva brahmalok'ūpapattiyā.

meaning_1: companionship with Brahma; company of God
meaning_2: companionship with Brahma; company of God
example_1: te vata, vāseṭṭha, tevijjā brāhmaṇā yaṃ na jānanti, yaṃ na passanti, tassa sahabyatāya maggaṃ desessanti. ayam'eva ujumaggo ayam'añjas'āyano niyyāniko niyyāti takkarassa brahmasabyatāyā'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

meaning_1: holy; divine; equal to Brahma; like god almighty
example_1: tuvañ'hi no brahmasamo'si saccaṃ, kathaṃ upapajjati brahmalokaṃ jutima.
commentary: (ANa) evaṃ kho doṇa brāhmaṇo brahmasamo hotī'ti evaṃ brahmavihārehi samannāgatattā brāhmaṇo brahmasamo nāma hoti. (VINt) brahmasamenā'ti brahmattabhāvasamena.

meaning_1: companionship with Brahma; company of God
meaning_2: companionship with Brahma; company of God
example_1: atha kho vāseṭṭho māṇavo evam'āha, ayam'eva ujumaggo, ayam'añjas'āyano niyyāniko niyyāti takkarassa brahmasahabyatāya, yv'āyaṃ akkhāto brāhmaṇena pokkharasātinā'ti.
commentary: (DNa) takkarassa brahmasahabyatāyā'ti yo taṃ maggaṃ karoti paṭipajjati, tassa brahmunā saddhiṃ sahabhāvāya, ekaṭṭhāne pātubhāvāya gacchatī'ti attho.

meaning_1: with a deep voice; with a voice like god; twenty-eighth of the thirty-two marks of a great man
example_1: brahmassaro kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo karavikabhāṇī, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
commentary: (MNa) brahmassaro'ti aññe chinnassarā'pi bhinnassarā'pi kākassarā'pi honti, tathāgato pana mahābrahmuno sarasadisena sarena samannāgato.

meaning_1: fact of having a deep voice; fact of having the voice of god
with god's splendour; having the glory of Brahma; (comm) with a body like Brahma himself
example_1: bhavañ'hi caṅkī abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahmavaṇṇī brahmavaccasī akhudd'āvakāso dassanāya
commentary: (MNa) brahmavacchasī'ti mahābrahmuno sarīrasadisena sarīrena samannāgato.

meaning_1: with god's splendour; having the glory of Brahma; (comm) with a body like Brahma himself
example_1: bhavañ'hi caṅkī abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahmavaṇṇī brahmavacchasī akhudd'āvakāso dassanāya
commentary: (MNa) brahmavacchasī'ti mahābrahmuno sarīrasadisena sarīrena samannāgato.

meaning_2: ancient name of the city of Benares

meaning_1: like Brahma in appearance; god-like in aspect; (comm) surpassingly beautiful
meaning_2: like Brahma in appearance; surpassingly beautiful
example_1: bhavañ'hi caṅkī abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahmavaṇṇī brahmavacchasī akhudd'āvakāso dassanāya
commentary: (MNa) brahmavaṇṇī'ti seṭṭhavaṇṇī, parisuddhavaṇṇesu'pi seṭṭhena suvaṇṇavaṇṇen'eva samannāgato'ti attho.

example_1: satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvesiṃ. satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvetvā satta saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punāgamāsiṃ. saṃvaṭṭamāne sud'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, loke ābhassar'ūpago homi, vivaṭṭamāne loke suññaṃ brahmavimānaṃ upapajjāmi.

meaning_1: divine dwelling; heavenly abode; sublime state
meaning_2: divine state of mind, name collectively given to mettā, karuṇā, muditā, and upekkhā
example_1: so cattāro brahmavihāre bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā brahmalok'ūpago ahosi.

meaning_1: who delights in god; who relishes god; who is very happy with god

example_1: tassa bhavānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo bhavesu bhavarāgo bhavanandī bhavasneho bhavamucchā bhavapipāsā bhavapariḷāho bhav'ajjhosānaṃ bhavataṇhā sānuseti.

sace maṃ, bhante, evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, jāti pan'āvuso ānanda, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavāti? evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ, jāti kho, āvuso, bhavanidānā bhavasamudayā bhavajātikā bhavappabhavā'ti. evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ.

meaning_1: ending of becoming; cessation of being; end of existence; (comm) Nibbāna
example_1: evaṃdiṭṭhino, bhikkhave, etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, yā c'āyaṃ bhave appaṭikulyatā, sā c'assa na bhavissati. yā c'āyaṃ bhavanirodhe pāṭikulyatā, sā c'assa na bhavissatī'ti.
example_2: vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho, taṇhānirodhā upādānanirodho, upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho, jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā nirujjhanti.
commentary: (MNa) bhavanirodho'ti nibbānaṃ.

meaning_1: leading to the ending of existence; leading to the cessation of being
example_1: yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako bhavañ'ca pajānāti, bhavasamudayañ'ca pajānāti, bhavanirodhañ'ca pajānāti, bhavanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañ'ca pajānāti, ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti

meaning_1: conduit to existence; channel to becoming; i.e. craving
example_1: pariciṇṇo mayā satthā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ, ohito garuko bhāro, bhavanetti samūhatā.
example_2: khīṇāya bhavanettiyā, diṭṭhe dhamme yathātathe, na bhayaṃ maraṇe hoti, bhāranikkhepane yathā.
commentary: (MNa) bhavanettī'ti bhavarajju, taṇhāy'etaṃ nāmaṃ. tāya hi goṇā viya gīvāya rajjuyā, sattā hadaye baddhā taṃ taṃ bhavaṃ nīyanti, tasmā bhavanettī'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: who has worn away the conduit to existence; who has destroyed the channel to becoming
example_1: sumbho subho matulo aṭṭhamo ca, ath'assumegho anīgho sudāṭho, paccekabuddhā bhavanettikhīṇā, hiṅgū ca hiṅgo ca mah'ānubhāvā.

meaning_1: ending of the conduit to existence; cessation of the channel to becoming
example_1: vedanāya… saññāya… saṅkhāresu … viññāṇe yo chando … adhiṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayā, ayaṃ vuccati bhavanetti. tesaṃ nirodho bhavanettinirodho'ti.

meaning_1: destruction of the conduit to existence; ending of the channel to becoming; (comm) extinction of craving
example_1: duve imā cakkhumatā pakāsitā, nibbānadhātū anissitena tādinā, ekā hi dhātu idha diṭṭhadhammikā, saupādisesā bhavanettisaṅkhayā, anupādisesā pana samparāyikā, yamhi nirujjhanti bhavāni sabbaso.
example_2: ye etadaññāya padaṃ asaṅkhataṃ, vimuttacittā bhavanettisaṅkhayā, te dhammasār'ādhigamā khaye ratā, pahaṃsu te sabbabhavāni tādino'ti.
commentary: (ITIa) bhavanettisaṅkhayā'ti bhavanettiyā taṇhāya parikkhayā.

meaning_lit: discourse on the conduit to existence

meaning_2: prosperous, polite word often used in the place of 'you'
example_1: labheyya nu kho so coro coraghātesu, āgamentu tāva bhavanto coraghātā, amukasmiṃ me gāme vā nigame vā mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā, yāv'āhaṃ tesaṃ uddisitvā āgacchāmī'ti
example_2: handa, kuto nu bhavaṃ vacchāyano āgacchati divādivassā'ti?

meaning_2: gone to the end of existence
gone to the end of existence

meaning_1: gentleman such as yourself; such a respectable person
example_1: ambho samaṇa, n'atthi dhammiko paribbajo, evaṃ me ettha hoti. tañ'ca kho bhavantarūpānaṃ vā adassanā, yo vā pan'ettha dhammo'ti.

grammar: masc, acc sg of bhavant, irreg
example_1: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ye'me, bho gotama, kulaputtā bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ uddissa saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, bhavaṃ tesaṃ gotamo pubbaṅ'gamo, bhavaṃ tesaṃ gotamo bahukāro, bhavaṃ tesaṃ gotamo samādapetā, bhoto ca pana gotamassa sā janatā diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjatī'ti.
example_2: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato

meaning_1: there will be those who say (to)
example_1: tassa bhavanti vattāro, iṅgha tāva āyasmā āgamaṃ pariyāpuṇassū'ti, iti'ssa bhavanti vattāro.
example_2: no ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu parisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhena kāyasamācārena samannāgato acchiddena appaṭimaṃsena, tassa bhavanti vattāro, iṅgha tāva āyasmā kāyikaṃ sikkhassū'ti, iti'ssa bhavanti vattāro

example_1: yadā c'āhaṃ, bho, samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ manteyyaṃ, mā me bhonto antar'antarā kathaṃ opātetha. kathāpariyosānaṃ me bhavanto āgamentū'ti.
example_2: labheyya nu kho so coro coraghātesu, āgamentu tāva bhavanto coraghātā, amukasmiṃ me gāme vā nigame vā mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā

grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of bhavapaccaya
meaning_1: dependent on existence; due to being
example_1: vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ

meaning_lit: discourse on the question about being

meaning_1: which leads to acquiring existence; related to getting (another) existence
example_1: katame cattāro? idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa oram'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni appahīnāni honti, upapattipaṭilābhiyāni saṃyojanāni appahīnāni honti, bhavapaṭilābhiyāni saṃyojanāni appahīnāni honti.
commentary: (ANa) bhavapaṭilābhiyānī'ti upapattibhavassa paṭilābhāya paccayāni.

meaning_1: fever for being; burning passion for existence
example_1: tassa bhavānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo bhavesu bhavarāgo bhavanandī bhavasneho bhavamucchā bhavapipāsā bhavapariḷāho bhav'ajjhosānaṃ bhavataṇhā sānuseti.

meaning_1: thirst for being; craving for existence
example_1: tassa bhavānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo bhavesu bhavarāgo bhavanandī bhavasneho bhavamucchā bhavapipāsā bhavapariḷāho bhav'ajjhosānaṃ bhavataṇhā sānuseti.

meaning_1: produced by being; generated by existence
example_1: sace maṃ, bhante, evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, jāti pan'āvuso ānanda, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavāti? evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ, jāti kho, āvuso, bhavanidānā bhavasamudayā bhavajātikā bhavappabhavā'ti. evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ.

meaning_1: attachment to existence; bondage to being
example_1: kusalī bhāsasī tesaṃ, mārapāsappahāyinaṃ, kassa te dhammam'aññāya, acchiduṃ bhavabandhanan'ti.

meaning_1: who has severed attachment to existence; who has broken bondage to being
example_1: bodhi mahānāmo atho'pi uttaro, kesī sikhī sundaro dvārabhājo, tiss'ūpatissā bhavabandhanacchidā, upasikhi taṇhacchido ca sikhari.

meaning_1: may you be well!; may you be happy! blessings!
example_1: bhavam'atthu bhavantaṃ jotipālaṃ, rājā disampati bhavantaṃ jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantayati, rājā disampati bhoto jotipālassa māṇavassa dassanakāmo'ti
commentary: (DNa) bhavam'atthu bhavantaṃ jotipālan'ti bhoto jotipālassa bhavo vuddhi vises'ādhigamo sabbakalyāṇañ'c'eva maṅgalañ'ca hotū'ti attho.

example_1: ekacce licchavī evam'āhaṃsu, kiṃ so bhavamāno saccako nigaṇṭhaputto yo bhagavato vādaṃ āropessati, atha kho bhagavā saccakassa nigaṇṭhaputtassa vādaṃ āropessatī'ti?
commentary: (MNa) kiṃ so bhavamāno saccako nigaṇṭhaputto, yo bhagavato vādaṃ āropessatī'ti yo saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhagavato vādaṃ āropessati, so kiṃ bhavamāno kiṃ yakkho bhavamāno udāhu indo, udāhu brahmā bhavamāno bhagavato vādaṃ āropessati? na hi sakkā pakatimanussena bhagavato vādaṃ āropetun'ti ayam'ettha adhippāyo.

meaning_1: wished for the well-being; desired the prosperity (of)
example_1: yehi jātehi nandissaṃ, yesañ'ca bhavam'icchisaṃ, te maṃ dārehi saṃpuccha, sā'va vārenti sūkaraṃ.
commentary: (SNa) bhavam'icchisan'ti vuḍḍhiṃ patthayiṃ.

meaning_1: infatuation with being; fixation on existence
example_1: tassa bhavānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo bhavesu bhavarāgo bhavanandī bhavasneho bhavamucchā bhavapipāsā bhavapariḷāho bhav'ajjhosānaṃ bhavataṇhā sānuseti.

meaning_1: source of becoming; reason for being; origin of existence
example_1: rūpaṃ disvā sati muṭṭhā, piyaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto, sārattacitto vedeti, tañ'ca ajjhosa tiṭṭhati, tassa vaḍḍhanti āsavā, bhavamūl'opagāmino'ti.
example_2: ye'maṃ kāyaṃ vivajjenti, gūthalittaṃ'va pannagaṃ, bhavamūlaṃ vamitvāna, parinibbissanti'n'āsavā'ti.
commentary: (THa) tassa vaḍḍhanti āsavā bhavamūl'opagāmino'ti bhavassa saṃsārassa mūlabhāvaṃ kāraṇabhāvaṃ upagamanasabhāvā kām'āsav'ādayo cattāro'pi āsavā tassa puggalassa upar'ūpari vaḍḍhantiyeva, na hāyanti.

meaning_1: yoke of being; bondage of existence
example_1: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, yogā. katame cattāro? kāmayogo, bhavayogo, diṭṭhiyogo, avijjāyogo.
commentary: (ANa) rūp'ārūpabhavesu chandarāgo bhavayogo, tathā jhānanikanti… bhavesu yojetī'ti bhavayogo.

meaning_1: detachment from the bondage of existence
meaning_lit: unyoking from the yoke of being
example_1: cattāro visaññogā, kāmayogavisaññogo, bhavayogavisaññogo, diṭṭhiyogavisaññogo, avijjāyogavisaññogo.
commentary: (DNa) arahattamaggo bhavayogavisaññogo nāma. sot'āpattimaggo diṭṭhiyogavisaññogo nāma.

meaning_1: detachment from the bond of being; disconnection from bondage to existence
example_1: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, visaṃyogā. katame cattāro? kāmayogavisaṃyogo, bhavayogavisaṃyogo, diṭṭhiyogavisaṃyogo, avijjāyogavisaṃyogo.
commentary: (ANa) kāmayogavisaṃyogo'ti kāmayogato visaṃyojanakāraṇaṃ. sesapadesu'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: delighted with being; enjoying existence; taking pleasure in being; devoted to existence
example_1: bhavarāmāya vata, bho, pajāya bhavaratāya bhavasammuditāya samūlaṃ bhavaṃ udabbahī'ti.
example_2: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, olīyanti eke? bhav'ārāmā, bhikkhave, devamanussā bhavaratā bhavasammuditā tesaṃ bhavanirodhāya dhamme desiyamāne cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati n'ādhimuccati.

meaning_1: passion for existence; desire to be; desire to become
example_1: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, aniccasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sabbaṃ kāmarāgaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ rūparāgaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ bhavarāgaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ avijjaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ asmimānaṃ samūhanati.
example_2: āsīsanti thomayanti abhijappanti juhanti, kām'ābhijappanti paṭicca lābhaṃ, te yājayogā bhavarāgarattā, n'ātariṃsu jātijaran'ti brūmi.

meaning_1: afflicted with passion for existence; overcome by the desire to be; overwhelmed by the desire to become
example_1: bhavarāgaparetebhi, bhavarāg'ānusārībhi, māradheyy'ānupannehi, n'āyaṃ dhammo susambudho.

meaning_1: bond of passion for existence; fetter of desire to exist
example_1: satta saññojanāni, anunayasaññojanaṃ, paṭighasaññojanaṃ, diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ, vicikicchāsaññojanaṃ, mānasaññojanaṃ, bhavarāgasaññojanaṃ, avijjāsaññojanaṃ.

meaning_1: bond of passion for existence; fetter of the desire to exist
example_1: satta saṃyojanāni, anunayasaṃyojanaṃ, paṭighasaṃyojanaṃ, diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ, vicikicchāsaṃyojanaṃ, mānasaṃyojanaṃ, bhavarāgasaṃyojanaṃ, avijjāsaṃyojanaṃ.

meaning_1: underlying tendency towards passion for existence; inherent inclination to desire to become
example_1: kāmarāg'ānusayassa… paṭigh'ānusayassa… diṭṭh'ānusayassa… vicikicch'ānusayassa… mān'ānusayassa… bhavarāg'ānusayassa… avijj'ānusayassa pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
example_2: es'ev'anto vicikicch'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto mān'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto bhavarāg'ānusayānaṃ, es'ev'anto avijj'ānusayānaṃ

meaning_1: following passion for existence; acting according to the desire to be; motivated by the desire to become
example_1: bhavarāgaparetebhi, bhavarāg'ānusārībhi, māradheyy'ānupannehi, n'āyaṃ dhammo susambudho.
bhavarāmāya vata, bho, pajāya bhavaratāya bhavasammuditāya samūlaṃ bhavaṃ udabbahī'ti.
sokassa mūlaṃ palikhāya sabbaṃ, anāgu jhāyāmi asocamāno, chetvāna sabbaṃ bhavalobhajappaṃ, anāsavo jhāyāmi pamattabandhū'ti.
commentary: (SN) bhavalobhajappan'ti bhavalobhasaṅkhātaṃ taṇhaṃ.

meaning_1: intention to live; will to exist; drive to be; survival instinct
meaning_2: intention to live; will to exist
example_1: sītaṃ, uṇhaṃ, jighacchā, pipāsā, uccāro, passāvo, kāyasaṃvaro, vacīsaṃvaro, ājīvasaṃvaro, ponobhaviko bhavasaṅkhāro, ime kho, bhikkhave, dasa dhammā sarīraṭṭhā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) bhavasaṅkhāran'ti punabbhavasaṅkhāraṇakaṃ. (ANa) bhavasaṅkhāran'ti bhavagāmikammaṃ.

meaning_1: attached to being; clinging to existence
example_1: aññathābhāvī bhavasatto loko, bhavapareto bhavam'ev'ābhinandati, yadabhinandati taṃ bhayaṃ, yassa bhāyati taṃ dukkhaṃ, bhavavippahānāya kho pan'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
commentary: (UDa) aññathābhāvī bhavasatto'ti asambhave vaḍḍhiyaṃ hitasukhe satto laggo sattaloko maññanāya yathāruci cintiyamāno'pi viparītappaṭipattiyā tato aññathābhāvī ahitadukkhabhāvī vighātaṃ'y'eva pāpuṇāti. (UDa) atha vā aññathābhāvī'ti nicco me attā'tiādinā maññanāya parikappitākārato sayaṃ aññathābhāvī samāno anicco adhuvo'ti attho. bhavasatto'ti kām'ādibhavesu bhavataṇhāya satto laggo gadhito.

meaning_1: source of being; arising of existence
example_1: bhavasamudayā jātisamudayo, bhavanirodhā jātinirodho, ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo jātinirodhagāminī paṭipadā
commentary: (MNa) bhavasamudayā'ti ettha pana jātiyā paccayabhūto kammabhavo veditabbo.

meaning_1: with being as source; originating from existence
example_1: sace maṃ, bhante, evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, jāti pan'āvuso ānanda, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavāti? evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ, jāti kho, āvuso, bhavanidānā bhavasamudayā bhavajātikā bhavappabhavā'ti. evaṃ puṭṭho'haṃ, bhante, evaṃ byākareyyaṃ.

meaning_1: pleased with being; enjoying existence; happy to be
example_1: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, olīyanti eke? bhav'ārāmā, bhikkhave, devamanussā bhavaratā bhavasammuditā tesaṃ bhavanirodhāya dhamme desiyamāne cittaṃ na pakkhandati na pasīdati na santiṭṭhati n'ādhimuccati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, olīyanti eke.
example_2: bhavarāmāya vata, bho, pajāya bhavaratāya bhavasammuditāya samūlaṃ bhavaṃ udabbahī'ti.
commentary: (ITIa) bhavesu suṭṭhu muditā'ti bhavasammuditā.

meaning_1: barb of being; arrow of existence; (comm) dart leading to being
example_1: niṭṭhaṅ'gato asantāsī, vītataṇho anaṅgaṇo, acchindi bhavasallāni, antimo'yaṃ samussayo.
commentary: (DHPa) acchindi bhavasallānī'ti sabbāni'pi bhavagāmīni sallāni acchindi.

meaning_1: bondage to being; chain to existence
example_1: yesaṃ kesañci bhavasaṃyojanaṃ appahīnaṃ, sabbe te sadukkhā saupaghātā saupāyāsā sapariḷāhā micchāpaṭipannā'ti, iti vadaṃ itth'eke apasādeti.
example_2: bhavasaṃyojane ca kho appahīne bhavo'pi appahīno hotī'ti, iti vadaṃ dhammam'eva deseti.

meaning_1: wearing away the chain of existence; exhausting the bond of being
example_1: tato aññā vimuttassa, ñāṇaṃ ve hoti tādino, akuppā me vimuttī'ti, bhavasaṃyojanakkhayā.

meaning_2: pleasure of existence; enjoyment of being
example_1: bhavasātabaddhā'ti. ekaṃ bhavasātaṃ, sukhā vedanā. dve bhavasātāni, sukhā ca vedanā iṭṭhañ'ca vatthu. tīṇi bhavasātāni, yobbaññaṃ, ārogyaṃ, jīvitaṃ.

meaning_1: tied to the pleasure of existence; bound to the pleasure of being
example_1: icchānidānā bhavasātabaddhā, te duppamuñcā na hi aññamokkhā, pacchā pure vā'pi apekkhamānā, ime'va kāme purime'va jappaṃ.

meaning_1: stream of existence; current of being
example_1: tesaṃ phassaparetānaṃ, bhavasota-anusārinaṃ, kummaggapaṭipannānaṃ, ārā saṃyojanakkhayo.

meaning_1: flowing along the stream of being; following the current of existence
example_1: tesaṃ phassaparetānaṃ, bhavasot'ānusārinaṃ, kummaggapaṭipannānaṃ, ārā saṃyojanakkhayo.
example_2: tesu ussukkajātesu, bhavasot'ānusārisu, ke'dha taṇhaṃ pajahiṃsu, ke lokasmiṃ anussukā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) bhavasot'ānusārīsū'ti vaṭṭasotaṃ anusarantesu.

meaning_1: affection for being; love for sensual existence
example_1: tassa bhavānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo bhavesu bhavarāgo bhavanandī bhavasneho bhavamucchā bhavapipāsā bhavapariḷāho bhav'ajjhosānaṃ bhavataṇhā sānuseti.

meaning_2: gratification in being; satisfaction in existence

meaning_1: liberation from being; freedom from existence

grammar: masc, nom sg of bhavant, irreg
example_1: suvijāno bhavaṃ hoti, suvijāno parābhavo, dhammakāmo bhavaṃ hoti, dhammadessī parābhavo.
example_2: puṭṭho kho pana pañh'ābhinīto ahāpetvā alambitvā paripūraṃ vitthārena parassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsitā hoti. veditabbam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso ayaṃ bhavan'ti.

grammar: masc, nom sg of bhavant, irreg
example_1: kim'etaṃ bhavaṃ gotamo āha puna bhavaṃ gotamo bravitū'ti
example_2: atha ca pana bhavaṃ gotamo evam'āha, aham'pi kho, brāhmaṇa, kasāmi ca vapāmi ca. kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjāmī'ti.

grammar: imp 2nd pl of bhavatu, irreg form of bhavatha
