example_1: n'atthi samaṇassa gotamassa uttari manussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-viseso. takkapariyāhataṃ samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti vīmaṃs'ānucaritaṃ sayaṃpaṭibhānaṃ. yassa ca khv'āssa atthāya dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāyā'ti.
example_2: atthi nu kho me uttarimanussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-viseso adhigato, so'haṃ pacchime kāle sabrahmacārīhi puṭṭho na maṅku bhavissāmī'ti
commentary: (MNa) uttari manussadhammā'ti manussadhammato uttari

meaning_1: becoming a human being; acquiring the human state
example_1: kiccho manussapaṭilābho, kicchaṃ maccāna jīvitaṃ, kicchaṃ saddhammassavanaṃ, kiccho buddhānam'uppādo.

commentary: (VINa) paṇḍakā'ti ussannakilesā avūpasantapariḷāhā napuṃsakā, te pariḷāhaveg'ābhibhūtā yena kenaci saddhiṃ mittabhāvaṃ patthenti.

example_1: pañcannaṃ dhīro bhayānaṃ na bhāye, bhikkhu sato sapariyantacārī, ḍaṃs'ādhipātānaṃ sarīsapānaṃ, manussaphassānaṃ catuppadānaṃ.
commentary: (NIDD1) manussaphassā vuccanti corā vā assu mānavā vā katakammā vā akatakammā vā. te bhikkhuṃ pañhaṃ vā puccheyyuṃ vādaṃ vā āropeyyuṃ akkoseyyuṃ paribhāseyyuṃ roseyyuṃ viroseyyuṃ hiṃseyyuṃ vihiṃseyyuṃ heṭheyyuṃ viheṭheyyuṃ ghāteyyuṃ upaghāteyyuṃ upaghātaṃ vā kareyyuṃ. yo koci manussato upaghāto, manussaphasso.

example_1: sīhassa byagghassa ca dīpino ca, na vijjatī porisiyaṃbalena, manussabhāvo ca gavaṃ'va pekkho, jātī hi tesaṃ asamā samānā.
example_2: aṭṭhahi akkhaṇehi vajjitaṃ manussabhāvaṃ sandhāy'āha sudullabho laddho manussalābho'ti. tattha aṭṭha akkhaṇā nāma tayo apāyā arūpā asaññasattā paccantadeso indriyānaṃ vekallaṃ niyatamicchādiṭṭhikatā apātubhāvo buddhassā'ti.
commentary: (JAa) manussabhāvo ca gavaṃ'va pekkho'ti apica yo etesaṃ manussabhāvo, so gunnaṃ viya pekkhitabbo.

meaning_1: in human form; of human birth
example_1: manussabhūtaṃ sambuddhaṃ, attadantaṃ samāhitaṃ, iriyamānaṃ brahmapathe, cittass'ūpasame rataṃ.
commentary: (THa) manussabhūtan'ti manussesu bhūtaṃ, nibbattaṃ, manuss'attabhāvaṃ vā pattaṃ. (ANa) manussabhūtan'ti dev'ādibhāvaṃ anupagantvā manussam'eva bhūtaṃ.

example_1: yam'pi bhikkhave tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno micchājīvaṃ pahāya sammāājīvena jīvikaṃ kappesi
ime ce'pi, bhaddiya, mahāsālā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ akusaladhammappahānāya kusaladhamm'ūpasampadāya, imesam'pi'ssa mahāsālānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya, ko pana vādo manussabhūtassā'ti!
example_2: thūṇaṃ ce'p'āhaṃ acetanaṃ vādena vādaṃ samārabheyyaṃ, sā'pi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddhā saṅkampeyya sampakampeyya sampavedheyya. ko pana vādo manussabhūtassā'ti?
commentary: (THa) manussabhūtan'ti manussesu bhūtaṃ, nibbattaṃ, manuss'attabhāvaṃ vā pattaṃ.

example_1: kā ca, bhikkhave, sappurisānaṃ gati? devamahattatā vā manussamahattatā vā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) manussamahattatā'ti tiṇṇaṃ kulānaṃ sampatti.

meaning_1: king of human beings; lord of men
example_1: dutiyam'pi saddam'anussāvesi, bimbisāro ahaṃ bhagavā, bimbisāro ahaṃ sugatā'ti. idaṃ sattamaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, vessavaṇassa mahārājassa sahabyataṃ upapajjāmi, so tato cuto manussarājā bhavituṃ pahomi.
ārāmacetyā vanacetyā, pokkharañño sunimmitā, manussarāmaṇeyyassa, kalaṃ n'āgghanti soḷasiṃ.
commentary: (SNa) manussarāmaṇeyyassā'ti manussaramaṇīyabhāvassa. idāni manussaramaṇīyakavasena bhūmiramaṇīyakaṃ dassento gāme vā'ti-ādim'āha.

meaning_1: isolated from people; secluded from humans
example_1: veḷuvane kho'haṃ, brāhmaṇa, eta'r'ahi viharāmī'ti. kacci pana, bho ānanda, veḷuvanaṃ ramaṇīyañ'c'eva appasaddañ'ca appanigghosañ'ca vijanavātaṃ manussarāhaseyyakaṃ paṭisallānasāruppan'ti?
commentary: (VINa) manussarāhaseyyakan'ti manussānaṃ rahassakiriyaṭṭhāniyaṃ.

meaning_1: isolated from people; secluded from humans
example_1: yāni ca kho tāni sen'āsanāni appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhasseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni tathārūpehi sen'āsanehi saṃsaggaṃ vaṇṇayāmī'ti
commentary: (MNa) manussarāhasseyyakānī'ti manussānaṃ rahassakamm'ānucchavikāni, rahassamantaṃ mantentānaṃ anurūpānī'ti attho.

meaning_1: human world; world of men; human realm
example_1: katamā ca, bhikkhave, āsavānaṃ vemattatā? atthi, bhikkhave, āsavā nirayagamanīyā, atthi āsavā tiracchānayonigamanīyā, atthi āsavā pettivisayagamanīyā, atthi āsavā manussalokagamanīyā, atthi āsavā devalokagamanīyā.
example_2: loko'ti nirayaloko tiracchānaloko pettivisayaloko manussaloko devaloko khandhaloko dhātuloko āyatanaloko ayaṃ loko paro loko brahmaloko devaloko, ayaṃ vuccati loko.
commentary: (MNa) manussaloke sāvatthiyaṃ sattapaṇṇāsa kulasatasahassāni, rājagahe anto ca bahi ca aṭṭhārasa manussakoṭiyo vasiṃsu. evaṃ aññesu'pi ṭhānesū'ti manussaloke'pi gaṇavāso'va.

meaning_1: which leads to the human realm; which is conducive to human rebirth
example_1: katamā ca, bhikkhave, āsavānaṃ vemattatā? atthi, bhikkhave, āsavā nirayagamanīyā, atthi āsavā tiracchānayonigamanīyā, atthi āsavā pettivisayagamanīyā, atthi āsavā manussalokagamanīyā, atthi āsavā devalokagamanīyā.

meaning_1: leading to the human realm; conducive to human rebirth
example_1: manusse c'āhaṃ, sāriputta, pajānāmi, manussalokagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ, manussalokagāminiñ'ca paṭipadaṃ, yathā paṭipanno ca kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā manussesu upapajjati tañ'ca pajānāmi.

meaning_1: to be experienced in the human realm
commentary: (ANa) nirayavedanīyan'ti niraye vipākadāyakaṃ. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: perception of people; concept of humans
example_1: so evaṃ pajānāti, ye assu darathā gāmasaññaṃ paṭicca te'dha na santi, ye assu darathā manussasaññaṃ paṭicca te'dha na santi, atthi c'ev'āyaṃ darathamattā yadidaṃ, araññasaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan'ti.

yāvañ'c'idaṃ, bhante, bhagavā evaṃ manussagahane evaṃ manussakasaṭe evaṃ manussasāṭheyye vattamāne sattānaṃ hit'āhitaṃ jānāti. gahanañ'h'etaṃ, bhante, yadidaṃ manussā, uttānakañ'h'etaṃ, bhante, yadidaṃ pasavo.

ayañ'hi devaputto pubbe manussabhūto samāno manussadaliddo ahosi manussakapaṇo manussavarāko, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapanno devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahabyataṃ. so aññe deve atirocati vaṇṇena c'eva yasasā cā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) manussavarāko'ti manussalāmako. (UDa) manussavarāko'ti manussānaṃ hīḷitaparibhūtatāya ativiya dīno.

example_1: yo pana bhikkhu sañcicca manussaviggahaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, satthahārakaṃ v'āssa pariyeseyya, maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya, maraṇāya vā samādapeyya
commentary: (VIN 1.1.3) manussaviggaho nāma yaṃ mātukucchismiṃ paṭhamaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ paṭhamaṃ viññāṇaṃ pātubhūtaṃ, yāva maraṇakālā etth'antare eso manussaviggaho nāma.

meaning_1: offence involving defeat related to humans
expellable offence of (killing a) human being
example_1: manussaviggahapārājik'āpatti uttarimanussadhammapārājik'āpattiyā methunadhammapārājik'āpattiyā adinn'ādānapārājik'āpattiyā aññabhāgiyā.

meaning_1: being which has taken the form of a human female
example_1: yakkhiyā vā petiyā vā paṇḍakena vā tiracchānagatāya vā manussaviggah'itthiyā vā saddhiṃ raho paṭicchanne āsane nisajjaṃ kappeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. amātugāme mātugāmasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

meaning_1: lord of men; ruler of men
example_1: cakkavattī ahuṃ rājā, jambumaṇḍassa issaro, muddh'āvasitto khattiyo, manuss'ādhipatī ahuṃ.

construction:
manussa + asura + sakka + rakkhasa + ā
manussāsurasakkarakkhasa + ā
compound_construction: manussā ca asurā ca sakka ca rakkhasā ca
example_1: mahāyasaṃ saṃparivārayanti naṃ, sace ca pabbajjam'upeti tādiso, nekkhammachand'ābhirato vicakkhaṇo, devā manuss'āsura-sakka-rakkhasā.
commentary: (DNa) manuss'āsurasakkarakkhasā'ti manussā ca asurā ca sakkā ca rakkhasā ca.

example_1: antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pī'ti tiracchānagat'itthiyā'pi methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevitvā assamaṇo hoti asakyaputtiyo, pag'eva manuss'itthiyā. tena vuccati, antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pī'ti.
example_2: mātugāmo nāma manuss'itthī, na yakkhī na petī, na tiracchānagatā. antamaso tadahujātā'pi dārikā, pag'eva mahattarī.
commentary: (VINa) pag'eva manuss'itthiyā'ti paṭhamataraṃ manussajātikāya itthiyā

meaning_1: lord of men; ruler of men; epithet of the Buddha
meaning_2: lord of men; ruler of men
example_1: dev'inda-nāg'inda-nar'indapūjito, manuss'indaseṭṭhehi tath'eva pūjito, taṃ vandatha pañjalikā labhitvā, buddho have kappasatehi dullabho'ti.
dev'inda-nāg'inda-nar'inda-pūjito, manuss'indaseṭṭhehi tath'eva pūjito, taṃ vandatha pañjalikā labhitvā, buddho have kappasatehi dullabho'ti.

commentary: (VINa) ubhatobyañjanā'ti itthinimittena ca purisanimittena cā'ti ubhohi byañjanehi samannāgatā.

example_1: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye manussesu paccājāyanti. atha kho ete'y'eva bahutarā sattā ye aññatra manussehi paccājāyanti.
example_2: appakā te manussesu, ye janā pāragāmino, ath'āyaṃ itarā pajā, tīram'eva anudhāvati.

example_1: chetvā khīlaṃ chetvā palighaṃ, indakhīlaṃ ūhacca manejā, te caranti suddhā vimalā, cakkhumatā sudantā susunāgā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) ūhacca manejā'ti ete taṇhāejāya anejā bhikkhū indakhīlaṃ ūhacca samūhanitvā catūsu disāsu appaṭihatacārikaṃ caranti.

example_1: akkharikāya'pi kīḷanti, man'esikāya'pi kīḷanti, yathāvajjena'pi kīḷanti. hatthismim'pi sikkhanti, assasmim'pi sikkhanti, rathasmim'pi sikkhanti, dhanusmim'pi sikkhanti, tharusmim'pi sikkhanti
commentary: (VINa) man'esikāyā'ti man'esikā vuccati manasā cintitajānanakīḷā, tāya kīḷanti.

grammar: masc, in comps, mano group, from manas
example_1: manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce paduṭṭhena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti, cakkaṃva vahato padaṃ.
example_2: aniccadassāvī kho pan'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavato manobhāvanīyānañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) munātī'ti mano, cittass'etaṃ nāmaṃ.
notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

example_1: ubhatodaṇḍakena ce'pi, bhikkhave, kakacena corā ocarakā aṅgam'aṅgāni okanteyyuṃ, tatrā'pi yo mano padūseyya, na me so tena sāsanakaro.
commentary: (MNa) yo mano padūseyyā'ti yo bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā mano padūseyya, taṃ kakacena okantanaṃ n'ādhivāseyya.

example_1: kusalaṃ idaṃ manokammaṃ sukh'udrayaṃ sukhavipākan'ti, ten'eva tvaṃ, rāhula, pītipāmojjena vihareyyāsi ahoratt'ānusikkhī kusalesu dhammesu.
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu visamena kāyakammena samannāgato hoti, visamena vacīkammena samannāgato hoti, visamena manokammena samannāgato hoti.
commentary: (DNa) amhākaṃ kul'ūpakattherā averā hontu abyāpajjā'ti evaṃ cintanaṃ mettaṃ manokammaṃ nāma.

example_1: tatra, bhikkhave, tividhā kāyakamm'antasandosabyāpatti akusalasañcetanikā dukkh'udrayā dukkhavipākā hoti, catubbidhā vacīkamm'antasandosabyāpatti akusalasañcetanikā dukkh'udrayā dukkhavipākā hoti, tividhā manokamm'antasandosabyāpatti akusalasañcetanikā dukkh'udrayā dukkhavipākā hoti.

meaning_1: defect of mind; imperfection of mental conduct
example_1: eta'r'ahi kho pan'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kusalo kāyavaṅkānaṃ kāyadosānaṃ kāyakasāvānaṃ, kusalo vacīvaṅkānaṃ vacīdosānaṃ vacīkasāvānaṃ, kusalo manovaṅkānaṃ manodosānaṃ manokasāvānaṃ.
pañca kāmaguṇā loke, manochaṭṭhā paveditā, ettha chandaṃ virājetvā, evaṃ dukkhā pamuccatī'ti.
tīṇi kho, āvuso gotama, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto daṇḍāni paññapeti pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyāti, seyyath'idaṃ, kāyadaṇḍaṃ, vacīdaṇḍaṃ, manodaṇḍan'ti.
commentary: (MNa) kāyadaṇḍaṃ vacīdaṇḍaṃ manodaṇḍan'ti ettha purimadaṇḍadvayaṃ te acittakaṃ payyapenti. yathā kira vāte vāyante sākhā calati, udakaṃ calati, na ca tattha cittaṃ atthi, evaṃ kāyadaṇḍo'pi acittako'va hoti. yathā ca vāte vāyante tālapaṇṇ'ādīni saddaṃ karonti, udakāni saddaṃ karonti, na ca tattha cittaṃ atthi, evaṃ vacīdaṇḍo'pi acittako'va hotī'ti imaṃ daṇḍadvayaṃ acittakaṃ paññapenti. cittaṃ pana manodaṇḍan'ti paññapenti.

example_1: manopakopaṃ rakkheyya, manasā saṃvuto siyā, manoduccaritaṃ hitvā, manasā sucaritaṃ care.
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako hirīmā hoti, hirīyati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena, hirīyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, hirīdhanaṃ
commentary: (VINa) manoduccaritan'ti abhijjhābyāpādamicchādiṭṭhiyo veditabbā. (ANa) manoduccaritan'ti abhijjhādi tividhaṃ akusalakammaṃ.

meaning_1: feeling related to the mind door

example_1: evaṃ, bhante. idaṃ kho, gahapati, dhātunānattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, cakkhuviññāṇadhātu… manodhātu, dhammadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu.
commentary: (SNa) cakkhudhātū'ti-ādīsu… tisso manodhātuyo manodhātu, vedan'ādayo tayo khandhā sukhumarūpāni nibbānañ'ca dhammadhātu, sabbam'pi manoviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇadhātū'ti.

example_1: evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ. tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na manaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me manonissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.

meaning_1: mental agitation; mental irritation; mental disturbance
example_1: manopakopaṃ rakkheyya, manasā saṃvuto siyā, manoduccaritaṃ hitvā, manasā sucaritaṃ care.
asu hi, bhante, manopaṭibaddho kālaṅ'karotī'ti.

meaning_1: heart's aspiration; mind's resolve; mental determination
example_1: mamañ'hi pubbe etadahosi, aho vata aññe'pi sattā itthattaṃ āgaccheyyun'ti. iti mama ca manopaṇidhi, ime ca sattā itthattaṃ āgatā'ti.
commentary: (DNt) manopaṇidhī'ti manasā eva patthanā, tathā cittappavattimattam'evā'ti attho

commentary: (SNPa) akkuṭṭho manopadosaṃ rakkheyya

meaning_1: mental corruption; dirt in the mind
example_1: samānabhāgaṃ kubbetha, gāme akkuṭṭhavanditaṃ, manopadosaṃ rakkheyya, santo anuṇṇato care.

meaning_1: mentally corrupted; epithet of a class of envious devas
example_1: ye pana mayaṃ ahumhā manopadosikā, te mayaṃ ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyimhā. te mayaṃ ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññam'aññamhi cittāni padūsimhā, te mayaṃ aññam'aññaṃ paduṭṭhacittā kilantakāyā kilantacittā.

example_1: santi, bhikkhave, manopadosikā nāma devā, te ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyanti. te ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññam'aññamhi cittāni padūsenti.
commentary: (DNa) manena padussanti vinassantī'ti manopadosikā, ete cātumahārājikā.

example_1: cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha viññāṇakāyā veditabbā, cha phassakāyā veditabbā, aṭṭhārasa mano'pavicārā veditabbā, chattiṃsa sattapadā veditabbā
example_2: aṭṭhārasamano'pavicāro ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā somanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati, domanassaṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati, upekkhāṭṭhānīyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicarati.
commentary: (MNa) manopavicārā'ti vitakkavicārā. vitakkuppādakañhi mano idha mano'ti adhippetaṃ, manassa upavicārāti manopavicārā.

meaning_1: led by mind; preceded by mind; headed by mind; with mind as forerunner
example_1: manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce paduṭṭhena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti, cakkaṃva vahato padaṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) dhammā'ti vedan'ādayo tayo khandhā. ete hi uppādapaccay'aṭṭhena somanassasampayuttamano pubbaṅ'gamo etesan'ti manopubbaṅ'gamā nāma.

meaning_1: who are worthy of respect; worthy of esteem
meaning_lit: who should be developed in mind
example_1: atha kho pañcak'aṅgassa thapatissa etadahosi, akālo kho tāva bhagavantaṃ dassanāya, paṭisallīno bhagavā. manobhāvaniyānam'pi bhikkhūnaṃ asamayo dassanāya, paṭisallīnā manobhāvaniyā bhikkhū.
commentary: (DNt) mano bhavanti manaso vivaṭṭanissitaṃ vaḍḍhiṃ āvahantī'ti manobhāvaniyā'ti

meaning_1: who are worthy of respect; worthy of esteem
meaning_lit: who should be developed in mind
example_1: aniccadassāvī kho pan'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavato manobhāvanīyānañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ.
example_2: so khv'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ vā payirupāsitvā manobhāvanīye vā bhikkhū sāy'anhasamayaṃ kapilavatthuṃ pavisanto, bhantena'pi hatthinā samāgacchāmi, bhantena'pi assena samāgacchāmi
commentary: (SNa) manobhāvanīyānan'ti manavaḍḍhakānaṃ. yesu hi diṭṭhesu kusalavasena cittaṃ vaḍḍhati, te sāriputtamoggallān'ādayo mahātherā manobhāvanīyā nāma.

example_1: manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce paduṭṭhena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti, cakkaṃva vahato padaṃ.
example_2: papañcasaññā itar'ītarā narā, papañcayantā upayanti saññino, manomayaṃ gehasitañ'ca sabbaṃ, panujja nekkhammasitaṃ irīyati.
commentary: (MNa) manomayā'ti jhānacittamayā.

meaning_1: name of a privately awakened Buddha
example_1: satthā pavattā sarabhaṅgo lomahaṃso, ucc'aṅgamāyo asito anāsavo, manomayo mānacchido ca bandhumā, tadādhimutto vimalo ca ketumā.
commentary: (MNa) asito anāsavo manomayo'ti ime'pi tayo janā.

meaning_1: knowledge of the psychic power of mentally producing a body
meaning_2: knowledge of the supernormal power of mental creation
example_1: tato paṭipāṭiyāva samādhi paññā vimutti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ… ākās'ānañc'āyatanasamāpatti… vipassanāñāṇaṃ manomayiddhiñāṇaṃ iddhividhañāṇaṃ dibbasotañāṇaṃ cetopariyañāṇaṃ pubbenivās'ānussatiñāṇaṃ dibbacakkhuñāṇaṃ…
commentary: (PM) katamā manomayā iddhi? idha bhikkhu imamhā kāyā aññaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimmināti rūpiṃ manomayaṃ sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ahīn'indriyaṃ.

example_1: tīṇi moneyyāni, kāyamoneyyaṃ, vacīmoneyyaṃ, manomoneyyaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) katamaṃ manomoneyyaṃ? tividhamanoduccaritassa pahānaṃ manomoneyyaṃ, tividhaṃ manosucaritaṃ manomoneyyaṃ, man'ārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ manomoneyyaṃ, manopariññā manomoneyyaṃ. pariññāsahagato maggo, manasmiṃ chandarāgappahānaṃ, cittasaṅkhāranirodhā saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpatti manomoneyyan'ti (mahāni. 14).

meaning_1: heart's desire; object of interest; wish
example_1: sabbattha sukhito hutvā, saṃsaritvā bhav'ābhave, anāgatamhi addhāne, lacchase taṃ manorathaṃ.

meaning_1: commentary on the Aṅguttara Nikāya compiled by Buddhaghosa

example_1: yathā saṅkāraṭhānasmiṃ, ujjhitasmiṃ mahāpathe, padumaṃ tattha jāyetha, sucigandhaṃ manoramaṃ.
example_2: dhī taṃ jammi jare atthu, dubbaṇṇakaraṇī jare, tāva manoramaṃ bimbaṃ, jarāya abhimadditaṃ.

meaning_2: delightful language; Magadha language; Pāḷi language

meaning_1: intention which results in mental action
example_1: katamañ'ca, puṇṇa, kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ? idha, puṇṇa, ekacco sabyābajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyābajjhaṃ vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyābajjhaṃ manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti.
commentary: (MNa) ubhayacopanaṃ appattā raho cintayantassa manodvāre pavattā manosaṅkhāro nāma.

meaning_1: mental intention; mental volition; mental will
example_1: kabaḷīkāro āhāro oḷāriko vā sukhumo vā, phasso dutiyo, manosañcetanā tatiyā, viññāṇaṃ catutthaṃ
example_2: tattha katamo kāyasaṅkhāro? kāyasañcetanā kāyasaṅkhāro, vacīsañcetanā vacīsaṅkhāro, manosañcetanā cittasaṅkhāro.

meaning_1: sustenance that is mental intention; nutriment of mental volition
example_1: evañ'hi, bhikkhave, tassa purisassa hoti, imaṃ c'āhaṃ aṅgārakāsuṃ papatissāmi, tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchāmi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan'ti. evam'eva khv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, manosañcetan'āhāro daṭṭhabbo'ti vadāmi. manosañcetanāya, bhikkhave, āhāre pariññāte tisso taṇhā pariññātā honti.
commentary: (VISMa) ekādasahi aggīhi sabbaso ādittā bhavā aṅgārakāsusadisāti passato upapattibhayaṃ na hotī'ti āha manosañcetan'āhāro aṅgārakās'ūpamena dīpetabbo'ti.

meaning_1: due to mental intention; caused by mental volition
example_1: vācāya vā h'ānanda, sati vacīsañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ. mane vā h'ānanda, sati manosañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ avijjāpaccayā ca.

meaning_1: epithet of a class of devas in Jain doctrine
example_1: atthi, bhante, manosattā nāma devā tattha so upapajjati.
commentary: (MNa) manosattā nāma devā'ti manamhi sattā laggā lagitā.
(ANa) kāyasandosan'ti kāyadvārassa dussanākāraṃ. sesadvaye'pi es'eva nayo.

commentary: (MNa) manosamācāre yo bhikkhu abhijjhālu byāpannacitto micchādiṭṭhiko hoti, tassa manosamācāro aparisuddho nāma.

example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, vappa, ye manosamārambhapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, manosamārambhā paṭiviratassa evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.

construction:

meaning_1: contact with the mind; mental impression; mental experience
example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhave, phasso? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, phassakāyā, cakkhusamphasso, sotasamphasso, ghānasamphasso, jivhāsamphasso, kāyasamphasso, manosamphasso. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, phasso.
example_2: cakkhusamphasso… sotasamphasso… ghānasamphasso… jivhāsamphasso… kāyasamphasso… manosamphasso loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etth'esā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati
commentary: (DNa) manosamphasso'ti ime dasa samphasse ṭhapetvā seso sabbo manosamphasso nāma. vedanāchakkam'pi eten'eva nayena veditabbaṃ. (MNa) manosamphasso'ti iminā sesā bāvīsati lokiyavipāka-manasampayutta-phassā. (SNa) manosamphasso'ti sāvajjanena bhav'aṅgena sampayuttaphasso.

meaning_1: caused by mental contact; produced by mental impression; born from mental experience
example_1: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, domanassaṃ? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetasikaṃ asātaṃ manosamphassajaṃ dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ, idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, domanassaṃ
example_2: cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, vedanākāyā, cakkhusamphassajā vedanā, sotasamphassajā vedanā, ghānasamphassajā vedanā, kāyasamphassajā vedanā, manosamphassajā vedanā.

meaning_1: feeling arisen from a mental impressions
dependent on feeling tone arisen from mental experience

meaning_1: dependent on contact with the mind; due to mental impression
construction:
mano + samphassa + paccaya + ā
manosamphassapaccaya + ā
example_1: manaṃ aññato passati, dhamme aññato passati, manoviññāṇaṃ aññato passati, manosamphassaṃ aññato passati, yam'p'idaṃ manosamphassapaccayā

meaning_1: mental experience and the corresponding field of consciousness; mental impression and the associated dimension of knowing
example_1: kuhiṃ me, samaṇa, gantvā mokkhasi? mam'eva, samaṇa, sotaṃ, mama saddā … mam'eva, samaṇa, ghānaṃ, mama gandhā, mam'eva, samaṇa, jivhā, mama rasā, mam'eva, samaṇa, kāyo, mama phoṭṭhabbā, mam'eva, samaṇa, mano, mama dhammā, mama manosamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanaṃ. kuhiṃ me, samaṇa, gantvā mokkhasī'ti?
commentary: (SNa) cakkhusamphassa-viññāṇ'āyatanan'ti cakkhuviññāṇena sampayutto cakkhusamphasso'pi viññāṇ'āyatanam'pi mam'evā'ti. ettha ca cakkhusamphassena viññāṇasampayuttakā dhammā gahitā, viññāṇ'āyatanena sabbāni'pi cakkhudvāre uppannāni āvajjan'ādiviññāṇāni. sotadvār'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

example_1: cakkhusamphass'āyatanaṃ, sotasamphass'āyatanaṃ, ghānasamphass'āyatanaṃ, jivhāsamphass'āyatanaṃ, kāyasamphass'āyatanaṃ, manosamphass'āyatanaṃ. chaphass'āyatano ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
aho vata ayam'āyasmā kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveyya, vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveyya, manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveyya!
example_2: ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā
commentary: (ANa) manosucaritan'ti tassa paṭipakkhabhūtaṃ tividhaṃ kusalakammaṃ.

meaning_1: who has the quality of ethical thought; endowed with the quality of virtuous mental behaviour
example_1: ṭhānañ'ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ manosucaritasamaṅgī taṃnidānā tappaccayā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyya, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjatī'ti pajānāti. ettāvatā kho, ānanda, ṭhān'āṭhānakusalo bhikkhū'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.

meaning_1: with mind as chief; ruled by mind
example_1: manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce paduṭṭhena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti, cakkaṃva vahato padaṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) evaṃ adhipativasena pana mano seṭṭho etesan'ti manoseṭṭhā. yathā hi gaṇ'ādīnaṃ adhipati puriso gaṇaseṭṭho seṇiseṭṭh'oti vuccati, tathā tesam'pi mano'va seṭṭho.

example_1: tīṇi soceyyāni, kāyasoceyyaṃ, vacīsoceyyaṃ, manosoceyyaṃ.
eta'r'ahi kho pan'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho kusalo kāyavaṅkānaṃ kāyadosānaṃ kāyakasāvānaṃ, kusalo vacīvaṅkānaṃ vacīdosānaṃ vacīkasāvānaṃ, kusalo manovaṅkānaṃ manodosānaṃ manokasāvānaṃ.
aniccaṃ dukkhan'ti vipassa yoniso, suññaṃ anattā'ti aghaṃ vadhan'ti ca, manovicāre uparundha cetaso, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
commentary: (THa) manovicāre uparundha cetaso'ti manovicārasaññino gehasita-somanass'upavicār'ādike aṭṭhārasa cetaso uparundha vārehi nirodhehi.

meaning_1: thinking and knowing; mind consciousness; mental awareness; sentience
example_1: nissaṭṭhena āvuso, pañcahi indriyehi parisuddhena manoviññāṇena ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ neyyaṃ, anantaṃ viññāṇan'ti viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ neyyaṃ
example_2: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, viññāṇakāyā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotaviññāṇaṃ, ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyaviññāṇaṃ, manoviññāṇaṃ. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) viññāṇavāre cakkhuviññāṇan'ti cakkhumhi viññāṇaṃ, cakkhuto vā jātaṃ viññāṇan'ti cakkhuviññāṇaṃ. evaṃ sotaghānajivhākāyaviññāṇāni. itaraṃ pana mano'y'eva viññāṇan'ti manoviññāṇaṃ. dvipañcaviññāṇavajjassa tebhūmakavipākacittass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

meaning_1: knowing; mind consciousness element; mental awareness
example_1: evaṃ, bhante. idaṃ kho, gahapati, dhātunānattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, cakkhuviññāṇadhātu… manodhātu, dhammadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu.
commentary: (SNa) cakkhudhātū'ti-ādīsu… tisso manodhātuyo manodhātu, vedan'ādayo tayo khandhā sukhumarūpāni nibbānañ'ca dhammadhātu, sabbam'pi manoviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇadhātū'ti.

example_1: evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ. tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na manoviññāṇaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me manoviññāṇanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.

meaning_lit: to be known by mind knowing
example_1: manaṃ, āvuso channa, manoviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme etaṃ mama, eso'ham'asmi, eso me attā'ti samanupassasī'ti?

meaning_lit: to be known by the mind
meaning_2: to be comprehended by the mind
example_1: ye te manoviññeyyā dhammā aviññātā aviññātapubbā, na ca vijānāsi, na ca te hoti vijāneyyan'ti? atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
example_2: bhusā ce'pi manoviññeyyā dhammā manassa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, n'ev'assa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti. amissīkatam'ev'assa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ vayañ'c'ass'ānupassati.
commentary: (ADha) manoviññāṇena jānituṃ sakkā'ti manoviññeyyaṃ.

meaning_1: thought; (comm) thought arisen in the mind
example_1: kummo aṅgāni sake kapāle, samodahaṃ bhikkhu manovitakke, anissito aññam'aheṭhayāno, parinibbuto n'ūpavadeyya kañcī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) manovitakke'ti manamhi uppannavitakke.

meaning_1: mantra; scripture; sacred hymn; Veda; chant
example_1: asajjhāyamalā mantā, anuṭṭhānamalā gharā, malaṃ vaṇṇassa kosajjaṃ, pamādo rakkhato malaṃ.

meaning_1: bearer of the Vedas; Vedic reciter
example_1: tena kho pana samayena brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa ambaṭṭho nāma māṇavo antevāsī hoti ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo
example_2: uppātesu nimittesu, lakkhaṇesu ca kovidaṃ, ajjhāyakaṃ mantadharaṃ, porohicce ṭhapeti so.
commentary: (APAa) mantadharo'ti mantānaṃ dhāretā'ti attho, vedasaṅkhātassa catutthavedassa sajjhāyana-savana-dānānaṃ vasena dhāretā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

example_1: atha āgaccheyya suddo vā suddadāso vā, tasmiṃ padese ṭhito tadeva mantanaṃ manteyya, evam'pi rājā pasenadi kosalo āha, evam'pi rājā pasenadi kosalo āhā'ti.

meaning_1: family name of a Sakyan arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in giving Dhamma talks
example_1: puṇṇo nāma, bhante, āyasmā mantāṇiputto jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito, attanā ca app'iccho app'icchakathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā
example_2: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ puṇṇo mantāṇiputto.
commentary: (MNa) puṇṇo'ti tassa therassa nāmaṃ. mantāṇiyā pana so putto, tasmā mantāṇiputto'ti vuccati. (MNa) mantāṇiputto'ti mantāṇiyā brāhmaṇiyā putto. (ANa) puṇṇo mantāṇiputto'ti nāmena puṇṇo, mantāṇibrāhmaṇiyā pana so putto'ti mantāṇiputto. tassa pañhakamme ayam'anupubbikathā, ayaṃ kira padum'uttara-dasabalassa uppattito puretaram'eva haṃsavatīnagare brāhmaṇamahāsālakule nibbatti. tassa nāmaggahaṇadivase gotamo'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu. so vayappatto tayo vede uggaṇhitvā sabbasippesu kovido hutvā pañcamāṇavakasataparivāro vicaranto tayo'pi vede oloketvā mokkhadhammaṃ adisvā idaṃ vedattayaṃ nāma kadalikkhandho viya bahi maṭṭhaṃ anto nissāraṃ, imaṃ gahetvā vicaraṇaṃ thusakoṭṭanasadisaṃ hoti. kiṃ me iminā'ti isipabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā brahmavihāre nibbattetvā aparihīnajjhāno brahmalokok'ūpapanno bhavissāmī'ti pañcahi māṇavakasatehi saddhiṃ pabbatapādaṃ gantvā isipabbajjaṃ pabbaji. tassa parivārāni aṭṭhārassa jaṭilasahassāni ahesuṃ. so pañca abhiññā aṭṭha samāpattiyo nibbattetvā tesam'pi kasiṇaparikammaṃ ācikkhi. te tassa ovāde ṭhatvā sabbe'pi pañca abhiññā aṭṭha samāpattiyo nibbattesuṃ. (APAa) mantāṇiputto'ti mantāṇīnāmāya kappakadhītuyā putto, māsapuṇṇatāya divasapuṇṇatāya puṇṇo'ti laddhanāmo'ti attho.
notes: Theragāthā verse 4 (TH1.4, TH4) is attributed to him.

meaning_1: of great splendour; extremely glorious; superbly bright
example_1: no h'idaṃ bho kassapa. evam'eva kho, rājañña, yathārūpe yaññe gāvo vā haññanti, aj'eḷakā vā haññanti, kukkuṭasūkarā vā haññanti, vividhā vā pāṇā saṃghātaṃ āpajjanti, paṭiggāhakā ca honti micchādiṭṭhī micchāsaṅkappā micchāvācā micchākamm'antā micchāājīvā micchāvāyāmā micchāsatī micchāsamādhī, evarūpo kho, rājañña, yañño na mahapphalo hoti na mah'ānisaṃso na mahājutiko na mahāvipphāro.

meaning_1: of great splendour; extremely glorious; superbly bright

example_1: imaṃ kho me tumhe, bhikkhave, saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ dhāretha, sātiṃ pana bhikkhuṃ kevaṭṭaputtaṃ mahātaṇhājāla-taṇhāsaṅghāṭa-ppaṭimukkan'ti.
commentary: (MNa) mahātaṇhājāla-taṇhāsaṅghāṭa-paṭimukkan'ti taṇhā'va saṃsibbit'aṭṭhena mahātaṇhājālaṃ, saṅghaṭit'aṭṭhena saṅghāṭan'ti vuccati. iti imasmiṃ mahātaṇhājāle taṇhāsaṅghāṭe ca imaṃ sātiṃ bhikkhuṃ kevaṭṭaputtaṃ paṭimukkaṃ dhāretha. anupaviṭṭho antogadho'ti naṃ dhārethā'ti attho.

example_1: santi, bhante, aññāni mahānagarāni, seyyath'idaṃ, campā rājagahaṃ sāvatthī sāketaṃ kosambī bārāṇasī, ettha bhagavā parinibbāyatu.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, saradasamaye kassako mahānaṅgalena kasanto sabbāni mūlasantānakāni sampadālento kasati, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, aniccasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sabbaṃ kāmarāgaṃ pariyādiyati, sabbaṃ rūparāgaṃ pariyādiyati, sabbaṃ bhavarāgaṃ pariyādiyati, sabbaṃ avijjaṃ pariyādiyati, sabbaṃ asmimānaṃ samūhanati.

example_2: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yatth'imā mahānadiyo saṃsandanti samenti, seyyath'idaṃ, gaṅgā, yamunā, aciravatī, sarabhū, mahī, tato puriso dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni uddhareyya.

example_1: itiha te ubho'pi mahānāgā aññam'aññassa subhāsitaṃ samanumodiṃsū'ti.

example_1: varam'assatarā dantā, ājānīyā ca sindhavā, kuñjarā ca mahānāgā, attadanto tato varaṃ.
example_2: tesaṃ'y'eva kho pana, bhikkhave, mahānāgānaṃ anusikkhamānā taruṇā bhiṅkacchāpā taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamuḷālaṃ abbuhetvā na suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā sakaddamaṃ asaṅkhāditvā ajjhoharanti.

meaning_1: name of a Sakyan layman; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost layman in giving fine things
example_1: atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
example_2: kathañ'ca, mahānāma, ariyasāvako sīlasampanno hoti? idha, mahānāma, ariyasāvako sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
commentary: (ANa) mahānāmo'ti dasabalassa cūḷapitu putto eko sakyarājā. (ANa) paṇītadāyakānan'ti paṇītarasadāyakānaṃ mahānāmo sakko aggo'ti dasseti. so kira padum'uttarabuddhakāle haṃsavatiyaṃ kulagehe nibbatto satthu dhammakathaṃ suṇanto satthāraṃ ekaṃ upāsakaṃ paṇītarasadāyakānaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā adhikārakammaṃ katvā taṃ ṭhān'antaraṃ patthesi. so kappasatasahassaṃ devamanussesu saṃsaritvā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde kapilavatthupure sakyarājakule nibbattitvā vayappatto dasabalassa paṭhamadassane'y'eva sot'āpattiphale patiṭṭhāsi.

meaning_1: name of a privately awakened Buddha
example_1: bodhi mahānāmo atho'pi uttaro, kesī sikhī sundaro dvārabhājo, tiss'ūpatissā bhavabandhanacchidā, upasikhi taṇhacchido ca sikhari.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, subhūmiyaṃ catumahāpathe mahānigrodho samantā pakkhīnaṃ paṭisaraṇaṃ hoti, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, saddho kulaputto bahuno janassa paṭisaraṇaṃ hoti bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānanti.
hoti kho so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena tassa mahānirayassa puratthimaṃ dvāraṃ apāpurīyati.
example_2: atha kho, pāpima, kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho nāg'āpalokitaṃ apalokesi, na v'āyaṃ dūsī māro mattam'aññāsī'ti. sah'āpalokanāya ca pana, pāpima, dūsī māro tamhā ca ṭhānā cavi mahānirayañ'ca upapajji.

example_1: yesañ'ca mayaṃ cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paribhuñjāma, tesaṃ te kārā amhesu mahapphalā bhavissanti mah'ānisaṃsā
example_2: disvāna āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi, ān'āpānassatiṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. ān'āpānassati, rāhula, bhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mah'ānisaṃsā'ti.

example_1: atthi pana, bho gotama, añño yañño imāya tividhāya yaññasampadāya soḷasaparikkhārāya app'aṭṭhataro ca appasamārambhataro ca mahapphalataro ca mah'ānisaṃsataro cā'ti?
commentary: (DNt) udayasaññitaṃ atisayena mahantaṃ nissand'ādi-phalaṃ etassā'ti mah'ānisaṃsataro.

meaning_1: of mighty power; of mighty splendour; of great majesty; of great magnificence
example_1: api ca te ahaṃ, brahme, gatiñ'ca pajānāmi, jutiñ'ca pajānāmi, evaṃ mah'iddhiko bako brahmā, evaṃ mah'ānubhāvo bako brahmā, evaṃ mahesakkho bako brahmā'ti.
example_2: imesaṃ ce tumhe, bhikkhave, dasannaṃ kathāvatthūnaṃ upādāy'upādāya kathaṃ katheyyātha, imesam'pi candimasūriyānaṃ evaṃ mah'iddhikānaṃ evaṃ mah'ānubhāvānaṃ tejasā tejaṃ pariyādiyeyyātha, ko pana vādo aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānan'ti!

meaning_1: of greater majesty; of greater magnificence; of superior splendour
example_1: passāmi kho ty'āhaṃ, mārisa, evarūpaṃ iddh'ānubhāvan'ti. tayā ca kho, mārisa, mayā ca sv'eva bhagavā mah'iddhikataro c'eva mah'ānubhāvataro ca. gaccheyyāsi tvaṃ, mārisa, tassa bhagavato upaṭṭhānaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassā'ti?

meaning_1: mighty power; mighty splendour; great majesty; great magnificence

meaning_1: name of an arahant nun; Buddha's foster-mother; first Bhikkhunī; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost nun in long-standing
family_set: great disciples; names of arahants; names of nuns
example_1: ekam'antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā mahāpajāpatī gotamī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
commentary: (MNa) mahāpajāpati gotamī'ti gotamī'ti gottaṃ. nāmakaraṇadivase pan'assā laddhasakkārā brāhmaṇā lakkhaṇasampattiṃ disvā, sace ayaṃ dhītaraṃ labhissati, cakkavattirañño aggamah'esī bhavissati. sace puttaṃ labhissati, cakkavattirājā bhavissatī'ti ubhayathā'pi mahatī'y'ev'assā pajā bhavissatī'ti byākariṃsu. ath'assā mahāpajāpatī'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu. idha pana gottena saddhiṃ saṃsanditvā mahāpajāpatigotamī'ti vuttaṃ.
notes: Therīgāthā verses 157-162 (TH6.6, TH55) are attributed to her.

meaning_1: name of an arahant nun; Buddha's foster-mother; first Bhikkhunī; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost nun in long-standing
family_set: great disciples; names of arahants; names of nuns
example_1: itthaṃ sudaṃ mahāpajāpatigotamī therī gāthaṃ abhāsitthā'ti.
example_2: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ rattaññūnaṃ yadidaṃ mahāpajāpatigotamī.
commentary: (MNa) ath'assā mahāpajāpatī'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu. idha pana gottena saddhiṃ saṃsanditvā mahāpajāpatigotamī'ti vuttaṃ. (ANa) theripāḷiyā paṭhame yadidaṃ mahāpajāpatigotamī'ti mahāpajāpatigotamī therī rattaññūnaṃ aggā'ti dasseti. (MNt) mahāpajāpatigotamī'ti ettha gotamī'ti tassa gotamagottato āgataṃ nāmaṃ, mahāpajāpati pana guṇato. (ANt) tattha gotamī'ti gottaṃ. nāmakaraṇadivase pan'assā laddhasakkārā brāhmaṇā lakkhaṇasampattiṃ disvā sace ayaṃ dhītaraṃ labhissati, cakkavattirañño mah'esī bhavissati. sace puttaṃ labhissati, cakkavattirājā bhavissatī'ti ubhayathā'pi mahatī'y'ev'assā pajā bhavissatī'ti byākariṃsu, tasmā puttapajāya c'eva dhītupajāya ca mahantatāya mahāpajāpatī'ti vohariṃsu. tadubhayaṃ pana saṃsandetvā mahāpajāpatigotamī'ti vuttaṃ.
notes: Therīgāthā verses 157-162 (TH6.6, TH55) are attributed to her.

meaning_1: of great understanding; having profound wisdom
example_1: vītataṇho anādāno, niruttipadakovido, akkharānaṃ sannipātaṃ, jaññā pubb'āparāni ca, sa ve antimasārīro mahāpañño, mahāpuriso'ti vuccati.
example_2: evaṃ vutte, bhagavā visākhaṃ upāsakaṃ etadavoca, paṇḍitā, visākha, dhammadinnā bhikkhunī, mahāpaññā, visākha, dhammadinnā bhikkhunī.
commentary: (MNa) mahāpaññā'ti mahante atthe mahante dhamme mahantā niruttiyo mahantāni paṭibhānāni pariggaṇhanasamatthāya paññāya samannāgatā.

meaning_1: state of great understanding; fact of having profound wisdom
example_1: katame cattāro? sappurisasaṃsevo, saddhammassavanaṃ, yonisomanasikāro, dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipatti, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahāpaññatā saṃvattantī'ti.
commentary: (PM) mahāpaññatāya saṃvattantī'ti katamā mahāpaññā? mahante atthe pariggaṇhātī'ti, mahāpaññā. mahante dhamme pariggaṇhātī'ti, mahāpaññā. mahantā niruttiyo pariggaṇhātī'ti, mahāpaññā. mahantāni paṭibhānāni pariggaṇhātī'ti, mahāpaññā.

meaning_1: fact of being highly intelligent; fact of having great understanding
example_1: nīcakulīnasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā nīcakulīnattaṃ upaneti, uccākulīnasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā uccākulīnattaṃ upaneti, duppaññasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā duppaññattaṃ upaneti, mahāpaññasaṃvattanikā paṭipadā mahāpaññattaṃ upaneti. kammassakā, māṇava, sattā kammadāy'ādā kammayonī kammabandhū kammappaṭisaraṇā.

meaning_1: leading to great wisdom; conducive to enormous understanding
example_1: mahāpaññasaṃvattanikā esā, māṇava, paṭipadā yadidaṃ, samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā upasaṅkamitvā paripucchitā hoti, kiṃ, bhante, kusalaṃ, kiṃ akusalaṃ, kiṃ sāvajjaṃ, kiṃ anavajjaṃ, kiṃ sevitabbaṃ, kiṃ na sevitabbaṃ, kiṃ me karīyamānaṃ dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya hoti, kiṃ vā pana me karīyamānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya hotī'ti?

meaning_2: Chapter 7 of the Sotāpattisaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

example_1: yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye sīlavante pabbajite kulaṃ upasaṅkamante manussā paripucchanti paripañhanti dhammaṃ suṇanti, mahāpaññāsaṃvattanikaṃ, bhikkhave, taṃ kulaṃ tasmiṃ samaye paṭipadaṃ paṭipannaṃ hoti.
commentary: (DNa) katamā mahāpaññā? mahante sīlakkhandhe pariggaṇhātī'ti mahāpaññā, mahante samādhikkhandhe paññākkhandhe vimuttikkhandhe vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhe pariggaṇhātī'ti mahāpaññā. mahantāni ṭhān'āṭhānāni mahantā vihārasamāpattiyo mahantāni ariyasaccāni mahante satipaṭṭhāne sammappadhāne iddhipāde mahantāni indriyāni balāni mahante bojjh'aṅge mahante ariyamagge mahantāni sāmaññaphalāni mahantā abhiññāyo mahantaṃ param'atthaṃ nibbānaṃ pariggaṇhātī'ti mahāpaññā.

meaning_1: leading to profound understanding; conducive to great wisdom
example_1: yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye sīlavante pabbajite kulaṃ upasaṅkamante manussā paripucchanti paripañhanti dhammaṃ suṇanti, mahāpaññāsaṃvattanikaṃ, bhikkhave, taṃ kulaṃ tasmiṃ samaye paṭipadaṃ paṭipannaṃ hoti.
yathā saṅkāraṭhānasmiṃ, ujjhitasmiṃ mahāpathe, padumaṃ tattha jāyetha, sucigandhaṃ manoramaṃ.
example_2: devayānaṃ abhiruyha, virajaṃ so mahāpathaṃ, kāmarāgaṃ virājetvā, brahmalok'ūpago ahu, na naṃ jāti nivāresi, brahmalok'ūpapattiyā.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ayaṃ mahāpathavī ek'odakā assa. tatra puriso ekacchiggaḷaṃ yugaṃ pakkhipeyya.
example_2: taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave, katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ, yo v'āyaṃ mayā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito ayaṃ vā mahāpathavī'ti?

meaning_1: with big feet; with a large footprint
example_1: santi hi, brāhmaṇa, nāgavane vāmanikā nāma hatthiniyo mahāpadā, tāsaṃ p'etaṃ padaṃ assā'ti.
mah'āpadāna nidānaṃ, nibbānañ'ca sudassanaṃ, janavasabha govindaṃ, samayaṃ sakkapañhakaṃ, mahāsatipaṭṭhānañ'ca, pāyāsi dasamaṃ bhave.

meaning_1: great reference; principal authority; principal source
example_1: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, mah'āpadese desessāmi, taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca.
example_2: addhā, idaṃ tassa bhagavato vacanaṃ, imassa ca bhikkhuno suggahitan'ti. idaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṃ mah'āpadesaṃ dhāreyyātha.
commentary: (DNa) mahāpadese'ti mahāokāse, mahāapadese vā, buddh'ādayo mahante mahante apadisitvā vuttāni mahākāraṇānī'ti attho.

meaning_1: name of a king of Mithilā
example_1: atha kho, bhikkhave, saṅkho nāma rājā yo so yūpo raññā mahāpanādena kārāpito. taṃ yūpaṃ ussāpetvā ajjhāvasitvā taṃ datvā vissajjitvā samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇ'addhika-vaṇibbaka-yācakānaṃ dānaṃ datvā metteyyassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa santike kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissati.
commentary: (DNa) raññā mahāpanādena kārāpito'ti raññā hetubhūtena tass'atthāya sakkena devarājena vissakammadevaputtaṃ pesetvā kārāpito.

meaning_1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk among those skilled in the expansion of perception
family_set: great disciples; names of arahants; names of monks
example_1: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ saññāvivaṭṭakusalānaṃ yadidaṃ mahāpanthako.
commentary: (DHPa) tassa ca dārakassa panthe jātattā panthako'ti nāmaṃ kariṃsu. tassā nacirass'eva aparo'pi gabbho patiṭṭhahi. sabbaṃ purimanayen'eva vitthāretabbaṃ. tassa'pi dārakassa panthe jātattā paṭhamajātassa mahāpanthako'ti nāmaṃ katvā itarassa cūḷapanthako'ti nāmaṃ kariṃsu. (THa) tena ca samayena rājagahe dhanaseṭṭhissa dhītā attano dāsena saddhiṃ santhavaṃ katvā ñātakehi bhītā hatthasāraṃ gahetvā tena saddhiṃ palāyitvā aññattha vasantī taṃ paṭicca gabbhaṃ labhitvā paripakkagabbhā ñātigharaṃ gantvā vijāyissāmī'ti gacchantī antarāmaggeyeva puttaṃ vijāyitvā sāminā nivattitā pubbe vasitaṭṭhāne vasantī puttassa panthe jātattā panthako'ti, nāmaṃ akāsi. tasmiṃ ādhāvitvā vidhāvitvā vicaraṇakāle tam'eva paṭicca dutiyaṃ gabbhaṃ paṭilabhitvā paripakkagabbhā pubbe vuttanayen'eva antarāmagge puttaṃ vijāyitvā sāminā nivattitā jeṭṭhaputtassa mahāpanthako'ti kaniṭṭhassa cūḷapanthako'ti nāmaṃ katvā yathāvasitaṭṭhāneyeva vasantī anukkamena dārakesu vaḍḍhantesu tehi, amma, ayyakakulaṃ no dassehī'ti nibundhiyamānā dārake mātāpitūnaṃ santikaṃ pesesi.
notes: Theragāthā verses 510-517 (TH8.3, TH231) are attributed to him.

example_1: seyyathā'pi, aggivessana, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre mahāpabbato.

meaning_1: having a large following; with a great congregation
example_1: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mahāparisānaṃ yadidaṃ uruvelakassapo.
commentary: (ANa) mahāparisānan'ti mahāparivārānaṃ uruvelakassapo aggo'ti dasseti. aññesañ'hi therānaṃ kañci kālaṃ parivāro mahā hoti kañci kālaṃ appo, imassa pana therassa dvīhi bhātikehi saddhiṃ ekaṃ samaṇasahassaṃ nibaddhaparivāro'va ahosi. tesu ek'ekasmiṃ ek'ekaṃ pabbājente dve samaṇasahassāni honti, dve dve pabbājente tīṇi sahassāni honti. tasmā so mahāparivārānaṃ aggo nāma jāto.

meaning_1: with a large retinue; having a large following
example_1: buddho samāno kiṃ labhati? mahāparivāro hoti, mah'āssa honti parivārā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā. buddho samāno idaṃ labhati.

meaning_1: fact of having a big retinue; fact of having a large entourage
example_1: addham'idaṃ, bhikkhave, lābhānaṃ yadidaṃ āraññikattaṃ … piṇḍapātikattaṃ… paṃsukūlikattaṃ… tecīvarikattaṃ… dhammakathikattaṃ… vinayadharattaṃ … bāhusaccaṃ… thāvareyyaṃ… ākappasampadā… parivārasampadā… mahāparivāratā… kolaputti… vaṇṇapokkharatā… kalyāṇavākkaraṇatā… app'icchatā… appābādhatā'ti.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, māgaṇḍiya, api nu so puriso iti c'itic'eva kāyaṃ sannāmeyyā'ti? evaṃ, bho gotama. taṃ kissa hetu? asu hi, bho gotama, aggi dukkhasamphasso c'eva mah'ābhitāpo ca mahāpariḷāho cā'ti.
example_2: aṅgārakās'ūpamā kāmā mahāpariḷāh'aṭṭhenā'ti passanto vikkhambhanato kāme parivajjeti

meaning_1: large pile of earth; big heap of soil
example_1: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, catumahāpathe mahāpaṃsupuñjo. puratthimāya ce'pi disāyaṃ āgaccheyya sakaṭaṃ vā ratho vā, upahanat'eva taṃ paṃsupuñjaṃ

meaning_1: name of a group of deities
example_1: ath'āguṃ harayo devā, ye ca lohitavāsino, pāragā mahāpāragā, āguṃ devā yasassino, das'ete dasadhā kāyā, sabbe nānattavaṇṇino.
commentary: (DNa) pāragā mahāpāragā'ti ete ca duvidhā āgatā.

example_1: aparesam'pi dasannaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati, jeṭṭhabhātu, kaniṭṭhabhātu, jeṭṭhabhaginiyā, kaniṭṭhabhaginiyā, cūḷamātuyā, mahāmātuyā, cūḷapituno, mahāpituno, pitucchāya, mātulassā'ti.
commentary: (VVt) mahāpitā pitu jeṭṭhabhātā.

meaning_1: having great merit; extremely auspicious; very virtuous
example_1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū rajak'attharaṇaṃ gantvā rajakabhaṇḍikaṃ avaharitvā ārāmaṃ haritvā bhājesuṃ. bhikkhū evam'āhaṃsu, mahāpuññ'attha tumhe, āvuso.
example_2: mahantañ'ca taṃ padumavanañ'cā'ti mahāpadumavanaṃ, mahantī ca sā nadī cā'ti mahānadī, mahanto ca so maṇi cā'ti mahāmaṇi, mahanto ca so gahapatiko cā'ti mahāgahapatiko, mahantañ'ca taṃ dhanañ'cā'ti mahādhanaṃ, mahanto ca so puñño cā'ti mahāpuñño.

meaning_1: massive mountain of merit; great mass of good
example_1: imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi puññ'ābhisandehi kusal'ābhisandehi samannāgatassa ariyasāvakassa na sukaraṃ puññassa pamāṇaṃ gaṇetuṃ, ettako puññ'ābhisando, kusal'ābhisando, sukhass'āhāro'ti. atha kho asaṅkhyeyyo appameyyo mahāpuññakkhandho tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
devadahaṃ pañcattayaṃ, kin'ti-sāma-sunakkhattaṃ, sappāya-gaṇa-gopaka-mahāpuṇṇa-cūḷapuṇṇañ'cā'ti.

meaning_lit: longer (discourse) on the full moon night
example_1: cūḷavedalla-mahāvedalla-sammādiṭṭhi-sakkapañha-saṅkhārabhājaniya-mahāpuṇṇama-sutt'ādayo sabbe'pi vedañ'ca tuṭṭhiñ'ca laddhā laddhā pucchitasutt'antā vedallan'ti veditabbaṃ. evaṃ aṅgavasena navavidhaṃ.
commentary: (DNt) mahāpuṇṇamasuttaṃ (ma. ni. 3.85) pana tadah'uposathe pannarase puṇṇamāya rattiyā aññatarena bhikkhunā puṭṭhena bhagavatā bhāsitaṃ, taṃ majjhimanikāyapariyāpannaṃ.

meaning_lit: longer discourse on the full moon night

example_2: yo ubho'nte viditvāna, majjhe mantā na lippati, taṃ brūmi mahāpuriso'ti, so'dha sibbinim'accagā'ti.

meaning_1: auspicious marks of a great man; characteristics of an illustrious being
example_1: suppatiṭṭhitapādo kho pana bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
example_2: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati n'ādhimuccati na sampasīdati, kos'ohite ca vatthaguyhe, pahūtajivhatāya ca.
commentary: (MNa) mahāpurisalakkhaṇan'ti mahāpurisānaṃ buddh'ādīnaṃ lakkhaṇadīpakaṃ dvādasasahassaganthappamāṇaṃ satthaṃ

example_1: ayaṃ samādhi paccuppannasukho c'eva āyatiñ'ca sukhavipāko'ti paccattaññ'eva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati, ayaṃ samādhi ariyo nirāmiso'ti paccattaññ'eva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati, ayaṃ samādhi mahāpurisasevitoti paccattaññ'eva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati, ayaṃ samādhi santo paṇīto paṭippassaddhaladdho ekodibhāv'ādhigato
katame aṭṭha dhammā uppādetabbā? aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakkā, app'icchass'āyaṃ dhammo, n'āyaṃ dhammo mah'icchassa. santuṭṭhass'āyaṃ dhammo, n'āyaṃ dhammo asantuṭṭhassa.

meaning_1: meditation of a great man; internal dwelling of an illustrious being
example_1: sādhu, sādhu, sāriputta! mahāpurisavihārena kira tvaṃ, sāriputta, eta'r'ahi bahulaṃ viharasi. mahāpurisavihāro eso, sāriputta, yadidaṃ suññatā.
commentary: (MNa) mahāpurisavihāro'ti buddha-paccekabuddha-tathāgata-mahāsāvakānaṃ mahāpurisānaṃ vihāro.

example_1: mutt'āhaṃ sabbapāsehi, ye dibbā ye ca mānusā, mahābandhanamutto'mhi, nihato tvam'asi antakā'ti.
example_2: taṃ parisaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā mahābandhanā mokkhaṃ karitvā caturāsītipāṇasahassāni mahāviduggā uddharitvā tejodhātuṃ samāpajjitvā sattatālaṃ vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā aññaṃ sattatālam'pi acciṃ abhinimminitvā pajjalitvā dhūmāyitvā mahāvane kūṭ'āgārasālāyaṃ paccuṭṭhāsiṃ.
commentary: (DNa) mahābandhanā'ti mahatā kilesabandhanā mocetvā. (NIDD1a) mahābandhanan'ti mahantaṃ dumocayabandhanaṃ.

meaning_1: bound by a great bond; chained by a strong shackle
example_1: baddho'si sabbapāsehi, ye dibbā ye ca mānusā, mahābandhanabaddho'si, na me samaṇa mokkhasī'ti.
commentary: (PMa) mahābandhanabaddho'ti daḷhattā ducchedattā ca mahantehi bandhanehi baddho. (VINt) mahābandhanabaddho'ti mahatā kilesabandhanena baddho, mahati vā bandhane baddho, kilesabandhanassa ṭhānabhūte bhavacārake baddho'ti attho.

meaning_1: freed from a great bond; released from a strong shackle
example_1: mutt'āhaṃ sabbapāsehi, ye dibbā ye ca mānusā. mahābandhanamutto'mhi, nihato tvam'asi antakā'ti.

meaning_2: having a great power or strong force
example_1: mahāmatī mahāvīro, mahājhāyī mahābalo, mahākāruṇiko nātho, mahātamapanūdano.

meaning_1: having great discernment; of great wisdom; of enormous intelligence
example_1: paññāpāramitaṃ patto, mahābuddhi mahāmati, ajaḷo jaḷasamāno, sadā carati nibbuto.
commentary: (THa) mahābuddhī'ti mahā-puthu-hāsa-javana-tikkha-nibbedhika-bhāva-ppattāya mahatiyā buddhiyā paññāya samannāgato.

example_2: mātaraṃ pitaraṃ hantvā, rājāno dve ca khattiye, raṭṭhaṃ sānucaraṃ hantvā, anīgho yāti brāhmaṇo.

example_1: yāva hi vanatho na chijjati, aṇumatto'pi narassa nārisu, paṭibaddhamano'va tāva so, vaccho khīrapako'va mātari.
example_2: mātari pitari c'āpi, atho jeṭṭhamhi bhātari. ācariye catutthamhi, tesu na mānaṃ kayirātha.

example_1: ehi tvaṃ, samma mātali, sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ yojetvā nimiṃ rājānaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadehi, ayaṃ te, mahārāja, sahassayutto ājaññaratho sakkena devānam'indena pesito, abhiruheyyāsi, mahārāja, dibbaṃ yānaṃ avikampamāno'ti.
example_2: panādo opamañño ca, devasūto ca mātali, cittaseno ca gandhabbo, naḷo rājā jan'esabho.
commentary: (JAa) mātalī'ti sārathiṃ āmantesi.

example_1: sabrahmakāni, bhikkhave, tāni kulāni yesaṃ puttānaṃ mātāpitaro ajjhāgāre pūjitā honti.
example_2: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo akāmakānaṃ mātāpitūnaṃ assumukhānaṃ rudantānaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito

meaning_1: cared for by mother and father; treated with compassion by one's parents
example_1: tam'enaṃ mātāpitaro sakkatā garukatā mānitā pūjitā kalyāṇena manasā anukampanti, ciraṃ jīva, dīgham'āyuṃ pālehī'ti. mātāpit'ānukampitassa, mahānāma, kulaputtassa vuddhi'y'eva pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.

meaning_1: performing one's parental duties; fulfilling filial responsibilities
example_1: mātāpitukiccakaro, puttadārahito sadā, antojanassa atthāya, ye c'assa anujīvino.
commentary: (ANa) kiccakaro'ti uppannānaṃ kiccānaṃ kārako.

meaning_1: protected by a mother and father
example_1: yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi
commentary: (VIN) mātāpiturakkhitā nāma mātāpitaro rakkhanti gopenti issariyaṃ kārenti vasaṃ vattenti.

grammar: masc, comp, dat pl of mātāpitar
meaning_1: for mothers and fathers; for parents
example_1: brahmā'ti, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. pubb'ācariyā'ti, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. pubbadevatā'ti, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. āhuneyyā'ti, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
commentary: (VVt) puttānan'ti ca mātāpitūnan'ti ca sampadānavacanaṃ.

meaning_1: looking after one's parents; supporting one's mother and father
example_1: mātāpit'ūpaṭṭhānaṃ, puttadārassa saṅgaho, anākulā ca kamm'antā, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.
commentary: (SNPa) idāni mātāpituupaṭṭhānan'ti ettha mātu ca pitu cā'ti mātāpitu. upaṭṭhānan'ti upaṭṭhahanaṃ.

meaning_1: mother and son; mother and child
example_1: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyaṃ ubho mātāputtā vass'āvāsaṃ upagamiṃsu, bhikkhu ca bhikkhunī ca. te aññam'aññassa abhiṇhaṃ dassanakāmā ahesuṃ.
kumbhakāro pure āsiṃ, vekaḷiṅge ghaṭīkaro, mātāpettibharo āsiṃ, kassapassa upāsako.

meaning_1: from parents; from mother and father
example_1: cātumahābhūtiko mātāpettikasambhavo odanakummās'ūpacayo anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammo, idañ'ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan'ti

meaning_1: origination from one's parents; produced by one's mother and father
example_1: gaṇḍo'ti kho, bhikkhave, imass'etaṃ cātumahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummās'ūpacayassa anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammassa.
example_2: cātumahābhūtiko mātāpettikasambhavo odanakummās'ūpacayo anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammo, idañ'ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan'ti

meaning_1: supporting one's mother and father; looking after one's parents
example_1: kumbhakāro pure āsiṃ, vekaḷiṅge ghaṭīkaro, mātāpettibharo āsiṃ, kassapassa upāsako.

meaning_1: one's mother before; previously one's mother

example_1: atha naṃ ayaṃ te, tāta, mātāmaho, ayaṃ mātulo'ti vatvā vandāpesuṃ. so sabbe vandamāno vicaritvā ekam'pi attānaṃ vandantaṃ adisvā kiṃ nu kho maṃ vandantā n'atthī'ti pucchi.
commentary: (VINt) pitu mātā pitāmahī. mātu pitā mātāmaho. mātu mātā mātāmahī.

example_1: mattikan'ti mātito āgataṃ, idaṃ te mātāmahiyā mātu imaṃ gehaṃ āgacchantiyā gandhamāl'ādīnaṃ atthāya dinnaṃ dhanan'ti attho.
commentary: (VINt) pitu mātā pitāmahī. mātu pitā mātāmaho. mātu mātā mātāmahī.

example_1: taṃ kissa hetu? mātito hi, bho gotama, anupapanno'ti.

meaning_1: name for an early stage of the Abhidhamma in the suttapiṭaka and vinayapiṭaka; (comm) two Pātimokkhas
example_1: idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya, asukasmiṃ nāma āvāse sambahulā therā bhikkhū viharanti bahussutā āgat'āgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā. tesaṃ me therānaṃ sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
commentary: (ANa) mātikādharā'ti dvepātimokkhadharā.

example_1: ubbhatasmiṃ kathine'ti aṭṭhannaṃ mātikānaṃ aññatarāya mātikāya ubbhataṃ hoti, saṅghena vā antarā ubbhataṃ hoti.
commentary: (VINa) aṭṭhimā, bhikkhave, mātikā kathinassa ubbhārāya, pakkaman'antikā, niṭṭhānantikā, sanniṭṭhānantikā, nāsanantikā, savanantikā, āsāvacchedikā, sīm'ātikkantikā, sah'ubbhārā'ti

meaning_1: water course; irrigation channel; water way; canal
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, khettaṃ unnāmaninnāmi ca hoti, pāsāṇasakkharikañ'ca hoti, ūsarañ'ca hoti, na ca gambhīrasitaṃ hoti, na āyasampannaṃ hoti, na apāyasampannaṃ hoti, na mātikāsampannaṃ hoti, na mariyādasampannaṃ hoti.
commentary: (ANa) na mātikāsampannan'ti na khuddakamahantīhi udakamātikāhi sampannaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: two Pātimokkhas; precepts for Buddhist monks and nuns
commentary: (ANa) mātikādharā'ti dvepātimokkhadharā.

meaning_1: expert in the Abhidhamma; (comm) who knows the two Pātimokkha; who knows the summaries of the Dhamma and Vinaya
example_1: idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya, asukasmiṃ nāma āvāse sambahulā therā bhikkhū viharanti bahussutā āgat'āgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā. tesaṃ me therānaṃ sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
commentary: (ANa) mātikādharā'ti dvepātimokkhadharā. (VISMa) tesaṃ'y'eva dhammavinayānaṃ mātikāya dhāraṇena mātikādharā.

grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of māti
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, rañño bhaddo ass'ājānīyo ubhato sujāto hoti, mātito ca pitito ca. yassaṃ disāyaṃ aññe'pi bhaddā ass'ājānīyā jāyanti, tassaṃ disāyaṃ jāto hoti.
example_2: aññātikā nāma mātito vā pitito vā yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā asambaddhā.
commentary: (ANa) mātito ca pitito cā'ti yassa mātā brāhmaṇī, mātu mātā brāhmaṇī, tassā'pi mātā brāhmaṇī. pitā brāhmaṇo, pitu pitā brāhmaṇo, tassā'pi pitā brāhmaṇo, so ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca.

meaning_1: mother's side of the family; maternal lineage
example_1: mahantaṃ ñātisaṃghaṃ ohāyāt'i mātipakkhe asītikulasahassāni, pitipakkhe asītikulasahassānī'ti evaṃ saṭṭhikulasatasahassaṃ ohāya pabbajito.
commentary: (PYt) mātipakkha-pitipakkhato'ti mātuyā pakkho mātipakkho, pituno pakkho pitipakkho, mātipakkho ca pitipakkho ca mātipakkhapitipakkhā.

example_1: tapojigucchāya āyuttā, pālayaṃ pavivekiyaṃ, rūpe ca ye niviṭṭhāse, devalok'ābhinandino, te ve samm'ānusāsanti, paralokāya mātiyā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) mātiyā'ti maccā

meaning_1: for the mother; to the mother
example_1: dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yadā bodhisatto mātukucchimhā nikkhamati, dve udakassa dhārā antalikkhā pātubhavanti, ekā sītassa ekā uṇhassa yena bodhisattassa udakakiccaṃ karonti mātu ca. ayam'ettha dhammatā.
ayaṃ me mātā, tassā me mātu ayaṃ mātā'ti, apariyādinnā'va bhikkhave, tassa purisassa mātumātaro assu, atha imasmiṃ jambudīpe tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya.

kāmesumicchācārī hoti. yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi, tathārūpāsu cārittaṃ āpajjitā hoti
example_2: idha, visākhe, mātugāmo susaṃvihitakamm'anto hoti, saṅgahitaparijano, bhattu manāpaṃ carati, sambhataṃ anurakkhati.

example_1: manussaviggaho nāma yaṃ mātukucchismiṃ paṭhamaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ paṭhamaṃ viññāṇaṃ pātubhūtaṃ, yāva maraṇakālā etth'antare eso manussaviggaho nāma.
example_2: yathā pana aññe sattā mātukucchito nikkhamantā paṭikūlena asucinā makkhitā nikkhamanti, na evaṃ bodhisatto.
commentary: (VINa) tattha gabbhaseyyakānaṃ vasena sabba-sukhum'āttabhāva-dassan'atthaṃ, yaṃ mātukucchismin'ti vuttaṃ.

example_1: so ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca. saṃsuddhagahaṇiko'ti saṃsuddhāya mātukucchiyā samannāgato. samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā'ti ettha pana kammajatejodhātu gahaṇīti vuccati.
example_2: so amhe pajāpatiyo samānā attanā saddhiṃ ekamātukucchiyā sayitadārikā viya maññatī'ti samuppannabalavasokā hutvā tasmiṃ'y'eva padese mucchitā papatiṃsu, patitā'ti attho.

example_1: yañ'c'assa bhuñjatī mātā, annaṃ pānañ'ca bhojanaṃ, tena so tattha yāpeti, mātukucchigato naro'ti.
commentary: (SNa) mātukucchigato naro'ti mātuyā tirokucchigato, kucchiyā abbhantaragato'ti attho.

meaning_1: woman; female; women in general; womankind
example_1: idha, visākhe, mātugāmo susaṃvihitakamm'anto hoti, saṅgahitaparijano, bhattu manāpaṃ carati, sambhataṃ anurakkhati.
example_2: so tattha passati mātugāmaṃ dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā. tassa mātugāmaṃ disvā dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti.
commentary: (VIN 1.2.2) mātugāmo nāma manuss'itthī, na yakkhī na petī, na tiracchānagatā. antamaso tadahujātā'pi dārikā, pag'eva mahattarī.
notes: masc in grammar, fem in meaning

example_1: mātugāme mātugāmasaññī sahaseyyaṃ kappeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

meaning_1: presence of women; company of women
example_1: indriyesu guttadvārassa visūkadassanaṃ kaṇṭako, brahmacariyassa mātugām'ūpacāro kaṇṭako, paṭhamassa jhānassa saddo kaṇṭako, dutiyassa jhānassa vitakkavicārā kaṇṭakā
commentary: (ANa) mātugām'ūpacāro'ti mātugāmassa samīpacāritā.

example_1: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, vacchako taruṇako tāva'd'eva jātako mātugoravakena vuyhamāno, so'pi tiriyaṃ gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamāsi.
commentary: (MNa) mātugoravakena vuyhamāno'ti mātā purato purato huṃhun'ti goravaṃ katvā saññaṃ dadamānā urena udakaṃ chindamānā gacchati, vacchako tāya goravasaññāya dhenuyā vā urena chinn'odakena gacchamāno mātugoravakena vuyhamāno'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: matricide; who has killed one's mother
example_1: āyasmā upāli bhikkhūnaṃ etam'atthaṃ ārocesi. bhikkhū bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ… mātughātako, bhikkhave, anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo, upasampanno nāsetabbo'ti.
commentary: (KVa) yena manussajātikā janetti sayam'pi manussabhūten'eva sañcicca jīvitā voropitā, ayaṃ mātughātako nāma. pitughātakepi es'eva nayo.

meaning_2: attitude as to the mother; a state of mind like to the mother
example_1: etha tumhe, bhikkhave, mātumattīsu mātucittaṃ upaṭṭhapetha, bhaginimattīsu bhaginicittaṃ upaṭṭhapetha, dhītumattīsu dhītucittaṃ upaṭṭhapethā'ti.
ime kho, bhikkhave, dve sukkā dhammā lokaṃ na pāleyyuṃ, na'y'idha paññāyetha mātā'ti vā mātucchā'ti vā mātulānī'ti vā ācariyabhariyā'ti vā garūnaṃ dārā'ti vā.

atha kho āyasmā nando bhagavato mātucchāputto ākoṭitapaccākoṭitāni cīvarāni pārupitvā akkhīni añjetvā acchaṃ pattaṃ gahetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
example_2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nando bhagavato bhātā mātucchāputto sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evamāroceti, anabhirato ahaṃ, āvuso, brahmacariyaṃ carāmi, na sakkomi brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ, sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattissāmī'ti.
commentary: (UDa) na hi bhagavato sahodarā uppajjanti, tena vuttaṃ mātucchāputto'ti, cūḷamātuputto'ti attho. mahāpajāpatigotamiyā hi so putto.

meaning_lit: from the breast of the mother
example_1: tam'enaṃ jātaṃ samānaṃ sakena lohitena poseti. lohitañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ mātuthaññaṃ.
example_2: daharassa hi, thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa ājīvotipi na hoti, kuto pana pāpakaṃ ājīvaṃ ājīvissati, aññatra mātuthaññā!
commentary: (MNa) aññatra mātuthaññā'ti thaññacoradārakā nāma honti, mātari khīraṃ pāyantiyā apivitvā aññavihitakāle piṭṭhipassena āgantvā thaññaṃ pivanti. ettakaṃ muñcitvā añño micchājīvo n'atthi. ayam'pi kilesasahagatacitten'eva hotī'ti dasseti.

meaning_1: maternal affection; love for one's mother
supporting one's mother; providing for one's mother
example_1: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho mātuposako brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ahañ'hi, bho gotama, dhammena bhikkhaṃ pariyesāmi, dhammena bhikkhaṃ pariyesitvā mātāpitaro posemi. kacc'āhaṃ, bho gotama, evaṃkārī kiccakārī homī'ti?
example_2: yadā ahosiṃ pavane, kuñjaro mātuposako, na tadā atthi mahiyā, guṇena mama sādiso.
commentary: (CPa) mātuposako'ti andhāya jarājiṇṇāya mātuyā paṭijagganako.

example_1: etha tumhe, bhikkhave, mātumattīsu mātucittaṃ upaṭṭhapetha, bhaginimattīsu bhaginicittaṃ upaṭṭhapetha, dhītumattīsu dhītucittaṃ upaṭṭhapethā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) mātumattīsū'ti mātupamāṇāsu.

example_1: dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, mātumaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ, tesaṃ vā mātumaraṇaṃ paccanubhontānaṃ amanāpasampayogā manāpavippayogā kandantānaṃ rodantānaṃ assu passannaṃ paggharitaṃ, na tv'eva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakaṃ.
example_2: mātumaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ… pitumaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ… bhātumaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ… bhaginimaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ… puttamaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ… dhītumaraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ … ñātibyasanaṃ dukkhaṃ… bhogabyasanaṃ dukkhaṃ… rogabyasanaṃ dukkhaṃ… sīlabyasanaṃ dukkhaṃ… diṭṭhibyasanaṃ dukkhaṃ anveti anugacchati anvāyikaṃ hotī'ti, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti.
commentary: (NIDD1a) mātumaraṇan'ti mātuyā maraṇaṃ.

example_1: ayaṃ me mātā, tassā me mātu ayaṃ mātā'ti, apariyādinnā'va bhikkhave, tassa purisassa mātumātaro assu, atha imasmiṃ jambudīpe tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya.

meaning_1: generation of mother's mothers; lineage of female ancestors
example_1: jānanti pana bhonto, yā janikāmātu mātā yāva sattamā mātumātāmahayugā brāhmaṇaṃ'y'eva agamāsi, no abrāhmaṇan'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho.

meaning_1: whose mother has died; with a dead mother
example_1: n'āhaṃ, bhagini, pisāco, bhikkhu piṇḍāya ṭhito'ti. bhikkhussa ātumārī, bhikkhussa mātumārī!
commentary: (MNa) ātumārī mātumārī'ti ettha ātū'ti pitā, mātū'ti mātā. idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, yassa pitā vā mātā vā atthi, taṃ mātāpitaro amhākaṃ puttako'ti yathā tathā vā uppādetvā yaṃkiñci khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ datvā ekasmiṃ ṭhāne sayāpenti. so evaṃ rattiṃ piṇḍāya na carati. tuyhaṃ pana mātāpitaro matā maññe, tena evaṃ carasī'ti.

example_1: yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi
commentary: (MNa) māturakkhitā'ti-ādīsu yaṃ pitari naṭṭhe vā mate vā ghāsacchādan'ādīhi paṭijaggamānā, vayapattaṃ kulaghare dassāmī'ti mātā rakkhati, ayaṃ māturakkhitā nāma. eten'upāyena piturakkhit'ādayo'pi veditabbā.

example_1: kakkaṭako āha, mātula, ayaṃ saro etto, tvaṃ pana ito kiṃ nesī'ti?
example_2: aparesam'pi dasannaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati, jeṭṭhabhātu, kaniṭṭhabhātu, jeṭṭhabhaginiyā, kaniṭṭhabhaginiyā, cūḷamātuyā, mahāmātuyā, cūḷapituno, mahāpituno, pitucchāya, mātulassā'ti.
commentary: (VVt) mātulo'ti mātu bhātā. jeṭṭhakaniṭṭhe dve pitucchā, dve mātule ca ekato katvā dasā'ti vuttaṃ.

tasmā hi bhūtā nisāmetha sabbe,

meaning_1: honours; reveres; holds in high esteem; (comm) loves

meaning_1: having honoured; having revered; having thought highly (of)

meaning_2: you mustn't be careless, don't be negligent

commentary: (UDa) pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpentī'ti pāṭaligāmasaṅkhāte bhūmipadese nagaraṃ māpenti.

example_1: yasmiṃ padese majjhimā devatā vatthūni pariggaṇhanti, majjhimānaṃ tattha raññaṃ rājamah'āmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.

meaning_2: having built, having constructed, having created

example_1: so kho ahaṃ, mārisa moggallāna, taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo tato paṭinivattitvā vejayantaṃ nāma pāsādaṃ māpesiṃ. vejayantassa kho, mārisa moggallāna, pāsādassa ekasataṃ niyyūhaṃ.
example_2: ten'āha, caṅkamaṃ māpesiṃ, pañcadosavivajjitan'ti.

meaning_1: do not delight (in); do not be pleased (with)
example_1: so'pi pathaviṃ pathavito abhijānāti, pathaviṃ pathavito abhiññāya pathaviṃ mā maññi, pathaviyā mā maññi, pathavito mā maññi, pathaviṃ me'ti mā maññi, pathaviṃ m'ābhinandi. taṃ kissa hetu? pariññeyyaṃ tassā'ti vadāmi.

commentary: (DNa) māyā kuṭeṇḍu viṭeṇḍu, viṭucca viṭuṭo sahā'ti te dāsā sabbe'pi māyākārakā'va.

meaning_1: may not (schism be pleasing) for the venerables
example_1: te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi evam'assu vacanīyā, m'āyasmanto evaṃ avacuttha, na c'eso bhikkhu dhammavādī, na c'eso bhikkhu vinayavādī, m'āyasmantānam'pi saṅghabhedo ruccittha

so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evam'assa vacanīyo, m'āyasmā samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkami, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha aṭṭhāsi
