example_1: so varaṃ varaṃ migasaṃghe vadhitvā mudumaṃsāni mudumaṃsāni bhakkhayitvā tam'eva āsayaṃ ajjhupeyyan'ti.
commentary: (PYt) migasaṅgho'ti migānaṃ saṅgho.

meaning_1: name of a female lay disciple
name of a female lay disciple
example_1: ekam'antaṃ nisinnā kho migasālā upāsikā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
odahi migavo pāsaṃ, n'āsadā vākaraṃ migo, bhutvā nivāpaṃ gacchāma, kandante migabandhake'ti.
commentary: (THa) migavo'ti, migaluddako.

example_1: sārattā kāmabhogesu, giddhā kāmesu mucchitā, atisāraṃ na bujjhanti, migā kūṭaṃ'va oḍḍitaṃ, pacchā'saṃ kaṭukaṃ hoti, vipāko hi'ssa pāpako'ti.
atha kho sāḷho ca migāranattā sāṇo ca sekhuniyanattā yen'āyasmā nandako ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ nandakaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
commentary: (ANa) migāranattā'ti migāraseṭṭhino nattā. (VINa) sāḷho'ti tassa nāmaṃ, migāramātuyā pana nattā hoti, tena vuttaṃ migāranattā'ti

example_1: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ dāyikānaṃ yadidaṃ visākhā migāramātā
example_2: seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, imassa migāramātupāsādassa dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā yadidaṃ, yāva pacchimasopānakaḷevarā.
commentary: (MNa) migāramātupāsādo ti visākhāya pāsādo. sā hi migārena seṭṭhinā mātuṭṭhāne ṭhapitattā migāramātā'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: name of a monastery outside Sāvatthī, built by Visākhā
example_1: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubb'ārāme migāramātupāsāde
example_2: sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, āyām'ānanda, yena pubb'ārāmo migāramātupāsādo ten'upasaṅkamissāma divāvihārāyā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) pubb'ārāme migāramātupāsāde'ti pubb'ārāmasaṅkhāte vihāre migāramātuyā pāsāde.

example_1: aṭṭha micchattā, micchādiṭṭhi, micchāsaṅkappo, micchāvācā, micchākamm'anto, micchāājīvo, micchāvāyāmo micchāsati, micchāsamādhi.
example_2: micchattaniyatā dhammā. sammattaniyatā dhammā. aniyatā dhammā
commentary: (DNa) micchattā'ti ayāthāvā micchāsabhāvā.

example_1: micchattaniyatā dhammā. sammattaniyatā dhammā. aniyatā dhammā
commentary: (DNa) micchattaniyato'ti micchāsabhāvo hutvā niyato. niyatamicchādiṭṭhiyā saddhiṃ ānantariyakammass'etaṃ nāmaṃ.

meaning_2: Chapter 3 of the Maggasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

example_1: yañ'ca sāmaṃ ñātaṃ tañ'ca atidhāvanti yañ'ca loke saccasammataṃ tañ'ca atidhāvanti. tasmā tesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ micchā'ti vadāmī'ti.
example_2: yadi, bhante nāgasena, tathāgatena bhaṇitaṃ, abyāvaṭā tumhe, ānanda, hotha tathāgatassa sarīrapūjāyā'ti, tena hi, pūjetha naṃ pūjaniyassa dhātuṃ, evaṃ karā saggamito gamissathā'ti yaṃ vacanaṃ, taṃ micchā.

example_1: mātari pitari c'āpi, yo micchā paṭipajjati, tathāgate vā sambuddhe, atha vā tassa sāvake, bahuñ'ca so pasavati, apuññaṃ tādiso naro.
example_2: methunam'anuyuttassa, mussate vā'pi sāsanaṃ, micchā ca paṭipajjati, etaṃ tasmiṃ anāriyaṃ.

meaning_1: with wrong livelihood; having a wrong mode of living
example_1: pare micchāājīvā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāājīvā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
example_2: evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāājīvassa purisapuggalassa sammāājīvo hoti parikkamanāya, micchāvāyāmassa purisapuggalassa sammāvāyāmo hoti parikkamanāya

meaning_1: wrong livelihood; wrong mode of living
example_1: kummaggo'ti kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭh'aṅgikass'etaṃ micchāmaggassa adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, micchādiṭṭhiyā micchāsaṅkappassa micchāvācāya micchākamm'antassa micchāājīvassa micchāvāyāmassa micchāsatiyā micchāsamādhissa.
example_2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako micchāājīvaṃ pahāya sammāājīvena jīvitaṃ kappeti, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sammāājīvo.

example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhave, micchākamm'anto? pāṇ'ātipāto, adinn'ādānaṃ, kāmesumicchācāro, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, micchākamm'anto.
example_2: kummaggo'ti kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭh'aṅgikass'etaṃ micchāmaggassa adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, micchādiṭṭhiyā micchāsaṅkappassa micchāvācāya micchākamm'antassa micchāājīvassa micchāvāyāmassa micchāsatiyā micchāsamādhissa.
commentary: (PMa) micchākamm'anto'ti pāṇ'ātipāt'ādi-tividhā cetanā.

meaning_1: undertaking wrong action; with wrong behaviour
example_1: pare micchākamm'antā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammākamm'antā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
example_2: evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāvācassa purisapuggalassa sammāvācā hoti parikkamanāya, micchākamm'antassa purisapuggalassa sammākamm'anto hoti parikkamanāya

example_1: dusse pana akkante, buddhānaṃ adhikāraṃ katvā patthitapatthitaṃ labhantī'ti loke anussavo, mayā ca mahā-abhinīhāro kato, na ca puttaṃ labhāmi, tucchaṃ idaṃ vacanan'ti micchāgahaṇaṃ gaṇheyya.
kāmesumicchācāro akusalaṃ

meaning_1: dependent on misconduct; due to misconduct
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco… sahā'pi dukkhena sahā'pi domanassena kāmesu micchācārī hoti, kāmesu micchācārapaccayā ca dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti

meaning_1: who misbehaves oneself (regarding); who behaves wrongly (with)
example_1: kāmesumicchācārī hoti. yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi, tathārūpāsu cārittaṃ āpajjitā hoti
example_2: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, idh'assa puriso pāṇ'ātipātī adinn'ādāyī kāmesumicchācārī musāvādī pisuṇavāco pharusavāco samphappalāpī abhijjhālu byāpannacitto micchādiṭṭhiko.
commentary: (SNa) vatthukāmesu kilesakāmena micchā carantī'ti kāmesumicchācārino.

example_1: yam'pi bhikkhave tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussabhūto samāno micchājīvaṃ pahāya sammāājīvena jīvikaṃ kappesi

katame dasa dhammā pahātabbā? dasa micchattā, micchādiṭṭhi, micchāsaṅkappo, micchāvācā, micchākamm'anto, micchāājīvo, micchāvāyāmo, micchāsati, micchāsamādhi, micchāñāṇaṃ, micchāvimutti. ime dasa dhammā pahātabbā.
commentary: (SNa) micchāñāṇenā'ti micchāpaccavekkhaṇena

meaning_1: with incorrect understanding; with wrong wisdom
example_1: pare micchāñāṇī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāñāṇī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
example_2: evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāñāṇissa purisapuggalassa sammāñāṇaṃ hoti parikkamanāya, micchāvimuttissa purisapuggalassa sammāvimutti hoti parikkamanāya.
commentary: (MNa) ettha ca micchāñāṇan'ti pāpakiriyāsu upāyacintāvasena pāpaṃ katvā sukataṃ mayā'ti paccavekkhaṇākārena ca uppanno moho veditabbo, tena samannāgatā puggalā micchāñāṇī.

example_1: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi pubbaṅ'gamā hoti? micchādiṭṭhiṃ, micchādiṭṭhī'ti pajānāti, sammādiṭṭhiṃ, sammādiṭṭhī'ti pajānāti, s'āssa hoti sammādiṭṭhi.
example_2: atthāya vata me buddho, nadiṃ nerañjaraṃ agā, yass'āhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvāna, micchādiṭṭhiṃ vivajjayiṃ.
commentary: (MNa) micchā pāpikā viññugarahitā etesaṃ diṭṭhī'ti micchādiṭṭhī, kammapathapariyāpannāya n'atthi dinnan'tiādivatthukāya, micchattapariyāpannāya aniyyānikadiṭṭhiyā ca samannāgatā'ti attho.

meaning_1: having wrong view; with incorrect belief
example_1: pare micchādiṭṭhī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammādiṭṭhī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
example_2: evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchādiṭṭhissa purisapuggalassa sammādiṭṭhi hoti parikkamanāya, micchāsaṅkappassa purisapuggalassa sammāsaṅkappo hoti parikkamanāya
commentary: (MNa) micchā pāpikā viññugarahitā etesaṃ diṭṭhī'ti micchādiṭṭhī, kammapathapariyāpannāya n'atthi dinnan'tiādivatthukāya, micchattapariyāpannāya aniyyānikadiṭṭhiyā ca samannāgatā'ti attho.

meaning_1: who has wrong view; who holds a false belief
example_1: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu gahananissito hoti? idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu micchādiṭṭhiko hoti, antaggāhikāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgato hoti.
example_2: saṭhassa sāṭheyyaṃ appahīnaṃ hoti, māyāvissa māyā appahīnā hoti, pāp'icchassa pāpikā icchā appahīnā hoti, micchādiṭṭhikassa micchādiṭṭhi appahīnā hoti
commentary: (MNa) micchādiṭṭhiko'ti akusaladassano. (ITIa) micchādiṭṭhikā'ti viparītadassanā.

meaning_1: undertaking volitional action based on wrong view; performing deeds due to wrong beliefs
example_1: ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā.
commentary: (VINa) micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā'ti micchādiṭṭhivasena samādinnanānāvidhakammā, ye ca micchādiṭṭhimūlakesu kāyakammādīsu aññe'pi samādapenti.

meaning_1: because of undertaking actions based on wrong view
example_1: samaṇo'pi kho, vāseṭṭha, kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā micchādiṭṭhiko micchādiṭṭhikammasamādāno micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānahetu kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
commentary: (DNa) micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānahetū'ti micchādiṭṭhivasena samādinnakammahetu, micchādiṭṭhikammassa vā samādānahetu.

meaning_1: dependent on wrong view; due to incorrect belief
example_1: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ… micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, chandapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, vitakkapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, saññāpaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco… sahā'pi dukkhena sahā'pi domanassena micchādiṭṭhi hoti, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā ca dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
commentary: (SNa) micchādiṭṭhipaccayāpī'ti diṭṭhisampayuttā vedanā'pi vaṭṭati. diṭṭhiṃ upanissayaṃ katvā uppannā kusal'ākusalavedanā'pi vaṭṭati vipākavedanā'pi.

meaning_1: with wrong view as the utmost; with incorrect belief as the supreme
example_1: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ mahāsāvajjaṃ yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, micchādiṭṭhi. micchādiṭṭhiparamāni, bhikkhave, mahāsāvajjānī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) micchādiṭṭhiparamānī'ti micchādiṭṭhi paramā etesan'ti micchādiṭṭhiparamāni. pañca hi ānantariyakammāni mahāsāvajjāni nāma, tehi'pi micchādiṭṭhi'y'eva mahāsāvajjatarā'ti adhippāyo. kasmā? tesañ'hi paricchedo atthi. cattāri hi ānantariyakammāni niraye nibbattāpentī'ti vuttāni.

meaning_lit: discourse on the abandoning of wrong view

meaning_1: taking up wrong views; believing wrong theories
example_1: alajjitāye lajjanti, lajjitāye na lajjare, micchādiṭṭhisamādānā, sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ.
example_2: abhaye bhayadassino, bhaye c'ābhayadassino, micchādiṭṭhisamādānā, sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ.

meaning_1: due to the subsiding of wrong view
example_1: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, micchādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ … micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, micchāsamādhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ
commentary: (SNa) micchādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'ti micchādiṭṭhi-vūpasamo nāma sammādiṭṭhi. tasmā yaṃ sammādiṭṭhipaccayā vedayitaṃ vuttaṃ, tadeva micchādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā veditabbaṃ.

meaning_1: afflicted with wrong view; beaten by wrong view; hammered by wrong view
example_1: anicce niccasaññino, dukkhe ca sukhasaññino, anattani ca attā'ti, asubhe subhasaññino, micchādiṭṭhihatā sattā, khittacittā visaññino.
pañcavassasat'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu tayo dhammā vepullam'agamaṃsu. adhammarāgo visamalobho micchādhammo. tīsu dhammesu vepullaṃ gatesu tesaṃ sattānaṃ āyu'pi parihāyi, vaṇṇo'pi parihāyi.
commentary: (DNa) micchādhammo'ti purisānaṃ purisesu itthīnañ'ca itthīsu chandarāgo.

meaning_1: afflicted with immorality; suffering from perversity
example_1: eta'r'ahi, brāhmaṇa, manussā adhammarāgarattā visamalobh'ābhibhūtā micchādhammaparetā. te adhammarāgarattā visamalobh'ābhibhūtā micchādhammaparetā tiṇhāni satthāni gahetvā aññam'aññaṃ jīvitā voropenti, tena bahū manussā kālaṃ karonti.
commentary: (ANa) micchādhammaparetā'ti avatthupaṭisevanasaṅkhātena micchādhammena samannāgatā.

example_1: dvīsu, bhikkhave, micchāpaṭipajjamāno bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ, bahuñ'ca apuññaṃ pasavati. katamesu dvīsu?
commentary: (ANa) micchāpaṭipajjamāno'ti micchāpaṭipattiṃ paṭipajjamāno.

example_1: gihī vā hi, māṇava, pabbajito vā micchāpaṭipanno micchāpaṭipatt'ādhikaraṇahetu na ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ. gihissa v'āhaṃ, māṇava, pabbajitassa vā sammāpaṭipattiṃ vaṇṇemi.
commentary: (SNa) micchāpaṭipatt'ādhikaraṇahetū'ti micchāpaṭipattikaraṇahetu. yasmā micchāpaṭipattiṃ karoti, tasmā'ti attho.

meaning_1: wrong practice; following the wrong road
example_1: asussūsā aparipucchā paññāya paripantho, ananuyogo apaccavekkhaṇā dhammānaṃ paripantho, micchāpaṭipatti saggānaṃ paripantho
commentary: (MNa) micchāpaṭipattin'ti aniyyānikaṃ akusalapaṭipadaṃ. (SNa) micchāpaṭipattin'ti ayāthāvapaṭipattiṃ.

meaning_1: wrong course; wrong path of action
example_1: tatra, bhikkhave, yam'idaṃ taramānassa bhāsitaṃ, sadukkho eso dhammo saupaghāto saupāyāso sapariḷāho, micchāpaṭipadā.
example_2: gihino v'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, pabbajitassa vā micchāpaṭipadaṃ na vaṇṇemi. gihi vā, bhikkhave, pabbajito vā micchāpaṭipanno micchāpaṭipatt'ādhikaraṇahetu n'ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.

meaning_1: practising wrongly; going the wrong way
example_1: micchāpaṭipanno tvam'asi, aham'asmi sammāpaṭipanno. sahitaṃ me, asahitaṃ te. purevacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca, pacchāvacanīyaṃ pure avaca. adhiciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattaṃ. āropito te vādo, cara vādappamokkhāya. niggahito'si, nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī'ti.
example_2: yesaṃ kesañci bhavasaṃyojanaṃ appahīnaṃ, sabbe te sadukkhā saupaghātā saupāyāsā sapariḷāhā micchāpaṭipannā'ti, iti vadaṃ itth'eke apasādeti.

meaning_1: badly directed; wrongly orientated; at a wrong angle
example_1: diso disaṃ yaṃ taṃ kayirā, verī vā pana verinaṃ, micchāpaṇihitaṃ cittaṃ, pāpiyo naṃ tato kare.
example_2: micchāpaṇihitaṃ kho, mahāli, cittaṃ hetu, micchāpaṇihitaṃ cittaṃ paccayo pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyāti.

meaning_1: fact of being badly directed; fact of being wrongly orientated; fact of being at a wrong angle
example_1: taṃ kissa hetu? micchāpaṇihitattā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhiyā.
commentary: (SNa) micchāpaṇihitattā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhiyā'ti kammassakatapaññāya c'eva maggabhāvanāya ca micchā ṭhapitattā, appavattitattā'ti attho.

meaning_1: to show the wrong state of being
meaning_lit: for the purpose of showing the wrong state

example_1: kummaggo'ti kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭh'aṅgikass'etaṃ micchāmaggassa adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, micchādiṭṭhiyā micchāsaṅkappassa micchāvācāya micchākamm'antassa micchāājīvassa micchāvāyāmassa micchāsatiyā micchāsamādhissa.

meaning_1: wrong intention; incorrect notion; false idea; wrong concept
example_1: asāre sāramatino, sāre c'āsāradassino, te sāraṃ n'ādhigacchanti, micchāsaṅkappagocarā.
example_2: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi pubbaṅ'gamā hoti? micchāsaṅkappaṃ, micchāsaṅkappo'ti pajānāti, sammāsaṅkappaṃ, sammāsaṅkappo'ti pajānāti, s'āssa hoti sammādiṭṭhi.
commentary: (MNa) micchāsaṅkappā'ti ayāthāva-aniyyānika-akusalasaṅkappā.

meaning_1: having wrong intention; with wrong notions; with wrong ideas
example_1: pare micchāsaṅkappā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāsaṅkappā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
example_2: evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchādiṭṭhissa purisapuggalassa sammādiṭṭhi hoti parikkamanāya, micchāsaṅkappassa purisapuggalassa sammāsaṅkappo hoti parikkamanāya
commentary: (MNa) micchāsaṅkappā'ti ayāthāv'āniyyānik'ākusalasaṅkappā

meaning_1: having wrong mindfulness; with incorrect present moment awareness
example_1: pare micchāsatī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāsatī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
example_2: evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāsatissa purisapuggalassa sammāsati hoti parikkamanāya, micchāsamādhissa purisapuggalassa sammāsamādhi hoti parikkamanāya

meaning_1: wrong mindfulness; incorrect present moment awareness; imperfect memory
example_1: kummaggo'ti kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭh'aṅgikass'etaṃ micchāmaggassa adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, micchādiṭṭhiyā micchāsaṅkappassa micchāvācāya micchākamm'antassa micchāājīvassa micchāvāyāmassa micchāsatiyā micchāsamādhissa.

meaning_1: having wrong mindfulness; with incorrect present moment awareness
example_1: evam'eva kho, rājañña, yathārūpe yaññe gāvo vā haññanti, aj'eḷakā vā haññanti, kukkuṭasūkarā vā haññanti, vividhā vā pāṇā saṃghātaṃ āpajjanti, paṭiggāhakā ca honti micchādiṭṭhī micchāsaṅkappā micchāvācā micchākamm'antā micchāājīvā micchāvāyāmā micchāsatī micchāsamādhī, evarūpo kho, rājañña, yañño na mahapphalo hoti na mah'ānisaṃso na mahājutiko na mahāvipphāro.

meaning_1: having imperfect stability of mind; with incorrect meditative composure
example_1: pare micchāsamādhi bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāsamādhī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
example_2: evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāsatissa purisapuggalassa sammāsati hoti parikkamanāya, micchāsamādhissa purisapuggalassa sammāsamādhi hoti parikkamanāya

meaning_1: imperfect stability of mind; incorrect meditative composure
example_1: aṭṭha micchattā, micchādiṭṭhi, micchāsaṅkappo, micchāvācā, micchākamm'anto, micchāājīvo, micchāvāyāmo micchāsati, micchāsamādhi.
example_2: katamā ca, bhikkhave, micchāpaṭipadā? seyyath'idaṃ, micchādiṭṭhi… micchāsamādhi. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, micchāpaṭipadā.
commentary: (PMa) micchāsamādhī'ti akusalasamādhi. (ADha) ayāthāvasamādhānato micchāsamādhī'ti

meaning_1: dependent on incorrect stability of mind; due to wrong meditative composure
example_1: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ… micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, chandapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, vitakkapaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, saññāpaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ

meaning_1: due to the subsiding of incorrect meditative composure
example_1: so evaṃ pajānāmi, micchādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, micchādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ … micchāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, micchāsamādhi-vūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, sammāsamādhipaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ

meaning_1: speaking wrongly; with bad speech; badly spoken
example_1: pare micchāvācā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāvācā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
example_2: evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāvāc'assa purisapuggalassa sammāvācā hoti parikkamanāya, micchākamm'antassa purisapuggalassa sammākamm'anto hoti parikkamanāya

example_1: kummaggo'ti kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭh'aṅgikass'etaṃ micchāmaggassa adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, micchādiṭṭhiyā micchāsaṅkappassa micchāvācāya micchākamm'antassa micchāājīvassa micchāvāyāmassa micchāsatiyā micchāsamādhissa.
example_2: iti pubb'eva kho pan'assa susīlyaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, dussīlyaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ, ayañ'ca micchādiṭṭhi micchāsaṅkappo micchāvācā ariyānaṃ paccanīkatā asaddhammasaññatti attukkaṃsanā paravambhanā.
commentary: (PMa) micchāvācā'ti musāvād'ādi-catubbidhā cetanā.

meaning_1: with wrong effort; having incorrect endeavour
example_1: pare micchāvāyāmā bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāvāyāmā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
example_2: evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāājīvassa purisapuggalassa sammāājīvo hoti parikkamanāya, micchāvāyāmassa purisapuggalassa sammāvāyāmo hoti parikkamanāya

example_1: kummaggo'ti kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭh'aṅgikass'etaṃ micchāmaggassa adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, micchādiṭṭhiyā micchāsaṅkappassa micchāvācāya micchākamm'antassa micchāājīvassa micchāvāyāmassa micchāsatiyā micchāsamādhissa.

katame dasa dhammā pahātabbā? dasa micchattā, micchādiṭṭhi, micchāsaṅkappo, micchāvācā, micchākamm'anto, micchāājīvo, micchāvāyāmo, micchāsati, micchāsamādhi, micchāñāṇaṃ, micchāvimutti. ime dasa dhammā pahātabbā.
commentary: (SNa) micchāvimuttī'ti ayāthāvavimutti, aniyyānikavimutti.

meaning_1: having incorrect liberation; with wrong emancipation
example_1: pare micchāvimuttī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha sammāvimuttī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
example_2: evam'eva kho, cunda, vihiṃsakassa purisapuggalassa avihiṃsā hoti parikkamanāya… micchāñāṇissa purisapuggalassa sammāñāṇaṃ hoti parikkamanāya, micchāvimuttissa purisapuggalassa sammāvimutti hoti parikkamanāya.
commentary: (MNa) micchāvimuttī'ti avimuttā'y'eva samānā, vimuttā mayan'ti evaṃsaññino, avimuttiyaṃ vā vimuttisaññino. tatr'āyaṃ vacan'attho, micchā pāpikā viparītā vimutti etesaṃ atthī'ti micchāvimuttī.

meaning_1: dependent on wrong liberation; based on incorrect deliverance
example_1: sammāvimuttissa micchāvimutti nijjiṇṇā hoti. ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, te c'assa nijjiṇṇā honti. ime dasa dhammā abhiññeyyā.
haritako haritapaṇṇavaṇṇo. miñjāya pana palaṇḍukassa ekā miñjā hoti, bhañjanakassa dve, haritakassa tisso. cāpalasuṇo amiñjako, aṅkuramattam'eva hi tassa hoti.

kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nhāru aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ, yaṃ vā pan'aññam'pi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā pathavīdhātu.

dvattikkhattuṃ kho bhavaṃ gotamo mukhe ālopaṃ samparivattetvā ajjhoharati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā asambhinnā kāyaṃ pavisati, na c'assa kāci odanamiñjā mukhe avasiṭṭhā hoti, ath'āparaṃ ālopaṃ upanāmeti.

meaning_2: to measure, to weigh, to balance
having measured, having weighed, having balanced

example_1: ūn'ūdaro mita-āhāro, app'icchassa alolupo, sadā icchāya nicchāto, aniccho hoti nibbuto.
example_2: porāṇam'etaṃ atula, n'etaṃ ajjatanām'iva, nindanti tuṇhim'āsīnaṃ, nindanti bahubhāṇinaṃ, mitabhāṇim'pi nindanti, n'atthi loke anindito.

meaning_1: of value; in measure; worth as much as
example_1: appasm'eke pavecchanti, bahun'eke na dicchare, appasmā dakkhiṇā dinnā, sahassena samaṃ mitā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) sahassena samaṃ mitā'ti sahassena saddhiṃ mitā, sahassa dānasadisā hoti.

meaning_1: speaking in moderation; who is measured in speech
example_1: porāṇam'etaṃ atula, n'etaṃ ajjatanām'iva, nindanti tuṇhim'āsīnaṃ, nindanti bahubhāṇinaṃ, mitabhāṇim'pi nindanti, n'atthi loke anindito.
commentary: (DHPa) mitabhāṇimpī'ti kiṃ esa suvaṇṇahiraññaṃ viya attano vacanaṃ maññamāno ekaṃ vā dve vā vatvā tuṇhī ahosī'ti nindanti. evaṃ sabbathā'pi imasmiṃ loke anindito nāma n'atthī'ti attho. (APAa) mitabhāṇī'ti pamāṇaṃ ñatvā bhaṇanasīlo, pamāṇaṃ jānitvā dhammaṃ desesī'ti attho.

meaning_1: moderate in food; limited in eating; with lean diet
example_1: allaṃ sukkhaṃ vā bhuñjanto, na bāḷhaṃ suhito siyā, ūn'ūdaro mit'āhāro, sato bhikkhu paribbaje.
example_2: ūn'ūdaro mit'āhāro, app'icchassa alolupo, sadā icchāya nicchāto, aniccho hoti nibbuto.

example_1: mitte bhajassu kalyāṇe, suddhājīve atandite, paṭisanthāravuty'assa, ācārakusalo siyā, tato pāmojjabahulo, dukkhass'antaṃ karissati.
example_2: yādisaṃ kurute mittaṃ, yādisaṃ c'ūpasevati, sa ve tādisako hoti, sahavāso hi tādiso.

example_1: patirūpakārī dhuravā, uṭṭhātā vindate dhanaṃ, saccena kittiṃ pappoti, dadaṃ mittāni ganthati.
commentary: (SNPa) dadan'ti yaṃkiñci icchitapatthitaṃ dadanto mittāni ganthati, sampādeti karotī'ti attho. duddadaṃ vā dadaṃ ganthati, dānamukhena vā cattāri'pi saṅgahavatthūni gahitānī'ti veditabbāni. tehi mittāni karotī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

example_1: saṅgāhako mittakaro, vadaññū vītamaccharo, netā vinetā anunetā, tādiso labhate yasaṃ.
example_2: patirūpe vase dese, ariyamittakaro siyā, sammāpaṇidhisampanno, pubbe puññakato naro, dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ yaso kitti, sukhañ'c'etaṃ'dhivattatī'ti. paṭhamaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) mittakaro'ti mittagavesano.

example_1: atthi, bhante, pubbavijjanaṃ nāma vajjigāmo. tatth'āyasmato channassa mittakulāni suhajjakulāni upavajjakulānī'ti.
example_2: honti h'ete, sāriputta, channassa bhikkhuno mittakulāni suhajjakulāni upavajjakulāni.

example_1: uṭṭhānaṃ anālasyaṃ bhogānaṃ āhāro, maṇḍanā vibhūsanā vaṇṇassa āhāro, sappāyakiriyā ārogyassa āhāro, kalyāṇamittatā sīlānaṃ āhāro
example_2: kalyāṇamittatā muninā, lokaṃ ādissa vaṇṇitā, kalyāṇamitte bhajamāno, api bālo paṇḍito assa.

example_1: uppajjeyyā'ti uppajjeyya saṅghato vā gaṇato vā ñātito vā mittato vā paṃsukūlaṃ vā attano vā dhanena.
commentary: (VINa) ñātakehi me cīvar'atthāya pesitaṃ, mittehi pesitaṃ, te āgatā cīvare dassantī'ti evaṃ ñātito vā mittato vā paccāsā hoti.

example_1: tassa so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā mittato'pi naṃ saddaheyya, suhajjato'pi naṃ saddaheyya, tasmiñ'ca vissāsaṃ āpajjeyya.
commentary: (MNa) mittato'pi naṃ saddaheyyā'ti mitto me ayan'ti saddaheyya.

meaning_1: fact of betraying one's friends; fact of being a false friend
example_1: tatr'idaṃ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa ghoravisatā, yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo tibbarāgo. tatr'idaṃ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa dujjivhatā, yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo pisuṇavāco. tatr'idaṃ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa mittadubbhitā, yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo aticārinī.

meaning_1: who betrays one's friends; who is a false friend
meaning_2: who betrays his friends, treacherous person
example_1: asuci, duggandho, sabhīru, sappaṭibhayo, mittadubbhī, ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā kaṇhasappe. evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañc'ime ādīnavā mātugāme.
commentary: (ANa) mittadubbhī'ti pānabhojanadāyakam'pi mittaṃ dubbhati hiṃsati.

meaning_2: who betrays his friends, treacherous person

meaning_1: who betrays one's friends; treacherous person
meaning_2: who betrays his friends, treacherous person
example_1: ye lūkhasā dāruṇā piṭṭhimaṃsikā, mittadduno nikkaruṇā-atimānino, adānasīlā na ca denti kassaci, es'āmagandho na hi maṃsabhojanaṃ.
example_2: thīghātakā ye c'ime pāradārikā, mittadduno ye ca sapanti subbate, sabbe ca te maccharipañcam'ādhamā, tasmā adatvā udakam'pi nāsniye.
commentary: (SNPa) mittadduno'ti mittadūhakā, dāradhanajīvitesu vissāsam'āpannānaṃ mittānaṃ tattha micchāpaṭipajjanakā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (JAa) mittadduno'ti ye tesaññ'eva gehe khāditvā bhuñjitvā paññattāsane nisīditvā sayitvā puna māsakahāpaṇaṃ nāma āharāpenti, lañjaṃ gaṇhanti, te mittadūsakā bālā evarūpaṃ mīḷhaṃ khādanti, mahārājā'ti. (SaDM) ettha mittaddū'ti mittaṃ dunāti hiṃsati dubbhatī'ti mittaddu. atra vedā na tāṇāya bhavanti tassa, mittadduno bhūnahuno narassā'ti pāḷi nidassanaṃ.

example_1: cattāro'me, gahapatiputta, amittā mittapatirūpakā veditabbā. añña'd'atthuharo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo, vacīparamo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo, anuppiyabhāṇī amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo, apāyasahāyo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo.
commentary: (DNa) idāni yo evaṃ karoto anattho uppajjati, aññāni vā pana yāni kānici bhayāni yekeci upaddavā yekeci upasaggā, sabbe te bālaṃ nissāya uppajjanti. tasmā evarūpā bālā na sevitabbā'ti bāle mittapatirūpake amitte dassetuṃ cattāro'me, gahapatiputta amittā'ti-ādim'āha.

meaning_1: companionship; close association with a friend; intimate acquaintance
way of close association with a friend; manner of intimate acquaintance

example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati, aho vat'āyaṃ na mittavā assā'ti! taṃ kissa hetu? na, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa mittavatāya nandati.
example_2: kathañ'c'ānanda, satthāraṃ sāvakā mittavatāya samudācaranti, no sapattavatāya?

example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati, aho vat'āyaṃ na mittavā assā'ti! taṃ kissa hetu? na, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa mittavatāya nandati.

meaning_1: compassionate towards friends; sympathetic to friends
example_1: upakāro ca yo mitto, sukhe dukkhe ca yo sakhā, atth'akkhāyī ca yo mitto, yo ca mitt'ānukampako.

meaning_1: obligation to friends and colleagues; responsibility to friends and companions
example_1: kuto, bho sāriputta, amhākaṃ appamādo yesaṃ no… mitt'āmaccānaṃ mitt'āmaccakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ñātisālohitānaṃ ñātisālohitakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, atithīnaṃ atithikaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, pubbapetānaṃ pubbapetakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, devatānaṃ devatākaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, rañño rājakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ayam'pi kāyo pīṇetabbo brūhetabbo'ti?
commentary: (MNt) mitt'āmaccānaṃ piyavacana-atthacariyā-samān'attat'ādi mitt'āmaccakaraṇīyaṃ kattabbaṃ, tathā ñātisālohitānaṃ.

meaning_1: friends and colleagues; friends and companions
example_1: kodhanaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalaṃ kodh'ābhibhūtaṃ kodhaparetaṃ, ye'pi'ssa te honti mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā, te'pi ārakā parivajjanti kodh'ābhibhūtaṃ.
example_2: tam'enaṃ mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā jātam'eva naṃ saṅghāṭikaṃ kareyyuṃ, saṅghāṭikattam'eva samādapeyyuṃ, ehi tvaṃ, bhadramukha, saṅghāṭiko hohi, saṅghāṭikassa te sato saṅghāṭidhāraṇamattena abhijjhālussa abhijjhā pahīyissati

meaning_1: friends, colleagues, family and blood relatives
example_1: labheyya nu kho so coro coraghātesu, āgamentu tāva bhavanto coraghātā, amukasmiṃ me gāme vā nigame vā mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā, yāv'āhaṃ tesaṃ uddisitvā āgacchāmī'ti
example_2: seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puriso sallena viddho assa savisena gāḷh'ūpalepanena. tassa mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhāpeyyuṃ.

meaning_1: display of friendship; demonstration of affection
example_1: kiṃ pana tvaṃ, mahārāja, atthavasaṃ sampassamāno imasmiṃ sarīre evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karosi, mitt'ūpahāraṃ upadaṃsesī'ti?

meaning_1: name of a town; capital of the Videha country
meaning_2: name of a town; capital of the Videha country
example_1: ath'addasāsiṃ sugataṃ, nagaraṃ mithilaṃ pati, adantānaṃ dametāraṃ, sambuddham'akutobhayaṃ.
example_2: mahesayaṃ avantīnaṃ, sovīrānañ'ca rorukaṃ, mithilā ca videhānaṃ, campā aṅgesu māpitā, bārāṇasī ca kāsīnaṃ, ete govindamāpitā'ti.
commentary: (THIa) mithilaṃ patī'ti mithil'ābhimukhaṃ, mithilānagar'ābhimukhaṃ gacchantan'ti attho.

example_1: assosuṃ kho mithileyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā, samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito videhesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi mithilaṃ anuppatto
te vādakāmā parisaṃ vigayha, bālaṃ dahantī mithu aññam'aññaṃ, vadanti te aññasitā kath'ojjaṃ, pasaṃsakāmā kusalā vadānā.
example_2: na v'āham'etaṃ tathiyan'ti brūmi, yam'āhu bālā mithu aññam'aññaṃ, sakaṃ sakaṃ diṭṭhim'akaṃsu saccaṃ, tasmā hi bālo'ti paraṃ dahanti.

meaning_2: pair of a male and a female

example_1: pāṭaliputtassa kho, ānanda, tayo antarāyā bhavissanti, aggito vā udakato vā mithubhedā vā'ti.
commentary: (DNa) eko, iminā akathitaṃ amussa, amunā akathitaṃ imassā'ti vadantānaṃ pisuṇavācānaṃ vasena bhinnānaṃ manussānaṃ aññam'aññabheden'eva nassissatī'ti attho.

example_1: ubhayena m'idaṃ maraṇam'eva, n'āmaraṇaṃ pacchā vā pure vā, paṭipajjatha mā vinassatha, khaṇo vo mā upaccagā.
ahaṃ middhena pakato, vihārā upanikkhamiṃ, caṅkamaṃ abhiruhanto, tatth'eva papatiṃ chamā.
example_2: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati
commentary: (ANa) thinaṃ cittagelaññaṃ, middhaṃ cetasikagelaññaṃ. thinañ'ca middhañ'ca thinamiddhaṃ.

meaning_1: pleasure of dozing; pleasure of sleeping
example_1: paṭibuddhena ca te, moggallāna, khippaññ'eva paccuṭṭhātabbaṃ na seyyasukhaṃ na passasukhaṃ na middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharissāmī'ti
example_2: yo kho, nāgita, na'y'imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī… so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) middhasukhan'ti niddāsukhaṃ.

example_1: middhī yadā hoti mahagghaso ca, niddāyitā samparivattasāyī, mahāvarāho'va nivāpapuṭṭho, punappunaṃ gabbham'upeti mando.
atha kho āyasmā ānando uttiyaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca, tenah'āvuso uttiya, upamaṃ te karissāmi. upamāya m'idh'ekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.

meaning_1: here a certain; in this case a
example_1: ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena m'idh'ekacco mātugāmo dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā dassanāya, daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā app'esakkhā ca?
commentary: (ANa) yena m'idh'ekacco mātugāmo'ti yena idh'ekaccā itthī.

meaning_1: but how is it then?; and how then?
example_1: yathā kathaṃ pana, bhante, ariyassa vinaye soceyyaṃ hoti? sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā ariyassa vinaye soceyyaṃ hotī'ti
example_2: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, thera, ekavihārī ekavihārassa ca vaṇṇavādī'ti?

meaning_1: like; as; as per; according to; how; in whatever way

commentary: (ANa) yathā'ti kāraṇavacanaṃ, yasmā avisaye pañhaṃ pucchitā hontī'ti attho.

example_2: accayo maṃ, bhante, accagamā, yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, y'āhaṃ evam'akāsiṃ. tassā me, bhante, ayyo ānando accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu, āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā'ti.

grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathāpasādana

grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of yathābala

example_2: accayo maṃ, bhante, accagamā, yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, y'āhaṃ evam'akāsiṃ. tassā me, bhante, ayyo ānando accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu, āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā'ti.

example_1: nibbidam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ. kā ca, bhikkhave, nibbidāya upanisā? yathābhūtañāṇadassanan'ti'ssa vacanīyaṃ.

commentary: (VINa) rathakārajātī'ti cammakārajā'ti.

meaning_1: female chariot maker; carpenter woman; (comm) leatherworker
example_1: so brāhmaṇiṃ'y'eva gacchati, na khattiyiṃ na vessiṃ na suddiṃ na caṇḍāliṃ na nesādiṃ na veniṃ na rathakāriṃ na pukkusiṃ gacchati, na gabbhiniṃ gacchati, na pāyamānaṃ gacchati, na anutuniṃ gacchati.
example_2: veṇī vā avaññā honti, rathakārī ca dubbhikā, caṇḍālī kapaṇā honti, kappakā ca punappunaṃ.
commentary: (PVa) rathakārī'ti cammakārino.

example_1: n'āccayanti ahorattā, jīvitaṃ n'ūparujjhati, āyu anupariyāyati, maccānaṃ nemī'va rathakubbaran'ti.
commentary: (SNa) nemī'va rathakubbaran'ti yathā divasaṃ gacchantassa rathassa cakkanemi kubbaraṃ anupariyāyati na vijahati, evaṃ āyu anupariyāyatī'ti.

example_1: niyyānikaṃ vata buddhasāsanan'ti pasīditvā yojanikaṃ suvaṇṇacetiyaṃ kambalakañcukena parikkhipitvā tattha rathacakkappamāṇehi suvaṇṇapadumehi alaṅ'kari.

commentary: (VVt) hatthi-assarath'attharan'ti hatthipiṭṭhe attharitaṃ attharaṇaṃ hatthattharaṇaṃ nāma. assarath'atthare'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: mounted a chariot; boarded a carriage
example_1: idaṃ vatvāna maghavā, devarājā sujampati, puthuddisā namassitvā, pamukho ratham'āruhī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) pamukho ratham'āruhī'ti devānaṃ pamukho seṭṭho rathaṃ āruhi.

example_1: yāni tāni, bhante, raññaṃ khattiyānaṃ muddh'āvasittānaṃ issariyamadamattānaṃ kāmagedhapariyuṭṭhitānaṃ janapadatthāvariyappattānaṃ mahantaṃ pathavimaṇḍalaṃ abhivijiya ajjhāvasantānaṃ hatthiyuddhāni … assayuddhāni … rathayuddhāni … pattiyuddhāni bhavanti, tesam'pi, bhante, pattiyuddhānaṃ n'atthi gati n'atthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe.

meaning_2: measure of length (36 tajjāri = 1 rathareṇu; 36 rathareṇu = 1 likhā)

example_1: mā, bhikkhave, devadattassa lābhasakkārasilokaṃ pihayittha. yāvakīvañ'ca, bhikkhave, devadattassa ajātasattukumāro pañcahi rathasatehi sāyaṃ pātaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ gamissati, pañca ca thālipākasatāni bhatt'ābhihāro āharīyissati, hāni'y'eva, bhikkhave, devadattassa pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu, no vuddhi.
example_2: atha kho sumanā rājakumārī pañcahi rathasatehi pañcahi rājakumārisatehi parivutā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
commentary: (ANa) pañcahi rathasatehī'ti bhuttapātarāsā pitu santikaṃ pesetvā pañca rathasatāni yojāpetvā tehi parivutā'ti attho.

meaning_1: sound of chariots; noise of vehicles
example_1: kusāvatī, ānanda, rājadhānī dasahi saddehi avivittā ahosi divā c'eva rattiñ'ca, seyyath'idaṃ, hatthisaddena assasaddena rathasaddena bherisaddena mudiṅgasaddena vīṇāsaddena gītasaddena saṅkhasaddena sammasaddena pāṇitāḷasaddena asnātha pivatha khādathā'ti dasamena saddena.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño rāj'antepuraṃ hatthisammaddaṃ assasammaddaṃ rathasammaddaṃ rajjanīyāni rūpa-sadda-gandha-rasa-phoṭṭhabbāni, yāni na pabbajitassa sāruppāni. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dasamo ādīnavo rāj'antepurappavesane.
commentary: (VINa) rāj'antepuraṃ hatthisammaddan'ti-ādīsu hatthīhi sammaddo etthā'ti hatthisammaddaṃ, hatthisambādhan'ti attho. assa-ratha-sammaddapade'pi es'eva nayo.

example_1: tesaṃ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā rathasahassānaṃ eko'y'eva so ratho hoti yam'ahaṃ tena samayena abhiruhāmi, vejayanto ratho.
dānañ'ca peyyavajjañ'ca, atthacariyā ca yā idha, samān'attatā ca dhammesu, tattha tattha yath'ārahaṃ, ete kho saṅgahā loke, rathass'āṇī'va yāyato.
commentary: (ANa) rathass'āṇī'va yāyato'ti yathā rathassa gacchato āṇi saṅgaho nāma hoti, sā rathaṃ saṅgaṇhāti, evam'ime saṅgahā lokaṃ saṅgaṇhanti.

meaning_1: relay chariot; (comm) chariot yoked to a trained horse
example_1: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, rañño pasenadissa kosalassa sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasantassa sākete kiñci'd'eva accāyikaṃ karaṇīyaṃ uppajjeyya. tassa antarā ca sāvatthiṃ antarā ca sāketaṃ satta rathavinītāni upaṭṭhapeyyuṃ.
example_2: atha kho, āvuso, rājā pasenadi kosalo sāvatthiyā nikkhamitvā antepuradvārā paṭhamaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruheyya, paṭhamena rathavinītena dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇeyya, paṭhamaṃ rathavinītaṃ vissajjeyya dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruheyya.
commentary: (MNa) satta rathavinītānī'ti vinīt'āssājāniyayutte satta rathe.

meaning_1: chariots; one of the four divisions of an army
example_1: senā nāma hatthī assā rathā pattī. dvādasapuriso hatthī, tipuriso asso, catupuriso ratho, cattāro purisā sarahatthā patti. dassanāya gacchati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
example_2: bal'aggaṃ nāma ettakā hatthī, ettakā assā, ettakā rathā, ettakā pattī.

example_1: anīkaṃ nāma hatth'ānīkaṃ, ass'ānīkaṃ, rath'ānīkaṃ, patt'ānīkaṃ. tayo hatthī pacchimaṃ hatth'ānīkaṃ, tayo assā pacchimaṃ ass'ānīkaṃ, tayo rathā pacchimaṃ rath'ānīkaṃ, cattāro purisā sarahatthā pattī pacchimaṃ patt'ānīkaṃ.

kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo hantā hoti? idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato hatthim'pi hanati [hanti], hatth'āruham'pi hanati, assam'pi hanati, ass'āruham'pi hanati, ratham'pi hanati, rath'āruham'pi hanati, pattikam'pi hanati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo hantā hoti.
seyyathā'pi, mahārāja, majjhe siṅghāṭake pāsādo. tattha cakkhumā puriso ṭhito passeyya manusse gehaṃ pavisante'pi nikkhamante'pi rathiyā'pi rathiṃ sañcarante, majjhe siṅghāṭake nisinne'pi.

idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato hatthim'pi hanati, hatth'āruham'pi hanati, assam'pi hanati, ass'āruham'pi hanati, ratham'pi hanati, rathikam'pi hanati, pattikam'pi hanati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo hantā hoti.
example_2: yathā nu kho imāni, bhante, puthusipp'āyatanāni, seyyath'idaṃ, hatth'ārohā ass'ārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsikaputtā āḷārikā kappakā nhāpakā sūdā mālākārā rajakā pesakārā naḷakārā
commentary: (AN) rathikā'ti sabbe'pi rath'ācariya-rathayodha-ratharakkh'ādayo. (JAa) rathikā'ti rathayodhā.

example_1: antaragharaṃ nāma rathikā byūhaṃ siṅghāṭakaṃ gharaṃ.
example_2: kharassarena paṇavena rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chindathā'ti.
commentary: (VINa) rathikā'ti racchā.

example_1: kharassarena paṇavena rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhāmetvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sīsaṃ chindathā'ti.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, bhikkhu paṃsukūliko rathiyāya nantakaṃ disvā vāmena pādena niggaṇhitvā dakkhiṇena pādena pattharitvā, yo tattha sāro taṃ paripātetvā ādāya pakkameyya.
example_2: seyyathā'pi, bhante, usabho chinnavisāṇo sūrato sudanto suvinīto rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ anvāhiṇḍanto na kiñci hiṃsati pādena vā visāṇena vā
commentary: (ANa) rathiyāyā'ti antaravīthiyaṃ

example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā rath'īsāya satthiṃ ussajjitvā rath'īsaṃ'y'eva ajjhomaddati. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyo assadoso.
commentary: (ANa) rath'īsāya satthiṃ ussajjitvā'ti sīsaṃ nāmetvā yugaṃ bhūmiyaṃ pātetvā satthinā rathīsaṃ paharitvā.

meaning_1: chariot rug; carpet for a carriage
example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, ambaṭṭha, idha rājā pasenadi kosalo hatthigīvāya vā nisinno assapiṭṭhe vā nisinno rath'ūpatthare vā ṭhito uggehi vā rājaññehi vā kiñci'd'eva mantanaṃ manteyya. so tamhā padesā apakkamma ekam'antaṃ tiṭṭheyya.
commentary: (DNa) rathūpatthare'ti rathamhi rañño ṭhān'atthaṃ attharitvā sajjitapadese. (DNt) rathūpatthare'ti rathassa upari attharitapadese.

example_1: rājā arahasi bhavituṃ, cakkavattī rath'esabho, cāturanto vijitāvī, jambusaṇḍassa issaro.
commentary: (THa) rath'esabho'ti rathikesu ājānīyausabhapuriso, mahārathiko'ti attho.

meaning_lit: discourse on the simile of the chariot

meaning_1: (in an argument) fault; weak-spot; flaw; opening
example_1: yutto kathāyaṃ parisāya majjhe, pasaṃsam'icchaṃ vinighāti hoti, apāhatasmiṃ pana maṅku hoti, nindāya so kuppati randham'esī.
commentary: (SNPa) randham'esī'ti parassa randham'eva gavesanto.

meaning_2: who finds fault or weak points
example_1: makkhī dhammaṃ suṇāti makkhapariyuṭṭhito, upārambhacitto dhammaṃ suṇāti randhagavesī, dhammadesake āhatacitto hoti khīlajāto, duppañño hoti jaḷo eḷamūgo, anaññāte aññātamānī hoti.
commentary: (ANa) randhagavesī'ti guṇarandhaṃ guṇacchiddaṃ gavesanto.

meaning_1: (in an argument) seeking a fault; looking for a weak-spot; trying to find an opening
example_1: yutto kathāyaṃ parisāya majjhe, pasaṃsam'icchaṃ vinighāti hoti, apāhatasmiṃ pana maṅku hoti, nindāya so kuppati randham'esī.
commentary: (SNPa) randham'esī'ti parassa randham'eva gavesanto.

example_1: evaṃ bho purisa jānāhi, pāpadhammā asaññatā, mā taṃ lobho adhammo ca, ciraṃ dukkhāya randhayuṃ.

evam'eva kho, mārisa, santi amanussā caṇḍā ruddhā rabhasā, te n'eva mahārājānaṃ ādiyanti, na mahārājānaṃ purisakānaṃ ādiyanti, na mahārājānaṃ purisakānaṃ purisakānaṃ ādiyanti. te kho te, mārisa, amanussā mahārājānaṃ avaruddhā nāma vuccanti.
commentary: (DNa) rabhasā'ti karaṇ'uttariyā.

example_1: kaṇhaṃ dhammaṃ vippahāya, sukkaṃ bhāvetha paṇḍito, okā anokam'āgamma, viveke yattha dūramaṃ.
ramaṇīyāni araññāni, yattha na ramatī jano, vītarāgā ramissanti, na te kāmagavesino.
example_2: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, pokkharaṇī acch'odakā sāt'odakā sīt'odakā setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā nānārukkhehi sañchannā.
commentary: (MNa) ramaṇīyaṃ bhūmibhāgan'ti supupphita-nānappakāra-jalaja-thalaja-puppha-vicittaṃ manorammaṃ bhūmibhāgaṃ. (MNa) ramaṇīyan'ti rajatapaṭṭasadisaṃ vippakiṇṇavālikaṃ pahūtamacchakacchapaṃ abhirāmadassanaṃ.

example_1: ramaṇīyāni araññāni, yattha na ramatī jano, vītarāgā ramissanti, na te kāmagavesino.

meaning_1: with delightful pieces of land; with charming natural landscape
enjoys; finds pleasure; takes delight (in); likes
example_1: dhammapīti sukhaṃ seti, vippasannena cetasā, ariyappavedite dhamme, sadā ramati paṇḍito.
example_2: ramaṇīyāni araññāni, yattha na ramatī jano, vītarāgā ramissanti, na te kāmagavesino.

example_1: yāh'ayaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, rati, aññatr'eva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehi, api dibbaṃ sukhaṃ samadhigayha tiṭṭhati, tāya ratiyā ramamāno hīnassa na pihemi, na tattha abhiramāmi.
commentary: (MNa) tāya ratiyā ramamāno'ti idaṃ catutthajjhānika-phala-samāpatti-ratiṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ.

example_1: s'āhaṃ sugatassa sāvikā, magg'aṭṭh'aṅgikayānayāyinī, uddhaṭasallā anāsavā, suññ'āgāragatā ramām'ahaṃ.

meaning_1: finding pleasure (in); taking delight (in); making oneself happy (with)
example_1: ek'āsanaṃ ekaseyyaṃ, eko caram'atandito, eko damayam'attānaṃ, van'ante ramito siyā.
example_2: sa jhānapasuto dhīro, van'ante ramito siyā, jhāyetha rukkhamūlasmiṃ, attānam'abhitosayaṃ.

meaning_2: to delight in, to enjoy oneself
having delighted in, having enjoyed oneself
example_1: tattha ramitvā kīḷitvā, āgacchantī sakaṃ gharaṃ, vihāraṃ daṭṭhuṃ pāvisiṃ, sākete añjanaṃ vanaṃ.

meaning_1: gives delight; pleases; makes one happy
example_1: nanu ahaṃ citta tay'āmhi yācito, giribbaje citrachadā vihaṅ'gamā, mahindaghosa-tthanit'ābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.
example_2: yadā balākā sucipaṇḍaracchadā, kāḷassa meghassa bhayena tajjitā, palehiti ālayam'ālay'esinī, tadā nadī ajakaraṇī rameti maṃ.

meaning_1: you yourself must enjoy; you yourself must take pleasure (in)
meaning_lit: you yourself must cause to enjoy
example_1: jhāya bhikkhu mā pamādo, mā te kāmaguṇe ramessu cittaṃ, mā lohaguḷaṃ gilī pamatto, mā kandi dukkham'idan'ti ḍayhamāno.
migo yathā seri sucittakānane, rammaṃ giriṃ pāvus'ābbhamāliniṃ, anākule tattha nage ramissaṃ, asaṃsayaṃ citta parābhavissasi.
example_2: so bajjhataṃ pāsasatehi chabbhi, rammā vanā niyyatu rājadhāniṃ, tuttehi so haññatu pācanehi, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yo ahāsi.
commentary: (THIa) ramman'ti ramaṇīyaṃ. taṃ kira bhūmibhāgasampattiyā chāyūdakasampattiyā ca rukkhānaṃ ropitākārena ativiya manuññaṃ manoramaṃ.

example_1: tena h'āyasmanto yena rammakassa brāhmaṇassa assamo ten'upasaṅkamatha, app'eva nāma labheyyātha bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyā'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, mahāsamuddo ekaraso loṇaraso, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ayaṃ dhammavinayo ekaraso vimuttiraso
example_2: cakkhūhi n'eva lol'assa, gāmakathāya āvaraye sotaṃ, rase ca n'ānugijjheyya, na ca mamāyetha kiñci lokasmiṃ.

example_1: yathā'pi bhamaro pupphaṃ, vaṇṇagandham'aheṭhayaṃ, paleti rasam'ādāya, evaṃ gāme munī care.
example_2: pavivekarasaṃ pitvā, rasaṃ upasamassa ca, niddaro hoti nippāpo, dhammapītirasaṃ pivaṃ.

example_1: lakkhaṇ'ādīsu ca tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sabhāvo vā sāmaññaṃ vā lakkhaṇaṃ nāma, kiccaṃ vā sampatti vā raso nāma, upaṭṭhān'ākāro vā phalaṃ vā paccupaṭṭhānaṃ nāma, āsannakāraṇaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ nāma.

diṭṭhi hi'ssa, bhikkhave, pāpikā. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, nimbabījaṃ vā kosātakibījaṃ vā tittakalābubījaṃ vā allāya pathaviyā nikkhittaṃ yañ'c'eva pathavirasaṃ upādiyati yañ'ca āporasaṃ upādiyati sabbaṃ taṃ tittakattāya kaṭukattāya asātattāya saṃvattati. taṃ kissa hetu?
commentary: (SNt) pathavirasaṃ āporasan'ti sasambhāra-pathavī-āpesu labbhamānaṃ rasaṃ.

example_1: dasavass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu imāni rasāni antaradhāyissanti, seyyath'idaṃ, sappi navanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ loṇaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) imāni rasānī'ti imāni loke aggarasāni.

example_1: santi, bhikkhave, pupphagandhe adhivatthā devā. santi, bhikkhave, phalagandhe adhivatthā devā. santi, bhikkhave, rasagandhe adhivatthā devā.
commentary: (ANt) rasagandho sajjulas'ādi.

meaning_1: fine flavour; top taste; quality savour
example_1: … evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye ann'agga-ras'aggānaṃ lābhino, atha kho et'eva sattā bahutarā ye ann'agga-ras'aggānaṃ na lābhino, uñchena kapāl'ābhatena yāpenti.
commentary: (ANa) ann'agga-ras'aggānan'ti uttam'annānañ'ca uttamarasānañ'ca.

meaning_1: fact of having an acute sense of taste
construction:
rasa + gasa + aggī + tā
rasaggasaggī + tā
example_1: ten'eva so sugatim'upecca modati, sukhapphalaṃ kariya sukhāni vindati, sam'ojasā rasaharaṇī susaṇṭhitā, idh'āgato labhati rasaggas'aggitaṃ.

meaning_1: auspicious mark of having an acute sense of taste
with acute sense of taste; twenty-first of the thirty-two marks of a great man
example_1: rasaggas'aggī kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
commentary: (MNa) rasaggas'aggī'ti ettha rasaṃ gasantī'ti rasaggasā, rasaharaṇīnam'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ, tā aggā assā'ti rasaggas'aggī.

meaning_1: craving for tastes; desire for flavours
example_1: katamā ca, bhikkhave, taṇhā? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, taṇhākāyā, rūpataṇhā, saddataṇhā, gandhataṇhā, rasataṇhā, phoṭṭhabbataṇhā, dhammataṇhā. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, taṇhā.

commentary: (ANa) tattha rājānaṃ ārabbha, mahāsammato mandhātā dhammāsoko evaṃmah'ānubhāvo'ti-ādinā nayena pavattakathā rājakathā.

meaning_1: obligation to the king; responsibility to the ruler
example_1: kuto, bho sāriputta, amhākaṃ appamādo yesaṃ no… mitt'āmaccānaṃ mitt'āmaccakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ñātisālohitānaṃ ñātisālohitakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, atithīnaṃ atithikaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, pubbapetānaṃ pubbapetakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, devatānaṃ devatākaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, rañño rājakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ayam'pi kāyo pīṇetabbo brūhetabbo'ti?
example_2: adhivāsetu kira, bhante, āyasmā anuruddho pañcak'aṅgassa thapatissa svātanāya attacatuttho bhattaṃ, yena ca kira, bhante, āyasmā anuruddho pagevataraṃ āgaccheyya, pañcak'aṅgo, bhante, thapati bahukicco bahukaraṇīyo rājakaraṇīyenā'ti. adhivāsesi kho āyasmā anuruddho tuṇhībhāvena.
commentary: (MNt) rājakiccakaraṇaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ rājakaraṇīyaṃ.

example_1: sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto attadutiyo yena rājak'ārāmo ten'upasaṅkami.
commentary: (MNa) rājak'ārāmo'ti pasenadinā kārito nagarassa dakkhiṇadisābhāge thūp'ārāmasadise ṭhāne vihāro.

meaning_2: Chapter 2 of the Sotāpattisaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

example_1: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. atha kho abhayo rājakumāro yena nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā nigaṇṭhaṃ nāṭaputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
example_2: satthari hi paṭhamagamanena kapilapuraṃ gantvā kaniṭṭhabhātikaṃ nandarājakumāraṃ pabbājetvā kapilapurā nikkhamma anupubbena sāvatthiṃ gantvā viharante āyasmā nando anabhirato ahosi

meaning_1: one hundred royal maidens; one hundred ladies-in-waiting
example_1: atha kho sumanā rājakumārī pañcahi rathasatehi pañcahi rājakumārisatehi parivutā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinnā kho sumanā rājakumārī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

atha kho sumanā rājakumārī pañcahi rathasatehi pañcahi rājakumārisatehi parivutā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinnā kho sumanā rājakumārī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

na hi nūna so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phari. sace hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phareyya, na hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṅ'kareyya.
saṃvijjati kho, bho raṭṭhapāla, imasmiṃ rājakule pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ bhūmigatañ'ca vehāsagatañ'ca.
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sabhaggato vā parisaggato vā ñātimajjhagato vā pūgamajjhagato vā rājakulamajjhagato vā abhinīto sakkhipuṭṭho

meaning_1: amidst the royal court; among royalty
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sabhaggato vā parisaggato vā ñātimajjhagato vā pūgamajjhagato vā rājakulamajjhagato vā abhinīto sakkhipuṭṭho
commentary: (ANa) rājakulamajjhagato'ti rājakulassa majjhe mahāvinicchaye ṭhito.

example_1: kodhanassa, bhikkhave, purisapuggalassa kodh'ābhibhūtassa kodhaparetassa, ye'pi'ssa te honti bhogā uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sed'āvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā, te'pi rājāno rājakosaṃ pavesenti kodh'ābhibhūtassa.

meaning_1: royal food; royal cuisine; king's food
example_1: sūro yathā rājakhādāya puṭṭho, abhigajjam'eti paṭisūram'icchaṃ, yen'eva so tena palehi sūra, pubb'eva n'atthi yadidaṃ yudhāya.

meaning_1: name of a city; capital of Magadha; modern day Rajgir
example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, brāhmaṇa, idha puriso āgaccheyya rājagahaṃ gantu'kāmo. so taṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya, icchām'ahaṃ, bhante, rājagahaṃ gantuṃ, tassa me rājagahassa maggaṃ upadisā'ti.
example_2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā soṇo rājagahe viharati sītavanasmiṃ. atha kho āyasmato soṇassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
commentary: (MNa) rājagahe'ti evaṃnāmake nagare, tañ'hi mandhātumahāgovind'ādīhi pariggahitattā rājagahan'ti vuccati.

example_1: tena kho pana samayena rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa sattavassiko sīs'ābādho hoti. bahū mahantā mahantā disāpāmokkhā vejjā āgantvā n'āsakkhiṃsu arogaṃ kātuṃ.
commentary: (VBt) rājagahako'ti rājagahavāsī.

meaning_1: going to Rājagaha; headed to Rājagaha
example_1: tena hi, brāhmaṇa, taṃ'y'ev'ettha paṭipucchissāmi. yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi. taṃ kiṃ maññasi, brāhmaṇa, kusalo tvaṃ rājagahagāmissa maggassā'ti?

meaning_1: at Rājagaha; Rājagaha is the location; set in Rājagaha
example_1: rājagahanidānaṃ. ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho uttaro devaputto bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi
kumbhīro rājagahiko, vepullassa nivesanaṃ, bhiyyo naṃ satasahassaṃ, yakkhānaṃ payirupāsati, kumbhīro rājagahiko, so'p'āgā samitiṃ vanaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) kumbhīro rājagahiko'ti rājagahanagare nibbatto kumbhīro nāma yakkho.

meaning_1: located near to Rājagaha; (comm) mountains around Rājagaha
example_1: vipulo rājagahīyānaṃ, giriseṭṭho pavuccati, seto himavataṃ seṭṭho, ādicco aghagāminaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) rājagahīyānan'ti rājagahapabbatānaṃ. (SNt) rājagahasamīpappavattīnaṃ rājagahiyānaṃ

meaning_1: (of a horse) special behaviour for a king; qualities befitting a king
meaning_2: royal qualities; characteristics of a king
example_1: yato kho, bhaddāli, bhadro ass'ājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tam'enaṃ assadamako uttari kāraṇaṃ kāreti anukkame maṇḍale khurakāse dhāve davatte rājaguṇe rājavaṃse uttame jave uttame haye uttame sākhalye.
commentary: (MNa) rājaguṇe'ti raññā jānitabbaguṇe. kūṭakaṇṇarañño kira guḷavaṇṇo nāma asso ahosi. rājā pācīnadvārena nikkhamitvā cetiyapabbataṃ gamissāmī'ti kalambanadītīraṃ sampatto. asso tīre ṭhatvā udakaṃ otarituṃ na icchati, rājā ass'ācariyaṃ āmantetvā, aho tayā asso sikkhāpito udakaṃ otarituṃ na icchatī'ti āha. ācariyo, susikkhāpito deva asso, evam'assa hi cittaṃ sac'āhaṃ udakaṃ otarissāmi, vālaṃ temissati, vāle tinte rañño aṅge udakaṃ pāteyyā'ti evaṃ tumhākaṃ sarīre udakapātanabhayena na otarati, vālaṃ gaṇhāpethā'ti āha. rājā tathā kāresi. asso vegena otaritvā pāraṃ gato. etadatthaṃ ayaṃ kāraṇā karīyati.

meaning_1: with a tax-value; with a customs-value
commentary: (VINa) rāj'aggaṃ bhaṇḍan'ti rāj'ārahaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ, yato rañño pañcamāsakaṃ vā atirekapañcamāsakaṃ vā agghanakaṃ suṅkaṃ dātabbaṃ hoti, taṃ bhaṇḍan'ti attho. rājakan'ti'pi pāṭho, ayam'ev'attho.

meaning_1: component of royalty; part of a king's regalia
example_1: rājā samāno kiṃ labhati? yāni tāni rāj'ārahāni rāj'aṅgāni rāj'ūpabhogāni rāj'ānucchavikāni tāni khippaṃ paṭilabhati.
commentary: (DNa) rāj'ārahānī'ti rañño anurūpāni hatthi-ass'ādīni, tāni'y'eva rañño senāya aṅgabhūtattā rāj'aṅgānī'ti vuccanti.

example_1: rājā te sabbe gāhāpetvā rāj'aṅgaṇe nābhippamāṇe āvāṭe khaṇāpetvā te tattha nisīdāpetvā paṃsūhi pūretvā upari palāle vikirāpetvā aggiṃ dāpesi.

meaning_1: man of the ruling class; young noble
example_1: atha kho pāyāsi rājañño uttaraṃ māṇavaṃ āmantāpetvā etadavoca, saccaṃ kira tvaṃ, tāta uttara, dānaṃ datvā evaṃ anuddisasi, imin'āhaṃ dānena pāyāsiṃ rājaññam'eva imasmiṃ loke samāgacchiṃ, mā parasmin'ti
example_2: abhijānāsi no tvaṃ, rājañña, divā seyyaṃ upagato supinakaṃ passitā ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakan'ti?

example_1: āyantu bhonto ye tattha khattiyakulā brāhmaṇakulā rājaññakulā uppannā, sākassa vā sālassa vā salaḷassa vā candanassa vā padumakassa vā uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya, aggiṃ abhinibbattentu, tejo pātukarontu.

grammar: masc, abl sg of rāja, atta group
meaning_1: from the king; from the government
example_1: rājato vā upasaggaṃ, abbhakkhānañ'ca dāruṇaṃ, parikkhayañ'ca ñātīnaṃ, bhogānañ'ca pabhaṅguraṃ.
ṭhānañ'hi so manuj'indo, rajjaṃ laddhāna khattiyo, so kuddho rājadaṇḍena, tasmiṃ pakkamate bhusaṃ, tasmā taṃ parivajjeyya, rakkhaṃ jīvitam'attano.
commentary: (SNa) rājadaṇḍenā'ti rañño uddhaṭadaṇḍena, so appako nāma na hoti, dasasahassa-vīsatisahassa-ppamāṇo hoti'y'eva.

example_1: tvaññ'eva no citta karosi brāhmaṇo, tvaṃ khattiyo rājadasī karosi, vessā ca suddā ca bhavāma ekadā, devattanaṃ vā'pi tav'eva vāhasā.
commentary: (THa) rājadasī'ti rājā asi, dakāro padasandhikaro

meaning_1: royal grant; gift from the king
example_1: tena kho pana samayena caṅkī brāhmaṇo opāsādaṃ ajjhāvasati satt'ussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭh'odakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) rājadāyan'ti rañño dāyabhūtaṃ, dāyajjan'ti attho.

example_1: te pesitā rājadūtā, piṭṭhito anubandhisuṃ, kuhiṃ gamissati bhikkhu, kattha vāso bhavissati.

meaning_1: royal responsibility; duty of a king
example_1: atīte kururaṭṭhe indapattanagare dhanañcaye rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto tassa aggamahesiyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā anupubbena viññutaṃ patto takkasilāyaṃ sippāni uggahetvā pitarā uparajje patiṭṭhāpito aparabhāge pitu accayena rajjaṃ patvā dasa rājadhamme akopento kurudhamme vattittha.
bhūtapubb'āhaṃ, bhikkhu, rājā ahosiṃ khattiyo muddh'āvasitto. tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītinagarasahassāni ahesuṃ kusāvatī rājadhānippamukhāni.
commentary: (SNa) kusāvatī-rājadhāni-ppamukhānī'ti kusāvatīrājadhānī tesaṃ nagarānaṃ pamukhā, sabbaseṭṭhā'ti attho.

example_1: tam'anugacchanto passeyya purāṇaṃ nagaraṃ purāṇaṃ rājadhāniṃ pubbakehi manussehi ajjhāvuṭṭhaṃ ārāmasampannaṃ vanasampannaṃ pokkharaṇīsampannaṃ uddhāpavantaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ.
example_2: so bajjhataṃ pāsasatehi chabbhi, rammā vanā niyyatu rājadhāniṃ, tuttehi so haññatu pācanehi, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yo ahāsi.
commentary: (NIDD1a) ekassa rañño āṇāpavattiṭṭhānaṃ rājadhānī. (SNt) rājadhānī'ti rañño nivāsanagaraṃ.

example_1: tena ca samayena rājadhītā saṅghamittā'pi tasmiṃ'y'eva ṭhāne ṭhitā hoti. tassā ca sāmiko aggibrahmā nāma kumāro yuvarājena tissakumārena saddhiṃ pabbajito hoti.
example_2: atha rājā aññaṃ dahariṃ abhirūpaṃ rājadhītaraṃ ānetvā aggamahesiṭṭhāne ṭhapesi. sā jantuṃ nāma puttaṃ vijāyi.

example_1: vattu'kāmo haṃsānaṃ sīghavegatāya bārāṇasinagare rājanivesanassa uparibhāgaṃ sampattakāle daṭṭhaṭṭhānato daṇḍakaṃ vissajjetvā ākās'aṅgaṇe patitvā dvedhā bhijji.

meaning_1: king's inner chamber; king's inner court
example_1: tena kho pana samayena rāj'antepure rājaparisāya sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam'antarākathā udapādi
example_2: atha kho so gahapati sameti me akkhadhuttehīti pakkāmi. atha kho idaṃ kathāvatthu anupubbena rāj'antepuraṃ pāvisi.

example_1: dasa'y'ime, bhikkhave, ādīnavā rāj'antepurappavesane. katame dasa?
commentary: (VINa) dasa ādīnavā rāj'antepurappavesane rājasikkhāpade niddiṭṭhā.
(VINa) tattha rājāno eva paccatthikā rājapaccatthikā. te ca sayaṃ ānentā'pi aññehi āṇāpentā'pi ānentiy'evā'ti veditabbā.

meaning_1: king's retinue; royal council; king's court; royal assembly
meaning_2: retinue of a king, royal assembly
example_1: tena kho pana samayena rāj'antepure rājaparisāya sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam'antarākathā udapādi

atha kho, bhikkhave, khaṇḍo ca rājaputto tisso ca purohitaputto bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni yojāpetvā bhaddaṃ bhaddaṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā bhaddehi bhaddehi yānehi bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā niyyiṃsu. yena khemo migadāyo tena pāyiṃsu.
example_2: yathā, mahārāja, mahiyā rājaputtānaṃ hatthi-assaratha-dhanu-tharu-lekha-muddā-sikkhā-khagga-manta-suti-sammuti-yuddha-yujjhāpana-kiriyā karaṇīyā, avasesānaṃ puthu-vessa-suddānaṃ kasi vaṇijjā gorakkhā karaṇīyā

example_1: yadā maṃ bhakuṭiṃ katvā, rājaputtī udikkhati, āḷāriko tadā homi, rañño maddass'antepure.
commentary: (JAa) rājaputtī'ti phussatī maddarājadhītā.

meaning_1: king's man; royal servant; government officer
meaning_2: who is in the king's service
example_1: atha kho te, ānanda, rājapurisā ghaṭikāraṃ kumbhakāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ, imāni kho, bhante, pañcamattāni taṇḍulavāhasatāni kikinā kāsirājena pahitāni paṇḍupuṭakassa sālino tadupiyañ'ca sūpeyyaṃ.
example_2: seyyathā'pi saha bhaṇḍena gahitacoraṃ, vadhetha nan'ti rañño āṇāya rājapurisā bandhitvā catukke catukke pahārasatāni dentā āghātanaṃ nenti.

meaning_1: royal service; government position; police force
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, kulaputto yena sippaṭṭhānena jīvikaṃ kappeti, yadi muddāya yadi gaṇanāya yadi saṅkhānena yadi kasiyā yadi vaṇijjāya yadi gorakkhena yadi issatthena yadi rājaporisena yadi sipp'aññatarena.
commentary: (MNa) rājaporisan'ti āvudhena rājakammaṃ katvā upaṭṭhānaṃ.

example_1: puna caparaṃ, gahapati, ariyasāvako uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatehi bhogehi bāhābalaparicitehi sed'āvakkhittehi dhammikehi dhammaladdhehi pañcabaliṃ kattā hoti, ñātibaliṃ, atithibaliṃ, pubbapetabaliṃ, rājabaliṃ, devatābaliṃ. idam'assa tatiyaṃ ṭhānagataṃ hoti pattagataṃ āyatanaso paribhuttaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) rājabalin'ti rañño kattabbayuttakaṃ rājabaliṃ.

meaning_2: tax to be given to a king

example_1: atha āgaccheyya suddo vā suddadāso vā, tasmiṃ padese ṭhito tadeva mantanaṃ manteyya, evam'pi rājā pasenadi kosalo āha, evam'pi rājā pasenadi kosalo āhā'ti. apinu so rājabhaṇitaṃ vā bhaṇati rājamantanaṃ vā manteti? ettāvatā so assa rājā vā rāj'amatto vā'ti?
commentary: (DNa) rājabhaṇitan'ti yathā raññā bhaṇitaṃ, tass'atthassa sādhanasamatthaṃ. so'pi tass'atthassa sādhanasamattham'eva bhaṇitaṃ bhaṇatī'ti attho.

meaning_1: danger of kings; peril from rulers; fear of kings
example_1: rājabhayam'pi dukkhaṃ, corabhayam'pi dukkhaṃ, veribhayam'pi dukkhaṃ, dubbhikkhabhayam'pi dukkhaṃ, aggibhayam'pi dukkhaṃ… evarūpāni, mahārāja, bahuvidhāni anekavidhāni dukkhāni saṃsāragato anubhavati.
commentary: (NIDD1a) rājato uppannabhayaṃ rājabhayaṃ. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: king's possession; wealth of a king
example_1: bhogā'ti rājabhogā imaṃ alakkhikaṃ vippajahanti. yattha kolaṃ pacissatī'ti yattha gantvā puna badaram'eva pacinitvā vikkiṇantī jīvikaṃ kappessati, tatth'eva naṃ nethā'ti vadati.

meaning_1: suitable to be used by a king; useful to a king; fit for a king
meaning_2: fit to be used by a king
example_1: aṭṭhahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhaddo ass'ājānīyo rāj'āraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgan't'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati. katamehi aṭṭhahi?
commentary: (MNa) rājabhoggo'ti rañño upabhogo.

example_1: tena kho pana samayena caṅkī brāhmaṇo opāsādaṃ ajjhāvasati satt'ussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭh'odakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) rājato laddhaṃ bhoggaṃ rājabhoggaṃ. kena dinnan'ti ce, raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ… atha vā rājabhoggan'ti sabbaṃ chejjabhejjaṃ anusāsantena titthapabbat'ādīsu suṅkaṃ gaṇhantena setacchattaṃ ussāpetvā raññā hutvā bhuñjitabbaṃ.

example_1: apinu so rājabhaṇitaṃ vā bhaṇati rājamantanaṃ vā manteti? ettāvatā so assa rājā vā rāj'amatto vā'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama.

commentary: (DNa) rāhubhaddam'upāgamun'ti rāhu-asur'indaṃ upasaṅkamiṃsu.

example_1: tam'enaṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārenti… bilaṅgathālikam'pi karonti, saṅkhamuṇḍikam'pi karonti, rāhumukham'pi karonti, jotimālikam'pi karonti, hatthapajjotikam'pi karonti, erakavattikam'pi karonti
commentary: (MNa) rāhumukhan'ti rāhumukhakammakāraṇaṃ, taṃ karontā saṅkunā mukhaṃ vivaritvā antomukhe dīpaṃ jālenti. kaṇṇacūḷikāhi vā paṭṭhāya mukhaṃ nikhādanena khaṇanti. lohitaṃ paggharitvā mukhaṃ pūreti.

meaning_1: name of an arahant monk; Buddha's son
family_set: names of arahants; names of monks
example_1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā rāhulo ambalaṭṭhikāyaṃ viharati.
example_2: idam'avoca bhagavā. attamano āyasmā rāhulo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi.
commentary: (ANa) rāhulo'ti attano puttaṃ rāhulattheraṃ dasseti. thero kira pabbajitadivasato paṭṭhāya pāto'va uṭṭhahanto hatthapūraṃ vālikaṃ ukkhipitvā aho vat'āhaṃ ajja dasabalassa c'eva ācariy'upajjhāyānañ'ca santikā ettakaṃ ovādañ'c'eva anusāsaniñ'ca labheyyan'ti pattheti. tasmā sikkhākāmānaṃ aggo nāma jāto'ti. (THa) so tato cavitvā devamanussesu saṃsaranto imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde amhākaṃ bodhisattaṃ paṭicca yasodharāya deviyā kucchimhi nibbattitvā rāhulo'ti laddhanāmo mahatā khattiyaparivārena vaḍḍhi, tassa pabbajjāvidhānaṃ khandhake (mahāva. 105) āgatam'eva. so pabbajitvā satthu santike anekehi suttapadehi suladdhovādo paripakkañāṇo vipassanaṃ ussukkāpetvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇi. tena vuttaṃ apadāne
notes: Theragāthā verses 295-298 (TH4.8, TH193) are attributed to him.

meaning_1: neglects; omits; excludes; is negligent (about); (comm) abandons
example_1: so tāya dhammapariyattiyā divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhu, bhikkhu pariyattibahulo, no dhammavihārī.
example_2: yato ca bhikkhu ātāpī, sampajaññaṃ na riñcati, tato so vedanā sabbā, parijānāti paṇḍito.
commentary: (SNa) sampajaññaṃ na riñcatī'ti sampajaññaṃ na jahati. (ANa) riñcati paṭisallānan'ti ekībhāvaṃ vissajjeti.

meaning_1: having neglected; having abandoned; having disregarded
example_1: riñcitvā paramaṃ atthaṃ, hīnam'atthaṃ asevi'haṃ, kilesānaṃ vasaṃ gantvā, sāmaññ'atthaṃ na bujjhi'haṃ.
commentary: (THIa) riñcitvā paramaṃ atthan'ti jhānavipassanāmaggaphalādiṃ uttamaṃ atthaṃ jahitvā chaḍḍetvā.

example_1: yo passati pānīyaghaṭaṃ vā paribhojanīyaghaṭaṃ vā vaccaghaṭaṃ vā rittaṃ tucchaṃ so upaṭṭhāpeti
example_2: atha kho bhagavā taṃ udak'ādhānaṃ ukkujjitvā āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi, passasi no tvaṃ, rāhula, imaṃ udak'ādhānaṃ rittaṃ tucchan'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

example_1: rittassa munino carato, kāmesu anapekkhino, oghatiṇṇassa pihayanti, kāmesu gadhitā pajā'ti.
example_2: okaṃ pahāya aniketasārī, gāme akubbaṃ muni santhavāni, kāmehi ritto apurekkharāno, kathaṃ na viggayha janena kayirā.

example_1: sace kho, mārisa, sabbassa sabbattena ananubhūtaṃ, tadabhiññāya mā h'eva te rittakam'eva ahosi, tucchakam'eva ahosī'ti.
example_2: tassa taṃ passato nijjhāyato yoniso upaparikkhato rittakaññ'eva khāyeyya, tucchakaññ'eva khāyeyya, asārakaññ'eva khāyeyya.

meaning_1: fact of being empty; vacuousness; insubstantiality
example_1: tadeva taṃ atthābhāvena rittakaṃ. rittakattā ca tucchakaṃ.

commentary: (MNt) rittapatt'ovā'ti yesu kulesu paṭipiṇḍavasena pavattati, tesaṃ sabbapacchimaṃ attano yathāladdhaṃ datvā tattha kiñci aladdhā rittapatto vihāraṃ pavisitvā nipajjati jighacchādubbalyenā'ti adhippāyo.

meaning_1: devoid of divisive speech; free of slander
example_1: sacco siyā appagabbho, amāyo rittapesuṇo, akkodhano lobhapāpaṃ, vevicchaṃ vitare muni.
commentary: (SNPa) rittapesuṇo'ti pahīnapesuṇo. (THa) pisuṇavācāvirahitato rittapesuṇo

meaning_1: disgruntled; dissatisfied; (comm) devoid of the pleasure of jhāna
example_1: addasā kho bhagavā goyogapilakkhasmiṃ piṇḍāya caramāno aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ ritt'assādaṃ bāhir'assādaṃ muṭṭhassatiṃ asampajānaṃ asamāhitaṃ vibbhantacittaṃ pākat'indriyaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) ritt'assādan'ti jhānasukh'ābhāvena ritt'assādaṃ.

example_1: sītassa purakkhato uṇhassa purakkhato ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-sarīṃsapa-samphassehi rissamāno khuppipāsāya mīyamāno, ayam'pi, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ ādīnavo sandiṭṭhiko, dukkhakkhandho kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānam'eva hetu.
commentary: (MNa) rissamāno'ti ruppamāno, ghaṭṭiyamāno.

example_1: vāri pokkharapatt'eva, ār'agge'r'iva sāsapo, yo na limpati kāmesu, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
evaṃ bhaṇeti, bhaṇayati, bhaṇāpeti, bhaṇāpayati. bhaṇenti, bhaṇayanti, bhaṇāpenti, bhaṇāpayanti. tatha'riva aññe'pi yojetabbā.

sanskrit: vṛkṣa, pādapa, mahīruha, kuja, aga, taru, vanaspati, druma, śākhin
example_1: subh'ānupassiṃ viharantaṃ, indriyesu asaṃvutaṃ, bhojanamhi c'āmattaññuṃ, kusītaṃ hīnavīriyaṃ, taṃ ve pasahati māro, vāto rukkhaṃ'va dubbalaṃ.
example_2: yathā'pi mūle anupaddave daḷhe, chinno'pi rukkho punareva rūhati, evam'pi taṇh'ānusaye anūhate, nibbattatī dukkham'idaṃ punappunaṃ.
synonym: jagatiruha, taru, duma, pādapa, mahiruha, mahīruha, viṭapī

example_1: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, mahācoro gahananissito hoti? idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro tiṇagahanaṃ vā nissito hoti, rukkhagahanaṃ vā rodhaṃ vā mahāvanasaṇḍaṃ vā.

meaning_1: top of a tree and the peak of a mountain

example_1: yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yā tā rattiyo abhiññātā abhilakkhitā, cātuddasī pañcadasī aṭṭhamī ca pakkhassa, tathārūpāsu rattīsu yāni tāni ārāmacetiyāni vanacetiyāni rukkhacetiyāni bhiṃsanakāni salomahaṃsāni tathārūpesu sen'āsanesu vihareyyaṃ app'eva nām'āhaṃ bhayabheravaṃ passeyyan'ti.
commentary: (MNa) rukkhacetiyānī'ti gāmanigam'ādidvāresu pūjanīyarukkhā'y'eva rukkhacetiyāni.

meaning_1: shade of a tree; tree's shadow
example_1: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghamm'ābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito. so taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā nhātvā ca pivitvā ca paccuttaritvā tatth'eva rukkhacchāyāya nisīdeyya vā nipajjeyya vā.

meaning_1: kind of tree; type of tree
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici rukkhajātānaṃ phandano tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati yadidaṃ mudutāya c'eva kammaññatāya ca. evam'evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, n'āññaṃ ekadhammam'pi samanupassāmi yaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ mudu ca hoti kammaññañ'ca yatha'y'idaṃ cittaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) rukkhajātānan'ti paccatte sāmivacanaṃ, rukkhajātānī'ti attho. rukkhānam'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

example_1: tūlaṃ nāma tīṇi tūlāni, rukkhatūlaṃ, latātūlaṃ, poṭakitūlaṃ.
commentary: (VINa) rukkhatūlan'ti simbalirukkh'ādīnaṃ yesaṃ kesañci rukkhānaṃ tūlaṃ.

example_1: pupphitakālato paṭṭhāya abbohārikaṃ. allarukkhato pana ahicchattakaṃ gaṇhanto rukkhattacaṃ vikopeti, tasmā tattha pācittiyaṃ. rukkhapappaṭikāya'pi es'eva nayo.
commentary: (VINt) rukkhattacaṃ vikopetī'ti vuttattā rukkhe jātaṃ yaṃ kiñci chattakaṃ rukkhattacaṃ avikopetvā matthakato chinditvā gahetuṃ vaṭṭatī'ti vadanti.

example_1: atha kho, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ sāle adhivatthāya devatāya mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā ārāmadevatā vanadevatā rukkhadevatā osadhitiṇavanappatīsu adhivatthā devatā saṅgamma samāgamma evaṃ samassāseyyuṃ, mā bhavaṃ bhāyi, mā bhavaṃ bhāyi
commentary: (MNa) rukkhadevatā'ti abhilakkhitesu naḷerupucimand'ādīsu rukkhesu adhivatthā devatā.

meaning_1: nature of a tree; tree's characteristic; inherent quality of a tree
example_1: kathaṃ pana, mārisa, rukkho rukkhadhamme ṭhito hotī'ti? idha, devate, rukkhassa mūlaṃ mūl'atthikā haranti, tacaṃ tac'atthikā haranti, pattaṃ patt'atthikā haranti, pupphaṃ pupph'atthikā haranti, phalaṃ phal'atthikā haranti.
commentary: (VMVt) rukkhadhamme'ti rukkhassa pavattiyaṃ. rukkhānaṃ viya chedan'ādīsu akuppanañ'hi rukkhadhammo nāma. (PYt) rukkhadhammo'ti rukkhasabhāvo. rukkhadhammo ca nāma chedanabhedan'ādīsu rukkhānaṃ acetanattā kopassa akaraṇaṃ, tasmiṃ rukkhadhamme ṭhitā devatā rukkhadhamme ṭhitā nāma, chedanabhedan'ādīsu rukkhassa viya rukkhaṭṭhakadevatāya akopanaṃ rukkhadhamme ṭhitā nāmā'ti adhippāyo.

example_1: ye kuṭṭanissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ. rukkhaṃ ce nissāya tiṭṭheyya, ye rukkhanissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ. udakaṃ ce nissāya tiṭṭheyya, ye udakanissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ.
commentary: (SNa) rukkhanissitā'ti uccāliṅgapāṇak'ādayo.

meaning_1: fruit tree; tree which bears fruit
example_1: yācitak'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. rukkhaphala-upamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.
example_2: rukkhaphal'ūpamā kāmā sambhañjanaparibhañjan'aṭṭhenā'ti passanto vikkhambhanato kāme parivajjeti
commentary: (MNa) rukkhaphal'ūpamā sabb'aṅgapaccaṅga-palibhañjan'aṭṭhena.

meaning_1: like a fruit tree; similar to a fruit tree
example_1: evam'eva kho, gahapati, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, rukkhaphal'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo'ti.
example_2: aṭṭhikaṅkal'ūpamā… maṃsapes'ūpamā… tiṇ'ukk'ūpamā… aṅgārakās'ūpamā… supinak'ūpamā… yācitak'ūpamā… rukkhaphal'ūpamā… asisūn'ūpamā… sattisūl'ūpamā… sappasir'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo'ti.
commentary: (MNa) rukkhaphal'ūpamā sabb'aṅgapaccaṅga-palibhañjan'aṭṭhena.

meaning_1: foot of a tree; base of a tree
example_1: etāni, bhikkhu, rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññ'āgārāni. jhāyatha, bhikkhu, mā pamād'attha, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī'ti.
example_2: araññe rukkhamūle vā, suññ'āgāre'va bhikkhavo, anussaretha sambuddhaṃ, bhayaṃ tumhāka no siyā.
commentary: (MNa) rukkhamūlan'ti yaṃkiñci sandacchāyaṃ vivittaṃ rakkhamūlaṃ.

meaning_1: gone to the foot of a tree
example_1: tañ'ca nāgaṃ passati rukkhamūlagataṃ vā abbhokāsagataṃ vā gacchantaṃ vā tiṭṭhantaṃ vā nisinnaṃ vā nipannaṃ vā. so niṭṭhaṃ gacchati, ayam'eva so mahānāgo'ti.
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññ'āgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā

meaning_1: root of a tree in a thicket
example_1: rukkhamūlagahanaṃ pasakkiya, nibbānaṃ hadayasmiṃ opiya, jhā gotama mā pamādo, kiṃ te biḷibiḷikā karissatī'ti.
commentary: (THa) rukkhamūlagahanan'ti rukkhamūlabhūtaṃ gahanaṃ, gahanañ'hi atthi, na rukkhamūlaṃ, rukkhamūlañ'ca atthi, na gahanaṃ, tesu rukkhamūlaggahaṇena ṭhānassa chāyāsampannatāya vāt'ātapaparissayābhāvaṃ dasseti. gahanaggahaṇena nivātabhāvena vātaparissayābhāvaṃ janasambādhābhāvañ'ca dasseti, tadubhayena ca bhāvanāyogyataṃ.

meaning_1: living place at the foot of a tree
ascetic who lives at the foot of a tree; root of a tree dweller
meaning_2: who lives at the foot of a tree
example_1: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, rukkhamūlikassa rukkhamūlikamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi.

commentary: (MNa) rukkhamūlikassā'ti rukkhamūlavāsino.

meaning_2: practice of living at the foot of tree

rukkhamūlika + aṅga

meaning_1: fact of being an ascetic who lives at the foot of a tree; fact of being a root of a tree dweller
construction:
rukkha + mūla + ika + tta
rukkhamūlika + tta
example_1: so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho'mhi rukkhamūliko, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na rukkhamūlikā'ti. so tena rukkhamūlikattena attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.
example_2: so paṭipadaṃ'y'eva antaraṃ karitvā tena rukkhamūlikattena n'ev'attān'ukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti. ayam'pi, bhikkhave, sappurisadhammo.

meaning_1: mere fact of living at the foot of a tree
example_1: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, udakorohakassa udakorohaṇamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi. n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, rukkhamūlikassa rukkhamūlikamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi. n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, abbhokāsikassa abbhokāsikamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi.

meaning_lit: discourse on living at the foot of a tree

example_1: seyyathā'pi nāma ulūko rukkhasākhāyaṃ mūsikaṃ maggayamāno jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati.

example_1: pheggu phegguparivāro, pheggu sāraparivāro, sāro phegguparivāro, sāro sāraparivāro, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro rukkhā. evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro rukkh'ūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame cattāro?
te evaṃ vadeyyuṃ m'āyasmanto etaṃ bhikkhuṃ kiñci avacuttha, dhammavādī c'eso bhikkhu, vinayavādī c'eso bhikkhu, amhākañ'c'eso bhikkhu chandañ'ca ruciñ'ca ādāya voharati
example_2: sakañ'hi diṭṭhiṃ katham'accayeyya, chand'ānunīto ruciyā niviṭṭho, sayaṃ samattāni pakubbamāno, yathā hi jāneyya tathā vadeyya.

example_1: yathā'pi ruciraṃ pupphaṃ, vaṇṇavantaṃ agandhakaṃ, evaṃ subhāsitā vācā, aphalā hoti akubbato.

meaning_1: having beautiful qualities; pleasing in nature
example_1: asaṃsayassa kusalassa, venayikassa sārathivarassa, anuttarassa ruciradhammassa, nikkaṅkhassa pabhāsakassa, mānacchidassa vīrassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
commentary: (MNa) ruciradhammassā'ti sucidhammassa

example_1: sa kho so, bhikkhave, bālo abyatto akusalo sūdo sakassa bhattu nimittaṃ na uggaṇhāti, idaṃ vā me ajja bhattu sūpeyyaṃ ruccati, imassa vā abhiharati, imassa vā bahuṃ gaṇhāti, imassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.

te bhikkhū bhikkhūhi evam'assu vacanīyā, m'āyasmanto evaṃ avacuttha, na c'eso bhikkhu dhammavādī, na c'eso bhikkhu vinayavādī, m'āyasmantānam'pi saṅghabhedo ruccittha
example_2: mā āyasmantānam'pi saṅghabhedo ruccittha. samet'āyasmantānaṃ saṅghena, samaggo hi saṅgho, sammodamāno avivadamāno ek'uddeso, phāsu viharatī'ti.

meaning_2: having found delight in, having liked
