example_1: tassa kāmanandī'pi n'ānuseti, byāpādanandī'pi n'ānuseti, vihesānandī'pi n'ānuseti, rūpanandī'pi n'ānuseti, sakkāyanandī'pi n'ānuseti, kāmanandiyā'pi ananusayā, byāpādanandiyā'pi ananusayā, vihesānandiyā'pi ananusayā, rūpanandiyā'pi ananusayā, sakkāyanandiyā'pi ananusayā.

meaning_1: mental representation of form; image of matter
example_1: kathañ'ca, gahapati, niketasārī hoti? rūpanimittaniketavisāravinibandhā kho, gahapati, niketasārī'ti vuccati.
commentary: (SNa) rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā'ti rūpam'eva kilesānaṃ paccay'aṭṭhena nimittaṃ, ārammaṇakiriya-saṅkhāta-nivāsanaṭṭhān'aṭṭhena niketan'ti rūpanimittaniketaṃ. visāro ca vinibandho ca visāravinibandhā. ubhayen'api hi kilesānaṃ patthaṭabhāvo ca vinibandhanabhāvo ca vutto, rūpanimittanikete visāravinibandhā'ti rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā, tasmā rūpanimittaniketamhi uppannena kilesavisārena c'eva kilesabandhanena cā'ti attho.

meaning_1: expanding of and bondage to the resort that is the mental representation of form
example_1: kathañ'ca, gahapati, niketasārī hoti? rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā kho, gahapati, niketasārī'ti vuccati. saddanimitta … gandhanimitta… rasanimitta… phoṭṭhabbanimitta… dhammanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā kho, gahapati, niketasārī'ti vuccati.
commentary: (SNa) rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā'ti rūpam'eva kilesānaṃ paccay'aṭṭhena nimittaṃ, ārammaṇakiriya-saṅkhāta-nivāsanaṭṭhān'aṭṭhena niketan'ti rūpanimittaniketaṃ. visāro ca vinibandho ca visāravinibandhā. ubhayen'api hi kilesānaṃ patthaṭabhāvo ca vinibandhanabhāvo ca vutto, rūpanimittanikete visāravinibandhā'ti rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā, tasmā rūpanimittaniketamhi uppannena kilesavisārena c'eva kilesabandhanena cā'ti attho.
notes: A difficult term to translate. See CPB note 22.

meaning_1: bound by gratification to the mental representation of form
example_1: kathañ'c'āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ avisaṭan'ti vuccati? idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na rūpanimitt'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti rūpanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ na rūpanimitt'assādavinibandhaṃ na rūpanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ avisaṭan'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: bound with a chain to the gratification from the mental representation of form
example_1: kathañ'c'āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati? idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rūpanimitt'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti rūpanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ rūpanimitt'assādavinibandhaṃ rūpanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: bound by the gratification from the mental representation of form
example_1: kathañ'c'āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati? idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rūpanimitt'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti rūpanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ rūpanimitt'assādavinibandhaṃ rūpanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: following the mental representation of form
example_1: kathañ'c'āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati? idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rūpanimitt'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti rūpanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ rūpanimitt'assādavinibandhaṃ rūpanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati.
commentary: (MNa) rūpanimitt'ānusārī'ti rūpanimittaṃ anussarati anudhāvatī'ti rūpanimitt'ānusārī.

meaning_1: ending of material form; cessation of the body
example_1: āhārasamudayā rūpasamudayo, āhāranirodhā rūpanirodho.

meaning_1: path of practice leading to the end of material form
example_1: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

meaning_1: leading to the end of material form
example_1: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na rūpaṃ upādiyissāmi, na ca me rūpanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.

tassa taṃ cittaṃ sugataṃ subhāvitaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ suvimuttaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ rūpehi. ye ca rūpapaccayā uppajjanti āsavā vighātā pariḷāhā, mutto so tehi, na so taṃ vedanaṃ vedeti. idam'akkhātaṃ rūpānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ.

meaning_1: quest for forms; searching for sights
example_1: rūpadhātuṃ, bhikkhave, paṭicca uppajjati rūpasaññā, rūpasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpasaṅkappo, rūpasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpacchando, rūpacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpapariḷāho, rūpapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpapariyesanā
commentary: (SNa) rūpapariyesanā'ti pariḷāhe uppanne sandiṭṭhasambhatte gahetvā tassa rūpassa paṭilābh'atthāya pariyesanā.

meaning_1: fever for forms; burning passion for sights; strong desire for visible objects
example_1: so aparena samayena rūpānaṃ'y'eva samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā rūpataṇhaṃ pahāya rūpapariḷāhaṃ paṭivinodetvā vigatapipāso ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto vihareyya.
commentary: (MNa) rūpapariḷāhan'ti rūpaṃ ārabbha uppajjanapariḷāhaṃ.

meaning_1: appearance of a form; manifestation of an image
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso āgaccheyya lākhaṃ vā haliddiṃ vā nīlaṃ vā mañjiṭṭhaṃ vā ādāya. so evaṃ vadeyya, ahaṃ imasmiṃ ākāse rūpaṃ likhissāmi, rūpapātubhāvaṃ karissāmī'ti.

meaning_1: suitable reason; appropriate cause; good reason
example_1: aññatra tathā rūpappaccayā'ti ṭhapetvā tathārūpappaccayaṃ.
commentary: (KVa) aññatra tathārūpappaccayā'ti tathārūpe kāraṇe asati kevalaṃ senaṃ dassan'atthāya gacchato pade pade dukkaṭaṃ, dassan'ūpacāre ṭhatvā passato pācittiyaṃ.

example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhave, sāmiso vimokkho? rūpappaṭisaṃyutto vimokkho sāmiso vimokkho. katamo ca, bhikkhave, nirāmiso vimokkho? arūpappaṭisaṃyutto vimokkho nirāmiso vimokkho.

meaning_1: experiencing sights; conscious of material form
meaning_2: experiencing sight; conscious of material form
example_1: idha pana, upavāṇa, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rūpappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti rūparāgappaṭisaṃvedī ca.
commentary: (SNa) rūpappaṭisaṃvedī'ti nīlapīt'ādi-bhedaṃ ārammaṇaṃ vavatthāpento rūpaṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ karoti, tasmā rūpappaṭisaṃvedī nāma hoti.

meaning_1: with form as a support; establish on matter
example_1: upayo, bhikkhave, avimutto, anupayo vimutto. rūp'upayaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, rūp'ārammaṇaṃ rūpappatiṭṭhaṃ nand'ūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.
commentary: (DNt) rūpaṃ sahakārīkāraṇabhāvena patiṭṭhā etassā'ti rūpappatiṭṭhaṃ.

meaning_1: who measures by appearance; appraising by form; who judges on the basis of external looks
example_1: rūpappamāṇo rūpappasanno, ghosappamāṇo ghosappasanno, lūkhappamāṇo lūkhappasanno, dhammappamāṇo dhammappasanno. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.
commentary: (ANa) pañca'me rūpe pamāṇaṃ gahetvā pasanno rūpappamāṇo nāma

meaning_1: who has confidence in appearances; whose faith is based on form; pleased by form
example_1: rūpappamāṇo rūpappasanno, ghosappamāṇo ghosappasanno, lūkhappamāṇo lūkhappasanno, dhammappamāṇo dhammappasanno. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.
commentary: (ANa) pañca'me rūpe pamāṇaṃ gahetvā pasanno rūpappamāṇo nāma. rūpappasanno'ti tass'eva atthavacanaṃ.

meaning_1: imprisoned by form; held captive by material form
meaning_lit: bound with the bond of form
example_1: rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano rūpabandhanabaddho santarabāhirabandhanabaddho atīradassī apāradassī, baddho jīyati baddho mīyati baddho asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ gacchati.

katamāni pañca? rūpabalaṃ, bhogabalaṃ, ñātibalaṃ, puttabalaṃ, sīlabalaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa balāni. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi balehi samannāgato mātugāmo visārado agāraṃ ajjhāvasatī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) rūpabalan'ti-ādīsu rūpasampatti rūpabalaṃ, bhogasampatti bhogabalaṃ, ñātisampatti ñātibalaṃ, puttasampatti puttabalaṃ, sīlasampatti sīlabalaṃ. (SNt) rūpasampatti rūpabalaṃ taṃsamaṅgino upatthambhakabhāvato. esa nayo sesesu'pi. balāni hi sattānaṃ vuḍḍhiyā upatthambhakapaccayo hoti, yathā taṃ āhāro.

meaning_1: because of the power of beauty
example_1: na, bhikkhave, mātugāmo rūpabalahetu vā bhogabalahetu vā ñātibalahetu vā puttabalahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. sīlabalahetu kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.

meaning_1: existence in the realm of form
example_1: kati pan'āvuso, bhavā'ti? tayo'me, āvuso, bhavā, kāmabhavo, rūpabhavo, arūpabhavo'ti.
example_2: rūpadhātuvepakkañ'ca, ānanda, kammaṃ n'ābhavissa, api nu kho rūpabhavo paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ bhante
commentary: (NIDD1a) rūpabhave'ti rūp'āvacare.

meaning_1: enjoyment of forms; pleasure in sights
made from sights; consists of material forms
meaning_2: made of sights; consisting of material forms
example_1: cakkhu, bhikkhave, purisassa samuddo, tassa rūpamayo vego.
commentary: (SNa) tassa rūpamayo vego'ti samuddassa appamāṇo ūmimayo vego viya tassā'pi cakkhusamuddassa samosarantassa nīlādi-bhedassa ārammaṇassa vasena appameyyo rūpamayo vego veditabbo.

meaning_1: taking pleasure in forms; pleased by sights
example_1: cakkhuṃ kho, māgaṇḍiya, rūp'ārāmaṃ rūparataṃ rūpasammuditaṃ. taṃ tathāgatassa dantaṃ guttaṃ rakkhitaṃ saṃvutaṃ, tassa ca saṃvarāya dhammaṃ deseti.
commentary: (MNa) rūpe ratan'ti rūparataṃ.

meaning_1: taking pleasure in material form; delighting in materiality
example_1: rūp'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, rūparatassa rūpasammuditassa rūpanirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti, na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti, n'eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti.
commentary: (NIDD1a) rūp'ārāman'ti rūpaṃ ārāmaṃ assā'ti rūp'ārāmaṃ. rūpe ratan'ti rūparataṃ. rūpe santuṭṭhī'ti rūpasammuditaṃ.

meaning_1: taste for forms; pleasure in sights
commentary: (SNt) arasarūpo'ti ācārarahitasabhāvo. rūpassa assādanavasena uppajjanakasukhadhammā rūparasā. esa nayo saddaras'ādīsu.

meaning_1: passion for material existence; desire for worldly existence
meaning_2: desire to be born in the world of form
example_1: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, aniccasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sabbaṃ kāmarāgaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ rūparāgaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ bhavarāgaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ avijjaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ asmimānaṃ samūhanati.
example_2: rūparāgo, arūparāgo, māno, uddhaccaṃ, avijjā, imāni pañc'uddham'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.

meaning_1: craving for material form; desire for sights
example_1: idha pana, upavāṇa, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rūpappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti rūparāgappaṭisaṃvedī ca.
commentary: (SNa) rūparāgappaṭisaṃvedī'ti kilesassa atthibhāven'eva pana rūparāgaṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ karoti nāma, tasmā rūparāgappaṭisaṃvedī'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: experiencing greed for sights; experiencing desire for material form
meaning_2: experiencing greed for the sight; experiencing desire for the material form
example_1: idha pana, upavāṇa, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rūpappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti rūparāgappaṭisaṃvedī ca.
commentary: (SNa) rūparāgappaṭisaṃvedī'ti kilesassa atthibhāven'eva pana rūparāgaṃ paṭisaṃviditaṃ karoti nāma, tasmā rūparāgappaṭisaṃvedī'ti vuccati.

example_1: rūpasamphassajaṃ vedanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpacchando, rūpacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpapariḷāho, rūpapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpapariyesanā, rūpapariyesanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpalābho
commentary: (SNa) rūpalābho'ti pariyesitvā laddhaṃ saha taṇhāya ārammaṇaṃ rūpalābho'ti vuttaṃ.

meaning_1: thought about forms; conception of sights
example_1: rūpadhātuṃ, bhikkhave, paṭicca uppajjati rūpasaññā, rūpasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpasaṅkappo, rūpasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpacchando, rūpacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpapariḷāho, rūpapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati rūpapariyesanā
commentary: (SNa) rūpasaṅkappo'ti tasmiṃ'y'eva ārammaṇe tīhi cittehi sampayuttasaṅkappo.

meaning_1: freed by the exhaustion of form; liberated through the dissolution of matter
example_1: rūpasaṅkhayavimutto kho, vaccha, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāḷho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo. upapajjatī'ti na upeti, na upapajjatī'ti na upeti, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatī'ti na upeti, n'eva upapajjati na na upapajjatī'ti na upeti.

meaning_1: free from classification in terms of form
example_1: evam'eva kho, mahārāja, yena rūpe tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya taṃ rūpaṃ tathāgatassa pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tāl'āvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṅkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ. rūpasaṅkhāyavimutto kho, mahārāja, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo.
commentary: (SNa) rūpasaṅkhāya vimutto'ti āyatiṃ rūpassa anuppattiyā rūp'ārūpakoṭṭhāsena'pi evarūpo nāma bhavissatī'ti vohārassa'pi paṭipassaddhattā rūpapaṇṇattiyā'pi vimutto.

meaning_1: freed from classification according to form
example_1: rūpasaṅkhāvimutto ho, vaccha, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāḷho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo. upapajjatī'ti na upeti, na upapajjatī'ti na upeti, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatī'ti na upeti, n'eva upapajjati na na upapajjatī'ti na upeti.
commentary: (SNa) rūpasaṅkhāya vimutto'ti āyatiṃ rūpassa anuppattiyā rūp'ārūpakoṭṭhāsena'pi evarūpo nāma bhavissatī'ti vohārassa'pi paṭipassaddhattā rūpapaṇṇattiyā'pi vimutto.

meaning_1: classification of form; grouping of materiality
example_1: tividhena rūpasaṅgaho, sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ rūpaṃ, anidassanasappaṭighaṃ rūpaṃ, anidassana-appaṭighaṃ rūpaṃ.

meaning_1: thoughts about sights; intention regarding forms
example_1: katame ca, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, cetanākāyā, rūpasañcetanā, saddasañcetanā, gandhasañcetanā, rasasañcetanā, phoṭṭhabbasañcetanā, dhammasañcetanā.

meaning_1: recognition of form; perception of matter; concept of materiality; (comm) existence in the realm of form
example_1: idha mayaṃ, bhante, yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhāma sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā, ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāma
example_2: yattha nāmañ'ca rūpañ'ca, asesaṃ uparujjhati, paṭighaṃ rūpasaññā ca, etth'esā chijjate jaṭā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) paṭighaṃ rūpasaññā cā'ti ettha paṭighasaññāvasena kāmabhavo gahito, rūpasaññāvasena rūpabhavo. tesu dvīsu gahitesu arūpabhavo gahito'va hoti bhavasaṅkhepenā'ti.

meaning_1: who is percipient of the body; who is conscious of materiality
example_1: aṭṭh'imāni, bhikkhave, abhibh'āyatanāni. katamāni aṭṭha? ajjhattaṃ rūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni, tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī'ti, evaṃsaññī hoti. idaṃ paṭhamaṃ abhibh'āyatanaṃ.
example_2: vibhūtarūpasaññissa, sabbakāyappahāyino, ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, n'atthi kiñcī'ti passato, ñāṇaṃ sakk'ānupucchāmi, kathaṃ neyyo tathāvidho.

meaning_1: similar in form (to); with the same appearance (as)
example_1: revato tesaṃ kathaṃ sutvā cintesi, ayaṃ dārikā daharā paṭhamavaye ṭhitā, imissā kira evaṃvidhaṃ rūpaṃ mama ayyikāya rūpasadisaṃ bhavissati, pucchissāmi tāva nesaṃ adhippāyan'ti cintetvā āha, tumhe kiṃ kathethā'ti? tāta, ayaṃ dārikā ayyikā viya te jaraṃ pāpuṇātū'ti vadāmā'ti.

meaning_1: sights, sounds, smells, tastes and touches
construction:
rūpa + sadda + gandha + rasa + phoṭṭhabba + āni
rūpasaddagandharasaphoṭṭhabba + āni
compound_construction: rūpāni ca saddā ca gandhā ca rasā ca phoṭṭhabbāni ca
example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño rāj'antepuraṃ hatthisammaddaṃ assasammaddaṃ rathasammaddaṃ rajjanīyāni rūpa-sadda-gandha-rasa-phoṭṭhabbāni, yāni na pabbajitassa sāruppāni. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dasamo ādīnavo rāj'antepurappavesane.

meaning_1: source of material form; arising of the body; origination of materiality
example_1: āhārasamudayā rūpasamudayo, āhāranirodhā rūpanirodho.

meaning_1: contact with forms; impression of sights

commentary: (MNa) lobhanīyesu dhammesū'ti lobhadhammesu.

meaning_1: created by greed; produced by desire
example_1: yaṃ, bhikkhave, lobhapakataṃ kammaṃ lobhajaṃ lobhanidānaṃ lobhasamudayaṃ, yatth'assa attabhāvo nibbattati tattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati.
commentary: (ANa) lobhapakatan'ti lobhena pakataṃ, lobh'ābhibhūtena luddhena hutvā katakamman'ti attho.

meaning_1: dependent on greed; due to desire

meaning_1: with greed as source; originating from desire

meaning_1: mastering one's terror; overcoming fear; fearless

meaning_2: submits; complies; to let one's hair drop (as a sign of subduedness or modesty)
example_1: na sammā vattati, na lomaṃ pāteti, na netthāraṃ vattati, yena saṅgho attamano hoti taṃ karomī'ti n'āha.
commentary: (MNa) na lomaṃ pātetī'ti anulomavatte na vattati, vilomam'eva gaṇhāti.

example_1: seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso dīghalomikaṃ eḷakaṃ lomesu gahetvā ākaḍḍheyya parikaḍḍheyya samparikaḍḍheyya, evam'ev'āhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ ākaḍḍhissāmi parikaḍḍhissāmi samparikaḍḍhissāmi.
cakkhūhi n'eva lola-assa, gāmakathāya āvaraye sotaṃ, rase ca n'ānugijjheyya, na ca mamāyetha kiñci lokasmiṃ.

meaning_1: abandoned agitation; dispelled restlessness; (or) given up longing

example_1: patirūpako mattikākuṇḍalo'va, loha-aḍḍhamāso'va suvaṇṇachanno, caranti loke parivārachannā, anto asuddhā bahi sobhamānā'ti.

tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā uddhaṃpādaṃ adhosiraṃ gahetvā tattāya lohakumbhiyā pakkhipanti ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya. so tattha pheṇ'uddehakaṃ paccati.

commentary: (VINa) lohakumbhī nāma kāḷalohena vā tambalohena vā yena kenaci lohena katā kumbhī.

example_1: jhāya bhikkhu mā pamādo, mā te kāmaguṇe ramessu cittaṃ, mā lohaguḷaṃ gilī pamatto, mā kandi dukkham'idan'ti ḍayhamāno.
example_2: tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā tattena ayosaṅkunā mukhaṃ vivaritvā ādittena sampajjalitena sajotibhūtena tattaṃ lohaguḷaṃ mukhe pakkhipanti ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) mā lohaguḷan'ti sativossaggalakkhaṇena hi pamādena pamattā niraye tattaṃ lohaguḷaṃ gilanti, tena taṃ vadāmi mā pamatto hutvā lohaguḷaṃ gili, mā niraye ḍayhamāno dukkham'idan'ti kandī'ti attho.

meaning_1: half a copper coin; half a copper māsaka

commentary: (DNa) lohicco'ti tassa brāhmaṇassa nāmaṃ.

meaning_1: because of taking refuge in the Saṅgha
example_1: sādhu kho, devānam'inda, saṅghasaraṇagamanaṃ hoti. saṅghasaraṇagamanahetu kho, devānam'inda, evam'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantī'ti.

meaning_1: frequented by group; visited by herds

example_2: vāḷamigasaṅghasevitaṃ, kuñjaramattakareṇuloḷitaṃ, asahāyikā gantum'icchasi, rahitaṃ bhiṃsanakaṃ mahāvanaṃ.

meaning_1: adorning the community; beautifying the monastic order

example_2: bhikkhu ca sīlasampanno, bhikkhunī ca bahussutā, upāsako ca yo saddho, yā ca saddhā upāsikā, ete kho saṅghaṃ sobhenti, ete hi saṅghasobhanā'ti.

meaning_1: which binds together; which joins (the others) together

meaning_lit: offence requiring involvement of the community from start to finish

example_2: n'āhaṃ taṃ passāmi samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā, saṅghiṃ gaṇiṃ gaṇ'ācariyaṃ, api arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ paṭijānamānaṃ, yo mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho na saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya, yassa na kacchehi sedā mucceyyuṃ.

meaning_1: attending on the community; serving the Saṅgha
example_1: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ saṅgh'upaṭṭhākānaṃ yadidaṃ hatthigāmako uggato gahapati.
commentary: (ANa) saṅgh'upaṭṭhākānan'ti bhikkhusaṅghassa upaṭṭhākānaṃ hatthigāmako uggato gahapati, aggo'ti dasseti.

example_1: ayaṃ vuccati, visākhe, ariyasāvako saṅgh'uposathaṃ upavasati, saṅghena saddhiṃ saṃvasati, saṅghañ'c'assa ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmojjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
example_2: yāvatikā ca bhikkhū kammappattā saṅgh'uposathaarahā cattāro vā tato vā atirekā pakatattā pārājikaṃ anāpannā saṅghena vā anukkhittā.
commentary: (ANa) saṅgh'uposathan'ti aṭṭhannaṃ ariyapuggalānaṃ guṇe ārabbha upavutthattā ayaṃ uposatho saṅgh'uposatho'ti vutto.

meaning_1: worthy of (participating in) the observance day ceremony with the community
example_1: yāvatikā ca bhikkhū kammappattā saṅgh'uposath'ārahā cattāro vā tato vā atirekā pakatattā pārājikaṃ anāpannā saṅghena vā anukkhittā.

meaning_1: concerning the community; regarding the monastic order
example_1: ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho pañcasikho gandhabbadevaputto beluvapaṇḍuvīṇaṃ assāvesi, imā ca gāthā abhāsi buddh'ūpasañhitā dhamm'ūpasañhitā saṅgh'ūpasañhitā arahant'ūpasañhitā kām'ūpasañhitā
commentary: (DNa) buddh'ūpasañhitā'ti buddhaṃ ārabbha buddhaṃ nissayaṃ katvā pavattā'ti attho. sesapadesu'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: including the world system; with the solar system
meaning_lit: with the circle of animals; i.e. zodiac

example_1: sac'ajja mayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ careyyāma, vācāya sucaritaṃ careyyāma, manasā sucaritaṃ careyyāma, evaṃ mayaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyāma.
commentary: (SNa) sac'ajja mayan'ti sace ajja mayaṃ.

meaning_1: if he; if one; if this
example_1: sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno ek'aṃsabyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ek'aṃsena byākaroti, vibhajjabyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na vibhajja byākaroti, paṭipucchābyākaraṇīyaṃ pañhaṃ na paṭipucchā byākaroti, ṭhapanīyaṃ pañhaṃ na ṭhapeti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.
example_2: khat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. upahat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā pitaraṃ dhammikaṃ dhammarājānaṃ jīvitā na voropessatha, imasmiññ'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ uppajjissathā'ti.

example_1: tassa evam'assa, idaṃ kho parittaṃ gopade udakaṃ. sac'āhaṃ añjalinā vā pivissāmi bhājanena vā khobhessāmi'pi taṃ loḷessāmi'pi taṃ apeyyam'pi taṃ karissāmi.
example_2: mahāsatto… cirakālasamparicitaṃ nekkhamm'ajjhāsayaṃ upabrūhayamāno mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya pabbajitu'kāmo hutvā puna cintesi, sac'āhaṃ pabbajissāmi, guṇasambhāvanāpākaṭo bhavissāmī'ti.

example_1: sabbapāpassa akaraṇaṃ, kusalassa upasampadā, sacittapariyodapanaṃ, etaṃ buddhānasāsanaṃ.
example_2: tesaṃ sutvāna sappaññā, sacittaṃ paccaladdhā te, aniccaṃ aniccato dakkhuṃ, dukkham'addakkhu dukkhato.

meaning_1: endowed with mind; possessing consciousness; of which one is aware
skilled in understanding one's own mind
meaning_lit: skilled in the ways of one's own mind
example_1: no ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paracittapariyāyakusalo hoti, atha sacittapariyāyakusalo bhavissāmī'ti, evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) sacittapariyāyakusalo'ti attano cittavārakusalo.

meaning_1: purifying one's own mind; cleaning one's heart; (comm) removing the five hindrances
example_1: sabbapāpassa akaraṇaṃ, kusalass'ūpasampadā, sacittapariyodapanaṃ, etaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ.
commentary: (DHPa) sacittapariyodapanan'ti pañcahi nīvaraṇehi attano cittassa vodāpanaṃ.

meaning_1: purifying one's own mind; cleansing one's heart; (comm) eight liberations
example_1: katame dve? sacittavodānañ'ca na ca kiñci loke upādiyati. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve dhammā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) sacittavodānan'ti sakacittassa vodānaṃ, aṭṭhannaṃ samāpattīnaṃ etaṃ nāmaṃ.

example_1: kadā nu maṃ pāvusakālamegho, navena toyena sacīvaraṃ vane, isippayātamhi pathe vajantaṃ, ovassate taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

so tasmiṃ ambavane rattiṭṭhāna-divāṭhāna-leṇakuṭi-maṇḍap'ādīni sampādetvā bhagavato anucchavikaṃ gandhakuṭiṃ kārāpetvā ambavanaṃ aṭṭhārasahatth'ubbedhena tambapaṭṭavaṇṇena pākārena parikkhipāpetvā buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sacīvarabhattena santappetvā dakkhiṇ'odakaṃ pātetvā vihāraṃ niyyātesi.
commentary: (DNt) sacīvarabhattenā'ti cīvarena, bhattena ca.

example_1: sace musā na bhaṇasi, sace pāṇaṃ na hiṃsasi, sace adinnaṃ n'ādiyasi, saddahāno amaccharī, kiṃ kāhasi gayaṃ gantvā, udapāno'pi te gayā'ti.
example_2: sace, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, kiṃmūlakā, āvuso, sabbe dhammā, kiṃsambhavā sabbe dhammā, kiṃsamudayā sabbe dhammā, kiṃsamosaraṇā sabbe dhammā

meaning_1: if it is not troublesome for you; if it's convenient for you; if you don't mind
example_1: sace te kassapa agaru, viharemu ajjaṇho aggisālamhī'ti
example_2: ye te, māṇava, brāhmaṇā pañca dhamme paññapenti puññassa kiriyāya, kusalassa ārādhanāya, sace te agaru, sādhu te pañca dhamme imasmiṃ parisati bhāsassū'ti.
commentary: (MNa) sace te agarū'ti sace tuyhaṃ yathā brāhmaṇā paññapenti, tathā idha bhāsituṃ bhāriyaṃ na hoti, yadi na koci aphāsukabhāvo hoti, bhāsassū'ti attho.

example_1: sace'jja mayaṃ gocare careyyāma sake pettike visaye, na my'āyaṃ, sakuṇagghi, alaṃ abhavissa, yadidaṃ, yuddhāyā'ti. ko pana te, lāpa, gocaro sako pettiko visayo'ti?
commentary: (SNa) sace'jja mayan'ti sace ajja mayaṃ.

example_2: tesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, evaṃsamaññānaṃ sataṃ evaṃpaṭiññānaṃ sataṃ, yā samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadā taṃ paṭipajjissāma. evaṃ no ayaṃ amhākaṃ samaññā ca saccā bhavissati paṭiññā ca bhūtā.

example_2: ye diṭṭhim'uggayha vivādayanti, idam'eva saccan'ti ca vādayanti, te tvaṃ vadassū na hi te'dha atthi, vādamhi jāte paṭisenikattā.

example_2: atha kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno yena mahāvanaṃ kūṭ'āgārasālā ten'upasaṅkami.

deva, idāni ṭhapetvā saccakiriyaṃ añño mama sakkhi n'atthi, sac'āyaṃ dārako tumhe paṭicca jāto, ākāse tiṭṭhatu, no ce, bhūmiyaṃ patitvā maratū'ti bodhisattassa pāde gahetvā ākāse khipi.

meaning_1: leading to the truth; going to the true
example_1: saccañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi saccagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.
commentary: (SNa) param'atthasaccatāya saccaṃ.

grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of sacca
example_1: amosadhammaṃ nibbānaṃ, tadariyā saccato vidū, te ve sacc'ābhisamayā, nicchātā parinibbutā'ti.
example_2: attani ca, bhikkhave, attaniye ca saccato thetato anupalabbhamāne, yam'pi taṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ, so loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassāmī'ti, nan'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kevalo paripūro bāladhammo'ti?

meaning_1: truly called; correctly named; epithet of the Buddha
example_1: sa ve accaruci nāgo, himavā'v'aññe sil'uccaye, sabbesaṃ nāganāmānaṃ, saccanāmo anuttaro.
example_2: ahiṃsako'ti me nāmaṃ, hiṃsakassa pure sato, ajj'āhaṃ saccanāmo'mhi, na naṃ hiṃsāmi kiñci naṃ.
commentary: (THa) saccanāmo'ti saccen'eva nāganāmo. (ANa) saccanāmo'ti tacchanāmo bhūtanāmo āguṃ akaraṇen'eva nāgo'ti evaṃ avitathanāmo.

meaning_1: name of a privately awakened Buddha
example_1: buddho ahu maṅgalo vītarāgo, usabhacchidā jāliniṃ dukkhamūlaṃ, santaṃ padaṃ ajjhagam'opanīto, uposatho sundaro saccanāmo.

meaning_1: firm in truth; steadfast in truth; honest
example_1: upāyāsā ca te sabbe, viddhastā vinaḷīkatā, sītibhūto damappatto, dhitimā saccanikkamo.

ṭhito ahaṃ, aṅgulimāla, tvañ'ca tiṭṭhā'ti. atha kho corassa aṅgulimālassa etadahosi, ime kho samaṇā sakyaputtiyā saccavādino saccapaṭiññā. atha pan'āyaṃ samaṇo gacchaṃ y'ev'āha, ṭhito ahaṃ, aṅgulimāla, tvañ'ca tiṭṭhā'ti.
commentary: (PVa) saccappaṭiññā tava m'esā hotū'ti sabbam'pi t'āhaṃ abhisaddaheyyan'ti tava esā paṭiññā mayhaṃ saccaṃ hotu.

example_1: saccapabbaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

meaning_1: striving for the truth; persevering honestly; (comm) firmly striving
example_1: passanti devā ca tathāgatā ca, lokasmiṃ bālaṃ visamaṃ carantaṃ, tasmā hi att'ādhipateyyako ca, lok'ādhipo ca nipako ca jhāyī, dhamm'ādhipo ca anudhammacārī, na hīyati saccaparakkamo muni.
commentary: (ANa) saccaparakkamo'ti thiraparakkamo bhūtaparakkamo.

meaning_1: clinging to (something as) true; clutching (something as) the truth
example_1: kām'esanā bhav'esanā, brahmacariy'esanā saha, iti saccaparāmāso, diṭṭhiṭṭhānā samussayā.
commentary: (ANa) iti saccaparāmāso, diṭṭhiṭṭhānā samussayā'ti iti saccaṃ iti saccan'ti gahaṇaparāmāso ca diṭṭhisaṅkhātā'y'eva diṭṭhiṭṭhānā ca ye samussitattā uggantvā ṭhitattā samussayā'ti vuccanti, te sabbe'pi.
(MNt) saccaparicchedam'evā'ti pariññ'ābhisamay'ādi-vasena saccānaṃ paricchindanam'eva.

meaning_2: highest state of honesty; perfection of truthfulness

meaning_1: asserting the truth; confirming the truth
example_1: saccappaṭiñño purimāsu jātisu, advejjhavāco alikaṃ vivajjayi, na so visaṃvādayitā'pi kassaci, bhūtena tacchena tathena bhāsayi.
example_2: saccappaṭiññā tava m'esā hotu, sutvāna dhammaṃ labha suppasādaṃ, aññatthiko no ca paduṭṭhacitto, yaṃ te sutaṃ asutañ'c'āpi dhammaṃ, sabbam'pi akkhissaṃ yathā pajānanti.
commentary: (PVa) saccappaṭiññā tava m'esā hotū'ti sabbam'pi t'āhaṃ abhisaddaheyyan'ti tava esā paṭiññā mayhaṃ saccaṃ hotu.

meaning_1: with honest mind; with good heart
example_1: vadanti ve duṭṭhamanā'pi eke, atho'pi ve saccamanā vadanti, vādañ'ca jātaṃ muni no upeti, tasmā munī n'atthi khilo kuhiñci.
commentary: (NIDD1) atho'pi ve saccamanā vadantī'ti ye tesaṃ titthiyānaṃ saddahantā okappentā adhimuccantā saccamanā saccasaññino bhūtamanā bhūtasaññino tathamanā tathasaññino yāthāvamanā yāthāvasaññino aviparītamanā aviparītasaññino vadanti upavadanti bhagavantañ'ca bhikkhusaṅghañ'ca abhūtenā'ti, atho'pi ve saccamanā vadanti. (SNPa) duṭṭhamanā'pi eke atho'pi ve saccamanā'ti ekacce duṭṭhacittā, ekacce tathasaññino'pi hutvā, titthiyā duṭṭhacittā, ye tesaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā saddahiṃsu, te saccamanā'ti adhippāyo.

meaning_1: arrives at the truth; realizes the reality
example_1: kittāvatā pana, bho gotama, sacc'ānuppatti hoti, kittāvatā saccam'anupāpuṇāti? sacc'ānuppattiṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā'ti.

meaning_1: awakens to the truth; understands reality
example_1: ettāvatā, bho gotama, sacc'ānurakkhaṇā hoti, ettāvatā saccam'anurakkhati, ettāvatā ca mayaṃ sacc'ānurakkhaṇaṃ pekkhāma. kittāvatā pana, bho gotama, sacc'ānubodho hoti, kittāvatā saccam'anubujjhati? sacc'ānubodhaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā'ti.

meaning_1: adhering to the truth; preserving accuracy
example_1: saccam'anurakkhatā, bhāradvāja, viññunā purisena n'ālam'ettha ek'aṃsena niṭṭhaṃ gantuṃ, idam'eva saccaṃ, mogham'aññan'ti.

meaning_1: adheres to the truth; preserves accuracy
example_1: kittāvatā pana, bho gotama, sacc'ānurakkhaṇā hoti, kittāvatā saccam'anurakkhati? sacc'ānurakkhaṇaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmā'ti.
commentary: (MNa) saccam'anurakkheyyā'ti param'atthasaccassa nibbānassa sacchikiriy'atthaṃ ādito'va vacīsaccaṃ rakkheyya.

meaning_1: spoke the truth; told the truth
example_1: iti vadaṃ brāhmaṇo saccam'āha, no musā. so tena na samaṇo'ti maññati, na brāhmaṇo'ti maññati, na seyyo'ham'asmī'ti maññati, na sadiso'ham'asmī'ti maññati, na hīno'ham'asmī'ti maññati.
example_2: sabbasaṃhārako n'atthi, suddhaṃ kaṅgu pavāyati, alikaṃ bhāyatiyaṃ dhuttī, saccam'āha mahallikā'ti.
commentary: (ANa) iti vadaṃ brāhmaṇo saccam'āhā'ti evam'pi vadanto khīṇ'āsavabrāhmaṇo saccam'eva āha.

meaning_1: considered true; thought to be true (by)
example_1: yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ'va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, ajjhositaṃ saccamutaṃ paresaṃ. na tesu tādī sayasaṃvutesu, saccaṃ musā vā'pi paraṃ daheyya.
commentary: (ANa) ajjhositaṃ saccamutaṃ paresan'ti paresaṃ saddhāya parapattiyāyanāya saccamutan'ti maññitvā ajjhositaṃ gilitvā pariniṭṭhāpetvā gahitaṃ.

example_1: tassa yā purimā kāmasaññā, sā nirujjhati. vivekaja-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, vivekaja-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.
commentary: (DNa) vivekaja-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hotī'ti tasmiṃ paṭhamajjhānasamaye vivekajapītisukhasaṅkhātā sukhumasaññā saccā hoti, bhūtā hotī'ti attho. atha vā kāmacchand'ādi-oḷārik'aṅga-ppahānavasena sukhumā ca sā bhūtatāya saccā ca saññā'ti sukhumasaccasaññā, vivekajehi pītisukhehi sampayuttā sukhumasaccasaññāti vivekaja-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññā sā assa atthī'ti vivekaja-pītisukha-sukhumasacca-saññī'ti evam'ettha attho daṭṭhabbo. esa nayo sabbattha.

example_1: musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato ahosiṃ saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa.
commentary: (MNa) saccena saccaṃ sandahati ghaṭetī'ti saccasandho

meaning_1: produced by honesty; derived from truth
example_1: atha kho yāni tāni kulāni aḍḍhāni mahaddhanāni mahābhogāni pahūtajātarūparajatāni pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇāni pahūtadhanadhaññāni, sabbāni tāni dānasambhūtāni c'eva saccasambhūtāni ca sāmaññasambhūtāni ca.
commentary: (SNa) ettha pana saccaṃ nāma saccavāditā. sāmaññaṃ nāma sesasīlaṃ.

meaning_1: considered to be correct; regarded as true (by)
example_1: pittasamuṭṭhānāni'pi kho, sīvaka, idh'ekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti. sāmam'pi kho etaṃ, sīvaka, veditabbaṃ yathā pittasamuṭṭhānāni'pi idh'ekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti, lokassa'pi kho etaṃ, sīvaka, saccasammataṃ yathā pittasamuṭṭhānāni'pi idh'ekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.
commentary: (SNa) saccasammatan'ti bhūtasammataṃ. loko'pi hi'ssa sarīre sabalavaṇṇat'ādipittavikāraṃ disvā pittamassa kupitan'ti jānāti.

example_1: dānena damena saṃyamena saccavajjena atthi puññaṃ, atthi puññassa āgamo'ti.
commentary: (MNa) saccavajjenā'ti saccavacanena.

example_1: yāvajīvaṃ mātāpettibharo assaṃ, yāvajīvaṃ kule jeṭṭh'āpacāyī assaṃ, yāvajīvaṃ saṇhavāco assaṃ, yāvajīvaṃ apisuṇavāco assaṃ, yāvajīvaṃ vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvaseyyaṃ muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato, yāvajīvaṃ saccavāco assaṃ
apāṇ'ātipātaṃ nissāya pāṇ'ātipāto pahātabbo. dinn'ādānaṃ nissāya adinn'ādānaṃ pahātabbaṃ. saccavācaṃ nissāya musāvādo pahātabbo. apisuṇaṃ vācaṃ nissāya pisuṇā vācā pahātabbā.

meaning_1: attached to perception; stuck in concepts

meaning_1: perception; conception; recognition; third of the five aggregates

meaning_1: name; label; concept; idea; notion; impression; representation; symbol
example_1: tass'īdha diṭṭhe va sute mute vā, pakappitā n'atthi aṇū'pi saññā, taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ diṭṭhim'anādiyānaṃ, ken'īdha lokasmiṃ vikappayeyya.

meaning_1: classes of perception; categories of recognition
example_1: cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, saññākāyā, rūpasaññā, saddasaññā, gandhasaññā, rasasaññā, phoṭṭhabbasaññā, dhammasaññā. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, saññā.

meaning_1: aggregate of perception; mass of recognitions; third of the five aggregates

meaning_1: field of perception; conceived world; mentally constructed reality

example_2: so suññam'idaṃ saññāgataṃ gāmasaññāyā'ti pajānāti, suññam'idaṃ saññāgataṃ manussasaññāyā'ti pajānāti, atthi c'ev'idaṃ asuññataṃ yadidaṃ, araññasaññaṃ paṭicca ekattan'ti.
commentary: (MNa) tato tena maggena adhigantabbaṭṭhānaṃ vicinanto atthi uttari imassa saññāgatassa nissaraṇan'ti pajānāti, imassa mayā adhigatassa brahmavihārasaññāgatassa uttari nissaraṇaṃ nibbānaṃ atthī'ti evaṃ pajānātī'ti adhippāyo, ettāvatānena nirodhasaccavavatthānaṃ kataṃ hoti.

meaning_1: related to perception; concerning recognition; kind of perception; (comm) perception itself
example_1: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.

example_1: saññādhātu kho, gahapati, viññāṇassa oko. saññādhāturāgavinibandhañ'ca pana viññāṇaṃ, okasārī'ti vuccati.

example_1: vedanāpaññattiyā sati saññāpaññattiṃ paññāpessatī'ti, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati. saññāpaññattiyā sati vitakkapaññattiṃ paññāpessatī'ti, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati.

meaning_1: way of acquiring a perception; acquisition of conception
example_1: saññāpaṭilābhaṃ'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, duvidhena vadāmi, sevitabbam'pi, asevitabbam'pi, tañ'ca aññam'aññaṃ saññāpaṭilābhaṃ.

meaning_1: made of awareness; made of perception
example_1: arūpiṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, attānaṃ paccemi saññāmayan'ti. arūpī ca hi te, poṭṭhapāda, attā abhavissa saññāmayo, evaṃ santam'pi kho te, poṭṭhapāda, aññā'va saññā bhavissati añño attā.
example_2: ye pana te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, atthi sabbaso āruppā'ti, sace tesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati, ye te devā arūpino saññāmayā, apaṇṇakaṃ me tatr'ūpapatti bhavissati.
commentary: (MNa) saññāmayā'ti arūpajjhānasaññāya saññāmayā.

meaning_1: enjoying perception; taking pleasure in recognition

meaning_1: freed by the exhaustion of perception; liberated through the dissolution of conception

meaning_1: source of perception; arising of recognition
example_1: phassasamudayā saññāsamudayo, phassanirodhā saññānirodho.

meaning_1: (understanding of the) subtlety of perception; fineness of recognition
example_1: saññāsokhummena samannāgato hoti paramena, tena ca saññāsokhummena aññaṃ saññāsokhummaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā na samanupassati, tena ca saññāsokhummena aññaṃ saññāsokhummaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā na pattheti.
saññaṃ attato samanupassati, saññāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā saññaṃ, saññāya vā attānaṃ. ahaṃ saññā, mama saññā'ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.

meaning_1: end of perception and consciousness; disappearance of recognition and knowing
example_1: nandībhavaparikkhayā, saññāviññāṇasaṅkhayā, vedanānaṃ nirodhā upasamā, evaṃ khv'āhaṃ āvuso jānāmi sattānaṃ nimokkhaṃ pamokkhaṃ vivekan'ti.
tassa saññāvipariṇām'aññathābhāvā uppajjanti soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā.

meaning_1: deluded conception; distortion of perception; inversion of perception
example_1: anicce, bhikkhave, niccan'ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso. dukkhe, bhikkhave, sukhan'ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso.
commentary: (ANa) saññāvipallāsā'ti saññāya vipallatthabhāvā, catasso viparītasaññāyo'ti attho.

example_1: sabbesu kāmesu yo vītarāgo, ākiñcaññaṃ nissito hitvā m'aññaṃ, saññāvimokkhe parame'dhimutto, tiṭṭheyya so tattha anānuyāyī.
commentary: (NIDD2) saññāvimokkhe parame'dhimutto'ti saññāvimokkhā vuccanti satta saññāsamāpattiyo. tāsaṃ saññāsamāpattīnaṃ ākiñcaññ'āyatana-samāpatti-vimokkho aggo ca seṭṭho ca viseṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca, parame agge seṭṭhe viseṭṭhe pāmokkhe uttame pavare adhimuttivimokkhena adhimutto tatr'ādhimutto tadadhimutto taccarito tabbahulo taggaruko tanninno tappoṇo tappabbhāro tadadhimutto tadadhipateyyo'ti, saññāvimokkhe parame'dhimutto. (SNPa) saññāvimokkhe parame'ti sattasu saññāvimokkhesu uttame ākiñcaññ'āyatane.

meaning_1: non-liability due to not perceiving something as an offence
meaning_2: release from a disciplinary offense by not perceiving an action as an offense
example_1: tatrā'pi atthi saññāvimokkhaṃ, atthi nosaññāvimokkhaṃ. tattha yaṃ citt'aṅgaṃ labhati'y'eva, taṃ saññāvimokkhaṃ, itaraṃ nosaññāvimokkhaṃ.
commentary: (VINa) dukesu sacittakā āpatti saññāvimokkhā, acittakā nosaññāvimokkhā. (VINt) nappaṭinissajjāmī'ti saññāya abhāvena muccanato saññāvimokkhaṃ. (KVa) sabbāpattiyo ca saññāvasena duvidhā honti saññāvimokkhā nosaññāvimokkhā'ti. tattha yato vītikkamasaññāya abhāvena muccati, ayaṃ saññāvimokkhā, itarā nosaññāvimokkhā.

meaning_1: detached from perception; indifferent to concepts
example_1: saññāvirattassa na santi ganthā, paññāvimuttassa na santi mohā, saññañ'ca diṭṭhiñ'ca ye aggahesuṃ, te ghaṭṭayantā vicaranti loke'ti.

meaning_1: skilled in the expansion of perception
example_1: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ saññāvivaṭṭakusalānaṃ yadidaṃ mahāpanthako.
commentary: (ANt) sabbaso rūpasaññānan'ti-ādinā (dha. sa. 265) vuttasaññā atikkamitvā ākās'ānañc'āyatana-saññā-sahagataṃ… n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatana-saññāsahagatan'ti (dha. sa. 265-268) saññāsīsena vuttajjhānānaṃ vivaṭṭakusalo, tathā itthipuris'ādisaññā niccasaññ'ādito cittaṃ vivaṭṭetvā kevale rūp'ārūpadhammamatte asaṅkhate nibbāne ca visesato vaṭṭanato ca suññat'ānupassanābahulo saññāvivaṭṭakusalo.

meaning_1: due to the subsiding of perception
example_1: so evaṃ pajānāmi… saññāpaccayā'pi vedayitaṃ, saññāvūpasama-paccayā'pi vedayitaṃ
commentary: (SNa) saññāvūpasama-paccayā n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatana-vedanā.

example_1: te ca h'āvuso, āyusaṅkhārā abhaviṃsu te vedaniyā dhammā, na'y'idaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyetha.
commentary: (PMa) saññāvedayitanirodhan'ti saññāya vedanāya ca nirodhaṃ.

meaning_1: ending of recognition and feeling; cessation of conception and what is felt
example_1: te ca h'āvuso, āyusaṅkhārā abhaviṃsu te vedaniyā dhammā, na'y'idaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyetha.
example_2: idha mayaṃ, bhante, yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhāma sabbaso n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharāma, paññāya ca no disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā

meaning_1: state of the ending of recognition and feeling; element of cessation of conception and what is felt
example_1: evaṃ vutte, aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, yā c'āyaṃ, bhante, ābhādhātu yā ca subhadhātu yā ca ākās'ānañc'āyatanadhātu yā ca viññāṇ'añc'āyatanadhātu yā ca ākiñcaññ'āyatanadhātu yā ca n'evasaññ'ānāsaññ'āyatanadhātu yā ca saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu, imā nu kho, bhante, dhātuyo kiṃ paṭicca paññāyantī'ti?
commentary: (SNa) saññāvedayitanirodho'va saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu. iti bhagavā anusandhikusalassa bhikkhuno tattha nisīditvā pañhaṃ pucchitu'kāmassa okāsaṃ dento desanaṃ niṭṭhāpesi.

meaning_1: meditation attainment of cessation of conception and what is felt
example_1: tatiyassa jhānassa pīti kaṇṭako, catutthassa jhānassa assāsapassāso kaṇṭako, saññāvedayitanirodha-samāpattiyā saññā ca vedanā ca kaṇṭako, rāgo kaṇṭako doso kaṇṭako moho kaṇṭako.
example_2: na kho, gahapati, saññāvedayitanirodha-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhahantassa bhikkhuno evaṃ hoti, ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodha-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhahissan'ti vā ahaṃ saññāvedayitanirodha-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhahāmī'ti

meaning_1: (gram) desire to make a noun; change of identity

example_1: tato paraṃ sarīrassa abbhantare yakanasaññitaṃ yamakamaṃsapiṇḍaṃ vaṇṇato rattaṃ rattakumuda-bāhira-patta-piṭṭhi-vaṇṇan'ti vavatthapeti.

meaning_2: theory of percipience of self after death

example_1: tasmā't'iha, moggallāna, yathāsaññissa te viharato taṃ middhaṃ okkamati taṃ saññaṃ mā manas'ākāsi taṃ saññaṃ mā bahulam'akāsi
example_2: na saññasaññī na visaññasaññī, no'pi asaññī na vibhūtasaññī, evaṃ sametassa vibhoti rūpaṃ, saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā.

example_1: papañcasaññā itar'ītarā narā, papañcayantā upayanti saññino, manomayaṃ gehasitañ'ca sabbaṃ, panujja nekkhammasitaṃ irīyati.

ek'ūnapaññāsa ājīvakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa paribbājakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa nāg'āvāsasate, vīse indriyasate, tiṃse nirayasate, chattiṃsa rajodhātuyo, satta saññīgabbhā, satta asaññīgabbhā, satta nigaṇṭhigabbhā
commentary: (MNa) satta saññīgabbhā'ti oṭṭha-goṇa-gadrabh'āja-pasu-miga-mahiṃse sandhāya vadati.

example_1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyī āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca, saññī'm'eva nu kho, āvuso ānanda, tadāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedeti udāhu asaññī'ti? saññī'm'eva kho, āvuso, tadāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedeti, no asaññī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) saññī'm'eva nu kho'ti sacittako'y'eva nu kho. makāro padasandhimattaṃ.

example_1: apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhiyā katamehi catucattālīsāya ākārehi abhiniveso hoti? soḷasa saññīvādā, aṭṭha asaññīvādā, aṭṭha n'evasaññī-n'āsaññī-vādā, satta ucchedavādā, pañca diṭṭhadhammanibbānavādā, apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhiyā imehi catucattālīsāya ākārehi abhiniveso hoti.
example_2: uddham'āghātanikā'ti āghātanaṃ vuccati maraṇaṃ, uddham'āghātanā attānaṃ vadantī'ti uddham'āghātanikā. saññī'ti pavatto vādo, saññīvādo, so etesaṃ atthī'ti saññīvādā.
commentary: (PMa) saññiṃ vadantī'ti saññīvādā.

meaning_1: holding a doctrine of percipient (post-mortem existence)
meaning_2: holding the doctrine of percipient (post-mortem existence)
example_1: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā uddham'āghātanikā saññīvādā uddham'āghātanaṃ saññiṃ attānaṃ paññapenti soḷasahi vatthūhi.
commentary: (PMa) saññiṃ vadantī'ti saññīvādā.

example_1: so sukhañ'ce vedanaṃ vedayati, saññutto naṃ vedayati. dukkhañ'ce vedanaṃ vedayati, saññutto naṃ vedayati. adukkham'asukhañ'ce vedanaṃ vedayati, saññutto naṃ vedayati.
synonym: ābaddha, gathita, gadhita, naddha, baddha, sita
commentary: (SNa) saññutto naṃ vedayatī'ti kilesehi sampayutto'va hutvā taṃ vedanaṃ vedayati, na vippayutto. (SNa) saññutto dukkhasmā'ti karaṇ'atthe nissakkaṃ, dukkhena sampayutto'ti attho.

meaning_1: attached to perception; attracted to percepts; engaged with conception
example_1: vedan'upayaṃ… saññ'upayaṃ… saṅkhār'upayaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, saṅkhār'ārammaṇaṃ saṅkhārappatiṭṭhaṃ nand'ūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.

meaning_1: accumulation of recognition that is clung to; mass of recognized concepts that are grasped
example_1: katame c'āvuso, pañc'upādānakkhandhā? seyyath'idaṃ, rūp'upādānakkhandho, vedan'upādānakkhandho, saññ'upādānakkhandho, saṅkhār'upādānakkhandho, viññāṇ'upādānakkhandho.
example_2: kummo'ti kho, bhikkhu, pañcann'etaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, rūp'upādānakkhandhassa, vedan'upādānakkhandhassa, saññ'upādānakkhandhassa, saṅkhār'upādānakkhandhassa, viññāṇ'upādānakkhandhassa.

meaning_1: arising of perception; appearance of recognition
example_1: saññā kho, poṭṭhapāda, paṭhamaṃ uppajjati, pacchā ñāṇaṃ, saññ'uppādā ca pana ñāṇ'uppādo hoti. so evaṃ pajānāti, idappaccayā kira me ñāṇaṃ udapādī'ti.

meaning_1: accumulation of recognition that is clung to; mass of recognized concepts that are grasped
example_1: seyyath'īdaṃ rūp'ūpādānakkhandho, vedan'ūpādānakkhandho, saññ'ūpādānakkhandho, saṅkhār'ūpādānakkhandho, viññāṇ'ūpādānakkhandho

meaning_1: attached to perception; attracted to recognition; engaged with conception

meaning_1: fetter; chain; bond; thing which binds
example_1: pañca oram'bhāgiyāni saññojanāni, sakkāyadiṭṭhi, vicikicchā, sīlabbataparāmāso, kāmacchando, byāpādo.
commentary: (ADHa) saññojanānī'ti bandhanāni.

meaning_1: dregs; rubbish; worst part; waste product

example_2: saṭṭhivassasahassāni, paripuṇṇāni sabbaso, niraye paccamānānaṃ, kadā anto bhavissati.

commentary: (SNa) saṃkilesikadhamman'ti saṃkilesikasabhāvaṃ. (VISM) taṇhādiṭṭhi-duccarita-saṃkilesānaṃ visayadhammatāya saṃkilesikadhammato'ti evaṃ pabhedato vuttassa anicc'ādisammasanassa vasena sammasati.

example_1: so evaṃ vadeyya, na tāv'āhaṃ imaṃ sallaṃ āharissāmi yāva na taṃ jiyaṃ jānāmi yāy'amhi viddho, yadi vā akkassa yadi vā saṇṭhassa yadi vā nhārussa yadi vā maruvāya yadi vā khīrapaṇṇino'ti

example_1: na tāva, kassapa, saddhammassa antaradhānaṃ hoti yāva na saddhammappatirūpakaṃ loke uppajjati. yato ca kho, kassapa, saddhammappatirūpakaṃ loke uppajjati, atha saddhammassa antaradhānaṃ hoti.
commentary: (SNa) saddhammappatirūpakan'ti dve saddhammappatirūpakāni adhigama-saddhammappatirūpakañ'ca pariyatti-saddhammappatirūpakañ'ca. idaṃ vipassanāñāṇassa upakkilesajātaṃ adhigamasaddhammappatirūpakaṃ nāma. tisso pana saṅgītiyo anāruḷhaṃ dhātukathā ārammaṇakathā asubhakathā ñāṇavatthukathā vijjākaraṇḍako'ti imehi pañcahi kathāvatthūhi paribāhiraṃ guḷhavinayaṃ guḷhavessantaraṃ guḷhamahosadhaṃ vaṇṇapiṭakaṃ aṅgulimālapiṭakaṃ raṭṭhapālagajjitaṃ āḷavakagajjitaṃ vedallapiṭakan'ti abuddhavacanaṃ pariyatti-saddhamma-ppatirūpakaṃ nāma.

meaning_lit: discourse on the counterfeit of the good teaching

meaning_1: understanding the true teaching; comprehending the good doctrine
example_1: sabbhi'r'eva samāsetha, sabbhi kubbetha santhavaṃ, sataṃ saddhammam'aññāya, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo'ti.

meaning_1: persuasion to accept a true doctrine; convincing to follow a righteous teaching
example_1: santaṃ'y'eva kho pana paraṃ lokaṃ atthi paro loko'ti paraṃ saññāpeti, s'āssa hoti saddhammasaññatti. tāya ca pana saddhammasaññattiyā n'ev'attān'ukkaṃseti, na paraṃ vambheti.
commentary: (MNa) saddhammasaññattī'ti bhūtadhammasaññāpanā.

meaning_1: possessing good qualities; full of positive characteristics
example_1: sappuriso, bhikkhave, saddhammasamannāgato hoti, sappurisabhatti hoti, sappurisacintī hoti, sappurisamantī hoti, sappurisavāco hoti, sappurisakamm'anto hoti, sappurisadiṭṭhi hoti, sappurisadānaṃ deti.

meaning_1: hearing the true teaching; listening to the good doctrine
example_1: katamesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ? bhagavato ahaṃ, bhante, dassanassa atitto appaṭivāno kālaṅ'kato, saddhammasavanass'āhaṃ, bhante, atitto appaṭivāno kālaṅ'kato, saṅghass'āhaṃ, bhante, upaṭṭhānassa atitto appaṭivāno kālaṅ'kato. imesaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ atitto appaṭivāno kālaṅ'kato'ti.
commentary: (DNa) saddhammassavanan'ti sappāyassa tepiṭakadhammassa savanaṃ.

meaning_1: hearing the true teaching; listening to the good doctrine
example_1: kiccho manussapaṭilābho, kicchaṃ maccāna jīvitaṃ, kicchaṃ saddhammassavanaṃ, kiccho buddhānam'uppādo.
commentary: (DNa) saddhammassavanan'ti sappāyassa tepiṭakadhammassa savanaṃ.

example_1: taṃ dhammaṃ suṇāti gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aññatarasmiṃ vā kule paccājāto. so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhati.
asso yathā bhadro kasāniviṭṭho, ātāpino saṃvegino bhavātha, saddhāya sīlena ca vīriyena ca, samādhinā dhammavinicchayena ca, sampannavijjācaraṇā patissatā, jahissatha dukkham'idaṃ anappakaṃ.
example_2: saddhā bījaṃ tapo vuṭṭhi, paññā me yuganaṅgalaṃ, hirī īsā mano yottaṃ, sati me phālapācanaṃ.

example_1: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi saddhā, mayhaṃ'p'atthi saddhā, na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi vīriyaṃ, mayhaṃ'p'atthi vīriyaṃ
example_2: alam'eva saddhāpabbajitena kulaputtena vīriyaṃ ārabhituṃ
commentary: (MNa) saddhā'ti imāsaṃ sattannaṃ samāpattīnaṃ nibbattan'atthāya saddhā.

example_1: aniccā hi calā saddhā, evaṃ diṭṭhā hi sā mayā, rajjanti'pi virajjanti, tattha kiṃ jiyyate muni.
assaddhassa, bhikkhave, saddhākathā dukkathā, dussīlassa sīlakathā dukkathā, appassutassa bāhusaccakathā dukkathā, maccharissa cāgakathā dukkathā, duppaññassa paññākathā dukkathā.

meaning_1: a person in whom faith has arisen; who has great confidence
meaning_2: who's faith has arisen (for); who are confident (in)
example_1: idha, bhikkhave, saddhājāto upasaṅkamati, upasaṅkamanto payirupāsati, payirupāsanto sotaṃ odahati, ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti, sutvā dhammaṃ dhāreti, dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhati
commentary: (MNa) saddhājāto'ti okappaniyasaddhāya jātasaddho. (MNt) saddhā jātā etassā'ti saddhājāto, agyāhitātipakkhepena jāta-saddassa pacchāvacanaṃ. evametan'ti adhimuccanaṃ okappaniyasaddhā.

meaning_1: fit to be believed; should be trusted
example_1: ye'pi tava sotabbaṃ saddhātabbaṃ maññissanti, te'pi anayabyasanaṃ āpajjissanti, seyyathā'pi te satthikā.
commentary: (SNt) saddhāyiko'ti saddhāya ayitabbo, saddheyyo'ti attho. ten'āha saddhātabbo'ti.

meaning_1: with faith as one's companion; accompanied with confidence; full of faith
example_1: saḷ'eva phass'āyatanāni bhikkhavo, asaṃvuto yattha dukkhaṃ nigacchati, tesañ'ca ye saṃvaraṇaṃ avedisuṃ, saddhādutiyā viharant'ānavassutā.

meaning_1: offered with faith; (comm) in the results of actions
example_1: yathā vā pan'eke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ bījagāmabhūtagāmasamārambhaṃ anuyuttā viharanti
commentary: (DNa) saddhādeyyānī'ti kammañ'ca phalañ'ca idhalokañ'ca paralokañ'ca saddahitvā dinnāni. ayaṃ me ñātī'ti vā, mitto'ti vā, idaṃ paṭikarissati, idaṃ vā tena katapubban'ti vā, evaṃ na dinnānī'ti attho. evaṃ dinnāni hi na saddhādeyyāni nāma honti.

meaning_1: wealth that is confidence; treasure of faith
example_1: satt'imāni, bhikkhave, dhanāni. katamāni satta? saddhādhanaṃ, sīladhanaṃ, hirīdhanaṃ, ottappadhanaṃ, sutadhanaṃ, cāgadhanaṃ, paññādhanaṃ
commentary: (DNa) tattha sampattipaṭilābhaṭṭhena saddhā'va dhanaṃ saddhādhanaṃ.

meaning_1: firm in faith; unwavering in confidence
example_1: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ saddh'ādhimuttānaṃ yadidaṃ vakkalī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) saddh'ādhimuttānan'ti saddhāya adhimuttānaṃ, balavasaddhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vakkalitthero aggo'ti dasseti. aññesaṃ hi saddhā vaḍḍhetabbā hoti, therassa pana hāpetabbā jātā. tasmā so saddh'ādhimuttānaṃ aggo'ti vutto. vakkalī'ti pan'assa nāmaṃ.

meaning_1: who has attained the path of stream entry through faith
example_1: yo, bhikkhave, ime dhamme evaṃ saddahati adhimuccati, ayaṃ vuccati saddh'ānusārī, okkanto sammattaniyāmaṃ, sappurisabhūmiṃ okkanto, vītivatto puthujjanabhūmiṃ.
example_2: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ye te bhikkhū dhamm'ānusārino saddh'ānusārino, te'pi tiriyaṃ mārassa sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gamissanti.
commentary: (MNa) dhamm'ānusārino, saddh'ānusārino'ti ime dve paṭhamamaggasamaṅgino.

meaning_1: gaining of faith; acquiring of confidence
example_1: so tena saddhāpaṭilābhena samannāgato iti paṭisañcikkhiṃ, sambādho ghar'āvāso raj'āpatho, abbhokāso pabbajjā.

meaning_1: characteristics of confidence; manifestation of faith
example_1: kacci pan'āyaṃ, subhūti, saddho bhikkhu sudattassa upāsakassa putto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito sandissati saddh'āpadānesū'ti?
commentary: (ANa) saddh'āpadānesū'ti saddhānaṃ puggalānaṃ apadānesu lakkhaṇesu.

meaning_1: who ordained out of confidence; who went forth with faith
example_1: alam'eva saddhāpabbajitena kulaputtena vīriyaṃ ārabhituṃ
commentary: (SNa) saddhāpabbajitenā'ti saddhāya pabbajitena.

meaning_1: nurtured by faith; fortified by confidence; matured by faith
example_1: yassa kassaci, mahānāma, dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sīlaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sutaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ cāgaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ…

meaning_1: power that is confidence; strength of faith
example_1: puna caparaṃ, udāyi, akkhātā mayā sāvakānaṃ paṭipadā, yathāpaṭipannā me sāvakā pañca balāni bhāventi. idh'udāyi, bhikkhu saddhābalaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ
commentary: (ANa) saddhābal'ādīsu saddhā'y'eva akampiy'aṭṭhena balan'ti saddhābalaṃ.

meaning_lit: discourse on the strength of faith

meaning_1: measure of faith; degree of confidence
example_1: evaṃ svākkhāte, bhikkhave, mayā dhamme uttāne vivaṭe pakāsite chinnapilotike yesaṃ mayi saddhāmattaṃ pemamattaṃ sabbe te saggaparāyanā'ti.
example_2: tathāgate c'assa saddhāmattaṃ hoti pemamattaṃ, api c'assa ime dhammā honti
commentary: (MNa) yesaṃ mayi saddhāmattaṃ pemamattan'ti iminā yesaṃ añño ariyadhammo n'atthi, tathāgate pana saddhāmattaṃ pemamattam'eva hoti. te vipassakapuggalā adhippetā. vipassakabhikkhūnañ'hi evaṃ vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā nisinnānaṃ dasabale ekā saddhā ekaṃ pemaṃ uppajjati.

meaning_1: mere faith; simple faith; faith alone
example_1: siyā kho pana, bhante, idh'ekaccassa āyasmato evam'assa, kevalaṃ saddhāmattakaṃ nūna ayam'āyasmā nissāya nekkhamm'ādhimutto'ti.
example_2: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, na kho āḷāro kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī'ti pavedeti, addhā āḷāro kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharatī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) kevalaṃ saddhāmattakenā'ti paññāya asacchikatvā suddhena saddhāmattaken'eva.

meaning_1: trustworthy; in whom one has confidence
meaning_lit: in whom one places the heart
example_1: sā bhikkhuniṃ upagacchiṃ, yā me saddhāyikā ahu, sā me dhammam'adesesi, khandh'āyatanadhātuyo.
commentary: (THIa) sā bhikkhuniṃ upāgacchiṃ, yā me saddhāyikā ahū'ti yā mayā saddhātabbā saddheyyavacanā ahosi, taṃ bhikkhuniṃ s'āhaṃ upagacchiṃ upasaṅkamiṃ, paṭācārātheriṃ saddhāya vadati.

meaning_1: attainment of faith; achievement of confidence
example_1: yo ca kho, bhikkhave, mātāpitaro assaddhe saddhāsampadāya samādapeti niveseti patiṭṭhāpeti, dussīle sīlasampadāya samādapeti niveseti patiṭṭhāpeti, maccharī cāgasampadāya samādapeti niveseti patiṭṭhāpeti, duppaññe paññāsampadāya samādapeti niveseti patiṭṭhāpeti, ettāvatā kho, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ katañ'ca hoti paṭikatañcā'ti.

meaning_1: full of confidence; with good faith; having faith
example_1: idha, visākhe, mātugāmo saddhāsampanno hoti, sīlasampanno hoti, cāgasampanno hoti, paññāsampanno hoti.
example_2: kathañ'ca, visākhe, mātugāmo saddhāsampanno hoti? idha, visākhe, mātugāmo saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ

meaning_1: what is called the state of being full of faith
liberated through faith; attained through confidence; epithet of a stream-enterer or higher
family_set: epithets of stream entry; types of ariyas
example_1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, bhaddāli, api nu tvaṃ, bhaddāli, tasmiṃ samaye ubhatobhāgavimutto vā hosi paññāvimutto vā kāyasakkhi vā diṭṭhippatto vā saddhāvimutto vā dhamm'ānusārī vā saddh'ānusārī vā'ti?
example_2: katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo saddhāvimutto? idha ekacco puggalo ye te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe āruppā te na kāyena phusitvā viharati, paññāya c'assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhīṇā honti, tathāgate c'assa saddhā niviṭṭhā hoti mūlajātā patiṭṭhitā.
commentary: (MNa) saddhāvimutto'ti saddhāya vimutto. so'pi vuttanayen'eva chabbidho hoti. ten'ev'āha, idh'ekacco puggalo idaṃ dukkhan'ti, yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā'ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. tathāgatappaveditā c'assa dhammā paññāya vodiṭṭhā honti vocaritā… no ca kho yathā diṭṭhippattassa. ayaṃ vuccati puggalo saddhāvimutto'ti (pu. pa. 208).

meaning_1: growth in faith; increase in confidence
example_1: katamā tisso? saddhāvuddhi, sīlavuddhi, paññāvuddhi, imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso vuddhiyo'ti.

meaning_1: with faith as the trunk; having confidence as a trunk
example_1: sati ca sampajaññañ'ca, caraṇā nāgassa tepare, saddhāhattho mahānāgo, upekkhāsetadantavā.
commentary: (THa) anavajjadhammānaṃ ādāne saddhā hattho etassā'ti, saddhāhattho (ANa) saddhāhattho'ti saddhāmayāya soṇḍāya samannāgato.

meaning_1: power of faith; faculty of confidence
example_1: aparāni'pi pañc'indriyāni saddh'indriyaṃ vīriy'indriyaṃ sat'indriyaṃ samādh'indriyaṃ paññ'indriyaṃ
example_2: tassa cittaṃ rakkhato āsavesu ca sāsavesu ca dhammesu saddh'indriyam'pi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati. vīriyindriyam'pi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.
commentary: (ANa) saddh'indriyaṃ bhāvetī'ti-ādīsu saddhā'va attano saddhādhure ind'aṭṭhaṃ karotī'ti saddh'indriyaṃ.

meaning_1: ending of faith; cessation of the faculty of confidence
example_1: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā saddh'indriyaṃ nappajānanti, saddh'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, saddh'indriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, saddh'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti, vīriy'indriyaṃ nappajānanti …
commentary: (SNa) saddh'indriyaṃ nappajānantī'ti dukkhasaccavasena na pajānanti. saddh'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānantī'ti samudayasaccavasena na pajānanti. evaṃ nirodhaṃ nirodhasaccavasena, paṭipadaṃ maggasaccavasenā'ti. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: leading to the ending of faith; going to the cessation of the faculty of confidence
example_1: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā saddh'indriyaṃ nappajānanti, saddh'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, saddh'indriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, saddh'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti, vīriy'indriyaṃ nappajānanti …
commentary: (SNa) saddh'indriyaṃ nappajānantī'ti dukkhasaccavasena na pajānanti. saddh'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānantī'ti samudayasaccavasena na pajānanti. evaṃ nirodhaṃ nirodhasaccavasena, paṭipadaṃ maggasaccavasenā'ti. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: appearance of faith; arising of the faculty of confidence
example_1: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā saddh'indriyaṃ nappajānanti, saddh'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti, saddh'indriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti, saddh'indriyanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ nappajānanti, vīriy'indriyaṃ nappajānanti …
commentary: (SNa) saddh'indriyaṃ nappajānantī'ti dukkhasaccavasena na pajānanti. saddh'indriyasamudayaṃ nappajānantī'ti samudayasaccavasena na pajānanti. evaṃ nirodhaṃ nirodhasaccavasena, paṭipadaṃ maggasaccavasenā'ti. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo.

meaning_1: co-resident; who lives in the same monastery
commentary: (VINa) saddhivihārikaṃ paccakkhāmī'ti na vevacanena paccakkhānaṃ. y'āhaṃ pabbājesiṃ, y'āhaṃ upasampādesiṃ, mayhaṃ mūlena yo pabbajito, mayhaṃ mūlena yo upasampanno, mayhaṃmūlikā yassa pabbajjā, mayhaṃ mūlikā yassa upasampadā t'āhaṃ paccakkhāmī'ti evaṃ saddhivihārikavevacanena sikkhāpaccakkhānaṃ hoti.

example_1: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca, saddhivihāriko, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīn'āyāvatto'ti.

commentary: (VINa) saddhivihārikaṃ paccakkhāmī'ti na vevacanena paccakkhānaṃ. y'āhaṃ pabbājesiṃ, y'āhaṃ upasampādesiṃ, mayhaṃ mūlena yo pabbajito, mayhaṃ mūlena yo upasampanno, mayhaṃmūlikā yassa pabbajjā, mayhaṃ mūlikā yassa upasampadā t'āhaṃ paccakkhāmī'ti evaṃ saddhivihārikavevacanena sikkhāpaccakkhānaṃ hoti.

example_1: na paṭibalo hoti antevāsiṃ vā saddhivihāriṃ vā gilānaṃ upaṭṭhātuṃ vā upaṭṭhāpetuṃ vā, anabhirataṃ vūpakāsetuṃ vā vūpakāsāpetuṃ vā, uppannaṃ kukkuccaṃ dhammato vinodetuṃ āpattiṃ na jānāti, āpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ na jānāti
ekam'antaṃ nisinnā kho therā bhikkhū yāvatako ahosi sabbeh'eva saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesuṃ.
example_2: atha kho te bhikkhū yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu
commentary: (VIN 1.3.2) saddhin'ti ekato.

example_1: sace labhetha nipakaṃ sahāyaṃ, saddhiṃcaraṃ sādhuvihāridhīraṃ, abhibhuyya sabbāni parissayāni, careyya ten'attamano satīmā.
example_2: no ce labhetha nipakaṃ sahāyaṃ, saddhiṃcaraṃ sādhuvihāridhīraṃ, rājā'va raṭṭhaṃ vijitaṃ pahāya, eko care mātaṅg'araññ'eva nāgo.

example_1: saddh'īdha vittaṃ purisassa seṭṭhaṃ, dhammo suciṇṇo sukham'āvahati, saccaṃ have sādutaraṃ rasānaṃ, paññājīviṃ jīvitam'āhu seṭṭhan'ti.

iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.
tam'enaṃ saddheyyavacasā upāsikā disvā tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena vadeyya pārājikena vā saṅgh'ādisesena vā pācittiyena vā
commentary: (VINa) saddheyyavacasā'ti saddhātabbavacanā.

meaning_1: whose word can be trusted; believable; trustworthy; credible
example_1: tam'enaṃ saddheyyavacasā upāsikā disvā tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena vadeyya pārājikena vā saṅgh'ādisesena vā pācittiyena vā
commentary: (VIN 1.3.1) saddheyyavacasā nāma āgataphalā abhisametāvinī viññātasāsanā. (VINa) saddheyyavacasā'ti saddhātabbavacanā. sā pana yasmā ariyasāvikāva hoti, ten'assa padabhājane, āgataphalā'ti-ādi vuttaṃ.

example_1: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave dve agārā sadvārā.
