meaning_1: leaving behind all action; completely abandoning all intentional activity
example_1: sabbakammavihāyīnaṃ, panuṇṇaṃ ko nivāraye, nekkhaṃ jambonadass'eva, ko taṃ ninditum'arahati, devā'pi naṃ pasaṃsanti, brahmunā'pi pasaṃsito'ti.
commentary: (ANa) sabbakammavihāyīnan'ti sabbaṃ tebhūmakakammaṃ cajitvā paricchinnaṃ parivaṭumaṃ katvā ṭhitaṃ.

meaning_1: all sensual pleasure; all objects of sense desire
example_1: etam'ādīnaṃ ñatvā, bhaven'amhi anatthiko, nissaṭo sabbakāmehi, patto me āsavakkhayo'ti.
example_2: mahaddhane mahābhoge, aḍḍhe ajāyi'haṃ kule, sabbakāmehi sampanne, ratanehi ca sattahi.
commentary: (THa) nissaṭo sabbakāmehī'ti… mānusehi viya dibbehi'pi kāmehi nivattitacitto'smī'ti attho

meaning_1: all enjoyment of sensual pleasures; all sensual gratification
example_1: yadi ca jahati sabbakāmabhogaṃ, kathayati dhammakathaṃ jino janassa, vacanapaṭikarass'ābhippasannā, sutvāna dhamm'ānudhammam'ācarantī'ti.
alasv'assa anuṭṭhātā, na ca kiccāni kāraye, sabbakāmasamiddhassa, taṃ me sakka varaṃ disā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) sabbakāmasamiddh'assā'ti sabbakāmehi samiddho assa.

meaning_1: possessing all sensual pleasures; fulfilled in all desires
meaning_lit: with success in all sensual pleasures
example_1: tattha cittaṃ paṇidhehi, yattha te vusitaṃ pure, tāvatiṃsesu devesu, sabbakāmasamiddhisu, purakkhato parivuto, devakaññāhi sobhasī'ti.
commentary: (JAa) sabbakāmasamiddhisū'ti sabbesaṃ kāmānaṃ samiddhiyuttesu.

meaning_1: bringing all the objects of sense desire; giving all the sensual pleasures
example_1: yo naṃ bharati sabbadā, niccaṃ ātāpi ussuko, sabbakāmaharaṃ posaṃ, bhattāraṃ n'ātimaññati.
commentary: (ANa) sabbakāmaharan'ti sabbakāmadadaṃ.

example_1: apalokento kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo sabbakāyen'eva apaloketi, so na uddhaṃ ulloketi, na adho oloketi, na ca vipekkhamāno gacchati, yugamattañ'ca pekkhati, tato c'assa uttari anāvaṭaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ bhavati.
example_2: sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.

meaning_1: experiencing the whole body; conscious of the whole body; sensitive to the whole process
example_1: sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.
commentary: (PMa) sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī'ti sabbassa assāsapassāsakāyassa paṭisaṃvedī.

meaning_1: experiencing the whole body; sensitive to the whole physical process; (comm) experiencing the body of the in and out breath; experiencing the beginning middle and end of the breath
example_1: sabbakāyappaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, sabbakāyappaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati, passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.
commentary: (PMa) sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī'ti sabbassa assāsapassāsakāyassa paṭisaṃvedī. (VISM) sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmi… passasissāmī'ti sikkhatī'ti sakalassa assāsakāyassa ādimajjhapariyosānaṃ viditaṃ karonto pākaṭaṃ karonto assasissāmī'ti sikkhati.

example_1: 420, 471. māyoge sabbakāle ca.
example_2: hiyyattanīajjatanī'icc'etā vibhattiyo yadā māyogā, tadā sabbakāle ca honti. mā gamā, mā vacā, mā gamī, mā vacī.

meaning_1: at all times; all the time; always
example_1: suka-sāḷika-sadd'ettha, daṇḍamāṇavakāni ca, sobhati sabbakālaṃ sā, kuveranaḷinī sadā.
example_2: gūthañ'ca muttaṃ ruhirañ'ca pubbaṃ, paribhuñja tvaṃ asuciṃ sabbakālaṃ, etaṃ te paralokasmiṃ hotu, vatthā ca te kiṭakasamā bhavantu, etādisaṃ duccaritaṃ caritvā, idh'āgatā cirarattāya khādatī'ti.

meaning_1: everything to be done; all duties
example_1: govinde brāhmaṇe kālaṅ'kate rājā disampati paridevesi, yasmiṃ vata, bho, mayaṃ samaye govinde brāhmaṇe sabbakiccāni sammā vossajjitvā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricārema, tasmiṃ no samaye govindo brāhmaṇo kālaṅ'kato'ti.
bhāvehi maggaṃ amatassa pattiyā, niyyānikaṃ sabbadukhakkhay'ogadhaṃ, aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ sabbakilesasodhanaṃ, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
example_2: pamādassa samitattā santo, sabbakilesānaṃ samitattā santo, sabbaduccaritānaṃ samitattā santo

meaning_1: with all internal organs; with all internal parts
source of bondage to all planes of existence
example_1: khettāni viceyya kevalāni, dibbaṃ mānusakañ'ca brahmakhettaṃ, sabbakhettamūlabandhanā pamutto, khettajino tādi pavuccate tathattā.
commentary: (SNPa) yaṃ dibbaṃ dvādas'āyatanabhedaṃ tathā mānusakañ'ca, yañ'ca brahmakhettaṃ chaḷ'āyatane cakkh'āyatan'ādi-dvādas'āyatana-bhedaṃ, taṃ sabbam'pi vijeyya viceyya vā. yato yadetaṃ sabbesaṃ khettānaṃ mūlabandhanaṃ avijjābhavataṇh'ādi, tasmā sabbakhettamūlabandhanā pamutto.

example_1: n'atthi kiccaṃ brāhmaṇassa, katakicco hi brāhmaṇo, yāva na gādhaṃ labhati nadīsu, āyūhati sabbagattebhi jantu, gādhañ'ca laddhāna thale ṭhito yo, n'āyūhatī pāragato hi so'va.
gat'addhino visokassa, vippamuttassa sabbadhi, sabbaganthappahīnassa, pariḷāho na vijjati.

meaning_1: freeing from all bonds; liberating from all ties
example_1: das'uttaraṃ pavakkhāmi, dhammaṃ nibbānapattiyā, dukkhass'antakiriyāya, sabbaganthappamocanaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) sabbaganthappamocanan'ti abhijjhākāyaganth'ādīnaṃ sabbaganthānaṃ pamocanaṃ.

meaning_1: freed from all bonds; liberated from all ties
example_1: sa ve sabb'ābhibhū dhīro, sabbaganthappamocano, phuṭṭhassa paramā santi, nibbānaṃ akutobhayaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) sabbaganthappamocano'ti sabbe cattāro'pi ganthe mocetvā ṭhito.

meaning_1: eliminated all ties; abandoned all bonds
example_1: sabbaganthappahīnassa, vippamuttassa te sato, samaṇassa na taṃ sādhu, yadaññam'anusāsasī'ti.
example_2: gat'addhino visokassa, vippamuttassa sabbadhi, sabbaganthappahīnassa, pariḷāho na vijjati.
commentary: (DHPa) sabbaganthappahīnassā'ti catunnam'pi ganthānaṃ pahīnattā sabbāganthappahīnassa.

meaning_1: all the fragrant substances; all the perfumes
meaning_2: all the fragrant substances; all the perfumes
example_1: eten'upāyena pañcahi yugasatehi rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ veṭhetvā āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjitvā sabbagandhānaṃ citakaṃ karitvā rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ jhāpenti.

meaning_1: all of the perfumed water; all the scented water
meaning_2: all the perfumed water; all the scented water
example_1: kosinārakā'pi mallā sabbagandh'odakena bhagavato citakaṃ nibbāpesuṃ.

vajasatajeṭṭhako vā usabho, vajasahassajeṭṭhako vasabho. sabbagavaseṭṭho sabbaparissayasaho seto pāsādiko mahābhāravaho asanisatasaddehi'pi akampaniyo nisabho, so idha usabho'ti adhippeto. idam'pi hi tassa pariyāyavacanaṃ.

meaning_1: who has severed all bonds to the household life; who has cut all ties to lay-life
example_1: yaṃ gihissa'pi tadatthajotakaṃ, pabbajjam'pi ca tad'ādhigacchati, khajjabhojjarasalābhi'r'uttamaṃ, āhu sabbagihibandhanacchidan'ti.

meaning_1: all parts; all factors; all aspects
meaning_2: all parts; all factors; all aspects
example_1: evaṃ sabb'aṅgasampannaṃ, muniṃ dukkhassa pāraguṃ, anek'ākārasampannaṃ, payirupāsanti gotaman'ti.
commentary: (SNa) evaṃ sabb'aṅgasampannan'ti evaṃ sabbaguṇasampannaṃ.

example_1: yaṃ me atthi kataṃ puññaṃ, arahantesu tādisu, taṃ me sabb'aṅgakalyāṇi, tayā saddhiṃ vipaccataṃ.
example_2: daddallamānā yasasā yasassinī, nāvāya ca tvaṃ avalamba tiṭṭhasi, āḷārapamhe hasite piyaṃvade, sabb'aṅgakalyāṇi bhusaṃ virocasi.
commentary: (VVa) sabb'aṅgakalyāṇī'ti n'ātidīghā n'ātirassā n'ātikisā n'ātithūlā n'ātikāḷī n'āccodātā atikkantā mānusavaṇṇaṃ appattā dibbavaṇṇan'ti evaṃ vuttehi sabbehi aṅgehi kāraṇehi, sabbehi vā aṅgapaccaṅgehi kalyāṇī sobhanā sundarā. (PVa) sabb'aṅgakalyāṇī'ti sabbehi aṅgehi sundare, sobhana-sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgī'ti attho.

meaning_1: with all parts; including all features
meaning_lit: having all major and minor limbs
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rajako vā cittakārako vā sati rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā suparimaṭṭhe vā phalake bhittiyā vā dussapaṭṭe vā itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgaṃ.

meaning_1: with all parts; including all features
meaning_lit: having all major and minor limbs
construction:
sabba + aṅga + paccaṅga + ī
sabbaṅgapaccaṅga + ī
example_1: saññā nu kho, manomayaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, attānaṃ paccemi sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ahīn'indriyan'ti.
example_2: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rajako vā cittakārako vā rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā suparimaṭṭhe phalake vā bhittiyā vā dussapaṭṭe vā itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ.
commentary: (DNa) sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgī'ti sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgayutto.

meaning_1: endowed with all (the good) qualities; possessing all the factors
example_1: evaṃ sabb'aṅgasampannaṃ, muniṃ dukkhassa pāraguṃ, anek'ākārasampannaṃ, payirupāsanti gotaman'ti.
commentary: (SNa) sabb'aṅgasampannan'ti evaṃ sabbaguṇasampannaṃ.

meaning_1: whole mind; whole heart; all intention
example_1: te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi katvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti
example_2: balatā esā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa yaṃ tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne aṭṭhiṃkatvā manasikatvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti.
commentary: (MNa) sabbacetasā samannāharitvā'ti appamattakam'pi vikkhepaṃ akaronto sakalacittena samannāharitvā.
notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

meaning_1: all clothes; everything one is wearing
example_1: te tadah'uposathe sāvakaṃ evaṃ samādapenti, ehi tvaṃ, ambho purisa, sabbacelāni nikkhipitvā evaṃ vadehi, n'āhaṃ kvacani kassaci kiñcanat'asmiṃ, na ca mama kvacani katthaci kiñcanat'atthī'ti.
seyyā nāma sabbacchannā, sabbaparicchannā, yebhuyyenacchannā, yebhuyyena paricchannā.
commentary: (VINa) tasmā yaṃ sen'āsanaṃ upari pañcahi chadanehi aññena vā kenaci sabbam'eva paṭicchannaṃ, ayaṃ sabbacchannā nāma seyyā

example_1: atha kho, ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imāsu pokkharaṇīsu evarūpaṃ mālaṃ ropāpeyyaṃ uppalaṃ padumaṃ kumudaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ sabb'otukaṃ sabbajanassa anāvaṭan'ti.

meaning_1: victor over all; universal conqueror; master of existence
example_1: idha kho taṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammā vadamāno vadeyya, idaṃ jātu vedagū, idaṃ jātu sabbajī, idaṃ jātu apalikhataṃ gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhaṇin'ti
example_2: yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu channaṃ phass'āyatanānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādāvimutto hoti, evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabbajī hoti.
commentary: (SNa) sabbajī'ti ek'aṃsena sabbavaṭṭaṃ jinitvā abhibhavitvā ṭhito'smī'ti vadati.

meaning_1: leaving everything behind; giving up everything; abandoning all
example_1: sabb'ābhibhū sabbavidū'ham'asmi, sabbesu dhammesu anūpalitto, sabbañ'jaho taṇhakkhaye vimutto, sayaṃ abhiññāya kam'uddiseyyaṃ.
example_2: sabb'ābhibhuṃ sabbaviduṃ sumedhaṃ, sabbesu dhammesu anūpalittaṃ, sabbañ'jahaṃ taṇhākkhaye vimuttaṃ, tam'ahaṃ naraṃ ekavihārī'ti brūmī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) sabbaṃ jaho'ti sabbaṃ tebhūmakadhammaṃ jahitvā ṭhito.

example_1: vimokkh'antikam'etaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ bodhiyā mūle saha sabbaññutaññāṇassa paṭilābhā sacchikā paññatti yadidaṃ bhagavā'ti, metteyyā'ti bhagavā.
example_2: katamaṃ tathāgatassa sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ? sabbaṃ saṅkhatam'asaṅkhataṃ anavasesaṃ jānātī'ti, sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ.
commentary: (PM) katamaṃ tathāgatassa sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ? sabbaṃ saṅkhatamasaṅkhataṃ anavasesaṃ jānātī'ti, sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ. tattha āvaraṇaṃ n'atthī'ti, anāvaraṇañāṇaṃ.

example_1: kiṃ me ekena tiṇṇena, purisena thāmadassinā, sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇitvā, santāressaṃ sadevakaṃ.

meaning_1: omniscient; all knowing; with complete understanding
example_1: pūraṇo, bho gotama, kassapo sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti, carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitan'ti.
example_2: kathaṃ carahi sabbaññū, vanditabbā tathāgatā, kathaṃ avandiyā buddhā, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.

meaning_1: omniscient one; who is all knowing; who understands everything; epithet of the Buddha
example_1: sabbaññū sabbadassāvī, jino ācariyo mama, mahākāruṇiko satthā, sabbalokatikicchako.
example_2: kathaṃ carahi sabbaññū, vanditabbā tathāgatā, kathaṃ avandiyā buddhā, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.

example_1: evaṃ virattaṃ khem'attaṃ, sabbasaṃyojan'ātigaṃ, anvesaṃ sabbaṭṭhānesu, mārasenā'pi n'ājjhagā'ti.

meaning_1: all states of being; (or) all points of view
example_1: pajjotakaro ativijjha, sabbaṭṭhitīnaṃ atikkamam'addasa, ñatvā ca sacchikatvā ca, aggaṃ so desayi das'addhānaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) sabbaṭṭhitīnan'ti sabbesaṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhānānaṃ viññāṇaṭṭhitīnaṃ vā.

grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of sabba
example_1: yato yato mano nivāraye, na dukkham'eti naṃ tato tato, sa sabbato mano nivāraye, sa sabbato dukkhā pamuccati.
example_2: na sabbato mano nivāraye, na mano saṃyatattam'āgataṃ, yato yato ca pāpakaṃ, tato tato mano nivāraye'ti.

grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of sabba
meaning_1: in every direction; from all sides; in every way
meaning_2: from every side, in every respect
example_1: viññāṇaṃ anidassanaṃ, anantaṃ sabbatopabhaṃ, ettha āpo ca pathavī, tejo vāyo na gādhati.

grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of sabba
meaning_1: as everything; from everything; apart from everything
example_1: sabbaṃ kho ahaṃ, brahme, sabbato abhiññāya yāvatā sabbassa sabbattena ananubhūtaṃ tadabhiññāya sabbaṃ n'āp'ahosiṃ sabbasmiṃ n'āp'ahosiṃ sabbato n'āp'ahosiṃ sabbaṃ me'ti n'āp'ahosiṃ, sabbaṃ n'ābhivadiṃ.
504, 470. sabbato uṃ iṃsu.

meaning_1: radiant in every direction; luminous all around; (comm) able to be crossed from anywhere
example_1: viññāṇaṃ anidassanaṃ, anantaṃ sabbatopabhaṃ, ettha āpo ca pathavī, tejo vāyo na gādhati.
commentary: (DNa) pabhan'ti pan'etaṃ kira titthassa nāmaṃ, tañ'hi papan'ti etthā'ti papaṃ, pakārassa pana bhakāro kato. sabbato pabham'assā'ti sabbatopabhaṃ. nibbānassa kira yathā mahāsamuddassa yato yato otaritu'kāmā honti, taṃ tadeva titthaṃ, atitthaṃ nāma n'atthi. evam'eva aṭṭhatiṃsāya kammaṭṭhānesu yena yena mukhena nibbānaṃ otaritu'kāmā honti, taṃ tadeva titthaṃ, nibbānassa atitthaṃ nāma n'atthi. tena vuttaṃ sabbatopabhan'ti.

example_1: sabbaṃ kho ahaṃ, brahme, sabbato abhiññāya yāvatā sabbassa sabbattena ananubhūtaṃ tadabhiññāya sabbaṃ n'āp'ahosiṃ sabbasmiṃ n'āp'ahosiṃ sabbato n'āp'ahosiṃ sabbaṃ me'ti n'āp'ahosiṃ, sabbaṃ n'ābhivadiṃ.

meaning_1: to all beings; encompassing all living beings
example_1: iti uddham'adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabb'attatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
commentary: (PMa) sabb'attatāyā'ti sabbesu hīna-majjhim'ukkaṭṭha-mitta-sapatta-majjhatt'ādi-ppabhedesu attatāya, ayaṃ parasatto'ti vibhāgaṃ akatvā attasamatāyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. atha vā sabb'attatāyā'ti sabbena cittabhāvena, īsakam'pi bahi avikkhipamāno'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

example_1: dullabho puris'ājañño, na so sabbattha jāyati, yattha so jāyati dhīro, taṃ kulaṃ sukham'edhati.
example_2: sabbattha munī anissito, na piyaṃ kubbati no'pi appiyaṃ, tasmiṃ paridevamaccharaṃ, paṇṇe vāri yathā na limpati.

meaning_1: in every way; in every respect; entirely
example_1: āvilacitto anāvilaṃ, sarajo vītarajaṃ anaṅgaṇaṃ, sabbattha vimuttamānasaṃ, kiṃ maṃ ovariyāna tiṭṭhasi.

meaning_1: (gram) in all cases; in all instances
example_1: 506, 496. sabbatth'āsass'ādilopo ca.
example_2: sabbattha vibhattipaccayesu asa'icc'etassa dhātussa ādissa lopo hoti vā. siyā, santi, sante, samāno. vā'ti kim'atthaṃ? asi.

grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of sabbatthaka
construction:
sabba + ttha + ka + aṃ
sabbatthaka + aṃ
example_1: snehaparetā'ti udakasinehena parigatā. santarabāhirā'ti saddhiṃ antopadesena c'eva bahipadesena ca, sabbatthakam'eva udakasinehena phuṭā'ti attho.
commentary: (MNt) sabbatthakam'evā'ti sabbatth'eva.

meaning_1: understanding of the paths of practice which lead to all destinations
path of practice leading to all destinations
example_1: imesañ'ca pan'āhaṃ, āvuso, catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā sabbatthagāminippaṭipadaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāmī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) sabbatthagāminin'ti sabbagatigāminiṃ agatigāminiñ'ca. paṭipadan'ti maggaṃ.

meaning_1: going everywhere; leading to all destinations
example_1: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato sabbatthagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
commentary: (ANa) sabbatthagāminin'ti sabbagatigāminiñ'ca agatigāminiñ'ca.

meaning_1: undefeated everywhere; unconquered in every respect
example_1: etādisāni katvāna, sabbattha'm'aparājitā, sabbattha sotthiṃ gacchanti, taṃ tesaṃ maṅgalam'uttaman'ti.
example_2: atthi sakyakule jāto, buddho appaṭipuggalo, sabb'ābhibhū māranudo, sabbattha'm'aparājito.
commentary: (SNa) sabbattha'm'aparājito'ti sabbesu rāg'ādīsu vā mārayuddhe vā ajito.

meaning_1: always useful; always beneficial; ever advantageous
example_1: satiñ'ca khv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sabb'atthikaṃ vadāmī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) satiñ'ca khv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sabb'atthikaṃ vadāmī'ti loṇadhūpanaṃ viya sabbakammik'āmaccaṃ viya ca sabbattha icchitabbaṃ vadāmī'ti attho. yathā hi loṇadhūpanaṃ sabbabyañjanesupi nivisati, yathā ca sabbakammiko amacco yodhakammam'pi karoti mantakammam'pi paṭihārakammam'pī'ti sabbakiccāni sādheti, evaṃ uddhatassa cittassa niggaṇhanaṃ, līnassa paggaṇhananti sabbam'etaṃ satiyā ijjhati, na sakkā vinā satiyā etaṃ sampādetuṃ, tasmā evam'āha. imasmiṃ sutte pubbabhāgavipassanā bojjhaṅgāva kathitā.

meaning_1: in every way; in every case
example_1: yo c'āvuso hetu yo ca paccayo cakkhuviññāṇassa uppādāya so ca hetu so ca paccayo sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ aparisesā nirujjheyya, api nū kho cakkhuviññāṇaṃ paññāyethā'ti?
example_2: evaṃ sabbathā'pi karuṇāyitvā vuttanayen'eva attani piyapuggale majjhatte verimhī'ti catūsu janesu sīmāsambhedaṃ katvā

example_1: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho gopakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca, atthi nu kho, bho ānanda, ekabhikkhu'pi tehi dhammehi sabbenasabbaṃ sabbathāsabbaṃ samannāgato yehi dhammehi samannāgato so bhavaṃ gotamo ahosi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho'ti?
commentary: (MNa) sabbathā sabban'ti sabbakoṭṭhāsehi sabbaṃ.

example_1: kiṃdado balado hoti, kiṃdado hoti vaṇṇado, kiṃdado sukhado hoti, kiṃdado hoti cakkhudo, ko ca sabbadado hoti, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito'ti.
example_2: so ca sabbadado hoti, yo dadāti upassayaṃ, amataṃ dado ca so hoti, yo dhammam'anusāsatī'ti.

meaning_1: all stress, fatigue and discomfort; all anxiety, weariness and distress
example_1: tam'enaṃ passeyya aparena samayena taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā nhāyitvā ca pivitvā ca sabba-daratha-kilamatha-pariḷāhaṃ paṭippassambhetvā paccuttaritvā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe nisinnaṃ vā nipannaṃ vā, ek'antasukhā vedanā vedayamānaṃ.
sabbaññū sabbadassāvī, jino ācariyo mama, mahākāruṇiko satthā, sabbalokatikicchako.
example_2: pūraṇo, bho gotama, kassapo sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti, carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitan'ti.
commentary: (THa) ten'eva samantacakkhunā sabbassa dassanato sabbadassāvī.

example_1: kiṃ kayirā udapānena, āpā ce sabbadā siyuṃ, taṇhāya mūlato chetvā, kissa pariyesanaṃ care'ti.
example_2: bālasaṅgatacārī hi, dīgham'addhāna socati, dukkho bālehi saṃvāso, amitten'eva sabbadā, dhīro ca sukhasaṃvāso, ñātīnaṃ'va samāgamo.

meaning_1: all suffering; all pain; all stress; all discomfort
example_1: evamesā kasī kaṭṭhā, sā hoti amatapphalā, etaṃ kasiṃ kasitvāna, sabbadukkhā pamuccatī'ti.
example_2: sabbadānaṃ dhammadānaṃ jināti, sabbarasaṃ dhammaraso jināti, sabbaratiṃ dhammarati jināti, taṇhakkhayo sabbadukkhaṃ jināti.
commentary: (SNa) sabbadukkhā pamuccatī'ti, na kevalaṃ seyyo'va hoti, na ca kevalaṃ paññaṃ labhati, sokamajjhe na socati, ñātimajjhe virocati, sugatiyaṃ nibbattati, ciraṃ sukhaṃ tiṭṭhati, sakalasmā pana vaṭṭadukkhā'pi muccatī'ti.

meaning_1: wearing away of all suffering; extinction of all stress; termination of all tension
example_1: tasmā evaṃ samannāgato bhikkhu iminā paramena paññ'ādhiṭṭhānena samannāgato hoti. esā hi, bhikkhu, paramā ariyā paññā yadidaṃ, sabbadukkhakkhaye ñāṇaṃ.
commentary: (MNa) sabbadukkhakkhaye ñāṇaṃ nāma arahattamagge ñāṇaṃ, imasmiṃ pana sutte arahattaphale ñāṇaṃ adhippetaṃ.

meaning_1: for the sake of the complete extinction of all suffering

example_1: na'y'idaṃ sithilam'ārabbha, na'y'idaṃ appena thāmasā, nibbānaṃ adhigantabbaṃ, sabbadukkhappamocanaṃ.

meaning_1: giving up all suffering; letting go of all discomfort; abandoning of all pain
example_1: eso hi bhagavā buddho, nadiṃ nerañjaraṃ pati, sabbadukkhappahānāya, dhammaṃ deseti pāṇinaṃ, tass'āhaṃ santikaṃ gacchaṃ, so me satthā bhavissati.

meaning_1: surpassed all suffering; transcended all discomfort
example_1: atthi nu kho, bhante, taṃ cakkhu, yena cakkhunā atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivaṭṭe paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya
commentary: (MNa) sabbadukkhavītivatte'ti sabbaṃ vipākavaṭṭasaṅkhātaṃ dukkhaṃ vītivatte.

meaning_1: surpassed all suffering; transcended all discomfort
example_1: yatra hi nāma tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātito'pi anussarissati
commentary: (MNa) sabbadukkhavītivatte'ti sabbaṃ vipākavaṭṭasaṅkhātaṃ dukkhaṃ vītivatte.

meaning_1: which dispels all suffering; which drives out all dissatisfaction
example_1: aṅgīrasassa nam'atthu, sakyaputtassa sirīmato, yo imaṃ dhammaṃ desesi, sabbadukkh'āpanūdanaṃ.

meaning_1: all fear of bad destinations; all danger of hell; (comm) fear of all human misfortune
example_1: imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sabbaduggatibhayaṃ samatikkanto hotī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) sabbaduggatibhayaṃ samatikkanto'ti manussadobhaggaṃ paṭikkhittaṃ.

meaning_1: all fear of bad destinations and states of suffering; all danger of hell and the lower realms; (comm) all fear of human misfortune and the four hells
example_1: imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sabbaduggativinipātabhayaṃ samatikkanto hotī'ti.
commentary: (SNa) sabbaduggativinipātabhayaṃ samatikkanto'ti manussadobhaggena saddhiṃ cattāro apāyā paṭikkhittā.

meaning_1: all the doors; i.e. body, speech and mind
everything; all things; all mental phenomena; all states of mind; all teachings
example_1: kāmesu n'ābhigijjheyya, manas'ānāvilo siyā, kusalo sabbadhammānaṃ, sato bhikkhu paribbaje'ti.
example_2: jhāyiṃ virajam'āsīnaṃ, katakiccaṃ anāsavaṃ, pāraguṃ sabbadhammānaṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, aññāvimokkhaṃ pabrūhi, avijjāya pabhedanaṃ.
commentary: (ANa) pāragū sabbadhammānan'ti sabbadhammā vuccanti pañcakkhandhā dvādas'āyatanāni aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo, tesaṃ sabbadhammānaṃ abhiññāpāraṃ, pariññāpāraṃ, pahānapāraṃ, bhāvanāpāraṃ, sacchikiriyāpāraṃ, samāpattipārañ'cā'ti chabbidhaṃ pāraṃ gatattā pāragū.

meaning_1: discourse of the root cause of all things
example_1: sabbadhammamūlapariyāyaṃ vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi. taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
commentary: (MNa) sabbadhammamūlapariyāyan'ti sabbesaṃ dhammānaṃ mūlapariyāyaṃ… sabbesaṃ dhammānaṃ kāraṇadesanan'ti vā evaṃ attho daṭṭhabbo.

grammar: masc pl, comp, gen pl of sabbadhammā, irreg form of sabbadhammānaṃ
meaning_1: of everything; of all things; of all mental phenomena; of all states of mind
construction:
sabba + dhammā + ānaṃ
sabbadhammā + āna(ṃ) > sabbadhammāna
example_1: yaṃ manussā namassanti, sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ, devā'pi taṃ namassanti, iti me arahato sutaṃ.
example_2: aññātam'etaṃ vacanaṃ, asitassa yathātathaṃ, taṃ taṃ gotama pucchāmi, sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ.
commentary: (ANa) sabbadhammānapāragun'ti sabbesaṃ khandh'āyatanadhātudhammānaṃ abhiññāpāragū, pariññāpāragū, pahānapāragū, bhāvanāpāragū, sacchikiriyāpāragū, samāpattipāragū'ti chabbidhena pāragamanena pāragataṃ pārappattaṃ matthakappattaṃ.

meaning_1: (gram) belonging to the 'all roots' class of verbal endings; having verbal endings of four tenses (i.e. aorist, imperative, optative and present)
example_1: 431, 458. hiyyattanī sattamī pañcamī vattamānā sabbadhātukaṃ.
example_2: hiyyattan'ādayo catasso vibhattiyo sabbadhātukasaññā honti. agamā, gaccheyya, gacchatu, gacchati.

meaning_1: everywhere; in every way; in all respects
example_1: gat'addhino visokassa, vippamuttassa sabbadhi, sabbaganthappahīnassa, pariḷāho na vijjati.
example_2: iti uddham'adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabb'attatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā viharati.

example_1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahako tasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe sabbanavako hoti. atha kho āyasmā mahako āyasmantaṃ theraṃ etadavoca, sādhu khv'assa, bhante thera, sītako ca vāto vāyeyya, abbhasampilāpo ca assa, devo ca ekam'ekaṃ phusāyeyyā'ti.
commentary: (PYt) sabbanavakassā'ti sabbesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ navakassa.

example_1: evaṃ liṅga, sabbanāma, pada, upasagga, nipāta, taddhita, ākhyāta, kammappavacanīy'ādisaññā ca.

meaning_1: all objects; all signs; all mental images
example_1: siyā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā… bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṅ'kāra-mamaṅ'kāra-mān'ānusayā n'āssu
example_2: kati pan'āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā ṭhitiyā'ti? tayo kho, āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā ṭhitiyā, sabbanimittānañ'ca amanasikāro, animittāya ca dhātuyā manasikāro, pubbe ca abhisaṅkhāro.
commentary: (MNa) sabbanimittānan'ti rūp'ādīnaṃ sabb'ārammaṇānaṃ. (ANa) sabbanimittesū'ti rūpanimittaṃ, saddanimittaṃ, gandhanimittaṃ, rasanimittaṃ, phoṭṭhabbanimittaṃ, sassatādinimittaṃ, puggalanimittaṃ dhammanimittan'ti evarūpesu ca bahiddhā sabbanimittesu.

meaning_1: letting go of everything; giving up everything; epithet of Nibbāna
example_1: n'āññatra bojjhā tapasā, n'āññatr'indriyasaṃvarā, n'āññatra sabbanissaggā, sotthiṃ passāmi pāṇinan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) sabbanissaggā'ti nibbānato.

example_1: ye sabbanihīnaṃ kāyaṃ paripūrenti, te gandhabbakāyaṃ paripūrentī'ti.

example_1: sabbapaṭhamaṃ tāva kiñci'd'eva karuṇāyitabbarūpaṃ… hatthapādehi paggharantakimigaṇaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karontaṃ disvā, kicchaṃ vat'āyaṃ satto āpanno, app'eva nāma imamhā dukkhā mucceyyā'ti karuṇā pavattetabbā.

meaning_1: all proponents of other belief systems

seyyā nāma sabbacchannā, sabbaparicchannā, yebhuyyenacchannā, yebhuyyena paricchannā.

meaning_1: overcoming all dangers; surmounting all difficulties
example_1: vajasatajeṭṭhako vā usabho, vajasahassajeṭṭhako vasabho. sabbagavaseṭṭho sabbaparissayasaho seto pāsādiko mahābhāravaho asanisatasaddehi'pi akampaniyo nisabho, so idha usabho'ti adhippeto. idam'pi hi tassa pariyāyavacanaṃ.

meaning_1: who only uses items from the rubbish
commentary: (VINa) catūsu paccayesu antamaso dantakaṭṭham'pi sabbaṃ paṃsukūlam'eva assā'ti sabbapaṃsukūliko.

meaning_1: compassionate for the well-being of all breathing beings
example_1: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati, sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī, byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti
example_2: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇ'ātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato ahosiṃ nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho, lajjī day'āpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī vihāsiṃ.

sabba + pāṇa + bhūta + ā
sabbapāṇabhūta + ā

meaning_1: all evil deeds; all wrongdoing; all unwholesome action
meaning_2: all evil deed; all crimes; all wrongdoing

example_2: virato idha sabbapāpakehi, nirayadukkhaṃ aticca vīriyavā so, so vīriyavā padhānavā, dhīro tādi pavuccate tathattā.

meaning_1: meal for followers of all religions

commentary: (VMVt) sabbapāsehī'ti sabbakilesapāsehi. ye dibbā ye ca mānusā'ti ye dibbakāmaguṇanissitā, mānusakakāmaguṇanissitā ca kilesapāsā nāma atthi, sabbehi tehi.

meaning_1: giving up everything; abandoning the whole lot
example_1: katamo ca, bhikkhave, sabbappahānāya dhammo? cakkhuṃ, bhikkhave, pahātabbaṃ, rūpā pahātabbā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ pahātabbaṃ, cakkhusamphasso pahātabbo
commentary: (SNa) sabbappahānāyā'ti sabbassa pahānāya.

meaning_1: who has given up everything; who has abandoned all; (comm) who has given up all evil
example_1: taṃ ve tamonudaṃ dhīraṃ, tevijjaṃ maccuhāyinaṃ, hitaṃ devamanussānaṃ, āhu sabbappahāyinaṃ.
example_2: yassa rāgo ca doso ca, avijjā ca virājitā, taṃ bhāvitatt'aññataraṃ, brahmabhūtaṃ tathāgataṃ, buddhaṃ verabhay'ātītaṃ, āhu sabbappahāyinan'ti.
commentary: (ANa) sabbappahāyinan'ti sabbe pāpadhamme pajahitvā ṭhitaṃ.

meaning_1: in full flower; in full blossom
example_1: ramaṇīyaṃ, āvuso ānanda, gosiṅgasālavanaṃ, dosinā ratti, sabbaphāliphullā sālā, dibbā, maññe, gandhā sampavanti, kathaṃrūpena, āvuso ānanda, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti?
example_2: sabbaphāliphullā kho, ānanda, yamakasālā akālapupphehi. te tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti tathāgatassa pūjāya.
commentary: (MNa) sabbapāliphullā'ti sabbattha pāliphullā, mūlato paṭṭhāya yāva aggā apupphitaṭṭhānaṃ nāma n'atthi.

meaning_1: free from all bonds; liberated from all ties
example_1: cittasmiṃ vasībhūt'āmhi, iddhipādā subhāvitā, sabbabandhanamutta-amhi, na taṃ bhāyāmi āvuso'ti.

meaning_1: most foolish; most stupid of all
meaning_2: most foolish; most stupid of all
example_1: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi, ayañ'ca imesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ sabbabālo sabbamūḷho. kathañ'hi nāma sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno vikkhepaṃ byākarissatī'ti.

meaning_1: all states of existence; all forms of existence
example_1: ārammaṇe taṃ balasā nibandhisaṃ, nāgaṃ'va thambhamhi daḷhāya rajjuyā, taṃ me suguttaṃ satiyā subhāvitaṃ, anissitaṃ sabbabhavesu hehisi.
example_2: kadā nu'haṃ pabbatakandarāsu, ekākiyo addutiyo vihassaṃ, aniccato sabbabhavaṃ vipassaṃ, taṃ me idaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

meaning_1: all states of existence; all forms of existence
example_1: ye etadaññāya padaṃ asaṅkhataṃ, vimuttacittā bhavanettisaṅkhayā, te dhammasār'ādhigamā khaye ratā, pahaṃsu te sabbabhavāni tādino'ti.
suddhassa ve sadā phaggu, suddhass'uposatho sadā, suddhassa sucikammassa, sadā sampajjate vataṃ, idh'eva sināhi brāhmaṇa, sabbabhūtesu karohi khemataṃ.
example_2: tathāgatassa buddhassa, sabbabhūt'ānukampino, tass'accayā na vijjanti, tassa n'atthi apāgataṃ, so na sammoham'āpādi, so'va dhīro sadā sato'ti.
commentary: (SNPa) sabbesu bhūtesu sabbabhūtesu.

meaning_1: compassionate for all beings; sympathetic to all living beings
example_1: na mandiyā sayāmi n'āpi kāveyyamatto, atthaṃ samecc'āham'apetasoko, eko vivitte sayan'āsanamhi, sayām'ahaṃ sabbabhūt'ānukampī.
example_2: tathāgatassa buddhassa, sabbabhūt'ānukampino, tass'accayā na vijjanti, tassa n'atthi apāgataṃ, so na sammoham'āpādi, so'va dhīro sadā sato'ti.

example_1: yadattanī passati ānisaṃsaṃ, diṭṭhe sute sīlavate mute vā, tadeva so tattha samuggahāya, nihīnato passati sabbam'aññaṃ.
commentary: (NIDD1) nihīnato passati sabbam'aññan'ti. aññaṃ satthāraṃ dhamm'akkhānaṃ gaṇaṃ diṭṭhiṃ paṭipadaṃ maggaṃ hīnato nihīnato omakato lāmakato chatukkato parittato dissati passati dakkhati oloketi nijjhāyati upaparikkhatī'ti, nihīnato passati sabbam'aññaṃ.

meaning_1: all conception; all imagination; all make-believe; every idea; all illusion
example_1: sabbamaññitānaṃ tv'eva, bhikkhu, samatikkamā muni santo'ti vuccati. muni kho pana, bhikkhu, santo na jāyati, na jīyati, na mīyati, na kuppati, na piheti.
example_2: sabbamaññita-samugghāta-sāruppaṃ vo, bhikkhave, paṭipadaṃ desessāmi.
commentary: (MNa) sabbamaññitānan'ti sabbesaṃ tiṇṇam'pi taṇhā-diṭṭhi-māna-maññitānaṃ.

meaning_1: suitable for eradicating all conception; supportive for exterminating all imagination
example_1: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, n'āparaṃ itthattāyā'ti pajānāti. ayaṃ kho sā, bhikkhave, sabbamaññita-samugghāta-sappāyā paṭipadā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) samugghātasappāyā'ti samugghātassa upakārabhūtā.

meaning_1: suitable for eradicating all conception; fit for exterminating all imagination
example_1: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, n'āparaṃ itthattāyā'ti pajānāti. ayaṃ kho sā, bhikkhave, sabbamaññita-samugghāta-sāruppā paṭipadā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) sabbamaññita-samugghāta-sāruppan'ti sabbesaṃ taṇhā-māna-diṭṭhi-maññitānaṃ samugghātāya anucchavikaṃ.
(VINa) sabbamattikāmayan'ti piṭṭha-saṅghāṭaka-kavāṭa-sūcighaṭika-vātapāna-kavāṭamattaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ bhitti-chadan'iṭṭhaka-thambh'ādi-bhedaṃ sabbaṃ gehasambhāraṃ mattikāmayam'eva katvā'ti attho.

example_1: kiṃ nu kho, bho, gotama, sabbam'atthī'ti? sabbam'atthī'ti kho, brāhmaṇa, ayam'eko anto.

meaning_1: all churning thought; all mental disturbance
example_1: tasmā tathāgato sabbamaññitānaṃ sabbamathitānaṃ sabba-ahaṃkāra-mamaṃkāra-mān'ānusayānaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā anupādā vimutto'ti vadāmī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) sabbamaññitānan'ti sabbesaṃ tiṇṇam'pi taṇhā-diṭṭhi-māna-maññitānaṃ. mathitānan'ti tesaṃ'y'eva vevacanaṃ.

meaning_1: all day and all night; all the time
example_1: yassa sabbam'ahorattaṃ, ahiṃsāya rato mano, mettaṃ so sabbabhūtesu, veraṃ tassa na kenacī'ti.

meaning_1: throughout the day and night; continuously; all the time
example_1: divā tapati ādicco, rattim'ābhāti candimā, sannaddho khattiyo tapati, jhāyī tapati brāhmaṇo, atha sabbam'ahorattiṃ, buddho tapati tejasā'ti.
kassapassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa sabbamitto nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi agg'upaṭṭhāko.

meaning_1: all of this; all of these
example_1: ahañ'c'amhi adhammiko, yo'haṃ itthiyā kāraṇā rañño ambaṃ avaharāmi. sabbam'idaṃ carimaṃ katan'ti tatth'eva paripati.

meaning_1: as soon as all this was said; no sooner than all this was done
example_1: ahañ'c'amhi adhammiko, yo'haṃ itthiyā kāraṇā rañño ambaṃ avaharāmi. sabbam'idaṃ carimaṃ katan'ti tatth'eva paripati.

meaning_1: based on all items; rooted in all things
most deluded; most confused of all
meaning_2: most deluded; most confused of all
example_1: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi, ayañ'ca imesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ sabbabālo sabbamūḷho. kathañ'hi nāma sandiṭṭhikaṃ sāmaññaphalaṃ puṭṭho samāno vikkhepaṃ byākarissatī'ti.

meaning_1: all of this; all of these
example_1: yañ'ca padaṃ, yañ'ca anupadaṃ, yañ'ca anvakkharaṃ, yañ'ca anubyañjanaṃ, sabbam'etaṃ padaso nāma.
sabbam'p'idaṃ hāyatu ca jīratu ca bhijjatu ca deha-nissitaṃ

meaning_1: all bonds; every tie; all attachments
example_1: puññaṃ vata pasavi bahuṃ, sappañño vat'āyaṃ upāsako, yo cīrāya adāsi cīvaraṃ, sabbayogehi vippamuttiyā'ti.

meaning_1: detached from all ties; free from all attachment
example_1: hitvā mānusakaṃ yogaṃ, dibbaṃ yogaṃ upaccagā, sabbayogavisaṃyuttaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
example_2: diṭṭhiyogaṃ samūhacca, avijjañ'ca virājayaṃ, sabbayogavisaṃyuttā, te ve yog'ātigā munī'ti.
commentary: (MNa) sabbayogavisaṃyuttan'ti sabbakilesayogavisaṃyuttaṃ. (THIa) sabbayogavisaṃyuttā'ti sabbehi kāmayog'ādīhi yogehi vimuttā tato eva anāsavā hutvā loke cara, diṭṭhasukhavihārena viharāhī'ti attho.

meaning_1: made of all jewels; made of all gems
meaning_2: made of all jewels; made of all gems
example_1: sabbaratanamayassa tālassa sabbaratanamayo khandho ahosi, sabbaratanamayāni pattāni ca phalāni ca.
commentary: (DNa) sabbaratanamayo'ti ettha ekā iṭṭhakā sovaṇṇamayā, ekā rūpiyamayā, ekā veḷuriyamayā, ekā phalikamayā, ekā lohit'aṅkamayā, ekā masāragallamayā, ekā sabbaratanamayā, ayaṃ pākāro sabbapākārānaṃ anto ubbedhena saṭṭhihattho ahosi.

meaning_1: all night long; lasting the whole night
construction:
sabba + ratti + ka + aṃ
sabbarattika + aṃ

tena kho pana samayena vesāliyaṃ vajjiputtako sabbaratticāro hoti. atha kho so bhikkhu vesāliyā tūriya-tāḷita-vādita-nigghosasaddaṃ sutvā paridevamāno tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi
commentary: (SNa) sabbaratticāro'ti kattikanakkhattaṃ ghosetvā sakalanagaraṃ dhajapaṭāk'ādīhi paṭimaṇḍetvā pavattito sabbaratticāro.

meaning_1: shining the whole night; shining all through the night
example_1: bhūmiṃ gato bhūmigato, sabbarattiṃ sobhaṇo sabbarattisobhaṇo. apāyaṃ gato apāyagato, issarena kataṃ issarakataṃ, sallena viddho sallaviddho, kathinassa dussaṃ kathinadussaṃ

grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of sabbaratti
meaning_1: whole night; all through the night

commentary: (THa) sabbarattin'ti sakalaṃ rattiṃ.

example_1: sabbadānaṃ dhammadānaṃ jināti, sabbarasaṃ dhammaraso jināti, sabbaratiṃ dhammarati jināti, taṇhakkhayo sabbadukkhaṃ jināti.
commentary: (DHPa) sabbe pana gandharas'ādayo'pi rasā ukkaṃsato devatānaṃ sudhābhojanaraso'pi saṃsāravaṭṭe pātetvā dukkh'ānubhavanass'eva paccayo. yo pan'esa sattatiṃsa-bodhipakkhiyadhamma-saṅkhāto ca navalok'uttaradhamma-saṅkhāto ca dhammaraso, ayam'eva sabbarasānaṃ seṭṭho. tena vuttaṃ, sabbarasaṃ dhammaraso jinātī'ti.

meaning_1: rid of all greed hatred and delusion, with all impurities removed
sanskrit: sarva + rāga + dveṣa + moha + nihita + nirṇīta + kaṣāya
family_compound: sabba rāga dosa1 moha nihita ninnīta kasāya
example_1: so hoti bhikkhu khamo sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-sarīsapa-samphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ, uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsakajātiko hoti sabba-rāga-dosa-moha-nihita-ninnītakasāvo āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.

meaning_1: detached from all desire; with all passion faded
example_1: sabbarāgavirattassa, taṇhakkhayavimuttino, esanā paṭinissaṭṭhā, diṭṭhiṭṭhānā samūhatā.
commentary: (ITIa) sabbarāgavirattassā'ti sabbehi kāmarāga-bhavarāgehi virattassa.

example_1: anuvicca papañcanāmarūpaṃ, ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca rogamūlaṃ, sabbarogamūlabandhanā pamutto, anuvidito tādi pavuccate tath'attā.
commentary: (SNPa) tam'eva vā papañcaṃ anuvicca tāya bhāvanāya sabbesaṃ rogānaṃ mūlabandhanā, sabbasmā vā rogānaṃ mūlabandhanā, avijjā-bhavataṇh'ādi-bhedā

meaning_1: lightest of all; least severe; very least; minimum
commentary: (ANa) sabbalahuso'ti sabbalahuko.

meaning_1: whole world; entire universe; all the world; every world
example_1: sabbasaṅkhārā ca me anavatthitā khāyissanti, sabbaloke ca me mano n'ābhiramissati, sabbalokā ca me mano vuṭṭhahissati
example_2: tasmā pajānaṃ na upādiyetha, bhikkhu sato kiñcanaṃ sabbaloke, ādānasatte iti pekkhamāno, pajaṃ imaṃ maccudheyye visattan'ti.
commentary: (NIDD2) sabbaloke'ti sabbaapāyaloke sabbamanussaloke sabbadevaloke sabbakhandhaloke sabbadhātuloke sabbaāyatanaloke'ti, bhikkhu sato kiñcanaṃ sabbaloke.

meaning_1: conquering the whole world; mastering the entire universe
example_1: pabbajam'pi ca anomanikkamo, aggataṃ vajati sabbapāṇinaṃ, tena uttaritaro na vijjati, sabbalokam'abhibhuyya viharatī'ti.

meaning_1: benefit of the whole world; welfare of the whole world
example_1: so n'eva attabyābādhāya ceteti, na parabyābādhāya ceteti, na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti, attahita-parahita-ubhayahita-sabbalokahitam'eva so bhavaṃ gotamo cintento nisinno hoti.
example_2: idha, bhikkhu, paṇḍito mahāpañño n'ev'attabyābādhāya ceteti na parabyābādhāya ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti attahitaparahitaubhayahitasabbalokahitam'eva cintayamāno cinteti

meaning_1: supreme power over the whole world; rulership over the entire universe
example_1: pathabyā ekarajjena, saggassa gamanena vā, sabbalok'ādhipaccena, sot'āpattiphalaṃ varaṃ.

meaning_1: conqueror of the whole world; master of the entire universe
example_1: hitvā ratiñ'ca aratiṃ, sītībhūtaṃ nirūpadhiṃ, sabbalok'ābhibhuṃ vīraṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

meaning_1: recognition of disenchantment with the entire world; perception of non-delight in the whole world
example_1: pañc'imā, bhikkhave, saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mah'ānisaṃsā amat'ogadhā amatapariyosānā. katamā pañca? asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, ādīnavasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā.
example_2: idh'ānanda, bhikkhu ye loke upādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayā, te pajahanto viharati anupādiyanto. ayaṃ vuccat'ānanda, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā.
commentary: (ANa) sabbaloke anabhiratisaññā'ti sabbasmiṃ tedhātusannivese loke ukkaṇṭhitassa uppajjanakasaññā.

meaning_1: recognition of disenchantment with the entire world; perception of non-delight in everything
example_1: katame nava dhammā uppādetabbā? nava saññā, asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, āhārepaṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke-anabhiratisaññā, aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā. ime nava dhammā uppādetabbā.
commentary: (DNa) sabbaloke-anabhiratisaññā'ti sabbasmiṃ vaṭṭe ukkaṇṭhantassa uppannasaññā.

meaning_1: all activities; all processes; all conditions; all fabrications; all formations
example_1: sabbasaṅkhārā ca me anavatthitā khāyissanti, sabbaloke ca me mano n'ābhiramissati, sabbalokā ca me mano vuṭṭhahissati
example_2: etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānan'ti

meaning_1: stilling of all processes; calming of all activities
example_1: etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, dukkhaṃ saṅkhārapaccayā, sabbasaṅkhārasamathā, saññānaṃ uparodhanā, evaṃ dukkhakkhayo hoti, etaṃ ñatvā yathātathaṃ.
example_2: avijjāya tv'eva tamokāyassa asesavirāganirodho, santam'etaṃ padaṃ paṇītam'etaṃ padaṃ, yadidaṃ, sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
commentary: (SNPa) sabbasaṅkhārasamathā'ti sabbesaṃ vuttappakārānaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ maggañāṇena samathā, upahatatāya phalasamatthatāyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (ANa) yasmā pana taṃ āgamma sabbe saṅkhārā samathaṃ gacchanti, tasmā sabbasaṅkhārasamatho'ti vuttaṃ.

meaning_1: due to the stilling of all processes, etc.; due to calming all activities, etc.
observing the impermanence of all formations; watching the instability of all conditions
example_1: etha, tumhe, bhikkhave, asubh'ānupassino kāye viharatha, āhāre paṭikūlasaññino, sabbaloke anabhiratisaññino, sabbasaṅkhāresu anicc'ānupassino'ti.
commentary: (ANa) sabbasaṅkhāresu anicc'ānupassī'ti sabbe'pi tebhūmakasaṅkhāre aniccato anupassanto.

meaning_1: who has overcome all attachment; who has surpassed all snares
example_1: yo iddhiyā sarabhuṃ aṭṭhapesi, so gavampati asito anejo, taṃ sabbasaṅg'ātigataṃ mahāmuniṃ, devā namassanti bhavassa pāragun'ti.
commentary: (THa) sabbasaṅg'ātigataṃ tādisaṃ sabbe'pi rāga-dosa-moha-māna-diṭṭhi-saṅge atikkamitvā ṭhitattā sabbasaṅg'ātigataṃ

meaning_1: with the whole collection of sayings
example_1: satthā ca no loke udapādi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, dhammo ca svākkhāto suppavedito niyyāniko upasamasaṃvattaniko sammāsambuddhappavedito, aviññāpit'atthā c'amha saddhamme, na ca no kevalaṃ paripūraṃ brahmacariyaṃ āvikataṃ hoti uttānīkataṃ sabbasaṅgāhapadakataṃ sappāṭihīrakataṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) sabbasaṅgāhapadakatan'ti sabbasaṅgahapadehi kataṃ, sabbasaṅgāhikaṃ kataṃ na hotī'ti attho. sabbasaṅgāhapadagatan'ti'pi pāṭho, na sabbasaṅgāhapadesu gataṃ, na ekasaṅgahajātan'ti attho.

example_1: evaṃ yāva sabbasatā cattāri cattāri katvā sabbacatukkaṃ nāma assa dāpesi.
diṭṭhā vā y'eva addiṭṭhā, ye ca dūre vasanti avidūre, bhūtā vā sambhavesī vā, sabbasattā bhavantu sukhit'attā.
example_2: kathañ'ca bhikkhu karuṇāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati? seyyathā'pi nāma ekaṃ puggalaṃ duggataṃ durūpetaṃ disvā karuṇāyeyya, evam'eva sabbasatte karuṇāya pharatī'ti

example_1: upasaṅkamitvā sabbasantharitaṃ satthataṃ āvasath'āgāraṃ santharitvā āsanāni paññapetvā udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā telapadīpaṃ āropetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu
commentary: (DNa) sabbasantharin'ti yathā sabbaṃ santhataṃ hoti, evaṃ santhariṃ.

example_1: ekam'antaṃ ṭhitā kho pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ, sabbasantharisanthataṃ, bhante, āvasath'āgāraṃ, āsanāni paññattāni, udakamaṇiko patiṭṭhāpito, telapadīpo āropito, yassa'dāni, bhante, bhagavā kālaṃ maññatī'ti.

grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of sabbasanthari
meaning_1: covered completely; spread all over; completely decked out
example_1: upasaṅkamitvā sabbasanthariṃ santh'āgāraṃ santharitvā āsanāni paññapetvā udakamaṇikaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā telappadīpaṃ āropetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.

example_1: buddho samāno kiṃ labhati? aparihānadhammo hoti, na parihāyati saddhāya sīlena sutena cāgena paññāya, na parihāyati sabbasampattiyā. buddho samāno idaṃ labhati.
example_2: sīlam'ev'idha sikkhetha, asmiṃ loke susikkhitaṃ, sīlaṃ hi sabbasampattiṃ, upanāmeti sevitaṃ.
commentary: (THa) yasmā sīlaṃ sevitaṃ paricitaṃ rakkhitaṃ manussasampatti, dibbasampatti, nibbānasampattī'ti etaṃ sabbasampattiṃ taṃsamaṅgino sattassa upanāmeti āvahati.

meaning_1: all the crops; the entire harvest
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse sabbasassesu gām'antasambhatesu gopālako gāvo rakkheyya, tassa rukkhamūlagatassa vā abbhokāsagatassa vā satikaraṇīyam'eva hoti, etā gāvo'ti. evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, satikaraṇīyam'eva ahosi, ete dhammā'ti.

meaning_1: all the crops; the entire harvest; all kinds of crops
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gimhānaṃ pacchime māse sabbasassesu gām'antasambhatesu gopālako gāvo rakkheyya, tassa rukkhamūlagatassa vā abbhokāsagatassa vā satikaraṇīyam'eva hoti, etā gāvo'ti.

meaning_1: all bonds; all ties; all attachment
example_1: āguṃ na karoti kiñci loke, sabbasaṃyoge visajja bandhanāni, sabbattha na sajjatī vimutto, nāgo tādi pavuccate tathattā'ti.
example_2: jaheyya sabbasaṃyogaṃ, kareyya saraṇ'attano, careyy'ādittasīso'va, patthayaṃ accutaṃ padan'ti.
commentary: (SNa) sabbasaṃyogan'ti sabbaṃ dasavidham'pi saṃyojanaṃ.

meaning_1: which make one an ascetic; which should be done by an ascetic

commentary: (MNa) ye dhammā samaṇakaraṇā ca brāhmaṇakaraṇā cā'ti ye dhammā samādāya paripūritā samitapāpasamaṇañ'ca bāhitapāpabrāhmaṇañ'ca karontī'ti attho… ettha pana samaṇena kattabbadhammā vuttā. te'pi ca samaṇakaraṇā honti'y'eva. idha pana hir'ottapp'ādi-vasena desanā vitthāritā.

meaning_1: ascetic duty; something which should be done by a monk

commentary: (ANa) samaṇakaraṇīyānī'ti samaṇena kattabbakiccāni.

meaning_1: dregs of an ascetic; waste material of an renunciant
example_1: imesaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, samaṇamalānaṃ samaṇadosānaṃ samaṇakasaṭānaṃ āpāyikānaṃ ṭhānānaṃ duggativedaniyānaṃ appahānā na samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno'ti vadāmi.

(VINa) samaṇakuttako'ti samaṇavesadhārako. so kira sikhāmattaṃ ṭhapetvā sīsaṃ muṇḍetvā ekaṃ kāsāvaṃ nivāsetvā ekaṃ aṃse katvā vihāraṃ'y'eva upanissāya vighāsādabhāvena jīvati.

meaning_1: respect for ascetics; reverence for monks

meaning_1: component of an ascetic; part of a monk's requisites; (comm) the four assemblies

commentary: (DNa) samaṇaṅgānī'ti samaṇānaṃ koṭṭhāsabhūtā catasso parisā.
(VVt) samaṇacīvaran'ti kappakataṃ nivāsanapārupan'upagaṃ.

example_1: kathañ'ca, visākhe, nigaṇṭh'uposatho hoti? atthi, visākhe, nigaṇṭhā nāma samaṇajātikā.
commentary: (ANa) samaṇajātikā'ti samaṇā'y'eva.

meaning_1: monastic suffering; unpleasantness for an ascetic

meaning_1: fault of an ascetic; defect of an renunciant
example_1: imesaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, samaṇamalānaṃ samaṇadosānaṃ samaṇakasaṭānaṃ āpāyikānaṃ ṭhānānaṃ duggativedaniyānaṃ appahānā na samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno'ti vadāmi.
commentary: (MNa) etehi samaṇā dussanti, padussanti, tasmā samaṇadosā'ti vuccanti.

example_1: app'eva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan'ti bhikkhubhāvā cāveyyaṃ, samaṇadhammā cāveyyaṃ, sīlakkhandhā cāveyyaṃ, tapoguṇā cāveyyaṃ.

meaning_1: claiming to be a monk; pretending to be a monastic
example_1: addasā kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ dussīlaṃ pāpadhammaṃ asuciṃ saṅkassarasamācāraṃ paṭicchannakamm'antaṃ asamaṇaṃ samaṇapaṭiññaṃ abrahmacāriṃ brahmacāripaṭiññaṃ antopūtiṃ avassutaṃ kasambujātaṃ majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinnaṃ

(ANa) assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño'ti assamaṇo hutvā'va samaṇapatirūpakatāya samaṇo ahan'ti evaṃ paṭiñño. (UDa) salākaggahaṇ'ādīsu kittakā samaṇā'ti ca gaṇanāya aham'pi samaṇo'mhī'ti micchāpaṭiññāya samaṇapaṭiññaṃ.

example_1: tesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, evaṃsamaññānaṃ sataṃ evaṃpaṭiññānaṃ sataṃ, yā samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadā taṃ paṭipajjissāma, evaṃ no ayaṃ amhākaṃ samaññā ca saccā bhavissati paṭiññā ca bhūtā
commentary: (MNa) samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadā'ti samaṇānaṃ anucchavikā samaṇānaṃ anulomappaṭipadā.

meaning_1: suitable for an ascetic; appropriate for a monastic
example_1: rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ vā, na bodhāya na santiyā, n'etaṃ samaṇasāruppaṃ, na etaṃ ariyaddhanaṃ.
commentary: (THIa) n'etaṃ samaṇasāruppan'ti etaṃ jātarūpa-rajat'ādi-pariggaha-vatthu, tassa vā pariggaṇhanaṃ samaṇānaṃ sāruppaṃ na hoti. tathā hi vuttaṃ na kappati samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ jātarūparajatan'ti-ādi (cūḷava. 446).

example_1: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti itar'ītarena cīvarena, santuṭṭho hoti itar'ītarena piṇḍapātena, santuṭṭho hoti itar'ītarena sen'āsanena, santuṭṭho hoti itar'ītarena gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārena, abhirato ca brahmacariyaṃ carati. imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca samaṇasukhānī'ti.

meaning_1: refined ascetic; epithet of an arahant
family_set: epithets of arahants; types of ariyas
example_1: apare'pi cattāro puggalā, samaṇam'acalo, samaṇapadumo, samaṇapuṇḍarīko, samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo.
commentary: (DNa) arahā pana sabbesam'pi ganthakārakilesānaṃ abhāvā samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo nāma. ten'āha, katamo ca puggalo samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo? idh'ekacco āsavānaṃ khayā… viharati. ayaṃ vuccati puggalo samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo'ti.

example_1: disvāna bhāradvājagottaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca, kassa nv'ayaṃ bhoto bhāradvājassa agy'āgāre tiṇasanthārako paññatto, samaṇaseyy'ānurūpaṃ maññe'ti?
commentary: (MNa) samaṇaseyy'ānurūpaṃ maññe'ti imaṃ tiṇasanthārakaṃ samaṇassa anucchavikā seyyā'ti maññāmi.

example_1: disvāna bhāradvājagottaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca, kassa nv'ayaṃ bhoto bhāradvājassa agy'āgāre tiṇasanthārako paññatto, samaṇaseyyārūpaṃ maññe'ti?
commentary: (MNa) samaṇaseyy'ānurūpaṃ maññe'ti imaṃ tiṇasanthārakaṃ samaṇassa anucchavikā seyyā'ti maññāmi. na ca asaññatasamaṇassa nivutthaṭṭhānametaṃ. tathāhettha hatthena ākaḍḍhitaṭṭhānaṃ vā pādena ākaḍḍhitaṭṭhānaṃ vā sīsena pahaṭaṭṭhānaṃ vā na paññāyati, anākulo anākiṇṇo abhinno chekena cittakārena tūlikāya paricchinditvā paññatto viya. saññatasamaṇassa vasitaṭṭhānaṃ, kassa bho vasitaṭṭhānanti pucchati.

meaning_1: on account of an ascetic's teaching
example_1: yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno rajanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ na rajjati vītarāgattā, dosanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ na dussati vītadosattā, mohanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ na muyhati vītamohattā, madanīyesu dhammesu cittaṃ na majjati vītamadattā, so na chambhati na kampati na vedhati na santāsaṃ āpajjati, na ca pana samaṇavacanahetu'pi gacchatī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) na ca pana samaṇavacanahetu'pi gacchatī'ti samaṇānaṃ paravādīnaṃ vacanahetu'pi attano diṭṭhiṃ pahāya tesaṃ diṭṭhivasena na gacchatī'ti attho. idhā'pi khīṇ'āsavo'va adhippeto.

example_1: iti karaṇīy'ākaraṇīye kho pana saccato thetato anupalabbhiyamāne muṭṭhassatīnaṃ anārakkhānaṃ viharataṃ na hoti paccattaṃ sahadhammiko samaṇavādo.
commentary: (ANa) na hoti paccattaṃ sahadhammiko samaṇavādo'ti evaṃ bhūtānaṃ tumhākaṃ vā aññesaṃ vā mayaṃ samaṇā'ti paccattaṃ sakāraṇo samaṇavādo na hoti na ijjhati. samaṇā'pi hi pubbekatakāraṇā'y'eva honti, assamaṇā'pi pubbekatakāraṇā'y'evā'ti.

meaning_1: suitable for an ascetic; fit for a monk
example_1: buddho samāno kiṃ labhati? yāni tāni samaṇ'ārahāni samaṇ'aṅgāni samaṇ'ūpabhogāni samaṇ'ānucchavikāni, tāni khippaṃ paṭilabhati. buddho samāno idaṃ labhati.
commentary: (DNa) samaṇ'ānucchavikānī'ti tesaṃ'y'eva adhivacanaṃ.

meaning_1: worthy of an ascetic; fit for a monk
example_1: buddho samāno kiṃ labhati? yāni tāni samaṇ'ārahāni samaṇ'aṅgāni samaṇ'ūpabhogāni samaṇ'ānucchavikāni, tāni khippaṃ paṭilabhati.
commentary: (DNa) samaṇ'ārahānī'ti samaṇānaṃ anurūpāni cīvar'ādīni.

meaning_1: belonging to an ascetic; part of a monk
example_1: katamāni tīṇi? adhisīlasikkhāsamādānaṃ, adhicittasikkhāsamādānaṃ, adhipaññāsikkhāsamādānaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi samaṇassa samaṇiyāni samaṇakaraṇīyāni.
commentary: (ANa) samaṇiyānī'ti samaṇasantakāni.

example_1: kaṃ nu uddissa muṇḍ'āsi, samaṇī viya dissasi, na ca rocesi pāsaṇḍaṃ, kim'iva carasi momūhāti.
commentary: (SNa) samaṇī viya dissasī'ti samaṇisadisā dissasi.

example_1: samaṇ'īdha araṇā loke, samaṇānaṃ vusitaṃ na nassati, samaṇā icchaṃ parijānanti, samaṇānaṃ bhojissiyaṃ sadā
example_2: samaṇaṃ mātā pitā bhātā, vandanti naṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ, samaṇ'īdha jātihīnaṃ, abhivādenti khattiyā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) samaṇ'īdhā'ti samaṇaṃ idha.

example_1: so samaṇ'uddeso bhikkhūhi evam'assa vacanīyo, m'āvuso, samaṇ'uddesa evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya
example_2: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhikkhu yaññad'eva rattiṃ vā divaṃ vā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, tāva'd'ev'assa tibbaṃ hir'ottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti bhikkhūsu bhikkhunīsu upāsakesu upāsikāsu antamaso ārāmikasamaṇ'uddesesu.
commentary: (VIN 2.5.7.10) samaṇ'uddeso nāma sāmaṇero vuccati.

meaning_1: possessions of an ascetic; monastic property
example_1: buddho samāno kiṃ labhati? yāni tāni samaṇ'ārahāni samaṇ'aṅgāni samaṇ'ūpabhogāni samaṇ'ānucchavikāni, tāni khippaṃ paṭilabhati. buddho samāno idaṃ labhati.
commentary: (DNa) samaṇ'ūpabhogānī'ti samaṇānaṃ upabhogaparikkhārā.

meaning_1: contemplative practice; monk training; training in the skills of renunciation; (comm) meditation training
example_1: subhāsitassa sikkhetha, samaṇ'ūpāsanassa ca, ek'āsanassa ca raho, cittavūpasamassa cā'ti.
example_2: ek'āsanassa sikkhetha, samaṇ'ūpāsanassa ca, ekattaṃ monam'akkhātaṃ, eko ce abhiramissasi, atha bhāhisi dasadisā.
commentary: (SNa) samaṇ'ūpāsanassa cā'ti samaṇehi upāsitabbaṃ samaṇ'ūpāsanaṃ nāma aṭṭhatiṃsabhedaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ, tam'pi sikkheyya bhāveyyā'ti attho.

example_1: so samaten'eva sudaṃ janapadaṃ pasāsati. tassa samatena janapadaṃ pasāsato pubben'āparaṃ janapadā na pabbanti, yathā taṃ pubbakānaṃ rājūnaṃ ariye cakkavattivatte vattamānānaṃ.
commentary: (DNa) samatenā'ti attano matiyā.

example_1: tesaṃ no amhākaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena rasapathavī udakasmiṃ samatani.
commentary: (DNa) samatanī'ti patiṭṭhahi samantato patthari. (DNt) samatanī'ti sañchādentī vipphari, sā pana tasmiṃ udake patiṭṭhitā ahosī'ti āha patiṭṭhahī'ti.

example_1: mudusamatale pana phāsuvihāraṃ āgamma kammaṭṭhānaṃ sampajjati.
tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, soṇa, vīriyasamathaṃ adhiṭṭhahaṃ, indriyānañ'ca samataṃ paṭivijjha, tattha ca nimittaṃ gaṇhāhī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
commentary: (ANa) indriyānañ'ca samataṃ paṭivijjhā'ti saddh'ādīnaṃ indriyānaṃ samataṃ samabhāvaṃ adhiṭṭhāhi. tattha saddhaṃ paññāya, paññañ'ca saddhāya, vīriyaṃ samādhinā, samādhiñ'ca vīriyena yojayatā indriyānaṃ samatā adhiṭṭhitā nāma hoti. sati pana sabb'atthikā, sā sadā balavatī'y'eva vaṭṭati.

example_1: upadhī te samatikkantā, āsavā te padālitā, sīho'si anupādāno, pahīnabhayabheravo.
example_2: pūj'ārahe pūjayato, buddhe yadi va sāvake, papañcasamatikkante, tiṇṇasokapariddave.
commentary: (SNa) vidhā samatikkantan'ti mānakoṭṭhāse suṭṭhu atikkantaṃ.

meaning_1: fact of having surpassed; fact of having surmounted; fact of having transcended
construction:

samatikkanta + tta

example_1: sabbamaññitānaṃ tv'eva, bhikkhu, samatikkamā muni santo'ti vuccati. muni kho pana, bhikkhu, santo na jāyati, na jīyati, na mīyati, na kuppati, na piheti.
example_2: ek'āyano ayaṃ, bhikkhave, maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā
commentary: (ANa) samatikkamāyā'ti samatikkaman'atthāya.

example_1: tatra, bhikkhave, yāni cha nekkhammasitāni somanassāni tāni nissāya tāni āgamma yāni cha gehasitāni somanassāni tāni pajahatha, tāni samatikkamatha. evam'etesaṃ pahānaṃ hoti, evam'etesaṃ samatikkamo hoti.

meaning_2: should be overcome; should be transcended

meaning_1: having gone beyond; having passed over; having overstepped
example_1: atha kho, bhaggava, acelo kaḷāramaṭṭako nacirass'eva parihito sānucāriko vicaranto odanakummāsaṃ bhuñjamāno sabbān'eva vesāliyāni cetiyāni samatikkamitvā yasā nihīno kālam'akāsi.

santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā param'atthavisuddhiṃ paññāpenti. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, param'atthavisuddhiṃ paññāpentānaṃ yadidaṃ sabbaso ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
example_2: katamā c'āvuso, ākiñcaññā cetovimutti? idh'āvuso, bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, ākiñcaññā cetovimutti.

meaning_1: it set in; it established itself
example_1: tato me manasīkāro, yoniso udapajjatha, ādīnavo pāturahu, nibbidā samatiṭṭhatha.
commentary: (THa) nibbidā samatiṭṭhathā'ti nibbindanaṃ ādīnav'ānupassan'ānubhāva-siddhaṃ nibbidāñāṇaṃ mama hadaye saṇṭhāsi, muhuttam'pi tesaṃ rūp'ārūpadhammānaṃ gahaṇe cittaṃ n'āhosi, añña'd'atthu muñcitu'kāmat'ādi-vasena tattha udāsīnam'eva jātan'ti attho.

meaning_1: set in; became established; established itself
example_1: tato me manasīkāro, yoniso udapajjatha, ādīnavo pāturahu, nibbidā samatiṭṭhatha.

meaning_1: full to the top; even with the brim; level with the lip
example_1: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, udakamaṇiko ādhāre ṭhapito pūro udakassa samatittiko kākapeyyo. tam'enaṃ balavā puriso yato yato āvajjeyya, āgaccheyya udakan'ti? evaṃ, bhante.
example_2: samatittikaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggahessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā'ti.
commentary: (VINa) samatittikan'ti samapuṇṇaṃ samabharitaṃ. (DNa) samatittikā'ti samabharitā. (MNa) samatittikan'ti oṭṭhavaṭṭiyā heṭṭhimalekhāsamaṃ. (SNa) samatittikā'ti mukhavaṭṭisamā.

meaning_lit: rule about level with the brim (of the bowl)

meaning_1: stilling (of); serenity (of); calming (of); settling (of); peace (of); (comm) mental unification
example_1: kadā nu rūpe amite ca sadde, gandhe rase phusitabbe ca dhamme, ādittato'haṃ samathehi yutto, paññāya dacchaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.
example_2: etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānan'ti
commentary: (SNa) samatho'ti citt'ek'aggatā. (DhSa) kāmacchand'ādayo paccanīkadhamme sametī'ti samatho.

example_1: uppann'uppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāya sammukhāvinayo dātabbo, sativinayo dātabbo, amūḷhavinayo dātabbo, paṭiññāya kāretabbaṃ, yebhuyyasikā, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇ'avatthārako'ti.
example_2: ime kho pan'āyasmanto, satta adhikaraṇasamathā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.

example_1: samathaṃ paṭipādesiṃ, uttam'atthassa pattiyā, tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.

meaning_1: meditation subject of serenity; calming object of meditation

meaning_1: sign of mental stillness; basis for calming
example_1: atthi, bhikkhave, samathanimittaṃ abyagganimittaṃ. tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'āhāro anuppannassa vā samādhisambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā samādhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.
commentary: (SNa) samathanimittan'ti samatho'pi samathanimittaṃ, ārammaṇam'pi.

meaning_1: preceded by calm; with serenity first
example_1: idha, āvuso, bhikkhu samathapubbaṅ'gamaṃ vipassanaṃ bhāveti. tassa samathapubbaṅ'gamaṃ vipassanaṃ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati. so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
commentary: (ANa) samathapubbaṅ'gaman'ti samathaṃ pubbaṅ'gamaṃ purecārikaṃ katvā.

example_1: kati saṅkhār'upekkhā vipassanāvasena uppajjanti? aṭṭha saṅkhār'upekkhā samathavasena uppajjanti. dasa saṅkhār'upekkhā vipassanāvasena uppajjanti.
commentary: (PMa) samathavasenā'ti samādhivasena. ayam'eva vā pāṭho.

meaning_1: calm and insight; stilling and seeing; calmly observing
example_1: sīghaṃ dūtayuga'nti kho, bhikkhu, samathavipassanān'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. nagarassāmī'ti kho, bhikkhu, viññāṇass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. majjhe siṅghāṭako'ti kho, bhikkhu, catunn'etaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ adhivacanaṃ
example_2: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu samathavipassanaṃ yuganaddhaṃ bhāveti. tassa samathavipassanaṃ yuganaddhaṃ bhāvayato maggo sañjāyati. so taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.

tattha katamo samatho? yā cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti ṭhānaṃ paṭṭhānaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ samādhi samādhānaṃ avikkhepo avippaṭisāro vūpasamo mānaso ek'aggaṃ cittassa, ayaṃ samatho.
example_2: ken'aṭṭhena samādhī'ti samādhān'aṭṭhena samādhi. kim'idaṃ samādhānaṃ nāma? ekārammaṇe cittacetasikānaṃ samaṃ sammā ca ādhānaṃ, ṭhapanan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.
commentary: (MNt) samādhānato'ti sammā cittassa ādhānato ṭhapanato. (VISMa) cittacetasikānaṃ samaṃ avisāravasena sampiṇḍentassa viya ādhānaṃ samādhānaṃ. avisāralakkhaṇo hi samādhi, sampiṇḍanaraso ca. sammā avikkhipanavasena ādhānaṃ samādhānaṃ. avikkhepalakkhaṇo vā hi samādhi, vikkhepaviddhaṃsanaraso cā'ti. sv'āyaṃ yasmā ekārammaṇe cittassa ṭhitihetu, tasmā ṭhapanan'ti vuttaṃ hotī'ti āha.

meaning_1: for the benefit of stability of mind; for the advantage of meditative composure
example_1: samādhi yathābhūtañāṇadassan'attho yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ānisaṃso, sukhaṃ samādh'atthaṃ samādh'ānisaṃsaṃ, passaddhi sukh'atthā sukh'ānisaṃsā, pīti passaddh'atthā passaddh'ānisaṃsā
kandanti naṃ ñātī pakiriya kese, ahovatā no amarā'ti c'āhu, vatthena naṃ pārutaṃ nīharitvā, citaṃ samādhāya tatoḍahanti.

meaning_1: perfect peace of mind; stability of mind; stillness of mind; meditative composure
example_1: asso yathā bhadro kasāniviṭṭho, ātāpino saṃvegino bhavātha, saddhāya sīlena ca vīriyena ca, samādhinā dhammavinicchayena ca, sampannavijjācaraṇā patissatā, jahissatha dukkham'idaṃ anappakaṃ.
example_2: saddhassa hi, bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhavīriyassa upaṭṭhitassatino etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ vossagg'ārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhissati samādhiṃ, labhissati cittassa ek'aggataṃ.

example_1: ratho sīlaparikkhāro, jhān'akkho cakkavīriyo, upekkhā dhurasamādhi, anicchā parivāraṇaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) upekkhā dhurasamādhī'ti dhurassa samādhi, unnatonatākārassa abhāvena dvinnam'pi yugapadesānaṃ samatā'ti attho. ayañ'hi tatramajjhattupekkhā citt'uppādassa līn'uddhaccabhāvaṃ haritvā payogamajjhatte cittaṃ ṭhapeti, tasmā imassa maggarathassa, dhurasamādhī'ti vuttā.

example_1: ek'ūnatiṃso vayasā subhadda, yaṃ pabbajiṃ kiṃkusal'ānuesī, vassāni paññāsa samādhikāni, yato ahaṃ pabbajito subhadda.
example_2: vassāni paññāsa samādhikāni, vasimha selassa guhāya romaka, asaṅkamānā abhinibbutattā, hatth'attam'āyanti mam'aṇḍajā pure.
commentary: (JAa) samādhikānī'ti sama-adhikāni.

meaning_1: talk about stability of mind; discussion about meditative composure
example_1: seyyath'idaṃ, appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṃsaggakathā vīriy'ārambhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā

meaning_1: expert in meditative stability; skilled in internal peace; (comm) skilled in defining the factors of samādhi
example_1: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yv'āyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro cā'ti.
example_2: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo. idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo.
commentary: (SNa) samādhikusalo'ti paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ pañc'aṅgikaṃ dutiyaṃ ti'v'aṅgikan'ti evaṃ aṅgavavatthānakusalo.

meaning_1: category of mental stability; class of meditative composure
example_1: yo ca sammāvāyāmo yā ca sammāsati yo ca sammāsamādhi ime dhammā samādhikkhandhe saṅgahitā. yā ca sammādiṭṭhi yo ca sammāsaṅkappo, ime dhammā paññākkhandhe saṅgahitā'ti.

meaning_1: valuing stability of mind; giving weight to meditative composure
example_1: katame cattāro? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo na sīlagaru hoti na sīl'ādhipateyyo, na samādhigaru hoti na samādh'ādhipateyyo, na paññāgaru hoti na paññ'ādhipateyyo.
commentary: (VISMa) sā pana yasmā samādhiṃ garuṃ katvā tattha ninnapoṇapabbhārabhāvena pavattiyā hoti, tasmā samādhigarū'ti-ādi vuttaṃ.

meaning_1: highest meditative composure; superior stability of mind
example_1: katamāni cattāri? sīl'aggaṃ, samādhi'ggaṃ, paññā'ggaṃ, vimutt'aggaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri aggānī'ti.
commentary: (ANa) sīl'aggan'ti aggappattaṃ uttamasīlaṃ. es'eva nayo sabbattha.

meaning_1: born from stable mind; produced by samadhi; produced by meditative composure
example_1: tassa mayhaṃ āvuso, etadahosi, idha bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.

example_1: tassa samādhijapītisukh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti samādhija-pītisukh'assāda-gadhitaṃ samādhija-pītisukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ samādhijapītisukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.

example_1: tassa samādhijapītisukh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti samādhija-pītisukh'assāda-gadhitaṃ samādhija-pītisukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ samādhijapītisukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: following the joy and happiness born from stability of mind
example_1: tassa samādhijapītisukh'ānusāri viññāṇaṃ hoti samādhija-pītisukh'assāda-gadhitaṃ samādhija-pītisukh'assāda-vinibandhaṃ samādhijapītisukh'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan'ti vuccati.

meaning_1: with a stable mind; with meditative composure; with samādhi
construction:
saṃ + ā + √dhā + i + inā
samādhi + inā
example_1: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā, abhibhuyya disā sabbā, appamāṇasamādhinā.
commentary: (ANa) appamāṇasamādhinā'ti arahattamaggasamādhinā. (UDa) āneñjasamādhinā'ti catutthajjhānapādakena aggaphalasamādhinā, arūpajjhānapādakenā'ti'pi vadanti. āneñjena samādhinā'ti'pi pāṭho.

meaning_1: cause for meditative composure; basis for mental stillness
example_1: adhicittam'anuyuttena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tīṇi nimittāni kālena kālaṃ manasi kātabbāni, kālena kālaṃ samādhinimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ, kālena kālaṃ paggahanimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ, kālena kālaṃ upekkhānimittaṃ manasi kātabbaṃ.
example_2: katamo pan'āyye, samādhi, katame dhammā samādhinimittā, katame dhammā samādhiparikkhārā, katamā samādhibhāvanā'ti?
commentary: (ANa) kālena kālaṃ samādhinimittaṃ manasikātabban'ti-ādīsu taṃ taṃ kālaṃ sallakkhetvā ek'aggatāya yuttakāle ek'aggatā manasikātabbā. ek'aggatā hi idha samādhinimittan'ti vuttā. tatra vacan'attho, samādhi'y'eva nimittaṃ samādhinimittaṃ.

meaning_1: power of a collected mind; faculty of meditative stability
example_1: aparāni'pi pañc'indriyāni saddh'indriyaṃ vīriy'indriyaṃ sat'indriyaṃ samādh'indriyaṃ paññ'indriyaṃ
example_2: tassa cittaṃ rakkhato āsavesu ca sāsavesu ca dhammesu… samādh'indriyam'pi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati. paññindriyam'pi bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati.

compound_construction: samādhi ca paññā ca vimutti ca

meaning_1: state of meditative composure; attainment of mental peace
example_1: siyā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā imasmiñ'ca saviññāṇake kāye ahaṅ'kāra-mamaṅ'kāra-mān'ānusayā n'āssu
example_2: siyā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā n'eva pathaviyaṃ pathavisaññī assa
commentary: (ANa) samādhipaṭilābho'ti citt'ek'aggatālābho.

meaning_1: requisite ingredient of mental stability; requirement for meditative composure
example_1: katamo pan'āyye, samādhi, katame dhammā samādhinimittā, katame dhammā samādhiparikkhārā, katamā samādhibhāvanā'ti?

meaning_1: nurtured by stability of mind; fortified by meditative composure
example_1: sīlaparibhāvito samādhi mahapphalo hoti mah'ānisaṃso. samādhiparibhāvitā paññā mahapphalā hoti mah'ānisaṃsā. paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ samma'd'eva āsavehi vimuccati, seyyath'idaṃ, kām'āsavā, bhav'āsavā, avijj'āsavā'ti.

meaning_1: headed by stillness; with meditative stability in front
example_1: te pana, samiddhi, kiṃsamudayā'ti? phassasamudayā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃsamosaraṇā'ti? vedanāsamosaraṇā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃpamukhā'ti? samādhippamukhā, bhante'ti.
example_2: samādhippamukhā sabbe dhammā, sat'ādhipateyyā sabbe dhammā, paññ'uttarā sabbe dhammā, vimuttisārā sabbe dhammā, amat'ogadhā sabbe dhammā, nibbānapariyosānā sabbe dhammā'ti.

meaning_1: power that is meditative composure; strength of perfect peace of mind
example_1: puna caparaṃ, udāyi, akkhātā mayā sāvakānaṃ paṭipadā, yathāpaṭipannā me sāvakā pañca balāni bhāventi. idh'udāyi, bhikkhu samādhibalaṃ bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ. tatra ca pana me sāvakā bahū abhiññāvosānapāramippattā viharanti.
commentary: (DNa) samādhibalan'ti uddhacce akampanavasena samādhi'y'eva.

meaning_1: development of mental stability; cultivation of meditative composure
example_1: atthi, bhikkhave, samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satisampajaññāya saṃvattati, atthi, bhikkhave, samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattati.
example_2: katamo pan'āyye, samādhi, katame dhammā samādhinimittā, katame dhammā samādhiparikkhārā, katamā samādhibhāvanā'ti?

meaning_1: is calmed; becomes collected; becomes composed; becomes stable (for)
example_1: passaddhisambojjh'aṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati. passaddhakāyassa sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati.
example_2: tassa kāye kāy'ānupassino viharato cittaṃ na samādhiyati, upakkilesā na pahīyanti. so taṃ nimittaṃ na uggaṇhāti.
commentary: (MNa) samādhiyatī'ti sammā ṭhapiyati, appanāpattaṃ viya hoti. (ANa) samādhiyatī'ti ārammaṇe sammā ṭhapitaṃ hoti.

meaning_1: attainment of mental stillness; success in stability of mind; being accomplished in meditative composure
example_1: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca samādhisampanno samādhisampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā
example_2: appamatto samāno samādhisampadaṃ ārādheti. so tāya samādhisampadāya attamano hoti paripuṇṇasaṅkappo. so tāya samādhisampadāya attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti, aham'asmi samāhito ek'aggacitto, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū asamāhitā vibbhantacittā'ti.

meaning_1: talk about the attainment of mental stillness; discussion about success in meditative composure
example_1: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca samādhisampanno samādhisampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

meaning_1: for the benefit of attaining mental stillness; for the advantage of accomplishment in meditative composure
example_1: iti kho, bhikkhave, na'y'idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ lābhasakkārasilok'ānisaṃsaṃ, na sīlasampad'ānisaṃsaṃ, na samādhisampad'ānisaṃsaṃ, na ñāṇadassan'ānisaṃsaṃ. yā ca kho ayaṃ, bhikkhave, akuppā cetovimutti, etadattham'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ, etaṃ sāraṃ etaṃ pariyosānan'ti.

meaning_1: skilled in mental stillness; with good meditation; accomplished in meditative composure
example_1: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū sīlasampannā samādhisampannā ñāṇasampannā vimuttisampannā vimuttiñāṇadassanasampannā, dassanam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahukāraṃ vadāmi
example_2: ko nu kho, bhikkhave, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ evaṃ sambhāvito… attanā ca samādhisampanno samādhisampadākathañ'ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā

meaning_1: more skilled in meditative composure; more accomplished in stability of mind (than)
example_1: na kho pan'āhaṃ passāmi sadevake loke … attanā samādhisampannataraṃ aññaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā, yam'ahaṃ sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya vihareyyaṃ.
commentary: (SNa) sīlasampannataran'ti sīlena sampannataraṃ, adhikataran'ti attho. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo. ettha ca sīl'ādayo cattāro dhammā lokiyalok'uttarā kathitā, vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ lokiyam'eva. paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ h'etaṃ.

meaning_1: stability of mind as an element of awakening; meditative composure as a factor of enlightenment
meaning_2: concentration as a constituent of awakening
example_1: yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno passaddhakāyassa sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati, samādhisambojjh'aṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno āraddho hoti.
example_2: yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, akālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo samādhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya.

meaning_1: leading to samadhi; conducive to meditative composure
example_1: puna caparaṃ, mahānāma, ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni.
commentary: (DNa) upacārasamādhiṃ vā appanāsamādhiṃ vā saṃvattayantī'ti samādhisaṃvattanikānī'ti vuccanti. (ANa) samādhisaṃvattanikānī'ti maggasamādhi-phalasamādhi-nibbattakāni.

meaning_1: for whom meditative composure is the (whole of) monkhood; equating samādhi with ascetic life
example_1: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, taṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhato evaṃ hoti, no c'ass'āhaṃ parihāyāmī'ti. ye te, assaji, samaṇabrāhmaṇā samādhisārakā samādhisāmaññā tesaṃ taṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhataṃ evaṃ hoti, no c'assu mayaṃ parihāyāmā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) samādhisārakā samādhisāmaññā'ti samādhiṃ'y'eva sārañ'ca sāmaññañ'ca maññanti. mayhaṃ pana sāsane na etaṃ sāraṃ, vipassanāmaggaphalāni sāraṃ. so tvaṃ samādhito parihāyanto kasmā cintesi sāsanato parihāyāmī'ti.

meaning_1: with meditative composure in common; with similar stability of mind
example_1: samādhisāmaññagatānaṃ sataṃ samādhikathā ca no bhavissati, sā ca no pavattinī bhavissati, sā ca no phāsu bhavissati. paññāsāmaññagatānaṃ sataṃ paññākathā ca no bhavissati, sā ca no pavattinī bhavissati, sā ca no phāsu bhavissatī'ti.
katame cattāro? sīlasāro, samādhisāro, paññāsāro, vimuttisāro, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro sārā'ti.

meaning_1: for whom meditative composure is the essence; taking meditative composure as essential
example_1: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, taṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhato evaṃ hoti, no c'ass'āhaṃ parihāyāmī'ti. ye te, assaji, samaṇabrāhmaṇā samādhisārakā samādhisāmaññā tesaṃ taṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhataṃ evaṃ hoti, no c'assu mayaṃ parihāyāmā'ti.
commentary: (SNa) samādhisārakā samādhisāmaññā'ti samādhiṃ'y'eva sārañ'ca sāmaññañ'ca maññanti. mayhaṃ pana sāsane na etaṃ sāraṃ, vipassanāmaggaphalāni sāraṃ. so tvaṃ samādhito parihāyanto kasmā cintesi sāsanato parihāyāmī'ti.

meaning_1: pleasure of meditative composure; happiness of perfect peace of mind
example_1: katamāni dve? samādhisukhañ'ca asamādhisukhañ'ca. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve sukhāni.

example_1: tena kho pana samayena dve bhikkhū sampayojesuṃ, tatr'eko bhikkhu accasarā, atha kho so bhikkhu tassa bhikkhuno santike accayaṃ accayato deseti, so bhikkhu nappaṭiggaṇhāti.

meaning_1: comfort in the future; ease in the next life
